data/maps/AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice/s.AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_NoSucc: I'm investigating this ship on behalf\nof CAPT. STERN.\pHe also asked me to find a SCANNER,\nbut I haven't had any success…$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice/s.AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_OhCanY: Oh! That's a SCANNER!\pListen, can I get you to deliver that\nto CAPT. STERN?\pI want to investigate this ship a\nlittle more.$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice/s.AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_ThisIs: This ship is called S.S. CACTUS.\nIt seems to be from an earlier era.$

data/maps/AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F/scr.AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieI: What's so funny about having my inner\ntube aboard the ship?$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F/scr.AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieP: It's not easy throwing POKé BALLS\nwhile hanging on to an inner tube!$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F/scr.AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_IsntItFu: Isn't it fun here?\nI get excited just being here!$

data/maps/AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F/sc.AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanI: When we go out to sea, we SAILORS\nalways bring our POKéMON.\lHow about a quick battle?$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F/sc.AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanP: The ship's bottom has sunk into the\ndepths.\pIf a POKéMON knew how to go underwater,\nwe might make some progress…$

data/maps/AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorRooms.AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorRooms_Text_Brig: It's bright and shiny!\nBut it's just trash…$

data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanIntro: DAN: While searching for treasures,\nwe discovered a TRAINER!$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanDefeat: DAN: We couldn't win even though\nwe worked together…$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostBatt: DAN: We can't find any treasures…\nI wonder if someone got them already?$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanNotEnoug: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON.\nYou can't expect to beat us like that.$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraIntro: KIRA: Oh?\nWe were searching for treasures.\lBut we discovered a TRAINER instead!$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostBat: KIRA: Where could the treasures be?\pI've already decided what I'm buying\nwhen we find the treasures!$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraNotEnou: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?\nWe'll have to battle some other time!$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRegiste: KIRA: Oh, you make me so angry!\nI'm going to register you for that!$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchI: DAN: We've been searching for\ntreasures all this time.\pOur POKéMON have grown stronger, too.\nLet us show you, okay?$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostRema: DAN: We can't find any treasures,\nwe lose at POKéMON…\pI want to go home… But if I say that,\nshe gets all angry with me…$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchN: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON.\nYou can't expect to beat us like that.$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematch: KIRA: Oh? We meet again!\pJust like us, you still haven't given up\nsearching for treasures, have you?\pWant to make it so the loser has\nto give up searching?$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostRem: KIRA: We're not leaving until we raise\nour POKéMON some more and we find\lthe treasures here!$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematch: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?\nWe'll have to battle some other time!$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniIntro: I'm not good at swimming,\nbut I am good at battles!$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniPostBat: Walking around barefoot in this ship\nis kind of gross.$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonInt: Strength and compassion…\nThose are a TRAINER's treasures!$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonDef: Ah, there is something about you\nthat sparkles.$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonPos: In a cabin somewhere on board,\nI saw something sparkle.$

data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms2_B1F/scrip.AbandonedShip_Rooms2_B1F_Text_PerfectPla: This is a perfect place to go exploring!\nIt's exciting here!\pI bet there're amazing treasures on\nboard.$

data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F/scripts.AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_TakingALookA: Ships of this sort are rare, so I'm\ntaking a look around.\pHmhm…\nThere appear to be other cabins…$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F/scripts.AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaIntro: What on earth would compel you to\ncome here? You must be curious!$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F/scripts.AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaDefeat: Not just curious, but also strong…$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F/scripts.AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostBa: The man next door…\pHe says he's just sightseeing,\nbut I don't know about that.$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F/scripts.AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRegist: You're such a tough TRAINER!\nLet me register you as a memento!$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F/scripts.AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRematc: What on earth would compel you to\ncome back? You must really be curious!$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F/scripts.AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostRe: I'm sure that man's up to something!\nHe just acts so suspiciously!$
data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F/scripts.AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusPos: I'm in trouble with my mom, so I ran.\nKeep it a secret where I am!$

data/maps/AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F/script.AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQuea: Urrrrppp…\pI'm getting queasy just being aboard\nthis ship…\pIt's not even moving, but…$

data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_House_Sign_Text_0: AKALA VILLA\pA place for visitors to stay while\non AKALA ISLE.$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_OldManOnBench_Text_0: Ah the weather is so nice today,\nisn't it?\pI was just feeding the NATU and this\none decided to join me on my bench!$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_TotemBattle_Text_1: Totem MAGMORTAR was defeated!\nIt scampered off somewhere…$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_TotemBattle_Text_3: Totem PROBOPASS was defeated!\nIt scampered off somewhere…$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_Totem_sign_Text_0: The totem is emanating a strong\nenergy…\pTouch the totem to teleport to another\nIsle?$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_Totem_sign_Text_5: A strange totem stands here,\npower is emanating from it…$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_0: I came to the ISLES to hike the\nmountains!$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_2: AKALA ISLE has the best hiking!\nIt's got lush forests and rugged trails!$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_: Ha! Didn't see me, did you?$
I guess the element of surprise isn't\nalways super effective…$
It's so lush on AKALA ISLE,\nI can easily hide in the trees!$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_0: I want to be the first to prove myself\nto the Totem POKéMON!$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_1: Drat,\nthat's not going to help my case.$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_2: There's a weird Totem further ahead but\nI haven't seen a Totem POKéMON.$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerLand_Tex: Hey! No shoes on the beach!$
Ouch,\nwhere's a lifeguard when you need one…$
AKALA ISLE has the best beaches!\nIt's got soft sand and clear waters!$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerWater_Te: Out of my way!\nI'm swimming laps!$
Not the break I was looking for…$
ULA'ULA ISLE has the best beaches!\nIgnore anyone who says otherwise!$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerWaterM_T: Hah!\nYou need to ride a POKéMON to surf?$
If I hadn't swam myself\nmaybe I would've had the energy to win…$
The current out here is strong!\nA POKéMON must be really powerful to\lmigrate all the way out to the ISLES!$
data/maps/AkalaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_Bench_Heal_Text_0: Would you like to take a rest on this\nbench?$

data/maps/Akala_Cave_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_: You must be tough if you made it all the\nway up here!$
I had to stop climbing because it was\ngetting far too hot.\pIt's like someone's got a fire going\nup on the peak…$
data/maps/Akala_Cave_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattlePicnicker_T: I'm tired from all this walking,\nlet's have a battle!$
I'm usually not this tired but\nthe heat in this cave is exhausting!$
data/maps/Akala_Cave_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattleCamper_Text: Check me out!\nI caught some strong POKéMON!$
Is it warm in here or is it just me?$

data/maps/Akala_Forest_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_AkalaForest_TrainerBattleBugCatche: Look at all the cool bugs here on the \nISLES!$
The ISLES are far away from other land,\nso Bug-type POKéMON here must have\ladapted to the environment.$
The climate is a bit different on the\nALOLA ISLES…\pI'm sure that's why there are some\nunique Bug-type POKéMON here.$

data/maps/Akala_House_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Akala_House_OldWoman_Text_0: I tell my husband everyday not to feed\nthe NATU, but he never listens!\pOne day he'll bring one of those darn\nthings home, I just know it!$

data/maps/AlolaWater_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_MelemeleSea_TrainerBattleSwimmer_T: There are some strong currents here.\nI think it attracts strong POKéMON!$

data/maps/AquaHideout_1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_1F_Text_OurBossIsSnatchingSo:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here! He's gone off to
snatch something important!\p… …
Where did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$
data/maps/AquaHideout_1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_1F_Text_WhereMightMagmaHideo: What? What?\nAre you a TEAM MAGMA grunt?\pI hear that TEAM MAGMA is trying to\nawaken an awesome POKéMON at their\lHIDEOUT.\pBut where might their HIDEOUT be?$
data/maps/AquaHideout_1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossWentToJackASubma:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here!
He's gone off to jack a submarine!\p… …
Where did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$
data/maps/AquaHideout_1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsOnRoute122:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here! He's on his way to
MT. PYRE on ROUTE 122!\p… …
Why did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$
data/maps/AquaHideout_1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_1F_Text_TeamMagmaAtMtChimney: What? What?\nAre you a TEAM MAGMA grunt?\pI hear that TEAM MAGMA is after\nan awesome POKéMON at MT. CHIMNEY.\pBut what is that POKéMON like?$
data/maps/AquaHideout_1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsInSlateportCit:
What? What? What do you want with
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here!
He's on his way to SLATEPORT CITY!\p… …
Why did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$
data/maps/AquaHideout_1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: I took the loss for the TEAM,\nbut I did my job…$

data/maps/AquaHideout_B1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro: If you want to know the secret about\nour HIDEOUT, you have me to beat!$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: Our HIDEOUT's secret?\pWell, let's just say…\nThere's a submarine at the far end!\pBut, by now…\nKekekeke…$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro: Fuel supply loaded A-OK!\nIn-cruise snacks loaded A-OK!\pNothing left to do but KO a pesky\nmeddler!$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle: Humph!\nThis was supposed to happen!\pMy mission was to just hold you up!$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro: Yawn… Keeping watch over the\nHIDEOUT bores me. I'll take you on.$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle: If you scurry too much, other TEAM\nAQUA members might get you.$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Intro: Hey!\nYou there!\pWhich do you think is cooler?\nTEAM AQUA's uniform or TEAM MAGMA's?$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Defeat: I lost in a cool way…$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B1F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7PostBattle: If you have a cool uniform, you look\ngood even in a loss, don't you think?$

data/maps/AquaHideout_B2F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro:
Hehehe…\pGot here already, did you?
We underestimated you!\pBut this is it!\pI'm a cut above the GRUNTS you've seen
so far.\pI'm not stalling for time.
I'm going to pulverize you!$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B2F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B2F_Text_OurBossGotThroughHi: Hehehe!\pWhile I was toying with you, our BOSS\ngot through his preparations!$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B2F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle:
Hehehe!\pOur BOSS has already gone on his way to
some cave under the sea!\pIf you're going to give chase, you'd
better search the big, wide sea beyond\lLILYCOVE.\pBut will you find it then?
Hehehe!$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B2F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro: Wahahah, I grew weary of waiting!\nYou owe me a battle, too!$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B2F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Intro:
Warp panels, the HIDEOUT's pride
and joy!\pYou're clueless about where you are,
aren't you?\pFluster and tire out the enemy, then
lower the boom! That's our plan!$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B2F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Defeat: What's wrong with you?\nYou're not tired at all!$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B2F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle: That reminds me… I can't remember\nwhere I put the MASTER BALL.\pIf I fail to guard it, our BOSS will\nchew me out…$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B2F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Intro: When I joined TEAM AQUA, the first\nthing I had to learn was how these\lwarp panels connected.$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B2F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Defeat: I was too occupied thinking about\nthe warp panels…$
data/maps/AquaHideout_B2F/scripts.inc.AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8PostBattle: I'll have to learn about how I can\nbattle more effectively…$

data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified: AZALEA TOWN POKéMON GYM\pBUGSY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyIntro:
I'm BUGSY!\pI never lose when it comes
to bug POKéMON.\pMy research is going to make me the
authority on bug POKéMON!\pLet me demonstrate all I've
learned from my studies.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyBeaten:
Whoa, amazing! You're an
expert on POKéMON!\pMy research isn't complete
yet.\pOK, you win. Take this
BADGE.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_HiveBadgeSpeech:
Do you know the benefits
of HIVEBADGE?\pIf you have it, POKéMON up
to L30 will obey you,\leven traded ones.\pPOKéMON that know CUT will be able
to use it outside of battle too.\pHere, I also want you to
have this.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_FuryCutterSpeech: TM89 contains U-TURN.\pU-TURN lets you do damage and\nswitch your POKéMON in the same\lturn!\pIsn't that great?\nI discovered it!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyAdvice: Bug POKéMON are deep. There are\nmany mysteries to be explored.\pStudy your favorites thoroughly.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyRematch: Wow, you're the JOHTO CHAMPION now!\pYour skills are truly impressive!\pI've been busy with my research.\pI'm ready to show you my new\nfindings.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyRematchDefeat: Wow, you must be an expert trainer.\nMy research must not be complete...$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherBennySeen: Bug POKéMON evolve young. So they\nget stronger that much faster.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherBennyAfter: POKéMON become stronger\nif they evolve. Really!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherAlSeen: Bug POKéMON are cool and tough!\nI'll prove it to you!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherAlBeaten: You proved how tough you are…$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherAlAfter: They're so cool, but most girls\ndon't like bug POKéMON.\pI don't know why…$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherJoshSeen: You saved all the SLOWPOKE?\nWhew, you're mighty!\pBut my grown-up POKéMON are\npretty tough too!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherJoshAfter: I guess I should teach them\nbetter moves…$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay1Seen: AMY: Hi! Are you challenging\nthe LEADER? No way!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay1After: AMY: You're really strong!\pBut BUGSY's even stronger!\nHis SCYTHER's CUT almost\lalways makes critical hits!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay2Seen: MAY: You want to see the\nLEADER? Good luck!\pBUGSY is so strong!\nHis SCYTHER's CUT always\lseems to crit!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay2After: MAY: Our bug POKéMON lost!\nOh, what a shame.\pBUGSY's won't lose though!\pHis PINECO makes short work\nof ROCK-type POKéMON!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymGuide:
Yo, challenger!\pBUGSY's young, but his knowledge
of bug POKéMON is for real.\pIt's going to be tough
without my advice.\pLet's see… BUGSY's bagworm POKéMON
knows a move that covers its\lROCK-type weakness.\pOh, and don't forget about those
nasty critical hits! Good luck!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideWin: Well done! That was a great\nclash of talented young trainers.\pWith people like you, the\nfuture of POKéMON is bright!$

data/maps/AzaleaTown_House1_hns/scripts..CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss1:
All the SLOWPOKE have disappeared
from the town.\pThe forest's protector may be
angry with us…\pIt may be a bad omen. We should
stay in.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_House1_hns/scripts..CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss3: The SLOWPOKE have returned…\pBut my APPRENTICE hasn't come back\nfrom ILEX FOREST.\pWhere in the world is that lazy guy?$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_House1_hns/scripts..CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss4: You chased off TEAM ROCKET and\nwent to ILEX FOREST alone?\pThat takes guts! I like that.\nCome train with us.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_House1_hns/scripts..CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice1: Where have all the SLOWPOKE gone?\pAre they out playing somewhere?$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_House1_hns/scripts..CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice3: I'm sorry--I forgot to thank you.\pThis is CHARCOAL that I made.\pFIRE-type POKéMON would be happy\nto hold that.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_House1_hns/scripts..CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice4: The SLOWPOKE came back, and you even\nfound FARFETCH'D.\pYou're the coolest, man!$

data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_BallAnyway: Anyway, can I make you some BALLS?$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_KurtGetStarted: KURT: I'll get started right now!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_KurtMakingBallsMustWait:
Hm? Who are you?\p{PLAYER}, eh? You want me to make
some BALLS?\pSorry, but that'll have to wait.\pDo you know TEAM ROCKET?
Ah, don't worry.\pI'll tell you anyhow.\pTEAM ROCKET's an evil gang that
uses POKéMON for their dirty work.\pThey're supposed to have disbanded
three years ago.\pAnyway, they're at the WELL,
cutting off SLOWPOKETAILS to sell!\pSo I'm going to go give them a
lesson in pain!\pHang on, SLOWPOKE! Old KURT
is on his way!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_KurtHonoredToMakeBalls:
KURT: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pYou handled yourself like a
real hero at the WELL.\pI like your style!\pI would be honored to make
BALLS for a trainer like you.\pThis is all I have now, 
but take it.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_KurtBallsFromApricorns: KURT: I make BALLS from BERRIES.\pCollect them from trees and bring\n'em to me.\pI'll make POKé BALLS out of them.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_KurtAskYouHaveAnApricorn: KURT: You have BERRIES for me?\pFine! I'll turn them into POKé BALLS.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_KurtTurnedOutGreat: KURT: That turned out great.\pTry catching POKéMON with it.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_KurtWhatIsThat: Wh-what is that?\pI've never seen one before.\pIt looks a like a POKé BALL, but\nit appears to be something else.\pLet me check it for you.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_KurtThisBallStartedToSha: {PLAYER}!\pThis BALL started to shake\nwhile I was checking it.\pThere must be something to this!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_Kurt_Whatwasthat: What was that sound?!\pLet's go outside to investigate!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterSlowpokeGon: The SLOWPOKE are gone… \nWere they taken away by bad people?$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterSlowpokeBac: The SLOWPOKE my dad gave me came back!\pIts TAIL is growing back too!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterDad: Dad works at SILPH where\nhe studies POKé BALLS.\pI have to stay home\nwith Grandpa and SLOWPOKE.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterHelp: I get to help Grandpa now!\pWe'll make good BALLS\nfor you, so please wait!$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterSound: Did that sound come from\nILEX FOREST????$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_Forest: Did you check ILEX FOREST yet?\nIt sounds very restless.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_KurtsHouse_hns/scri.KurtsHouse_Text_CelebiStatue: It's a statue of the forest's\nprotector.$

data/maps/AzaleaTown_Mart_hns/scripts.in.AzaleaMart_Text_CooltrainerM:
Are you able to buy a GREAT BALL?
All I can buy are POKé BALLS.\pI heard that more items become
available to buy when you earn\lGYM BADGES!\pI wish KURT would make me some
of his custom BALLS.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_Mart_hns/scripts.in.AzaleaMart_Text_BugCatcher: A GREAT BALL is better for catch-\ning POKéMON than a POKé BALL.\pBut KURT's might be better some-\ntimes.$

data/maps/AzaleaTown_PokemonCenter_hns/s.AzaleaPokecenter_Text_Gentleman: Do your POKéMON know HM moves?\pThose moves can be used even if\nyour POKéMON has fainted.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_PokemonCenter_hns/s.AzaleaPokecenter_Text_UnusedPCExplanatio: This BILL guy created the system\nfor storing POKéMON in a PC.\pBILL's PC can store up to 30\nPOKéMON per BOX.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_PokemonCenter_hns/s.AzaleaPokecenter_Text_FishingGuru: BILL's PC can store up to 30\nPOKéMON per BOX.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_PokemonCenter_hns/s.AzaleaPokecenter_Text_PokefanF: Do you know about BERRIES?\pCrack one open, hollow it out and\nfit it with a special device.\pThen you can catch POKéMON with it.\pBefore POKé BALLS were invented,\neveryone used BERRIES.$

data/maps/AzaleaTown_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Text_RivalBefore:
…Tell me something.\pIs it true that TEAM ROCKET
has returned?\pWhat? You beat them? Hah! Quit
lying.\pYou're not joking?
Then let's see how good you are.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Text_RivalWin: …Humph! Useless POKéMON!\pListen, you. You only won because\nmy POKéMON were weak.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Text_RivalAfter:
I hate the weak.\pPOKéMON, trainers. It doesn't
matter who or what.\pI'm going to be strong and wipe
out the weak.\pThat goes for TEAM ROCKET too.\pThey act big and tough in a group.\pBut get them alone, and they're weak.
I hate them all.\pYou stay out of my way. A weakling
like you is only a distraction.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Text_Rocket1: It's unsafe to go in there,\nso I'm standing guard.\pAren't I a good Samaritan?$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Text_Rocket2: Do you know about SLOWPOKETAIL?\nI heard it's tasty!\pAren't you glad I told you that?$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Text_GrampsBefore: The SLOWPOKE have disappeared\nfrom town…\pI heard their TAILS are being\nsold somewhere.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Text_GrampsAfter: The SLOWPOKE have returned.\pKnowing them, they could've just\nbeen goofing off somewhere.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Text_Teacher: Did you come to get KURT to make\nsome BALLS?\pA lot of people do just that.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Text_Youngster:
Cut through AZALEA and you'll be
in ILEX FOREST.\pBut these skinny trees make it
impossible to get through.\pThe CHARCOAL MAN's POKéMON
can CUT down trees.$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Text_Kurt1: ILEX FOREST is restless!\pWhat is going on?$
data/maps/AzaleaTown_hns/scripts.inc.AzaleaTown_Text_Kurt3: Could you go see why ILEX FOREST\nis so restless?$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobb.BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_Wel: Where the battling spirit of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pI welcome you to the BATTLE ARENA!\pI am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobb.BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_Wis: Now, do you wish to take\nthe BATTLE ARENA challenge?$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobb.BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_Exp:
In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake
the Set KO Tourney.\pAll participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.\pThe three POKéMON must be lined up in
the order in which they are to appear.\pDuring battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.\pOnce a POKéMON enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.\pIf a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.\pIf you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.\pIf you pull off the feat of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.$

POKéMON is totally important.\pFor example, if your first POKéMON
has certain type disadvantages,\ltry making your second POKéMON one\lwith moves that are super effective\lagainst the first one.\pI think that will be a good way of
making an effective team.$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobb.BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_Exp:
The Set KO Tourney has special rules,
unlike standard battles.\pFirst, one battle lasts only
three turns.\pIf the outcome is not decided after
three turns, it goes to judging.\pThe REFEREE will choose the winner
based on how the POKéMON battled.\pAlso, a POKéMON cannot be switched out
until its battle's outcome is decided.$
The first judging factor is “Mind.”\nThis factor evaluates how aggressive\lthe battlers were.\pThe judging is based on how often\nthe TRAINERS ordered the use of\loffensive moves.$

The second judging factor is “Skill.”
This factor evaluates how effectively\lPOKéMON moves were used.\pIf a move worked successfully,
the Skill rating goes up.\pIf a move failed, the Skill rating
is lowered.\pIf it was an offensive move, the Skill
rating goes up if the move was “super\leffective” and goes down if it was\l“not very effective.”\pThe Skill rating will not go up for
moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.\pIf the opponent used PROTECT or
DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to\lhit with a move, its Skill rating will not\lgo down.$

The third judging factor is “Body.”\nThis factor is based on how much HP\lremained at the end of a battle.\pThe rating takes into account how much\nHP a POKéMON had at the start of\lbattle, and what remained at the end.$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobb.BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_Exp:
The Set KO Tourney has special rules,
unlike standard battles.\pFirst, one battle lasts only
three turns.\pIf the outcome is not decided after
three turns, it goes to judging.\pThe REFEREE will choose the winner
based on how the POKéMON battled.\pAlso, a POKéMON cannot be switched out
until its battle's outcome is decided.$
The first judging factor is “Mind.”\nThis factor evaluates how aggressive\lthe battlers were.\pThe judging is based on how often\nthe TRAINERS ordered the use of\loffensive moves.$

The second judging factor is “Skill.”
This factor evaluates how effectively\lPOKéMON moves were used.\pIf a move worked successfully,
the Skill rating goes up.\pIf a move failed, the Skill rating
is lowered.\pIf it was an offensive move, the Skill
rating goes up if the move was “super\leffective” and goes down if it was\l“not very effective.”\pThe Skill rating will not go up for
moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.\pIf the opponent used PROTECT or
DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to\lhit with a move, its Skill rating will not\lgo down.$

The third judging factor is “Body.”\nThis factor is based on how much HP\lremained at the end of a battle.\pThe rating takes into account how much\nHP a POKéMON had at the start of\lbattle, and what remained at the end.$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby.BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_Expl:
The SINGLE BATTLE Tournament
is exactly as the name suggests--\la tournament of SINGLE BATTLES.\pAll participating TRAINERS must
enter three POKéMON each.\pIn each battle, one of the three
POKéMON must be held in reserve.\pThe other two POKéMON can battle
one at a time.\pChoose the two battling POKéMON after
examining the opponent's trio.\pYou win the tournament by defeating
four TRAINERS.\pBattle Points are awarded to
the tournament winner.\pIf you want to interrupt your
tournament, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLob.BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_Ex: Here, POKéMON are required to think\nand battle by themselves.\pUnlike in the wild, POKéMON that live\nwith people behave differently\ldepending on their nature.$

Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.\pAnother POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.\pYet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.\pDue to its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good\lat using.\pIt may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.$

There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.\pThere are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or\lused to heal HP and so on.\pThere are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with\lstat problems including poison and \lparalysis.\pPOKéMON will consider using moves in
these three categories.$

When not under command by its TRAINER,
a POKéMON may be unable to effectively\luse certain moves.\pA POKéMON is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.\pIf a POKéMON only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often\lbe unable to live up to its potential.$
Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may\nstart using moves that don't match its\lnature when it is in trouble.\pIf a POKéMON begins behaving oddly\nin a pinch, watch it carefully.$

the Battle Choice.\pThe Battle Choice rules are very
simple…\pChoose one of three paths and make
your way to the goal room at the end\lof the BATTLE PIKE. It's that simple.\pHowever, what happens on the chosen
path depends entirely on the luck\lof the challenger…\pIf you reach the goal, you will be
rewarded with Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please have a word with\lour staff in the big rooms on the way.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLo.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_W: Where the courage of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE PYRAMID!\pI am your guide to\nthe Battle Quest.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLo.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_E: Have you the courage to embark on\nthe Battle Quest challenge?$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLo.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_A: We await your challenge in the future!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLo.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_E:
The Battle Quest is a battling
event in which you must explore\lthe PYRAMID and try to reach the top.\pIn the PYRAMID are seven floors of
mazes, all of them filled with not only\lskilled TRAINERS but also wild POKéMON.\pYou must enter with three POKéMON,
none of them holding an item.\pOn your ascent, you will be provided
with a BATTLE BAG for items.\pIf you fail in your challenge, any item
placed in the BATTLE BAG disappears.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, you must select “REST”\land save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLo.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_W: The PYRAMID offers two courses,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich will you enter?$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLo.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_S: Very good. Now, please select the three\nPOKéMON you wish to accompany you.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLo.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_N: A slight problem, adventurer!\pYou seem to not have the three\nPOKéMON qualified for the challenge.\pPlease also remember to take all\nitems from your POKéMON.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

and each no higher than Level 50.\pPlease also remember to take all
items from your POKéMON.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
When you are ready, please have\na word with me.$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLo.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_B: Whether you believe my fortunes\nor not, the choice is yours…\pThe future can be changed anytime…\nI wish you safe passage…$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLo.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_T: Did you know?\pIf you run fast, TRAINERS may notice\nand come after you for a battle.\pSo, if you want to avoid TRAINERS,\ndon't catch their eyes, but sneak\lcautiously and quietly past them.$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLo.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_E: When the PYRAMID is conquered,\nthe wild POKéMON that appear in it\lare replaced by different kinds.\pExplore, observe, and learn what kinds\nof wild POKéMON you may encounter.$

TRAINERS are lying in wait for you
inside the PYRAMID.\pOn each floor, there are up to
eight TRAINERS.\pWhen you defeat a TRAINER, you will
get a helpful hint for your adventure.$

The mazes in the PYRAMID rearrange
themselves every time you enter it.\pThe mazes are poorly lit.
You must advance with caution.\pThe light grows brighter whenever you
defeat a wild POKéMON or a TRAINER.$

The BATTLE BAG serves as your BAG
while in the PYRAMID.\pThere are two separate BATTLE BAGS--
one each for the Level 50 and\lOpen Level adventures.\pThey each can hold up to 99 pieces
of ten kinds of items.\pThe contents of the BATTLE BAG are
lost if you fail in your quest.$

Buhahaha!\pYou couldn't tell it from looking now,
but I used to be one tough TRAINER.\pI had a reputation as the toughest
BEAUTY around, I tell you!\p… … … … … …\pWhat is it now?

abilities.\pIn fact, their POKéMON moves have

but feel this…\pTime is so cruel…$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveIn: I thrive in darkness…\nYes… What is worthy of me?\lNone other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…\pWhat say you to wandering in darkness\nand in utter and total desperation?$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScott:
Did SCOTT bring you here, too?
What is it with that guy?\pIt sounds like he really does know
how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…\pI've never seen him battling in person
ever.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveI: ZIGG!\nI believe in you, little buddy!\pI'll make my little ZIGG any favorite\ntasty treats you like if you win!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCa:
People call me a busybody,
but I can't help it.\pYour hat's on crooked!
Oh, no, trash on the ground!\lOops, it's almost dinnertime!\pI don't know if I can stand to just
watch at the BATTLE PALACE…$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeat: I may not look that impressive now,\nbut I once beat a GYM LEADER.\pWho knows, maybe I should give it\nanother shot at glory.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBi: I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for\nthe way I battle, too.\pI win matches in the blink of\nan eye!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterTh: I'm better than my daddy\nat POKéMON.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUp: Go on, my baby sweetie!\nGo rack up some wins for Daddy!\pYou're just like your mother,\nso you'll be dominating!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPre:
It wasn't easy getting here,
but I'd heard about this knockout\lpretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.\pInstead of her, do you know what
I found?\pA whole teeming mob of sweaty,
stinky, and primitive martial artists!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Sometime: I sometimes see this really important-\nlooking old man going in there.\pHe has these really awesome POKéMON.\nHe seems really nice, though.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOf:
Do you know it?
The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?\pWhen there comes a confident TRAINER
reaching for the golden pinnacle,\lthere shall appear a man among men.\pDon't know that legend?
Well, of course not!\lI just made it up!\pWhat's it supposed to mean?
That, my friend, I can't say!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWiped:
Man! Oh man!
I've never lost once before!\pBut I got wiped out with no saving
grace at all!\pAnd then I'm told I don't have any
talent?! Man!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTra: This guy ran into a horribly tough\nTRAINER while he was on the BATTLE\lTOWER challenge.\pNow look at him…\pYou need to be cautious if you ever\ndecide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBa: Yes!\nI've finally got enough Battle Points!\pI guess I'll trade for another giant\nplush DOLL!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHa: Oh, yeah, okay!\nSo this is the RANKING HALL!\pI'd like to go down in history as\na super champ and have my name\lrecorded here for posterity.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAny: With you by my side, I can do anything.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfO:
Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!\pOoh, I just can't wait anymore!\pLet's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM
right this instant!\pIf we get together in the BATTLE SALON,
the power of our love will overcome\leveryone we meet.\pWhy, before us, darling, everything
will topple like dominoes!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Frontier:
The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively
for tough TRAINERS.\pMany people with special abilities
have been invited, it seems.\pThat man SCOTT…\pHe may have built this place to serve
a bigger objective…$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeH: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you good eyesight?\pThere is an odd tree past here, and to\nmy tired eyes it seems to wiggle.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOd: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you a good memory?\pI have this feeling there once was\nan odd tree past here.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMo:
I…
I saw it!\pThere was a sticky sort of a POKéMON
with a long tail up ahead!\pIt was hiding under a boulder, and
it kept staring at me!$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_hns.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTo: This is the BATTLE TOWER!\nKeep the win streak as the toughest\lTRAINER!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_hns.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePa: This is the BATTLE PALACE!\nKeep your eyes on POKéMON battles!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_hns.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleAr: This is the BATTLE ARENA!\nLet the toughest teams gather!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_hns.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePy: This is the BATTLE PYRAMID!\nAdvance through the Battle Quest!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_hns.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingH: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL\nSet your sights on new records!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_hns.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Exchange: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER\nExchange your Battle Points!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_hns.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTo: Wow!\nIt's huge!\pThe BATTLE TOWER feels special.\nIt's different from the others.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_hns.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerL: My grand ambition is to conquer both\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON\lLEAGUE.\pAnd if my dream comes true…\pI… I'm going to ask MIMI next door\nif she will be friends with me!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_hns.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidT: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh!\nI just can't make it to the top!\pSince I'm out of options, maybe I can\nclimb the outside…$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDo: This is the BATTLE DOME!\nYour path to the invincible superstar!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFa: This is the BATTLE FACTORY!\nSeek out the toughest POKéMON!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePi: This is the BATTLE PIKE!\nChoose one of three paths!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBa: This is the BATTLE TOWER.\pTRAINERS bring their best-raised\nPOKéMON for elimination-style matches.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeY: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHave: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…\pI'm terribly sorry.\pYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWou: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWith: Please sail with us another time!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBo: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWher: Then, where would you like to go?$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutO: I'm the best out of all my friends.\nBut here…\lI've been useless!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFind: I want to go to the BATTLE TOWER,\nbut I can't find it even though I have\la map of the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThis place is just too big!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasi: I wanted to take a challenge as soon\nas I arrived here.\pBut on the way, I got seasick…\nUrrrrp…$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToug:
It's not as if just anyone can come
here, you know?\pOnly those TRAINERS who've been
recognized as tough are brought here.\pThat's why many TRAINERS don't even
know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCa: Hey, bro…\pAre you sure we can make challenges\neven if we don't have any POKéMON?$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySa: Uh…\nI'm sure it'll be okay.\pI think…\pBut remember that big scary guy?\nHe said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRais: That's the BATTLE FACTORY.\nYou can rent strong POKéMON there.\pBut it makes me wonder.\nWho's raising those rental POKéMON?$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOf: I'm scared of going into the BATTLE\nPIKE because of SEVIPER…\pB-but I came all the way here, so I will\ntry to conquer everything!\l…Shudder…$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlay: Let's play rock, paper, scissors!\nOne, two, three!\p… … … … … …$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTa: Yay! I won!\nI will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllP: Oh, no…\nI lost.\pI guess I'm not very lucky today.\nI'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge\luntil tomorrow.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFi: I believe I'm the only person here who,\nfor some unknown reason, would choose\lfishing over battling.\pHuh? You can't catch anything here?\nThat's disappointing…$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBatt: Today, I'm going to keep battling, no\nmatter what, until I get a Symbol.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOff: Oh? You're off to challenge\nthe BATTLE DOME?\pI'll wish you the best of luck.\nLet us both win our way up and meet\lin challenges.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeIsHe: Grandpa, over here!\nThe BATTLE DOME is here!\lGo get 'em, Grandpa!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetG: Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME?\nI won't let GENTLEMEN beat me!\pBut where is the entrance?$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingH: There used to be nothing here not all\nthat long ago.\pBut, now look at this place! Amazing!\nI'll bring my mother out to see this.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyA: I've finally arrived at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER!\pI'm sure to grab attention with\nmy looks and ability!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFi: Munch, munch…\pIt looks like this square's filled with\ntough people.\pMunch, munch…$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlder:
Crunch, munch…\pA while back, I met this older girl
at the BATTLE PIKE.\pShe had these eyes that were scary
in a real ornery way.\pCrunch, munch…\pShe got all furious: “Will you quit
eating!” Then she whaled on me.\pIt was a hair-raising kind of
scary experience, sure enough.\pCrunch, munch…$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTime: Huh? Will you listen to yourself?\nThat's nothing!\pWhy, the last time I cheered for him,\nour eyes met and sparks flew!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceL:
Whaaaaaat?!
Pfft!\pThat only happened because
I happened to be sitting next to you!\pThe DOME ACE only looked our way
because my cheering was so loud!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceI:
Oh, shush!
Keep that racket down!\pYou fair-weather fans should stick
to cheering for some GYM LEADER!\pThe DOME ACE is mine!
The only idol for me!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOver:
Those people squabbling over there…\pIt's hard to believe, but they once
were TRAINERS, and good ones, too.\pThey used to be incredibly tough,
and they were famous, too.\pBut they were obliterated by this
certain TRAINER at a tournament.\pThey were so thoroughly whipped,
they became smitten by the TRAINER.\pNow they're just fans of the TRAINER.
They go cheer for their idol at the\lBATTLE DOME every day now.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_OutsideWest/scr.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithL: I heard a rumor that someone saw\na POKéMON with an unusually long tail\lsomewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pIt must be adorable. I'm sure of it…\pOh, challenges can wait. I feel driven\nto find the delightful creature!$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueF: For a first-time visitor, we issue\nthe FRONTIER PASS.\pIt's for use at all the facilities\nin the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pHere you are!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Placed: {PLAYER} placed the TRAINER CARD\nin the FRONTIER PASS.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_EnjoyB: We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE\nFRONTIER has to offer!$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottG:
SCOTT: It's great to see you here,
it really is!\pI hope you'll take your time and
explore everywhere.\pNaturally, I hope you'll also experience
the pure essence of battling.\pI also have my quarters here, so feel
free to visit if you have time.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGu: I'm your guide to the various facilities\nhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnA: Which would you like to learn about?$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Battle: It is the gigantic tower considered\nto be the BATTLE FRONTIER's symbol.\pThere are four kinds of BATTLE ROOMS\nin the tower for SINGLE, DOUBLE, MULTI,\land LINK MULTI BATTLES.$

The BATTLE DOME is the large building
shaped like a huge egg.\pEvents named Battle Tourneys are held
in this facility.\pThe Battle Tourneys are offered in
two courses--for SINGLE and DOUBLE\lBATTLES.$
The BATTLE PALACE is the red building\non the right of the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThere are two kinds of BATTLE HALLS\nfor SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.$
The BATTLE ARENA is the dojo-like\nbuilding at the center-right of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pAn event called the Set KO Tourney\ntakes place at the BATTLE ARENA.$

The BATTLE FACTORY is the large
building that is the closest to us.\pAn event called the Battle Swap
is conducted there.\pThe Battle Swap event is offered in
two courses for SINGLE and DOUBLE\lBATTLES.$
The BATTLE PIKE is the building shaped\nlike a POKéMON at the center-left of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pAn event called the Battle Choice\nis conducted there.$
The BATTLE PYRAMID is the enormous\npyramid.\pAn event called the Battle Quest\nis conducted there.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Rankin: The RANKING HALL is located near\nthe BATTLE TOWER.\pThere, you may see the most fantastic\nrecords left by the TRAINERS that\ltook on the many challenges of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Exchan: The EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER is near\nthe BATTLE TOWER.\pThe Battle Points you have earned in\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER may be exchanged\lfor fabulous prizes there.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGu: I'm your guide to the basic rules that\nare common to all the challenges\loffered by the facilities in the BATTLE\lFRONTIER.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnA: What would you like to learn about?$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LevelM: All the challenges at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER's facilities come in\ltwo courses--Level 50 and Open Level.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level5:
The Level 50 course is open to POKéMON
up to and including Level 50.\pPlease keep in mind, however, that
no TRAINER you face will have any\lPOKéMON below Level 50.\pThis course is the entry level for
battles at the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pTo begin, we hope you will challenge
this course.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLe:
The Open Level course places no limit
on the levels of POKéMON entering\lchallenges.\pThe levels of your opponents will
be adjusted to match the levels of\lyour POKéMON.\pHowever, no TRAINER you face will
have any POKéMON below Level 60.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEnt:
Virtually any kind of POKéMON may take
on the challenges at all facilities.\pEGGS and certain kinds of POKéMON,
however, are not permitted.\pThe numbers of POKéMON required for
challenges will depend on the facility.\pAt all facilities, however, two or more
of the same kind of POKéMON are not\lpermitted.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldIt: When entering a challenge at a BATTLE\nFRONTIER facility, POKéMON may not\lbe holding the same kind of item.\pPlease make sure that all POKéMON\nentering a challenge are holding\ldifferent items.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGu: I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnA: Which would you like to learn about?$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Symbol:
There are seven facilities at
the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pTRAINERS who gain recognition for
their abilities may be rewarded with\lsymbols from each of the facilities.\pTo earn a symbol, TRAINERS may need
to defeat other TRAINERS in a row,\land may need to win events repeatedly.\pIt's certainly not easy to win symbols.
I wish you the best of luck!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Record:
It is possible to record one battle
on your FRONTIER PASS.\pYou may record a battle you had with
a friend or friends.\pOr you may record a battle conducted
at the BATTLE FRONTIER excluding\lmatches at the BATTLE PIKE or\lthe BATTLE PYRAMID.\pYou may choose to record your match
at the end of a battle.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate/s.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Battle: Battle Points are rewards given to\nTRAINERS who battled outstandingly\lat the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pYou may trade in your Battle Points\nfor prizes at the EXCHANGE SERVICE\lCORNER.$

data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeT:
SCOTT: Well, hello and welcome!
Heheh… Sorry about the cramped space.\pAnyway, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me formally
welcome you to the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThis is my dream come true.
It took me years and years, but I've\lfinally given shape to my dream.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchE:
On reflection, it was a terribly long
journey…\pI left home alone on a quest to find
strong TRAINERS.\pNo one can imagine how much effort
or time it took to make this real.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThis:
But that's all in the past.
No point dwelling on that!\pAll I want for you is to enjoy battling
to your heart's content here.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I want you to have this
as a memento for all the time our\lpaths crossed on our journeys.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainB:
SCOTT: You can check your Battle
Points on your FRONTIER PASS.\pThe more success you have here at
the BATTLE FRONTIER, the more Battle\lPoints you will collect.\pUse your Battle Points the way you
see fit, like trading them for items.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Expectin: I'm expecting great things from you!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSe:
SCOTT: Every TRAINER is an individual.
They all lead lives of their own.\pBut when they're in a battle,
it doesn't matter who they are.\pThey're all the same!\pI love the purity of battle,
where everyone is equal.\pThat's why I go everywhere seeking
TRAINERS who are serious about\lbattling, and invite them here.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouM:
SCOTT: Have you met any of
the FRONTIER BRAINS?\pBetter yet, have you obtained any
symbols from them?\pI handpicked the FRONTIER BRAINS
as the toughest TRAINERS anywhere.\pBut I'm sure that seeing how tough
you are will startle even them!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindW:
SCOTT: You don't just train for battle,
right?\pI think I remember you working on
a POKéDEX as well.\pWell, guess what?\pYou may run into wild POKéMON in
the BATTLE FRONTIER somewhere…\lFufufu!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCol:
SCOTT: Are you enjoying things in
the BATTLE FRONTIER?\p…Wait a second…
Oh!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've collected the full set\lof silver symbols!\pThat's more than impressive!
You are tough, just as I suspected!\pNormally, I wouldn't do something
like this, but this is a special time!\pI want you to have this.
I'm sure you can put it to proper use.$

SCOTT: I hope you're enjoying
everything in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\p…Wait a second…
Oh, my disbelieving eyes!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've gathered up the full set\lof gold symbols!\pThat's more than stupendous!
You're incredible, just as I suspected!\p… … … … … …\p{PLAYER}, you've got to accept this!\pI think you will be able to
appreciate the value of my gift!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIB: I must say I have the gift of knowing\na good TRAINER when I see one.\pI'm so glad I had the foresight to\nbring you here!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_BerryPoc: Your BERRY POCKET seems to\nbe stuffed.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50Tr: SCOTT: Oh, I heard about you!\nHow you ruled the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 50 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's fantastic!\nI want you to have this!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100T: SCOTT: Oh, my! I heard about you!\nHow you overwhelmed the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 100 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's ridiculously spectacular!\nYou've got to have this!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Expectin: I'll be expecting to hear even greater\nthings about you now!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse/scr.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ComeBack: Oops, well, if you have too much\nstuff, come back for this later.$
