you are will startle even them!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_hns.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindW:
SCOTT: You don't just train for battle,
right?\pI think I remember you working on
a POKéDEX as well.\pWell, guess what?\pYou may run into wild POKéMON in
the BATTLE FRONTIER somewhere…\lFufufu!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_hns.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCol:
SCOTT: Are you enjoying things in
the BATTLE FRONTIER?\p…Wait a second…
Oh!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've collected the full set\lof silver symbols!\pThat's more than impressive!
You are tough, just as I suspected!\pNormally, I wouldn't do something
like this, but this is a special time!\pI want you to have this.
I'm sure you can put it to proper use.$

SCOTT: I hope you're enjoying
everything in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\p…Wait a second…
Oh, my disbelieving eyes!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've gathered up the full set\lof gold symbols!\pThat's more than stupendous!
You're incredible, just as I suspected!\p… … … … … …\p{PLAYER}, you've got to accept this!\pI think you will be able to
appreciate the value of my gift!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_hns.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIB: I must say I have the gift of knowing\na good TRAINER when I see one.\pI'm so glad I had the foresight to\nbring you here!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_hns.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_BerryPoc: Your BERRY POCKET seems to\nbe stuffed.$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_hns.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50Tr: SCOTT: Oh, I heard about you!\nHow you ruled the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 50 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's fantastic!\nI want you to have this!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_hns.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100T: SCOTT: Oh, my! I heard about you!\nHow you overwhelmed the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 100 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's ridiculously spectacular!\nYou've got to have this!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_hns.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Expectin: I'll be expecting to hear even greater\nthings about you now!$
data/maps/BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_hns.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ComeBack: Oops, well, if you have too much\nstuff, come back for this later.$

data/maps/BellchimeTrail_hns/scripts.inc.BellchimeTrail_Text_Morty:
MORTY: The legendary POKéMON
did not choose me...\pBut that does not mean that I
have lost out on my future.\pI will continue my training until I
I discover a new future for me.\pIf you seek another battle, find
me at the FIGHTING DOJO.$

data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_ClairIntroText: I am CLAIR.\pThe world's best dragon master.\pI can hold my own against even the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE's ELITE FOUR.\pDo you still want to take me on?\p…Fine. Let's do it!\pAs a GYM LEADER, I will use my full\npower against any opponent!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_ClairWinText: I lost?\pI don't believe it. There must be\nsome mistake…$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_GoToDragons:
I won't admit this.\pI may have lost, but you're still
not ready for the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI know. You should take the dragon-
user challenge.\pBehind this GYM is a place called
DRAGON'S DEN.\pThere is a small shrine at its
center. Go there.\pIf you can prove that you've lost
your lazy ideals, I will recognize\lyou as a trainer worthy of a GYM\lBADGE!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_TooMuchToEx: What's the matter?\pIs it too much to expect of you?$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_YouKeptMeWa: You've kept me waiting!\pHere! Take this!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_DescribeTM: That contains DRAGON CLAW.\pYou can figure out what it does.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_League:
What's the matter?\pAren't you headed to the POKéMON
LEAGUE?\pDon't you know where it is?\pFrom here, go to NEW BARK TOWN.\pThen SURF east. The route there is
very tough.\pDon't you dare lose at the POKéMON
LEAGUE!\pIf you do, I'll feel even worse
about having lost to you!\pGive it everything you've got.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_ClairAfterLeague: You did it, huh?\pYou are now the JOHTO CHAMP.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_ClairRematchText: You did it, huh?\pYou are now the JOHTO CHAMP.\pYou've proven your strength but can\nyou handle me again?\pAs a Dragon Master, I won't hold\nback.\pNot this time.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_ClairRematchDefeatTex: I lost?\pAgain?\pI don't believe it. There must be\nsome mistake…$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermCodySeenT: I just got access to use DRAGON-\ntype POKéMON!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermCodyBeate: Rats! If only I had a DRAGONITE!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermCodyAfter: Members of our dragon-user clan\ncan use dragon POKéMON only after\lour MASTER allows it.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfFranSeenT: I can't allow a nameless trainer\npast me!\pCLAIR would be livid if I did!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfFranAfter: Uh-oh… CLAIR is going to be mad…$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermPaulSeenT: Your first battle against dragons?\pI'll show you how tough they are!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermPaulAfter: LANCE told you that he'd like to\nsee you again?\pNot a chance!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermMikeSeenT: My chance of losing? Not even one\npercent!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermMikeAfter: I know my short-comings now.\pThanks for showing me!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfLolaSeenT: Dragons are sacred POKéMON.\pThey are full of life energy.\pIf you're not serious, you won't\nbe able to beat them.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfLolaAfter: Dragons are weak against DRAGON-\ntype moves.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_GuideText:
Yo! CHAMP in making!\pIt's been a long journey, but we
are almost done! Count on me!\pWhile CLAIR looks up to the Dragon
Master, LANCE, she's managed to\lcreate her own identity with a\lteam consisting of dragons from\lthe sea.\pDragons are supposed to be
weak against ICE-type moves,\lbut you'll need some DRAGON-type\lor FAIRY-type moves of your own if\lyou want to win.$You got this!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_GuideGotoDragonsDen: You were great to beat CLAIR!\pShe can be a bit of a sore loser,\nthough\pSounds like you need to head to the\nDRAGON'S DEN if you want that GYM BADGE!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_GuideWinText: You were great to beat CLAIR!\pAll that's left is the POKéMON\nLEAGUE challenge.\pYou're on the way to becoming the\nPOKéMON CHAMPION!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Gym_hns/scripts.BlackthornGym_Text_GymStatueCertified: BLACKTHORN CITY POKéMON GYM\pCLAIR'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

data/maps/BlackthornCity_House1_hns/scri.BlackthornCity_House1_Text_Granny: A clan of trainers who can freely\ncommand dragons live right here in\lBLACKTHORN.\pAs a result, there are many legends\nabout dragons in this town.$

data/maps/BlackthornCity_House2_hns/scri.BlackthornCity_House2_Text_YouWillTradeW: I collect POKéMON!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_House2_hns/scri.BlackthornCity_House2_Text_MonYouTakeCar: Yay! I got myself {STR_VAR_1}!\p{STR_VAR_2}, you take care!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_House2_hns/scri.BlackthornCity_House2_Text_ThisIsntAMon: Uh, no, I don't think so.\nThat isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_House2_hns/scri.BlackthornCity_House2_Text_YouWontTradeM: You don't want to trade? Aww...$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_House2_hns/scri.BlackthornCity_House2_Text_After: Hi, how's my old MR MIME doing?$

data/maps/BlackthornCity_House3_hns/scri.BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_IC: Uh…\nOh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.\pI can make POKéMON forget their moves.\pWould you like me to do that?$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_House3_hns/scri.BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_Wh: Which POKéMON should forget a move?$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_House3_hns/scri.BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_Mo: {STR_VAR_1} knows only one move\nso it can't be forgotten…$
It worked to perfection!\p{STR_VAR_1} has forgotten\n{STR_VAR_2} completely.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_House3_hns/scri.BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_Co: Come again if there are moves that\nneed to be forgotten.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_House3_hns/scri.BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_Eg: What?\nNo EGG should know any moves.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_House3_hns/scri.BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_Ca: Hm!\pYour {STR_VAR_1} doesn't seem willing\nto forget SURF.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_House3_hns/scri.BlackthornCity_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_:
I'm the MOVE TUTOR.\pI know all the moves that POKéMON
learn--every one of them--and I can\lteach POKéMON those moves.\pI can teach a move to a POKéMON
of yours if you'd like.\pI'll do it for a HEART SCALE.
I'm collecting those now.$
Oh! That's it! That's an honest to\ngoodness HEART SCALE!\pLet me guess, you want me to teach\na move?$
Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have any move\nI can teach that POKéMON.$
{PLAYER} handed over one HEART SCALE\nin exchange.$
If your POKéMON need to learn a move,\ncome back with a HEART SCALE.$
Hunh? There isn't a single move that\nI can teach an EGG.$

data/maps/BlackthornCity_Mart_hns/script.BlackthornMart_Text_CooltrainerM: You can't buy MAX REVIVE, but it\nfully restores a fainted POKéMON.\pBeware--it won't restore PP, the\nPOWER POINTS needed for moves.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_Mart_hns/script.BlackthornMart_Text_BlackBelt: MAX REPEL keeps weak POKéMON away\nfrom you.\pIt's the longest lasting of the\nREPEL sprays.$

data/maps/BlackthornCity_PokemonCenter_h.BlackthornCity_PokemonCenter1FGentlemanT: Deep inside far-off INDIGO\nPLATEAU is the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI hear the best trainers gather\nthere from around the country.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_PokemonCenter_h.BlackthornCity_PokemonCenter1FTwinText: There was this move I just had\nto teach my POKéMON.\pSo I got the MOVE DELETER to make\nit forget an HM move.$

data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackthornCity_Text_BaobaCall: WARDEN BAOBA: {PLAYER}!\pThis is WARDEN BAOBA.\pI'm calling to tell you that\nthe SAFARI ZONE has expanded!\pPlease come visit!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackthornCity_Text_ElmCall: PROF.ELM: Hello, {PLAYER}?\pI have something here for you.\nCould you swing by my LAB?\pSee you later!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackthornCity_Text_ClairNotReady: CLAIR, our GYM LEADER, has been\nfollowing your progress.\pHowever, she only battles trainers\nwho already have 7 badges.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackthornCity_Text_ClairIsIn: CLAIR, our GYM LEADER, is waiting\nfor you.\pHowever, it would be impossible for\na run-of-the-mill trainer to win.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackthornCity_Text_ClairIsBeaten: You defeated CLAIR?\pThat's amazing!\pI've never heard of her losing to\nanyone other than LANCE.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackthornGrampsRefusesEntryText: No. Only chosen trainers may train\nhere.\pPlease leave.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackthornGrampsGrantsEntryText: If CLAIR allows it, her grand-\nfather--our MASTER--will also.\pYou may enter.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackBeltText_VoicesInMyHead: Arooo! Voices in my head!\pHuh? I'm listening to my radio!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackthornCooltrainerF1Text: Are you going to make your POKéMON\nremember some moves?$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackthornYoungsterText: Dragon masters all come from the city\nof BLACKTHORN.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackthornCity_MeetSantosText: SANTOS: …\pI'm SANTOS of the weekday family.\pTake a guess.$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackthornCity_SantosGaveGiftText: SANTOS: …\pSPELL TAG…\pGHOST-type moves get stronger…\pIt will frighten you…$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackthornCity_SantosSaturdayText: SANTOS: …\pSee you again on another Saturday…\pI won't have any more gifts…$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackthornCooltrainerF2Text: Wow, you came through the ICE PATH?\pYou must be a real hotshot trainer!$
data/maps/BlackthornCity_hns/scripts.inc.BlackthornGymSignText: BLACKTHORN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: CLAIR\pThe Blessed User of Dragon POKéMON$

data/maps/BurnedTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.BurnedTower_1FEusineIntroText: EUSINE: My name's EUSINE.\pI'm on the trail of a POKéMON\ncalled SUICUNE.\pAnd you are...?\p{PLAYER}? Glad to meet you!\pI heard SUICUNE might be in\nthis BURNED TOWER, so I came\lto check it out.\pBut where exactly could it be?$
data/maps/BurnedTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.BurnedTower_1FEusineText: EUSINE: I heard SUICUNE might\nbe in this BURNED TOWER, so I\lcame to check it out.\pBut where exactly could it be?$
data/maps/BurnedTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.BurnedTower_1FMortyText: MORTY: ECRUTEAK's GYM LEADER\nhas to study what are said to\lbe the legendary POKéMON--\lSUICUNE, ENTEI and RAIKOU.\pEUSINE is here, so I've\ndecided to investigate the\lTOWER with him.$
data/maps/BurnedTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.BurnedTowerSilver_BeforeText: ..............................\p...Oh, it's you.\pI came looking for some\nlegendary POKéMON they say\lroost here.\pBut there's nothing here!\pNothing, after all the effort\nof coming to this dump?\lNo way!\pIt's all your fault!$
data/maps/BurnedTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.BurnedTowerSilver_WinText: ...Humph!\pI only lost because my\nPOKéMON are incredibly weak.\pHow pathetic.$
data/maps/BurnedTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.BurnedTowerSilver_AfterText1: ...Aw, whatever.\pYou'd never be able to catch\na legendary POKéMON anyway.$
data/maps/BurnedTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.BurnedTowerSilver_LossText: ...Humph!\pThis is why I hate battling\nwimps. It's a waste of time.$
data/maps/BurnedTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.BurnedTowerSilver_AfterText2: Humph!\pWhat are you doing falling\ninto a hole? Some genius!\pServes you right!$
data/maps/BurnedTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.BurnedTower_Text_NardSeen: Don't worry!\pWe fire-breathers know the true\npower of fire better than anyone!$
data/maps/BurnedTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.BurnedTower_Text_NardBeaten: Thanks for such a heated battle!$
data/maps/BurnedTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.BurnedTower_Text_NardAfter: The reason this tower's burned is\nthat it was hit by lightning.\pThe fire I'm breathing is tiny\nin comparison...$
data/maps/BurnedTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.BurnedTower_Text_RichardoSeen: I'm practicing my stealing in the\nBURNED TOWER! Don't try\lthis at home!$
data/maps/BurnedTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.BurnedTower_Text_RichardoAfter: Maybe a life of crime isn't for\nme...$

data/maps/BurnedTower_B1F_hns/scripts.in.BurnedTowerB1FEusineText:
EUSINE: I'm shocked!\pSUICUNE raced by like a blur,
right in front of my eyes!\pFor ten years I chased
SUICUNE, and I finally got to\lsee it.\pI'm all choked up!\p{PLAYER}, I owe this all to you!\pThank you!\pI heard that the legendary
POKéMON of ECRUTEAK test\lchosen humans by allowing them\lto get close.\pI'm going to track SUICUNE.\p{PLAYER}, let's meet again!\pFarewell!$

data/maps/CaveOfOrigin_B1F/scripts.inc.CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory:
Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}?
I've heard tales of your exploits.\pMy name is WALLACE.\pI was once the GYM LEADER of
SOOTOPOLIS, but something came up.\pSo now, I've entrusted my mentor JUAN
with the GYM's operation.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pGROUDON and KYOGRE, the two POKéMON
wreaking havoc here, are considered\lto be super-ancient POKéMON.\pBut there aren't just two super-
ancient POKéMON.\pThere is one more somewhere.\pSomewhere, there is a super-
ancient POKéMON named RAYQUAZA.\pIt's said that it was RAYQUAZA that
becalmed the two combatants in\lthe distant past.\pBut even I have no clue as to
RAYQUAZA's whereabouts…$
data/maps/CaveOfOrigin_B1F/scripts.inc.CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, do you perhaps\nknow where RAYQUAZA is now?\pIf you do, please tell me.$
data/maps/CaveOfOrigin_B1F/scripts.inc.CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOri: WALLACE: The CAVE OF ORIGIN?\pBut that's right here!\nI need you to do better than that!\pPlease, I need you to think about\nwhere RAYQUAZA might be right now.$
data/maps/CaveOfOrigin_B1F/scripts.inc.CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentio:
WALLACE: MT. PYRE?\pBut when I met the old lady there
earlier, she made no mention of it.\pI very much doubt that the old lady
would try to hide something from me…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, could you think about this
more carefully for me?$
data/maps/CaveOfOrigin_B1F/scripts.inc.CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSom: WALLACE: Huh? You don't remember?\nHmm… That's a problem…\pCan't you remember somehow?$
data/maps/CaveOfOrigin_B1F/scripts.inc.CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPilla: WALLACE: The SKY PILLAR?\pThat's it!\nIt must be the SKY PILLAR!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, there's not a moment to lose!\nWe'll head to the SKY PILLAR right away!$

data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_1F_hns/.CeladonMansion_Text_Manager: My dear POKéMON keep me company,\nso I don't ever feel lonely.\pMEOWTH even brings money home.$

data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_2F_hns/.CeladonMansion2F_Text_Computer:
{PLAYER} turned on the PC.\p…\pSomeone was in the middle of
composing an e-mail.\p…I hope you'll come visit KANTO.\pI think you'll be surprised at
how much things have changed here.\pYou'll also see many POKéMON that
aren't native to JOHTO.\pTo the PRODUCER\p…$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_2F_hns/.CeladonMansion2F_Text_LilDill:
Hi all, Patch 15--\pSorry, I mean...\pHi there, I'm the GAME DIRECTOR!\pI built the maps, the tilesets, the
the scripts, and much more.\pBut I couldn't have done it without
the other devs and the playtesters.\pThank you for playing! I hope you've
enjoyed POKéMON HEART & SOUL.$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_2F_hns/.CeladonMansion2F_Text_InfiniteBacon: We're working to rebuild this game\nin pokeemerald expansion!$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_2F_hns/.CeladonMansion2F_Text_TixoRebel: Have you heard of THE EGGENING?\nIt was a bug from the playtest\lthat randomly changed POKéMON into\lEGGs!\pI developed the fix for it!$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_2F_hns/.CeladonMansion2F_Text_Phant: I love DEMAKES!\pHave you played SWORD AND SHIELD\nULTIMATE PLUS - ENGLISH?\lI translated it!\pFor my next DEMAKE, I think I'll\ndo ALOLA!$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_2F_hns/.CeladonMansion2F_Text_Exclsior: I implemented the unique surfing\nsurfing sprites for each POKéMON!\pSince the project is OPEN SOURCE,\nyou can add your own features too!$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_2F_hns/.CeladonMansion2F_Text_DaniRaibow:
Hi!\pI am pretty good at finding problems,
and can fix little ones.\pWanna hear a joke?\pLance tried to teach DRAGONITE the
move DRAGON BREATH.\pHowever, DRAGONITE was moving too
fast from EXTREMESPEED; it couldn't\lcatch it!$

data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_3F_hns/.GameFreak_Text_GameDesigner: Is that right?\pI'm the GAME DESIGNER!\pFilling up your POKéDEX is tough,\nbut don't give up!$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_3F_hns/.GameFreak_Text_GraphicArtist: I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST.\pI drew you!$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_3F_hns/.GameFreak_Text_GraphicArtistPrintDiploma: I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST.\pOh, you completed your POKéDEX?\pWant me to print out your\nDIPLOMA?$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_3F_hns/.GameFreak_Text_GraphicArtistRefused: Give me a shout if you want your\nDIPLOMA printed.$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_3F_hns/.GameFreak_Text_GraphicArtistError: Something's wrong. I'll have to\ncancel printing.$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_3F_hns/.GameFreak_Text_Programmer: Who, me? I'm the PROGRAMMER.\pPlay the slot machines!$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_3F_hns/.GameFreak_Text_CharacterDesigner: Aren't the TWINS adorable?\pJASMINE's pretty too.\pOh, I love them!$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_3F_hns/.CeladonMansion3F_Text_Drawing: It's a detailed drawing of a\npretty girl.$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_3F_hns/.CeladonMansion3F_Text_GameProgram: It's the game program. Messing\nwith it could put a bug in the\ngame!$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_3F_hns/.CeladonMansion3F_Text_ReferenceMaterial: It's crammed with reference\nmaterials. There's even a\nPOKé DOLL.$

data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_RoofDay.CeladonMansionRoof_Text_Fisher: High places--I do love them so!\pI'd say the only thing that loves\nheights as much as me is smoke!$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_RoofDay.CeladonMansionRoof_Text_Graffiti: There's graffiti on the wall…\p{PLAYER} added a moustache!$

data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_RoofHou.CeladonMansionRoofHouse_Text_PharmacistI: Let me recount a terrifying tale…$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_RoofHou.CeladonMansionRoofHouse_Text_PharmacistN: Then again, it's not as scary\nwhile it's still light outside.\pCome back after sunset, OK?$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_RoofHou.CeladonMansionRoofHouse_Text_PharmacistS:
Once upon a time, there was a
little boy who was given a new\lBICYCLE…\pHe wanted to try it right away…\pHe was having so much fun that
he didn't notice the sun had set…\pWhile riding home in the pitch-
black night, the bike suddenly\lslowed!\pThe pedals became heavy!\pWhen he stopped pedaling, the
bike began slipping backwards!\pIt was as if the bike were cursed
and trying to drag him into\loblivion!\p…\p…\pSHRIEEEEK!\pThe boy had been riding uphill on
CYCLING ROAD!\p…
Ba-dum ba-dum!\pFor listening so patiently, you

data/maps/CeladonCity_Apartments_RoofHou.CeladonMansionRoofHouse_Text_PharmacistC: TM82 is SLEEP TALK.\pIt will allow your POKéMON to use\na random move while asleep.\pBut good luck sleeping after that\nterrifying tale!$

data/maps/CeladonCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaBeforeBattle:
ERIKA: Hello… Lovely weather,
isn't it? It's so pleasant…\p…I'm afraid I may doze off…\pMy name is ERIKA. I am the LEADER
of CELADON GYM.\p…Oh? All the way from JOHTO, you
say? How nice…\pOh. I'm sorry, I didn't realize
that you wished to challenge me.\pVery well, but I shall not lose.$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaBeaten: ERIKA: Oh! I concede defeat…\pYou are remarkably strong…\pI shall give you RAINBOWBADGE…$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_Erika_GiveTM: ERIKA: That was a delightful\nmatch.\pI felt inspired. Please, I wish\nyou to have this TM.$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_Erika_ExplainTM: It is GIGA DRAIN.\pIt is a wonderful move that\ndrains half the damage it inflicts\lto heal your POKéMON.\pPlease use it if it pleases you…$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaAfterBattle: ERIKA: Losing leaves a bitter\naftertaste…\pBut knowing that there are strong\ntrainers spurs me to do better…$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaRematch: ERIKA: Oh, hello.\pWhat a surprise, KANTO CHAMPION!\pIt's so lovely to see you again.\pYour journey must have been so\nexciting.\pEven champions enjoy a challenge.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
data/maps/CeladonCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaRematchDefeat: ERIKA: Losing still leaves a\nbitter aftertaste…\pBut knowing that there are strong\ntrainers spurs me to do better…$

data/maps/CeruleanCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.CeruleanGym_Text_Note: Sorry, I'll be out for a while.\nMISTY, GYM LEADER\pSince MISTY's out, we'll be away\ntoo.\lGYM TRAINERS$

data/maps/CeruleanCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.CeruleanGym_Text_GruntBye: Hey, you! Forget you see me,\nokay?\pYou see, hear, know nothing,\pokay? Bye, kid! Nothing!\pBye-bye a go-go!$
data/maps/CeruleanCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.CeruleanGym_Text_Note1: Sorry, I'll be out for a while.\nMISTY, GYM LEADER\pSince MISTY's out, we'll be away\ntoo. GYM TRAINERS$

MISTY: I was expecting you, you
pest!\pYou may have a lot of JOHTO GYM
BADGES, but you'd better not\ltake me too lightly.\pMy WATER-type POKéMON are
tough!$
data/maps/CeruleanCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.CeruleanGym_Text_MistyWinLoss: MISTY: You really are good…\pI'll admit that you are skilled…\pHere you go. It's CASCADEBADGE.$

data/maps/CeruleanCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfDianaSeen: Sorry about being away. Let's get\non with it!$
data/maps/CeruleanCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfDianaBeaten: I give up! You're the winner!$
data/maps/CeruleanCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfBrianaSeen: Don't let my elegant swimming\nunnerve you.$
data/maps/CeruleanCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfBrianaBeaten: Ooh, you calmly disposed of me…$
data/maps/CeruleanCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfBrianaAfter: Don't be too smug about beating\nme.\pMISTY will destroy you if you get\ncomplacent.$
data/maps/CeruleanCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmermParkerSeen: Glub…\pI'm first! Come and get me!$
data/maps/CeruleanCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmermParkerAfter: MISTY has gotten much better in\nthe past few years.\pDon't let your guard down, or\nyou'll be crushed!$
data/maps/CeruleanCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.CeruleanGym_Text_GuideIntro: Yo! CHAMP in making!\pSince MISTY was away, I went out\pfor some fun too. He-he-he.$
data/maps/CeruleanCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.CeruleanGym_Text_GuideWin: Hoo, you showed me how tough you\nare.\pAs always, that was one heck of a\ngreat battle!$
data/maps/CeruleanCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.CeruleanGym_Text_Misty_ExplainTM: It's the WATER PULSE TM.\pIt causes damage and sometimes\ncauses confusion as well!$

data/maps/CherrygroveCity_House1_hns/scr.CherrygroveCity_GymSpeechHouse_Text_Poke: You're trying to see how good\nyou are as a POKéMON trainer?\pYou better visit the POKéMON\nGYMS all over JOHTO and collect\lBADGES.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_House1_hns/scr.CherrygroveCity_GymSpeechHouse_Text_BugC: When I get older, I'm going to\nbe a GYM LEADER!\pI make my POKéMON battle with\nmy friend's to make them\ltougher!$

data/maps/CherrygroveCity_House2_hns/scr.CherrygroveCity_GuideHouse_Text_GuideGen: When I was a wee lad, I was a\nhotshot trainer!\pHere's a word of advice:\nCatch lots of POKéMON!\pTreat them all with kindness!$

data/maps/CherrygroveCity_House3_hns/scr.CherrygroveCity_EvolutionHouse_Text_Youn: POKéMON gain experience in\nbattle and change their form.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_House3_hns/scr.CherrygroveCity_EvolutionHouse_Text_Lass: POKéMON change?\pI would be shocked if one did\nthat!$

data/maps/CherrygroveCity_Mart_hns/scrip.Cherrygrove_Pokemart_Text_CooltrainerM: They're fresh out of POKé BALLS!\pWhen will they get more of them?$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_Mart_hns/scrip.Cherrygrove_Pokemart_Text_CooltrainerM_P: POKé BALLS are in stock!\nNow I can catch POKéMON!$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_Mart_hns/scrip.Cherrygrove_Pokemart_Text_Youngster:
When I was walking in the grass, a
bug POKéMON poisoned my POKéMON!\pI just kept going, but then my
POKéMON fainted.\pYou should keep an ANTIDOTE
with you.$

data/maps/CherrygroveCity_PokemonCenter_.CherryGrove_Pokecenter_Text_Fisher: It's great. I can store any number\nof POKéMON, and it's all free.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_PokemonCenter_.CherryGrove_Pokecenter_Text_Gentleman: That PC is free for any\ntrainer to use.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_PokemonCenter_.CherryGrove_Pokecenter_Text_Lass: They say a watched pot never\nboils. But watching the clock\lin the POKéCENTER makes time fly!$

data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentIntro:
You're a rookie trainer,
aren't you? I can tell!\pThat's OK! Everyone is a
rookie at some point!\pIf you'd like, I can teach
you a few things.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentPokecenter: This is a POKéMON CENTER.\pThey heal your POKéMON in no\ntime at all.\pYou'll be relying on them a lot,\nso you better learn about them.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentMart: This is a POKéMON MART.\pThey sell BALLS for catching wild\nPOKéMON and other useful items.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentRoute30: ROUTE 30 is out this way.\pTrainers will be battling\ntheir prized POKéMON there.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentSea: This is the sea, as you can see.\pSome POKéMON are found only in\nin water.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentMap: Here…\pIt's my house! Thanks for\nyour company.\pOh, and if you're ever lost, check\nthe MAP on your POKéGEAR!\pI wish you luck on your journey!$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentDecline: Oh… It's something I enjoy\ndoing…\pFine. Come see me whenever\nyou like.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_RivalSeen: … … … … … … … …\pYou got a POKéMON at the LAB.\pWhat a waste.\nA wimp like you.\p… … … … … … … …\pDon't you get what I'm saying?\nWell, I too, have a good POKéMON.\pI'll show you what I mean!$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_SilverWin: Humph. Are you happy you won?$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_RivalAfter: … … … … … … … …\pDo you want to know who I am?\pI'm going to be the world's\ngreatest POKéMON trainer.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_RivalID: Give it back!\nThat's my TRAINER CARD!\pOh no!\nYou saw my name...$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_TeacherHaveMapCard: When you're with POKéMON,\ngoing anywhere is fun.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_YoungsterNoPokedex: MR. POKéMON's house is still\nfarther up ahead.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_YoungsterHavePokede: I battled the trainers on the\nroad.\pMy POKéMON lost. They're a\nmess! I must take them to a\lPOKéMON CENTER.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_MysticWaterGuyBefor: A POKéMON I caught had an\nitem.\pI think it's MYSTIC WATER.\pI don't need it, so do you\nwant it?$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_MysticWaterGuyAfter: Back to fishing for me, then.$
data/maps/CherrygroveCity_hns/scripts.in.CherrygroveCity_Text_CitySign: CHERRYGROVE CITY\pThe City of Cute, Fragrant\nFlowers$

data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeEasierToFly: You crossed the sea to get here?\pThat must have been hard.\pIt would be much easier if your\nPOKéMON knew how to FLY...$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeBeatChuck: But you can't use FLY without this\ncity's GYM BADGE.\pIf you beat the GYM LEADER here,\ncome see me.\pI'll have a nice gift for you.$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeGiveHM: That's CIANWOOD's GYM BADGE!\pThen you should take this HM.$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeFlySpeech: Teach FLY to your POKéMON.\pYou will be able to FLY instantly\nto anywhere you have visited.$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeChubby: My husband lost to you, so he needs\nto train harder.\pThat's good, since he was getting\na little chubby.$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_Youngster: If you use FLY, you can get back\nto OLIVINE instantly.$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_PokefanM: Boulders to the north of town can\nbe crushed.\pThey may be hiding something.\pYour POKéMON could use ROCK SMASH\nto break them.$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_Lass: CHUCK, the GYM LEADER, spars with\nhis fighting POKéMON.$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_EusineSuicune:
EUSINE: Yo, {PLAYER}.\pWasn't that SUICUNE just now?\pI only caught a quick glimpse, but
I thought I saw SUICUNE running on\lthe waves.\pSUICUNE is beautiful and grand.\pAnd it races through towns and
roads at simply awesome speeds.\pIt's wonderful…\pI want to see SUICUNE up close…\pI've decided.\pI'll battle you as a trainer to
earn SUICUNE's respect!\pCome on, {PLAYER}. Let's battle now!$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_EusineBeaten: I hate to admit it, but you win.$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_EusineAfter: You're amazing, {PLAYER}!\pNo wonder POKéMON gravitate to you.\pI get it now.\pI'm going to keep searching for\nSUICUNE.\pI'm sure we'll see each other again.\pSee you around!$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_Sign: CIANWOOD CITY\pA Port Surrounded by Rough Seas$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_GymSign: CIANWOOD CITY POKéMON GYM\pLEADER: CHUCK\pHis Roaring Fists Do the Talking$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_PharmacySign: 500 Years of Tradition\pCIANWOOD CITY PHARMACY\pWe Await Your Medicinal Queries$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_Safari: CLIFF EDGE CAVE\nRoad to the SAFARI ZONE.$
data/maps/CianwoodCity_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_Engineer: This path is under construction.\nWe're getting the new SAFARI ZONE\lup and running!$

data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_GymStatueCertified: CIANWOOD CITY POKéMON GYM\pCHUCK'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckGotoDojo: WAHAHAHA {PLAYER}!\nI'm in the middle of my training!\pIf you want another match, come to\nthe FIGHTING DOJO in SAFFRON!$
data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckAtDojo: I will see you at the DOJO!\nWAHAHAHAHAHA$
data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckIntro1: WAHAHAH!\pSo you've come this far!\pLet me tell you, I'm tough!\pMy POKéMON will crush stones and\nshatter bones!\pWatch this!$
data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckIntro3: There! Scared now, are you?\pWhat? It has nothing to do with\nPOKéMON?\pThat's true!\pCome on. We shall do battle!$
data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckLoss: Wha? Huh? I lost?\pHow about that!\nYou're worthy of STORMBADGE!$
data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckBadgeSpeech: STORMBADGE makes all POKéMON up to\nL70 obey, even traded ones.\pIt also lets your POKéMON use FLY\nwhen you're not in a battle.\pHere, take this too!$
data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckTMSpeech: That is FOCUS PUNCH.\pIt moves slow but deals huge\ndamage. Just don't get hit first!$
data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckAfter: WAHAHAH! I enjoyed battling you!\pBut a loss is a loss!\pFrom now on, I'm going to train\n24 hours a day!$
data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckRematch: WAHAHAH! JOHTO CHAMPION!\pYou've come back for more!\pI see your skills have improved!\pReady to see who's stronger?$
data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltYoshiSeen: My POKéMON and I are bound togeth-\ner by friendship.\pOur bond will never be broken!$
data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltYoshiAfter: You seem to have a strong bond\nwith your POKéMON too!$
data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltNobSeen: Words are useless.\nLet your fists do the talking!$
data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltLungSeen: My raging fists will shatter your\nPOKéMON!$
data/maps/CianwoodGym_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltLungAfter: My POKéMON lost…\nMy… my pride is shattered…$

data/maps/CianwoodHouse1_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_OldManIntro:
I don't remember the last time
someone came to visit me.\pWhen I was young, I was a
POKéMON Trainer, too.\lI tried to reach the tower and\ldive into the ocean.\pI put a lot of effort into many
things.\pWell, I take things easy now,
listening to the waves and winds\lon this beach.$
data/maps/CianwoodHouse1_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_BellTowerStory:
Have you heard of the TIN TOWER
in ECRUTEAK?\pThere are what they call Clear Bells
on top of the tower.\pThey don't make a single noise
in strong winds.\pThere is only one way to make them
ring.\pIt is to obtain another CLEAR BELL
just like the ones at the top of the\ltower.\pI went after it when I was young.
But I never got one...$
data/maps/CianwoodHouse1_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_WhirlIslandsStory:
Have you heard of WHIRL ISLANDS?\pThere are what they call Tidal Bells
at its waterfall basin.\pThey don't make a single noise
in crashing waves.\pThere is only one way to make them
ring.\pIt is to obtain another Tidal Bell
just like the ones at the waterfall\lbasin.\pI went after it when I was young.
But I never got one...$
data/maps/CianwoodHouse1_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ClearBellReaction:
Oh! You've managed to get a
CLEAR BELL?\pThe old-time dream of mine...
I see...\pYou've done it...
...\l...I can hear it!\pThe chime of the bells on the wind
coming from the direction of the\lTIN TOWER...$
data/maps/CianwoodHouse1_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_TidalBellReaction:
Oh! You've managed to get a
Tidal Bell?\pThe old-time dream of mine...
I see...\pYou've done it...
...\l...I can hear it!\pThe chime of the bells on the sea
breeze coming from the direction of\lthe WHIRL ISLANDS...$

data/maps/CianwoodHouse2_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_LugiaHouseTeacher: You came from OLIVINE?\pDo you remember the four islands\nalong the way?\pI heard that a mythical sea crea-\nture is hiding in them.$
data/maps/CianwoodHouse2_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_LugiaHouseLass: I heard that you can only see it\nif you have a SILVER WING.\pIt must have the same scent as\nthe creature.$
data/maps/CianwoodHouse2_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_LugiaHouseTwin: I've heard that the whirlpools\naround the islands are caused by\lthe sea creature.\pYou might need a special move\nto get past them.$

data/maps/CianwoodHouse3_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacAskShuckle:
I, I'm in shock!\pA guy about your age with piercing
eyes and long hair came in.\pHe scared me into giving him my
prized POKéMON!\pI still have one left, but what if
he comes back?\pYou look strong. Could you look
after my POKéMON for a while?$
data/maps/CianwoodHouse3_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacTakeCareShuckle: Oh, thank you!\pTake good care of it, please!$
data/maps/CianwoodHouse3_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacIfHeComesBack: Oh, no… What'll I do if he comes\nback?$
data/maps/CianwoodHouse3_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacAskReturn: Hi! How's my POKéMON?\pI think I'm safe now, so may I\nhave it back?$
data/maps/CianwoodHouse3_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacShuckleNotThere: Hey, you don't have my POKéMON\nwith you.$
data/maps/CianwoodHouse3_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacShuckleLikesYou: My POKéMON has come to like you.\pAll right, you should keep it.\pBut promise to be good to it!$
data/maps/CianwoodHouse3_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacRobbed2: Oh, no, no… That's the same as\nbeing robbed.$
data/maps/CianwoodHouse3_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacHappinessSpeech: For POKéMON, happiness is being\nwith a person who treats them well.$
data/maps/CianwoodHouse3_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacLastMon: If I take my POKéMON back,\nwhat are you going to use\nin battle?$

data/maps/CianwoodPokecenter_hns/scripts.CianwoodPokemoncenter_Text_Fisher1: As far as water POKéMON go,\nTENTACOOL is the best by a\lnautical mile!$
data/maps/CianwoodPokecenter_hns/scripts.CianwoodPokemoncenter_Text_Fisher2: You seem like you need a water\nPOKéMON.\pHere, take this one, I have plenty.$
data/maps/CianwoodPokecenter_hns/scripts.CianwoodCity_Text_PokecenterLass: Did you meet the POKéMANIAC?\pHe's always bragging about his\nrare POKéMON.$
data/maps/CianwoodPokecenter_hns/scripts.CianwoodCity_Text_GymGuide:
The POKéMON GYM trainers here are
macho bullies.\pIf I stick around, they might
come after me.\pHere's some advice: the GYM LEADER
uses the FIGHTING-type.\pSo you should confound him with
psychic POKéMON.\pWipe out his POKéMON before they
can use their physical strength.\pAnd those boulders in the middle
of the GYM?\pIf you don't move them correctly,
you won't reach the GYM LEADER.\pIf you get stuck, go outside.$
data/maps/CianwoodPokecenter_hns/scripts.CianwoodCity_Text_GymGuideWin: {PLAYER}! You won!\nI could tell by looking at you!$
data/maps/CianwoodPokecenter_hns/scripts.CianwoodCity_Text_PokecenterSuperNerd: I love showing off the POKéMON\nthat I've raised.\pDon't you?\pI'm going to get into a bunch of\nbattles, and show off my POKéMON!$

data/maps/CianwoodShop_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_PharmacistGivePotion: Your POKéMON appear to be fine.\pIs something worrying you?\p…\pThe LIGHTHOUSE POKéMON is in\ntrouble?\pI got it!\pThis ought to do the trick.$
data/maps/CianwoodShop_hns/scripts.inc.CianwoodCity_Text_PharmacistDescribePoti: My SECRET POTION is a tad too\nstrong, so I only offer it in an\lemergency.$

data/maps/CinnabarIsland_Frlg/scripts.in.CinnabarIsland_Text_GymSign: CINNABAR ISLAND POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\lThe Hotheaded Quiz Master!$

data/maps/CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_h.CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Cool: CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE apparently\nlives alone in the SEAFOAM ISLANDS\lcave…$
data/maps/CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_h.CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Fish: It's been a year since the volcano\nerupted.$

data/maps/CinnabarIsland_hns/scripts.inc.CinnabarIsland_Text_Blaine: BLAINE: I'll never give up\nuntil the day I've rebuilt\lCINNABAR GYM!\pI'll be at the FIGHTING DOJO\nuntil then.$
data/maps/CinnabarIsland_hns/scripts.inc.CinnabarIsland_Text_BlueBefore:
Who are you?\pWell, it's plain to see that you're
a trainer…\pMy name's BLUE.\pI was once the CHAMPION, although
it was for only a short time…\pThat meddling RED did me in…\pAnyway, what do you want? You want
to challenge me or something?\p…I hate to say it, but I'm not in
the mood for a battle now.\pTake a good look around you…\pA volcano erupts, and just like
that, a whole town disappears.\pWe can go on winning and losing in
POKéMON. But if nature so much as\ltwitches, we can lose in a second.\p…\pThat's the way it is…\pBut, anyway, I'm still a trainer.\pIf I see a strong opponent, it
makes me want to battle.\pIf you want to battle me, you'll
need 15 badges first.\pI'll take you on then.$
data/maps/CinnabarIsland_hns/scripts.inc.CinnabarIsland_Text_Blue:
Who are you?\pWell, it's plain to see that you're
a trainer…\pMy name's BLUE.\pI was once the CHAMPION, although
it was for only a short time…\pThat meddling RED did me in…\pAnyway, what do you want? You want
to challenge me or something?\p…I hate to say it, but I'm not in
the mood for a battle now.\pTake a good look around you…\pA volcano erupts, and just like
that, a whole town disappears.\pWe can go on winning and losing in
POKéMON. But if nature so much as\ltwitches, we can lose in a second.\p…\pThat's the way it is…\pBut, anyway, I'm still a trainer.\pIf I see a strong opponent, it
makes me want to battle.\pIf you want to battle me, come to
the VIRIDIAN GYM.\pI'll take you on then.$
data/maps/CinnabarIsland_hns/scripts.inc.CinnabarIsland_Text_GymSign: There's a notice here…\pCINNABAR GYM has relocated to\nSEAFOAM ISLANDS.\pBLAINE$
data/maps/CinnabarIsland_hns/scripts.inc.CinnabarIsland_Text_Sign: CINNABAR ISLAND\pThe Fiery Town of Burning Desire$

data/maps/CliffEdgeCave_hns/scripts.inc.CliffEdgeCave_Text_Baldman: If you see a fork in the road\ninside a cave, most likely one\lway is right and the other leads\lto a dead end.\pBut people can't help trying both.$

data/maps/CliffEdgeGate_hns/scripts.inc.CliffEdgeGate_Text_IntroOpen:
Did you know? There's a SAFARI ZONE
just around the corner.\pIt's really fun!
You will see many different kinds of\lPOKéMON, and it's all you can catch!\pThere is no reason not to go, right?
Just around the corner.$
data/maps/CliffEdgeGate_hns/scripts.inc.CliffEdgeGate_Text_Expectations: I appreciate that everybody is looking\nforward to it.\pBut the lady at the reception seems\na bit too dramatic...\pDon't get your expectations too high!$
data/maps/CliffEdgeGate_hns/scripts.inc.CliffEdgeGate_Text_SignOpen: Everything Is Thrilling!\nExplore to Find Wild POKéMON!\lWarden BAOBA's SAFARI ZONE\lUp and Running!$

data/maps/DarkCave_NorthSide_hns/scripts.DarkCave2_Text_Nerd:
Whoa! You startled me there!\pI had my BLACK-GLASSES on, so I
didn't notice you at all.\pWhat am I doing here?\pHey, don't you worry about it.\pI'll give you a pair of BLACK-
GLASSES, so forget you saw me,
OK?$
data/maps/DarkCave_NorthSide_hns/scripts.DarkCave2_Text_Nerd2: BLACK-GLASSES ups the power of\nDARK-type moves.$

data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_TinyIslandCommunity: DEWFORD is a tiny island community.\nIf something gets trendy here,\leveryone picks up on it right away.$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_TownSign: DEWFORD TOWN\n“A tiny island in the blue sea.”$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_GymSign: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BRAWLY\l“A big wave in fighting!”$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_LandedInDewfordDeliverLett: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've hit land in DEWFORD.\pI suppose you're off to deliver that\nLETTER to, who was it now, STEVEN!$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg: MR. BRINEY: Have you delivered your\nLETTER?\pOr were you meaning to sail back to\nPETALBURG?$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSai: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG it is, then!\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_GoDeliverIllBeWaiting: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver\nthe LETTER. I'll be waiting.$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInDewford: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've hit land in DEWFORD!\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail again!$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\pNow, my friend, where are we bound?$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSai: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, is it?\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSai: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, is it?\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_JustTellMeWhenYouNeedTo: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever\nyou need to set sail again!$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_GettingItchToFish: This is a renowned fishing spot.\nAre you getting the itch to fish?$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods: I hear you, and I like what\nyou're saying!\pI'll give you one of my fishing RODS.$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice:
And, as an added bonus, I'll even throw
in a little fishing advice!\pFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\pFocus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull on the ROD.\pSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,\lyou need to time the pulls on your ROD\lto haul them in.$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_ThatsTooBadThen: Oh, is that so?\nThat's too bad, then.$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_GreatHaulInSomeBigOnes: Is that right! That's great!\nHaul in some big ones!$
data/maps/DewfordTown/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice:
Oh, hey, don't get down on yourself!
I'll give you a little fishing advice.\pFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\pFocus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull the ROD.\pSometimes you can snag something

data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pDEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY commands
FIGHTING-type POKéMON.\pGoing against him with NORMAL-type
POKéMON is asking for trouble.\pFIGHTING POKéMON will lay a serious
smack down on NORMAL POKéMON,\lso be careful!\pWhat's worse, the GYM is as dark as
the ocean floor.\pBut it will get brighter after defeating
the TRAINERS in your way.\pHey, okay, go for it!$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory: Whoah! It's turned too bright in here!\pYour future is bright, too!$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoPostBattle: Your skill overcame my strength!\nYour technique is commendable!$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro: There's no need for BRAWLY to be\ninvolved!\pI'll crush you!$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynDefeat: But… How?\nHow could I lose so easily?$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle: I'm not going to waste this loss.\nI'll use it to motivate me to train!\pOne day I'll become a GYM LEADER…\pNo, I'll become the POKéMON LEAGUE\nCHAMPION!$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraIntro: Don't you dare brush me off!\nIt's not my fault if you cry!$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle: I battle in the dark to make my heart\nstronger.\pBut because it's so dark, I can never\nsee BRAWLY's face…$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithIntro: Ufufu…\nAre you stumbling around in the dark?$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithDefeat: Oh, you…\nI don't want to know you!$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithPostBattle: You deserve to stay lost and end up\nback at the entrance again!$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenIntro: I'll show you the gumption of\na sailing man!$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenDefeat: How'd this happen?\nIt's not like me to lose this way!$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenPostBattle: Oh, aye! You're worthy of seeing\nour GYM LEADER.$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianIntro: If you mean to pass, it has to be\nthrough me!$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro:
I'm BRAWLY!
DEWFORD's GYM LEADER!\pI've been churned in the rough waves
of these parts, and I've grown tough\lin the pitch-black cave!\pSo you wanted to challenge me?
Let me see what you're made of!$
data/maps/DewfordTown_Gym/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat: Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger\nsplash than I expected!\pYou swamped me!\pOkay, you've got me.\nTake this GYM BADGE!$

up to Level 30, even those you get in\ltrades, obey without question.\pAnd, you'll be able to use the HM move

data/maps/DewfordTown_House1/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_House1_Text_LotToBeSaidForLi: There's a lot to be said for living on\na small island like this in harmony with\lPOKéMON and the family.$
data/maps/DewfordTown_House1/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_House1_Text_LifeGoesSlowlyOn: I left the major port of SLATEPORT\nCITY when I married my husband here.\pLife goes by slowly on this little\nisland. But being surrounded by the\lbeautiful sea--that's happiness, too.$

data/maps/DewfordTown_House2/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSil:
Gorge your eyes on this!\pIt's a SILK SCARF. It's right at the
cutting edge of fashion, yeah!\pOh, I can see your eyes twinkling!
