data/maps/DewfordTown_House2/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom: Oh, you don't have room?\pNow, listen tight, this SCARF is a must-\nhave! Why, I would sell all my items\lin order to get it!$
data/maps/DewfordTown_House2/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainSilkScarf: The SILK SCARF raises the power of\nNORMAL-type moves.\pIt's a marvelous SCARF that will go\nwith almost all POKéMON!$
data/maps/DewfordTown_House2/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool:
Wow, you bothered to cross the sea
to visit DEWFORD?\pDid you maybe come here because you
heard about BRAWLY?\pHe's so cool…
Everyone idolizes him.$

data/maps/DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F/s.DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_StoneC: There's a stone cavern at the edge\nof town.\pI've heard you can find rare stones\nthere.$
data/maps/DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F/s.DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Fainte: Even if a POKéMON faints and can't\nbattle, it can still use a move learned\lfrom a HIDDEN MACHINE (HM).$

data/maps/DiglettsCave_EntranceNorth_hns.DiglettsCave_EntranceNorth_Text_Brock: BROCK: Small spaces surrounded by\nrocks make you feel peaceful,\ldon't you agree?\pIf you want another match, I'll be\nat the FIGHTING DOJO.$

data/maps/DragonsDen_Cavern_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Text_Clair: {PLAYER}… So you're here.\pIf you think you can keep up,\nwith me, come to the FIGHTING\lDOJO in SAFFRON.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Cavern_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_Clair_GiveTM: CLAIR: WAIT!\pI'm sorry about this.\nHere, take this as my apology.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Cavern_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_Clair_ExplainTM: DRAGON PULSE is a kind of er...\nnever mind!\pIt's a huge energy of some kind.\pIf you don't want it, you don't have\nto take it.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Cavern_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_ClairWhatsTheMatt:
What's the matter? Aren't
you going on to the POKéMON\lLEAGUE?\pAfter you become CHAMPION, you
can rematch any GYM LEADER you\lwant.\pGo to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pDo you know how to get there?\pFrom here, go to NEW BARK TOWN.\pThen SURF east to POKéMON LEAGUE.\pThe route there is very tough.\pDon't you dare lose at the POKéMON
LEAGUE!\pIf you do, I'll feel even worse
about having lost to you!\pGive it everything you've got.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Cavern_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_DragonShrineSign: DRAGON SHRINE\pA shrine honoring the dragon\nPOKéMON\psaid to have lived in DRAGON'S\nDEN.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Cavern_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_SilverTraining1:
…
What? {PLAYER}?\p…No, I won't battle you now…\pMy POKéMON aren't ready to beat
you.\pI can't push them too hard now.\pI have to be disciplined to become
the greatest POKéMON trainer…$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Cavern_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_SilverTraining2: …\pWhew…\pLearn to stay out of my way…$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Cavern_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_CooltrainermDarin: The SHRINE ahead is home to the\nMASTER of our dragon-user clan.\pYou're not allowed to just go in!$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Cavern_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_CooltrainerfCaraA: Soon I'm going to get permission\nfrom our MASTER to use dragons.\pWhen I do, I'm going to become an\nadmirable dragon trainer and gain\lour MASTER's approval.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Cavern_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia1Se: It's a stranger we don't know.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Cavern_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia1Af: It was like having to battle\nLANCE.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Cavern_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia2Af: We'll tell on you.\pMASTER will be angry with you.$

data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ElderGreeting:
Hm… Good to see you here.\pNo need to explain why you came.
CLAIR sent you here, didn't she?\pThat girl is a handful…
I am sorry, but I must test you.\pNot to worry, you are to answer
only a few questions.\lReady?$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Question2: What helps you to win battles?$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Question3: What kind of trainer do you wish\nto battle?$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Question4: What is most important for\nraising POKéMON?$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Question5: Strong POKéMON. Weak POKéMON.\nWhich is more important?$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_WrongAnswer1: Hah? I didn't quite catch that…$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_PassedTest: Hm… I see…\pYou care deeply for POKéMON.\pVery commendable.\pThat conviction is what is\nimportant!\p{PLAYER}, don't lose that belief.\pIt will see you through at the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ClairYouPassed: So how did it go?\pI guess there's no point\nin asking. You did fail?\p..................................\p…What? You passed?$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ClairYoureLying: You're lying!\pEven I haven't been approved!$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_MustIInformLance: CLAIR!\pThis child is impeccable,\nin skill and spirit!\pAdmit defeat and confer the\nRISINGBADGE!\p…Or must I inform LANCE of this?$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_HereRisingBadge: Here, this is the RISINGBADGE…\pHurry up! Take it!$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_RisingBadgeExplan: RISINGBADGE will enable your\nPOKéMON to use the move for\lclimbing waterfalls.\pAlso, all POKéMON will recognize\nyou as a trainer and obey your\levery command without question.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ElderScoldsClair: CLAIR…\pReflect upon what it is that you\nlack and this child has.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ComeAgain: Come again, if you so desire.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_SilverIsInTrainin: A boy close to your age is in\ntraining here.\pHe is much like CLAIR when she was\nyounger. It is a little worrisome…$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Elder2: It's been quite some time since a\ntrainer has gained our MASTER's\lrare approval.\pIn fact, not since Master LANCE.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Elder3: You know young Master LANCE?\pHe looks so much like our MASTER\ndid in his youth.\pIt's in their blood.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_TakeThisDratini: Hm… Good to see you here.\pYour arrival is most fortunate.\pI have something for you.\pTake this DRATINI as proof that I\nhave recognized your worth.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_SymbolicDragon: Dragon POKéMON are symbolic of our\nclan.\pYou have shown that you can be\nentrusted with one.$
data/maps/DragonsDen_Shrine_hns/scripts..DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ClairsGrandfather: CLAIR appears to have learned an\ninvaluable lesson from you.\pI thank you as her grandfather.$

data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.EcruteakCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified: ECRUTEAK CITY POKéMON GYM\pMORTY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MortyIntroText:
Good of you to have come.\pHere in ECRUTEAK, POKéMON have
always been revered.\pIt's said that a rainbow-colored
POKéMON will come down to\lappear before a true Trainer.\pI believed that tale, so I've
trained here in secret.\pAs a result, I can now see what
others cannot.\pJust a bit more...\pWith a little more, I could see
a future where I meet the\lrainbow-colored POKéMON.\pYou're going to help me reach
that level!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MortyWinLossText: I'm not good enough yet...\pAll right. This BADGE is yours.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MortyText_FogBadgeSpeech: With the FOGBADGE, POKéMON up\nto Level 50 will obey you.\pAlso, any POKéMON that knows\nSURF will be able to use it\lanytime.\pI want you to have this too.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MortyText_ShadowBallSpeech: That's SHADOW BALL.\nIt causes damage and may\llower SP. DEF.\pUse it if it suits you.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MortyFightDoneText: I see...\pYour journey has taken you to\nfar-off places.\pYou've witnessed more than I\never have.\pI envy you for that...$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MortyRematchText:
Ah, the JOHTO CHAMPION!
Good of you to come.\pYou've shown strength and skill,
but have you grown since we\llast battled?\pI've trained with my GHOST-type
POKéMON ever since.\pLet's see if you can overcome
the shadows again.\pWant to have a rematch?$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.Morty_RematchDefeatText: I'm not good enough yet...\pYou've witnessed more than I\never have.\pI envy you for that...$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.SageJeffreySeenText: I spent the spring with my\nPOKéMON.\pThen summer, fall, and winter...\pThen spring came again.\nWe've been together a long time.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.SagePingSeenText: Can you inflict any damage\non our POKéMON?$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.SagePingAfterBattleText: We use GHOST-type POKéMON.\pNo NORMAL-type attacks can\nharm them!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MediumMarthaAfterBattleText: The one who wants to win the\nmost is the one who will!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MediumGraceSeenText: Stumped by our dark corridors?\nDefeat me if you want a hint!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MediumGraceAfterBattleText: Fine. I'll tell you the secret\nof the shadows.\pThe path is right in front of\nyour eyes!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.EcruteakCity_GymGuideText:
Hey CHAMP! You're almost
halfway there!\pTrainers here use GHOST and
DARK-type POKéMON.\pWhile MORTY is a GHOST-type
expert, be wary of his mystic\ldeer.\pIt's said to cause strange
nightmares...$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.EcruteakCity_GymGuideWinText: Whew, {PLAYER}. You did great!\pI was cowering in the corner\nout of pure terror!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Gym_hns/scripts.i.EcruteakCity_GymClosedText: MORTY, the GYM LEADER, is\nabsent.\pSorry, but you'll have to\nleave.\pHohohoho.$

data/maps/EcruteakCity_House1_hns/script.EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouse_Text_Gramps: This happened when I was young.\pThe sky suddenly turned black. A\ngiant flying POKéMON was blocking\lout the sun.\pI wonder what that POKéMON was?\pIt was like a bird and a dragon.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_House1_hns/script.EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouse_Text_Youngster: Is there really a POKéMON that big?\pIf it exists, it must be powerful.$

data/maps/EcruteakCity_House2_hns/script.Ecruteak_Text_ItemfinderAdventure: Ah. You're on an adventure with\nyour POKéMON?\pWell, what's an adventure without\ntreasure hunting?\pAm I right, or am I right?$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_House2_hns/script.Ecruteak_Text_ItemfinderTrueSpirit: Good! You understand the true\nspirit of adventure.\pI like that! Take this with you.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_House2_hns/script.Ecruteak_Text_ItemfinderExplanation:
There are many items lying about
that aren't obvious.\pUse DOWSING MACHINE to check if there
is an item on the ground near you.\pIt doesn't show the exact spot,
so you'll have to look yourself.\pOh yeah--I heard there are items
in ECRUTEAK's BURNED TOWER.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_House2_hns/script.Ecruteak_Text_ItemfinderToEachHisOwn: Oh… To each his own, I suppose…$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_House2_hns/script.Ecruteak_Text_ItemFinderMan: ECRUTEAK is a very old city.\nMany generations passed down\ltheir history in books like these.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_House2_hns/script.Ecruteak_Text_HistoryBook: HISTORY OF ECRUTEAK\pWant to read it?$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_House2_hns/script.Ecruteak_Text_TwoTowers:
In ECRUTEAK, there were two towers.\pEach tower was the roost of
powerful flying POKéMON.\pBut one of the towers burned to
the ground.\pThe two POKéMON haven't been seen
since…\pKeep reading?$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_House2_hns/script.Ecruteak_Text_ThreeMon:
ECRUTEAK was also home to three
POKéMON that raced around the town.\pThey were said to have been born
of water, lightning and fire.\pBut they could not contain their
excessive power.\pSo they say the three ran like the
wind off into the grassland.$

data/maps/EcruteakCity_Mart_hns/scripts..EcruteakMart_Text_SuperNerd: My EEVEE evolved into an ESPEON.\pBut my friend's EEVEE turned into\nan UMBREON.\pI wonder why? We both were raising\nour EEVEE in the same way…$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Mart_hns/scripts..EcruteakMart_Text_Granny: If you use REVIVE, a POKéMON that's\nfainted will wake right up.$

data/maps/EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter_hns.EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Bill1: Hi, I'm BILL. And who are you?\pHmm, {PLAYER}, huh?\nYou've come at the right time.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter_hns.EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Bill2:
I just finished adjustments on my
POKéMON STORAGE SYSTEM.\pYou know that PC you use to store
all your POKéMON?\pI developed that myself!\pNow that I've installed this one,
my PC is running at all\lPOKéMON CENTERS in JOHTO and KANTO.\pI have to hurry on back to
GOLDENROD and see my folks. Feel\lfree to visit anytime!\pBuh-bye!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter_hns.EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Pokefa: The way the KIMONO GIRLS dance is\nmarvelous.\pJust like the way they use their\nPOKéMON.$
You must be hoping to battle more\npeople, right?\pThere's apparently some place where\ntrainers gather.\pWhere, you ask?\pIt's a little past OLIVINE CITY.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter_hns.EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Cooltr: MORTY, the GYM LEADER, is soooo\ncool.\pHis POKéMON are really tough too.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter_hns.EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_GymGui: LAKE OF RAGE…\pThe appearance of a GYARADOS\nswarm…\pI smell a conspiracy. I know it!$

data/maps/EcruteakCity_SageOffice1_hns/s.EcruteakCity_SageOffice1_Text_Sign: The bell of tin rings clearly for\nthose under the tower's wing.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_SageOffice1_hns/s.EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_SageNoBadg: TIN TOWER is off limits to the\nunworthy. Sorry but you'll have\lto leave.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_SageOffice1_hns/s.EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_SageWithBa: TIN TOWER is off limits to anyone\nwithout ECRUTEAK GYM's BADGE.\pAh!\pECRUTEAK's GYM BADGE! Please, go\nright through.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_SageOffice1_hns/s.EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_SageNoClea: A momentous event has occurred.\pI beg your pardon, but I must ask\nyou to leave.\p…What soothes the soul…\pThe WISE TRIO say things that are\nso very difficult to understand…$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_SageOffice1_hns/s.EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_SageHearsC: A momentous event has occurred.\pI beg your pardon, but I must ask\nyou to leave.\p..............................$

Ah!\pThe sound of that CLEAR BELL!\pIt… It's sublime!\pI've never heard so beautiful a
sound before!\pThat bell's chime is indicative of
the bearer's soul.\pYou…\pYou may be able to make it through
TIN TOWER.\pPlease, do go on.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_SageOffice1_hns/s.EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_SageDone: That bell's chime is indicative of\nthe bearer's soul.\pYou…\nTruly are worthy.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_SageOffice1_hns/s.EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_WanderingS: The TIN TOWER ahead is a nine-\ntier tower of divine beauty.\pIt soothes the soul of all who\nsee it.$
The TIN TOWER shook! A POKéMON must\nhave returned to the top!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_SageOffice1_hns/s.EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_Gramps: Two towers… Two POKéMON…\pBut when one burned down, both\nPOKéMON flew away, never to return.$

data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Rocket1: ROCKET: Stop dancing such a serious\ndance! Show me something like\la hula dance!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_KimonoRocket1: KIMONO GIRL: ...You mustn't push\nsuch a request on me.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Rocket2: ROCKET: Huh?\pAre you telling me you don't\nrespect what the customer\lwants?$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Rocket3: Well, then I'll show you how\nto dance. I'll show you a\lgreat one.\pWahahaha!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_RocketSeen: Huh? Who are you?\nYou dare to get in my way?$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_RocketBeaten: Oh, no!\nYou make me look like a\lvillain!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_RocketAfter: Oops! I have an important mission!\nIf they find out I was wasting\ltime here, they'll make me start\lover as the lowest ROCKET GRUNT!\pI better leave now!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_KimonoRocket3:
You must be {PLAYER},
correct? That was indeed\lexcellent.\pKind and strong... Good at
raising POKéMON as well...\pThat person does know what
to look for in people...\pOhoho! That was just me
talking to myself.\lNever mind.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Kimono:
For KIMONO GIRLS like me,
dancing is everything.\pI have never gone a day
without a dance practice.\pPOKéMON are the same.
They grow with you little\lby little each day.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_SurfGuyRocket: What's the deal with that\nTeam Rocket Grunt, messing\lwith that KIMONO GIRL?\pYou are a Trainer, right?\nPlease help her!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_SurfGuyGiveSur: Wonderful! You were so\ncourageous for your age!\pIt was a rare sight to see!\nI want you to have this.\pDon't be shy--take it!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_SurfGuyGaveSur: That's SURF.\nIt's a move that lets POKéMON\lswim across water with ease.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_SurfGuyAfter:
Not only are the KIMONO GIRLS
great dancers, they're also\lskilled at POKéMON.\pBut they battle only for good
reasons.\pI don't know if you could beat
them if they showed their skill...$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Boy: I was supposed to be the hero...!\nSo much for getting close to\la KIMONO GIRL!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Granny:
That man's always with his
PSYDUCK.\pSays he wants a POKéMON that
can SURF and dance.\pIs he trying to make a POKéMON
that stars in synchronized\lswimming?$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_GrannyBefore: Oh... Ouch...!\nThis stomachache!\pI wouldn't let this guy act like\nthat if not for this pain...!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Gramps:
The KIMONO GIRLS are so
beautiful...\pBut they have to go through
rigorous training.\pAnd they have to learn to follow
customs before appearing in\lpublic.\pBut if you love something,
anything is possible.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_GrampsBefore: Oh... Ouch...!\nThis back pain!\pI wouldn't let this guy act like\nthat if not for this pain...!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Girl: The KIMONO GIRLS are my big\nsisters! I'll be like them one\lday!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_FancyPanel: It's a fancy panel that's\ndecorated with flowers.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_ZukiSeen:
Welcome. My name is ZUKI.
I met you previously in VIOLET\lCITY.\pTo bring back {STR_VAR_1}, we
needed someone with the right bond\lwith POKéMON.\pWe asked MR. POKéMON to give this
MYSTERY EGG to\lwhoever showed potential.\pThe EGG went from MR. POKéMON
to PROF.ELM, then to you.\pBut being pure alone is not enough
to face the power of this POKéMON.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_ZukiSeenAgain: I will test you to see if you are\na good Trainer.\pAre you ready, {PLAYER}?$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_ZukiNo: That is fine...\nI will wait for you to get\lready.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_NaokoSeen:
You are quite strong. You helped
me in the ILEX FOREST.\pI'm NAOKO--not so good with
directions.\pI saw you defeat Team Rocket
when KURT was in trouble at\lthe SLOWPOKE WELL.\pLet me challenge you and your
POKéMON!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_MikiSeen:
You're quite the Trainer. I
remember you chased off that\lRocket Grunt from right here.\pThank you for that.\pThough, I'm a Trainer too.
She who knows the most speaks\lthe least!\pI am MIKI--the KIMONO GIRL!\pLet me challenge you and your
POKéMON!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_SayoSeen:
Excellent spirit! You got me
off the ice by pushing me.\pI skate in sandals.
I am SAYO--the KIMONO GIRL!\pI listened in the DRAGON'S DEN
when you passed the Elder's test.\pLet me challenge you and your
POKéMON!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_KuniSeen:
I'm the last one.\pYou were dependable at the
GOLDENROD TUNNEL.\pI'm the one who twirls even
underground--KUNI!\pI saw you thwart Rocket's
plan to take the Radio Tower.\pNow show me your strength!
Let me challenge you and your\lPOKéMON!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_ZukiDone: We were not wrong about you.\nYou are indeed worthy of this...\pPlease take it.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_GirlHooh: Big sisters! I just saw the\nbig shadow of a POKéMON over\lthe TIN TOWER!\pIt could be...$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_GirlLugia: Big sisters! I just saw the\nbig shadow of a POKéMON in the\lWHIRL ISLANDS' waters!\pIt could be...$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_ZukiHooh: ZUKI: {PLAYER}!\nWe'll be at the TIN TOWER.\nSee you there!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_ZukiLugia: ZUKI: {PLAYER}!\nWe'll be at the WHIRL ISLANDS.\lSee you there!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_ZukiAfterAll:
Thank you for your help the
other day.\pYou've shown the bond between
people can grow with POKéMON...\pWe appreciate how you lived up
to our hopes, {PLAYER}!\pIf you learned anything from
this, thank MR. POKéMON and\lPROF.ELM...$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_Theater_hns/scrip.EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_KimonoGirlsBef: Talk to ZUKI in the middle\nwhen you are ready.$

data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_Silver2: {RIVAL}: How...? How is this\npossible? How can I lose to mere\lKIMONO GIRLS...?$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_Silver3:
{RIVAL}: You were watching me,
{PLAYER}...\pYeah, that's right!\pI never thought defeating five
KIMONO GIRLS would be so hard...\pI got beaten to a pulp...\p...\pYou must have come here for the
same reason, right?\pDon't get cocky just because you
defeated TEAM ROCKET!\pThese KIMONO GIRLS are insanely
strong.\pSee if you can defeat them.\pBut I'm not going back, I don't
want to see you win.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_UnusedMissingDaughter: Oh, no. Oh, no…\pMy daughter is missing.\pNo… She couldn't have gone to the\nBURNED TOWER.\pI told her not to go near it…\pPeople seem to disappear there…\pOh, what should I do…?$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_Gramps1: ECRUTEAK used to have two towers:\none each in the east and west.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_Gramps2: Ah, child. Have you learned to\ndance like the KIMONO GIRLS?\pIf you go to their DANCE THEATER,\nan odd old man will give you\lsomething nice, I hear.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_Lass1: I'm going to practice at the DANCE\nTHEATER. Care to join me?$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_Lass2: The tower that used to be here…\pMy grandma told me it used to be\nmuch taller.\pI hear there are ghosts in it now.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_Lass2_ReleasedBeasts: Three big POKéMON ran off in different\ndirections. What were they?$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_Fisher: I heard a rumor about OLIVINE\nLIGHTHOUSE.\pThe POKéMON that serves as the\nbeacon fell ill. Sounds like they\lare in trouble.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_Fisher_JasmineReturned: The POKéMON at OLIVINE LIGHTHOUSE\nhas been cured.\pBoats can safely sail out to sea at\nnight again.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_Youngster: I hear POKéMON are rampaging at the\nLAKE OF RAGE. I'd like to see that.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_Gramps3:
In the distant past…\pThis tower burned in a fire. Three
nameless POKéMON perished in it.\pA rainbow-colored POKéMON descended
from the sky and resurrected them…\pIt's a legend that has been passed
down by ECRUTEAK GYM LEADERS.\pMe?\pI was a trainer way back when.
Hohoho!$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_SageGym: Gym Leader MORTY is not here right\nnow. You may find him at the\lBURNED TOWER.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_Sign: ECRUTEAK CITY\nA Historical City\pWhere the Past Meets the Present$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_TinTowerSign: TIN TOWER\pA legendary POKéMON is said to\nroost here.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_OfficeSign: Barrier Station to TIN TOWER\pNo Trespassing by the Unworthy.$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_GymSign: ECRUTEAK CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MORTY\pThe Mystic Seer of the Future$
data/maps/EcruteakCity_hns/scripts.inc.EcruteakCity_Text_BurnedTowerSign: BURNED TOWER\pIt was destroyed by a mysterious\nfire.\pPlease stay away, as it is unsafe.$

data/maps/EverGrandeCity/scripts.inc.EverGrandeCity_Text_CitySign: EVER GRANDE CITY\p“The paradise of flowers, the sea,\nand POKéMON.”$

data/maps/EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom/s.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroS:
WALLACE: Welcome, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pThat incident in SOOTOPOLIS CITY…
That was superb work, putting an end\lto that crisis all by yourself.\pOops!\pIt wouldn't be fair to say that you
alone ended the crisis.\pYou overcame that difficult situation
by working as one with your POKéMON.\pWe TRAINERS raise POKéMON by giving
them items and by teaching them new\ltechniques for battle.\pBut we ourselves also learn many
things from POKéMON.\pAnd this is where your achievements
are put to the test against what\lothers like you have achieved.\pNow!\pWho can most elegantly dance with
their POKéMON in HOENN?\pShow me right here and now!$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom/s.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat: I, the CHAMPION, fall in defeat…\pThat was wonderful work.\nYou were elegant, infuriatingly so.\lAnd yet it was utterly glorious!\pKudos to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou are a truly noble POKéMON\nTRAINER!$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom/s.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBa:
WALLACE: The POKéMON you sent into
battle…\pAt times they danced like a spring
breeze, and at times they struck\llike lightning.\pIt was with light, yet surefooted,
elegance that you led your POKéMON.\pEven I felt bedazzled by your
masterful performance!\pYou now stand at the glorious peak
of the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI now proclaim you to be the new
HOENN region…$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom/s.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayAdv: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHere's some advice before you challenge\nthe CHAMPION…$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom/s.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayIts: MAY: Huh?\nWhat, what, what?\p{PLAYER}{KUN}…\nCould it be that…\lIt's already over?$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom/s.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Brenda: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}!\pHow would you like some advice before\nyou challenge the CHAMPION?…$
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}…\pAre you trying to tell me…\nYou've beaten the CHAMPION?$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom/s.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchA:
PROF. BIRCH: See?
What did I tell you, {RIVAL}?\pDidn't I tell you that you don't need
to worry about {PLAYER}{KUN}?\p… … … … … … … …
{PLAYER}{KUN}, you've finally done it.\pWhen I heard that you defeated your
own father at the PETALBURG GYM,\lI thought perhaps you had a chance…\pBut to think you've actually become
the CHAMPION!\pAh, yes!\pWhat became of your POKéDEX?
Here, let me see.$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom/s.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchC: PROF. BIRCH: Anyways,\ncongratulations!\pNow, go proudly into the final room!$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom/s.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Wallac: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pNo, let me rephrase that properly.\pThe new CHAMPION!\pCome with me.$
WALLACE: I'm sorry, but…\pFrom here on, only those TRAINERS who\nhave become CHAMPIONS may enter.\pYou'll have to wait outside with\nPROF. BIRCH.$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom/s.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCon:
MAY: Groan…\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pI'm just joking! That's okay!
That's the rule!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}!
Honestly, congratulations!$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom/s.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Brenda: BRENDAN: Whaaaat?! … … … … …\n… … … … … … … …\pIt can't be helped if that's the rule.\p{PLAYER}, way to go!\nCongratulations!$

data/maps/EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom/scri.EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpee:
I am the last of the POKéMON LEAGUE
ELITE FOUR, DRAKE the DRAGON master!\pIn their natural state, POKéMON are
wild living things. They are free.\pAt times, they hinder us.
At times, they help us.\pFor us to battle with POKéMON as
partners, do you know what it takes?\pDo you know what is needed?\pIf you don't, then you will never
prevail over me!$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom/scri.EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_PostBattl:
You deserve every credit for coming
this far as a TRAINER of POKéMON.\pYou do seem to know what is needed.\pYes, what a TRAINER needs is a
virtuous heart.\pPOKéMON touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and learn good from wrong.\pThey touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and grow strong.\pGo! Go onwards!
The CHAMPION is waiting!$

data/maps/EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom/scr.EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_IntroSpe:
Welcome, my name is GLACIA
of the ELITE FOUR.\pI've traveled from afar to HOENN
so that I may hone my ice skills.\pBut all I have seen are challenges by
weak TRAINERS and their POKéMON.\pWhat about you?\pIt would please me to no end if I could
go all out against you!$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom/scr.EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_Defeat: You and your POKéMON…\nHow hot your spirits burn!\pThe all-consuming heat overwhelms.\pIt's no surprise that my icy skills\nfailed to harm you.$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom/scr.EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_PostBatt: Advance to the next room.\pAnd there, confirm the truly fearsome\nside of the POKéMON LEAGUE.$

data/maps/EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame/scri.EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_HereWeHon: WALLACE: This room…\pThis is where we keep records of\nPOKéMON that prevailed through\lharsh battles.\pIt is here that the LEAGUE CHAMPIONS\nare honored.$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame/scri.EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_LetsRecor: WALLACE: Come on, let's record your\nname as a TRAINER who triumphed over\lthe POKéMON LEAGUE, and the names of\lthe partners who battled with you.$

data/maps/EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom/scr.EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_IntroSpe:
Ahahaha!\pI'm PHOEBE of the ELITE FOUR.
I did my training on MT. PYRE.\pWhile I trained, I gained the ability
to commune with GHOST-type POKéMON.\pYes, the bond I developed with POKéMON
is extremely tight.\pSo, come on, just try and see if you can
even inflict damage on my POKéMON!$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom/scr.EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_PostBatt:
There's a definite bond between you
and your POKéMON, too.\pI didn't recognize it, so it's only
natural that I lost.\pYup, I'd like to see how far your bond
will carry you.\pGo ahead, move on to the next room.$

data/maps/EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1.EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Lea: The POKéMON LEAGUE is only a short\ndistance after the VICTORY ROAD.\pIf you've come this far, what choice\ndo you have but to keep going?$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1.EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Bel: The long and harrowing VICTORY ROAD…\pIt's like reliving the path one has\ntraveled in life…\pBelieve in your POKéMON and give it\nyour very best!$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1.EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Sco:
SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've clawed your
way up to face the POKéMON LEAGUE!\pI'm happy for you!
You made my cheering worthwhile!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, if you were to become
the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION…\pI'll get in touch with you then.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
Go for greatness!$

data/maps/EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1.EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_Mus: Beyond this point, only those TRAINERS\nwho have collected all the GYM BADGES\lare permitted to enter.\pTRAINER, let us confirm that you have\nall the GYM BADGES.$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1.EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_Hav: You haven't obtained all the BADGES.\pIf you're bound for the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must return with them.$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1.EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_GoF: TRAINER! Believe in yourself and your\nPOKéMON, and go forth!$

data/maps/EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom/scr.EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_IntroSpe:
Welcome, challenger!
I'm SIDNEY of the ELITE FOUR.\pI like that look you're giving me.
I guess you'll give me a good match.\lThat's good! Looking real good!\pAll right! You and me, let's enjoy
a battle that can only be staged\lhere in the POKéMON LEAGUE!$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom/scr.EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_Defeat: Well, how do you like that? I lost!\nEh, it was fun, so it doesn't matter.$
data/maps/EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom/scr.EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_PostBatt: Well, listen to what this loser has\nto say.\pYou've got what it takes to go far.\nNow, go on to the next room and enjoy\lyour next battle!$

data/maps/FallarborTown/scripts.inc.FallarborTown_Text_ShadyCharactersCozmos: Something's happening,\nand I don't like it!\pI've seen shady characters wandering\nin and out of PROF. COZMO's home…$
data/maps/FallarborTown/scripts.inc.FallarborTown_Text_RegionKnownForMeteors: This region's been known for meteors\nsince the olden days.\pThey say METEOR FALLS was gouged out\nby a falling meteorite long ago.$
data/maps/FallarborTown/scripts.inc.FallarborTown_Text_MyPreciousAzurill: See! Take a look!\nThis is my precious AZURILL!\pIt's slick and smooth and plushy, too!$
data/maps/FallarborTown/scripts.inc.FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlan:
Have you already challenged FLANNERY,
the LEADER of LAVARIDGE GYM?\pThe girl's grandfather was famous.
He was one of the ELITE FOUR in the\lPOKéMON LEAGUE at one point.\pIt wouldn't surprise me to see FLANNERY
become a great TRAINER in her own\lright.$
data/maps/FallarborTown/scripts.inc.FallarborTown_Text_BattleTentSign: BATTLE TENT FALLARBOR SITE\n“May the Greatest Teams Gather!”$
data/maps/FallarborTown/scripts.inc.FallarborTown_Text_TownSign: FALLARBOR TOWN\n“A farm community with small gardens.”$
data/maps/FallarborTown/scripts.inc.FallarborTown_Text_MoveTutorSign: MOVE TUTOR'S HOUSE\n“New moves taught to POKéMON.”$

data/maps/FallarborTown_BattleTentCorrid.FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_DoAllRigh: We do all right in the preliminary round,\nbut we can never win the appeals…\pMaybe it means I have to watch what\nother contestants are doing…$
data/maps/FallarborTown_BattleTentCorrid.FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_MonAllThe: See!\nMy POKéMON won all these RIBBONS!\pHave your POKéMON earned any RIBBONS?\nYou can check them on your POKéNAV.$
data/maps/FallarborTown_BattleTentCorrid.FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_CantWinEv: I can't beat GYM LEADERS…\pI can't win any CONTESTS…\pI've been here, there, and everywhere,\nand it's all for naught…$

data/maps/FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby/.FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MakeT: Fufufufufu.\pI'm going to make everyone think\nI'm just a kid and let them play down.\pThen, I'll shock them and grab\nthe title!$
data/maps/FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby/.FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Falla:
You know how BATTLE TENTS offer
different events in different towns?\pMy favorite is definitely the BATTLE
TENT in FALLARBOR TOWN.\pI think it's fantastic how TRAINERS
try to win with all their faith in\ltheir POKéMON.$
data/maps/FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby/.FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_CameT:
I heard something about some tent,
so I came to camp out.\pI didn't know that tents these days
are so luxurious!\pSince I'm here, I may as well try
my hand at battling!$
data/maps/FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby/.FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Scott:
SCOTT: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
So you came out to this BATTLE TENT!\pThe people in these parts tend to be
easygoing and laid-back.\pBut, you see, what I'm looking for are
people with…\pHow should I say this?\pSomeone bursting with the desire
and the drive to win.\pIf there were a TRAINER like that,
I'd immediately…\pWhoops! Never mind!
Keep working at it!$
SCOTT: Instead of wasting your\ntime with the likes of me, why not\lmake a challenge?$

data/maps/FallarborTown_CozmosHouse/scri.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_Meteorite: PROF. COZMO: Oh…\nI never should have let myself be\lconned into telling TEAM MAGMA where\lyou can find METEORITES…\pThat METEORITE from METEOR FALLS…\nIt's never going to be mine now…$
data/maps/FallarborTown_CozmosHouse/scri.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMet:
Oh!
Hah?\pThat item…\pCould it be?\pIs it the METEORITE that TEAM MAGMA
took from METEOR FALLS?\pPlease, may I have it?\pI'm not asking for it for free.
How about in exchange for this TM?$
data/maps/FallarborTown_CozmosHouse/scri.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_PleaseUse: PROF. COZMO: This TM, it represents\nmy feeling of gratitude.\lPlease use it!$
data/maps/FallarborTown_CozmosHouse/scri.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_ReallyGoi: PROF. COZMO: Oh, I can't believe it.\nThis is really, really great!\pThis is really going to help my research!$
data/maps/FallarborTown_CozmosHouse/scri.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CrushedWi: PROF. COZMO: Oh, but…\nI'm crushed with disappointment…$
data/maps/FallarborTown_CozmosHouse/scri.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MayIHaveM: PROF. COZMO: Please, may I have that\nMETEORITE?\pI'm not asking for it for free.\nHow about in exchange for this TM?$
data/maps/FallarborTown_CozmosHouse/scri.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoWent: PROF. COZMO went off to METEOR FALLS\non ROUTE 114 with some people from\lTEAM MAGMA.$
data/maps/FallarborTown_CozmosHouse/scri.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_FeelSorry: Poor PROF. COZMO…\nHe's so depressed… I feel sorry for him.$
data/maps/FallarborTown_CozmosHouse/scri.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoIsSo: Look at PROF. COZMO…\nHe's so happy! I think it's cute.$

data/maps/FallarborTown_Mart/scripts.inc.FallarborTown_Mart_Text_DecidingSkittyEv:
I'm having a hard time deciding if I
should make my SKITTY evolve or not.\pI only have to use this MOON STONE,
but it's so hard to decide…\pIf I make it evolve, it will become
much stronger.\pBut it will look so different, too.$
data/maps/FallarborTown_Mart/scripts.inc.FallarborTown_Mart_Text_SellNuggetIFound: This NUGGET I found here…\nI suppose I'll have to sell it, seeing\las how it has no other use.$

data/maps/FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHo.FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_I:
I'm the MOVE TUTOR.\pI know all the moves that POKéMON
learn--every one of them--and I can\lteach POKéMON those moves.\pI can teach a move to a POKéMON
of yours if you'd like.\pI'll do it for a HEART SCALE.
I'm collecting those now.$
data/maps/FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHo.FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_T: Oh! That's it! That's an honest to\ngoodness HEART SCALE!\pLet me guess, you want me to teach\na move?$
data/maps/FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHo.FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_D: Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have any move\nI can teach that POKéMON.$
data/maps/FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHo.FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_H: {PLAYER} handed over one HEART SCALE\nin exchange.$
data/maps/FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHo.FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_C: If your POKéMON need to learn a move,\ncome back with a HEART SCALE.$
Hunh? There isn't a single move that\nI can teach an EGG.$

data/maps/FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F.FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Lane:
Oh, hello.
You are?\pOkay, your name's {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I can see that you're a TRAINER.\pSo that means you use the POKéMON
Storage System I developed.\pHow I arrived at that conclusion is
a simple deductive process.\pYou spoke to me because you wanted
to access something on this PC.\pOh, I'm sorry. I'm LANETTE.\pHonestly, I'm glad to meet you--it's
great you're using the Storage System.\pIf you could, please visit me at home.
My house is on ROUTE 114.$
data/maps/FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F.FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Foss: I wonder what POKéMON looked like\nlong, long ago?\pMaybe the FOSSIL MANIAC at the edge\nof town will know.$
data/maps/FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F.FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Plan: In the fields of FALLARBOR, we plant\nseedlings of hardy trees that thrive\leven in volcanic ash.$

data/maps/FarawayIsland_Entrance_hns/scr.FarawayIsland_Entrance_hns_Text_Sign: The writing is fading as if it\nwas written a long time ago..\p..ber, 6th day If any human..\nsets foot here.. again..et it\lbe a kindhearted pers.. ..ith\lthat hope, I depar..$

data/maps/FarawayIsland_Interior/scripts.FarawayIsland_Interior_Text_TheFeelingOf: The feeling of being watched faded…$

data/maps/FarawayIsland_Interior_hns/scr.FarawayIsland_Interior_hns_Text_TheFeeli: The feeling of being watched faded…$

data/maps/FortreeCity/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky:
No one believes me, but I saw this
gigantic POKéMON in the sky.\pIt seemed to squirm as it flew toward
ROUTE 131.\pBy the way… Sniff…
Um… You, uh…smell singed.\pWere you at a volcano or something?$
data/maps/FortreeCity/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Text_SomethingBlockingGym: I want to go to the POKéMON GYM,\nbut something's blocking the way.\pAfter all the bother I went through\ntraining on ROUTE 120…$
data/maps/FortreeCity/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Text_ThisTimeIllBeatWinona: I've got my pride-and-joy POKéMON\nwith me. This time, I'll beat WINONA.$
data/maps/FortreeCity/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Text_TreesGrowByDrinkingRain: The ground absorbs rainwater, and\ntrees grow by drinking that water…\pOur FORTREE CITY exists because\nthere's both water and soil.$
data/maps/FortreeCity/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLivel:
The CITY consists of homes built on
trees.\pPerhaps because of that lifestyle,
everyone is healthy and lively.\pWhy, even myself--I feel as if I've
grown thirty years younger.$
data/maps/FortreeCity/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Text_BugPokemonComeThroughWi: Living on top of trees is okay.\pBut sometimes BUG POKéMON come in\nthrough windows.\lIt can be really startling.$
data/maps/FortreeCity/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Text_PokemonThatEvolveWhenTr: There are POKéMON that evolve when\nyou trade them! That's what I heard.$
data/maps/FortreeCity/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Text_SomethingUnseeable: Something unseeable is in the way.$
data/maps/FortreeCity/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Text_UnseeableUseDevonScope: Something unseeable is in the way.\pWant to use the DEVON SCOPE?$
data/maps/FortreeCity/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFl: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.\pAn invisible POKéMON became completely\nvisible!\pThe startled POKéMON fled!$
data/maps/FortreeCity/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Text_CitySign: FORTREE CITY\n“The treetop city that frolics with\lnature.”$
data/maps/FortreeCity/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Text_GymSign: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: WINONA\p“The bird user taking flight into\nthe world.”$

data/maps/FortreeCity_DecorationShop/scr.FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_Merchand: Merchandise you buy here is sent to\nyour own PC.\pThat's fantastic! I wish they could\nalso deliver me home like that.$
data/maps/FortreeCity_DecorationShop/scr.FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDe: I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm\nputting my cute DOLLS on it.\pIf I don't, when I decorate my\nSECRET BASE, my DOLLS will get\ldirty or poked with splinters.$

data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pFORTREE GYM LEADER WINONA is
a master of FLYING-type POKéMON.\pShe's waiting at the back of this GYM,
behind the rotating doors.\pShe's waiting for new challengers
who are trying to take wing!\pOkay, go for it!$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredIntro: Behold the elegant battle style of\nBIRD POKéMON!$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredPostBattle: A TRAINER has to be smart to keep\nup with unexpected turns of events.\pDo you have the smarts to get to\nour LEADER?$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoIntro: The lovers of BIRD POKéMON aspire\nto join this GYM.\pAs a member of the FORTREE GYM,\nI'm not allowed to lose!$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoDefeat: It was too much of a load for me\nto bear…$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoPostBattle: The world is huge, and there are\ncountless tough TRAINERS.\pI'm going to keep training and make\nmyself even stronger.$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintIntro: There's no need for WINONA, our GYM\nLEADER, to deal with you!\pI'm plenty good enough for you!$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintPostBattle: WINONA is cute and she's strong.\nShe's the ultimate LEADER!\pBlush…$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyIntro: WINONA taught me personally!\nYou can't beat me easily!$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyPostBattle: Thanks to WINONA, the people of\nFORTREE can live without fear.$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoIntro: When WINONA takes to battle, her face\nshines with beautiful determination…\pI'm not letting you witness that\nlovely sight!$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoPostBattle: You'd better watch it!\nDon't get distracted staring at WINONA\lor you'll go crashing down in a heap!$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro: You'd better know that there are all\nsorts of FLYING-type POKéMON.\pYou do know that, right?$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusDefeat: You seem to know your stuff!$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusPostBattle: Sure, you beat me all right.\nBut you'd better watch it! Our LEADER\lWINONA's POKéMON are all business.$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro:
I am WINONA. I am the LEADER of
the FORTREE POKéMON GYM.\pI have become one with BIRD POKéMON
and have soared the skies…\pHowever grueling the battle, we have
triumphed with grace…\pWitness the elegant choreography
of BIRD POKéMON and I!$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaDefeat: Never before have I seen a TRAINER\ncommand POKéMON with more grace\lthan I…\pIn recognition of your prowess,\nI present to you this GYM BADGE.$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadge:
With the FEATHER BADGE, all POKéMON up
to LV 70, even those received through\ltrades, will obey your every command.\pYou will also be able to use
the HM move FLY outside of battle.\pAnd this…
This is a gift from me.$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainAerialAce: TM40 contains AERIAL ACE.\pIts speed…\nNo POKéMON should be able to avoid it.\p… … … … … …$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWinona: Registered GYM LEADER WINONA\nin the POKéNAV.$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostBattle: Though I fell to you, I will remain\ndevoted to BIRD POKéMON.$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM\pWINONA'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch:
WINONA: We humans can never escape
gravity's pull on the ground.\pBut by striving for excellence,
we have the power to soar!\pYou have scaled the pinnacle as
the reigning CHAMPION.\pPlease, allow me to see your power
at full flight!$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchDefeat: I failed to reach your height again…$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch: WINONA: Even though I have lost,\nthe wings of my heart remain unbroken.\pI can rise and soar again and\nyet again.\pI am convinced of it!$
data/maps/FortreeCity_Gym/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTw:
WINONA: We humans can never escape
gravity's pull on the ground.\pBut by striving for excellence,
we have the power to soar!\pYou have scaled the pinnacle as
the reigning CHAMPION.\pPlease, allow me to see your power
at full flight!\pOh, no… Do you have but one
POKéMON with you?\pPlease return with two POKéMON
at the very least.$

data/maps/FortreeCity_House1/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWont:
Wrooooaaar! I need it!
I have to get me a {STR_VAR_1}!\lI'll do anything for it!\p…Uh… Did you hear that?
My shout from the bottom of my heart?\pHaving heard that, you will trade
your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2},\lwon't you?$
data/maps/FortreeCity_House1/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House1_Text_MonYouTakeCare: Oh, yeah, right on!\p{STR_VAR_1}, welcome!\n{STR_VAR_2}, you take care!$
data/maps/FortreeCity_House1/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House1_Text_ThisIsntAMon: Uh, no, I don't think so.\nThat isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.$
data/maps/FortreeCity_House1/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWontTradeMe: No? You won't trade me?\nEven after I bared my heart to you?$
data/maps/FortreeCity_House1/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House1_Text_GoingToMakeVolbe: I'm going to make VOLBEAT super\nstrong from this moment on!\pI hope you do the same with PLUSLE!$
data/maps/FortreeCity_House1/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House1_Text_TradingMemoriesW: Trading POKéMON with others…\pIt's as if you're trading your own\nmemories with other people.$

data/maps/FortreeCity_House2/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House2_Text_HiddenPowersArou: People… POKéMON…\pTheir hidden powers are aroused by\nliving in natural environments…$
data/maps/FortreeCity_House2/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House2_Text_CoinInWhichHand: Let this old woman see if your hidden\npower has awoken…\pI hold a coin in my hand.\pNow, tell me, have I palmed it in\nthe right hand? Or in the left?$
data/maps/FortreeCity_House2/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainW: Oh! Yes, correct!\pWe shall try again.\pIn which hand have I palmed the coin?\nThe right or left?$
Oh! Yes, correct!\pWe shall try again.\pIn which hand have I palmed the coin?\nThe right or left?$
data/maps/FortreeCity_House2/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House2_Text_YourHiddenPowerH: Oh! Splendid!\nYour hidden power has awoken!\pHere, take this and awaken the hidden\npower of your POKéMON.$
data/maps/FortreeCity_House2/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House2_Text_ExplainHiddenPow: HIDDEN POWER is a move that changes\nwith the POKéMON.$

data/maps/FortreeCity_House3/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House3_Text_MetStevenHadAmaz:
While speaking about POKéDEXES,
I remembered something.\pI met this TRAINER, STEVEN, when
I was searching for rare stones.\pHoo, boy, he had some amazing POKéMON
with him.\pThey weren't just rare, they were
trained to terrifying extremes!\pHe might even be stronger than the
GYM LEADER in this town…$
data/maps/FortreeCity_House3/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House3_Text_OhYouHavePokedex: What's that thing you have there?\p… … … … … …\pOh, it's called a POKéDEX?\nIt's really awesome!$

data/maps/FortreeCity_House4/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House4_Text_BringsWorldClose: By being together with POKéMON,\npeople make more and more friends.\pAnd that brings the world closer\ntogether. I think it's wonderful!$
data/maps/FortreeCity_House4/scripts.inc.FortreeCity_House4_Text_AskedWingullToRu: Heheh, I asked my WINGULL to run\nan errand for me.$

data/maps/Gate_NationalPark_hns/scripts..Route35NationalParkGate_Text_OfficerAskT: Hello Trainer! The Bug-Catching\nContest is on today.\pThe rules are simple.\pUsing one of your POKéMON, catch a\nbug POKéMON to be judged.\pWould you like to give it a try?$
data/maps/Gate_NationalPark_hns/scripts..Route35NationalParkGate_Text_OfficerGive: Any EXP your POKéMON gains during\nthe contest will be reverted when\lyou leave.\pHere are the SPORT BALLS for the\nContest.$
data/maps/Gate_NationalPark_hns/scripts..Route35NationalParkGate_Text_OfficerExpl:
The person who gets the strongest
bug POKéMON is the winner.\pIf you run out of SPORT BALLS,
you're done.\pYou can catch up to 5 POKéMON. The
last one caught will be the only\lone kept and placed in the contest.\pGo out and catch the strongest bug
POKéMON you can find!$
data/maps/Gate_NationalPark_hns/scripts..Route35NationalParkGate_Text_OfficerAskT: If you have more than one POKéMON,\nyou'll have to use the\lfirst POKéMON in your party.\pIs that OK with you?$

Riding the BIKE is as simple as
pressing a button if you\lREGISTER it from the BAG.\pIf you need to go faster,
you first need to come to a stop!\pThat might seem like strange
advice, but you can only change\lgears on the BIKE while stopped.\pPress your R button when stopped
and the next time you pedal,\lyou will reach greater speeds!$

by since we moved from KANTO.\lWe appreciate your help!\pCan you make sure to show off
our patented gear-changing tech?\pIt's as simple as pressing R when
you are stopped on your BIKE.\pBeware! You will then go faster!$

data/maps/GoldenrodCity_GameCorner_hns/s.GoldenrodCity_GameCorner_Text_VF_HowToPl:
VOLTORB FLIP is a game in which you flip
cards to find numbers hidden beneath.\pThe cards hide the numbers 1 through 3,
and VOLTORB as well.\pThe first number you flip gives
you that many Coins.\pEach new number multiplies your total.
A 2 by x2 and a 3 by x3.\pBut if you flip a VOLTORB, it's game over.
You lose all Coins collected that round!\pQUIT the game at any time to keep
the Coins you've found so far.\pFind all hidden x2 and x3 cards to clear
the game and advance to the next level!$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_GameCorner_hns/s.GoldenrodCity_GameCorner_Text_VF_HintTex:
The numbers on the sides of the board
are hints about the numbers…\phidden in that row or column.\pThe larger the number, the more high-
value cards are in that row or column.\pThe VOLTORB count tells you how
many VOLTORBs lurk there.\pUse both totals to figure out
which cards are safe to flip!$

STATION and announce our comeback.\pThat should bring our boss GIOVANNI

our meticulous plans!$

construction.\pI heard that all sorts of POKéMON
lived in GOLDENROD in the past.\pPerhaps…\pThat wing has some connection to the
