data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_Youngster1: I know there's a new BIKE SHOP,\nbut I can't find it anywhere.$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_CooltrainerF1: Is that man in black dressed up\nlike a TEAM ROCKET member?\pHow silly!$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_CooltrainerF1_Cleared: Was that man in black really part\nof TEAM ROCKET? I can't believe it!$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_CooltrainerF2: The RADIO TOWER in GOLDENROD CITY\nis quite the landmark.\pThey're running a campaign now.\pThey'll give you a shiny new\nRADIO if you can pass their quiz.$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_CooltrainerF2_GotCard: Oh, your POKéGEAR already works\nas a radio!$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_Youngster2: E-he-he-he…\pI got in trouble for playing in\nthe DEPT.STORE basement.$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_Lass: That man inside rates your\nPOKéMON nicknames.\pHe can even rename them.$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_Gramps: Whew! This town is so big,\nI can't find anything at all.$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_RocketScout1: So this is the RADIO TOWER…$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_RocketScout2: What do you want, pest?\nScram already!$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_Rocket1: Stay out of the way!\nBeat it, kid!$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_Rocket2: Take over the RADIO TOWER…\pWhat? It's none of your business!$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_Rocket3: POKéMON? They're just tools\nwe use to make money!$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_Rocket4: Our dream will soon come true…\pIt was a long, hard struggle…$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_Rocket5: Hey, brat! You don't belong here!\nGet lost already!$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_Rocket6: Come and taste the terror of\nTEAM ROCKET!$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_DeptStoreSign: Full Selection of POKéMON Goods!\pGOLDENROD CITY DEPT.STORE$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_GymSign: GOLDENROD CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: WHITNEY\pThe Incredibly Pretty Girl!$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_CitySign: GOLDENROD CITY\pThe Festive City of Opulent Charm$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_BikeShopSign: The World is a Cycle Path!\nBIKE SHOP$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_NameRaterSign: NAME RATER\pGet Your POKéMON Nicknames Rated$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_MoveTutorAsk: I can teach your POKéMON some\namazing moves!\pShould I teach one?$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_MoveTutorDecline: Aww… But these moves are great!$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_MoveTutorWhich: Wahahah! You won't regret it!\pWhich move should I teach?$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_MoveTutorNoCash: Too bad. Guess I'll need to\nget some cash from home…$
data/maps/GoldenrodCity_hns/scripts.inc.GoldenrodCity_Text_MoveTutorUnderstand: If you understand this move,\nyou've made it as a trainer.$

data/maps/GraniteCave_1F/scripts.inc.GraniteCave_1F_Text_GetsDarkAheadHereYou:
Hey, you.
It gets awfully dark ahead.\lIt'll be tough trying to explore.\pThat guy who came by earlier…
STEVEN, I think it was.\pHe knew how to use FLASH, so he ought
to be all right, but…\pWell, for us HIKERS, helping out those
that we meet is our motto.\pHere you go, I'll pass this on to you.$
data/maps/GraniteCave_1F/scripts.inc.GraniteCave_1F_Text_ExplainFlash:
Teach that hidden move FLASH to
a POKéMON and use it.\pIt lights up even the inky darkness
of caves.\pBut, to use it, you need the GYM BADGE
from DEWFORD's POKéMON GYM.$

data/maps/GraniteCave_StevensRoom/script.GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ImStevenLet: My name is STEVEN.\pI'm interested in rare stones,\nso I travel here and there.\pOh?\nA LETTER for me?$
data/maps/GraniteCave_StevensRoom/script.GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ThankYouTak:
STEVEN: Okay, thank you.\pYou went through all this trouble to
deliver that. I need to thank you.\pLet me see…
I'll give you this TM.\pIt contains my favorite move,
STEEL WING.$
data/maps/GraniteCave_StevensRoom/script.GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_CouldBecome:
STEVEN: Your POKéMON appear quite
capable.\pIf you keep training, you could even
become the CHAMPION of the POKéMON\lLEAGUE one day. That's what I think.\pI know, since we've gotten to know each
other, let's register one another in\lour POKéNAVS.\p… … … … … …$
data/maps/GraniteCave_StevensRoom/script.GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_IveGotToHur: Now, I've got to hurry along.$
data/maps/GraniteCave_StevensRoom/script.GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_OhBagIsFull: Oh, your BAG is full…\nThat's too bad, then.$

data/maps/IcePath_1F_hns/scripts.inc.IcePath_1F_Text_Stuck1:
Me oh my... Is that you, {PLAYER}?
Fancy meeting you here!\pTo tell the truth... my sandals are
frozen on the ice, and I am stuck.\pIn other words, my flip-flops are
quick-frozen to the ground.\pTee hee.\pWell, it's no laughing matter.\pWould you come around and push
my back?$
data/maps/IcePath_1F_hns/scripts.inc.IcePath_1F_Text_Stuck2:
Me oh my... Is that you, {PLAYER}?
Fancy meeting you here!\pTo tell the truth... my sandals are
frozen on the ice, and I am stuck.\pIn other words, my flip-flops are
quick-frozen with the ground.\pTee hee.\pWell, it's no laughing matter.
Would you push my back?$
data/maps/IcePath_1F_hns/scripts.inc.IcePath_1F_Text_Cruel: Don't be so cruel.\nYou will push my back, won't you?$
data/maps/IcePath_1F_hns/scripts.inc.IcePath_1F_Text_Thanks: You really are kind.\nThank you so much!$

data/maps/IcePath_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.IcePath_B1F_Text_PuzzleSkipButton: Would you like to skip this\npuzzle?$
data/maps/IcePath_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.IcePath_B1F_Text_Sign: DANGER CRACKED ICE\nGO FAST ON BICYCLE\lSWITCH GEARS BY\lPRESSING ...\lThe sign is faded...$

data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_ApprenticeIntro:
Oh, man… My boss is going to be
steaming…\pThe FARFETCH'D that CUTS trees
for charcoal took off on me.\pI can't go looking for it here
in the ILEX FOREST.\pIt's too big, dark and scary
for me…$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_ApprenticeAfter: Wow! Thanks a whole bunch!\pMy boss' POKéMON won't obey me\nbecause I don't have a BADGE.$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_CharcoalMasterIntro: Ah! My FARFETCH'D!\pYou found it for us, kid?\pWithout it, we wouldn't be able\nto CUT trees for charcoal.\pThanks, kid!\pNow, how can I thank you…\pI know! Here, take this.$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_CharcoalMasterOutro: That's the CUT HM.\nTeach that to a POKéMON to clear\lsmall trees.\pOf course, you have to have the\nGYM BADGE from AZALEA to use it.$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_CharcoalMasterTalkAfter: Do you want to apprentice as a\ncharcoal maker with me?\pYou'll be first-rate in ten years!$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_Lass: Did something happen to the\nforest's guardian?$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_Signpost: ILEX FOREST is so overgrown with\ntrees that you can't see the sky.\pPlease watch out for items that may\nhave been dropped.$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_Shrine: ILEX FOREST SHRINE…\pIt's in honor of the forest's\nprotector…$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_ShrineCelebiEvent: ILEX FOREST SHRINE…\pIt's in honor of the forest's\nprotector…\pOh? What is this?\pIt's a hole.\nIt looks like the GS BALL would fit\linside it.\pWant to put the GS BALL here?$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_KurtCaughtCelebi: Whew, wasn't that something!\p{PLAYER}, that was fantastic. Thanks!\pThe legends about that SHRINE were\nreal after all.\pI feel inspired by what I just saw.\pIt motivates me to make better BALLS!\pI'm going!$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_BugCatcherWayneSeen: Don't sneak up on me like that!\pYou frightened a POKéMON away!$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_BugCatcherWayneBeaten: I hadn't seen that POKéMON before…$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_BugCatcherWayneAfter: A POKéMON I've never seen before\nfell out of the tree when I used\lHEADBUTT.\pI ought to use HEADBUTT in other\nplaces too.$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_Kimono_Girl1: KIMONO GIRL, KIMONO GIRL, lost and\nall alone. Poor girl lost in the\ldark ILEX FOREST.$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_Kimono_Girl2: You remember me from VIOLET CITY?\nYou must be imagining.\pAnyway, will you show me how to\nget out of this forest?$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_Kimono_Girl3: Me oh my... You are lost yourself,\naren't you?$
data/maps/IlexForest_hns/scripts.inc.IlexForest_Text_Kimono_Girl4: Wow! Are you going to show me how\nto get out?\pYou are such a smart POKéMON!$

data/maps/IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_hn.IndigoPlateau_Text_ShigyNinja: Congrats on making it here!\pI've seen tons of trainers come\nthrough here over the years, and\lall of them are wonderfully unique.\pYou should be proud of yourself\nfor getting this far!\pNow, go get 'em!$
data/maps/IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_hn.IndigoPlateau_Text_Blackbelt: The POKéMON LEAGUE is not taking\nnew challengers at the moment.\pPlease check back later.$
data/maps/IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_hn.IndigoPlateau_Text_CooltrainerM: At the POKéMON LEAGUE, you'll get\ntested by the ELITE FOUR.\pYou have to beat them all. If you\nlose, you have to start all over!$
data/maps/IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_hn.IndigoPlateau_Text_RivalEntrance1:
Hold it.\pYou're going to take the POKéMON
LEAGUE challenge now?\pThat's not going to happen.\pMy super-well-trained POKéMON
are going to pound you.\p{PLAYER}!
I challenge you!$
data/maps/IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_hn.IndigoPlateau_Text_RivalAfter: …Darn… I still can't win…\pI… I have to think more about my\nPOKéMON…\pHumph! Try not to lose!$
data/maps/IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_hn.IndigoPlateau_Text_TeleportGuy1: Ah! You're challenging the ELITE\nFOUR? Are you sure you're ready?\pIf you need to train some more,\nmy ABRA can help you.\pIt can TELEPORT you home.\pWould you like to go home now?$
data/maps/IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_hn.IndigoPlateau_Text_TeleportGuyYes: OK, OK. Picture your house in your\nmind…$
data/maps/IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_hn.IndigoPlateau_Text_TeleportGuyNo: OK, OK. The best of luck to you!$

data/maps/IndigoPlateau_hns/scripts.inc.IndigoPlateau_Text_Sign: INDIGO PLATEAU\pThe Ultimate Goal for Trainers!\pPOKéMON LEAGUE HQ$

data/maps/InsideOfTruck/scripts.inc.InsideOfTruck_Text_BoxPrintedWithMonLogo: The box is printed with a POKéMON logo.\pIt's a POKéMON brand moving and\ndelivery service.$

data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_EricIntro: MT. CHIMNEY's JAGGED PASS…\pNow this is what I've always wanted\nin a mountain.\pThis jagged bumpiness…\nIt rocks my soul!$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_EricPostBattle: Yes, I did lose at POKéMON…\pBut, when it comes to the love of\nthe mountains, I have you beat!$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_DianaIntro: This place isn't your casual hike.\nIt's not suited for a picnic.$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_DianaDefeat: Ohhh, no!\nThe ground is too bumpy…$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostBattle: Did you know?\pSome people cleverly ride their\nbicycles up this horribly bumpy pass.$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_DianaRegister: Will you ever be back in this area?\nIf you do return, I'd like a rematch.$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchIntro: Picnics are fun wherever you go.\nJust like POKéMON!$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchDefeat: I only lost because the ground is\ntoo bumpy!$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostRematch: I'll forget about losing and just\nenjoy this bumpy hike.$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_EthanIntro: JAGGED PASS is hard to walk on.\nIt's a good place for training.$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_EthanDefeat: It was all over while we were still\ntrying to find a good footing…$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostBattle: If I had an ACRO BIKE, I'd be able to\njump ledges.$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_EthanRegister: When I get more used to this bumpiness,\nI'll be sure to win!\pCan you register me in your POKéNAV?$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchIntro: I got used to this bumpiness.\nI sing while I climb now.$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchDefeat: It's still not easy to battle on this\nbumpy ground…$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostRematch: I should get an ACRO BIKE from RYDEL\nin MAUVILLE CITY…$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_GruntIntro: Wah!\nWhat are you doing here?\pWhat am I doing in a place like this?\pWhat business is it of yours?$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_GruntDefeat: Urrrgh…\pI should've ducked into our HIDEOUT\nright away…$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_GoWhereverYouWant: Okay, oh-kay!\nI admit it--you're strong!\pDon't worry about me.\nGo wherever you want!$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_BoulderShakingInResponse: Oh! This boulder is shaking in response\nto the MAGMA EMBLEM!$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_JulioIntro: Aiyeeh! It's awfully scary to shoot\ndown the mountain in one go!$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_JulioDefeat: I feel like I'm falling apart…$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_JulioPostBattle: My bicycle bounced around so much,\nmy rear end's sore…$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_AutumnIntro: I climb this hill every day.\nI have confidence in my strength!$
data/maps/JaggedPass/scripts.inc.JaggedPass_Text_AutumnPostBattle: What is that odd rock protrusion\na little up the hill from here?$

data/maps/LakeOfRageLowTide_hns/scripts..LakeOfRageLowTide_Text_Sage: This cave contains a POKéMON\ntoo strong for an ordinary\ltrainer.$

data/maps/LakeOfRage_House1_hns/scripts..HiddenPowerGuy_Text_Intro: …You have strayed far…\pHere I have meditated. Inside me,\na new power has been awakened.\pLet me share my power with your\nPOKéMON. Take this, child.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_House1_hns/scripts..HiddenPowerGuy_Text_Explanation: Do you see it? It is HIDDEN POWER!\pIt draws out the power of POKéMON\nfor attacking.\pRemember this: its type and power\ndepend on the POKéMON using it.$

data/maps/LakeOfRage_House2_hns/scripts..LakeOfRage_House2_Text_LakeHistory:
LAKE OF RAGE is actually a crater
made by rampaging GYARADOS.\pThe crater filled up with rainwater
and the LAKE was formed.\pThat's the story passed on from my
Grandpa's great-great-grandpa.\pIt used to be that you could catch
lively MAGIKARP there, but…\pI don't understand what's happening.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_House2_hns/scripts..LakeOfRage_House2_Text_MenInBlack: The LAKE hasn't been normal since\nthose men wearing black arrived.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_House2_hns/scripts..LakeOfRage_House2_Text_LastMon: Well don't let me take your last\nPOKéMON!$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_House2_hns/scripts..LakeOfRage_House2_Text_WorldsLargest: LAKE OF RAGE is back to normal.\pThe MAGIKARP have returned.\pI may yet realize my dream of own-\ning the world's largest MAGIKARP.\pIn fact... I'll pay you ¥2000 for\nevery MAGIKARP you give me, and\l¥100,000 for a HUGE MAGIKARP!$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_House2_hns/scripts..LakeOfRage_House2_Text_ForMe: So... Do you have a MAGIKARP for\nme?$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_House2_hns/scripts..LakeOfRage_House2_Text_HaveMagikarp: Ah, you have a MAGIKARP! Let's\nsee how big that baby is.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_House2_hns/scripts..LakeOfRage_House2_Text_BigPayout: Wow! This one is outstanding!\pI tip my hat to you!\pHere's a little something for your\ntrouble.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_House2_hns/scripts..LakeOfRage_House2_Text_Bonus: The record is the important thing.\pThink of that as a bonus!$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_House2_hns/scripts..LakeOfRage_House2_Text_TooShort: Wow! This one is outstanding!\p…I wish I could say that, but I've\nseen a bigger one before.\pI guess it's worth something.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_House2_hns/scripts..LakeOfRage_House2_Text_Refused: Oh… So you didn't get one good\nenough to show me? Maybe next time.$

data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_Pryce: {PLAYER}.\pEven here, the cold keeps me sharp.\pIf you wish to battle again, come\nto the FIGHTING DOJO.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_LanceForcedToEvolve: This lake is full of GYARADOS\nbut nothing else…\pSo the MAGIKARP are being forced\nto evolve…$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_LanceIntro1: Did you come here because of\nthe rumors?\pYou're {PLAYER}? I'm LANCE, a\ntrainer like you.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_LanceIntro2: This man here informed me of\nsome rumors.\pSo we came to investigate…$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_LanceIntro3:
I saw the way you battled
earlier, {PLAYER}.\pI can tell that you're a trainer
with considerable skill.\pIf you don't mind, could you help
us investigate?$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_LanceRadioSignal:
LANCE: Excellent!\pIt seems that the LAKE's MAGIKARP
are being forced to evolve.\pA mysterious radio broadcast
coming from MAHOGANY is the cause.\pWe'll be waiting for you,
{PLAYER}.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_LanceRefused: Oh… Well, if you change your mind,\nplease help us.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_LanceAskHelp: LANCE: Hm? Are you going to help\nus?$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_Gramps: The GYARADOS are angry!\pIt's a bad omen!$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_SuperNerd: I heard this lake was made by\nrampaging GYARADOS.\pI wonder if there is any\nconnection to their mass outbreak\lnow?$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_CooltrainerF: Did my eyes deceive me? I saw a\nred GYARADOS in the LAKE…\pBut I thought GYARADOS were\nusually blue?$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_FisherAndreSeen: Let me battle with the POKéMON I\njust caught!$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_FisherAndreBeaten: I might be an expert angler, but\nI stink as a POKéMON trainer…$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_FisherAndreAfter: I won't lose as an angler! I catch\nPOKéMON all day.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_FisherRaymondSeen: No matter what I do, all I catch\nare the same POKéMON…$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_FisherRaymondAfter: Why can't I catch any good\nPOKéMON?$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_CooltrainermAaronSeen: If a trainer spots another trainer,\nhe has to make a challenge.\pThat is our destiny.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_CooltrainermAaronAfter: POKéMON and their trainer become\npowerful through constant battling.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_CooltrainerfLoisSeen: What happened to the red\nGYARADOS?\pIt's gone?\pOh, darn. I came here for\nnothing?\pI know--let's battle!$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_CooltrainerfLoisAfter: Come to think of it, I've seen a\npink BUTTERFREE.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_MeetWesley: WESLEY: Well, how do you do?\pI'm a member of the WEEKDAY family!\nCan you guess my favorite day?$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_WesleyGivesGift: Pleased to meet you. Please take a\nsouvenir.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_WesleyGaveGift: WESLEY: BLACK BELT beefs up the\npower of fighting moves.$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_WesleyWednesday: WESLEY: Since you found me, you\nmust have met my brothers and\lsisters.\pOr did you just get lucky?$
data/maps/LakeOfRage_hns/scripts.inc.LakeOfRage_Text_Sign: LAKE OF RAGE,\nalso known as GYARADOS LAKE.$

data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_MayNiceBadgesTakeThis:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Long time no see!\pOh? While I visited the hot springs,
you got the LAVARIDGE GYM BADGE.\pYou must have collected
good POKéMON…\lNo, I believe you raised some.\pI guess it would be okay for you to
have this.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesCh:
MAY: With those GO-GOGGLES, you'll
have no trouble getting through the\ldesert near ROUTE 111.\pBut, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}…
Challenging GYMS…\pYou're trying hard because you don't
want to lose to me, I bet!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I think I should challenge
your dad in PETALBURG GYM.\pSee you again!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanNiceBadgesTake:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, hey, it's been a while.
How's it going?\pHmm…
That's a decent collection of BADGES.\pAll right, then.
You may as well have this.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGoggl:
BRENDAN: Keep those with you if you're
planning on going into that desert near\lROUTE 111.\pThere should be some POKéMON that
are exclusively desert-dwellers.\lYou might look around for those.\pAs for me…
I'm considering challenging NORMAN,\lthe GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.\pUnlike you, {PLAYER}, your dad looks like
he really is tough.\pSee you around!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt:
I have here an EGG.\pI'd hoped to hatch it by covering it in
hot sand by the hot springs.\lBut that doesn't seem to be enough…\pI've heard it would be best if it were
kept together with POKéMON and\lcarried about.\pYou are a TRAINER, yes?
And your POKéMON radiate vitality.\pSo, what say you?
Will you take this EGG to hatch?$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_HopeYoullWalkPlentyWi: Good! I hope you'll walk plenty with\nthis here EGG!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_NoRoomForThisEgg: Oh? You've too many POKéMON.\nThere's no room for this EGG…$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_AsYouWishThen: As you wish, then…\pIf you have a change of heart about\nhatching this EGG, I will be here.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_EverySoOftenEggFoundA: Every so often, an EGG will be found at\nthe POKéMON DAY CARE.\pOr at least that's how the rumor goes.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsNeverRunDry: We draw as much hot water as we need,\nand yet the hot springs never run dry.\pIsn't it magical?\pThese hot springs appear near active\nvolcanoes. Veins of water under the\lground are heated by magma to well up\las hot springs.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_PokemonNippedBackside: Being buried in this hot sand is…\nSigh…\pSo warm and heavenly…\pEh? Gyaah! Ouch!\pA POKéMON nipped my backside!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_OhYouLikeHotSprings: Oh, you like hot springs, do you?\pThat's surprising for one as young\nas you.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_BatheInHotSpringsEver: I bathe in the hot springs every day.\pI want to become a beautiful and strong\nGYM LEADER like FLANNERY.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_IfPokemonInHotSprings: If people put POKéMON in hot springs,\nit might be seriously strange.\pWhy, it might be an electric bath, or\na bubble bath, or even a lava bath…$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsClaims: They're claiming that these hot springs\nare good for calming nervous tension,\lrelieving aching muscles, solving\lromantic problems, and attracting\lmoney…$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_TownSign: LAVARIDGE TOWN\p“POKéMON CENTER HOT SPRINGS\nAn excellent place for relaxing!”$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Text_GymSign: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: FLANNERY\l“One with a fiery passion that burns!”$

data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pLAVARIDGE's GYM LEADER FLANNERY
uses FIRE-type POKéMON.\pHer passion for POKéMON burns stronger
and hotter than a volcano.\pDon't get too close to her--you'll burn!
Hose her down with water and then\lgo for it!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVi: Yow! That was a scorching-hot battle!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeDefeat: I'm blinded by sweat in my eyes…$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColePostBattle: Being buried in hot sand promotes\ncirculation.\pIt's effective for healing pain in\nyour joints.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleIntro: I'm trying to relieve my stress.\nDon't come along and stress me out!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleDefeat: I hope FLANNERY flames you good!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxlePostBattle: Haaah… Whew…\pIf you spend too much time buried in\nhot sand, it tuckers you out…$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganIntro: You must be getting tired by now.\nYou'd like to rest in the hot sand,\lwouldn't you?\pBut you should know that maintaining\nyour willpower is an important ability\lfor all TRAINERS.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganDefeat: Play with fire, and be burned…$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganPostBat: Your skill is real…\nBut our LEADER FLANNERY is strong.\pIf you don't watch yourself, you'll be\nburned seriously.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldPostBatt: The temperature of magma is\n392 degrees.\pYour POKéMON beat me, so they should\neasily survive in magma.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DaniellePostBa: I'm going to be a pretty and strong\nTRAINER just like FLANNERY.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JaceIntro: Come on, get with it!\nLet's go before my feelings cool!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JaceDefeat: It's so hot, and yet my heart is\nclutched by ice…$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JacePostBattl: The way the battling spirit burns\nwithin you, you may stand a chance\lagainst our LEADER.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffIntro: See how the flames blaze wildly?\nThey flare in anticipation of my win!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffPostBattl: Well, so what? I say so what?\nI can walk on hot coals barefoot!\p…Don't even think about trying it!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliIntro: As much as I love mountains,\nI especially love volcanoes.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliDefeat: Well, it seems to me I lost without\never being in control.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliPostBattle: I stay here because I became a fan\nof FLANNERY's power.\pHehehehe.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro:
Welcome… No, wait.\pPuny TRAINER, how good to see you've
made it here!\pI have been entrusted with the…
No, wait.\pI am FLANNERY, and I'm the GYM
LEADER here!\pUh…
Dare not underestimate me, though\lI have been LEADER only a short time!\pWith skills inherited from my grand-
father, I shall, uh…demonstrate the\lhot moves we have honed on this land!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat:
Oh…
I guess I was trying too hard…\pI… I've only recently become
a GYM LEADER.\pI tried too hard to be someone
I'm not.\pI have to do things my natural way. If
I don't, my POKéMON will be confused.\pThanks for teaching me that.
For that, you deserve this.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainHeatBad:
If you have a HEAT BADGE, all POKéMON
up to Level 50, even those you get in\ltrades from other people, will obey\lyou completely.\pAnd, it lets POKéMON use the HM move
STRENGTH outside of battle.\pThis is a token of my appreciation.
Don't be shy about taking it!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainOverhea: That TM50 contains OVERHEAT.\pThat move inflicts serious damage on\nthe opponent.\pBut it also sharply cuts the SP. ATK\nof the POKéMON using it. It might not\lbe suitable for longer battles.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredFlan: Registered GYM LEADER FLANNERY\nin the POKéNAV.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostBa: Your power reminds me of someone…\pOh! I know! You battle like NORMAN,\nthe GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCerti: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM\pFLANNERY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPreRem:
FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going
to deflate me.\pI love POKéMON.
I love to battle.\lAnd… I love this GYM!\pLet's exchange superhot moves
in another battle!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostRe:
FLANNERY: I lost the match,
but I'm completely satisfied.\pIt's not often I get to enjoy a battle
this heated.\pLet's have another one like this
again sometime!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F/scripts.i.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematc:
FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going
to deflate me.\pI love POKéMON.
I love to battle.\lAnd… I love this GYM!\pLet's exchange superhot moves
in another battle!\pOh, wait. Do you only have one POKéMON
that can battle?\pI hate to say this, but when you come
see me, bring at least two POKéMON.$

data/maps/LavaridgeTown_HerbShop/scripts.LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_WelcomeToHer: Welcome to the HERB SHOP, home of\neffective and inexpensive medicine!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_HerbShop/scripts.LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_YouveComeToL: You've come to look at herbal medicine\nin LAVARIDGE?\pThat's rather commendable.\pI like you! Take this!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_HerbShop/scripts.LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_ExplainCharc:
That CHARCOAL I gave you, it's used
for making herbal medicine.\pIt also does wonders when held by
a POKéMON.\pIt intensifies the power of FIRE-type
moves.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_HerbShop/scripts.LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_HerbalMedici: Herbal medicine works impressively well.\nBut your POKéMON will dislike you for it.\lIt must be horribly bitter!$

data/maps/LavaridgeTown_House/scripts.in.LavaridgeTown_House_Text_WifeWarmingEggI: My wife's warming an EGG in the hot\nsprings. This is what she told me.\pShe left two POKéMON with the DAY CARE.\nAnd they discovered that EGG!$

data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Mart/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_XSpeedFirstStrik: Use X SPEED to add to a POKéMON's\nSPEED in battle.\pThat will help it get in the first\nstrike--a decided advantage!$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_Mart/scripts.inc.LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_LocalSpecialtyOn: On MT. CHIMNEY's peak, there's a local\nspecialty that you can buy only there.\pGive it to a POKéMON--it will be elated.$

data/maps/LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F.LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trai: I think POKéMON get closer to their\nTRAINERS if they spend time together.\pThe longer the better.\nThat's what I think.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F.LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HotS: It's sort of magical how just sitting\nin a hot-spring pool can invigorate.\pI wish I could let my POKéMON\nsoak, too.$
data/maps/LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F.LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trai: Hohoho! Hey, kid, you can reach\nthe hot springs from here.\pIf POKéMON are getting rest, so too\nshould their TRAINERS.$

data/maps/LavenderTown_House1_hns/script.LavenderTown_House1_Text_Girl: Can you believe it?\pSome people get bored with taking\ncare of POKéMON.\pGRANPDA takes in such poor homeless\nPOKéMON and takes care of them.$
data/maps/LavenderTown_House1_hns/script.LavenderTown_House1_Text_Guy: MR. FUJI does live here but he's\naway now. He should be at the\lSOUL HOUSE.$
data/maps/LavenderTown_House1_hns/script.LavenderTown_House1_Text_Marowak2: The MAROWAK is quiet, though it\nappears quite happy.$

data/maps/LavenderTown_House2_hns/script.LavenderSpeechHouse_Text_PokefanF: LAVENDER is a tiny, quiet town at\nthe foot of the mountains.\pIt's gotten a bit busier since\nthe RADIO TOWER was built.$

data/maps/LavenderTown_Mart_hns/scripts..LavenderMart_Text_PokefanM: REPEL is a necessity if you are\ngoing to explore a cave.\pEven though I like exploring,\nI still haven't made it to all\lthe caves.$
data/maps/LavenderTown_Mart_hns/scripts..LavenderMart_Text_Rocker: I heard about a craftsman who\nmakes custom BALLS in the JOHTO\ltown of AZALEA.\pI wish I had some.$

data/maps/LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_hns.LavenderTown_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Gentle: To the north of LAVENDER is ROCK\nTUNNEL. Go through it to get to\lthe POWER PLANT.$
data/maps/LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_hns.LavenderTown_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Teache:
There's a radio program that plays
POKé FLUTE music.\pOh? Ah, your radio needs a RADIO
UPGRADE to tune into it.\pMaybe the RADIO STATION here
in town can provide you one?$
data/maps/LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_hns.LavenderTown_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Youngs: If the POWER PLANT isn't running,\nthe MAGNET TRAIN won't run either…\pIt also means the RADIO STATION\ncan't broadcast…$
The DIRECTOR of the RADIO STATION\nsure was happy.\pHe said they're back on the air\nbecause the POWER PLANT is running\lsmoothly again.$

data/maps/LavenderTown_RadioStation_hns/.LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Reception: Welcome! Feel free to look around\nanywhere on this floor.$
data/maps/LavenderTown_RadioStation_hns/.LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Officer: Sorry, but you can only tour the\nground floor.\pEver since JOHTO's RADIO TOWER\nwas taken over by a criminal gang,\lwe have had to step up our\lsecurity.$
data/maps/LavenderTown_RadioStation_hns/.LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_SuperNerd: Many people are hard at work here\nin the RADIO TOWER.\pThey must be doing their best to\nput on good shows.$
data/maps/LavenderTown_RadioStation_hns/.LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Gentleman: Oh, no, no, no!\pWe've been off the air ever since\nthe POWER PLANT shut down.\pAll my efforts to start this\nstation would be wasted if I can't\lbroadcast.\pI'll be ruined!$

Ah! So you're the {PLAYER} who
solved the POWER PLANT's problem?\pThanks to you, I never lost my
job.\pI tell you, you're a real
lifesaver!\pPlease take this as my thanks.$
With that thing, you can tune into\nthe radio programs here in KANTO.\pGahahahaha!$
data/maps/LavenderTown_RadioStation_hns/.LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_SuperNerd: Hey there!\pI am the super MUSIC DIRECTOR!\p
Hey there!\pI am the super MUSIC DIRECTOR!\pI'm responsible for the gorgeous\nmelodies that go out over the air.\pDon't be square. Grab your music\noff the air!$
data/maps/LavenderTown_RadioStation_hns/.LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Directory: 1F RECEPTION 2F SALES\p3F PERSONNEL 4F PRODUCTION\p5F DIRECTOR'S OFFICE$
data/maps/LavenderTown_RadioStation_hns/.LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_PokeFlute: Perk Up POKéMON with Mellow\nSounds of the POKé FLUTE on\lCHANNEL 20$
data/maps/LavenderTown_RadioStation_hns/.LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Reference: Wow! A full rack of POKéMON CDs\nand videos.\pThis must be the reference\nlibrary.$

data/maps/LavenderTown_SoulHouse_hns/scr.MrFuji_Text_Main:
MR.FUJI: Welcome.\pHmm… You appear to be raising
your POKéMON in a kind and\lloving manner.\pPOKéMON lovers come here to pay
their respects to departed\lPOKéMON.\pPlease offer condolences for the
souls of the departed POKéMON.\pI'm sure that will make them
happy.$
data/maps/LavenderTown_SoulHouse_hns/scr.SoulHouse_Text_Teacher: There are other graves of POKéMON\nhere, I think.\pThere are many chambers that only\nMR.FUJI may enter.$
data/maps/LavenderTown_SoulHouse_hns/scr.SoulHouse_Text_Lass: I came with my mom to visit\nPOKéMON graves…$
data/maps/LavenderTown_SoulHouse_hns/scr.SoulHouse_Text_Granny: The POKéMON that lived with me…\pI loved them like my\ngrandchildren…$

data/maps/LavenderTown_hns/scripts.inc.LavenderTown_Text_PokefanM: That's quite some building, eh?\pIt's KANTO's RADIO TOWER.$
data/maps/LavenderTown_hns/scripts.inc.LavenderTown_Text_Teacher: KANTO has many good radio shows.$
data/maps/LavenderTown_hns/scripts.inc.LavenderTown_Text_Gramps: People come from all over to pay\ntheir respects to the departed\lsouls of POKéMON.$
data/maps/LavenderTown_hns/scripts.inc.LavenderTown_Text_Youngster: You need a POKé FLUTE to wake\nsleeping POKéMON.\pEvery trainer has to know that!$
data/maps/LavenderTown_hns/scripts.inc.LavenderTown_Text_KantoRadioStationSign: KANTO RADIO STATION\pYour Favorite Programs On-Air\nAround the Clock!$
data/maps/LavenderTown_hns/scripts.inc.LavenderTown_Text_SoulHouseSign: SOUL HOUSE\pMay the Souls of POKéMON Rest\nEasy$

data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_MayShoppingLetsBattle:
MAY: Oh, hey?
{PLAYER}{KUN}, are you shopping, too?\pI bought a whole bunch of DOLLS and
POSTERS.\pOf course, I've also caught a lot of
POKéMON, and I'm raising them\lproperly, too.\pActually, I'm more worried if you're
raising POKéMON properly, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI'll battle with you, so you can show
me your POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_MayNotRaisingPokemon: MAY: Oh, why? {PLAYER}{KUN}, haven't you\nbeen raising your POKéMON?\pThat's not a very good showing as a\nTRAINER…$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_MayBattleMe: MAY: Come on, battle with me, so I can\ncheck out your POKéMON!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_MayWontBeBeaten: MAY: The POKéMON I raised won't be\nbeaten by your POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_MayDefeat: … … … … … … … …\pI remember the battle I had with you,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, on ROUTE 103.\pThat battle helped you become this\nstrong, {PLAYER}{KUN}, didn't it?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_MayGoingBackToLittlero: MAY: I'm thinking of going back to\nLITTLEROOT soon.\pI've caught a decent group of POKéMON,\nand my POKéDEX is coming along, so\lI'm going home to show my dad.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToCollectBa: {PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?\pCollect all the GYM BADGES and take\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\pWell, while you're collecting BADGES,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm going to work on my\lPOKéDEX. I'll complete it before you!\pSee you!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToPokemonLe:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?\pAre you taking the POKéMON LEAGUE
challenge?\pOr, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?\pI might've lost to you in battling,
but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you!\pSee you!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToBattleFro:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?\pAre you taking the BATTLE FRONTIER
challenge?\pOr, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?\pI might've lost to you in battling,
but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you!\pSee you!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanShoppingLetsBat: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, it's {PLAYER}.\pI'm running an errand for my dad.\nNo, I'm not buying any DOLLS.\pAnyways, it's been a while.\pWant to have a battle to see who's been\nraising POKéMON better?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidence: BRENDAN: Oh, what's the matter?\nDon't have the confidence?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanBattleMe: BRENDAN: Want to battle to see who's\nbeen raising POKéMON better?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanWontBeBeaten: BRENDAN: Aww, but you know I'm not\ngoing to lose to no {PLAYER}.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanDefeat: Humph…\nYou've done a lot of raising.\pThat stings a bit--I had a head start\non you as a TRAINER…$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanGoingBackToLitt: BRENDAN: I…\nI plan on going home to LITTLEROOT.\pYou know I'm helping out my dad on his\nPOKéDEX. It's coming together pretty\ldecently, so I should go show him.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToColle: {PLAYER}, what are you going to do?\pCollect all the GYM BADGES and take\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\pMaybe I'll do that, too…\pWell, anyway, hang in there!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToPokem: {PLAYER}, what are you going to do?\pSince you're that strong, are you\ntaking the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\pHeh, even me--if I trained my POKéMON\na bit more, I should be stronger than\lyou, {PLAYER}.\pWell, anyway, hang in there!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToBattl:
{PLAYER}, what are you going to do?\pAre you taking the BATTLE FRONTIER
challenge?\pOr, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?\pSince you're that strong, you should
consider the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pHeh, if I train my POKéMON a bit more,
I'll get stronger than you, {PLAYER}.\pMaybe I should go to the BATTLE
FRONTIER.\pWell, anyway, hang in there!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_MovedLootIntoHideoutTo: Fufufu…\pWe moved more loot into our secret\nHIDEOUT today…\pWh-who are you?!\nI was just talking to myself!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_ChanceToDoBigThings:
I'm just a GRUNT, so I don't know what
the BOSS is thinking…\pBut being on TEAM AQUA, I know I'll get
the chance to do big things!\pWh-who are you?!
I was just talking to myself!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_DontGoNearCaveInCove: Hey, you!\pDon't go near the cave in the cove!\pWhy? You don't need a reason why!\nI'm an adult, so you just listen to me!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_IfWorldBecomesOurs: If this whole wide world becomes ours,\nTEAM AQUA's, it will be a happier\lplace for POKéMON, too.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_WailmerLeapOutOfWater: There! WAILMER!\nLeap out of the water now!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_GetLostMessingUpTraini: Hunh? What do you want?\pYou're messing up our training,\nso can you, like, get lost?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallInTown: There's a POKéMON CONTEST HALL\nright in this here town. \pThat means well-raised POKéMON will\ncome from all over the country.\pMy heart swells with excitement!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_StrangeCaveInCove: Have you seen that strange cave in\nthe cove at the edge of town?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_GoingToMoveDeleterForH: I'm going to teach my POKéMON some new\nmoves for entering a CONTEST.\pSo, I'm going to see the MOVE DELETER\nand make it forget HM moves.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_ImFromKanto: I came from KANTO.\pThe HOENN region is beautiful with\nall its water and verdant nature.\pHunh? Wait a second…\pCould there be rare POKéMON that live\nonly in this area?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaBeenTrainingWa: TEAM AQUA's been training their\nWAILMER in the cove.\pWe SAILORS can't get our boats out\nto sea with them in the way!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_SomeonePuntedTeamAquaO: Ahoy, did you know?\pSomeone punted TEAM AQUA out of\nthe way for us!\pThat got the WAILMER out of the cove,\nso we can get our boats out again.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_SomeoneStoleMyPokemon: I was taking a relaxing snooze at the\nseaside inn to the sound of waves…\pWhen someone stole my POKéMON!\pWho's the abductor?\nTEAM AQUA? Is it TEAM AQUA?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_MissingPokemonCameBack: My missing POKéMON…\nIt came back without me noticing!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_ImArtDealer: I'm an ART DEALER.\pI am a buyer and seller of fine art,\nespecially paintings.\pI've heard that the MUSEUM here has\nmagnificent works on exhibit…$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_SeaRemainsForeverYoung: Even as we grow old and wrinkled,\nthe sea remains forever young with\lthe vivid brilliance of life…\pFwohoho fwohohohoho…$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_SixtyYearsAgoHusbandPr: It was sixty years ago that my husband\nproposed to me here.\lThe sea remains as beautiful as ever.\pMufufufu mufufufufufu…$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaRenovatedCaver:
Hm, you know of the peculiar cavern
in this cove?\pThat had been a natural formation,
but then that TEAM AQUA lot came\lalong and made their renovations.\pThey call themselves
the “nature-loving TEAM AQUA”!\pBut what they do and what they say
don't match at all!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaLotGoneForGood: That cave in the cove…\pI didn't notice it right away,\nbut it's completely empty now.\pThat TEAM AQUA lot, they must\nhave gone away for good.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_CitySign: LILYCOVE CITY\p“Where the land ends and the\nsea begins.”$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallSign: POKéMON CONTEST HALL\n“The gathering place for TRAINERS!”$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_MotelSign: COVE LILY MOTEL\p“Remember us as COVE LILY of\nLILYCOVE.”$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSignUnderConstru: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR\p“The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under\nconstruction in SLATEPORT CITY.\p“Service is scheduled to begin\nshortly.”$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSign: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR\p“Enjoy a delightful cruise on\nthe ferry S.S. TIDAL.”$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign: POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB\pThe names of TRAINERS are scribbled\nall over the sign…$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_DepartmentStoreSign: LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE\p“Overflowing with great merchandise\nand excitement!\p“A great place to find that something\nyou need!”$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_MoveDeletersHouseSign: MOVE DELETER'S HOUSE\p“Unwanted POKéMON moves deleted.”$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_DoYouKnowAboutBerryBle: Do you know about the machine\nBERRY BLENDER?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_FasterSpinBetterPokebl: People have to work together to get it\nto spin faster.\pThe faster you can make it spin, the\nbetter ポロックS you can get, I've heard.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_ExplainBerryBlender: It's used for making a kind of candy\ncalled a ポロック.\pIf you give a good ポロック to a POKéMON,\nits condition will improve by a lot.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_HeardTowerCalledSkyPil: I heard there's a tower somewhere out\non the sea routes.\pIt's called the SKY PILLAR, I hear.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_SawTallTowerOnRoute131: I saw this tall tower somewhere\naround ROUTE 131.\pCould that possibly be…?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_JustArrivedAndSawRareP:
We just arrived here on our
honeymoon vacation.\pWe happened to see a DRAGON-type
POKéMON flying way up in the sky.\pDo cool POKéMON like that live in
the HOENN region?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity/scripts.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_HoneymoonVowToSeeRareP: On our honeymoon, we vowed to see as\nmany rare POKéMON as we can.\pSo we were delighted to see a rare\nPOKéMON as soon as we arrived.\pI mean, we are totally happy!$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSm: This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST\nhere before.\pWell, guess what? Today, I made it\nwin a SMARTNESS CONTEST!\pMy abilities scare even me…$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBun:
I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS,
so I'm seeing how things work.\pIf you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST,
cool moves go over as appeals.\pBut smart moves and cute moves
don't go over well, for instance.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonE: That young man who won earlier had\na whole bunch of different ポロックS.\pCan you win if you had that many\nof those things?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPl: Whoa, isn't this place humongous!\pThe tension in the air… It's not\nlike a CONTEST hall in the sticks.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBest: MC: Okay, SMART POKéMON and their\nTRAINERS, are you ready?!\pGive it your best showing!\nLet's appeal!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjo: JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST?\pCome back with three friends, and\nall of you may enter a CONTEST!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWro:
Ayayayay…
I entered the wrong CONTEST.\pI entered this tough POKéMON in
the SMARTNESS CONTEST…\pCome on, wow them with a smart-looking
ROCK SMASH.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonT: I've spent many a year, and all my\nwisdom besides, raising this POKéMON\lto be smart.\pIt won't be easily bested by some\nyoung pup's POKéMON.\pMy dear wife, are you seeing this?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPulls: There it is!\pIf my POKéMON pulls a smart move next,\nthe audience's excitement will peak!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontApprec: Oh, dear, no!\pMy darling ZUBAT's LEECH LIFE is so\ncute I kept using it over and over!\pBut these mean people don't appreciate\nit at all!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToU: Even when TRAINERS enter the same\nkind of POKéMON, they all seem to use\ldifferent moves for appeals.\pIt's just like the way people have\ndifferent styles for battling.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonSma: I think the POKéMON look smarter\nthan their TRAINERS. By a lot.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveS: When all's said and done, I still love\nSMARTNESS CONTESTS.\pThat intellectual green color…\nIt's so… So… Cool.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnte: MC: Are you entering the BEAUTY\nCONTEST, too? Good luck!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokem: JUDGE: Ah, every POKéMON here is\na model of pristine beauty!\pWhy, I almost forgot to score them!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBe: A POKéMON this beautiful…\nThere isn't another one like it.\pEveryone's eyes will be glued to\nmy beauty.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGro: Waaaah!\pI brushed and groomed my POKéMON\ncarefully for this CONTEST…\pBut I overdid it…\nMy POKéMON's coat turned all scraggly…\pWhat should I do?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontS: This AURORA BEAM is so dazzling,\nthe JUDGE won't be able to see it.\pUh, wait a second…\nThat'll be meaningless, then!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLoo: This pretty POKéMON looks just like\nme when I was younger.\pRight when I said that, my husband\nspewed the coffee he was drinking.\pDid I say something funny?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WinBeautyC: You know, if I win at a BEAUTY\nCONTEST, sure it makes me\lhappy. More than usual, anyway.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAl: Wahahahah!\pWill you take a gander at all those\npretty POKéMON!\lI just love this sort of glitz!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnB: You can't always win on just beauty\nalone.\pYou have to groom your POKéMON so\nit's nice and glossy like mine.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddl: MC: Uh-oh! Hello!\nWe're in the middle of a CONTEST!\pPlease enter at our registration\ncounter and come out, okay?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmi: JUDGE: Oh, such charming and cute\nappeals!\pOh, my goodness! What a perfectly\nadorable WATER SPORT appeal!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyAzurillW: Oh, no… My sweet AZURILL was\ndistracted by another POKéMON.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_NeverWonBa: My POKéMON has never won in a battle,\nbut put it in a CONTEST and look out!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDance: My POKéMON's PETAL DANCE is a marvel\nof elegance.\pI won't let anyone disturb its\nperformance.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppea: Everyone's POKéMON are very cute.\pHowever, if my POKéMON were to make\na cute appeal…\pI'm sure that it would be so much \ncuter than the others.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyChildIsI: My child is in this CONTEST.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ComeOnDear: Come on, dear. Go for it!\nYour POKéMON is the best!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ThatGirlTh: I think that girl over there is\nthe cutest of the lot.\pWhat's that? They're judging\nPOKéMON by their looks?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WantCuteMo: Ohh, seeing all these cute POKéMON,\nthey make we want to get my own!\pI'm going to go catch some!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_BeautyCont: BEAUTY CONTEST STAGE\nBE ALLURED BY BEAUTIFUL POKéMON!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CuteContes: CUTENESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE CHARMED BY CUTE POKéMON!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestHall/scrip.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SmartConte: SMARTNESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE IMPRESSED BY SMART POKéMON!$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby/scri.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LadyGaveM: Yippee!\pThe lady at the reception counter\ngave me a case for ポロックS!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby/scri.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MakePokeb: Make ポロックS and put them in there.\pWhen you make a ポロック, everyone\nhas to put in a different BERRY.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby/scri.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourPokem: Congratulations!\pI did a painting of your POKéMON to\ncommemorate its victory…\pWell, your POKéMON's appeals were\nso fantastic, it spurred me into\lpainting better than I usually do.\lLook, see?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby/scri.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITa:
What do you think? I'm confident in
what I've done, but do you like it?\pA work of this caliber, it wouldn't look
out of place in an art museum.\pHuh? An art museum really is looking
for paintings?\pDo you think I should take this there?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby/scri.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePa:
What, really? Then, sure, I will take
this painting there right now.\pI'll give it a proper title, too.\pI hope they'll like it and consider
exhibiting this.\pPlease check if they did accept this.
Thank you!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby/scri.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeMemen: Oh, that's right!\pAs a memento of me painting your\nPOKéMON, please take this.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby/scri.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeHomeB: Oh… Then, I guess I'll just take\nthis home with me…\pBut, you know, I would like to take\nthis to the art museum… Okay?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby/scri.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_FineThats: Oh, fine, that's the way it is.\nI will hang this in my own house.\pI'll just have to try harder next time.\nWell, be seeing you.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby/scri.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MasterRan: Hoo, boy… Master Rank CONTESTS,\nhere I come.\pThe world will know that my dearest\nPOKéMON is the cutest being in all\lexistence. The time has come!\lUheheheh.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby/scri.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WholeVari: You can see a whole variety of\nPOKéMON here.\pThat's why I make this place a regular\npart of my daily stroll.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby/scri.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestFe: Wow, coming out to a CONTEST is\na feast for these eyes!\pWould you look at all the POKéMON\nthat just scream to be painted?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby/scri.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ToughCont: The TOUGHNESS CONTEST is like\nextreme, man!\pThose muscular appeals…\nCascading sweat… I swoon!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby/scri.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LavishedC: Day in and day out, I lavished my care\non this POKéMON.\pIts condition is peaking.\nToday, victory is mine!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby/scri.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MadePokeb: I made ポロックS with Mom, Dad, and\nBig Sister. They turned out great!\pI bet you can make smoother, better\nポロックS if you have more people.$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_hns/.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LadyGaveM: Yippee!\pThe lady at the reception counter\ngave me a case for ポロックS!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_hns/.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MakePokeb: Make ポロックS and put them in there.\pWhen you make a ポロック, everyone\nhas to put in a different BERRY.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_hns/.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourPokem: Congratulations!\pI did a painting of your POKéMON to\ncommemorate its victory…\pWell, your POKéMON's appeals were\nso fantastic, it spurred me into\lpainting better than I usually do.\lLook, see?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_hns/.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITa:
What do you think? I'm confident in
what I've done, but do you like it?\pA work of this caliber, it wouldn't look
out of place in an art museum.\pHuh? An art museum really is looking
for paintings?\pDo you think I should take this there?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_hns/.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePa:
What, really? Then, sure, I will take
this painting there right now.\pI'll give it a proper title, too.\pI hope they'll like it and consider
exhibiting this.\pPlease check if they did accept this.
Thank you!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_hns/.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeMemen: Oh, that's right!\pAs a memento of me painting your\nPOKéMON, please take this.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_hns/.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeHomeB: Oh… Then, I guess I'll just take\nthis home with me…\pBut, you know, I would like to take\nthis to the art museum… Okay?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_hns/.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_FineThats: Oh, fine, that's the way it is.\nI will hang this in my own house.\pI'll just have to try harder next time.\nWell, be seeing you.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_hns/.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MasterRan: Hoo, boy… Master Rank CONTESTS,\nhere I come.\pThe world will know that my dearest\nPOKéMON is the cutest being in all\lexistence. The time has come!\lUheheheh.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_hns/.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WholeVari: You can see a whole variety of\nPOKéMON here.\pThat's why I make this place a regular\npart of my daily stroll.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_hns/.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestFe: Wow, coming out to a CONTEST is\na feast for these eyes!\pWould you look at all the POKéMON\nthat just scream to be painted?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_hns/.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ToughCont: The TOUGHNESS CONTEST is like\nextreme, man!\pThose muscular appeals…\nCascading sweat… I swoon!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_hns/.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LavishedC: Day in and day out, I lavished my care\non this POKéMON.\pIts condition is peaking.\nToday, victory is mine!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_hns/.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MadePokeb: I made ポロックS with Mom, Dad, and\nBig Sister. They turned out great!\pI bet you can make smoother, better\nポロックS if you have more people.$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_Guest:
Hm, so they doubled the guests by
using POKéMON as attractions?\pHm, well, maybe I should make a cute
POKéMON our inn's mascot.\pI wonder if that will attract more
guests to stay with us?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_NoGue: Oh, sorry, sorry!\nI was too involved in watching TV!\pSince that TEAM AQUA came to town,\nthe tourists have been staying away.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_CantS: Hey, down in front!\nI can't see the TV!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_MonFo:
Amazing! You're telling me a POKéMON
found someone's lost item?\pThat's something. If we had some smart
POKéMON like that…\pWe could recover anything that our
guests mislaid…$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_Heard:
Oh, sorry, sorry!
I was too involved in watching TV!\pI heard that someone busted
the TEAM AQUA HIDEOUT.\pThanks to that, we just booked
a reservation from a big group.\pIt was a company called… Uh…
GAME something…$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_House:
Amazing! A house-sitting POKéMON
caught a burglar?\pThat's something. If we had a tough
POKéMON as a security guard…\pWe would be able to provide our guests
with greater safety.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_Bette:
Oh, sorry, sorry!
I was too involved in watching TV.\pOh, yes. A big group of guests arrived
a little while ago.\pThey booked in as GAME FREAK,
so I guess they must make games.\pUh-oh, I'd better get working on
their dinner!$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ShowM:
I'm the GAME DESIGNER.\pOh, is that right?
You're working on a POKéDEX?\pIt's tough trying to complete it,
but don't give up.\pIf you do complete it, please come
show me.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Fille:
Wow! That's awesome!
Yep, it's totally awesome!\pThis POKéDEX is completely filled!
You really must love POKéMON!\pI'm so impressed!\pLet me give you something in
recognition of your feat!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImThe: Me? You're talking to me?\nI'm the PROGRAMMER.\pI wonder what the SLOTS are\nlike here.$
I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST! Aren't the\nPOKéMON of HOENN interesting?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Girls: The girl TUBERS, they're cute, hey?\nTo battle against a cute TUBER…\pWhoop, it's so awesome!\pAnd the TWINS! Aren't they cute?\nA 2-on-2 battle with TWINS…\pWhoop, it's unbearably fun!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SeaBr: The sea breeze tickles my heart.\nIt feels wonderful here!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Never: You never know when and where\npeople will challenge you.\pThat's why I never leave home without\nmy GAME BOY ADVANCE.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Snooz:
SCOTT: … … … … …
… … … … … Zzz…\p… … … … … Huh?!
Oh, sorry, sorry! I was snoozing!\pI came to check out this POKéMON
CONTEST thing.\pI have to admit, it does look quite
entertaining, but…\pConsider me a purist--I prefer
battles and tough TRAINERS.\pBut that's just me.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I hope you'll enjoy everything
like the GYMS, CONTESTS, BATTLE TENT,\lthe whole works!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F/.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Conte: SCOTT: I think it does take strategy\nto win a CONTEST.\pDevising CONTEST strategies is one way\nof becoming a better TRAINER, I'd say.$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRo.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text: Don't they have set dates for their\nclear-out sales?\pI watch TV, but they never show any\ncommercials.$
Yes! I've been waiting a long time for\nthis clear-out sale.\pThey have items that you can only get\nhere. I'm going to load up, that I am!$
It's a VENDING MACHINE.\nWhich drink would you like?$
Clang!\pScore! An extra can of {STR_VAR_1}\ndropped down!$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_IBu: Whenever I come to the DEPARTMENT\nSTORE, I always end up buying all sorts\lof things because it's so fun.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Mom: Today, my mom is going to buy me some\nnice furniture.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Buy: I'm buying something for my AZUMARILL\nas a reward for winning a CONTEST.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Flo: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER\n    LOTTERY CORNER\p2F: TRAINER'S ZONE\p3F: BATTLE COLLECTION\p4F: TM CORNER\p5F: POKé DOLL FLOOR\pROOFTOP: ROOFTOP PLAZA$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Wir:
Wireless Communication is a
lot of fun, isn't it?\pI think it lets you do things that
weren't possible before.\pFor instance, you can now trade
with people you couldn't before.\pI think it's going to be exciting!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Spr: I want to spread the word about how\nfun Wireless Communication can be.$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Lea: Learn to use items properly.\nThat's basic, really.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Goo: My husband is waiting at home.\nWhat would make a good gift for him?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Sto: I'm leaving on a long journey soon.\nI need to stock up on items.$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Ite: For quickly toughening up POKéMON,\nitems are the best.\pPROTEIN boosts ATTACK,\nand CALCIUM raises SP. ATK.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Wan: I want my POKéMON to have more\nendurance.\pI'm trying to decide whether to raise\nDEFENSE with IRON, or SP. DEF with ZINC.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Gav: I gave a CARBOS to my POKéMON,\nand its SPEED went up.$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_Att: Hmm…\pAn attacking move…\nOr a defensive move…\pIt's no easy matter to decide which TM\nmoves should be taught to POKéMON…$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_Fif: There are so many different kinds of\nTM moves.\pA catalog I read said there are fifty\ndifferent kinds.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_Pok: I'd like to get all the different TMs,\nbut a POKéMON learns only four moves.$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Pla: This place is full of cute DOLLS.\pI should buy some for me, instead of\njust for my children.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Get: I'm not big enough to raise POKéMON,\nso I'm getting a cute DOLL instead.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Sel: They sell many cute MATS here.\pI wonder which one I should get?\nMaybe I'll buy them all…$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Clo: I think they closed the rooftop\nbecause the weather is wild today.$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_Harbor/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FerryUnavailabl: I beg your pardon?\nYou're looking for a ship?\pI'm sorry, the ferry service isn't\navailable at present…$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_Harbor/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTick: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_Harbor/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_NoTicket: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…\pI'm terribly sorry.\pYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_Harbor/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FlashTicketWher: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_Harbor/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime: Please sail with us another time!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_Harbor/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoard: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_Harbor/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLi: Then, where would you like to go?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_Harbor/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryUnav: Until they finish making the ferry,\nwe sailors have nothing to do…\pI wish they'd get a move on, the folks\nat the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_Harbor/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryAvai: The ferry S.S. TIDAL is finally in\noperation.\pThe folks at the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT\nmust've worked extra hard.\pWell, it's my turn to get busy now!$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_House1/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartners: POKéMON are partners to people.\nThey aren't our tools.\pUnfortunately, there are some people\nwho fail to understand that…$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_House2/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_House2_Text_NotAwakeYetHave: Huh? What? What's that?\pI'm not near awake yet…\nYou can have this…$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_House2/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_House2_Text_SleepIsEssentia: Yawn…\pSleep is essential for good health…\nSleep and regain health…$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_House3/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LearnFromMaster:
Oh, my, my! Are you traveling alone?
But you're so young! Good for you!\pI'm sure my kids could learn a thing
or two from you!\pMe? I'm a master of ポロックS.\pIf I get serious just a little, why,
I can concoct great ポロックS.\pWould you like to learn from me,
a master of ポロックS?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_House3/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_OhAreYouSure: Oh? Are you sure?\pYou shouldn't always try to do\neverything by yourself, dear!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_House3/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokebloc:
Oh, good! You're a smart soul!
This is a bit long, so listen up!\pAre you ready?\pIf you look at ポロックS, you should see
that they are rated on how they feel.\pThe lower the feel rating,
the better it is. Don't forget this!\pA good ポロック has a low feel
rating and a high level.\pA POKéMON can eat more good
ポロックS than ordinary ones, too.\pAnd this is important.\pIf you want to make smooth ポロックS,
use different kinds of BERRIES.\pDon't be stingy--the kinds of BERRIES
affect the smoothness of ポロックS.\pAnd another thing.\pThe more people blending BERRIES,
the smoother the ポロックS.\pThat's why you should talk to other
people and make ポロックS together.\pThat's about all you need to know to
make good ポロックS.\pIf everyone had POKéMON they love,
smooth ポロックS, and a loving family,\lthe world would be a happier place.\pDon't give up, dear!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_House3/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_HappyToHaveQuad: When my wife gave birth to quadruplets,\nyou bet I was shocked.\pBut, now, seeing them play together,\nit makes me happy.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_House3/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToWinMulti: We're having MULTI BATTLES, but I know\nI'm going to win.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_House3/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LikeMixingAtRec: We like mixing stuff at\nthe RECORD CORNER.\pBut what gets mixed up?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_House3/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_MakePokeblocksW: We're going to make super ポロックS\nwith a BERRY BLENDER!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_House3/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToEnterCon: I want to brag about how tough my\nPOKéMON is, so we're going to enter\la CONTEST together.$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_House4/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_House4_Text_MysteriesAtBott: This planet's biggest mysteries are\nat the bottom of the sea.\pSomebody said that, but I don't know…$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_House4/scripts.in.LilycoveCity_House4_Text_UnderwaterTrenc: There's a deep underwater trench\nbetween MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.\pThat's what someone told me, anyway.$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Welc: Welcome to LILYCOVE MUSEUM.\pPlease take the time to enjoy our\ncollection of fantastic artwork\lfeaturing POKéMON.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCu:
I'm the CURATOR of this MUSEUM of
fine arts.\pIt's heartening to see someone so
young as you in our MUSEUM.\pHave you viewed our collection of
paintings already?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_NotD: Ah, then let me not disturb you.\nPlease, do take your time.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Have: Oh? I do believe that you seem to\nbe a POKéMON TRAINER.\pHave you an interest in paintings,\ntoo?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Hono: I see…\pI'm honored that you would visit\nus in spite of that.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Exce: Ah, excellent!\nYou do like paintings!\pThen, may I ask you to come with me?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Very: It's a very old painting.\nThe paint is peeling here and there.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_OddL: It's an odd landscape with bizarre\nand fantastic scenery.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Pain: It's a painting of a beautiful, smiling\nwoman with a POKéMON on her lap.$
It's a painting of a legendary POKéMON\nfrom long ago.\pThe artist painted this from\nimagination.$
It's a painting of GRASS POKéMON\nswaying in a breeze.\pThey appear to be enjoying the wind's\ngentle caress.$
It's a delicious-looking painting\nof BERRIES.\pThis painting could make you hungry!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_Text_BirdPok: It's a replica of a famous sculpture.\pIt depicts an ancient BIRD POKéMON.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_BigP: It's a big POKé BALL carved from\na black stone.\pIt was apparently used in festivals\nin the olden days.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Ston: It's a huge stone tablet inscribed\nwith POKéMON and dense text in the\lsmall characters of an ancient,\lunreadable language.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Must: Battling with POKéMON is fun,\nI'll grant you that.\pBut one mustn't forget our love for\nthe fine arts.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_This: This ART MUSEUM… Well, you could\nsee many fantastic paintings.\pAnd the CURATOR is a wonderful person.\pAmong artists like myself, this MUSEUM\nis an inspiration.$
This lady is pretty!\nShe's like Mommy!$
This POKéMON is adorable!\nJust like our little boy!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Hear: I'd heard that this ART MUSEUM got\nin some new paintings.\pSo, naturally I hurried over.\pAre the new paintings up on\nthe second floor?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Cura: Lately, the CURATOR has been\nunusually cheerful.\pI bet something good happened for him.\nDefinitely.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_AimT: I aim to see many great paintings\nhere and learn from them.\pI have this dream of one day having\nmy artwork exhibited here.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Muse:
The ART MUSEUM has become a favorite
tourist destination.\pIt's great for LILYCOVE…
No, great for the HOENN region!\pThis is what I've heard--a lone TRAINER
procured all the paintings upstairs.$

data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_This: This is our special exhibit hall.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Expl:
As you can plainly see, there is not
a single painting on exhibit.\pHere, I don't wish to exhibit works of
so-called classical art.\pSuch classical works you can see on
our ground floor.\pI wish to exhibit work that is far
different from the classics.\pArt, after all, is not restricted to old,
famous works!\pThis exhibit hall, I wish to fill it with…\pModern and vibrant artworks of
POKéMON seemingly ready to spring\lforth into glorious life!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Plea:
I beg your pardon. I didn't intend
to monopolize the conversation.\pNow, as you are young, and yet
obviously well traveled…\pYou must encounter lively POKéMON
and works of art depicting them.\pIf you were to come across such
a painting, may we ask you to obtain\lthe artist's permission to exhibit\lit here?$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Wish: I wish to fill this exhibit hall with\nmodern and vibrant paintings of\lPOKéMON.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Than: Thanks to you, we've added a new\npainting to our collection!\pI've heard it depicts your POKéMON.\nTruly magnificent!\pThank you so very, very much!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Pain:
Isn't this marvelous?
This collection of paintings!\pEach one of them flawless!
None better than another!\pThese paintings have attracted
more guests to our ART MUSEUM.\pSincerely, I thank you, {PLAYER}.
This is my dream come true!$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Toke: This is merely a token of my gratitude.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Keep: I will keep this for you until we\nmeet again.$
data/maps/LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Hono: Ah, so good to see you, {PLAYER}!\pIt's an honor to have you visit us\non your busy journeys.\pPlease, relax and do enjoy your\nvisit with us.$
