data/maps/LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFan.LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_: Oh, wow!\nIt's {PLAYER}!$

I've heard the news!
You're really strong, aren't you?\pWe always argue about who is the
strongest of all TRAINERS here.\pSo when I heard about you, I decided
to be your fan!\pI hope you'll keep on battling other
tough TRAINERS.\pThat way, we'll be able to see more
of your hot, hot battles.\pThat will make the others here see
exactly how great you are.\pRemember, I'm cheering for you,
{PLAYER}!$
Yo, {PLAYER}!\nYou're the one we want to win!$
The others, they don't know that\nyou're the best of the best!\pIsn't that right, {PLAYER}?\nShow them you've got guts!$
I hate to say this, but the TRAINER\neverybody's talking about is\l{STR_VAR_1}, no question about it!\pThat TRAINER's power…\nIt's out of the ordinary.$
Darn it… I've been telling people\nthat {STR_VAR_1} is the best now…\pBut no one wants to listen…$

I've been hearing things about
a tough new TRAINER.\pThis TRAINER's supposed to be beating
GYM LEADERS, even.\pDo you know anything about this
new TRAINER?$
Oh!\n{PLAYER}!\pGo for it!\nI'm pulling for you!$

Sigh…
BRAWLY…\pOh, no! Wait!
That's not right! No, no, no!\pI'm your fan through and through!\pSo make me proud!
Go for it!$
I can't help it, I can only get to\nlike BRAWLY…$
Nobody understands the charm of\nBRAWLY…\pI don't care!\pEven if I'm the only one, I'm going\nto keep cheering for BRAWLY!$
Whatever anyone says, my favorite\nTRAINER is DEWFORD's GYM LEADER\lBRAWLY!$
You've surpassed your own father in\nevery regard!\pI'm telling you, so there's no question\nabout it at all!$
Even when things turned bleak,\nyour father never gave up.\pThis I know to be true.\pYou never give up even if you lose!\nSo keep on battling!$

NORMAN battled with more power,
charisma, and showmanship than you.\pEven though people may say that
you're strong…\pYou've still got a long way to go
compared to your father.$

You're beginning to get the same
air of awe NORMAN exudes.\pBut there's something conclusively
different between you and NORMAN.\pI can't tell you what that is.
You'll have to find it yourself.$

Everyone here, we're all huge fans
of POKéMON battles.\pWe discuss who we consider to be
the strongest of all TRAINERS.\pIf you were to become famous,
we might even become your fans!$
Oh, woweee! It's {PLAYER}!\nFor real, too!\pPlease, shake my hand, shake my hand!$

I'll always cheer for you, {PLAYER}!
Always, always!\pI don't want to see you lose ever,
{PLAYER}.\pBecause I know you're really,
really strong, {PLAYER}!$
{STR_VAR_1} is really cool…\pEveryone thinks so, right, right?$
{STR_VAR_1} really is cool, don't\nyou think so?\pEven if it's just me, I'm going to keep\ncheering my favorite TRAINER.$
My favorite TRAINER is…\pCool…\pStrong…\pAnd really nice…\pI wish there was a TRAINER like that…$
Whoa! It's {PLAYER}!\nWicked!\pWhen I grow up, I want to be strong\nlike you, {PLAYER}!$
Even if I'm the only one…\pYou'll always be the only one\nI cheer for, {PLAYER}!\pBecause I believe in you, {PLAYER}!$
{STR_VAR_1} is so wickedly cool…\nI want to shake hands with my hero.$
Even if I'm the only one…\pI'm never going to stop being\n{STR_VAR_1}'s fan!\pBecause I've heard, {STR_VAR_1}\nnever loses!$
{PLAYER}!\nYou are amazing after all!\pEver since I set eyes on you,\nI knew that you were great.\pIt looks like my eyes didn't deceive me.$
Who cares about the others.\nI'm in your corner!\pYou don't need to worry. Just get\nout there and battle like always.$

You're a pretty decent TRAINER,
I think.\pBut I also think that {STR_VAR_1}
is number one right now.\pThat's just my opinion.
Don't worry about it too much.$
Wow, you really are strong.\nMaybe even stronger than {STR_VAR_1}.\pBut {STR_VAR_1} needs me.\pIf I don't cheer for {STR_VAR_1},\nwho will?$
You've changed my mind!\nYou are strong, aren't you?\pI'd like you to tell me how you managed\nto get so strong!$
The tougher the situation, the more\nattractively you battle.\pI can't wait for your next battle!$
Among the recently hot TRAINERS,\n{STR_VAR_1} is the standout.\pThat toughness, it's simply not normal.\pYou're doing okay, but you're not in\nthe same class as {STR_VAR_1}.$
You are really popular…\pYou're strong, and you're caring to\nPOKéMON. No one can knock you.\pBut, you know, I believe in {STR_VAR_1}.\p{STR_VAR_1} is definitely stronger!\nI'm positive!$
You…\pImpressive!$
Your true worth, it is fine if only\nI recognized it.\pThe others I doubt will understand\nthe hidden power that beats within.$
Yes, I see strength in your eyes.\pBut!\pYou still haven't realized your\npotential.$

It is true that you are tremendously
powerful.\pBut!
I can tell…\pThat strength cannot be considered
true strength yet!\pTrue strength is…!
… …\pActually, I have no idea, either.$

in your veins after all!\pOh, yes. As thanks for rescuing me,
I'd like you to have the POKéMON you\lused earlier.\p{PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}!$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_W: PROF. BIRCH: While you're at it, why not\ngive a nickname to that {STR_VAR_1}?$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M:
PROF. BIRCH: If you work at POKéMON
and gain experience, I think you'll make\lan extremely good TRAINER.\pMy kid, {RIVAL}, is also studying
POKéMON while helping me out.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, don't you think it might be
a good idea to go see {RIVAL}?$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_G: PROF. BIRCH: Great!\n{RIVAL} should be happy, too.\pGet {RIVAL} to teach you what it\nmeans to be a TRAINER.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_D: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, don't be that way.\nYou should go meet my kid.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B:
PROF. BIRCH: {RIVAL}?
Gone home, I think.\pOr maybe that kid's scrabbling around
in tall grass again somewhere…\pIf you or your POKéMON get tired,
you should get some rest at home.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_H:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI heard you beat {RIVAL} on
your first try. That's excellent!\p{RIVAL}'s been helping with my research
for a long time.\p{RIVAL} has an extensive history as
a TRAINER already.\pHere, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I ordered this for my
research, but I think you should have\lthis POKéDEX.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_E:
PROF. BIRCH: The POKéDEX is a high-tech
tool that automatically makes a record\lof any POKéMON you meet or catch.\pMy kid, {RIVAL}, goes everywhere
with it.\pWhenever my kid catches a rare POKéMON
and records its data in the POKéDEX,\lwhy, {RIVAL} looks for me while I'm out\ldoing fieldwork, and shows me.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_C: PROF. BIRCH: Countless POKéMON\nawait you!\pArgh, I'm getting the itch to get out\nand do fieldwork again!$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M: MAY: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nYou got a POKéDEX, too!\pThat's great! Just like me!\nI've got something for you, too!$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_C:
MAY: It's fun if you can get a lot of
POKéMON!\pI'm going to look all over the place
because I want different POKéMON.\pIf I find any cute POKéMON, I'll catch
them with POKé BALLS!$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M: MAY: I wonder where I should go look\nfor POKéMON next?$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B: BRENDAN: Huh…\nSo you got a POKéDEX, too.\pWell then, here.\nI'll give you these.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_C:
BRENDAN: You know it's more fun to
have a whole bunch of POKéMON.\pI'm going to explore all over the place
to find different POKéMON.\pIf I find any cool POKéMON, you bet
I'll try to get them with POKé BALLS.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B: BRENDAN: Where should I look for\nPOKéMON next…$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_S: It's a serious-looking machine.\nThe PROF must use this for research.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_P: It's a PC used for research.\nBetter not mess around with it.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_C: It's crammed with books on POKéMON.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B: It's a book that's too hard to read.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_O:
PROF. BIRCH: Now…\p{PLAYER}{KUN} and {RIVAL}, I've had the two
of you help me study POKéMON.\pThanks to your help, new facts
are coming to light.\pIt appears that in the HOENN region,
there are also POKéMON from other\lregions.\pIt goes to show how rich and varied
the natural environments of HOENN\lhappen to be.\pThat's why I think it's necessary for
me to upgrade your POKéDEX to\lthe NATIONAL Mode.\pHere, let me see your POKéDEX units.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M: MAY: Eheheh!\pIt's so cool that even my POKéDEX\nis getting updated!\pIt's because you went out and caught\nso many POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B: BRENDAN: I went out all over HOENN\nand checked out POKéMON.\pYou can thank me for getting\nthe NATIONAL Mode POKéDEX.\pYep, you're lucky, {PLAYER}!$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_P: {PLAYER}'s POKéDEX was upgraded\nto the NATIONAL Mode!$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_G:
PROF. BIRCH: But listen.
You've become the CHAMPION,\lbut your POKéMON journey isn't over.\pThere is no end to the road
that is POKéMON.\pSomewhere, there is a grassy patch
that's waiting for you!$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M: MAY: I think I'll take a short break\nfrom fieldwork.\pI think I'll help the PROF here for\na while.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B: BRENDAN: For the time being,\nI'm taking a break from fieldwork.\pI'll be helping out the PROF here\nfor a while.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_C:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Let's have a look at your POKéDEX.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pYes, there's no doubt about it.\pYou really have completed the HOENN
region's POKéDEX.\pThat's more than just impressive.\pI have a gift for you.\pConsider it my show of appreciation
for the fantastic work you've done.\pMy gift is a rare POKéMON only found
in another region!\pYou can have any one of these
three POKéMON!$
PROF. BIRCH: These are rare POKéMON\nonly found in another region!\pYou can have any one of these\nthree POKéMON!$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_Y: PROF. BIRCH: The FIRE POKéMON\nCYNDAQUIL caught your eye!\pYou're as sharp as ever!\pSo the CYNDAQUIL is your choice?$
PROF. BIRCH: The WATER POKéMON\nTOTODILE is your choice!\pYou know how to pick a good one.\pSo, you'll take the TOTODILE?$
PROF. BIRCH: The GRASS POKéMON\nCHIKORITA is your choice!\pYou sure know what you're doing.\pSo, you'll take the CHIKORITA?$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_T: PROF. BIRCH: Take your time before\nyou decide.\pThey're all invaluable POKéMON.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_P: PROF. BIRCH: I see!\nYou picked a fine POKéMON!$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_N: Want to give a nickname to\nthe {STR_VAR_1} you received?$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_G:
PROF. BIRCH: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
You've completed the HOENN POKéDEX,\lbut your POKéMON journey isn't over.\pThere is no end to the road
that is POKéMON.\pSomewhere, there is a grassy patch
that's waiting for you!$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B: You received the promised POKéMON.\nBetter leave the others alone.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_D: Oh, you don't have any room for\nthis POKéMON.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, after this…
What are you going to do?\pAre you going to keep battling
and sharpening your skills?\pOr are you going to try filling
the NATIONAL POKéDEX?\pI'm staying here to help the PROF.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B: BRENDAN: Rather than collecting\nPOKéMON, I prefer slowly and \lsteadily raising the one I chose.$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nHave you gone to that place,\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER?$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nHave you gone out to that place,\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER?$
data/maps/LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchs.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_S:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pSCOTT: Hi, hi, {PLAYER}!
It's me, SCOTT.\pI'm aboard the S.S. TIDAL now.
It feels great to be on the sea!\pBy the way…\pThere's this place that I'd like to
invite you to for a visit.\pIf you're interested, board a ferry
at either SLATEPORT or LILYCOVE.\pI'll fill you in on the details when
we meet. I'll be waiting!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$

data/maps/MagmaHideout_1F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro: When TEAM MAGMA has roll call, we get\nimportant guarding assignments in\lthe order that we line up.\pThat's why I'm stuck off in this corner.\nI'm always late to roll call!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_1F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat: I'm always late for training sessions,\ntoo!\pI hate to say it, but I'm wimpy…$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_1F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: Okay, I'll try to put a little more\neffort into things from now on…$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_1F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro:
Our leader told us to dig into
MT. CHIMNEY, so we dug and dug.\pAnd in the course of digging, we came
across something that blew our minds!\pWhat did we find?\pFuhahaha!
I'll tell you if you beat me!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_1F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: I won't tell you after all.\nYou'll find out when you get there!\pIt'd be better if you saved surprises\nto the end, don't you think?$

data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_1R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Intro:
What, what, what?\pOnly TEAM MAGMA members are supposed
to be in here!\pBut you're not dressed in TEAM MAGMA's
uniform…\pYou rouse my suspicion!
Battle with me!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_1R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Defeat: Aiyiyi…\nMy pride as a TEAM MAGMA member…$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_1R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14PostBattl: If you suffer from chills, you should\njoin TEAM MAGMA.$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_1R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Intro: Hold it right there!\pYou don't really expect me to keep\nmy trap shut and let you waltz by me?$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_1R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3PostBattle: Maybe it would've been better if I did\njust let you go unchallenged…$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_1R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4PostBattle: I've already lost.\pDo I really need to keep running\naround in a circle?$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_1R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5PostBattle: Actually, I'm no expert at battling…$

data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_2R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Intro: I don't have a bone to pick with you.\nI'm just following orders!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_2R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15PostBattl: We dug up something beyond belief!\nAnd, we got the BLUE ORB!\pAll that's left is for our leader to…\nFufufu… Fwahahaha!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_2R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Intro: I can't stand heat. Maybe I should've\njoined TEAM AQUA instead…$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_2R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Defeat: Yeah, I really may not be right for\nTEAM MAGMA…$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_2R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6PostBattle: Don't you get lonely for the sea\nbeing in a place like this?$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_2R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Intro: You can hear tremors here sometimes.\pCould it be the volcano rattling?\nOr is it GROU…\pWhoops!\nNo, no, never mind!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_2R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Defeat: You're a fiery battler.\nJust like a volcano!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_2R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7PostBattle: You just happened to win this time,\nbut that doesn't matter.\pTEAM MAGMA's goal is about to be\nreached!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_2R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Intro: One of our guys was freaking out that\nhe lost his MAGMA EMBLEM…\pWait a minute!\nWas it you who found it?$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_2F_2R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8PostBattle: I'm getting this feeling that our plan\nis going to end in failure…$

data/maps/MagmaHideout_3F_1R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Intro: What did I do to deserve this guard\nposting?\pMy left ear is burning up!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_3F_1R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9PostBattle: Do you think it's odd that we're wearing\nhoods in this magma-filled volcano?$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_3F_1R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Intro:
We joined so we can help our leader
achieve his fantastic vision.\pI don't care if you're with TEAM AQUA
or if you're just some kid passing by.\pNo one interferes with us and gets
away with it!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_3F_1R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Defeat: Oh, no!\nYou're not to be trusted at all!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_3F_1R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16PostBattl: Listen to me.\nTEAM MAGMA is right!\pDon't listen to TEAM AQUA.\nDon't believe their lies!$

data/maps/MagmaHideout_3F_2R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Intro:
I understand everything our leader
says. But you know what?\pDoing stuff like digging up a super-
ancient POKéMON and ripping off\lsomeone's METEORITE…\pI think we're going a little too far.
What do you think?$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_3F_2R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Defeat: Yeah, I think we are doing something\nwrong somehow.$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_3F_2R/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10PostBattl: You know, losing to you cleared my mind.\pThe next time I see our leader,\nI'm going to ask him about what we do.$

data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro: I want to see GROUDON, too, but they\nwon't let me see even its tail…\pIt's got me feeling really frustrated.\pOh, no!\nI blabbed about GROUDON!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Defeat: I guess it's impossible to win if one\ndoesn't have a calm mind…$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11PostBattle: I wonder if GROUDON even has a tail?$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Intro: Fuhahaha!\nSoon! Very soon!\lOur grand objective will be achieved!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Defeat: Grrr…\nI've come so far, but now this?$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12PostBattle: MAXIE, sir!\nAn intruder is headed your way!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Intro: You're not finished yet!\nYou're not getting by me easily!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Defeat: Was I that easy to knock down?$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro:
Hehehe!
You made it this far, so I'll tell you!\pThat's right!
Up ahead, GROUDON is sleeping!\pMAXIE went to GROUDON just seconds
ago!\pIt's going to awaken real soon!
Hehe! Hehehe!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaPostBattle: …And while you wasted time with me,\nMAXIE should have awakened GROUDON…$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon:
MAXIE: GROUDON…\pNothing could awaken you from your
sleep bathed in magma…\pThis BLUE ORB is what you sought.
Wasn't it?\pI have brought you the BLUE ORB.
Let its shine awaken you!\pAnd show me…
Show me the full extent of your power!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWr: MAXIE: GROUDON!\nWhat's wrong?\pWasn't the BLUE ORB the key?\pGROUDON!\nWhere have you gone…$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou: MAXIE: Oh, so it was you?\pI've seen you poking around uninvited\nhere and there…\pI get it now!\nYou must have pulled a cheap stunt!$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieDefeat: What makes you so adept at handling\nPOKéMON?$
data/maps/MagmaHideout_4F/scripts.inc.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGr:
MAXIE: There has to be some reason
why GROUDON fled…\pThat's what you're trying to say,
aren't you?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pHumph…
You think I didn't know that?\pWith GROUDON gone, there is no longer
any need for this blasted volcano.\pI am going after GROUDON, so this
is where we part!$

data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified: MAHOGANY TOWN POKéMON GYM\pPRYCE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceIntro:
POKéMON have many experiences
in their lives, just like we do.\pI, too, have seen and suffered
much in my life.\pSince I am your elder, let me
show you what I mean.\pI have been with POKéMON since
before you were born.\pI do not lose easily.\pI, PRYCE--the winter trainer--
shall demonstrate my power!$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceImpressed: Ah, I am impressed by your\nprowess.\pWith your strong will, I know you\nwill overcome all life's obstacles.\pYou are worthy of this BADGE!$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_GlacierBadgeSpeech: That BADGE will raise the SPECIAL\nATTACK of POKéMON.\pIt also lets your POKéMON use\nWHIRLPOOL to get across\lreal whirlpools.\pAnd this… This is a gift from me!$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_HailSpeech: That TM contains HAIL.\pIt inflicts damage every\nturn for 5 turns.\pIt demonstrates the harshness\nof winter.$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_CherishPokemon: When the ice and snow melt,\nspring arrives.\pYou and your POKéMON will be\ntogether for many years to come.\pCherish your time together!$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceRematch:
Ah, JOHTO CHAMPION!\pYour skills are indeed
remarkable.\pI am impressed.\pBut even now, there is much to
learn from each other.\pI, PRYCE--the winter trainer--
still have a few tricks left.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceRematchDefeat: Ah, yet again I'm impressed by\nyour prowess.\pWith your strong will, I know you\nwill overcome all life's obstacles.$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_Guide:
PRYCE is a veteran who has
trained POKéMON for some 50 years.\pHe's got a solid lineup of
POKéMON to cover whatever\lyou bring his way.\pFire is a good place to start,
but watch out for the rain!$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_GuideWin: PRYCE is something, but you're\nsomething else!\pThat was a hot battle that\nbridged the generation gap!$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderRonaldSeen: I'll freeze your POKéMON,\nso you can't do a thing!$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderRonaldBeate: Darn. I couldn't do a thing.$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderRonaldAfter: I think there's a move a\nPOKéMON can use while it's\lfrozen.$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderBradSeen: This GYM has a slippery floor.\pIt's fun, isn't it?\pBut hey--we're not playing\ngames here!$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderBradBeaten: Do you see how serious we are?$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderBradAfter: This GYM is great.\nI love boarding with my\lPOKéMON!$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderDouglasBeat: OK. I'll tell you PRYCE's secret.$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderDouglasAfte: The secret behind PRYCE's power…\pHe meditates under a waterfall\ndaily to strengthen his mind\land body.$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierRoxanneSeen: To get to PRYCE, our GYM LEADER,\nyou need to think before you skate.$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierRoxanneBeaten: I wouldn't lose to you in skiing!$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierRoxanneAfter: If you don't skate with precision,\nyou won't get far in this GYM.$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierClarissaBeate: No! You made me wipe out!$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Gym_hns/scripts.i.MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierClarissaAfter: I shouldn't have been bragging\nabout my skiing…$

data/maps/MahoganyTown_House1_hns/script.MahoganyRedGyaradosHouse_Text_BlackBelt: I heard that a red GYARADOS appeared\nat the LAKE.\pThat's odd, since even ordinary\nGYARADOS are rare in that lake…$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_House1_hns/script.MahoganyRedGyaradosHouse_Text_Teacher: My favorite radio program? I'd say\nPOKéMON MUSIC.$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_House1_hns/script.MahoganyRedGyaradosHouse_Text_Teacher_Ro: I've been hearing laughter on the\nradio…\pIt's creepy.$

data/maps/MahoganyTown_PokemonCenter_hns.MahoganyTown_PokemonCenter_Text_PokefanM: What's this? TEAM ROCKET has come\nback?\pI saw some men in black at LAKE OF\nRAGE…$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_PokemonCenter_hns.MahoganyTown_PokemonCenter_Text_Youngste: I stop my POKéMON from evolving too\nearly.\pI make them learn certain moves\nbefore I let them evolve.$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_PokemonCenter_hns.MahoganyTown_PokemonCenter_Text_Cooltrai: POKéMON do become stronger when they\nevolve,\pbut they also learn moves more\nslowly.$

data/maps/MahoganyTown_Shop_hns/scripts..MahoganyTown_Shop_Text_Granny: Please come back another time.\nThe store is... closed\lright now.$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Shop_hns/scripts..MahoganyMart1F_Text_BlackBelt: Heheh! The experi- ment worked like\na charm.\pMAGIKARP are just worthless, but\nGYARADOS are big moneymakers.$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Shop_hns/scripts..MahoganyMart1F_Text_Lance_Radio: What took you, {PLAYER}?\pJust as we thought, that strange\nradio signal is coming from here.$
data/maps/MahoganyTown_Shop_hns/scripts..MahoganyMart1F_Text_Lance_SplitUp: LANCE: {PLAYER}, we should split up\nto check this place.\pI'll go first.$

data/maps/Mahoganytown_hns/scripts.inc.MahoganyTown_Text_RageCandyBarMerchantTr: Hiya, kid!\pI see you're new in MAHOGANY TOWN.\pSince you're new, you should try a\nyummy RAGECANDYBAR!\pRight now, it can be yours for just\n¥300! Want one?$
data/maps/Mahoganytown_hns/scripts.inc.MahoganyTown_Text_RageCandyBarMerchantSo: RAGECANDYBAR's sold out.\pI'm packing up. Don't bother me,\nkiddo.$
data/maps/Mahoganytown_hns/scripts.inc.MahoganyTown_Text_Gramps: Are you off to see the GYARADOS\nrampage at the LAKE?$
data/maps/Mahoganytown_hns/scripts.inc.MahoganyTown_Text_GrampsClearedRocketHid: MAGIKARP have returned to LAKE\nOF RAGE.\pThat should be good news for the\nanglers there.$
data/maps/Mahoganytown_hns/scripts.inc.MahoganyTown_Text_Fisher: Since you came this far, take the\ntime to do some sightseeing.\pYou should head north and check\nout LAKE OF RAGE right now.$
data/maps/Mahoganytown_hns/scripts.inc.MahoganyTown_Text_Lass: Visit Grandma's shop. She sells\nstuff that nobody else has.$
data/maps/Mahoganytown_hns/scripts.inc.MahoganyTown_Text_Sign: MAHOGANY TOWN\pWelcome to the Home of the Ninja$
data/maps/Mahoganytown_hns/scripts.inc.MahoganyTown_Text_RagecandybarSign: While visiting MAHOGANY TOWN, try\na RAGECANDYBAR!$
data/maps/Mahoganytown_hns/scripts.inc.MahoganyTown_Text_GymSign: MAHOGANY TOWN POKéMON GYM\pLEADER: PRYCE\pThe Teacher of Winter's Harshness$
data/maps/Mahoganytown_hns/scripts.inc.ElmPhoneRadioTowerRocketTakeoverText:
PROF.ELM: {PLAYER}, how are
things going?\pI called because something weird
is happening with the radio\lbroadcasts.\pThey were talking about TEAM
ROCKET.\p{PLAYER}, do you know anything
about it?\pMaybe TEAM ROCKET has returned.
No, that just can't be true.\pSorry to bug you.
Take care!$

data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_UncleHesTooPeppy: UNCLE: It's because of POKéMON that\nthis boy's got more pep, I suppose…\lBut he's become a bit too peppy…$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGy: WALLY: Aww, UNCLE, please?\pI want to challenge this GYM and see\nhow much better I've become.\pPlease? May I, please?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_UncleYourePushingIt: UNCLE: Now hold on, WALLY.\pSince you started living with POKéMON,\nyou have grown quite a lot stronger.\pBut don't you think you're pushing it\nto suddenly challenge a GYM?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWeCanBeatAnyone: WALLY: I'm not pushing it.\pIf I combine forces with RALTS,\nwe can beat anyone!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe:
WALLY: Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}!\pI've gotten a lot stronger since
we met.\p{PLAYER}, I want you and my UNCLE to
understand that.\p{PLAYER}, please, will you have
a battle with me?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyMyUncleWontKnowIm: WALLY: Oh… If you won't battle me,\n{PLAYER}, my UNCLE won't know that I've\lbecome really strong.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_UncleCanYouBattleWally: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, was it?\nOn WALLY's behalf, can I ask you to\lbattle with him just this once?\pI don't think he's going to listen to\nany reason the way he is now.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyHereICome: WALLY: {PLAYER}, thank you.\pOkay… Here I come!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyIllGoBackToVerdan: WALLY: UNCLE…\nI'll go back to VERDANTURF…$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_ThankYouNotEnoughToBat: {PLAYER}, thank you.\nBeing a TRAINER is tough, isn't it?\pIt's not enough just to have POKéMON\nand make them battle. That isn't what\lbeing a real TRAINER is about.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_UncleNoNeedToBeDown:
UNCLE: WALLY, there's no need to be so
down on yourself.\pWhy, what's keeping you from becoming
stronger and stronger?\pCome on, let's go home.
Everyone's waiting for you.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_UncleVisitUsSometime: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, it just dawned on me\nthat you must be the TRAINER who kept\lan eye out for WALLY when he caught\lhis POKéMON.\pWhy don't you visit us in VERDANTURF\nsometime?\lI'm sure WALLY would enjoy it.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPokenavCall:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pWALLY: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!\pI just wanted to tell you that
my uncle bought me a POKéNAV!\pNow I can get in touch with you
anytime, {PLAYER}!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack:
SCOTT: Hehe…
I was watching that match!\pYou're friends with that boy WALLY,
aren't you?\pBut you didn't hold anything back
and beat him impressively.\pYeah! That's what a real POKéMON
battle is all about!\pI idolize TRAINERS like that!\p… … … … … …
I'll be cheering for you!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKe:
WATTSON: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You look like you have a lot of zip!\lThat's a good thing, wahahahaha!\pFine! I've decided!
I need a favor, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pMAUVILLE CITY has an underground
sector called NEW MAUVILLE.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'd like you to go there and
switch off the GENERATOR.\pThe GENERATOR has been running a bit
haywire. It's getting unsafe.\pHere, this is the KEY to get into
NEW MAUVILLE.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge:
WATTSON: Don't you worry about it.
It won't be a challenge to you.\pThe entrance to NEW MAUVILLE is just
a short SURF away from ROUTE 110.\pThat's it, then, you have my trust!
Wahahahaha!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeTM: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!\pI knew it, {PLAYER}{KUN}! I knew I'd made\nthe right choice asking you!\pThis is my thanks--a TM containing\nTHUNDERBOLT!\pGo on, you've earned it!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonYoungTakeCharge: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!\pIt pleases me to no end to see\nthe young step up and take charge!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_NurseHurtMonBackToHeal: You know, it's cool to have POKéMON\nbattles and stuff…\pBut if your POKéMON gets hurt,\nyou have to nurse it back to health.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_AllSortsOfPeopleComeTh: The roads of this town stretch north\nand south, and east and west.\pBecause of that, we get all sorts of\npeople coming through.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_RydelVeryGenerous: Have you been to RYDEL'S CYCLES yet?\pRYDEL, the owner, is a very generous\nman.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_PokemonCanJumpYouOnBik: Even if you're riding a BIKE,\nwild POKéMON could jump you.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_CitySign: MAUVILLE CITY\n“The bright and shiny city of fun!”$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_GymSign: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: WATTSON\l“The cheerfully electrifying man!”$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_BikeShopSign: “Ride in gravel and shake up your\nsoul!”\lRYDEL'S CYCLES$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_GameCornerSign: “The play spot for all!”\nMAUVILLE GAME CORNER$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_ExplainTV:
Hi, do you check out TV at all?\pThey've added a bunch of cool new
shows recently.\pTV is so cool. I've seen my friends on
TV just out of the blue.\pAnd, sometimes, they even put you on TV
without telling you.\pI wish I would be on TV sometime.\pThat's why I think you should check
out TVs whenever you can.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Text_BeenCheckingOutTV: Hi, have you been checking out TVs?$

data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_RydelGreeting: Well, well, what have we here?\nA most energetic customer!\pMe? You may call me RYDEL.\nI'm the owner of this cycle shop.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_DidYouComeFro: RYDEL: Your RUNNING SHOES…\nThey're awfully filthy.\pDid you come from far away?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_GuessYouDontN: RYDEL: Is that right?\pThen, I guess you have no need for\nany of my BIKES.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesC:
RYDEL: Hm, hm… … … … …\pYou're saying that you came all this
way from LITTLEROOT?\pMy goodness!
That's ridiculously far!\pIf you had one of my BIKES, you could
go anywhere easily while feeling the\lgentle caress of the wind!\pI'll tell you what!
I'll give you a BIKE!\pOh, wait a second!\pI forgot to tell you that there are
two kinds of BIKES!\pThey are the MACH BIKE and
the ACRO BIKE!\pThe MACH BIKE is for cyclists who want
to feel the wind with their bodies!\pAnd an ACRO BIKE is for those who
prefer technical rides!\pI'm a real sweetheart, so you can
have whichever one you like!\pWhich one will you choose?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ComeBackToSwi: RYDEL: If you get the urge to switch\nBIKES, just come see me!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_WantToSwitchB: RYDEL: Oh? Were you thinking about\nswitching BIKES?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_IllSwitchBike: RYDEL: Okay, no problem!\nI'll switch BIKES for you!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedMach: {PLAYER} got the MACH BIKE exchanged\nfor an ACRO BIKE.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedAcro: {PLAYER} got the ACRO BIKE exchanged\nfor a MACH BIKE.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HappyYouLikeI: RYDEL: Good, good!\nI'm happy that you like it!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsI:
Oh? What happened to that BIKE
I gave you?\pOh, I get it, you stored it using your PC.\pWell, take it out of PC storage,
and I'll be happy to exchange it!\pMay the wind always be at your back
on your adventure!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HandbooksAreI: I'm learning about BIKES while\nI work here.\pIf you need advice on how to ride your\nBIKE, there're a couple handbooks in\lthe back.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_MachHandbookW: It's a handbook on the MACH BIKE.\pWhich page do you want to read?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMach: A BIKE moves in the direction that\nthe + Control Pad is pressed.\pIt will speed up once it gets rolling.\pTo stop, release the + Control Pad.\nThe BIKE will slow to a stop.\pWant to read a different page?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMach:
A MACH BIKE is speedy, but it can't
stop very quickly.\pIt gets a little tricky to get around
a corner.\pRelease the + Control Pad a little
before the corner and slow down.\pWant to read a different page?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes:
There are small sandy slopes
throughout the HOENN region.\pThe loose, crumbly sand makes it
impossible to climb normally.\pBut if you have a MACH BIKE, you can
zip up a sandy slope.\pWant to read a different page?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_AcroHandbookW: It's a handbook on the ACRO BIKE.\pWhich page do you want to read?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies: Press the B Button while riding,\nand the front wheel lifts up.\pYou can zip around with the front\nwheel up using the + Control Pad.\pThis technique is called a wheelie.\pWant to read a different page?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops: Keeping the B Button pressed,\nyour BIKE can hop on the spot.\pThis technique is called a bunny hop.\pYou can ride while hopping, too.\pWant to read a different page?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_BikeShop/scripts..MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps:
Press the B Button and the + Control
Pad at the same time to jump.\pPress the + Control Pad to the side
to jump sideways.\pPress it backwards to make the BIKE
change directions while jumping.\pWant to read a different page?$

data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCas: Okay, you wanted some COINS for\nthe games?\pBut you don't have a COIN CASE for\nstowing the COINS.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WereYouLook: Were you looking for COINS?\pIt's ¥500 for 50 COINS.\nWould you like some?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThankYouHer: Thank you very much!\nHere are your COINS!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveEno: Um… You don't appear to have\nenough money to buy COINS…\pPlease come back when you have\nat least ¥1000!$
Um… You don't appear to have\nenough money for that many COINS…$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NoRoomFor50: Oh! Your COIN CASE is too full to buy\nany more COINS!\pEnjoy the GOLDENROD GAME CORNER or\nexchange your COINS for prizes before\lcoming back!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NoRoomForCo: Oh?\nYour COIN CASE can't fit those COINS...$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontNeedCoi: Oh… You don't need COINS, then?\nGood luck on your adventure!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThanksBuyCo: Thank you for buying some COINS!\nGood luck on your adventure!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ExchangeCoi: Welcome.\pYou can exchange your COINS for\nprizes here.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SendToYourH: Thank you!\nWe'll send it to your PC at home.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NoRoomForPl: There isn't any room available for\nplacing {STR_VAR_1}.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_OhIsThatSo: Oh, is that so? \nYou need to save some COINS before\lcoming back here.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantCarryAn: Oh, you can't carry any more than that.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_GotTwoOfSam: I made a mistake and got two of\nthe same DOLLS.\pWould you like one of them?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_YouWantItBu: Huh?\nYou want it, but not right now?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontBeNegat: Oh, don't be so negative!\nYou can have this!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantWinJack: There's a prize I want, but I can't win\nthe jackpot.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCas: Hey, kid, if you want to play here,\nyou need a COIN CASE.\pI think the young lady next door\nhad one. Go see her!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_LuckOnlyLas: My luck can only last so long.\nThis is too much for me.\lHere, take some COINS!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_MauvilleSom: MAUVILLE has something for\neveryone.\pFor me, it's the GAME CORNER.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteTab: The ROULETTE tables have different\nrates.\pCheck your COINS if you're going to\npick a table.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_EasyToLoseT: It's easy to lose track of time in here. \nI should get back to work.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinsAreNee: COINS are needed to play here\nin the GAME CORNER.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteOnl: This ROULETTE thing…\nIt's rather demanding.\pWin or lose, it's only by luck.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_UpTo3CoinsC: Up to three COINS can be used to play\nthe SLOTS.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DifficultTo: It's very difficult to make it stop\nright on “7.”\pIf it stops on “7” during the REEL TIME\nbonus game, you'll receive extra COINS.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSl:
Here's some information for you
about the SLOTS.\pThe more lightning bolts you stock,
the more REEL TIME chances you get.\pIn a game with the maximum five
REEL TIME chances…\pIt is possible to receive four regular
bonuses, then a big bonus.\pThat would total 660 COINS, but it's
very difficult to get.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_GameCorner/script.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantPlayWit: You can't play if you don't have\na COIN CASE.$

data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pWATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE
GYM, uses ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.\pIf you challenge him with WATER-type
POKéMON, he'll zap them! Bzzt!\pAnd, he's put in switch-controlled
doors all over his GYM! Eccentric!\pHey, go for it!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictor: Whoa, you're electrifying!\nYou've powered the door open!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro: My electric soul, it'll shatter your\ndreams whole, whoa-yeahah!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat: That was plugged in, amped up,\nover-driven electric, man!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle: POKéMON and rock, it's all about heart,\nwhoa-yeah!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro: I trained under WATTSON!\nThere ain't no way I'll lose easily!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle: WATTSON, our GYM LEADER, has been\naround for a long, long time.\pHe was battling even before your\ndaddy was born, that tough coot.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenIntro: This GYM's got puzzles!\nIsn't it fun?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenPostBattle: WATTSON says he likes setting up\nlittle traps with switches.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianIntro: With my charm and my POKéMON's moves,\nyou'll be shocked!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle: I've heard that MAUVILLE was founded\nby WATTSON.\pHe was a TRAINER long before we\nbecame TRAINERS.\lHe must know all sorts of things!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloPostBattle: MAUVILLE GYM's WATTSON has a shiny\nforehead. It makes me happy!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro:
I've given up on my plans to convert
the city, I have.\pAnd so, I put my time into making
door traps in my GYM.\pOh? Now, what are you doing here?\pWhat's that? You say you've gotten
past all my rigged doors?\pWahahahah!
Now, that is amusing!\pThen, I, WATTSON, the LEADER of
MAUVILLE GYM, shall electrify you!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat: Wahahahah!\nFine, I lost!\pYou ended up giving me a thrill!\nTake this BADGE!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadge:
With the DYNAMO BADGE, POKéMON can
use ROCK SMASH out of battle.\pAnd, it will make your POKéMON a little
bit faster, too.\pHmm…
You should take this, too!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainShockWave: That TM34 there contains SHOCK WAVE.\pIt's a trustworthy move that never\nmisses! You can count on it!\p… … … … … …$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWattson: Registered GYM LEADER WATTSON\nin the POKéNAV.$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostBattle: I swell with optimism, seeing a promising\nyoung TRAINER like you!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM\pWATTSON'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPreRematch: WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last!\nI know what you want.\lYou want to battle my POKéMON!\pWahahahaha!\pI'll make sparks fly from you!\nDon't say I didn't warn you!$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch:
WATTSON: We'll have to recharge our
batteries again.\pWhen we're fully charged up, we'll
gladly accept your challenge.\pSo, come back again sometime,
won't you?$
data/maps/MauvilleCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeed:
WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last!
I know what you want.\lYou want to battle my POKéMON!\pWahahahaha!\pOops! Wait!

data/maps/MelemeleIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginni: My name is SAMSON OAK!\nI'm a POKéMON PROFESSOR.\pWhat's your name?$
Ah, {PLAYER}.\nA fine name!\pYou may know my cousin, PROFESSOR OAK,\nfrom the KANTO region.\pLet me show you to town!$
This is the main town on these islands.\pIt's eerily similar to HAU'OLI CITY in\nALOLA… {PAUSE 30}And when I think about it…\pThis whole island reminds me of MELEMELE\nISLAND…$

Well, anyways!\pI research variations of POKéMON that 
can be found in different regions!\pOn my way back from the ALOLA region,
I stumbled across these isles…\pSurprisingly, many of the POKéMON I saw
in ALOLA were here as well, so I've\lcalled this place… {PAUSE 30}the ALOLA ISLES!$

Now I haven't completely explored the
ISLES yet… {PAUSE 30}I just landed here myself.\pI'd like to know if all of the variants
native to ALOLA are here.\pIf you happen to come across any,
please come by my villa on the east side\lof the ISLE and show them to me!\pOh. And feel free to explore the ISLE
while on your way!\pSee you there!$
