data/maps/MeteorFalls_1F_2R/scripts.inc.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchDefeat: JAY: Oh, dear.\nWe've lost, my dear husband.$
data/maps/MeteorFalls_1F_2R/scripts.inc.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostRematch: JAY: Fifty years of marriage…\nMany things have happened.\pI hope that we will continue to make\nhappy memories together.$
data/maps/MeteorFalls_1F_2R/scripts.inc.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchNotEnou: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young\nTRAINER?\pIf you'd care to battle with us, you'll\nhave to come back with more POKéMON.$

data/maps/MeteorFalls_StevensCave/script.MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowH:
STEVEN: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I'm amazed you knew where to find me.\pDo you, uh…maybe think of me as
just a rock maniac?\pNo, that can't be right.\pWe battled alongside each other at
the SOOTOPOLIS SPACE CENTER.\pYou should have a very good idea
about how good I am.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you're going to mount
a serious challenge, expect the worst!$
data/maps/MeteorFalls_StevensCave/script.MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_StevenDefea: You…\nI had no idea you'd become so strong…$
data/maps/MeteorFalls_StevensCave/script.MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictio:
STEVEN: Come to think of it, ever since
our paths first crossed in GRANITE\lCAVE in DEWFORD, I had this feeling.\pI thought that you would eventually
become the CHAMPION.\pMy predictions usually come true.\pAnd where will you go from here?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pFufufu, even I couldn't tell you that.$

data/maps/MirageTower_4F/scripts.inc.MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeRootFossil: You found the ROOT FOSSIL.\pIf this FOSSIL is taken, the ground\naround it will likely crumble away…\pTake the ROOT FOSSIL anyway?$
data/maps/MirageTower_4F/scripts.inc.MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeClawFossil: You found the CLAW FOSSIL.\pIf this FOSSIL is taken, the ground\naround it will likely crumble away…\pTake the CLAW FOSSIL anyway?$

data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_WantKingsRockStevenGav: I got this from STEVEN, but I don't\nknow what it's good for.\pI think it's called KING'S ROCK.\nDo you want it?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_YouCanKeepIt: Why would you want it?\nYou're weird.\pYou can keep it, but keep it a secret\nfrom STEVEN.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_StevensHouseOverThere: STEVEN's house is right over there!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_WhatToDoWithWeirdRock: Yeah, you think so, too! What are you\nsupposed to do with some weird rock?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching: Around MOSSDEEP, you can see wild\nWAILMER.\pIt's called, uh…\nWhat was it now…\pWAI, WAI, WAI…\pWAILMER watching!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterReceivedLet: The island's SPACE CENTER has been\nlaunching huge rockets.\pThere's been some kind of an uproar\nover a letter they received recently.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterLaunchingRo: The island's SPACE CENTER has been\nlaunching huge rockets.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagm:
I heard from a SAILOR buddy that
TEAM AQUA set up shop in LILYCOVE.\pI also heard that someone came along
and wiped the floor with them!\pBut MOSSDEEP here's been targeted
by that TEAM MAGMA.\pIf you want to know what they're up to,
go visit the SPACE CENTER.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_FeelReliefOnLand: I'm a SAILOR, so the sea's obviously\nmore important to me.\pBut you know? When I get back on land\nafter a long voyage, I do feel relief!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_NiceIfWorldCoveredByFl: Wouldn't it be nice?\pIf the whole world was covered in\nplants and flowers like this island?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive:
All life needs the sea to live, even
though it makes its home on the land.\pLife, having run its course, becomes
soil and returns to the land.\pAnd the sea is always connected to
the land.\pYes, like the very shoreline here.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating: A voyage on a ship is fine.\pBut crossing the sea with POKéMON\nusing SURF…\pNow that's an exhilarating trip!\nWouldn't you agree, youngster?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock:
This rock has a special meaning to
the people at the SPACE CENTER.\pThey put it here as their wish for
their rockets to fly safely.\pWhen you make a wish, what do you use?
Do you wish upon a star?\pI use a wish tag to make it happen.
That's what I do.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_GymSign: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADERS: LIZA & TATE\p“The mystic combination!”$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterSign: MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER\n“The closest place to space.”$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWit:
SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, feeling good?
I'm doing great!\pI'd heard MOSSDEEP's GYM LEADER is
pretty strong, so I decided to come\ltake a look-see for myself.\pBut there's something wrong about
this town.\pPeople are going on about a warning
letter and the SPACE CENTER…\pI don't think it concerns me in any
way, though.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader:
Ahh… It feels great letting the waves
wash over my feet…\pSpeaking of the waves, you know that
island city SOOTOPOLIS?\pI think the GYM there had a new
LEADER come in.\pPeople tell me the new LEADER once
mentored WALLACE.$

data/maps/MossdeepCity_GameCorner_1F/scr.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_OldManGreetin: When I was young, I traveled the world\nas a POKéMON TRAINER.\pNow that I've become an old buzzard,\nmy only amusement is watching young\lTRAINERS battle.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_GameCorner_1F/scr.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_DoorIsLocked: The door appears to be locked.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_GameCorner_1F/scr.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_ChallengeVisi: A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is\nvisiting my home.\pWould you like to challenge\n{STR_VAR_1}?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_GameCorner_1F/scr.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_YouWontBattle: You won't battle? I'm disappointed\nthat I can't see you battle…$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_GameCorner_1F/scr.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_KeepItToA3On3: Oh, good, good!\pBut my house isn't all that sturdy.\pCould I ask you to keep it down to\na 3-on-3 match?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_GameCorner_1F/scr.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_SaveYourProgr: Before you two battle, you should\nsave your progress.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_GameCorner_1F/scr.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_HopeToSeeAGoo: I hope to see a good match!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_GameCorner_1F/scr.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleTie: So, it became a standoff.\pIt was a brilliant match in which\nneither side conceded a step!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_GameCorner_1F/scr.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleWon: That was superlative!\pWhy, it was like seeing myself in\nmy youth again!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_GameCorner_1F/scr.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleLost: Ah, too bad for you!\pBut it was a good match.\nI hope you can win next time.$

data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound
{PLAYER}?\pThe GYM LEADERS here use
PSYCHIC-type POKéMON.\pIf you go up against them with
FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON,\lthey'll inflict horrible damage!\pPlus, they'll come at you with
outstanding combination attacks.\pIf you want to win, you'll need to show
them how tight you are with your\lPOKéMON. Go for it!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictor: Wow, you're astounding!\nYou're one great TRAINER!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro: Battles hinge on the strength of your\nspirit! The weak-spirited will never win!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonDefeat: I lost!\nI must temper my spirit again!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle: The indecisive lose.\nThat's my warning to you.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle: If there are prodigies in the world,\nthen our GYM LEADERS are them!\pHowever, you may be even more talented\nthan them…$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro: Fufufufu… Watch me levitate a POKé\nBALL telekinetically!\pWrooooooooaaaar!\n… … … … … … …\pSometimes, I'm out of sync…$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeDefeat: My POKéMON battling skills are out\nof sync, too!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle:
A POKé BALL was too heavy to lift
psychically. But this dust bunny…\pWhoooooooooooooooh!
… … … … … …\pNo, I'm not cheating!
I didn't blow on it! Honestly!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro: When you lose to me, don't be too hard\non yourself.\pIt's not that you're weak--I'm just\ntoo strong!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle: I'm not going to get down on myself for\nlosing. I just need to train harder.\pPositive thinking--that's my strong\npoint!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro: I see it…\nI see your future…\pIf you can beat me, I will tell you\nyour future!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle: You will wage a terrifically intense\nbattle with our GYM LEADERS…\pThe result…\nYou won't hear it from me!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro: The roads you have traveled…\nWhat you have experienced…\pCome at me with everything you've\nlearned!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraDefeat: You've traveled a path of greatness!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle: A bright future awaits those who have\nworked diligently.\pFor those who lazed idly, there is\nonly despair at the end.\pWhat goes around comes around…$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaIntro: Even at the risk of life, I will win\nthis battle!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle: How dare you beat me…\pIt won't be my fault if something\nhorrible befalls you…$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro: Hohoho.\pYou need me to show you how tenacious\nthe PSYCHIC type can be.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat: Oh! My, my!\nYour battle style is fantastic!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle: I… I don't let defeat rattle m-me,\nhowever b-badly.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenIntro: Let me show you a perfectly awful,\nhorrifying time!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenPostBattle: Your vitality is contagious!\nGet away from me quickly!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordIntro: I may be past my prime, but I suggest\nyou not patronize me.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordDefeat: Ah, you overflow with the power\nof youth!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordPostBattle: It seems that I could not overcome\nyour youthful energy.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyIntro: You're not getting through to the end!\nNot if I can help it!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyDefeat: How could you be so ludicrously\nstrong?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyPostBattle: Humph! You may be strong, but you're\nnot suitable for the PSYCHIC type!\pThe way you battle is somehow brutal!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasIntro: Wroooar! Have a taste of my super\nPOKéMON hard-battling power!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasPostBattle: All right! I think I'll develop a special\ninvincible POKéMON power next.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro:
TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?\pLIZA: Fufufu… Were you surprised?\pTATE: That there are two GYM LEADERS?
LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?\pTATE: We're twins!
LIZA: We're twins!\pTATE: We don't need to talk because…
LIZA: We can each determine what…\pTATE: The other is thinking…
LIZA: All in our minds!\pTATE: This combination of ours…
LIZA: Can you beat it?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaDefeat: TATE: What?! Our combination…\nLIZA: Was shattered!\pTATE: It can't be helped. You've won…\nLIZA: So, in recognition, take this.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMindBadge: {PLAYER} received the MIND BADGE\nfrom TATE and LIZA.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTa: TATE: The MIND BADGE enhances the\nSP. ATK and SP. DEF of POKéMON.\pLIZA: It also lets you use the HM move\nDIVE outside of battle.\pTATE: You should also take this, too.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCalmMind:
TATE: That TM04 contains…
LIZA: CALM MIND!\pTATE: It raises SP. ATK and…
LIZA: It raises SP. DEF!\pTATE: It's a move that's perfect…
LIZA: For PSYCHIC POKéMON!\p… … … … … …$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredTateAndL: Registered GYM LEADERS TATE & LIZA\nin the POKéNAV.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostBat: TATE: Looks like the bond between you\nand your POKéMON is far stronger than\lthe bond that we share as twins.\pLIZA: You will become even stronger!\nWe've battled you, so we know.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaNeedTwo: TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?\pLIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?\pTATE: Oops, you have only one…\nLIZA: POKéMON that can battle.\pTATE: We can't battle that way!\pLIZA: If you want to challenge us,\nbring some more POKéMON.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM\pLIZA AND TATE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPreRema:
TATE: POKéMON…
LIZA: POKéMON…\pTATE: By changing the party's mix…
LIZA: The battle style changes.\pTATE: But me…
LIZA: But me…\pTATE: I'll always be with LIZA!
LIZA: I'll always be with TATE!\pTATE: Our combination…
LIZA: We'll show you again and again!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematch: TATE: You and your POKéMON…\nLIZA: It's as if you were siblings!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostRem: TATE: You can knock us down,\nbut we'll never stay down!\pLIZA: Because the two of us,\nwe always support each other!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Gym/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematch:
TATE: You're back again…
LIZA: You're back again…\pTATE: To give us a rematch.
LIZA: To give us a rematch.\pTATE: But…
LIZA: For our match…\pTATE: You brought just one POKéMON!
LIZA: You brought just one POKéMON!\pTATE: We need you to bring at least…
LIZA: Two POKéMON when you come back.$

data/maps/MossdeepCity_House1/scripts.in.MossdeepCity_House1_Text_ItLikesXPokeblo: It likes {STR_VAR_1}S,\ndoesn't it?\pNo, I'm positive of it! It definitely\nlikes {STR_VAR_1}S!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_House1/scripts.in.MossdeepCity_House1_Text_DoesntLikeOrDis: It doesn't appear to like or dislike\nany ポロックS.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_House1/scripts.in.MossdeepCity_House1_Text_HusbandCanTellP: My husband can tell what kind of\nポロックS a POKéMON likes at a glance.$

data/maps/MossdeepCity_House2/scripts.in.MossdeepCity_House2_Text_SisterMailsBoyf: My little sister exchanges MAIL with\nher boyfriend in FORTREE.\pI don't envy her one bit at all.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_House2/scripts.in.MossdeepCity_House2_Text_PokemonCarriesM: Even though I can't see my friend in\nFORTREE, my POKéMON carries MAIL\lback and forth for us.\pI'm not lonesome, even though we're\napart.$

data/maps/MossdeepCity_House3/scripts.in.MossdeepCity_House3_Text_YouWantSuperRod:
Hey there, TRAINER!
A SUPER ROD really is super!\pSay all you want, but this baby can
catch POKéMON off the seafloor!\pWhat do you think?
You want it, don't you?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_House3/scripts.in.MossdeepCity_House3_Text_SuperRodIsSuper: You bet, you bet!\nAfter all, a SUPER ROD is really super!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_House3/scripts.in.MossdeepCity_House3_Text_TryDroppingRodI: If there's any water, try dropping in\nyour ROD and see what bites!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_House3/scripts.in.MossdeepCity_House3_Text_GoAfterSeafloor: Go after the seafloor POKéMON with\nyour SUPER ROD.$

data/maps/MossdeepCity_House4/scripts.in.MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToF: My little brother says he likes to go\nfind people's SECRET BASES.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_House4/scripts.in.MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToV: My little brother says he likes to\nvisit people's SECRET BASES and have\lPOKéMON battles.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_House4/scripts.in.MossdeepCity_House4_Text_YouMadeSecretBa: Was it you who made a SECRET BASE\nnear {STR_VAR_1}?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_House4/scripts.in.MossdeepCity_House4_Text_MakeSecretBase: You should make a SECRET BASE\nsomewhere. I'll go find it!$

data/maps/MossdeepCity_Mart/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsFantastic: REVIVE is fantastic!\pGive it to a fainted POKéMON,\nand the POKéMON will arise.\pBut be careful, REVIVE doesn't restore\nthe used-up PP of moves.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Mart/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelLastsLong: MAX REPEL keeps all weak POKéMON away.\pOut of all the REPEL sprays, it lasts\nthe longest.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_Mart/scripts.inc.MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_NetAndDiveBallsRa:
The NET and DIVE BALLS are rare POKé
BALLS that are only made in MOSSDEEP.\pA NET BALL is effective against
BUG-type and WATER-type POKéMON.\pA DIVE BALL works best on POKéMON
at the bottom of the sea.$

data/maps/MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F/.MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GymLe: The GYM LEADERS in this town are\na formidable duo.\pTheir combination attacks are, like,\nexcellent and wow!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F/.MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Abili: Depending on the special abilities of\nPOKéMON, some moves might change\lor not work at all.$

data/maps/MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_2F/.MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Woman: If I win a whole lot of link battles\nand show everyone how good I am,\lI might get a fan following!$

data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Success: The rocket launched safely!\nThat's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Haywire: I know that things are a little\nhaywire right now, but…\pThe rocket's launch is imminent!$
I know that things are a little\nhaywire right now, but…\pThe rocket launched safely!\nThat's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketL:
A rocket launch demands perfection.
Not even a 1% margin of error is allowed.\pEven if it's 99% okay, the whole thing
is useless if 1% happens to be no good.\pDespite that, we never stop trying.
Why? It's a dream that never ends.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaHa: Those MAGMA thugs have their sights\nset on our SPACE CENTER.\pBut we can't allow anything that minor\nto interfere with our rocket launch!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_FoundTh: I was taking a stroll down the beach\nwhen I found this.\pIt's not anything I need, so you can\nhave it.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HoennFa: The HOENN region has been famous for \nits meteor showers for a long time.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaCa: TEAM MAGMA can't be allowed to steal\nthe rocket fuel.\pOh, by the way, you can have this stone\nI found on the beach.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_CantStr: With TEAM MAGMA around, I guess\nstrolls on the beach aren't safe.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_DidPoke: Some people claim that POKéMON came\nfrom space. Could it be true?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_AquaSho: TEAM AQUA should take care of\nTEAM MAGMA!\pBut if they did that, TEAM AQUA will\nbecome bold and brazen, won't they?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Rockets: A giant chunk of metal bursts through\nthe skies and flies into space…\pIt boggles my mind!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWa: A giant chunk of metal bursts through\nthe skies and flies into space…\pBut TEAM MAGMA wants to spoil\nthat dream of mine!\pI'm not having any of that!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenM:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, have you read that
proclamation already?\pTEAM MAGMA is coming after the rocket
fuel on this island.\pI don't know what they'd need it for,
but they can't be allowed to take it.\pI'll keep an eye on things for
a while longer.\pIn the meantime, why don't you go
check out the town?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3I: As promised, we've come for\nthe rocket fuel!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3P: Don't think you're on a roll just\nbecause you've beaten me!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1I: We gave you fair warning!\nThere's nothing sneaky about us!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1P: Okay, I get it already! The next time,\nwe'll come unannounced.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4I: The rocket fuel the SPACE CENTER has\nin storage--that's what we're after.\pWe mean to take every last bit of it!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4D: Please, can you spare some fuel?\nEven a chintzy cup will do!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4P: What are we going to do with\nthe rocket fuel?\pHow would I know?\nAsk our leader upstairs!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2I: Our leader said no one, but no one,\ngets past me!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2P: Please, tell our leader that\nI never abandoned my post.\lThat I stayed to the bitter end…$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIn:
This is…
An intent-to-steal notice?\p“To the staff of the SPACE CENTER:
How are you? We are doing fine.\p“We will soon visit you to take your
rocket fuel.\p“Please don't try to stop us.
We will take the fuel no matter what.\p“Let there be more land!
                                          TEAM MAGMA”$

data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Mossdee: MOSSDEEP has mainly sunny weather,\nand its winds are stable.\pIt's an ideal location for launching\nrockets.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WhyWoul: Why would TEAM MAGMA want to steal\nour rocket fuel in the first place?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Wouldve: If only I was a little younger, I would\nhave liked being an astronaut…\pNo… It's not too late!\nI can and will try!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MagmaCa: If TEAM MAGMA takes the rocket fuel,\nI won't be able to go to space!\pThey can't be allowed to get away\nwith such an outrage!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WishOrd: I wish ordinary people could go into\nspace one day…$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_DoesMag: TEAM MAGMA…\nDo they want to go to space, too?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_YoureOu: What's wrong with you?\pYou're outnumbered three to one,\nbut you still want to take us on?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_GoodAns: Good answer!\nThat's what a smart person'll do!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5I: A reckless go-getter, are you?\nOkay, I'll go first!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6I: It's too soon to be relieved!\nI'm up next!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7I: I bet you want to take a break.\nBut I'm not about to let you do that!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7D: We should've taken a break…\nThat's what we should've done…$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6P: Three of us here, and look at the sorry\nmess we got ourselves into.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7P: We three losing like this…\nWe look worse than usual by triple!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5P: Are we being useful to our leader\nat all?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WellTak: Hehehe!\pWe come all the way here to get some\nfuel, and we're interfered with again!\pIf you're going to mess with us too,\nwe'll take care of you at the same time!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieDo: MAXIE: Clear out of the way!\nDon't you dare interfere!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenW: STEVEN: TEAM MAGMA…\pWhat's the point of stealing rocket\nfuel?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieUs:
MAXIE: Fufufu… Since you're so
curious, you deserve an explanation.\pWe're going to jettison the entire
load into MT. CHIMNEY!\pWith GROUDON gone, we have no need
for that slag heap of a mountain!\pSo we'll use the fuel's power to make
the volcano erupt!\pIt will be savage!$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenA: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nYou're going to help me?\pLet's go into battle together!\nAre you ready?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_JustWan: All I want…\nI just want to expand the land mass…$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWe:
MAXIE: We failed to make the volcano
erupt…\pWe failed to control GROUDON after
we had awoken it…\pIs our goal to expand the land
misguided?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pIf…
If we, TEAM MAGMA, are wrong…\l… … … … … …\pThen might TEAM AQUA's goal to expand
the sea also be equally misguided?$
MAXIE: All right…\nWe will give up on the fuel…\pThere appear to be more important\nmatters that I must examine…$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F/sc.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenT:
STEVEN: Whew, that was too tense.
{PLAYER}{KUN}, thank you.\pI have something to give you as
thanks for your support.\pPlease come see me at home
after this.\pOh, yes, I don't live in RUSTBORO CITY.
I live right here on this island.$

data/maps/MossdeepCity_StevensHouse/scri.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarn:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pAs you can see, there's not much here,
but this is my home.\pThank you for all that you've done.\pThis is my token of appreciation.
It's the HIDDEN MACHINE DIVE.\pNo need to be shy--you've earned
this HM.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_StevensHouse/scri.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDi:
STEVEN: While you're using SURF, you
should notice dark patches of water.\pUse DIVE if you come to deep water
like it. You'll drop to the seafloor.\pWhen you want to come back up, use
DIVE again.\pIn some places, it won't be possible
for you to surface, though.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_StevensHouse/scri.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_Underwate: STEVEN: Apparently, there's an\nunderwater cavern between\lMOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.\pYou know, the one that CAPT. STERN\nfound in his submarine.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_StevensHouse/scri.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_TakeBallC: {PLAYER} checked the POKé BALL.\pIt contained the POKéMON\nBELDUM.\pTake the POKé BALL?$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_StevensHouse/scri.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_NoSpaceFo: There is no space for another POKéMON.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_StevensHouse/scri.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LeftPokeB: {PLAYER} left the POKé BALL where\nit was.$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_StevensHouse/scri.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFro:
It's a letter.\p… … … … … …\pTo {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pI've decided to do a little soul-
searching and train on the road.\pI don't plan to return home for some
time.\pI have a favor to ask of you.\pI want you to take the POKé BALL on
the desk.\pInside it is a BELDUM, my favorite
POKéMON.\pI'm counting on you.\pMay our paths cross someday.\pSTEVEN STONE$
data/maps/MossdeepCity_StevensHouse/scri.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_Collectio: It's a collection of rare rocks and\nstones assembled by STEVEN.$

data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteWillActivateVolc: The power contained in the METEORITE…\pBy amplifying its power with this\nmachine, MT. CHIMNEY's volcanic\lactivity will instantly intensify…\pIts energy will grow deep inside\nthe crater and…\lFufufu…$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro:
MAXIE: Hm?
Who are you?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pI'd heard ARCHIE bemoaning a child
who's been meddling in TEAM AQUA's\laffairs.\pIt must be you he meant.\pHumph! So you're thinking of
interfering with us, TEAM MAGMA?\pNow you listen.
Long ago, living things used the\lland to live and grow.\pThat is why land is all important!
It is the cradle of all!\pThat is why TEAM MAGMA is dedicated
to the expansion of the land mass.\pIt is for further advancement of
humankind and POKéMON!\pAnd for that, we need the power of
what sleeps within this mountain…\pOh! There was no need for you to
learn that much.\pBut, no matter!
I'll teach you the consequences of\lmeddling in our grand design!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_MaxieDefeat: What?!\pI, MAXIE, was caught off guard?!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfM:
MAXIE: But, enough.
I will back off this time.\pBut don't think that this is the last
you've seen of TEAM MAGMA.\pFufufu…\pEven without the METEORITE, if we
obtain that ORB… Fufufu…$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_TabithaIntro: Hehehe!\pSo you've come all the way here!\pBut you're too late!\nI've already delivered the METEORITE\lfrom METEOR FALLS to the BOSS!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_TabithaDefeat: Hehehe…\pEven though I've lost, if our leader\nawakens that thing…$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_TabithaPostBattle: BOSS, hurry!\nGive it the METEORITE's energy!\pHehehe…$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Intro: We of TEAM MAGMA are working hard for\neveryone's sake.\pLike, if that thing's power made more\nland, there'd be more places to live.\pEveryone'd be happy!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Defeat: Hunh?\nWhat do you mean I lost?$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: Our BOSS says, “It will make everyone\nhappy.”\pBut why does everyone keep getting\nin our way?$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Intro: If there were more land, I'd be able\nto get a big house of my own!\pI'm going to build it on hardened lava!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Defeat: My dream of a big house…$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: A kid like you, you ought to be\nsplashing about in the waves!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_TeamAquaAlwaysMessingWith: That annoying TEAM AQUA…\nThey always mess with our plans!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_YouBetterNotMessWithUs: You'd better not mess with us!\pWe're trying to awaken that thing\nfor the benefit of everyone!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_AquasNameSimilar: We're TEAM MAGMA!\pThey're TEAM AQUA!\pIt totally annoys me that they'd\nuse a name like ours!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_KeepMakingMoreLand: We're going to keep making more land!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma:
ARCHIE: Grr, {PLAYER}!
I should've guessed you'd show up!\pSee for yourself what the fanatics
of TEAM MAGMA are up to!\pThey're trying to inject the stolen
METEORITE's power into the volcano!\pDoing something like that will cause
the volcano's eruption!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_ArchieIHaveMyHandsFull: ARCHIE: Grrr…\pI want to stop that MAXIE,\nbut I can't!\pNot when I have my hands full battling\nthree opponents at once!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou:
ARCHIE: {PLAYER}!
Thank you!\pWith your help, we thwarted TEAM
MAGMA's destructive plan!\pBut… You…
Whose side are you on?\pAh, it doesn't matter.\pWe will remain vigilant and keep up
our pursuit of TEAM MAGMA.\p{PLAYER}, we shall meet again!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_MagmaOutnumbersUs: Darn… TEAM MAGMA outnumbers us!\nWe can't keep up with them!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_LessHabitatForWaterPokemo: If they expand the land, there'll be\nless habitats for WATER POKéMON!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_MagmasNameSimilar: We're TEAM AQUA!\pThey're TEAM MAGMA!\pIt burns me up that they'd use such\na confusing name!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_LavaCookiesJust200: LAVA COOKIES are MT. CHIMNEY's local\nspecialty.\pTry one. It's just ¥200.$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_YouveNotGotTheMoney: Oh, dear. You can't buy a thing if\nyou've not got the money.$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_MetoriteFittedOnMachine: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine…\pThe machine seems to be storing\nenergy in the METEORITE.$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_RemoveTheMeteorite: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine…\pDo you want to remove the METEORITE?$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_PlayerRemovedMeteorite: {PLAYER} removed the METEORITE from\nthe mysterious machine.$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_MachineMakesNoResponse: This mysterious machine…\nIt makes no response whatsoever.$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_ShelbyIntro: I've been to the hot springs and\nrefreshed my tired bones.\lRight now I'm feeling strong!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_ShelbyDefeat: Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren't you something!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostBattle: Well, well, I've lost. I can't call\nmyself an EXPERT now, can I?$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRegister: Thank you, child. It was fun, as if\nI were battling my own grandchild.\pPlease, come see me again for\na rematch.$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchIntro: If you can mesh your heart with those\nof your POKéMON, why, you should be\lable to achieve great things.$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchDefeat: Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren't you something!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostRematch: Perhaps your heart has become one\nwith the hearts of your POKéMON.$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_MelissaIntro: I've got the fire in me, baby.\nI can't stand it! I have to battle!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_MelissaDefeat: Ooh, that was a scorching-hot match!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_MelissaPostBattle: The heat of MT. CHIMNEY warms\nme up, baby!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_SheilaIntro: I've finally made it to MT. CHIMNEY.\nI want to make my POKéMON battle!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_SheilaDefeat: The way you battle…\nIt's like a MT. CHIMNEY eruption!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_SheilaPostBattle: Like I said, I've finally made it to\nMT. CHIMNEY. It would be a shame if\lI only do a little sightseeing…\pI want to get in some battles and buy\nCOOKIES as souvenirs.$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_ShirleyIntro: Since I bathed in the hot springs,\nI've been feeling great!\lI'm sure I'm going to win!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_ShirleyDefeat: Yowch!\nI'm getting a chill out of the water.$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_ShirleyPostBattle: I'll have to take another dip in the\nhot springs. Want to join me?\pJust joking!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_SawyerIntro: This is one fine mountain! Plenty of\nhot people around for company!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_SawyerDefeat: Oh, you're a real firebrand, too!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostBattle: I think I need a dip in LAVARIDGE\nHOT SPRING with the locals!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_SawyerRegister: I like little fireballs like you.\nLet me register you in my POKéNAV.$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchIntro: I'm happily surrounded by hot people\naround these parts. I won't lose!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchDefeat: Gosh, you're still the same\nfirebrand as before!$
data/maps/MtChimney/scripts.inc.MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostRematch: Actually, it really is hot here.\nI'm overdressed for these parts.$

data/maps/MtChimney_CableCarStation/scri.MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarR: The CABLE CAR is ready to go down.\nWould you like to be on it?$
data/maps/MtChimney_CableCarStation/scri.MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnoth: Please ride with us another time.$

data/maps/MtMoon_Cave_hns/scripts.inc.MtMoon_Cave_Text_Rival_Before: ..................................\pIt's been a while, {PLAYER}.\p…Since I lost to you, I thought about\nwhat I was lacking with my POKéMON…\pAnd we came up with an answer.\p{PLAYER}, now we'll show you!$
data/maps/MtMoon_Cave_hns/scripts.inc.MtMoon_Cave_Text_Rival_Win: ..................................\pI thought I raised my POKéMON to be the\nbest they could be…\p…But it still wasn't enough…$
data/maps/MtMoon_Cave_hns/scripts.inc.MtMoon_Cave_Text_Rival_After: ..................................\p…You won, fair and square.\pI admit it. But this isn't the end.\pI'm going to be the greatest POKéMON\ntrainer ever.\pBecause these guys are behind me.\p…Listen, {PLAYER}.\pOne of these days I'm going to prove\nhow good I am by beating you.$
data/maps/MtMoon_Cave_hns/scripts.inc.MtMoon_Cave_Text_Rival_Loss: ..................................\pI've repaid my debt to you.\pWith my POKéMON, I'm going to beat the\nCHAMPION and become the world's greatest\ntrainer.$

data/maps/MtMoon_Outside_hns/scripts.inc.MtMoon_Outside_Text_WhiteRockTouchIt: An unusual white rock.\nThe color reminds you of the moon.\pTouch it?$

data/maps/MtMoon_Shop_hns/scripts.inc.MtMoon_Shop_Text_GiftShopLass: When the sun goes down, CLEFAIRY\ncome out to play.$

data/maps/MtMortar_1F_North_hns/scripts..MountMortar2_Text_PokemaniacMillerAfter:
A while back, this karate dude
wanted to battle.\pHe was ridiculously good.
He just thrashed us silly.\pHe went in deeper saying it
was for his training.\pI wonder how he is?$
data/maps/MtMortar_1F_North_hns/scripts..MountMortar2_Text_SupernerdMarkusAfter: I came to explore MT.MORTAR,\nbut I got separated from my\lpartner…\pDid you run into a trainer\nwho uses a SEADRA that knows\lWATERFALL?$

data/maps/MtMortar_2F_hns/scripts.inc.MtMortar_2F_Text_SupernerdHughAfter: I'm investigating MT.MORTAR,\nbut my pal's gone AWOL.\pHave you seen a trainer who\nhas a SLOWPOKE that can use\lSTRENGTH?$

data/maps/MtMortar_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.MountMortar4_Text_KiyoIntro: Hey!\pI am the KARATE KING!\nI train alone here in the dark!\pYou! Battle with me!\nHwaaarggh!$
data/maps/MtMortar_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.MountMortar4_Text_KiyoTyrogueReward:
I... I'm crushed...\pMy training is still not
enough...\pBut a loss is a loss.
I admit it.\pAs proof that you defeated me,
I'll give you a rare fighting\lPOKéMON.$
data/maps/MtMortar_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.MountMortar4_Text_KiyoGotTyrogue: TYROGUE is a FIGHTING-type.\pIt evolves into a tougher\nPOKéMON.\pKeep up the hard work.\nI'll keep training too.\pFarewell!$
data/maps/MtMortar_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.MountMortar4_Text_KiyoFullParty: You have no room in your party!$

data/maps/MtPyre_1F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_1F_Text_TakeThisForYourOwnGood: All sorts of beings wander the slopes\nof MT. PYRE…\pThere is no telling what may happen.\nTake this. It's for your own good.$
data/maps/MtPyre_1F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_1F_Text_ExplainCleanseTag: Have a POKéMON hold that\nCLEANSE TAG.\pIt will help ward off wild POKéMON.$
data/maps/MtPyre_1F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespects: Did you come to pay your respect\nto the spirits of departed POKéMON?\pYou must care for your POKéMON a lot.$
data/maps/MtPyre_1F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_1F_Text_RestingPlaceOfZigzagoon: This is the final resting place of my\nZIGZAGOON. I cherished it…$

data/maps/MtPyre_2F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_2F_Text_MemoriesOfSkitty: Memories of my darling SKITTY…\nMy eyes overflow thinking about it.$
data/maps/MtPyre_2F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_2F_Text_TumbledFromFloorAbove: Ooch, ouch… There are holes in the\nground here and there.\pI didn't notice and took a tumble from\nthe floor above.$
data/maps/MtPyre_2F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkIntro: Hey! Are you searching for POKéMON?\nYou came along after me! You're rude!$
data/maps/MtPyre_2F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkPostBattle: People don't come here often, so\nI thought there'd be rare POKéMON.$
data/maps/MtPyre_2F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeIntro: LUKE: We're here on a dare.\pHeheh, if I show her how cool I am,\nshe'll fall for me. I know it!\pI know! I'll cream you and show her\nhow cool I am!$
data/maps/MtPyre_2F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_2F_Text_LukePostBattle: LUKE: Well, we lost but that's okay!\nI'm right here by your side.\lWe'll make it through this dare!$
data/maps/MtPyre_2F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeNotEnoughMons: LUKE: If you want to take me on,\nbring some more POKéMON.\pIf you don't, I won't be able to show\noff to my girl how cool I am!$
data/maps/MtPyre_2F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_2F_Text_DezIntro:
DEZ: I came here on a dare with my
boyfriend.\pIt's really scary, but I'm with my
boyfriend. It's okay.\pI know! I'll get my boyfriend to look
cool by beating you!$
data/maps/MtPyre_2F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_2F_Text_DezPostBattle: DEZ: We're lovey-dovey, so we don't\ncare if we lose!$
data/maps/MtPyre_2F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_2F_Text_DezNotEnoughMons: DEZ: If you want to challenge us, you\nshould bring at least two POKéMON.\pMy boyfriend's strong.\nJust one POKéMON won't do at all.$
data/maps/MtPyre_2F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahIntro: You are an unfamiliar sight…\nDepart before anything befalls you!$
data/maps/MtPyre_2F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahPostBattle: Our family has been TRAINERS here\nsince my great-grandmother's time…\pIt is my duty to protect this\nmountain…$
data/maps/MtPyre_2F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderPostBattle: I get freaked out every time I see\nanything move…\pI shouldn't have come here to train…$

data/maps/MtPyre_3F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamIntro: The rich atmosphere of the mountain\nhas elevated my psychic power!\pA mere child like you…\nYou dream of winning?$
data/maps/MtPyre_3F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamPostBattle: My psychic powers have surely\ngrown several times, but…$
data/maps/MtPyre_3F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaIntro: Ahahahaha!\pThis is no place for children, least\nof all you!$
data/maps/MtPyre_3F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle: This means my training is still not\nenough…\pI've got to keep working toward the\nsummit…\pGo, me!$
data/maps/MtPyre_3F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleDefeat: That was amazing!\nYou're a very special TRAINER.$
data/maps/MtPyre_3F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle:
POKéMON no longer of this world.
POKéMON that are with you now.\pAnd the POKéMON that you will meet
in the future…\pThey are all to be equally cherished.
Please remember that.$
data/maps/MtPyre_3F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRegister: I would like to see your POKéMON\nwhen they grow up some more…\pPlease, I need to see your POKéNAV.$
data/maps/MtPyre_3F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchIntro: Oh, it's you…\pHave you come to show me your grown\nPOKéMON?$
data/maps/MtPyre_3F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchDefeat: How amazing!\nYou are a special person.$
data/maps/MtPyre_3F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch:
POKéMON no longer of this world.
POKéMON that are with you now.\pAnd the POKéMON that you will meet
in the future…\pThey are all to be equally cherished.
I see that you've remembered that.$

data/maps/MtPyre_4F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiPostBattle: Until I improve, my teacher, who rests\nhere, will never find true peace…$

data/maps/MtPyre_5F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaIntro: I love all things horrifying…\nIt's like a disease…\pWhen I'm here…\nI shiver with fear…$
data/maps/MtPyre_5F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaPostBattle: I want to see dreadful things…\nI can't leave…\pStay…\nWon't you stay with me?$

data/maps/MtPyre_6F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieIntro: When I'm here…\nA curious power flows into me…$
data/maps/MtPyre_6F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostBattle: Perhaps the power is from the spirits\nof POKéMON in fitful sleep here…$
data/maps/MtPyre_6F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRegister: Fufufu… I lost the match, but…\nI have this little ability…\pWithout ever laying my hands on\nyour POKéNAV… Hiyah!$
data/maps/MtPyre_6F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostRematch: The POKéMON at rest here…\nSometimes, they play…$
data/maps/MtPyre_6F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricIntro: Have you lost your bearings?\nHave no fear for I am here!$
data/maps/MtPyre_6F/scripts.inc.MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricPostBattle: I had this feeling that a lost TRAINER\nwould be panicked and easy to beat.\pIt's dirty and I won't try it again…$

data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Intro: No! Those TEAM MAGMA goons got\nhere ahead of us!\pWe can't fall behind!$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Defeat: I thought you were one of the MAGMAS\nwho happened to come back…$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: Yeah, so you are strong…\nBut there're a lot of us!$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Intro:
Hah!
Too bad for you!\pIf you came earlier, you only would've
had to battle the wimpy TEAM MAGMA.\pBut since you arrived now, you have
to take on us toughies!$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Defeat: Urgh… I should've let you take on\nTEAM MAGMA first…$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: You don't know anything!\nSo why are you messing with us?$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Intro: You…\nWe saw you at MT. CHIMNEY.\pYou don't belong to either TEAM,\nso why would you be here?$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Defeat: If you're going to mess with anyone,\nlet it be TEAM MAGMA…$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3PostBattle: Heh, it doesn't matter!\nWe bought ourselves some time!\pThe BOSS should have snatched what\nhe was after!$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Intro: Oh, I know!\nYou tried to join TEAM MAGMA,\lbut they wouldn't have you!\pWell, don't think that we'll let you\njoin our TEAM AQUA!$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Defeat: If you want to join TEAM AQUA that\nbadly, we can consider it…$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4PostBattle: We have a great combination going\nwith us members and our leader.$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_ArchieWeGotTheOrbLets:
ARCHIE: TEAM MAGMA's MAXIE got ahead
of us, but we also got what we wanted.\pThe RED ORB preserved at MT. PYRE…
I, ARCHIE, now have it in my possession!\pFufufu… Now we can bring our ultimate
objective to fruition!\pOkay, TEAM!
We're pulling out!$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLef:
Oh, no…
This cannot happen…\pNot only the BLUE ORB, but even
the RED ORB has been taken…\pThe BLUE ORB and RED ORB must never
be separated. They belong together.\pWhat are those men trying to do with
the two ORBS?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pOh, yes. Was it TEAM MAGMA who came
and took the BLUE ORB first?\pWell, in their haste, they left this
behind.\pI couldn't imagine what exactly it
could be.\pI would like you to have it.
Perhaps it will be useful in some way.$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_OrbsHaveBeenTaken: The BLUE ORB and RED ORB taken by\nthose sinister men…\pThey must never be apart…\nI fear something terrible will happen…$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened:
Oh, my goodness…\pYou say that both GROUDON and KYOGRE
have been awakened?\pIt is said that the BLUE ORB and
the RED ORB quelled the rage of\lthe two POKéMON…\pIt is also said that the true owner
of the ORBS still exists.\pHowever, no one knows who, or what
exactly, the ORBS belong to.\pIt could be a human, or perhaps
a POKéMON, but no one knows.$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_ThoseTwoMenReturnedOr: The two men who took the ORBS came\nback to return them on their own.\pThose men…\nPerhaps they are not so evil after all…$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_SuperAncientPokemonTa:
The embodiments of the land, sea,
and the sky…\pThat is said to be the identities of
the super-ancient POKéMON…\pIn the same way that we humans and
POKéMON have life, our world, too,\lis alive…\pThe super-ancient POKéMON have
taught us that…$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_WillYouHearOutMyTale:
MT. PYRE is where we calm the spirits
of POKéMON that have passed on…\pThis is a high place where one can
see all of HOENN…\pThe disembodied spirits of POKéMON
must find solace here…\pIs it coincidence that you are here…\pWill you hear out my tale? A tale long
told in the HOENN region?$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale:
It happened long, long ago…\pThe world was wracked by a ferocious
clash between the POKéMON of the land\land the POKéMON of the sea…\pThe POKéMON of the land raised
mountains and created continents…\pThe POKéMON of the sea raised huge
waves and carved out oceans…\pTheir fierce duel raged without end.\pThe world was engulfed in massive
infernos and vicious storms.\pThe BLUE ORB and the RED ORB brought
an end to the calamity.\pLight poured from the two ORBS and
becalmed the enraged adversaries.\pThe pair, made docile, dove deep into
the sea where eventually they\ldisappeared…$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_WellThatTooIsFine: I see…\nWell, that, too, is fine…$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_HearTheNewLegendOfHoe:
It is my role to pass on the legends
of HOENN to future generations.\pAnd the crisis that just ended in
SOOTOPOLIS rewrote a legend…\pHave you the time to hear the new
legend of HOENN?$
data/maps/MtPyre_Summit/scripts.inc.MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale:
It happened long, long ago…\pThe world was wracked by a ferocious
clash between the POKéMON of the land\land the POKéMON of the sea…\pThe POKéMON of the land raised
mountains and created continents…\pThe POKéMON of the sea raised huge
waves and carved out oceans…\pTheir fierce duel raged without end.\pThe world was engulfed in massive
fires and vicious storms.\pIt was then that the POKéMON of
the sky descended from a storm.\pThe POKéMON, shining a vivid green,
becalmed the two enraged POKéMON.\pThen, its duty done, the green POKéMON
flew off into the wild blue yonder…$

data/maps/MtSilver_1F_WaterfallRoom_hns/.MtSilver_1F_WaterfallRoom_Text_Scientist: This is the entrance to the\nunexplored branch... {PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}\pDoes it feel cold here to you?\pOkay, I'm going to leave now.\pGood luck!$

data/maps/MtSilver_PokemonCenter_hns/scr.MtSilver_PokemonCenter_Text_Meara1:
I'm a researcher from... Uhh...
the PEWTER CITY museum!\pAn unusual amount of artifacts have
been discovered in this area, so\lI've come here to investigate.\pHave you found anything strange
in the mountain?\pMaybe something like a FLUTE?\pIf you do, please show me.$
data/maps/MtSilver_PokemonCenter_hns/scr.MtSilver_PokemonCenter_Text_Meara2:
That flute!\pYou have the spirit of a true
archaeologist!\pThere's a branch of the cave
where the POKéMON are too strong\lfor me to safely explore.\pIf I take you there, would you
explore it for more artifacts?$
data/maps/MtSilver_PokemonCenter_hns/scr.MtSilver_PokemonCenter_Text_Prompt: If I take you there, would you\nexplore it for more artifacts?$
data/maps/MtSilver_PokemonCenter_hns/scr.MtSilver_PokemonCenter_Text_Meara3: Ready to search for more artifacts?$

data/maps/NationalPark_BugContest_hns/sc.NationalParkBugContest_Text_Attendant: ATTENDANT: Would you like to end\nthe contest?$
data/maps/NationalPark_BugContest_hns/sc.NationalParkBugContest_Text_ContestantBe: BELINDA: I'm going to win!\nDon't bother me.$
data/maps/NationalPark_BugContest_hns/sc.NationalParkBugContest_Text_Contestant2A: ED: My PARASECT puts POKéMON to\nsleep with SPORE.$
data/maps/NationalPark_BugContest_hns/sc.NationalParkBugContest_Text_ContestantSh: SHAUN: I'm not concerned about\nwinning.\pI'm just looking for rare POKéMON.$
data/maps/NationalPark_BugContest_hns/sc.NationalParkBugContest_Text_Contestant6A: BARRY: You should weaken bug\nPOKéMON first,\pthen throw a BALL.$
data/maps/NationalPark_BugContest_hns/sc.NationalParkBugContest_Text_Contestant7A: CINDY: I love bug POKéMON.\pI guess you must like them too.$
data/maps/NationalPark_BugContest_hns/sc.NationalParkBugContest_Text_Contestant8A: JOSH: I've been collecting bug\nPOKéMON since I was just a baby.\pThere's no way I'm going to lose!$
data/maps/NationalPark_BugContest_hns/sc.NationalParkBugContest_Text_Contestant9A: SAMUEL: If you've got the time to\nchat, go find some bug POKéMON.$
data/maps/NationalPark_BugContest_hns/sc.NationalParkBugContest_Text_Contestant10: KIPP: I've studied about bug\nPOKéMON a lot.\pI'm going to win for sure.$
data/maps/NationalPark_BugContest_hns/sc.NationalParkBugContest_Text_Sign_BattleN: What is this notice?\pPlease battle only in the grass.\pNATIONAL PARK WARDEN'S OFFICE$
data/maps/NationalPark_BugContest_hns/sc.NationalParkBugContest_Text_TrainerTips: The NATIONAL PARK has different\nPOKéMON during the BUG-CATCHING\lCONTEST.$

data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_Lass: Look! Check out my bag!\pI printed out my favorites from my\nPOKéDEX and stuck them on my bag.$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_PokefanF: This is MAIL I got from my daughter.\nIt cheers me up.$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_Teacher1: Pay attention, please!\p…Oops, I have to quit thinking like\na teacher all the time.\pYou must be a POKéMON trainer.\pSince you're working so hard, I\nwant you to have this.$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_Teacher1_QuickC: Let a POKéMON hold that QUICK CLAW.\pSometimes it will strike first\nduring battle.$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_Youngster1: I'm playing with stickers I printed\nfrom my POKéDEX.$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_Youngster2: I get the other guy's POKéDEX sticker\nif I win.$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_Teacher2: I take walks in the PARK, but I\nnever go into the grass.\pTrainers always want to battle…\pYou must have been in many battles.\nLet me heal your POKéMON for you.$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_SchoolboyJack1_: The world of POKéMON is deep.\pThere are still lots of things we\ndon't know.\pBut I know more than you do!$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_SchoolboyJack_A: There is a lot to learn.\pFor example…\pThere are 92 kinds of TMs.\pTraded POKéMON level up faster.$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_JackRegister: There is a lot to learn.\pFor example…\pThere are 92 kinds of TMs.\pTraded POKéMON level up faster.$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_JackRematchIntr: I've learned a lot since we\nlast battled! Let's go!$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_JackPostRematch: There is a lot to learn.\pFor example…\pThere are 92 kinds of TMs.\pTraded POKéMON level up faster.$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_PokefanFBeverly: My POKéMON are simply darling.\pLet me tell you how proud my\ndarlings make me.$
I can beat you in pride, but…$
I must say, your POKéMON are quite\ncute, too.$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_PokefanmWilliam: We adore our POKéMON, even if they\ndislike us.\pThat's what being a FAN is about.$
I lost the battle, but my POKéMON win\nthe prize for being most lovely.$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_LassKrise_Seen: Hello? Why are you staring at me?\pOh, a battle?$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_LassKrise_After: I thought you were staring at me\nbecause I'm cute!$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_Sign_BattleNoti: What is this notice?\pPlease battle only in the grass.\pNATIONAL PARK WARDEN'S OFFICE$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_TrainerTips: TRAINER TIPS\pPrint out MAIL by opening it then\npressing START.$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_BeverlyRegister: I must say, your POKéMON are quite\ncute, too.$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_BeverlyHasItem: Oh, hello! I have something\nfor you.\pPlease take it as a token of\nmy appreciation!$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_BeverlyGaveItem: My darling POKéMON and I will\nbe cheering for you!$
data/maps/NationalPark_Normal_hns/script.NationalPark_Normal_Text_BeverlyNoRoom: Hmm, your BAG is full.\pCome back when you have room.$

data/maps/NewBarkTown_House1_hns/scripts.NewBarkTown_House1_Text_NeighborsDaughte:
PIKACHU is an evolved POKéMON.\pI was amazed by PROF.ELM's
findings.\pHe's so famous for his research
on POKéMON evolution.\p…sigh…\pI wish I could be a researcher
like him…$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_House1_hns/scripts.NewBarkTown_House1_Text_Neighbor: My daughter is adamant about\nbecoming PROF.ELM's assistant.\pShe really loves POKéMON!\pBut then, so do I!$

data/maps/NewBarkTown_House2_hns/scripts.NewBarkTown_House2_Text_ElmsWife: Hi, {PLAYER}! My husband's always\nso busy--I hope he's OK.\pWhen he's caught up in his\nPOKéMON research, he even\lforgets to eat.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_House2_hns/scripts.NewBarkTown_House2_Text_ElmsSon: When I grow up, I'm going to\nhelp my dad!\pI'm going to be a great\nPOKéMON professor!$

data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAideIsWaiting: {PLAYER}!\pWhat are you doing here?\pMy aide is still waiting for you\nIn VIOLET CITY!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmIntro:
ELM: {PLAYER}! There you are!\pI needed to ask you a favor.\pI'm conducting new POKéMON
research right now. I was\lwondering if you could help\lme with it, {PLAYER}.\pYou see…\pI'm writing a paper that I
want to present at a conference.\pBut there are some things I
don't quite understand yet.\pSo!\pI'd like you to raise a
POKéMON that I recently caught.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmResearchAmbition: When I announce my findings,\nI'm sure we'll delve deeper\pinto the many mysteries of\nPOKéMON.\pYou can count on it!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGotAnEmail: Oh, hey! I got an e-mail!\p… … … … … … … …\nHm… Uh-huh…\pOkay…$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmMissionFromMrPok:
Hey, listen.\pI have an acquaintance called
MR. POKéMON.\pHe keeps finding weird things and
raving about his discoveries.\pAnyway, I just got an e-mail
from him saying that this\ltime it's real.\pIt is intriguing, but we're
busy with our POKéMON research...\pWait!
I know!\p{PLAYER}, can you go in our
place?$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmChooseAPokemon: I want you to raise one of\nthe POKéMON contained in these BALLS.\pYou'll be that POKéMON's\nfirst partner, {PLAYER}!\pGo on. Pick one!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_DidntChooseStarter: ELM: Think it over carefully.\pYour partner is important.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ChoseStarter: ELM: I think that's a great\nPOKéMON too!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_Nickname: Would you like to give your\n{STR_VAR_1} a nickname?$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmDirections1:
MR. POKéMON lives a little bit
beyond CHERRYGROVE, the next\lcity over.\pIt's almost a direct route
there, so you can't miss it.\pBut just in case, you have my
phone number. Call me if\lanything comes up!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmDirections1_Regi:
MR. POKéMON lives a little bit
beyond CHERRYGROVE, the next\lcity over.\pIt's almost a direct route
there, so you can't miss it.\pBut just in case, here's my
phone number. Call me if\lanything comes up!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmLetYourMonBattle: If a wild POKéMON appears,\nlet your POKéMON battle it!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmDirections2: If a wild POKéMON appears, let\nyour POKéMON battle it!\pIf your POKéMON is hurt, you\nshould heal it with the machine\lto my right, or at the POKéCENTER.\pI'm counting on you!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmDescribesMrPokem: MR. POKéMON goes everywhere and\nfinds rarities.\pToo bad they're just rare and\nnot very useful…$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmPokeBall: It contains a POKéMON caught\nby PROF.ELM.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAfterTheft1: ELM: {PLAYER}, this is terrible…\pOh, yes, what was MR. POKéMON's\nbig discovery?$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAfterTheft4:
But… Is it a POKéMON EGG?\pIf it is, it is a great
discovery!\pELM: What?!?\pPROF.OAK gave you a POKéDEX?\p{PLAYER}, is that true?
Th-that's incredible!\pHe is superb at seeing the
potential of people as trainers.\pWow, {PLAYER}. You may have what
it takes to become the CHAMPION.\pYou seem to be getting on
great with POKéMON too.\pYou should take the POKéMON
GYM challenge.\pThe closest GYM would be the
one in VIOLET CITY.\p…{PLAYER}. The road to the
championship will be a long one.\pBefore you leave, make sure
that you talk to your mom.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmStudyingEgg: ELM: Don't give up!\nI'll call if I learn anything\labout that EGG!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAideHasEgg:
ELM: {PLAYER}? Didn't you meet
my assistant?\pHe should have met you with
the EGG at VIOLET CITY's\pPOKéMON CENTER.\pYou must have just missed him.
Try to catch him there.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmWaitingEggHatch: ELM: Hey, has that EGG changed\nany?$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmThoughtEggHatche: {PLAYER}? I thought the EGG\nhatched.\pWhere is the POKéMON?$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ShowTogepi3:
The EGG hatched! So, POKéMON
are born from EGGS…\pNo, perhaps not all POKéMON
are.\pWow, there's still a lot of
research to be done.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveEverstone1: Thanks, {PLAYER}! You're helping\nunravel POKéMON mysteries for us!\pI want you to have this as a\ntoken of our appreciation.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveEverstone2:
That's an EVERSTONE.\pSome species of POKéMON evolve
when they grow to certain levels.\pA POKéMON holding the EVERSTONE
won't evolve.\pGive it to a POKéMON you don't
want to evolve.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmCallYou: ELM: {PLAYER}, I'll call you if\nanything comes up.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideAfterTheft: …sigh… That stolen POKéMON.\pI wonder how it's doing.\pThey say a POKéMON raised by a\nbad person turns bad itself.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveMasterBall1: ELM: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pThanks to you, my research is\ngoing great!\pTake this as a token of my\nappreciation.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveMasterBall2:
The MASTER BALL is the best!\pIt's the ultimate BALL! It'll
catch any POKéMON without fail.\pIt's given only to recognized
POKéMON researchers.\pI think you can make much better
use of it than I can, {PLAYER}!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_KimonoGirls:
By the way...
A group of beautiful KIMONO\lGIRLS were looking for you.\pThey told me they are
waiting for you at the\lECRUTEAK DANCE THEATER.\pI know you've gone through many
things since that EGG got you\linvolved in all this...\pI hope you'll carry through it.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_KimonoWaiting: PROF.ELM: The KIMONO\nGIRLS are waiting for you at\lthe ECRUTEAK DANCE THEATER.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_League:
PROF.ELM: Hahaha...
Good job!\pThat rare EGG has brought you
a lot of trouble, huh?\pThe KIMONO GIRLS said something
about me?\pI have nothing to do with it.\pYou made your decision and went
through with it.\pHaving done so much, you should
be able to face the LEAGUE now!\pYou should head for INDIGO
PLATEAU!\pDo you know how to get there?
Follow ROUTE 27 to ROUTE 26.\pOnce there, go straight north!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveTicket1: ELM: {PLAYER}! There you are!\pI called because I have\nsomething for you.\pSee? It's an S.S.TICKET.\pNow you can catch POKéMON in\nKANTO.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveTicket2:
The ship departs from OLIVINE
CITY.\pBut you knew that already,
{PLAYER}.\pAfter all, you've traveled all
over with your POKéMON.\pGive my regards to PROF.OAK in
KANTO!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_LabMonEgg: It's the POKéMON EGG being\nstudied by PROF.ELM.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideGivePotion: {PLAYER}, I want you to have\nthis for your errand.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideAlwaysBusy: There are only three of us, so\nwe're always busy.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideSave: Don't forget to save your game\nregularly!\pPress the START button, then\nSAVE the game!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideTheftTestimony:
There was a loud noise
outside…\pWhen we went to look,
someone stole a POKéMON.\pIt's unbelievable that anyone
would do that!\p…sigh… That stolen POKéMON.\pI wonder how it's doing.\pThey say a POKéMON raised by a
bad person turns bad itself.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideExplainBalls: To add to your POKéDEX, you\nhave to catch POKéMON.\pThrow POKé BALLS at wild\nPOKéMON to get them.$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_Officer1:
I heard a POKéMON was stolen
here…\pI was just getting some
information from PROF.ELM.\pApparently, it was a young
male with long, red hair…\pWhat?\pYou battled a trainer like
that?\pDid you happen to get his
name?$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_Lab_hns/scripts.in.NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_Elm_CallMe: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pHow's your POKéDEX coming along?\nI'm busy now, but call me sometime\land I can check your progress!$

data/maps/NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_hn.NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ElmsLoo:
Oh, {PLAYER}…! Our neighbor,
PROF.ELM, was looking for you.\pHe said he wanted you to do
something for him.\pOh! I almost forgot! Your POKéGEAR
is back from the repair shop.\pHere you go!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_hn.NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Explain: MOM: Phone numbers are stored\nin memory.\pJust choose a name you want to call.\nI've already registered my number.\pGee, isn't that convenient?$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_hn.NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_WearThe: Oh, and don't forget your\nRUNNING SHOES!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_hn.NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Explain: MOM: {PLAYER}, press the B Button\nwhile wearing these to run fast!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_hn.NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MomHurr: MOM: PROF.ELM is waiting for you.\pHurry up, baby!$
data/maps/NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_hn.NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MomsFri: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pI'm visiting!\pHave you heard?\pMy daughter is adamant about\nbecoming PROF.ELM's assistant.\pShe really loves POKéMON!$

MOM: Wow, that's a cute POKéMON.
Where did you get it?\p…\pSo, you're leaving on an adventure...
That does sound challenging...\pJust be careful.\pPOKéMON are your friends.
You need to work as a team.\pNow, go on!
I'm behind you all the way!$

data/maps/NewSinjoh_HotSprings_hns/scrip.NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_MualaniBefore:
Am I a local or a visitor?
What a rude question!\pIf you must know, I'm a local.\pMy family was among the first to
enjoy these springs.\pSee, I even have this SPLASH PLATE
to prove it.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_HotSprings_hns/scrip.NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_MualaniBeforeB:
Wait...\pYou need the SPLASH PLATE
to tame the legendary POKéMON?\pIf the KIMONO GIRLS think you
are worthy, then so do I.\pBut you'll still need to earn
it.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_HotSprings_hns/scrip.NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_MualaniAfter: It is hard for me to let that\nplate go.\pBut when the situation changes,\nit is important for us to change\ltoo.\pThe plate is yours.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_HotSprings_hns/scrip.NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_SkierF: I hate the cold!\pI'm just here for the hot springs!$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_HotSprings_hns/scrip.NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_SkierM: I came here to snowboard\nbut all my girlfriend wants to do\lis sit in the springs all day!$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_HotSprings_hns/scrip.NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_OldLady: Ignore my husband.\pLet your worries melt away.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_HotSprings_hns/scrip.NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_CreepyMan: Ouughh...\pThis water feels magical on my back.\pIf you have back pain too,\nyou should stay here with me...$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_HotSprings_hns/scrip.NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLATutorIntro: The ancient power flows\nthrough these springs.\pI can teach your POKeMON moves\nfrom a forgotten age.\pInterested?$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_HotSprings_hns/scrip.NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLATutorDone: Done! Your POKeMON has mastered\nthe ancient technique.$

data/maps/NewSinjoh_House1_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_House1_Text_Looking4Celebi:
Hey there, Trainer!\pYou came all the way from
NEW BARK TOWN?\pI have a request for someone as
well traveled as you are.\lYou see, my favorite POKEMON in the\lwhole world just so happens to be\lthe mythical POKEMON known as CELEBI.\pIf you happen to have one, would
you mind showing it to me?$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House1_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_House1_Text_NicePokemonButNotC: That's a very wonderful POKEMON\nyou have there but that's\lnot exactly what I was looking for..$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House1_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_House1_OffersWooper:
That's it! That's a real living CELEBI!!\pThank you show much for bringing it
all the way up north for me to see.\pHere, my girlfriend happened to
catch a few too many of these during\lher trip to a far away region..\pPlease take this special WOOPER as
thanks, {PLAYER}.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House1_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_House1_Text_Decline: That's too bad. I really wanted\nto see one.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House1_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_House1_Text_TakeCareOfWooper: Take good care of that WOOPER\nfor me okay?$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House1_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_House1_Text_GoodToSeeYouAgain: It's good to see you again,\n{PLAYER}.\pHow have you been treating that\nthat WOOPER?$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House1_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_House1_Bookshelf_Text: It's a shelf packed full of\ncomputer games and graphic novels!$

data/maps/NewSinjoh_House2_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_House2_DeskLady_Text: Hello, little one..\pWelcome to New Sinjoh's...\nWell, you might call it a library.\pReally, this is where we keep all\nthe records of our town's history,\las well as any literature we\limport from other regions..$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House2_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_House2_Text_Bookshelf_North: It's crammed full of ancient\nleather-bound books.\pThe language is unrecognizeable.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House2_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_House2_Text_Bookshelf_South: It's crammed full of POKéMON\nbooks.\pThese look newer and more familiar.$

data/maps/NewSinjoh_House3_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_HauntedHouse_Text_TooEarlyNoRe: You sense an odd presence...\pBut there is no reaction.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House3_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_HauntedHouse_Text_StartScary: You sense an odd presence...\pAre you being watched?$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House3_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_HauntedHouse_Text_Log1:
Research Log 9:  September 20, 1975\pThe days are getting shorter now
and the wind is becoming harsh.\pThe villagers were quite welcoming.\pThey are allowing me to stay here
in this cabin for the winter.\pIt seems a family used to live here.
I often think about my family.\pMaybe I will have the courage to
return to them in the spring.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House3_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_HauntedHouse_Text_Log2:
Research Log 10: October 20, 1975\pMy thoughts have turned dark.\pPerhaps it is the changing of the
seasons.\pThe villagers continue to treat me
as one of their own.\pBut the guilt I carry prevents me from
returning the sentiment.\pI rarely leave the cabin now.\pAnd when I think of my family...
Their faces have changed...\lI only see the faces of the POKéMON\lthat were lost at the ruins...\pSometimes I think the POKéMON are
here with me. I see them in\lreflections, I feel their gaze.\pThings will be better in the spring.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House3_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_HauntedHouse_Text_Log3:
Research Log 10: November 1, 1975\pI am not alone here.
Maybe I never was.\pThe POKéMON are with me...\pThey are angry with me, I think.\pObjects are thrown, doors slam.\pHeavy boxes block the front door.\pBut truthfully, I could leave
if I wanted to.\pThere is nothing else for me now.\pI've written of a family before,
but the POKéMON are the only family\lI can remember...\pI am running out of food, but my
guilt outpaces my hunger.\pI think I will stay here a while...$

data/maps/NewSinjoh_House4_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_Cafe_Text_ResturantGreeting: H-hello! Welcome to our Cafe!\nHow can I help you today?$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House4_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_Cafe_Text_BaldingMan: A local family has run this\ncafe for as long as anyone\lcan remember.\pTheir youngest girl over there\nisn't used to serving so many\lstrangers.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House4_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_Cafe_Text_ScientistM:
Please forgive my colleague...\pThe drinks here are stronger than
what we're used to in HOENN.\pI tried to warn her, but she said
she needed to unwind.\pThis research expedition has been
hard on us all.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_House4_hns/scripts.i.NewSinjoh_Cafe_Text_Gentleman: What are you staring at, kid?\pNothin' wrong with a man and his\nPOKéMON eating at the same table.$

data/maps/NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_PlayerMeets:
MIHARU: Welcome to NEW SINJOH, 
{PLAYER}.\pFor generations, this village has
peacefully coexisted with immensely\lpowerful POKéMON, in isolation from\lthe prying eyes of outsiders.\pRecent events at our sacred temple
and a subsequent influx of uninvited\lguests now threaten to disrupt the\lcareful balance we have long\lprotected.$

SHIZUKO: Our cousins in ECRUTEAK\nCITY made us aware of your\lconnection to the LEGENDARY POKéMON\lof the JOHTO REGION, and your\lprowess as a trainer.\pWe believe you can help us in these\ntrying times.$

YOUKO: Go to the SINJOH RUINS, to
the north of ROUTE 50.\pMeet with the scientists there, and
investigate the events that invoked\ltheir presence.\pIt is imperative that the LEGENDARY
POKéMON there are not disturbed\lby the unworthy.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_MiharuBefor:
MIHARU: Just as we predicted.\pThe champion of stone sent you
to collect the PLATES.\pOur order has guarded these
PLATES for centuries.\pWe will not part with them
readily.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_MiharuFinal: MIHARU: You have done our village\na great service, {PLAYER}.\pWe will not forget this.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_YoukoBefore: YOUKO: Our cousins speak so\nhighly of you.\pIs it true?\pI will find out.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_YoukoAfter: YOUKO: Our cousins were right\nabout you.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_YoukoFinal: YOUKO: I had my doubts, at first.\pBut after what you've done, it\ncannot be denied.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_ShizukoBefo: SHIZUKO: We are trained in\nbattle as well as dance.\pObtaining the PLATEs will\nrequire strength and determination.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_ShizukoAfte: SHIZUKO: The bond you share\nwith your POKéMON is quite strong.\pYou have earned this PLATE.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_ShizukoFina: SHIZUKO: Few trainers in all\nof SINJOH's storied history have\lmanaged what you've just done.\pQuite impressive, {PLAYER}.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_OldMan:
The KIMONO GIRLS have watched
over our village since its founding.\pThey have sacrificed much.\pBlessed by the Gods themselves,
they have powers beyond that\lof any normal trainer!\pThat is to say, be prepared
if you ever fight them, young one.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_OldManAfter: You have bested the champions of\nour village.\pWhat does that make you, young one?$
