data/maps/NewSinjoh_PokemonCenter_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_PokemonCenter_Text_Skiier: The snow makes it hard to navigate\nthis place.\pIt all looks the same.\pSo this map is a big help!\pWhat a beautiful region!$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_PokemonCenter_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_Text_Artist: I've found great inspiration in\nthis hidden town!\pDon't you think the landscape\nis breathtaking?$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_PokemonCenter_hns/sc.Text_ItemGiveaway: I see!\nYou must be an artist as well!\pI happen to have an extra something\nthat'll help you notice the tiny\ldetails of life!$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_PokemonCenter_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_Text_Artist_No: You aren't one of those anti-tourist\ntypes are you?\nBeauty is meant to be shared.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_PokemonCenter_hns/sc.Text_WasGiven_ZoomLensAlready: I hope you enjoy that lens!$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_PokemonCenter_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_Text_FemAce: We don't have many modern\ncommodities in NEW SINJOH.\pBut at least we have this\nPOKéMON CENTER.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_PokemonCenter_hns/sc.NewSinjoh_PokemonCenter_hns_Text_0: {PLAYER} took a closer look at the\nSINJOH map.$

data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_TriggerNorthGate: Better not leave the Kimono\ngirls waiting.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_Steven: STEVEN: Ma'am, may I help you to\nthe spring over there?\pIt seems there is plenty of room.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_MilkMan_text_BuyMilk: I am the Milkman.\pMy milk is delicious.\pIf you would like some today, it'll be\n¥500.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_MilkMan_GotMilk: Here ya go!\nIt's fortified with what the world wants.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_MilkMan_NoMoney: Sorry.\nGet some cash, then you will get a sale!$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_MilkMan_NoSale: Don't you want it?\nIt gots what the world deserves.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.MilkMan_Battle_text: I am the MilkMan,\pMy milk is delicious.\pSpecial delivery today!$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_TravelShopGreeting: Welcome to My little Supply Shop.\nHow can I help you?$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_TravelBrother_Greeting: All our goods are homemade\nand grown locally!\pMy big sister opened up this shop,\nbecause the POKéMART company\lwon't open a location\lthis far out from a major town.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_Josh: This place is sick!\pHiding these hot springs\nfrom the world is a travesty.\pI'm gonna tell all my friends!$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_Janice: These springs are magical,\nbut I feel like the locals\lare giving us dirty looks.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_JaniceAfter: These springs are magical,\nand the locals are so kind\lwhen you get to know them!$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_OldLady1: There's nothing like a nice view to\ninvigorate this old soul.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_OldLady2: Great, now these tourists\nare hogging our hot springs!\pIt's been one bad thing after\nanother lately!$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_OldLady2Steven: What a handsome young man!\pMaybe these tourists aren't\nso bad after all.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_OldLady3:
How can that woman
be so rude to our guests?\pShe needs to take a dip
in the springs. \pThere is plenty of space
for everyone.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_OldLady3After: It seems everybody is getting\nused to each other around here.\pGood!$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_SpringsSage:
There has been much division
and strife in our community\lsince the newcomers arrived.\pRegardless of your perspective,
it is clear that the balance has\lbeen disturbed.\pPlease be kind to locals and
tourists alike.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_SpringsSageAfter: Things have been better since\nthe legendary POKéMON were quelled.\pBalance has returned to SINJOH.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_Sage2: Times change, but the STANTLER\nstill gather. For that, we can\lbe thankful.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_Daughter: Wheeeeee!!\pLook, Mommy!\nNo hands!\pJust like the snowboarders!$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_Mother: Look at my adorable baby go!\pThis rink has been here\nfor generations, but the children\lnever used it until the newcomers\larrived.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_Hiker: Business is booming!\nBut prices have gone up since\lthe city folk became interested\lin our little town.$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_HikerAfter: Business is booming!\pAnd with how much that silver haried\nguy tips, prices have come down!$
data/maps/NewSinjoh_hns/scripts.inc.NewSinjoh_Text_OldLady4After: I STILL only sell to locals!$

data/maps/OldaleTown/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_Text_SavingMyProgress: I want to take a rest, so I'm saving my\nprogress.$
data/maps/OldaleTown/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_Text_IWorkAtPokemonMart: Hi!\nI work at a POKéMON MART.\pCan I get you to come with me?$
data/maps/OldaleTown/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_Text_ThisIsAPokemonMart:
This is a POKéMON MART.
Just look for our blue roof.\pWe sell a variety of goods including
POKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.\pHere, I'd like you to have this as
a promotional item.$
data/maps/OldaleTown/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_Text_PotionExplanation: A POTION can be used anytime, so it's\neven more useful than a POKéMON CENTER\lin certain situations.$
data/maps/OldaleTown/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_Text_WaitDontComeInHere:
Aaaaah! Wait!
Please don't come in here.\pI just discovered the footprints of
a rare POKéMON!\pWait until I finish sketching
them, okay?$
data/maps/OldaleTown/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_Text_DiscoveredFootprints: I just discovered the footprints of\na rare POKéMON!\pWait until I finish sketching\nthem, okay?$
data/maps/OldaleTown/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_Text_FinishedSketchingFootpri: I finished sketching the footprints of\na rare POKéMON.\pBut it turns out they were only my\nown footprints…$
data/maps/OldaleTown/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_Text_BrendanLetsGoBack: BRENDAN: I'm heading back to my dad's\nLAB now.\l{PLAYER}, you should hustle back, too.$
data/maps/OldaleTown/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_Text_TownSign: OLDALE TOWN\n“Where things start off scarce.”$

data/maps/OldaleTown_House1/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_House1_Text_LeftPokemonGoesOu: When a POKéMON battle starts, the one\nat the left of the list goes out first.\pSo, when you get more POKéMON in your\nparty, try switching around the order\lof your POKéMON.\pIt could give you an advantage.$

data/maps/OldaleTown_House2/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_House2_Text_PokemonLevelUp: When POKéMON battle, they eventually\nlevel up and become stronger.$
data/maps/OldaleTown_House2/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_House2_Text_YoullGoFurtherWit: If the POKéMON with you become\nstronger, you'll be able to go farther\laway from here.$

data/maps/OldaleTown_Mart/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_Mart_Text_PokeBallsAreSoldOut: The clerk says they're all sold out.\nI can't buy any POKé BALLS.$
data/maps/OldaleTown_Mart/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_Mart_Text_ImGoingToBuyPokeBal: I'm going to buy a bunch of POKé BALLS\nand catch a bunch of POKéMON!$
data/maps/OldaleTown_Mart/scripts.inc.OldaleTown_Mart_Text_RestoreHPWithPotion: If a POKéMON gets hurt and loses its HP\nand faints, it won't be able to battle.\pTo prevent your POKéMON from fainting,\nrestore its HP with a POTION.$

data/maps/OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F/sc.OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trainer: That PC in the corner there is\nfor any POKéMON TRAINER to use.\pNaturally, that means you're welcome\nto use it, too.$
data/maps/OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F/sc.OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Pokemon: POKéMON CENTERS are great!\pYou can use their services as much\nas you like, and it's all for free.\lYou never have to worry!$
data/maps/OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F/sc.OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Wireles: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on\nthe second floor was built recently.\pBut they say they're still making\nadjustments.$
data/maps/OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F/sc.OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedI: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on\nthe second floor was built recently.\pI traded POKéMON right away.$

data/maps/OlivineCity_Cafe_hns/scripts.i.OlivineCity_Cafe_Text_Jasmine:
Oh... Hello, {PLAYER}.\pThese dishes in front of me are
not all mine...\pUh...\pActually, the person who sat here
before me ate a lot...\pIf you'd like to battle again,
please visit me at the FIGHTING\lDOJO in SAFFRON CITY.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Cafe_hns/scripts.i.OlivineCity_Text_CafeSailorStrength:
Hah! Your POKéMON sure look like
lightweights!\pThey don't have the power to
move boulders aside.\pHere, use this and teach them
STRENGTH!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Cafe_hns/scripts.i.OlivineCity_Text_CafeSailorGotStrength: On the sea, the only thing you\ncan count on is your own self!\pI'm so proud of my buff bod!\nYou should train like me!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Cafe_hns/scripts.i.OlivineCity_Text_CafeFishingGuru: OLIVINE CAFE's menu is packed\nwith hearty fare for beefy\lSAILORS like me!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Cafe_hns/scripts.i.OlivineCity_Text_CafeSailor: Whenever I roll into this town,\nI always visit the OLIVINE CAFE.\pEverything on the menu makes me\nfeel stronger. I can't stop eating!$

data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_Gent: I knew you'd come here.\pThank you for helping the GYM LEADER,\nbut battle is a separate matter.\pGo for it!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_Gent2: Impressive!\nYou should continue your journey to\ldifferent places.\pSince you can use SURF, why don't you\ntry it on the LAKE OF RAGE?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_Lass: Giggle...\nI know how capable you are\lfrom the LIGHTHOUSE.\pIt's time you showed that side of\nyourself to JASMINE! Good luck!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_Lass2: You are amazing...\nYou should aim even higher, since\lyou have such potential.\pHave you been to MAHOGANY TOWN?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideText:
JASMINE uses the newly discovered
STEEL-type.\pShe's known for having not one,
but two aces.\pThe first is a metal bug that can
use a technique to boost its ATTACK.\pWhile fire will hurt it, it can
sometimes endure powerful blows.\pThe second is a giant iron snake
with lots of powerful moves.\pApproach it with caution.\pIt may look slow, but I've seen it
strike first with shocking displays\lof SPEED.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideWinText: That was awesome.\pThe STEEL-type, huh?\pThat was a close encounter of an\nunknown kind!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePreText: JASMINE, the GYM LEADER, is at the\nLIGHTHOUSE.\pShe's been tending to a sick POKéMON.\pA strong trainer has to be\ncompassionate.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineSteelTypeInt:
…Thank you for your help at the
LIGHTHOUSE…\pBut this is different.
Please allow me to introduce myself.\pI am JASMINE, a GYM LEADER.
I use the STEEL-type.\p…Do you know about the STEEL-type?\pIt's a type that was only recently
discovered.\p…Um… May I begin?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineBetterTraine: …You are a better trainer than me,\nin both skill and kindness.\pIn accordance with LEAGUE rules,\nI confer upon you this BADGE.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineBadgeSpeech: MINERALBADGE raises POKéMON's \nSPECIAL DEFENSE.\p…Um… Please take this too…$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineIronTailSpee: …You could use that TM to teach\nIRON TAIL.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineGoodLuck: Um… I don't know how to say this,\nbut good luck…$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineRematchText: …Congratulations, JOHTO CHAMPION.\pYou have become so strong…\pI wonder if I have improved.\pWould you like to test that?\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineRematchDefea: …You are a better trainer than me,\nin both skill and kindness.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified: OLIVINE CITY POKéMON GYM\pJASMINE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineWantToTrade:
…Um, {PLAYER}…
I have something to ask you.\pI've raised this STEELIX since it
was a little ONIX.\pBut I think RUSTY would be happier
with a trainer like you.\pWould you trade any of your
POKéMON for my RUSTY?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Gym_hns/scripts.in.OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineTradeComplet: …How is RUSTY doing?\nI hope you're taking good care…$

data/maps/OlivineCity_House1_hns/scripts.OlivineCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWont: I collect POKéMON!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_House1_hns/scripts.OlivineCity_House1_Text_MonYouTakeCare: Yay! I got myself {STR_VAR_1}!\p{STR_VAR_2}, you take care!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_House1_hns/scripts.OlivineCity_House1_Text_ThisIsntAMon: Uh, no, I don't think so.\nThat isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_House1_hns/scripts.OlivineCity_House1_Text_YouWontTradeMe: You don't want to trade? Aww...$
data/maps/OlivineCity_House1_hns/scripts.OlivineCity_House1_Text_After: Hi, how's my old VOLTORB doing?$

data/maps/OlivineCity_House2_hns/scripts.OlivineCity_Text_PunishmentBro: Along the way to CIANWOOD,\nthere are four deserted islands.\pBad kids are taken to those\nislands as punishment!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_House2_hns/scripts.OlivineCity_Text_PunishmentBoy: Whenever I get in trouble,\nbig bro always scares me.$

data/maps/OlivineCity_House3_hns/scripts.OlivineCity_Text_OfferGoodRod: OLIVINE is on the sea!\pAnd if it's on the sea, there\nare bound to be fish!\pI've fished here for 30 years.\pWould you like to face the sea\nand try your hand at fishing?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_House3_hns/scripts.OlivineCity_Text_GiveGoodRod: Ah, hahah! We have ourselves\na new angler in the making!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_House3_hns/scripts.OlivineCity_Text_GaveGoodRod:
Fish aren't only found in the
sea--they're wherever there's\lwater.\pBy the way, your POKéDEX shows
fishing groups for POKéMON.\pDifferent spots may contain
similar fish types.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_House3_hns/scripts.OlivineCity_Text_DontWantGoodRod: Whaaat? You don't like to fish!?\nThat's incomprehensible!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_House3_hns/scripts.OlivineCity_Text_HaveGoodRod: How are things?\nDid you land the big one?$

data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_1FSailor: People train at this LIGHTHOUSE.\pIt's not easy to climb with all\nthe trainers waiting inside.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_1FPokefanF: In the past, POKéMON used to light\nthe sea around OLIVINE at night.\pThe LIGHTHOUSE was built in honor\nof those noble POKéMON.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorHueySeen: Men of the sea are always\nspoiling for a good fight!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorHueyAfter: What power! How would you like\nto sail the seas with me?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_HueyRegister: What power! How would you like\nto sail the seas with me?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_HueyRematchIntro: Men of the sea are always\nspoiling for a good fight!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_HueyPostRematch: What power! How would you like\nto sail the seas with me?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_GentlemanAlfredSe: Hm? This is no place\nfor playing.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_GentlemanAlfredBe: Ah! I can see that you're\nserious.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_GentlemanAlfredAf: Up top is a POKéMON that keeps\nthe LIGHTHOUSE lit.\pBut I hear that it's sick now,\nand can't be cured normally.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_BirdKeeperTheoSee: Why are you here? Are you just\ngoing to gawk? I suggest you leave!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_BirdKeeperTheoBea: You really are concerned about\nthe sick POKéMON…$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_BirdKeeperTheoAft: How the heck do you go up?\pI want to visit the sick POKéMON,\nbut I can't get up there…$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorTerrellSeen: Sailors are both kind and strong.\nHow about you?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorTerrellBeat: You are both kind and strong…$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorTerrellAfte: Every time I return to OLIVINE,\nI visit the GYM.\pThe GYM LEADER’s POKéMON type\nchanged without me noticing.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_GentlemanPrestonS: I travel the world to train my\nPOKéMON. I wish to battle you.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_GentlemanPrestonA: JASMINE used to use ROCK-type\nPOKéMON like ONIX.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorKentSeen: JASMINE must be worried sick about\nthe POKéMON here.\pShe won't even smile these days.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorKentBeaten: I can't manage a smile either…$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorKentAfter: Speaking of sick, I've heard there's\na good PHARMACY in CIANWOOD.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_LassConnieSeen: JASMINE is this city's GYM LEADER.\pI mean to bring her back with me.\pNobody had better get in my way!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_LassConnieAfter: Right. Anybody would be worried if\nhis or her own POKéMON were hurt.\pI'll pray for the POKéMON here, so\nJASMINE can come back to the GYM.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorErnestSeen: I wanted to battle JASMINE, but she's\nnot up to it now.\pSo, how about you?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorErnestAfter: A GYM LEADER isn't just about being\nstrong.\pA LEADER also needs to be\ncompassionate.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_BirdKeeperDenisSe: We're pretty high up here. My bird\nPOKéMON are in prime form.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_BirdKeeperDenisAf: My POKéMON learned how to use FLY in\nCIANWOOD.\pWell, since I'm a loser, I'll FLY\nacross the sea…$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_JasmineCianwoodPh:
JASMINE: …This POKéMON always kept
the sea lit at night.\p…But it suddenly got sick… It's
gasping for air…\p…I understand that there is a
wonderful PHARMACY in CIANWOOD…\pBut that's across the sea…
And I can't leave AMPHY unattended…$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_JasmineGetMedicin: …May I ask you to get some medicine\nfor me? Please?$

There is a wonderful PHARMACY
in CIANWOOD…\pBut that's across the sea…
And I can't leave AMPHY unattended…\p…May I ask you to get some medicine
for me? Please?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_JasmineDontBeOffe: JASMINE: …Um, please don't be\noffended…\p…AMPHY will not take anything from\nanyone but me…$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Lighthouse_hns/scr.OlivineLighthouse_Text_JasmineThankYou: JASMINE: …Oh, I'm so relieved…\pThis is just so wonderful…\pThank you so very, very much.\p…I will return to the GYM…\pI'll also warn you, STEEL types\nare powerful.$

data/maps/OlivineCity_Mart_hns/scripts.i.OlivineCity_Text_MartCooltrainerF: Do your POKéMON already know\nthe move for carrying people\lacross water?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_Mart_hns/scripts.i.OlivineCity_Text_MartLass: My BUTTERFREE came from my\nboyfriend overseas.\pIt carried some MAIL from him.\pWant to know what it says?\pLet's see... Nope! It's a\nsecret!$

data/maps/OlivineCity_PokemonCenter_hns/.OlivineCity_Text_PokecenterFisher: The SAILOR in the OLIVINE CAFE\nnext door is really generous.\pHe taught my POKéMON STRENGTH.\pNow it can move big boulders\nwithout breaking a sweat.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PokemonCenter_hns/.OlivineCity_Text_PokecenterTeacher: There's a person in CIANWOOD\nCITY across the sea.\pI heard him bragging about his\nrare POKéMON all the time.$

data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivineCity_PortInside_Text_Nationaldex1:
PROF.OAK: Hello!
You are starting to have the\lattitude of a CHAMPION, {PLAYER}!\pIt's time for your POKéDEX to
match who you are.\pLet me see your POKéDEX for a
second.\pI'll upgrade your POKéDEX with the
NATIONAL MODE.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivineCity_PortInside_Text_Nationaldex2: {PLAYER}'s POKéDEX was upgraded\nwith the NATIONAL MODE!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivineCity_PortInside_Text_Nationaldex3: PROF.OAK: It won't be easy to\ncomplete the NATIONAL POKéDEX...\pHowever, I'm sure you will make\nhonest attempt on our behalf!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivineCity_PortInside_Text_Nationaldex4: Oh, time flies!\pI have a radio show to record at\nGOLDENROD RADIO TOWER.\pYou must be heading for KANTO.\pIf you come near PALLET TOWN, do\ndrop by my POKéMON RESEARCH LAB!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivinePort_Text_NoPass: {PLAYER} tried to show the\n{STR_VAR_1}…\p…But no {STR_VAR_1}!\pSorry!\nYou may board only if you have an\l{STR_VAR_1}.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivinePort_Text_SailorGetOnBoard: We're departing soon.\nPlease get on board.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivinePort_Text_WhereSail: Where would you like to sail?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivinePort_Text_AskBoard: Welcome to FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA.\pWill you be boarding today?$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivinePort_Text_ComeAgain: We hope to see you again!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivinePort_Text_FlashTicket: {PLAYER} flashed the S.S.TICKET.\pThat's it. Thank you!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivinePort_Text_NoTicket: {PLAYER} tried to show the\nS.S.TICKET…\p…But no TICKET!\pSorry!\nYou may board only\lif you have an S.S.TICKET.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivinePort_Text_FishingGuru1: SHELLDER are easy to catch here.\pThey're kind of rare elsewhere.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivinePort_Text_FishingGuru2: How many RODS do you have?\pDifferent RODS catch different\nPOKéMON.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivinePort_Text_Youngster: S.S.AQUA uses jets to skim\nover the waves!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivinePort_Text_CooltrainerF: There are lots of POKéMON in KANTO.\pI wish I could go…$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortInside_hns/scr.OlivinePort_Text_SailorBeforeHOF: We don't want you to fall into the\nsea, so you're not allowed in.$

data/maps/OlivineCity_PortOutside_hns/sc.OlivineCity_PortOutside_Text_Sabrina: SABRINA: Out of the blue,\nI get the urge to see the ocean.\pI'll see you at the FIGHTING\nDOJO.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_PortOutside_hns/sc.OlivineCity_PortOutside_Text_PortFisherm: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA used to sail to\nKANTO on Mondays and Fridays. But\lnow, it sails almost constantly!$

data/maps/OlivineCity_hns/scripts.inc.OlivineCity_Text_Baoba:
{PLAYER}!\pThis is WARDEN BAOBA.\pSorry to have kept you waiting.
We've finally opened the\lSAFARI ZONE!\pDo you know where it is?\pYou know the GATE inside the cavern
in CIANWOOD CITY?\pIf you go through there and walk for
a short while, you should soon see\lthe SAFARI ZONE!\pWe're a little out of the way, but
please come visit!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_hns/scripts.inc.OlivineCity_Text_SilverEncounter:
You again?
There's no need to be alert.\pI don't bother with wimps
like you.\pSpeaking of weaklings, the
city's GYM LEADER isn't here,\land is supposedly taking care\lof a sick POKéMON at the\lLIGHTHOUSE.\pHumph! Boo-hoo!
Just let sick POKéMON go!\pA POKéMON that can't battle
is worthless!\pWhy don't you go train at the
LIGHTHOUSE?\pWho knows? It may make you a
bit of a better Trainer!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_hns/scripts.inc.OlivineCity_Text_CafeSign: OLIVINE CAFE\nWHERE STRONG SAILORS ENJOY\lHEARTY MEALS OF STRENGTH$
data/maps/OlivineCity_hns/scripts.inc.OlivineCity_Text_EonTicketWoman1: My name is MARY!\pJust kidding, but I love MARY's\nradio show!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_hns/scripts.inc.OlivineCity_Text_EonTicketWoman2: You must be {PLAYER}!!!\pOh my goodness! The champion!\pI heard about you on MARY's\nradio show!\pHere, take this!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_hns/scripts.inc.OlivineCity_Text_EonTicketWoman3: I can't believe I met the\nchampion!!!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_hns/scripts.inc.OlivineCity_Text_Sailor1:
Dark roads are dangerous
at night.\pBut in the pitch-black of
night, the sea is even more\ltreacherous!\pWithout the beacon of the
LIGHTHOUSE to guide it,\lno ship can sail.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_hns/scripts.inc.OlivineCity_Text_YoungsterPokegear: That thing you have--\nit's a POKéGEAR, right?\lWow, that's cool.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_hns/scripts.inc.OlivineCity_Text_YoungsterPokedex: Wow, you have a POKéDEX!\pThat is just so awesome.$
data/maps/OlivineCity_hns/scripts.inc.OlivineCity_Text_Sailor2:
The league has JASMINE
pegged as the sixth\lstrongest GYM LEADER!\pHah! That's a load of crud.\pThere's no way PRYCE could
hurt JASMINE's STEEL-type\lPOKéMON!\pBureaucracy if you ask me.\pShe's something to be feared,
that's for sure!$
data/maps/OlivineCity_hns/scripts.inc.OlivineCity_Text_Sign: OLIVINE CITY\pThe Port Closest to Foreign Lands$
data/maps/OlivineCity_hns/scripts.inc.OlivineCity_Text_GymSign: OLIVINE CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: JASMINE\pThe Steel-Clad Defense Girl$
data/maps/OlivineCity_hns/scripts.inc.OlivineCity_Text_LighthouseSign: OLIVINE LIGHTHOUSE\nAlso known as the GLITTER\lLIGHTHOUSE$
data/maps/OlivineCity_hns/scripts.inc.OlivineCity_Text_BattleTowerSign: TRAINER HILL and\nBATTLE TENTS AHEAD.\pOpening Now!$

data/maps/PacifidlogTown/scripts.inc.PacifidlogTown_Text_FastRunningCurrent: The sea between PACIFIDLOG and\nSLATEPORT has a fast-running tide.\pIf you decide to SURF, you could end\nup swept away somewhere else.$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown/scripts.inc.PacifidlogTown_Text_NeatHousesOnWater: See, isn't it neat?\nThese houses are on water!\pI was born here!$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown/scripts.inc.PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary:
The SKY PILLAR?\p…Oh, you must mean that tall, tall
tower a little further out.\pIf you asked me, I wouldn't climb it.
It's too scary to get up that high.\pLife at sea level in PACIFIDLOG,
that suits me fine.$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown/scripts.inc.PacifidlogTown_Text_TownSign: PACIFIDLOG TOWN\p“Where the morning sun smiles upon\nthe waters.”$

data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House1/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_RegiStory:
In the HOENN region, there are three
POKéMON that represent the power of\lrock, ice, and steel.\pEach of them is said to hide away deep
inside caves.\pThat's the story I heard when I was
just a little kid.$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House1/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_SixDotsOpenTh: “Six dots open three doors.”\pGrandpa used to say that, but I don't\nknow what he meant.$

data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House2/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ChairmansYoun: Er-hem!\pI am the POKéMON FAN CLUB's most\nimportant person, the CHAIRMAN's\lyounger brother.\pI'm here enjoying my vacation with\nPOKéMON, yes, indeed.$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House2/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_AdoringPokemo: It clearly likes you very much.\pA POKéMON that adoring and adorable\ndeserves a TM like this, no?$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House2/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_PutInSomeMore: Hmm…\nIt's not bad, but it's also not good.\pYou, as the TRAINER, need to put in\nsome more effort.$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House2/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ViciousPokemo: It has a vicious look to it.\pA frightening POKéMON like that\ndeserves a TM like this.$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House2/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ExplainReturn: If a POKéMON likes you a lot, RETURN's\npower is enhanced.\pIf it doesn't like you, FRUSTRATION's\npower goes up.$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House2/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_GetGoodTMInXD: Oh, yes. In about {STR_VAR_1} or so days,\nI should be getting a good TM or two.\pYou should come see me then.\nI'll give you a TM that's suitable for\lyour POKéMON.$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House2/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_VeryFriendlyW: It appears to be very friendly with the\nTRAINER.$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House2/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_DoesntLikeTra: It doesn't appear to like the TRAINER\nvery much.$

data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House3/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_WillingToTrad:
Check out this {STR_VAR_2}!\pIt's the {STR_VAR_2} that I caught
yesterday to celebrate my birthday!\pOh, I can see that you want it!
After all, it's priceless!\pI'll tell you what. I might be willing
to trade it for a {STR_VAR_1}.$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House3/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_ItsSubtlyDiff: Oh, so this is a {STR_VAR_1}?\pIt's sort of like a {STR_VAR_2},\nand yet it's subtly different.\pThank you!$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House3/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_WontAcceptAny: No, no, no! I won't accept any\nless than a real {STR_VAR_1}!$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House3/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_NotDesperateO: Oh, so you're not going to go through\nwith this?\pThat's cool. I'm not desperate to make\na trade or anything.$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House3/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_ReallyWantedT: I know I could go looking for one\non my own, but…\pBut I really wanted to get a BAGON\nthat another TRAINER caught…$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House3/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_IsThatAPokede: Is that a POKéDEX?\pDid you get to meet a lot of different\nPOKéMON?\pI wish I was like you.$

data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House4/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_PeopleSawHigh: People were saying they saw a POKéMON\nflying high above HOENN.\pIs it flying around all the time?\nDoesn't it need to rest somewhere?$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House4/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YesTown: Yes?\nYES TOWN?\pI've never heard of a place like that.$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House4/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YouHaveToCome: No? That doesn't make any sense.\nYou have to come from somewhere.\pOh! Wait! You're not going to say you\nwere born at the bottom of the sea?$

data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House5/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_CantSeeMirage: I can't see MIRAGE ISLAND today…$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House5/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_CanSeeMirageI: Oh! Oh my!\nI can see MIRAGE ISLAND today!$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_House5/scripts..PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_MirageIslandA: MIRAGE ISLAND…\pIt must become visible and invisible\ndepending on the weather conditions\lthat make mirages appear.\pOr is it really appearing and\ndisappearing?$

data/maps/PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1.PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Wha: What color is your TRAINER CARD?\nMine's copper!$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1.PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnC: PACIFIDLOG TOWN floats on top of\na colony of CORSOLA.\pIf I told you that, would you believe\nme?$
data/maps/PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1.PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Anc: The ancestors of the people in\nPACIFIDLOG were said to have been\lborn on boats and then lived and died \laboard them.\pI understand that they lived that way\nbecause they were searching for\lsomething.$

data/maps/PalletTown_House2_hns/scripts..PalletTown_House2_Text_Hello: DAISY: Hi! My kid brother is the\nGYM LEADER in VIRIDIAN CITY.\pBut he goes out of town so\noften, it causes problems for\lthe trainers.$
data/maps/PalletTown_House2_hns/scripts..PalletTown_House2_Text_OfferGrooming: DAISY: Hi! Good timing. I'm about\nto have some tea.\pWould you like to join me?\pOh, your POKéMON are a bit dirty.\pWould you like me to groom one?$
data/maps/PalletTown_House2_hns/scripts..PalletTown_House2_Text_WhichMon: DAISY: Which one should I groom?$
data/maps/PalletTown_House2_hns/scripts..PalletTown_House2_Text_Alright: DAISY: OK, I'll get it looking\nnice in no time.$
data/maps/PalletTown_House2_hns/scripts..PalletTown_House2_Text_AllDone: DAISY: There you go! All done.\pSee? Doesn't {STR_VAR_1} look\nnice?\pIt's such a cute POKéMON.$
data/maps/PalletTown_House2_hns/scripts..PalletTown_House2_Text_AlreadyGroomed: DAISY: I always have tea around\nthis time. Come join me.$
data/maps/PalletTown_House2_hns/scripts..PalletTown_House2_Text_Refused: DAISY: You don't want to have one\ngroomed?\pOK, we'll just have tea.$
data/maps/PalletTown_House2_hns/scripts..PalletTown_House2_Text_CantGroomEgg: DAISY: Oh, sorry. I honestly can't\ngroom an EGG.$

data/maps/PalletTown_Lab_hns/scripts.inc.PalletTown_Lab_Text_OakWelcomeKanto: OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\nIt's good of you to come all this\lway to KANTO.\pWhat do you think of the trainers\nout here? Pretty tough, huh?$
data/maps/PalletTown_Lab_hns/scripts.inc.PalletTown_Lab_Text_OakLabGoodbye: If you're in the area, I hope you\ncome visit again.$
data/maps/PalletTown_Lab_hns/scripts.inc.PalletTown_Lab_Text_OakOpenMtSilver:
OAK: Wow! That's excellent!\pYou collected the BADGES of GYMS
in KANTO. Well done!\pI was right in my assessment of
you.\pTell you what, {PLAYER}. I'll make
arrangements so that you can go\lto MT.SILVER.\pMT.SILVER is a big mountain that
is home to many wild POKéMON.\pIt's too dangerous for your average
trainer, so it's off limits. But\lwe can make an exception in your\lcase, {PLAYER}.\pGo up to INDIGO PLATEAU. You can
reach MT.SILVER from there.$
data/maps/PalletTown_Lab_hns/scripts.inc.PalletTown_Lab_Text_OakOpenIndigoPlateau: Oh, and speaking of the INDIGO\nPLATEAU, now that you've earned\l16 badges, the KANTO LEAGUE\lwill be ready to accept\lyour challenge once again.\pBut be warned, LANCE and his\nELITE FOUR won't go easy on you\lthis time.\pGood luck, {PLAYER}!$
data/maps/PalletTown_Lab_hns/scripts.inc.PalletTown_Lab_Text_OakNoKantoBadges: OAK: Hmm? You're not collecting\nKANTO GYM BADGES?\pThe GYM LEADERS in KANTO are as\ntough as any you battled in JOHTO.\pI recommend that you challenge them.$
data/maps/PalletTown_Lab_hns/scripts.inc.PalletTown_Lab_Text_OakYesKantoBadges: OAK: Ah, you're collecting KANTO\nGYM BADGES.\pI imagine that it's hard, but the\nexperience is sure to help you.\pCome see me when you get them all.\pI'll have a gift for you.\pKeep trying hard, {PLAYER}!$
data/maps/PalletTown_Lab_hns/scripts.inc.PalletTown_Lab_Text_OaksAssistant1: The PROF's POKéMON TALK radio\nprogram isn't aired here in KANTO.\pIt's a shame--I'd like to hear it.$
data/maps/PalletTown_Lab_hns/scripts.inc.PalletTown_Lab_Text_OaksAssistant2: Thanks to your work on the POKéDEX,\nthe PROF's research is coming along\lgreat.$
data/maps/PalletTown_Lab_hns/scripts.inc.PalletTown_Lab_Text_OaksAssistant3: Don't tell anyone, but PROF.OAK'S\nPOKéMON TALK isn't a live broadcast.$
data/maps/PalletTown_Lab_hns/scripts.inc.PalletTown_Lab_Text_OaksLabPC: There's an e-mail message on the PC.\p…\pPROF.OAK, how is your research\ncoming along?\pI'm still plugging away.\pI heard rumors that {PLAYER} is\ngetting quite a reputation.\pI'm delighted to hear that.\pELM in NEW BARK TOWN 8-)$

data/maps/PalletTown_RedsHouse_1F_hns/sc.RedsHouse_Text_Mom1: Hi!\pRED's been away for a long time.\pHe hasn't called either, so I have\nno idea where he is or what he's\lbeen doing.\pThey say that no word is proof that\nhe's doing fine, but I do worry\labout him.$
data/maps/PalletTown_RedsHouse_1F_hns/sc.RedsHouse_Text_Mom2: I worry about RED getting hurt or\nsick, but he's a boy.\pI'm proud that he is doing what he\nwants to do.$
data/maps/PalletTown_RedsHouse_1F_hns/sc.RedsHouse_Text_TV: They have programs that aren't\nshown in JOHTO…$

data/maps/PalletTown_RedsHouse_2F_hns/sc.RedsHouse_Text_NES: {PLAYER} played the NES.\pBetter get going--no time to lose!$
data/maps/PalletTown_RedsHouse_2F_hns/sc.RedsHouse_Text_PC: It looks like it hasn't been used\nin a long time…$

data/maps/PalletTown_hns/scripts.inc.PalletTown_Text_Teacher: I'm raising POKéMON too.\pThey serve as my private\nguards.$
data/maps/PalletTown_hns/scripts.inc.PalletTown_Text_Fisher: Technology is incredible!\pYou can now trade POKéMON\nacross time like e-mail.$
data/maps/PalletTown_hns/scripts.inc.PalletTown_Text_Sign: PALLET TOWN\pA Tranquil Setting of Peace\n& Purity$

data/maps/PetalburgCity/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally: Where has our WALLY gone?\pWe have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN\nvery soon…$
data/maps/PetalburgCity/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer:
Hiya! Are you maybe…
A rookie TRAINER?\pDo you know what POKéMON TRAINERS
do when they reach a new town?\pThey first check what kind of GYM
is in the town.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsPetalburgGym: See? This is PETALBURG CITY's GYM.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsGymSign: This is the GYM's sign. Look for it\nwhenever you're looking for a GYM.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection: My face is reflected in the water.\pIt's a shining grin full of hope…\pOr it could be a look of somber silence\nstruggling with fear…\pWhat do you see reflected in your face?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation: Let's say you have six POKéMON.\nIf you catch another one…\pIt is automatically sent to a STORAGE\nBOX over a PC connection.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Text_GymSign: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: NORMAN\l“A man in pursuit of power!”$
data/maps/PetalburgCity/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Text_CitySign: PETALBURG CITY\n“Where people mingle with nature.”$
data/maps/PetalburgCity/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer: Excuse me!\pLet me guess, from the way you're\ndressed, are you a POKéMON TRAINER?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot: … … … … … …\pWell, maybe not.\nYour clothes aren't all that dirty.\pYou're either a rookie TRAINER,\nor maybe you're just an ordinary kid.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedT: I'm roaming the land in search of\ntalented TRAINERS.\pI'm sorry to have taken your time.$

data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadYoureHereWithY:
DAD: Hm?\pWell, if it isn't {PLAYER}!
So you're all finished moving in?\pI'm surprised that you managed to
get here by yourself.\pOh, I see.
You're with your POKéMON.\pHm… Then I guess you're going to
become a TRAINER like me, {PLAYER}.\pThat's great news!
I'll be looking forward to it!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIdLikeAPokem: Um… I…\nI'd like to get a POKéMON, please…$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadOhYoureWallyRi: DAD: Hm? You're… Uh… Oh, right.\nYou're WALLY, right?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIveNeverCaug:
WALLY: I'm going to go stay with my
relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN.\pI thought I would be lonely by myself,
so I wanted to take a POKéMON along.\pBut I've never caught a POKéMON before.
I don't know how…$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadPlayerGoWithWa: DAD: {PLAYER}, you heard that,\nright?\pGo with WALLY and make sure that he\nsafely catches a POKéMON.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_IllLoanYouMyZigza: WALLY, here, I'll loan you my POKéMON.\pWALLY received a ZIGZAGOON!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouAndD: WALLY: Oh, wow!\nA POKéMON!\pDAD: Hm. I'll give you a POKé BALL, too.\nGo for it!\pWALLY received a POKé BALL!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadSoDidItWorkOut: DAD: So, did it work out?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye:
WALLY: Thank you, yes, it did.
Here's your POKéMON back.\p{PLAYER}, thank you for coming along
with me.\pYou two are why I was able to catch
my POKéMON.\pI promise I'll take really good
care of it.\pOh! My mom's waiting for me,
so I have to go!\pBye, {PLAYER}!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadge:
DAD: Now…\p{PLAYER}, if you want to become a
strong TRAINER, here's my advice.\pHead for RUSTBORO CITY beyond this
town.\pThere, you should challenge
the GYM LEADER, ROXANNE.\pAfter her, go on to other POKéMON
GYMS and defeat their LEADERS.\pCollect BADGES from them,
understood?\pOf course, I'm a GYM LEADER, too.
We'll battle one day, {PLAYER}.\pBut that's only after you become
stronger.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToRustbor:
DAD: Hm? Aren't you going to the
POKéMON GYM in RUSTBORO CITY?\pThere's no challenge for me to
battle a greenhorn TRAINER.\p{PLAYER}, I want you to challenge me
when you become a lot stronger.\pI'll battle you, {PLAYER}, when you
can show me four GYM BADGES, okay?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToDewford:
DAD: I see… So, you've beaten
the GYM LEADER in RUSTBORO CITY.\pBut there are many more TRAINERS
who are stronger than you, {PLAYER}.\pAcross the sea in DEWFORD TOWN is a
GYM LEADER named BRAWLY.\pYou should go challenge him.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_YouHaveGottenStro: DAD: Hm… {PLAYER}, you have gotten\nstronger.\pI can tell by the number of BADGES\nthat you've earned.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro:
DAD: Hm…
So, you did get four GYM BADGES.\pFine, as I promised, we will have
a POKéMON battle.\p{PLAYER}…\pI'm so happy that I can have
a real battle with my own child.\pBut, a battle is a battle!\pI will do everything in my power as
a GYM LEADER to win.\p{PLAYER}, you'd better give it your
best shot, too!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanDefeat: …\pI… I can't…\pI can't believe it. {PLAYER}…\pI lost to {PLAYER}?\pBut, rules are rules!\nHere, take this.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBad:
DAD: With that BADGE, the DEFENSE
of all your POKéMON will increase.\pPOKéMON that know the HM move SURF
will be able to travel over water.\pThis is my gift to you. {PLAYER}, I'm
sure you can use it correctly.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFacade: DAD: TM42 contains FACADE.\pIt doubles the power of moves if\nthe POKéMON is poisoned, paralyzed,\lor burned.\pIt might be able to turn a bad\nsituation into an advantage.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHappyAndSad: DAD: As the GYM LEADER, I can't\nexpress how upset I am…\pBut as a father, it makes me both\nhappy and a little sad. It's odd…$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_PleaseComeWithMe: Ah, there you are, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pPlease come with me.\nI have something I want you to have.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_LetMeBorrowPlayer: NORMAN, you don't mind, do you?\pLet me borrow your {PLAYER}{KUN} for\na minute or two.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTra:
DAD: {PLAYER}, you should go visit
your mother every so often.\pI'm going to stay here and redouble
my training.\pIt would bother me as a TRAINER to
not avenge my loss to you, {PLAYER}!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrai: DAD: {PLAYER}, how are things going?\pThe world of POKéMON is deep.\pI honestly think that no amount of\ntraining would ever be enough.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pThe doors in this GYM open when you
beat the awaiting TRAINERS.\pWhoops! The doors in this room are
already open, so don't attack me!\pThe TRAINERS of PETALBURG GYM
use all kinds of items.\pThe door at the left leads to
the SPEED ROOM.\pThe door at the right leads to
the ACCURACY ROOM.\pThe room's name will be on
the door, so choose carefully.\pOnce you've chosen the door…
Well, hey, go for it!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVicto: {PLAYER}! Whoa! You've overcome even\nyour own father!\pLike, whoa!\nWhat a stunning turn of events!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallIntro: The ability to attack before the\nopponent…\pJust that alone puts me at a great\nadvantage, don't you agree?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle: Go on to the next room where a new\nchallenge awaits you.\pAt the left is the CONFUSION ROOM.\pThe right door leads to the DEFENSE\nROOM.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBadge: Whomever you beat, and whomever you\nmay lose to, you never shirk from\ltraining yourself and your POKéMON.\pThat's what I think being a\nGYM LEADER is all about.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerIntro: This is the CONFUSION ROOM.\pLet me see how well bonded you are\nwith your POKéMON!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerDefeat: I couldn't confuse your team enough…\nYou share a strong bond together.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBattle: The next room is the STRENGTH ROOM.\nCan you withstand brute force?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBadge: After you beat our LEADER, the\ntraining has become a lot tougher.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro:
Just when you think you're going to
win, your opponent restores HP…\pCan you just imagine how awful that
must feel?\pI'll show you exactly how awful it
feels!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeDefeat: I couldn't restore HP enough…\nWhat ATTACK power…$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle:
I should have expected no less from
our LEADER's kid.\pNo, wait! A TRAINER's abilities are
earned only through effort.\pI lost because my own efforts
weren't enough.\pGo on! The ONE-HIT KO ROOM is next.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBadge: I'm going to keep training at GYMS.\nOne day, I'll become a LEADER.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeIntro: I'm not going to take it easy just\nbecause you're our LEADER's kid.\pI'll show you how horrid it is for\na POKéMON to take a critical hit!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle:
Your father really is strong.
He's a TRAINER worth my respect.\pAnd, I sense the same glow coming
from you as your father.\pI hope that you'll stage a terrific
battle with your father!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBadge: Since your dad became the LEADER,\nthe TRAINERS of PETALBURG CITY have\lbecome a lot tougher.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro: Giggle…\nThis is the ACCURACY ROOM.\pIt's pretty nasty when every attack\nlands without fail.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryDefeat: You were a cut above me…$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle:
There are some even stronger
TRAINERS waiting for you.\pThe left is the DEFENSE ROOM, and
the right is the RECOVERY ROOM.\pYour POKéMON's ATTACK power will be
on trial either way.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBadge: Do you know what we're trying to\nachieve as TRAINERS?\pWe're striving to become soul mates\nwith our POKéMON.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaIntro: The higher the DEFENSE, the more\nreckless I can be in attack.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle:
I think you've taught me a valuable
lesson here.\pNow, go on! The left door goes to
the STRENGTH ROOM.\pThe right door opens to
the ONE-HIT KO ROOM.\pBoth of them have TRAINERS who are
skilled at offense.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBadge: Hi! Have you tried using SURF?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyIntro: Our GYM LEADER told us to go all out\nand beat you.\pEven if you happen to be the\nLEADER's kid!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBattle: The way you use your POKéMON…\nIt's like your father's style.\pGo on through! The GYM LEADER, your\nfather, is waiting!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge: Sure, it's fine to make your POKéMON\nstronger.\pBut what decides the winner?\pWhy, it's the feelings TRAINERS have\nfor their POKéMON.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked: This door appears to be locked\nright now…$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterSpeedRoom: “SPEED ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked: This door appears to be locked\nright now…$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterAccuracyRoom: “ACCURACY ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterConfusionRoo: “CONFUSION ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterDefenseRoom: “DEFENSE ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterRecoveryRoom: “RECOVERY ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterStrengthRoom: “STRENGTH ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterOHKORoom: “ONE-HIT KO ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterGymLeadersRo: “GYM LEADER'S ROOM\p“See for yourself what POKéMON await\nyou!” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertifie: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM\pNORMAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch:
DAD: {PLAYER}…
I had a feeling that you would come.\pI would never refuse to accept
a challenge from you.\pYou do understand, don't you?\pInside a GYM, it doesn't matter that
we are a parent and child.\p…No, because we are parent and child,
we owe it to each other to do the best\lwe can. Isn't that right, {PLAYER}?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchDefe: Uh… Haha…\nMaybe that was going too hard…$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPostRematch: DAD: {PLAYER}…\nWhat is your dream?\pMy dream…\nHahaha…\lIt has already come true, actually.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Gym/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeed:
DAD: {PLAYER}…
I had a feeling that you would come.\pI would never refuse to accept
a challenge from you.\pYou do understand, don't you?\pInside a GYM, it doesn't matter that
we are a parent and child.\pHm? Wait a second, {PLAYER}.\pDo you only have one POKéMON that is
capable of battle?\pSorry, but you'll have to come back
with at least two POKéMON.$

data/maps/PetalburgCity_House1/scripts.i.PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWon: Traveling is wonderful!\pWhen I was young, I roamed the seas\nand the mountains!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_House1/scripts.i.PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure:
Sigh…\pI wish I could go on an adventure
with some POKéMON…\pCrawl through some damp grass…
Climb rocky, rugged mountains…\pCross the raging seas…
Wander about in dark caves…\pAnd, sometimes, even get a little
homesick…\pIt must be fabulous to travel!$

data/maps/PetalburgCity_House2/scripts.i.PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGy: NORMAN became our town's new\nGYM LEADER.\pI think he called his family over from\nsomewhere far away.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_House2/scripts.i.PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanO: I battled NORMAN once, but, whew,\nhe was way too strong.\pHow would I put it?\pI just got the feeling that he\nlives for POKéMON.$

data/maps/PetalburgCity_Mart/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStro: Even if a POKéMON is weak now,\nit will grow stronger.\pThe most important thing is love!\nLove for your POKéMON!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Mart/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful: Do you use REPEL?\nIt keeps POKéMON away, so it's\luseful when you're in a hurry.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_Mart/scripts.inc.PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidote: Do you have any ANTIDOTES with\nyou?\pIf you walk around with a poisoned\nPOKéMON, it will lose HP until it faints.\lTake some ANTIDOTES with you.$

data/maps/PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F.PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCSt: That PC-based POKéMON Storage\nSystem…\pWhoever made it must be some kind\nof a scientific wizard!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F.PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Oran: When my POKéMON ate an\nORAN BERRY, it regained HP!$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F.PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Many: There are many types of POKéMON.\pAll types have their strengths and\nweaknesses against other types.\pDepending on the types of POKéMON,\na battle could be easy or hard.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F.PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Tree:
For example, your TREECKO
is a GRASS type.\pIt's strong against the WATER and
GROUND types.\pBut, it's weak against FIRE-type
POKéMON.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F.PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Torc:
For example, your TORCHIC
is a FIRE type.\pIt's strong against the GRASS and
BUG types.\pBut, it's weak against WATER-type
POKéMON.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F.PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Mudk: For example, your MUDKIP\nis a WATER type.\pIt's strong against the FIRE type.\pBut, it's weak against GRASS-type\nand ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.$

data/maps/PetalburgCity_WallysHouse/scri.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksFor:
You're…
Ah, you must be {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?\pThank you for playing with WALLY a
little while ago.\pHe's been frail and sickly ever
since he was a baby.\pWe've sent him to stay with my relatives
in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.\pThe air is a lot cleaner there
than it is here.\pWhat's that? Where's WALLY?
He's already left, our WALLY.\pI wonder where he could have
gotten by now?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_WallysHouse/scri.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WonderHow: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_WallysHouse/scri.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExc:
{PLAYER}{KUN}! Please excuse us for
dragging you here this way.\pBut our WALLY's become very healthy
since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN.\pWe owe it all to you!\pWhen WALLY left town, you helped
him catch a POKéMON, right?\pI think that made WALLY really
happy.\pActually, not just WALLY.
It made me, his father, happy too.\pHappy that he's gained such a great
friend as you.\pThis isn't a bribe or anything, but
I'd really like you to have this.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_WallysHouse/scri.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_SurfGoAll: If your POKéMON can SURF, you'll be\nable to go to all sorts of places.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_WallysHouse/scri.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyIsCo: WALLY's coming home soon.\nI'm looking forward to that.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_WallysHouse/scri.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWal: Oh? You met WALLY in\nEVER GRANDE CITY?\pOh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, don't be silly.\pHe may have gotten healthy, but he\ncan't go somewhere far away like\lthat all by himself.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_WallysHouse/scri.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasR: WALLY was really happy when he told\nus that he caught a POKéMON.\pIt's been ages since I've seen him\nsmile like that.$
data/maps/PetalburgCity_WallysHouse/scri.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeft:
I want you to keep this a secret
from my husband…\pBut our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN
without telling anyone.\pYou know, WALLY is frail, but
he's surprisingly strong-willed.\pI'm sure that he'll come back safe
and sound one day!$

data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_NotAOneToBeFound: Hmmm…\nNot a one to be found…$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_HaveYouSeenShroomish: Hello, have you seen any POKéMON\ncalled SHROOMISH around here?\pI really love that POKéMON.$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_IWasGoingToAmbushYou: I was going to ambush you, but you\nhad to dawdle in PETALBURG WOODS\lforever, didn't you?\pI got sick of waiting, so here I am!$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_HandOverThosePapers: You! DEVON RESEARCHER!\pHand over those papers!$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_YouHaveToHelpMe: Aiyeeeh!\pYou're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?\nYou've got to help me, please!$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_NoOneCrossesTeamAqua: Hunh? What do you think you're doing?\nWhat, you're going to protect him?\pNo one who crosses TEAM AQUA\ngets any mercy, not even a kid!\pCome on and battle me!$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve:
Grrr… You've got some nerve
meddling with TEAM AQUA!\lCome on and battle me again!\pI wish I could say that, but I'm out of
POKéMON…\pAnd, hey, we of TEAM AQUA are also
after something in RUSTBORO.\pI'll let you go today!$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose:
Whew…
That was awfully close!\pThanks to you, he didn't rob me of
these important papers.\pI know, I'll give you a GREAT BALL as
my thanks!$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_TeamAquaAfterSomethi: Didn't that TEAM AQUA thug say\nthey were after something in\lRUSTBORO, too?$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_ICantBeWastingTime: Uh-oh! It's a crisis!\nI can't be wasting time!$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems: You're loaded with items.\nI can't give you this GREAT BALL.$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_GoBugPokemonTeam: I caught a whole bunch of POKéMON!\pGo, go, go!\nMy BUG POKéMON team!$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_ICouldntWin: I have all these POKéMON,\nbut I couldn't win…$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_ImOutOfPokeBalls: I caught a bunch of POKéMON.\nNow I'm out of POKé BALLS.$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_InstantlyPopularWith: If you take BUG POKéMON to school,\nyou get to be instantly popular!$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfILose: I can't be popular if I lose.$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_PeopleRespectYou: If you have a big BUG POKéMON,\npeople respect you for it.$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch1: I want a rematch when my BUG\nPOKéMON grow up!\pI'm registering you in my POKéNAV!$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch2: I want a rematch when my BUG \nPOKéMON grow up!\pI'm registering you in my POKéNAV!$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_MyPokemonHaveGrown: My BUG POKéMON have grown.\nI'll be popular again.$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfLose: I can't be popular if I lose.$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_IveBeenTrainingHard: You get to be popular if you have\nstrong POKéMON, right?\lSo, I've been training hard.$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass: Yo, there!\nYour POKéMON doing okay?\pIf your POKéMON are weak and you want\nto avoid battles, you should stay out\lof tall grass.$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanati: Sometimes, there are things on the\nground even if you can't see them.\pThat's why I always check where I'm\nwalking.$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem: Oh, neat!\nThat's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!\pYou must be a TRAINER.\nYou should try using this item.$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_MiracleSeedExplanati: It's a MIRACLE SEED.\nIf a POKéMON holds that item, its\lGRASS-type moves become stronger.\pBesides MIRACLE SEED, I think there are\nother convenient items for POKéMON\lto hold.$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperienc:
TRAINER TIPS\pAny POKéMON that appears even once
in a battle is awarded EXP Points.\pTo raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the
left of the team list.\pAs soon as a battle starts, switch it
out. It will earn EXP Points without\lbeing exposed to any harm.$
data/maps/PetalburgWoods/scripts.inc.PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP: TRAINER TIPS\pIn addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON\nhave Power Points (PP) that are used to\lmake moves during battle.\pIf a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be\ntaken to a POKéMON CENTER.$

data/maps/PewterCity_Frlg/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Text_GymSign: PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\lThe Rock-Solid POKéMON TRAINER!$

data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_Intro: BROCK: Wow, it's not often that we get a\nchallenger from JOHTO.\pI'm BROCK, the PEWTER GYM LEADER.\pI'm an expert on ROCK-type POKéMON.\pMy POKéMON are impervious to most\nphysical attacks. You'll have a hard\ltime inflicting any damage.\pCome on!$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_WinLoss: BROCK: Your POKéMON's powerful attacks\novercame my rock-hard defense…\pYou're stronger than I expected…\pGo ahead--take this BADGE.$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_GiveTM: Here, take this TM with you.$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_ExplainTM: It contains ROCK SLIDE.\pIt drops rocks on your opponents\nwith a chance to cause flinching.\pUse it to stop them in their tracks.$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_BoulderBadge: BROCK: {PLAYER}, thanks. I enjoyed\nbattling you, even though I am a bit\lupset.\pThat BOULDERBADGE will make your\nPOKéMON even more powerful.$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_FightDone: BROCK: The world is huge. There are\nstill many strong trainers like you.\pJust wait and see. I'm going to become\na lot stronger too.$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_CamperJerry_Seen: The trainers of this GYM use ROCK-type\nPOKéMON.\pThe ROCK-type has high DEFENSE.\pBattles could end up going a long time.\nAre you ready for this?$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_CamperJerry_Beaten: I have to win these battles…$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_CamperJerry_AfterBat: Hey, you! Trainer from JOHTO! BROCK is\ntough. He'll punish you if you don't\ltake him seriously.$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_Guide:
Yo! CHAMP in making! You're really
rocking.\pAre you battling the GYM LEADERS of
KANTO?\pThey're strong and dedicated people,
just like JOHTO's GYM LEADERS.$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_Guide_Win: Yo! CHAMP in making! That GYM didn't\ngive you much trouble.\pThe way you took charge was really\ninspiring. I mean that seriously.$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockWantToTrade:
BROCK: Hey, {PLAYER}. I found this
little BONSLY while training in the\lmountains.\pIt's cute, but I think it needs
a different kind of trainer.\pWould you trade a {STR_VAR_1}
for my {STR_VAR_2}?$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockTakeCare: BROCK: Thanks! Take good care of\nWOODY for me!$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockDeclineTrade: BROCK: No? That's okay.\nWOODY and I will keep training.$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockNotRequestedMon: BROCK: That's not a {STR_VAR_1}.\nThat's not what I'm after.$
data/maps/PewterCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockTradeCompleted: BROCK: How's WOODY doing?\nBONSLY are tougher than they look!$

data/maps/PewterCity_House2_hns/scripts..PewterCity_House2_Text_Gramps: I like snoozing with the radio on…\n…Zzzz…$

data/maps/PewterCity_Mart_hns/scripts.in.PewterCity_Mart_Text_Youngster: Hi! Check out my GYARADOS!\pI raised it from a MAGIKARP. I can't\nbelieve how strong it has become.$
data/maps/PewterCity_Mart_hns/scripts.in.PewterCity_Mart_Text_SuperNerd: There once was a weird old man who sold\nMAGIKARP.\pHe was saying the MAGIKARP from the\nLAKE OF RAGE were excellent.$

data/maps/PewterCity_Museum_1F_hns/scrip.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Recptionist: Welcome!\pJust to let you know, all the large\nspecimens have been taken to the\lother museums for display.\pSo for now, admission is free of\ncharge!\pPlease go ahead.$
data/maps/PewterCity_Museum_1F_hns/scrip.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_FossilWoman: You must be a strong trainer.\pWe don't have much use for the\nfossils on the counter over there.\pA strange man with silver hair\ndropped a ton of them off here.\pGo ahead and take them if you like.$
data/maps/PewterCity_Museum_1F_hns/scrip.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_FossilWomanAft: We often share research with the\nRUINS OF ALPH researchers.\pWe even share fossils with them\nthrough the PC!$
data/maps/PewterCity_Museum_1F_hns/scrip.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Oldman: I should be grateful for my long\nlife.\pNever did I think I would get to\nsee the bones of a dragon!$

data/maps/PewterCity_Museum_2F_hns/scrip.PewterCity_Museum_2F_Text_Nerd:
They say that meteorites struck
BIRTH ISLAND.\pWe would love to display them here
in our museum, but...\pThese meteorites are said to emit
strange energy and cannot be\lcarried away...$
data/maps/PewterCity_Museum_2F_hns/scrip.PewterCity_Museum_2F_Text_AskedDaddyToCa: I want a PIKACHU!\nIt's so cute!\pI asked my daddy to catch me one!$
data/maps/PewterCity_Museum_2F_hns/scrip.PewterCity_Museum_2F_Text_PikachuSoonIPr: Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!$
data/maps/PewterCity_Museum_2F_hns/scrip.PewterCity_Museum_2F_Text_MeteoriteThatF: A meteorite that fell on MT. MOON.\nIt is thought to be a MOON STONE.$

data/maps/PewterCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.PewterCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Teacher: …Yeah, and the GYM in CINNABAR's gone.\pI was really amazed.\p…Yes? I'm on the phone. Go away!$
data/maps/PewterCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_WantToTrad: I've been traveling all over, looking\nfor a good {STR_VAR_1}.\pWould you trade one for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$
data/maps/PewterCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_TakeCare: Thanks a bunch!\nTake good care of my {STR_VAR_1}!$
data/maps/PewterCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_DeclineTra: No? That's too bad…\nI think you'd like my HAUNTER.$
data/maps/PewterCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_NotRequest: Hmm, that's not a {STR_VAR_1}.\nThat's not what I'm looking for.$
data/maps/PewterCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_TradeCompl: How's that HAUNTER treating you?\nIt's a real trickster!$
data/maps/PewterCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.PewterCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_BugCatch: Most POKéMON get drowsy if they hear a\nJIGGLYPUFF singing.\pThere are several moves that can be\nused only while a POKéMON is asleep.$

data/maps/PewterCity_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Text_CooltrainerF: Have you visited PEWTER GYM?\pThe LEADER uses ROCK-type POKéMON.$
data/maps/PewterCity_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Text_BugCatcher: At night, CLEFAIRY come out to play at\nMT.MOON.\pBut not every night.$
data/maps/PewterCity_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Text_Gramps:
Ah, you came all the way out here from
JOHTO?\pThat brings back memories. When I was
young, I went to JOHTO to train.\pYou remind me so much of what I was like
as a young man.\pHere. I want you to have this item I
found in JOHTO.$
data/maps/PewterCity_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Text_Gramps_GotSilverWing: Going to new, unknown places and seeing\nnew people…\pThose are the joys of travel.$
data/maps/PewterCity_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Text_GymSign: PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pThe Rock Solid POKéMON Trainer$
data/maps/PewterCity_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Text_MuseumSign: There's a notice here…\pPEWTER MUSEUM OF SCIENCE is closed for\nrenovations…$
data/maps/PewterCity_hns/scripts.inc.PewterCity_Text_MtMoonGiftShopSign: There's a notice here…\pMT.MOON GIFT SHOP NOW OPEN!$

data/maps/PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_hns/s.PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_RematchBef:
BRUNO: Welcome back, young
warrior.\pThrough rigorous training, we have
grown stronger.\pMy rock-hard will is even more firm
and unyielding.\pAre you prepared to face an even
greater challenge?\pShow me the results of your
training.\pHoo hah!$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_hns/s.PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Before:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR.\pI always train to the extreme be-
cause I believe in our potential.\pThat is how we became strong.\pCan you withstand our power?\pHm? I see no fear in you. You look
determined. Perfect for battle!\pReady, {PLAYER}? You will bow down
to our overwhelming power!\pHoo hah!$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_hns/s.PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Defeat: Having lost, I have no right to\nsay anything…\pGo face your next challenge!$

data/maps/PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Fr.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakCong:
OAK: So, you've won!
Sincerely, congratulations!\pYou're the new POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\pYou've grown up so much since you
first left with {STR_VAR_1} to work\lon the POKéDEX.\p{PLAYER}, you have come of age!$

data/maps/PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_hn.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Rematch:
LANCE: Welcome back!\pYou've proven yourself in JOHTO,\pacquiring all 8 badges and even
besting me once.\pBut now, you're in the big
leagues.\pThe KANTO LEAGUE!\pA region with its own trials and
champions.\pHere, I am the final challenge,
with a team stronger than ever\lbefore.\pThis is the true test,\pa battle to determine the
CHAMPION of KANTO.\pAre you ready to rise to this new
challenge?\pTo prove yourself once more?\pShow me the strength that
conquered JOHTO, CHAMPION.$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_hn.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_BattleI:
LANCE: I've been waiting for you.\p{PLAYER}!\pI knew that you, with your skills,
would eventually reach me here.\pThere's no need for words now.\pWe will battle to determine who is
the stronger of the two of us.\pAs the most powerful trainer and as
the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION…\pI, LANCE the dragon master, accept
your challenge!$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_hn.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_BattleW: …It's over.\pBut it's an odd feeling.\pI'm not angry that I lost. In fact,\nI feel happy.\pHappy that I witnessed the rise\nof a great new CHAMPION!$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_hn.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_BattleA:
…Whew.\pYou have become truly powerful,
{PLAYER}.\pYour POKéMON have responded to your
strong and upstanding nature.\pAs a trainer, you will continue to
grow strong with your POKéMON.$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_hn.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_MaryOhN: MARY: Oh, no! It's all over!\pPROF.OAK, if you weren't so slow…$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_hn.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakCong:
PROF.OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pIt's been a long while.\pYou certainly look more impressive.\pYour conquest of the JOHTO LEAGUE
is just fantastic!\pYour dedication, trust and love for
your POKéMON made this happen.\pYour POKéMON were outstanding too.\pBecause they believed in you as a
trainer, they persevered.\pCongratulations, {PLAYER}!$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_hn.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Rematch:
PROF.OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pI've been following your progress
since PROF.ELM sent you on your\lway.\pYou've certainly become more
impressive.\pConquering both the JOHTO and now
the KANTO LEAGUE is no small feat.\pYou've truly outdone yourself!\pIt's clear that your POKéMON trust
you immensely,\pand that trust has been the
foundation of your success.\pBut remember, a trainer's journey
is never truly over.\pCongratulations on your victory,
{PLAYER}!$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_hn.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_MaryInt: MARY: Let's interview the brand new\nJOHTO CHAMPION!$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_hn.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Rematch: MARY: Let's interview the brand new\nKANTO CHAMPION!$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_hn.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Noisy: LANCE: This is getting to be a bit\ntoo noisy…\p{PLAYER}, could you come with me?$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_hn.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_MaryNoI: MARY: Oh, wait! We haven't done\nthe interview!$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_hn.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Rematch: MARY: Come on! You can't blow off\nthe interview AGAIN!$

data/maps/PokemonLeague_HallOfFame_hns/s.PokemonLeague_HallOfFame_LanceText:
LANCE: It's been a long time since I
last came here.\pThis is where we honor the LEAGUE
CHAMPIONS for all eternity.\pTheir courageous POKéMON are also
inducted.\pHere today, we witnessed the rise
of a new LEAGUE CHAMPION--a\ptrainer who feels compassion for,
and trust toward, all POKéMON.\pA trainer who succeeded through
perseverance and determination.\pThe new LEAGUE CHAMPION who has
all the makings of greatness!\p{PLAYER}, allow me to register you
and your partners as CHAMPIONS!$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_HallOfFame_hns/s.PokemonLeague_HallOfFame_Rematch_LanceTe:
LANCE: I remember, it wasn't long ago
I stood here, welcoming you as\pthe CHAMPION of JOHTO.\pAnd now, here we are again, in this
sacred place where we honor the very\pbest trainers and their POKéMON.\pToday, you've proven yourself not
just in JOHTO, but in KANTO as well,\lbesting even my strongest team.\pYou've shown remarkable compassion
and trust in your POKéMON,\la bond that has carried you to\lvictory time and again.\pYour journey, marked by
perseverance and unwavering\ldetermination,\lspeaks to your true spirit as a\ltrainer.\pYou have all the makings of a true
great, perhaps even the greatest.\p{PLAYER}, it is my honor to register
you, and your trusted partners,\las champions once again.$

data/maps/PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_hns/s.PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_Text_RematchBef:
KAREN: Ah, it's you again.\pI trust you haven't forgotten
my belief:\pTrue strength arises from trust
in one's POKéMON.\pSince our last encounter, my
bond with my POKéMON has\ldeepened further.\pAre you ready to face a team
united by an unbreakable bond?\pShow me the power of the bond
with your POKéMON.$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_hns/s.PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_Text_Before: I am KAREN of the ELITE FOUR.\pYou're {PLAYER}? How amusing.\pI love DARK-type POKéMON.\pI find their wild, tough image\nto be so appealing. And they're\lso strong.\pThink you can take them?\nJust try to entertain me.\pLet's go.$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_hns/s.PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_Text_Beaten: Well, aren't you good. I like that\nin a trainer.$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_hns/s.PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_Text_Defeat:
Strong POKéMON.\pWeak POKéMON.\pThat is only the selfish
perception of people.\pTruly skilled trainers should
try to win with their favorites.\pI like your style. You understand
what's important.\pGo on--the CHAMPION is waiting.$

data/maps/PokemonLeague_KogasRoom_hns/sc.PokemonLeague_KogasRoom_Text_RematchBefo: KOGA: Fwahahahaha!\pYou return, brave challenger.\pMy ninja skills have sharpened.\pNew sinister traps await you.\pPoison, sleep, and more...\nBe ready!\pFwahahahaha!\pShow me how you've grown!$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_KogasRoom_hns/sc.PokemonLeague_KogasRoom_Text_Before:
Fwahahahaha!\pI am KOGA of the ELITE FOUR.\pI live in shadows, a ninja!\pMy intricate style will confound
and destroy you!\pConfusion, sleep, poison…\pPrepare to be the victim of my
sinister technique!\pFwahahahaha!\pPOKéMON is not merely about brute
force--you shall see soon enough!$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_KogasRoom_hns/sc.PokemonLeague_KogasRoom_Text_Defeat:
I subjected you to everything I
could muster.\pBut my efforts failed. I must hone
my skills.\pGo on to the next room, and put
your abilities to test!$

data/maps/PokemonLeague_WillsRoom_hns/sc.PokemonLeague_WillsRoom_Text_Before:
Welcome to POKéMON LEAGUE,
{PLAYER}.\pAllow me to introduce myself.
I am WILL.\pI have trained all around the
world, making my psychic\lPOKéMON powerful.\pAnd, at last, I've been accepted
into the ELITE FOUR.\pI can only keep getting better!\pLosing is not an option!$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_WillsRoom_hns/sc.PokemonLeague_WillsRoom_Text_Defeat:
Even though I was defeated, I
won't change my course.\pI will continue battling until I
stand above all trainers!\pNow, {PLAYER}, move on and
experience the true ferocity of\lthe ELITE FOUR.$
data/maps/PokemonLeague_WillsRoom_hns/sc.PokemonLeague_WillsRoom_Text_RematchBefo:
WILL: Ah, welcome back.\pI have foreseen this encounter.\pMy psychic POKéMON and
I have evolved, developing\lnew tactics.\pPrepare yourself for a battle of
enhanced strategy and might.\pLet us see if your foresight
matches mine.$

data/maps/PoniIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Poni_TotemBattle_Text_1: Totem ELECTIVIRE was defeated!\nIt scampered off somewhere…$
data/maps/PoniIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Poni_Totem_sign_Text_0: The totem is emanating a strong\nenergy…\pTouch the totem to teleport to another\nIsle?$
data/maps/PoniIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Poni_Totem_sign_Text_5: A strange totem stands here,\npower is emanating from it…$
data/maps/PoniIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Poni_TrainerBattleSwimmer1_Text_2: I've swam into so many cool POKéMON!\nIt must be something in the water.$
data/maps/PoniIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Poni_TrainerBattleSwimmer2_Text_2: The current is great for tubing.\nI don't think I'll tube anywhere else!$
data/maps/PoniIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Poni_NPC_girl_Text_0: PONI ISLE is my favorite.\nThe wilderness just speaks for itself!$
data/maps/PoniIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Poni_Bench_Heal_Text_0: Would you like to take a rest on this\nbench?$

data/maps/ReceptionGate_hns/scripts.inc.ReceptionGate_Text_Janine:
JANINE: I'm on the way to my dad's
house to give him his lunch.\pThe ELITE FOUR has no time to rest
day or night. It's such hard work,\lyou know?\pIf you're ready for another battle,
I'll be at the DOJO later.$
