data/maps/ReceptionGate_hns/scripts.inc.VictoryRoadGate_Text_Officer: Only trainers who have proven\nthemselves may pass.$
data/maps/ReceptionGate_hns/scripts.inc.VictoryRoadGate_Text_Kimono: Sorry kid, this way is closed until\nsomeone deals with that LEGENDARY\lPOKéMON...$
data/maps/ReceptionGate_hns/scripts.inc.VictoryRoadGate_Text_NotEnoughBadges: You don't have all the GYM BADGES\nof JOHTO.\pI'm sorry, but I can't let you go\nthrough.$
data/maps/ReceptionGate_hns/scripts.inc.VictoryRoadGate_Text_EightBadges: Oh! The eight BADGES of JOHTO!\pPlease, go right on through!$
data/maps/ReceptionGate_hns/scripts.inc.VictoryRoadGate_Text_LeftBlackBelt: This way leads to MT.SILVER.\pYou'll see scary-strong POKéMON out\nthere.$
data/maps/ReceptionGate_hns/scripts.inc.VictoryRoadGate_Text_RightBlackBelt: Off to the POKéMON LEAGUE, are you?\pThe ELITE FOUR are so strong it's\nscary, and they're ready for you!$

data/maps/RocketHideout_B1F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B1F_Text_CameraGrunt2Seen: It's my turn! There's no escape!$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B1F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B1F_Text_CameraGrunt2Beate: Surveillance cams are in the\nPOKéMON statues.\pWe'll keep appearing until you\ntrip a secret switch.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B1F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B1F_Text_ScientistJedSeen: This was once a ninja hideout.\pThere are traps to confound\nintruders like you.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B1F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B1F_Text_ScientistJedAfter:
All right. I'll divulge a secret
about our hideout.\pThat thing on the floor up ahead
is a warp panel.\pIf you step on it, you'll be
warped back to the entrance.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B1F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B1F_Text_GruntM16After: I don't even know where the traps\nare planted.\pYou'll just have to collect your\ncourage and walk.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B1F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B1F_Text_SecretSwitch: A secret switch! Better press it.$

data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_MurkrowUnlock: MURKROW screamed the password,\nmimicking the voice of PETREL.\p..................\nThe voice-recognition system\lunlocked the door!$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_ArianaChallenge:
ARIANA: We can't let a brat like you
do as you please forever.\pIt'll hurt Team Rocket's pride over
and over again. Making it lessen,\lyou see.\p...So, it's time to finish you.
However strong you may be,\pif the two of us fight at the same
time, you'll have no chance of\lwinning. Don't you agree?\pHee hee hee! Sorry, baby.
Now, get ready to be thrashed.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceInterrupt: LANCE: Hold it!\nA two-on-one battle?\pThat is so unfair!\nTypical of Team Rocket to be so\lsneaky.\pAllow me to join the battle!$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_ArianaOutraged: ARIANA: What? You had an accomplice?\nWhere is your sense of dignity?\pAs interim boss in place of GIOVANNI,\nI'll show you how wrong it is to meddle\lwith Team Rocket!$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_ArianaLoss: Tch, you really are strong.\nIt's too bad.\pIf you were to join Team Rocket,\nyou could become an Executive.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_Text_ArianaRetreat:
ARIANA: But that's fine.
The broadcast experiment was a\ltotal success.\pIt doesn't matter what happens to
this hideout now.\pWe have much bigger plans.
You'll come to appreciate Team\lRocket's true power soon enough.\pEnjoy yourself while you can...
Hee hee hee...$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_Text_LanceStepBack: Sorry, {PLAYER}. I saw how well you\nwere doing, so I just hung back.\pNow all there is left to do is to turn\noff that odd radio signal.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceElectrodeFai:
It's this machine that's causing
all the problems.\pI don't see a switch on it…\pWe have no choice. We have to
make all the ELECTRODE faint.\pThat should stop this machine
from transmitting that strange\lsignal.\pIt's no fault of the POKéMON, so
it makes me feel guilty.\p{PLAYER}, let's split the job.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceSide: LANCE: Leave this side to me.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceElectrodeDon:
LANCE: That odd signal has
finally stopped.\pThe LAKE should be back to
normal.\pYou're the hero! Let me thank
you on behalf of all the\lPOKéMON.\pOh, yes. You should take this.
I found it here, but I don't\lhave any need for it.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceWhirlpool: That's WHIRLPOOL. Teach it to a\nPOKéMON to get across wild water.\pBut keep this in mind.\pYou can use that out of battle\nonly with the BADGE from\lMAHOGANY GYM.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceMonMaster:
{PLAYER}…\pThe journey to becoming the
POKéMON MASTER is long and\ldifficult.\pKnowing that, will you keep
going?\p…\pI see. No, you're right.\pIf you would give up that easily,
you would have never chased that\ldream in the first place.\pI look forward to seeing you
again!$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_B2FTransmitter: It's the radio transmitter that's\nsending the sinister signal.\pIt's working at full capacity.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_B2FDeactivateTran: The radio transmitter has finally\nstopped its evil broadcast.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceHeals1: LANCE: Are you all right?\pYour POKéMON are hurt and tired.\pHere, give them some of my\nmedicine.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceHeals2: LANCE: {PLAYER}, let's give it\nour best for POKéMON.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM17Seen: The door won't open?\pWell, duh. It has to have a\npassword that only TEAM ROCKET\lknows.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM17After: Heh, I'm just a GRUNT.\pI don't know the password.\nToo bad for you.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM18Seen: Oh, a kid? I don't really like\nthis, but eliminate you I must.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM18After: I got wiped out on the last\nmission by a kid too.\pWhen we were abducting POKéMON,\nthis kid with long red hair and\lmean-looking eyes just\lcreamed me…$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B2F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM19After: Heh, only the boss knows the\npassword for that door.\pWhere's the boss? Who knows?\nGo look for yourself.$

data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_LanceGetPassword:
LANCE: It takes two passwords
to get into the boss' quarters.\pThose passwords are known only
to a few ROCKETS.\pThat ROCKET there very graciously
told me so.\p{PLAYER}, let's go get the
passwords.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_B3FRocket: Urrggh… The guy in the cape is\nincredibly tough…$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_B3FLockedDoorNeed: The door's closed…\pIt needs two passwords to open.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_B3FLockedDoorOpen: The door's closed…\p{PLAYER} entered the two passwords.\pThe door opened!$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Rival:
…\pDidn't I tell you that I was
going to destroy TEAM ROCKET?\p…Tell me, who was the guy in the
cape who used dragon POKéMON?\pMy POKéMON were no match at all.\pIt's what he said that bothers
me…\pHe told me that I don't love and
trust my POKéMON enough.\pIt's not my fault my team is so
useless.\pI'm furious that I lost to a
bleeding heart like him.\pBut it makes me question myself.\pIs there something I'm doing
wrong?\pCould it be that love made his
team so powerful?$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelIntro:
Muhahaha, we've been waiting
for you. So, you are {PLAYER}...\pMe? You don't know who I am?
It is me, GIOVANNI.\pThe majestic GIOVANNI himself!
Wahahaha!$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelDisbelief: ...Huh?\nI don't sound anything like\lGIOVANNI?\pI don't even look like GIOVANNI?\nHow come? I've worked so hard\lto mimic him!$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelReveal:
PETREL: I am a Team Rocket
Executive!\pYou must be trying to sneak into
the radio-transmitter room.\pWell, that's not going to happen.
That room is protected with a\lspecial password.\pThe password is “Hail GIOVANNI.”
Surprised to hear it from me?\pKnowing the password won't help
you though.\pThe door won't open unless I say
the password. It only reacts to\lmy voice.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelBeaten: I… I couldn't do a thing…\pGIOVANNI, please forgive me…$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelAfterBattle:
PETREL: Since disbanding Team
Rocket three years ago, our\lGIOVANNI has been missing.\pBut we're certain he's been
waiting for the right time for\lour revival... Wahahaha!\pLosing to you won't change the
fact that you are unable to get\lin the radio-transmitter room!\pYou need my voice to unlock it!$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_MurkrowMimic: MURKROW is mimicking\nthe voice of PETREL!\pYou may be able to...!?$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntF5Seen: Do I know the password?\pMaybe.\pBut no weakling's going to get\nit!$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntF5Beaten: All right. Stop. I'll tell you.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntF5After: The password to the boss' room\nis SLOWPOKETAIL.\pBut it's useless unless you have\ntwo passwords.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntM28Seen: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!\pI remember you from the well!\pYou're challenging me again?\pHah! You're nuts, but you have\nguts!\pI'll warn you, I got better!\pIf you can beat me, I'll tell\lyou a password to the boss'\nroom!$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntM28After: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!\pThe password to the boss' room…\pUh…, I think it is RATICATE TAIL.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistRossSeen: I used to work for SILPH, but now\nI run research for TEAM ROCKET.\pA meddlesome child like you needs\nto be punished.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistRossBeat: A mere tactical error cost me…$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistRossAfte:
A radio signal that drives
POKéMON mad…\pMy experiment is a complete
success.\pMy promotion is assured. This
loss means absolutely nothing.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistMitchSee: I don't care that POKéMON are hurt\nby our experiment.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistMitchBea: Thinking is my strong suit, not\nbattling.$
data/maps/RocketHideout_B3F_hns/scripts..RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistMitchAft: If we turn up the power of our\nradio signal for broadcast\lnationwide…\pThe very thought excites me!$

data/maps/Route101/scripts.inc.Route101_Text_PleaseHelp: Hello! You over there!\nPlease! Help!\pIn my BAG!\nThere's a POKé BALL!$
data/maps/Route101/scripts.inc.Route101_Text_DontLeaveMe: Wh-Where are you going?!\nDon't leave me like this!$
data/maps/Route101/scripts.inc.Route101_Text_YouSavedMe:
PROF. BIRCH: Whew…\pI was in the tall grass studying wild
POKéMON when I was jumped.\pYou saved me.
Thanks a lot!\pOh?\pHi, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pThis is not the place to chat, so come
by my POKéMON LAB later, okay?$
data/maps/Route101/scripts.inc.Route101_Text_TakeTiredPokemonToPokeCent: If POKéMON get tired, take them to\na POKéMON CENTER.\pThere's a POKéMON CENTER in OLDALE\nTOWN right close by.$
data/maps/Route101/scripts.inc.Route101_Text_WildPokemonInTallGrass: Wild POKéMON will jump out at you in\ntall grass.\pIf you want to catch POKéMON, you have\nto go into the tall grass and search.$

data/maps/Route102/scripts.inc.Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon: WALLY: {PLAYER}…\nPOKéMON hide in tall grass like this,\ldon't they?\pPlease watch me and see if I can\ncatch one properly.\p…Whoa!$
data/maps/Route102/scripts.inc.Route102_Text_WallyIDidIt: WALLY: I did it… It's my…\nMy POKéMON!$
data/maps/Route102/scripts.inc.Route102_Text_LetsGoBack: {PLAYER}, thank you!\nLet's go back to the GYM!$
data/maps/Route102/scripts.inc.Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall: I'm…not very tall, so I sink right\ninto tall grass.\pThe grass goes up my nose and…\nFwafwafwafwafwa…\pFwatchoo!$
data/maps/Route102/scripts.inc.Route102_Text_CatchWholeBunchOfPokemon: I'm going to catch a whole bunch of\nPOKéMON!$

data/maps/Route103/scripts.inc.Route103_Text_MayRoute103Pokemon: MAY: Let's see… The POKéMON found\non ROUTE 103 include…$
data/maps/Route103/scripts.inc.Route103_Text_MayLetsBattle:
Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\p…Oh, I see, my dad gave you
a POKéMON as a gift.\pSince we're here, let's have a quick
battle!\pI'll give you a taste of what being
a TRAINER is like.$
data/maps/Route103/scripts.inc.Route103_Text_MayDefeated: Wow! That's great!\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, you're pretty good!$
data/maps/Route103/scripts.inc.Route103_Text_MayTimeToHeadBack:
MAY: I think I know why my dad has
an eye out for you now.\pI mean, you just got that POKéMON,
but it already likes you.\pYou might be able to befriend any
kind of POKéMON easily.\pWell, it's time to head back to
the LAB.$
data/maps/Route103/scripts.inc.Route103_Text_BrendanRoute103Pokemon: BRENDAN: Okay, so it's this one and\nthat one that live on ROUTE 103…$
data/maps/Route103/scripts.inc.Route103_Text_BrendanLetsBattle: Hey, it's {PLAYER}!\p…Oh, yeah, Dad gave you a POKéMON.\pSince we're here, how about a little\nbattle?\pI'll teach you what being a TRAINER's\nabout!$
data/maps/Route103/scripts.inc.Route103_Text_BrendanTimeToHeadBack:
BRENDAN: I think I get it.
I think I know why my dad has his eye\lout for you now.\pLook, your POKéMON already likes you,
even though you just got it.\p{PLAYER}, I get the feeling that you
could befriend any POKéMON with ease.\pWe should head back to the LAB.$
data/maps/Route103/scripts.inc.Route103_Text_ShouldHaveBroughtPotion: My POKéMON is staggeringly tired…\nI should have brought a POTION…$
data/maps/Route103/scripts.inc.Route103_Text_ShortcutToOldale: If you cross the sea from here,\nit'll be a shortcut to OLDALE TOWN.\pFufufu, that's useful, isn't it?$

data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_BrineyLivesInSeasideCottag: That seaside cottage is where\nMR. BRINEY lives.\pHe was once a mighty sailor who never\nfeared the sea, however stormy.$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_WhatsItLikeAtBottomOfSea: The sea, huh?\pI wonder what it's like at the bottom\nof the sea?$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_ThrowBallAtWeakenedPokemon: If you're going to throw a POKé BALL,\nweaken the wild POKéMON first.\pIt will be easier to catch if it's been\npoisoned, burned, or lulled to sleep.$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_OnlyThrowBallAtWildPokemon: You're a thief if you try to steal\nsomeone else's POKéMON.\pYou should throw POKé BALLS only at\nwild POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_ImNotATrainer: Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER.\pBut that's right, if TRAINERS lock eyes,\nit's a challenge to battle.\pIf you don't want to battle, stay out\nof their sight.$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_LikeFillingMouthWithSeedsT: I like filling my mouth with seeds,\nthen spitting them out fast!\pYou can have this, so you try it out!\pUse it on a POKéMON, and it will learn\na move for firing seeds rapidly.$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_TMsAreOneTimeUse: A word of advice!\pA TM, TECHNICAL MACHINE, is good only\nfor one-time use.\pOnce you use it, it's gone.\nThink twice before using it!$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_DontNeedThisTakeIt:
This FLOWER SHOP started selling
saplings recently.\pIt made me so happy, I went overboard
shopping.\pI don't need this WHITE HERB anymore.
Would you take it, please?$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_FlowerShopSellingSaplings: This FLOWER SHOP started selling\nsaplings recently.\pIt made me so happy, I went overboard\nshopping. Where should I put them?$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_TrainerTipsDoubleBattles: TRAINER TIPS\pIn the HOENN region there are pairs\nof TRAINERS who challenge others\lfor 2-on-2 POKéMON battles called\lDOUBLE BATTLES.\pIn a DOUBLE BATTLE, the TRAINER must\nsend out two POKéMON, the one at the\lleft of the list and the top one.\lWatch how POKéMON are lined up.$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_MayWeShouldRegister: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pDEVON upgraded your POKéNAV with\nthe MATCH CALL system, huh?\pWe should register each other so we\ncan get in contact anytime.$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_MayHowsYourPokedex: MAY: Oh, by the way, {PLAYER}{KUN},\nhow's your POKéDEX coming along?$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_MayMinesDecentLetsBattle: Mine's looking pretty decent.\nSo…\lHow about a little battle?$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_MayHaventRaisedPokemon: MAY: Oh, what's the matter?\pHaven't you caught or raised your\nPOKéMON very much?\pThat's not very good for a TRAINER!$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_MayLetsBattle: MAY: So, what do you think?\nHow about a little battle here?$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_MayIntro: MAY: You just became a TRAINER,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_MayPostBattle:
MAY: I can tell you've gotten pretty
good with the way you handle POKéMON.\pBut instead of only making them
battle, you should be like MR. BRINEY.\pIt's important to become friends with
POKéMON, too.$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_BrendanWeShouldRegister: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pCool, you had DEVON install the MATCH\nCALL system on your POKéNAV!\pLet's register each other in our\nPOKéNAVS so we can keep in touch.$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_BrendanHowsYourPokedex: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX?\nHave you filled in any pages yet?$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_BrendanDoingGreatLetsBattl: Me, I'm doing great!\pWant to check out how good I am with\na battle?$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_BrendanNoConfidence: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have\nany confidence in your POKéMON?$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_BrendanLetsBattle: BRENDAN: What's up?\nWant to have a battle with me?$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_BrendanIntro: BRENDAN: I know you just became\na TRAINER, but I won't go easy!$
data/maps/Route104/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_BrendanPostBattle:
BRENDAN: You've gotten pretty decent
at handling POKéMON.\pBut, you know, you shouldn't just be
making POKéMON battle.\pLike MR. BRINEY, it's important to
become friends with your POKéMON.$

data/maps/Route104_MrBrineysHouse/script.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WaitUpPeeko: MR. BRINEY: Hold on, lass!\nWait up, PEEKO!$
data/maps/Route104_MrBrineysHouse/script.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsS:
Hm? You're {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You saved my darling PEEKO!\lWe owe so much to you!\pWhat's that?
You want to sail with me?\pHmhm…\pYou have a LETTER bound for DEWFORD
and a package for SLATEPORT, then?\pQuite the busy life you must lead!\pBut, certainly, what you're asking is
no problem at all.\pYou've come to the right man!
We'll set sail for DEWFORD.$
data/maps/Route104_MrBrineysHouse/script.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_SetSailForD: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$
data/maps/Route104_MrBrineysHouse/script.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_DeclineDeli: MR. BRINEY: Is that so?\nYour deliveries can wait?\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!$
data/maps/Route104_MrBrineysHouse/script.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToMakeD:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!\pYou're to deliver a LETTER to DEWFORD
and a package to SLATEPORT.\pWhat you need me to do is no problem
at all--I'm the man for the job!\pFirst, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.$
data/maps/Route104_MrBrineysHouse/script.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToDeliv:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!\pYou're to deliver a package to
CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT.\pWhat you need me to do is no problem
at all--I'm the man for the job!\pFirst, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.$
data/maps/Route104_MrBrineysHouse/script.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WhereAreWeB: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\pNow, my friend, where are we bound?$
data/maps/Route104_MrBrineysHouse/script.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_TellMeWhene: MR. BRINEY: Is that so?\nWell, PEEKO owes her life to you.\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!$

data/maps/Route105/scripts.inc.Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pDAD: Oh, {PLAYER}?\p… … … … … …
Where are you now?\lIt sounds windy wherever you are.\pI just heard from DEVON's MR. STONE
about your POKéNAV, so I decided\lto give you a call.\pIt sounds like you're doing fine,
so that's fine with me.\pYou take care now.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$

data/maps/Route106/scripts.inc.Route106_Text_TrainerTips: TRAINER TIPS\pAdvice on catching POKéMON with a ROD:\nPress the A Button if you get a bite.$

data/maps/Route109/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateport: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've made land in SLATEPORT!\pI suppose you're going to visit CAPT.\nSTERN and deliver the DEVON GOODS?$
data/maps/Route109/scripts.inc.Route109_Text_BrineySailToDewfordQuestio: MR. BRINEY: I thought you're supposed\nto deliver the DEVON GOODS.\pWould you like to sail back to\nDEWFORD, then?$
data/maps/Route109/scripts.inc.Route109_Text_BrineyDewfordItIs: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$
data/maps/Route109/scripts.inc.Route109_Text_BrineyDeliverDevonGoods: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver\nthe DEVON GOODS. I'll be waiting.$
data/maps/Route109/scripts.inc.DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateport: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've made land in\nSLATEPORT!\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail again!$
data/maps/Route109/scripts.inc.Route109_Text_BrineyWhereAreWeBound: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\pNow, my friend, where are we bound?$
data/maps/Route109/scripts.inc.Route109_Text_BrineyTellMeWhenYouNeedToS: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever\nyou need to set sail again!$
data/maps/Route109/scripts.inc.Route109_Text_ChillAtMyPapasSpot: Yo, TRAINERS!\nWhether you're hot to trot,\lor cool cat not,\lchill at my papa's spot!$
data/maps/Route109/scripts.inc.Route109_Text_LittleKidsDartAround: Little kids can dart around so quickly…\pYou don't dare take your eyes off them\nfor an instant. It's very taxing.\pMine are with my POKéMON, so they\nshould be okay, but…$
data/maps/Route109/scripts.inc.Route109_Text_SandCastleTakingLongTime: Our sand castle's taking a long time\nto make.$
data/maps/Route109/scripts.inc.Route109_Text_WereGoingToMakeBigCastle: We're going to get all the sand from\nthe beach and make a big castle!\pAnd then we're going to be a king and\nqueen.\pWe'll let you be a servant.$
data/maps/Route109/scripts.inc.Route109_Text_ZigzagoonPicksUpLitter:
The water around these parts is clean.\pBut, I get my ZIGZAGOON to pick up
litter from the shoreline at times.\pDirty water becomes rain and joins our
rivers, which we drink from…\pIf we pollute the sea, it all comes
back to haunt us eventually.$
data/maps/Route109/scripts.inc.Route109_Text_SeashoreHouseSign: SEASHORE HOUSE\p“May hot battles rage on hot sands!\nThe place for hot TRAINERS!”$
data/maps/Route109/scripts.inc.Route109_Text_TrainerTipsSign: TRAINER TIPS\pPOKéMON at the same level may not\nalways have identical stats.\pPOKéMON raised by TRAINERS are said\nto grow stronger than wild POKéMON.$

data/maps/Route109_SeashoreHouse/scripts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SeashoreHous:
I'm the owner of the SEASHORE HOUSE.
But you can call me MR. SEA!\pWhat I love above all is to see hot
POKéMON battles.\pLet me see that your heart burns hot!\pIf you can defeat all the TRAINERS
here, I'll reward your efforts.$
data/maps/Route109_SeashoreHouse/scripts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_ShowMeSomeHo: Show me some hot matches!\pI run this SEASHORE HOUSE just for\nthat reason alone!$
data/maps/Route109_SeashoreHouse/scripts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_TakeTheseSod: You're scorching hot!\nThose battles blazed!\lI'm more than just satisfied!\pAs thanks for showing me your hot\nstreak, I want you to take these.\pIt's half a dozen bottles of SODA POP!$
data/maps/Route109_SeashoreHouse/scripts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_BagFull: Oh, but hey, your BAG's jammed full.\nI'll hang on to these for you.$
data/maps/Route109_SeashoreHouse/scripts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_WantToBuySod: Want to buy some SODA POP?\nPOKéMON love it!\pJust ¥300 a bottle!\nBuy some!$
data/maps/Route109_SeashoreHouse/scripts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneIntro: If you're looking for a battle in the\nSEASHORE HOUSE, you'll find no\lhotter TRAINER than me, matey!$
data/maps/Route109_SeashoreHouse/scripts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneDefeat: That was a hot battle!\nI can accept that loss, matey!$
data/maps/Route109_SeashoreHouse/scripts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwaynePostBa: Whenever I'm in SLATEPORT, I enjoy\nhot battles and ice-cold SODA POP!$
data/maps/Route109_SeashoreHouse/scripts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaIntro: Boring battles aren't worth the effort.\pFiery hot battles are what toughen up\nTRAINERS and POKéMON!$
data/maps/Route109_SeashoreHouse/scripts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaPostB: Whew, I'm all thirsty.\nMaybe I'll have a SODA POP.$
data/maps/Route109_SeashoreHouse/scripts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonIntro: I'm going to show you how great\nmy POKéMON are, but don't cry!$
data/maps/Route109_SeashoreHouse/scripts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonPostBat: If one of my POKéMON knew the move\nfor carrying me across water on its\lback, I could get rid of this inner tube.$

data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_hns.Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_Text_ManagerW:
MANAGER: I, I, I'm ready to blast
someone!\pWho would dare ruin my
generator?\pI spent so much time on it!\pIf I catch him, he's going to
get a taste of my ZAP CANNON!$
data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_hns.Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_Text_ManagerI: MANAGER: I won't forgive him!\pThe culprit can cry and\napologize,\pbut I'll still hammer him!\pGahahahah!$
data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_hns.Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_Text_ManagerT: MANAGER: Ah! Yeah!\pThat's the missing PART from my\nbeloved generator! You found it?$
Wahah! Thanks!\pHere! Take this TM as a reward!$
MANAGER: That TM is THUNDER.\pIt's a powerful technique!\pIt's not what anyone would\nconsider accurate, but it packs a\lwallop!$
data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_hns.Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_Text_ManagerM: MANAGER: My beloved generator!\pKeep pumping the electricity out!$
data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_hns.Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_Text_Engineer: This door is unsafe without power.$

data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_hns.Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Officer1: A thief broke into the POWER\nPLANT…\pWhat is the world coming to?$
I just got word from CERULEAN.\pIt appears that a shady\ncharacter has been loitering\laround.$
We'll have to beef up our\nsecurity presence.$
data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_hns.Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Engineer: Someone made off with a part\nthat's essential for the\lgenerator.\pWithout it, the new generator's\nuseless!$
The generator's up and running.\nIt's making electricity to spare.$
This POWER PLANT had been\nabandoned in the past.\pWe got it back up and running to\nprovide power to the MAGNET\lTRAIN.$
data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_hns.Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Officer2: The POWER PLANT's MANAGER is in\nthe back room with the generator.\pBut since someone wrecked the\ngenerator, he's been both sad and\lfurious…$
Since the generator's been fixed,\nthe MANAGER has been cheerful.$
data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_hns.Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Engineer: The MAGNET TRAIN consumes a lot\nof electricity.\pIt can't move if the new\ngenerator isn't operating.$
data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_hns.Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_WantToTr:
I work here at the POWER PLANT.
My MAGNETON's been my partner\lfor years.\pBut I've always wanted a
{STR_VAR_1}.\pWould you trade one for my
{STR_VAR_2}?$
data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_hns.Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_TakeCare: Thanks! Take good care of\nMAGGIE for me!$
data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_hns.Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_DeclineT: No? That's a shame.\nMy MAGNETON's a hard worker.$
data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_hns.Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_NotReque: Hmm, that's not a {STR_VAR_1}.\nThat's not what I had in mind.$
data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_hns.Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_TradeCom: How's MAGGIE doing?\nShe loves magnetic fields!$
data/maps/Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_hns.Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Engineer: All right! We can finally get the\nMAGNET TRAIN running again.$

data/maps/Route10_hns/scripts.inc.Route10_Text_Surge: Hey, kid!\pKeep your guard up out here,\nthis place is cracklin' with power!\pIf you want a rematch, report to\nthe FIGHTING DOJO!$
data/maps/Route10_hns/scripts.inc.Route10_Text_HikerJimAfter: Hay fever is making me sneeze!\nAhahah-CHOO!$
data/maps/Route10_hns/scripts.inc.Route10_Text_PokefanmRobertSeen: You like POKéMON, don't you?\pMe too!$
data/maps/Route10_hns/scripts.inc.Route10_Text_PokefanmRobertBeaten: I'd have to say that's my loss.$
data/maps/Route10_hns/scripts.inc.Route10_Text_PokefanmRobertAfter: Look what you did to my POKéMON…\pI won't forget this…$

data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_WeCantTalkAboutAquaActivit: TEAM AQUA's activities…\nWe can't talk about them yet.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_KickUpARuckus: I want to get going to SLATEPORT and\nkick up a ruckus!$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_MyFirstJobInAqua: This is my first job after joining\nTEAM AQUA. It's a little scary.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_AquaActionsBringSmiles: TEAM AQUA's actions should bring\nsmiles to people's faces!$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_MayLetsBattle: MAY: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}, long time no see!\pWhile I was searching for other\nPOKéMON, my POKéMON grew stronger.\pSo…\nHow about a little battle?$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_MayTakeThis: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've been busy\ntraining, too, haven't you?\pI think you deserve a reward!\nThis is from me!$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder: MAY: That's an ITEMFINDER.\pTry it out. If there is an item that's\nnot visible, it emits a sound.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let's meet again!\pI know it's a little silly coming from\nme, but I think you should train a lot\lharder for the next time.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_BrendanLetsBattle: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}.\nSo this is where you were.\lHow's it going?\pHave you been raising your POKéMON?\nI'll check for you.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_BrendanTakeThis: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, you've trained\nwithout me noticing…\pGood enough!\nHere, take this.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder:
BRENDAN: That's an ITEMFINDER.\pUse it to root around for items that
aren't visible.\pIf it senses something, it emits
a sound.\pAnyway, I'm off to look for new
POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_RideBikeAtFullSpeed: Wouldn't it be great to ride a BIKE\nat full speed on CYCLING ROAD?$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_HairStreamsBehindMe: How do you like the way my raven-\ncolored hair streams behind me?\pI grew my hair out just for that.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel:
Oh, hey, you got that BIKE from RYDEL!\pOh, it's glaringly obvious.
It says right on your bike…\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL…
That name's everywhere.\pYou should ride it around all over
the place--it's good advertising!$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_TwoRoads: The two roads, one above, one below…\pA road each for people and POKéMON.\nPerhaps that is right and fair.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_WalkOnTheLowRoad: I don't have a BIKE, so I'll take\na leisurely walk on the low road.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_BikeTechniques: Learning techniques will make BIKE\nriding even more fun.\pThere are some places that you can\nreach only by using a BIKE technique.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_WhichShouldIChoose: Which should I choose?\pMake a beeline for MAUVILLE on\nCYCLING ROAD, or take the low road\land look for POKéMON?$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBest: Bravo! Splendid showing!\pYour love of cycling comes from deep\nwithin your heart.\lYou've shaken me to my very soul!$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionGood: Your technique is remarkable.\pI suggest you speed up a bit while\nstill avoiding collisions.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionOk: I would consider you a work in\nprogress.\pStill, I hope you don't forget the\nsheer pleasure of cycling.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBad: My word… Your cycling skills border\non terrifying.\pMost certainly, you need much more\npractice riding.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionWorst: …I am aghast…\pYou're perhaps not cut out for this\nunfortunate cycling business.\pYou ought to give serious thought to\nreturning that BIKE to RYDEL.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_RatedForNumberOfCollisions: This is CYCLING ROAD.\pIf you were to ride from MAUVILLE to\nSLATEPORT on a MACH BIKE, you would\lbe rated for the number of collisions\land your total time.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_AlwaysAimHigher: Regardless of the results, I count on\nseeing more challenges from you.\lAlways aim higher!$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_AcroBikesDoNotQualify: On this CYCLING ROAD, those riding\nMACH BIKES are rated for their number\lof collisions and their total times.\pACRO BIKES do not qualify for rating.\nThey are easy to turn, so it's not fair.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_AquaWasHere: “TEAM AQUA was here!”\pSomeone painted that onto this sign,\nbut then someone else painted over it.\p“TEAM MAGMA rules!” is what it\nsays now.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_TrainerTipsPrlzSleep: TRAINER TIPS\pThe foe can be made helpless by\nparalyzing it or causing it to sleep.\pIt is an important technique for\nPOKéMON battles.$
data/maps/Route110/scripts.inc.Route110_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterItems: TRAINER TIPS\pThe items in the BAG can be reorganized\nby pressing SELECT.$

Oh, I see!
You two are running separately.\lWell, that's fine.\pOh, yes, I heard that your POKéNAV
had the MATCH CALL system installed.\pWell, then, I should register you in
my POKéNAV as well.\pThat way, even when we're apart,
I can rate your POKéDEX anytime.\p… … … … … …$

data/maps/Route110_TrickHouseEnd/scripts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FountainOfId: Wh-what should I do?\nMy fountain of ideas for tricks has\lrun dry…\pPerhaps it is time I toured the country\non a quest to devise new tricks…$
data/maps/Route110_TrickHouseEnd/scripts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePr:
I hate to admit defeat, but you have
bested me!\pStill, you must have been reeled in by
my charisma for you to visit me again\land again. Yes, you must have!\pBut that has nothing to do with my
losing!\pIn recognition of the friendship
between you, the driven, and the genius\lthat is myself, I demand that you take\lthis keepsake!\pActually there are two--
a RED TENT and a BLUE TENT.\lWhich do you prefer?$
data/maps/Route110_TrickHouseEnd/scripts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomInPC: What? No room in your PC?\nWhat am I to make of that?\pI wish I could say that, but I am much\ntoo kind and caring, so come back later!$
data/maps/Route110_TrickHouseEnd/scripts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJou: … … … … … …\pI am leaving on a journey of discovery.\nA quest in search of new tricks.\pI wish that you will one day visit and\nentertain me again.\pAnd now, farewell!$
data/maps/Route110_TrickHouseEnd/scripts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomForThi: What? Have you no room for this?\nWhat manner of items do you carry?\pBut fine, since you've reached me,\nyour reward will be with me till later.$
data/maps/Route110_TrickHouseEnd/scripts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTrick:
Scrub that smug smirk from your face!
It's much too early to think you've won!\pI'll make new tricks to stump you, I will.
You may mock me only when you're done.\pCome back for the next exciting
installment!$
data/maps/Route110_TrickHouseEnd/scripts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YoureIgnorin: Now, now! You're ignoring me now?\nNow that, I consider heartbreaking!$

You, you've come to challenge
my TRICK HOUSE, haven't you?\pThat's why you're here, isn't it?
Yes, it is!\pConsider your challenge accepted!\pEnter through the scroll there,
and let your challenge commence!\pI shall be waiting in the back!$
data/maps/Route110_TrickHouseEntrance/sc.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_GoInHol: There is a big hole behind the scroll!\pWant to go in?$
data/maps/Route110_TrickHouseEntrance/sc.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Leaving: There is a note affixed to the scroll…\p“I am leaving on a journey.\nDon't look for me. TRICK MASTER”$
data/maps/Route110_TrickHouseEntrance/sc.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_NextTim: For the next time, I'll use this trick,\nand that scheme, and those ruses…\pMufufufu… If I may say so, it's\nbrilliantly difficult, even for me!$
data/maps/Route110_TrickHouseEntrance/sc.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_InMidst:
Hah? What?!
Oh, it's you!\pI'm in the midst of devising new tricky
challenges!\pIt's not too much to ask for a bit more
time for me to think, is it now?\lYou wouldn't begrudge me that?\lCome back in a little while!$
data/maps/Route110_TrickHouseEntrance/sc.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_YoureHe: Ah, it's you! You're here to accept the\nreward from before, isn't that right?\lYes, right I am!\pHere!\nI'll give it to you now!$

data/maps/Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7/scr.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisPo: You're solving all the puzzles in the\nTRICK HOUSE. That's the feeling I get.$
data/maps/Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7/scr.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaI: Nufufufu, here at last!\nLet's get right with it!$

data/maps/Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7/scr.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroDe: This outcome I didn't see coming…$

data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_BattleOurFamily: Hello! I take it you're a traveler.\pHow's this? What do you say to taking\non our family of four in a series of\lPOKéMON battles?$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_IsThatSo: Is that so?\nDrop in, if you change your mind!$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_VictorIntro: That's the spirit! I like you!$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_VictorDefeat: Aiyah!\nYou're a lot tougher than I expected!$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_VictorPostBattle: Hey, all!\nI've found a pretty strong TRAINER!$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro: Oh, my goodness! Aren't you young?\pYou must be quite the TRAINER to beat\nmy husband, though.\pIt's my turn to battle now!$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_VictoriaDefeat: Oh, gosh!\nI can't get over how strong you are!$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_VictoriaPostBattle: There's a strong TRAINER here!\nThis one's really strong!$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_ViviIntro: You're stronger than Mommy? Wow!\pBut I'm strong, too!\nReally! Honestly!$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_VickyIntro: How dare you make my granddaughter\ncry!\pFor that, I'm going to smack you!\nPrepare to lose!$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_VickyDefeat: Kwah! You are strong…\nMy granddaughter was right…$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_VickyPostBattle: If you're not in any hurry,\nvisit with us awhile.$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_ToughToKeepWinningUpTheRan: If you don't raise your POKéMON some\nmore, it could be tough to keep winning\lup through the ranks.\pI've heard the POKéMON LEAGUE's\nELITE FOUR are far stronger than\lany GYM LEADER.$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_WinstrateFamilyDestroyedMe: I challenged the WINSTRATE family,\nbut four matches in a row is tough\lgoing… They destroyed me.$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_WinstrateHouseSign: “Our family's hearts beat as one!”\nTHE WINSTRATE'S HOUSE$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_OldLadysRestStopSign: OLD LADY'S REST STOP\n“Come in and rest your tired bones.”$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef: TRAINER TIPS\pOne of the indicators of a POKéMON's\npowerfulness is SP. ATK. It stands for\l“SPECIAL ATTACK.”\pLikewise, SP. DEF stands for “SPECIAL\nDEFENSE.”$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundH: There should be a tower made of sand\naround here somewhere.\pBut for some reason, it can be seen\nsometimes, and sometimes not.\pThat's why I call it the MIRAGE TOWER.$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible:
I see it!
The tower of sand!\pThe sand tower they called a mirage
is clearly visible!\pBut it looks so fragile…
It could crumble away anytime…\pI want to go inside it, but I can't
get my courage up for it…$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedD:
Whoa…
That was shocking.\pSand rained down in chunks all of
a sudden.\pWhat was it like inside?
Were there sandy ghosts and such?$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_MirageTowerHasntBeenSeenSi: Since I spoke to you, the tower of sand\nhasn't been seen.\pPerhaps it really was\nthe MIRAGE TOWER…$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_ClawFossilDisappeared: The CLAW FOSSIL disappeared into\nthe sand…$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_RootFossilDisappeared: The ROOT FOSSIL disappeared into\nthe sand…$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeR: Oh, no!\pMy uncle in MAUVILLE told me to take\nROCK SMASH with me if I was going to\lROUTE 111!\pMy uncle? He lives across from\nthe bike shop in MAUVILLE.$
data/maps/Route111/scripts.inc.Route111_Text_TrainerHillSign: {RIGHT_ARROW} TRAINER HILL ENTRANCE\p“Scale the heights, you hot-blooded\nTRAINERS!”$

data/maps/Route111_OldLadysRestStop/scri.Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_RestUpHer: Oh, dear, dear.\nAren't your POKéMON exhausted?\pIf you'd like, rest up here.\nThat's a fine idea! You should do that.$
data/maps/Route111_OldLadysRestStop/scri.Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_TakeYourT: That's right.\nTake your time and rest up!$
data/maps/Route111_OldLadysRestStop/scri.Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_StillTire: Oh, dear, dear.\nAre your POKéMON still tired?\pYou should take another rest here.\nThat's a fine idea. You should do that.$
data/maps/Route111_OldLadysRestStop/scri.Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_DontNeedT: Is that so?\nYou don't need to be shy about it.$

data/maps/Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse.Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySo:
You're the first TRAINER I've seen who
deploys POKéMON so masterfully.\pBut, I should tell you--my son is
stronger than you.\pHe even took the POKéMON LEAGUE
challenge, I'll have you know.$
data/maps/Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse.Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Like: We use this MACHO BRACE to more\neffectively strengthen our POKéMON\lin training.\pSince you've beaten all of us here,\nI don't know if you need it, but we\lwould like you to have our MACHO BRACE.$
data/maps/Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse.Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Pass: When it comes to POKéMON battles,\nwe tend to be pretty passionate.$
data/maps/Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse.Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Stro: Mommy is stronger than Daddy.\pI'm stronger than Mommy.\pAnd Grandma's stronger than me!\pBut my big brother is even stronger\nthan Grandma.$
data/maps/Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse.Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Gran:
There's no question that you're strong.\pBut if you were to battle my grandson,
you'd end up crying in frustration.\pHe's much stronger than any TRAINER
our family knows.\pHe must be challenging the POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.\pKnowing my grandson, he could be the
CHAMPION already!$
My grandson must be challenging the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.\pKnowing my grandson, he could be the\nCHAMPION already!$

data/maps/Route112/scripts.inc.Route112_Text_LeaderGoingToAwakenThing: Hey, man, is our leader really going\nto awaken that thing?$
data/maps/Route112/scripts.inc.Route112_Text_YeahWeNeedMeteorite: Sounds like it, yeah. But I heard\nwe need a METEORITE to do it.$
data/maps/Route112/scripts.inc.Route112_Text_OhThatsWhyCrewWentToFallar: Oh, I get it now. That's why the rest\nof the crew went out to FALLARBOR.$
data/maps/Route112/scripts.inc.Route112_Text_CantLetAnyonePassUntilThey: You got it. And until they come back,\nwe're not to let anyone pass, right.$
data/maps/Route112/scripts.inc.Route112_Text_NotEasyToGetBackToLavaridg: Eh, I'd like to get to MAUVILLE, but if\nI went down these ledges, it'd be no\leasy matter to get back to LAVARIDGE.$
data/maps/Route112/scripts.inc.Route112_Text_MtChimneyCableCarSign: MT. CHIMNEY CABLE CAR\n“A short walk {UP_ARROW} way!”$
data/maps/Route112/scripts.inc.Route112_Text_MtChimneySign: MT. CHIMNEY\p“For LAVARIDGE TOWN or the summit,\nplease take the CABLE CAR.”$

data/maps/Route112_CableCarStation/scrip.Route112_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarRe: The CABLE CAR is ready to go up.\nWould you like to be on it?$
data/maps/Route112_CableCarStation/scrip.Route112_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnothe: Please ride with us another time.$

data/maps/Route113/scripts.inc.Route113_Text_AshCanBeFashionedIntoGlass: Wahahaha! Today's technology is a\nwondrous thing!\pTake this volcanic ash here.\nIt can be fashioned into glass.$
data/maps/Route113/scripts.inc.Route113_Text_FunWalkingThroughAsh: It's fun walking through the volcano's\nashes on the ground and grass.\pYou can see where you walked--it's\nreally neat!$
data/maps/Route113/scripts.inc.Route113_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterKeyItem: TRAINER TIPS\pYou may register one of the KEY ITEMS\nin your BAG as SELECT.\pSimply press SELECT to use\nthe registered item conveniently.$
data/maps/Route113/scripts.inc.Route113_Text_GlassWorkshopSign: GLASS WORKSHOP\n“Turning Volcanic Ash into Glass Items”$

data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAsh: This area is covered in volcanic ash,\nhuff-puff!\pI'm specially gifted, huff-puff.\pI make glass out of volcanic ash\nand make items, huff-puff.\pGo collect ashes with this, huff-puff.$
data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_ExplainSootS:
Just take that SOOT SACK and walk
through piles of ash, huff-puff.\pAnd it will fill up with the volcanic ash,
huff-puff.\pOnce you think you've collected a good
amount, come see me, huff-puff.$
data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_LetsSeeColle: Have you collected ashes, huff-puff?\nLet me see, huff-puff.$
data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAsh: Hmmm…\nThere's not enough ash here, huff-puff.\lI can't make glass with this, huff-puff.\pLet's see… {STR_VAR_1} is the number of steps\nyou'll need to walk for me to make you\la BLUE FLUTE, huff-puff.$
data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichGlassIt: Oh!\nYou've got a lot of ashes, huff-puff!\pI'll make you a glass item, huff-puff!\nWhich one would you like, huff-puff?$
data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IsThatTheIte: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff?\nIs that the one for you, huff-puff?$
data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichWouldYo: Which one would you like, huff-puff?$
data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IllMakeItemF: A {STR_VAR_1} it is, then, huff-puff!\pOkay! I'll make it for you, huff-puff.\nJust wait a little while, huff-puff.$
data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAsh:
A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff?\pThere's not enough ash here to make
that, though, huff-puff.\pLet's see… {STR_VAR_2} is the number of steps
you'll need to walk through volcanic ash\lfor me to make that item, huff-puff.\pWhich item would you rather have me
make instead, huff-puff?$
data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_AllThatAshBu: You've collected all that ash, but you\ndon't want anything, huff-puff?$
data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IveFinishedG: Ah, I've finished your {STR_VAR_1}.\nTake it, huff-puff.$
data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInBag: Oh?\nYou've no room in your BAG, huff-puff.\pI'll hold on to it, so come back later,\nhuff-puff.$
data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInPC: Oh?\nYou've no room in your PC, huff-puff?\pI'll hold on to it, so come back later,\nhuff-puff.$
data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_HaventGotYou: Hah? You haven't got your SOOT SACK\nwith you, huff-puff.\pYou have to keep it with you to collect\nvolcanic ash, huff-puff.$
data/maps/Route113_GlassWorkshop/scripts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_FunToBlowGla: It's fun to blow a glass flute while\nmy boss is talking.\pHuff-huff! Puff-puff!$

data/maps/Route114/scripts.inc.Route114_Text_AllMyMonDoesIsRoarTakeThis: All my POKéMON does is ROAR…\nNo one dares to come near me…\pSigh… If you would, please take\nthis TM away…$
data/maps/Route114/scripts.inc.Route114_Text_ExplainRoar: TM05 contains ROAR.\nA ROAR sends POKéMON scurrying.$

data/maps/Route114_FossilManiacsHouse/sc.Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThi:
My big brother's the FOSSIL MANIAC…
He's a nice guy who loves FOSSILS…\pHe loves digging holes, too…
He dug this hole by himself…\pYou can have this, so you can DIG
holes just like my big brother…$
data/maps/Route114_FossilManiacsHouse/sc.Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_DigRetu: If you make a POKéMON DIG inside a\ncave, you're returned to the entrance…$
data/maps/Route114_FossilManiacsHouse/sc.Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_RocksFi: Rocks in peculiar shapes fill\nthe display case…$
data/maps/Route114_FossilManiacsHouse/sc.Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_Crammed: THE COMPOSITION OF STRATA…\nHOW RAIN SHAPES THE LAND…\lSTONES, SOIL, AND ROCK…\pIt's crammed with books.$

data/maps/Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel/s.Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_LookIn:
I'm the FOSSIL MANIAC…
I'm a nice guy who loves FOSSILS…\pDo you want a FOSSIL?\pBut the FOSSILS around these parts all
belong to me… None for you…\pIf you can't bear to go without
a FOSSIL, look in a desert where there\lare boulders and sand that may hide\lFOSSILS…$
data/maps/Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel/s.Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_DevonC:
You found a FOSSIL, didn't you?
That's so nice… It's so dreamy…\pWhat are you going to do with that
FOSSIL?\pFrom what I've heard, DEVON is doing
research on reviving POKéMON from\lFOSSILS…\pI love my FOSSILS, so I would never
do anything like that…$
data/maps/Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel/s.Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_Fossil: FOSSILS are so… Wonderful…\nIt's so dreamy…$
data/maps/Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel/s.Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_NotSaf:
Oh…
It's not safe that way…\pI was digging away, you see…
When the whole wall collapsed…\pI think there's a giant cavern
underneath now…\pBut I've left it alone because I don't
think there are any FOSSILS there…$

data/maps/Route114_LanettesHouse/scripts.Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingCl: LANETTE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI'm sorry everything is so cluttered…\nWhen I get engrossed in research,\lthings end up this way…\pThis is embarrassing… Please keep\nthis a secret in exchange for this.$
data/maps/Route114_LanettesHouse/scripts.Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYour: May I offer advice about my POKéMON\nStorage System?\pYou should organize your BOXES so you\ncan tell which POKéMON are in them.$
data/maps/Route114_LanettesHouse/scripts.Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNote: It's LANETTE's research notes.\nThere's information about BOXES.\pDesign BOXES to hold 30 POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER should be able to store\n420 POKéMON on the PC system.\pKeep reading?$
A marking system should be added to\nmake POKéMON easier to organize.\pThe name and wallpaper design of each\nBOX will be made changeable to please\lthe stored POKéMON.\pKeep reading?$

When storing a POKéMON, it should be
sent to the BOX inspected last.\pIf that BOX is full, the received
POKéMON is stored in the next BOX.\pIn other words, when a BOX is examined,
it is automatically selected as the BOX\lto which POKéMON are sent.$
data/maps/Route114_LanettesHouse/scripts.Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBil:
There's an e-mail from someone on
the PC.\p“… … … … … … …\p“Your Storage System offers more
convenience than mine.\p“It has a lot of user-friendly features
that make it fun and useful, too.\p“It makes me proud that I played
a part in its development.\p“Here's hoping that you'll continue
research in Storage Systems.\p“From BILL
… … … … … … … …”$

data/maps/Route115/scripts.inc.Route115_Text_NeverKnowWhenCavePokemonWi: Exploring a cave isn't like walking\non a road.\pYou never know when wild POKéMON will\nappear. It's full of suspense.$

data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko: Ohhh, what am I to do?\pWe were on our walk, PEEKO and I, when\nwe were jumped by an odd thug…\pThe scoundrel made off with my\ndarling PEEKO!\pWrrrooooooaaaar! PEEKO!$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_WantToDigTunnel: Nnn… Roar!\pI want to dig that tunnel!$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrder:
Nnn… Roar!
What's going on?\pI was digging the tunnel without any
tools when some goon ordered me out!\pThat tunnel's filled with POKéMON
that react badly to loud noises.\lThey could cause an uproar.\pThat's why we stopped using heavy
equipment for tunneling…\pI'm worried that the goon will do
something stupid and startle the\lPOKéMON into an uproar.$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_GoonHightailedItOutOfTunne: Nnn… Roar!\pThat goofy goon hightailed it out of\nthe tunnel! I can go back to digging!$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciatio:
Oh! It's you!\pYou're that person who not only helped
me in PETALBURG WOODS, but also got\lback my stolen package and then even\lgraciously delivered it to SLATEPORT!\pCAPT. STERN informed us that the
package arrived, too!\pI thank you very, very much!\pWhy, if I were a rain cloud, I would
shower you with gratitude and hail\lyou as a hero!\pFor you, the most wonderful TRAINER,
I bear good news!\pRecently, our company developed
a new kind of POKé BALL.\pAs a token of our appreciation, this
is our gift to our wonderful TRAINER!$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_NewBallAvailableAtMart: Our new POKé BALL will be available\nat the POKéMON MART in RUSTBORO.\pPlease do try it out!\nThank you and bye-bye!$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_BagIsJamPacked: Your BAG is jam-packed.\nI can't give you this REPEAT BALL.$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_TokenOfAppreciation: As a token of our appreciation for\nyour delivering our package, I have\la gift of a new kind of POKé BALL\lfor our most wonderful TRAINER!$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_CanYouHelpMeFindGlasses: I dropped my glasses…\nCan you help me find them?$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_MayISeeThoseGlasses: Those glasses!\nMay I see them for a second?$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingForMaybeTh: Hmm…\nThese are BLACKGLASSES.\lThey're not what I'm looking for…\pMaybe my glasses aren't around\nhere…$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_CantFindGlassesNotHere: Hmm…\nI can't find my glasses anywhere…\lMaybe they're not around here…$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingFor: Hmm…\nThese are BLACKGLASSES.\lThey're not what I'm looking for…$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_RusturfTunnelSign: RUSTURF TUNNEL\n“Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF\p“The tunnel project has been\ncanceled.”$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolutio: TRAINER TIPS\pIf you want to stop a POKéMON from\nevolving, press the B Button while it\lis trying to evolve.\lThe startled POKéMON will stop.\pThis is called an evolution cancel.$
data/maps/Route116/scripts.inc.Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets: TRAINER TIPS\pYour BAG has several POCKETS.\pItems you obtain are automatically\nplaced in the appropriate POCKETS.\pNo TRAINER can afford to be without\na BAG of their own.$

data/maps/Route116_TunnelersRestHouse/sc.Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_WeHadTo:
That RUSTURF TUNNEL there…\pAt first, we had a huge work crew boring
through rock with the latest machinery.\lBut, we had to stop.\pIt turns out that we would have had
a negative effect on wild POKéMON in\lthe area.\pSo, we've got nothing to do but loll
around here doing nothing.$
data/maps/Route116_TunnelersRestHouse/sc.Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_ManDigg: There's a man digging his way to\nVERDANTURF all by his lonesome.\lHe's desperate to get through.\pHe says that if he digs little by little\nwithout using machines, he won't\ldisturb POKéMON, and he'll avoid\lharming the natural environment.\pI wonder if he made it through yet.$
data/maps/Route116_TunnelersRestHouse/sc.Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_GetToVe: To get to VERDANTURF without using\nthis TUNNEL, you'd have to cross the\lsea to DEWFORD, sail on to SLATEPORT,\lthen travel through MAUVILLE.$
data/maps/Route116_TunnelersRestHouse/sc.Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_TunnelH: Did you hear? The TUNNEL to VERDANTURF\nhas gone through!\pSometimes, if you hope strongly enough,\ndreams do come true.$

data/maps/Route117/scripts.inc.Route117_Text_DayCarePokemonHadNewMove: I left my POKéMON at the DAY CARE.\pWhen I got it back, it had a new move\nthat I didn't teach it.\lI was really, really surprised.$
data/maps/Route117/scripts.inc.Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty: What do you think?\nAren't these flowers pretty?\pI planted them all!$
data/maps/Route117/scripts.inc.Route117_Text_DayCareSign: POKéMON DAY CARE\n“Let us raise your POKéMON.”$

data/maps/Route118/scripts.inc.Route118_Text_StevenQuestions:
STEVEN: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pIt's me, STEVEN!
We met in the cave near DEWFORD.\pHave you met many kinds of POKéMON
since I last saw you?\pThere are many, many kinds of POKéMON
in this wide world of ours.\pIf you wanted to raise only your
favorites, that's fine.\pPerhaps you find it more fun to raise
all sorts of POKéMON.\pAs a TRAINER of POKéMON,
what do you think?\pOf course, it's not any of my business.\pIt would be nice if we were to meet
again somewhere.$
data/maps/Route118/scripts.inc.Route118_Text_YouAgreeGoodRodIsGood: Hmm!\nA GOOD ROD is really good!\pWouldn't you agree?$
data/maps/Route118/scripts.inc.Route118_Text_IdenticalMindsTakeThis: Hmm!\nWe're of identical minds!\pHmm!\nTake this GOOD ROD!$
data/maps/Route118/scripts.inc.Route118_Text_TryYourLuckFishing: Wherever there's water, try your luck\nat fishing.$
data/maps/Route118/scripts.inc.Route118_Text_TryCatchingMonWithGoodRod: Try catching all sorts of POKéMON\nwith your GOOD ROD.$
data/maps/Route118/scripts.inc.Route118_Text_CanCrossRiversWithSurf: Even if there isn't a boat, you can\ncross rivers and the sea if you have\la POKéMON that knows SURF.\pPOKéMON can be counted on to do so\nmuch!$

data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_MayIntro:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Where were you? I was looking for you!\pHow much stronger have you gotten?
Let me check for you!\pReady with your POKéMON?
Of course you are! Go!$
data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_MayDefeat: Achah!\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, you're strong!\pI was worried that you might be\nstruggling with your training.$
data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_MayPresentForYou: MAY: But I had absolutely nothing to\nworry about! Keep it up!\pAnd, here! I have a present for you.$
data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_MayExplainFly:
MAY: Use FLY, and your POKéMON will
instantly carry you to any town you've\lalready visited.\pBut, to use FLY, you have to get
the GYM BADGE from FORTREE CITY.\lThat's important, so don't forget.\pYou should FLY home and visit
LITTLEROOT for a change.\pI bet your mom's worried about you,
{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pWell, let's meet again somewhere!$
data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_BrendanIntro:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! So this is where
you've been looking for POKéMON?\pLet me see how good you got.
I'll test you!\pNow!
It's a battle, so battle!$
data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_BrendanIllGiveYouThis: BRENDAN: I'd say you're good enough\nto search for POKéMON anywhere.\pHere, I'll give you this.\nTry it out.$
data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_BrendanExplainFly: BRENDAN: Use FLY, and your POKéMON\ninstantly carries you to any town\lyou've already visited.\pBut you need the FORTREE GYM BADGE \nto do that.\pAnyway, I have to move along.$
data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou:
SCOTT: Hahahah!
Way to go, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI just passed by a TRAINER riding
a BIKE.\pYou just beat that TRAINER, didn't you?
It was pretty obvious that you did.\pThe kid looked really upset with
a face all red from anger.\pI sure seem to run into you often.
Are you off to FORTREE GYM next?\pI expect that you'll do well at the GYM.
Well, I'll be seeing you!$
data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_ScottYouWonAtFortreeGym:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pSCOTT: Hiya, {PLAYER}{KUN}, it's me!\pJust as I thought, you won at
the FORTREE GYM.\pYour strength…
Perhaps you really are the TRAINER\lthat I've been searching for.\pRemember, you have a fan in me.
I'll be cheering from the sidelines.\lKeep up the great work!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$
data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_StayAwayFromWeatherInstitu: We're standing lookout here.\pHey, you! Stay away from the WEATHER\nINSTITUTE. It's not safe.$
data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_DontGoNearWeatherInstitute: Lookout duty is surprisingly boring.\pHey, you! Please don't go near the\nWEATHER INSTITUTE.$
data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_ThoughtFlyByCatchingBirdMo:
I thought you FLY by catching a whole
flock of BIRD POKéMON, and then\lhanging on to them somehow.\pBut it turns out there's an HM move
called FLY!\pI wish I'd known about that a long
time ago…$
data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_TallGrassSnaresBikeTires: Tch…\nIt's a no-go…\pThe tall grass snares BIKE tires.\nThere's no way you can cycle here.$
data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_CanYourMonMakeSecretBase: Can your POKéMON use its SECRET POWER\non a big pile of grass and make a\lSECRET BASE?$
data/maps/Route119/scripts.inc.Route119_Text_TrainerTipsDecoration: TRAINER TIPS\pUp to sixteen decorations and\nfurniture items can be placed in\la SECRET BASE.\pPick your favorite items and create\nyour very own SECRET BASE exactly the\lway you want.$

data/maps/Route119_House/scripts.inc.Route119_House_Text_RumorAboutCaveOfOrig: I heard about a cave called the CAVE\nOF ORIGIN.\pPeople rumor that the spirits of\nPOKéMON are revived there. Could\lsomething like that really happen?$

data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1: The BOSS got interested in\nthe research they have going here,\lso he sent us out.\pYou quit meddling!$
Our BOSS knows everything.\pBut I'm just a GRUNT. What would I know\nabout what he's thinking?$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4: Oh, no…\nI'll catch an earful for losing to a kid…\pI should just take a nap in the bed…$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Everyo: While I was sleeping, everyone went\nupstairs!$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WowYou: Wow, you're really strong!\pI wish I could be a POKéMON TRAINER\nlike you!$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_ProfSt:
The PROFESSOR loves rain.
That's a fact.\pBut if it keeps raining, people will be in
trouble. That's another fact.\pAnd thus, the PROFESSOR is studying
if the rain can be put to good use.$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Notici: On the 2nd floor of the INSTITUTE,\nwe study the weather patterns over\lthe HOENN region.\pWe've been noticing temporary and\nisolated cases of droughts and\lheavy rain lately…$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WhatWe: Hello!\nWe've been saved by your actions!\pWhat I don't understand is what on\nearth the AQUAS were up to.$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_TakeRe: There's a bed…\nLet's take a rest.$

data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2: The INSTITUTE created a type of\nPOKéMON that has something to do with\lthe weather. We're here to take them!$
Our plan's being spoiled by a kid?$
If the POKéMON they made here can\ncontrol the weather freely, then we of\lTEAM AQUA definitely need it!$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3: We're TEAM AQUA!\nWe appear wherever anything rare is\lfound!$
You don't have any idea what we of\nTEAM AQUA are working towards!\lYou stay out of our way!$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5: Don't tell me you're looking for that\nweather POKéMON, too?\pThat's a no-no!\nWe were here to get it first!$
Oh, will you look at my POKéMON?$
Humph, so what?\nWhat we want…\pWhat we really want isn't here…\nIhihihihi…$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Shelly:
Ahahahaha!\pYou're going to meddle in TEAM AQUA's
affairs?\pYou're either absolutely fearless,
simply ignorant, or both!\pYou're so cute, you're disgusting!
I'll put you down, kiddy!$
It's bad enough to have TEAM MAGMA\nblunder about, but now there's you!\pWhat makes you want to sniff around\nin our business, anyway?$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_TeamMa: We have a situation here!\pA TEAM MAGMA mob just passed\nthe WEATHER INSTITUTE.\pThey appear to be headed for\nMT. PYRE!$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_WeHave: What?!\pWe can't waste any more time here!\nWe have to hurry to MT. PYRE, too!\pAhahahaha!\nTEAM MAGMA, just you wait!$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Thanks: Thanks!\nThanks to you, we're safe!\pIt might be an odd way of thanking you,\nbut take this POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoRoom: Hm? You don't seem to have any room\nfor this POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Pokemo: That POKéMON changes shape according\nto the weather conditions.\pThere're plenty of them in the\nINSTITUTE--go ahead and take it.$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Changi: I've been researching rain for many\nyears, but it's ridiculous to think that\lhumans can freely change the weather.$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Groudo:
I track weather patterns over
the HOENN region.\pPresently, a drought has been recorded
in {STR_VAR_1}.\pCould that mean, somewhere near
{STR_VAR_1}…$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Kyogre:
I track weather patterns over
the HOENN region.\pPresently, heavy rainfall has been
recorded over {STR_VAR_1}.\pCould that mean, somewhere near
{STR_VAR_1}…$
data/maps/Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F/s.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoAbno: Abnormal weather conditions are\nno longer being reported.\pThe occasional rainfall is a blessing,\nreally.$

data/maps/Route11_hns/scripts.inc.Route11_Text_Engineer: I saw a strange POKéMON climbing\nin the trees, but it didn't\llook like MANKEY...$
data/maps/Route11_hns/scripts.inc.Route11_Text_YoungsterOwenSeen: There's no cheating in POKéMON.\pLet's keep it fair and square!$
data/maps/Route11_hns/scripts.inc.Route11_Text_YoungsterOwenAfterBattle: I fought fair and square with\nhonor.\pI don't regret this at all.$
data/maps/Route11_hns/scripts.inc.Route11_Text_YoungsterJasonSeen: It itches and tickles a bit when\nI wear shorts in the grass.$
data/maps/Route11_hns/scripts.inc.Route11_Text_YoungsterJasonAfterBattle: I'm going to catch more POKéMON in\nthe grass.$
data/maps/Route11_hns/scripts.inc.Route11_Text_PsychicHermanAfterBattle: …\pI lost while I had my eyes closed…$
data/maps/Route11_hns/scripts.inc.Route11_Text_PsychicFidelSeen: I can see it…\pEverything to see about you…$
data/maps/Route11_hns/scripts.inc.Route11_Text_PsychicFidelAfterBattle: Strength in conviction…\pYou're strong because you believe\nin your POKéMON.$

data/maps/Route120/scripts.inc.Route120_Text_StevenGreeting:
STEVEN: Hm? {PLAYER}{KUN}, hi.
It's been a while.\pThere's something here that you can't
see, right?\pNow, if I were to use this device on
the invisible obstacle…\pNo, no. Rather than describing it,
I should just show you.\lThat would be more fun.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON ready for
battle?$
data/maps/Route120/scripts.inc.Route120_Text_StevenIllWaitHere: STEVEN: No?\pI'll wait here, so you can get ready.$
data/maps/Route120/scripts.inc.Route120_Text_StevenReadyForBattle: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON\nready for battle?$
data/maps/Route120/scripts.inc.Route120_Text_StevenShowMeYourPower: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, show me your true\npower as a TRAINER!$
data/maps/Route120/scripts.inc.Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope: STEVEN used the DEVON SCOPE.\pAn invisible POKéMON became completely\nvisible!\pThe startled POKéMON attacked!$
data/maps/Route120/scripts.inc.Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope:
STEVEN: I see…
Your battle style is intriguing.\pYour POKéMON have obviously grown
since I first met you in DEWFORD.\pI'd like you to have this
DEVON SCOPE.\pWho knows, there may be other
concealed POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route120/scripts.inc.Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI enjoy seeing POKéMON and TRAINERS\nwho strive together.\pI think you're doing great.\pWell, let's meet again somewhere.$
data/maps/Route120/scripts.inc.Kecleon_Text_SomethingUnseeable: Something unseeable is in the way.$
data/maps/Route120/scripts.inc.Kecleon_Text_WantToUseDevonScope: Something unseeable is in the way.\pWant to use the DEVON SCOPE?$
data/maps/Route120/scripts.inc.Kecleon_Text_UseDevonScopeMonAttacked: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.\pAn invisible POKéMON became completely\nvisible!\pThe startled POKéMON attacked!$

data/maps/Route121/scripts.inc.Route121_Text_OkayMoveOutToMtPyre: Okay!\nWe're to move out to MT. PYRE!$
data/maps/Route121/scripts.inc.Route121_Text_AheadLoomsMtPyre: Ahead looms MT. PYRE…\pIt is a natural monument to the spirits \nof departed POKéMON…$
data/maps/Route121/scripts.inc.Route121_Text_MtPyrePierSign: MT. PYRE PIER\p…The sign is old and worn out.\nThe words are barely legible…$

data/maps/Route123/scripts.inc.Route123_Text_LoveGrassMonsHaveAny: I love GRASS-type POKéMON!\pDo you have any GRASS-type POKéMON?$
data/maps/Route123/scripts.inc.Route123_Text_YouLikeGrassMonsTooHaveThi: Oh?\pYou like GRASS-type POKéMON, too,\ndon't you?\pI'm so happy, you can have this!\nIt's a token of our friendship.$
data/maps/Route123/scripts.inc.Route123_Text_CheckTreesWithMyGrassMon: I check trees with my GRASS-type\nPOKéMON. I'm like a tree doctor.$
data/maps/Route123/scripts.inc.Route123_Text_RouteSignMtPyre: {UP_ARROW} MT. PYRE\n“Forbidden to the faint of heart.”$

data/maps/Route124_DivingTreasureHunters.Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text: I'm the DIVING TREASURE HUNTER!\pI'm the awesome dude who makes\ndeep-sea dives to gather treasures\lresting at the bottom.$
Tell me, have you seen any SHARDS of\ntools made in ancient times?$
You haven't got any treasures\nfor me…\pIf you see any SHARDS, like the RED\nSHARD, you've got to trade it with me!$
Oh, hey! That…\nThat's a SHARD! I'm looking for those!\pOh, man, you've got to trade that\nwith me! I'll give you something good!$
What do you want to trade?$
It's a done deal!\nUse that wisely!$
Do you want to trade something else?$
Whoops, your BAG's full.\nGet rid of some items, friend!$
No? That's a downer.\nWell, if you change your mind, come back.$
