data/maps/Route128/scripts.inc.Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened: ARCHIE: What happened…\nWhat is this wretched scene…\pDid I…make a horrible mistake?$
data/maps/Route128/scripts.inc.Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow:
MAXIE: Do you understand now,
ARCHIE?\pDo you finally see how disastrous
your dream turned out to be?\pWe have to hurry! We have to do
something before the situation goes\lcompletely out of control!$
data/maps/Route128/scripts.inc.Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToA:
MAXIE: {PLAYER}, don't say anything.\pI know that I have no right to be
critical of ARCHIE…\pBut the way things are now, I doubt
that we humans will be capable of\ldoing anything about it.\pBut neither can we stand by and
just watch helplessly.\pThe responsibility for putting an end
to this falls to ARCHIE and me…$
data/maps/Route128/scripts.inc.Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief: MAXIE: This defies belief…\pThose super-ancient POKéMON…\pTheir power is unbelievable.\nThey've upset the balance of nature…$
data/maps/Route128/scripts.inc.Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown:
This is terrible…\pAfter the scorching heat wave ended,
this deluge began.\pIf this doesn't stop, all of HOENN…
No, the whole world will drown.\pThis huge rain cloud is spreading
from above SOOTOPOLIS…\pWhat in the world is taking place there?\pThere's no point arguing here…
SOOTOPOLIS might provide answers…$
data/maps/Route128/scripts.inc.Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\nI don't know what you intend to do,\lbut don't do anything reckless.\pOkay.\nI'm going to SOOTOPOLIS.$

data/maps/Route12_House_hns/scripts.inc.Route12_House_Text_OfferSuperRod: I'm the FISHING GURU's younger\nbrother.\pI can see that you like fishing.\pThere's no doubt in my mind at\nall!\pSo? I know I'm right.$
data/maps/Route12_House_hns/scripts.inc.Route12_House_Text_GiveSuperRod: Yes, yes. Just as I thought!\pHere, fishing fan! Take this--\nit's a SUPER ROD.$
data/maps/Route12_House_hns/scripts.inc.Route12_House_Text_GaveSuperRod: Try your hand at fishing wherever\nthere is water.\pRemember--you can catch different\nPOKéMON using different RODS.$
data/maps/Route12_House_hns/scripts.inc.Route12_House_Text_DontWantSuperRod: Huh? My own eyes deceived me?$

data/maps/Route12_hns/scripts.inc.Route12_Text_NewFisher: Careful, something vicious lives in\nthese waters.$
data/maps/Route12_hns/scripts.inc.Route12_Text_FisherMartinSeen: Patience is the key to both\nfishing and POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route12_hns/scripts.inc.Route12_Text_FisherStephenSeen: I feel so content, fishing while\nlistening to some tunes on my\lradio.$
data/maps/Route12_hns/scripts.inc.Route12_Text_FisherStephenAfterBattle: Have you checked out KANTO's radio\nprograms? We get a good variety\lhere.$
data/maps/Route12_hns/scripts.inc.Route12_Text_FisherBarneySeen: What's most important in our\neveryday lives?$
data/maps/Route12_hns/scripts.inc.Route12_Text_FisherBarneyBeaten: The answer is coming up next!$
data/maps/Route12_hns/scripts.inc.Route12_Text_FisherBarneyAfterBattle: I think electricity is the most\nimportant thing in our daily\llives.\pIf it weren't, people wouldn't\nhave made such a fuss when the\lPOWER PLANT went out of\lcommission.$
data/maps/Route12_hns/scripts.inc.Route12_Text_KyleRegister: I'll remember this.\nGive me your number!$
data/maps/Route12_hns/scripts.inc.Route12_Text_KylePostRematch: The thrill of battle is almost\nas good as a big catch!$
data/maps/Route12_hns/scripts.inc.Route12_Text_FisherKyleAfterBattle: The tug you feel on the ROD when\nyou hook a POKéMON…\pThat's the best feeling ever for\nan angler like me.$

data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_PokefanmAlexSeen: Bow down before my regal POKéMON!$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_PokefanmAlexBeaten: How… How dare you mock royalty!$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_PokefanmAlexAfterBattle: Doesn't everyone wish to someday\nbe a king?$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_AlexRegister: You're not royalty but you're good.\nLet me get your number.$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_AlexRematchIntro: I've added knights to my court!\nLet's battle!$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_AlexPostRematch: Maybe I'm just a pawn after all.$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_PokefanmJoshuaSeen: Nihihi! Would you like to battle\nmy PIKACHU gang?$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_PokefanmJoshuaAfterBattle: You look like you have many\nPOKéMON, but PIKACHU\lis still the best.$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_BirdKeeperPerrySeen: Agility is the key attribute of\nbird POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_BirdKeeperPerryBeaten: You beat me with your speed…$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_BirdKeeperBretSeen: Check out my POKéMON. Just look\nat their coloring and their\lplumage.$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_BirdKeeperBretAfterBattle: If you groom them, POKéMON get\nhappy.$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_HikerKennySeen: I should go to ROCK TUNNEL to get\nmyself an ONIX.$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_HikerKennyAfterBattle: Geological features don't appear\nto change.\pBut they actually change, little\nby little.$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_KennyRegister: Maybe POKéMON change over time too.\nLet's battle again sometime!$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_KennyPostRematch: The power of POKéMON is like\nerosion. We will persevere!$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_TrainerTips: TRAINER TIPS\pLook! Right there, at the left\nside of the post.$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_Text_DirectionsSign: NORTH TO LAVENDER TOWN\pWEST TO FUCHSIA CITY$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_GetOffBoat_Text_0: Welcome back to mainland Kanto!\pCome back if you'd like to take a trip\nto the ALOLA ISLES!$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_0: Ahoy there!\pThat's one strange souvenir.\nYou must be from the ISLES!$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_0_5: Would you like to take the next ship?\nIt departs shortly!$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_1: Ahoy! Let's get you on board!$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_2: Ahoy!\nCome back when you'd like to set sail.$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_3: Ah, it's you again!\nDo you want to go to the ALOLA ISLES?$
data/maps/Route13_hns/scripts.inc.Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_4:
Ahoy!
This port is for residents only.\pAll of the residents of these ISLES
carry some… {PAUSE 30}strange souvenirs.\pIt makes them so easy to identify,
I don't even need to check tickets!$

data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_Eusine:
EUSINE: {PLAYER}! Not again!
I'll be there first next time!\pHaving followed it here, I'm
starting to understand what SUICUNE\lis after.\pTo be honest, I would like to keep
this information to myself.\pBut I want to be an honest trainer
in front of SUICUNE!\pThat's why I am sharing a clue with
you.\pIt seems that...
SUICUNE prefers a hilly place...\lNear water...\lSomewhere north...\pI don't know exactly where yet.
It will just be you and me!\pWho'll find it first?
I challenge you!$
data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_PokefanmTrevorSeen: Hi. Did you know…?\pPOKéMON get more friendly if you\ntrain them in a place that they\lremember.$
data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_PokefanmTrevorBeaten: Where did I meet this SCIZOR?$
data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_PokefanmTrevorAfterBattle: If only there were an easy way to\nidentify where I got my POKéMON…$
data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_TrevorRegister: You're interesting!\nCan I have your number?$
data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_TrevorRematchIntro: I've been training with my\nPOKéMON in familiar places!$
data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_TrevorPostRematch: Friendship makes POKéMON\nstronger. I'm sure of it!$
data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_PokefanmCarterSeen: Let me tell you, I had a hard time\ncatching my prized POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_PokefanmCarterAfterBattle: TOTODILE, CYNDAQUIL, CHIKORITA…\pI think that's a well-balanced mix.$
data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_CarterRegister: You know your starters!\nLet me get your number!$
data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_CarterRematchIntro: I've found even more rare starters\nto show off! Battle me!$
data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_CarterPostRematch: There are so many starters from\ndifferent regions to collect!$
data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_BirdKeeperRoySeen: My dream is to fly with my beloved\nbird POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_BirdKeeperRoyBeaten: I can dream, but I can't ever fly…$
data/maps/Route14_hns/scripts.inc.Route14_Text_BirdKeeperRoyAfterBattle: You have POKéMON that know the HM\nmove FLY, don't you? I envy you.$

data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_TeacherColetteAfterBattle: Before I became a teacher, I used\nto forget a lot of things.$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_TeacherHillarySeen: On sunny days, I think that the\nkids would rather be playing in the\lschoolyard than studying in class.$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_TeacherHillaryAfterBattle: Studying is important, but\nexercise is just as vital.$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_HillaryRegister: You've taught me a lesson!\nMay I have your number?$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_HillaryPostRematch: Teaching POKéMON is just like\nteaching children. Patience!$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_SchoolboyKippSeen: Hang on. I have to phone my mom.$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_SchoolboyKippAfterBattle: My mom worries so much about me, I\nhave to phone her all the time.$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_SchoolboyTommyBeaten: I forgot to do my homework!$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_SchoolboyTommyAfterBattle: Sayonara! I just learned that in\nmy Japanese class.$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_SchoolboyJohnnySeen: We're on a field trip to LAVENDER\nRADIO TOWER for social studies.$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_SchoolboyJohnnyAfterBattle: I'm tired of walking. I need to\ntake a break.$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_SchoolboyBillyBeaten: Oh, no! How could I lose?$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_SchoolboyBillyAfterBattle: If POKéMON were a subject at\nschool, I'd be the best!$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_BillyRegister: I should've paid more attention in class.\nCan I have your number?$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_BillyRematchIntro: I've been studying hard!\nLet me show you what I learned!$
data/maps/Route15_hns/scripts.inc.Route15_Text_BillyPostRematch: Book smarts aren't everything.\nI need battle experience too!$

data/maps/Route16_House_hns/scripts.inc.Route16FuchsiaSpeechHouse_Text_SuperNerd: A celebrity used to live here.$
If you cruise down CYCLING ROAD,\nyou will end up in FUCHSIA CITY.$

data/maps/Route16_hns/scripts.inc.Route16_Text_Sign: CYCLING ROAD\nDOWNHILL COASING\lALL THE WAY DOWN!$

data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_BikerRileySeen: Hey, you! You're from JOHTO, huh?$
data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_BikerRileyAfterBattle: Don't get cocky, you JOHTO punk!$
data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_BikerJoelBeaten: But you don't just look cool…$
data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_BikerJoelAfterBattle: I look cool, but I'm weak, so I'm\nnot really cool.\pI have to train harder…$
data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_BikerGlennSeen: Hey! Want to have a speed battle?$
data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_BikerGlennAfterBattle: Hands-free riding is considered\ncool on CYCLING ROAD.$
data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_BikerCharlesAfterBattle: Reckless driving causes accidents!\nTake it easy!$
data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_RileyRegister: Not bad for a JOHTO kid!$
data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_RileyRematchIntro: JOHTO punks can only win once!$
data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_RileyPostRematch: Maybe I should train in JOHTO\nafter all.$
data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_JoelRegister: You're pretty cool after all!\nLet's trade numbers!$
data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_JoelPostRematch: I'll keep training to be as cool\nas you, kid!$
data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_CharlesRegister: You're a heartbreaker like me, kid!\nGive me your number!$
data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_CharlesRematchIntro: I'm not just a highway star,\nI'm a heartbreaker!$
data/maps/Route17_hns/scripts.inc.Route17_Text_CharlesPostRematch: I met a trainer like you in UNOVA.\nDon't crash out!$

data/maps/Route18_hns/scripts.inc.Route18_Text_BirdKeeperBorisSeen: If you're looking for POKéMON,\nyou have to look in the tall grass.$
data/maps/Route18_hns/scripts.inc.Route18_Text_BirdKeeperBorisAfterBattle: Since you're so strong, it must be\nfun to battle.$
data/maps/Route18_hns/scripts.inc.Route18_Text_BirdKeeperBobSeen: CYCLING ROAD is a quick shortcut\nto CELADON.$
data/maps/Route18_hns/scripts.inc.Route18_Text_BirdKeeperBobAfterBattle: If you don't have a BICYCLE,\nyou're not allowed to use the\lshortcut.$

data/maps/Route19_hns/scripts.inc.Route19_Text_SwimmermHaroldSeen: Have you ever gone swimming in the\nsea at night?$
data/maps/Route19_hns/scripts.inc.Route19_Text_SwimmermHaroldAfterBattle: At night, the sea turns black. It\nfeels like it will swallow you up.$
data/maps/Route19_hns/scripts.inc.Route19_Text_SwimmermTuckerSeen: Pant, pant… Just… a little…\pfarther… to… FUCHSIA…$
data/maps/Route19_hns/scripts.inc.Route19_Text_SwimmermTuckerAfterBattle: I… asked my girlfriend to swim to\nFUCHSIA… Gasp…$
data/maps/Route19_hns/scripts.inc.Route19_Text_SwimmerfDawnBeaten: I could beat you at swimming…$
data/maps/Route19_hns/scripts.inc.Route19_Text_SwimmerfDawnAfterBattle: It's a quick swim between FUCHSIA\nand SEAFOAM ISLANDS…\pSheesh, some big man my boyfriend\nis! What a wimp!$
data/maps/Route19_hns/scripts.inc.Route19_Text_SwimmermJeromeSeen: Swimming? I'm lousy at it.\pI'm just splashing around in these\nshallow waters.$
data/maps/Route19_hns/scripts.inc.Route19_Text_SwimmermJeromeAfterBattle: I might be bad at swimming, but I\nlove the sea.$
data/maps/Route19_hns/scripts.inc.Route19_Text_Fisher1:
Sorry. This road is closed for
construction.\pIf you want to get to CINNABAR,
you'd better go south from PALLET
TOWN.$
data/maps/Route19_hns/scripts.inc.Route19_Text_Fisher1_RocksCleared: I'm all sweaty. Time for a swim!$
data/maps/Route19_hns/scripts.inc.Route19_Text_Fisher2: Aw man, KINGLER is blocking the\nbeach.$
data/maps/Route19_hns/scripts.inc.Route19_Text_FisherBefore: No fishing until these KINGLER\nclear out.$
data/maps/Route19_hns/scripts.inc.Route19_Text_Fisher2_RocksCleared: Those KINGLER finally left!\pNow I can go fishing again.$
data/maps/Route19_hns/scripts.inc.Route19_Text_CarefulSwimmingSign: Please be careful if you are\nswimming to SEAFOAM ISLANDS.\pFUCHSIA POLICE$

data/maps/Route1_hns/scripts.inc.Route1_Text_SchoolboyDanny_Seen: If trainers meet, the first\nthing to do is battle.$
data/maps/Route1_hns/scripts.inc.Route1_Text_SchoolboyDanny_Beaten: Awww… I've got a losing record…$
data/maps/Route1_hns/scripts.inc.Route1_Text_SchoolboyDanny_AfterBattle: For trainers, it's a given that\nwe'll battle whenever we meet.$
data/maps/Route1_hns/scripts.inc.Route1_Text_CooltrainerFQuinn_AfterBattl: You're strong.\pYou obviously must have trained\nhard.$

data/maps/Route20_hns/scripts.inc.Route20_Text_Headlocker:
There's a rare POKéMON on this
route.\pAnd sometimes it carries a rare
evolution item.\pThat's double rare!\pI need to finish my POKéDEX, so
I've been fishing here for hours!$
data/maps/Route20_hns/scripts.inc.Route20_Text_NicoleRegister: Your POKéMON swims fast!\nLet me get your number!$
data/maps/Route20_hns/scripts.inc.Route20_Text_NicoleRematchIntro: All this swimming has made my\nPOKéMON stronger! Let's battle!$
data/maps/Route20_hns/scripts.inc.Route20_Text_NicolePostRematch: Win or lose, I'm getting fit and\nso are my POKéMON!$
data/maps/Route20_hns/scripts.inc.Route20_Text_SwimmerfNicoleSeen: I feel so much lighter in water.$
data/maps/Route20_hns/scripts.inc.Route20_Text_SwimmerfNicoleAfterBattle: Swimming exercises your full body.\pIt's really good for you.$
data/maps/Route20_hns/scripts.inc.Route20_Text_SwimmerfLoriSeen: What an impressive collection of\nGYM BADGES. We should battle!$
data/maps/Route20_hns/scripts.inc.Route20_Text_SwimmerfLoriAfterBattle: SURF is no longer the only HM move\nyou use in water.$
data/maps/Route20_hns/scripts.inc.Route20_Text_SwimmermCameronSeen: I guess it's impossible to swim\nall the way to JOHTO.$
data/maps/Route20_hns/scripts.inc.Route20_Text_SwimmermCameronAfterBattle: Besides the sea, I can also swim\nin ponds and rivers.$
data/maps/Route20_hns/scripts.inc.Route20_Text_CinnabarIsland_GymUnusedSig: What does this sign say?\pCINNABAR GYM LEADER: BLAINE$

data/maps/Route21_hns/scripts.inc.Route21_Text_SwimmermSethAfterBattle: This arrogant guy was at CINNABAR's\nvolcano.$
data/maps/Route21_hns/scripts.inc.Route21_Text_SwimmerfNikkiSeen: If I win, you have to help me with\nmy suntan lotion!$
data/maps/Route21_hns/scripts.inc.Route21_Text_SwimmerfNikkiAfterBattle: I have to watch out for blemishes\ncaused by the sun.$
data/maps/Route21_hns/scripts.inc.Route21_Text_FisherArnoldSeen: I'm bored by fishing. Let's battle!$
data/maps/Route21_hns/scripts.inc.Route21_Text_FisherArnoldAfterBattle: I'll just go back to fishing…$

data/maps/Route22_hns/scripts.inc.Route22_Text_Silver1: {RIVAL}: You told me...\nyou were the number one in the whole\lworld!\pAre you gonna quit?\pWhat are you going to do now?$
data/maps/Route22_hns/scripts.inc.Route22_Text_Giovanni1: ....................\pGIOVANNI: One must acknowledge one's\ndefeat before he can move on...\pI will go solo... for now...\pSo that one day I will form a\nstronger organization!$
data/maps/Route22_hns/scripts.inc.Route22_Text_Silver2: {RIVAL}: What aspect of you was\nnumber one?\pGathering so many only to be\ndefeated by a mere child!$
data/maps/Route22_hns/scripts.inc.Route22_Text_Giovanni2:
GIOVANNI: Putting together the
potential of many is how you\lproduce a huge power...\lThat's what an organization is...\lThat's the strength of organization\pI failed... to make the best use of
my subordinates' potential...!\pBut you shall witness one day the
revival of me and my TEAM ROCKET!$
data/maps/Route22_hns/scripts.inc.Route22_Text_Silver3: {RIVAL}: I don't understand you!\pYou don't make any sense!$
data/maps/Route22_hns/scripts.inc.Route22_Text_Silver4:
{RIVAL}: I don't want to
understand you!\pI will never become someone like
you.\pA coward when you're alone and
acting like a tyrant when you're\lin front of other cowards!\pI will become strong!\pI will become a stronger man all
by myself!$

data/maps/Route24_hns/scripts.inc.Route24_Text_RocketSeen:
Hey, kid! Me am a TEAM ROCKET
member kind of guy!\pCome from another country, a
trainer number one, me!\pThink I did, if stop the energy,
be big panic for here people!\pSecret it is my mission, so tell
you I not!\pBut! If win you do versus me, a
man I be and mine secret to you\lI tell.\pHey, kid! Battle begin we do!$
data/maps/Route24_hns/scripts.inc.Route24_Text_RocketBeaten: Ayieeeh! No, no, no, believe it\nI can't!\pStrong very much be you! Match\nI am not to you!$
data/maps/Route24_hns/scripts.inc.Route24_Text_RocketAfter:
OK. Tell you mine secret will I?
MACHINE PART steal by me, hide it\lI did in GYM of the CERULEAN.\pInside water put it I did. Look
for in water center of GYM at.\pBut you forget me not!\pBeat you for sure will TEAM
ROCKET.\pCome from JOHTO will they, mine
friends, yes. Will revenge they\lare.$
data/maps/Route24_hns/scripts.inc.Route24_Text_RocketDisappears: …\pYou say what? TEAM ROCKET bye-\nbye a go-go? Broken it is says\lyou?\pOh, no! Should I do what now on\nfrom, me?$
data/maps/Route24_hns/scripts.inc.Route24_Text_Man: I could stay here all day.$

data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_Teleporter: THIS MACHINE WILL TRANSFORM\nA POKéMON INTO ITS GALARIAN FORM\lTHIS PROCESS IS PERMANENT.\lWOULD YOU LIKE TO PROCEED?$
data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_GrandpaIntro: Hm? You know BILL? He's my\ngrandson.\pHe's in JOHTO. He does\nsomething with PCs, so I'm\lhousesitting.$
data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_GrampsMeowth: My grandson BILL told me about\na POKéMON that has sharp claws,\la charm on its head, and is\psaid to bring good fortune.$
data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_GrampsZigzagoon: BILL mentioned a POKéMON that\nruns around in a zigzag\lpattern.\pIt's quite the little\nscavenger, I hear.$
data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_GrampsPonyta: Do you know of a POKéMON with\na fiery mane?\pI hear it can run faster than\nmost trains.$
data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_GrampsFarfetchd: BILL told me about a POKéMON\nthat always carries a stalk\lof leek with it.\pQuite the peculiar creature.$
data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_GrampsSlowpoke: Do you know the POKéMON that\nis always staring blankly?\pIts tail is often sold on the\nblack market.$
data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_TeleporterUnlock:
Oh, one more thing!\pBILL's TELEPORTER.
That's the big machine over there.\pHe never quite got it working.\pBut it does curious things to
POKéMON.\pYou're welcome to try it, if
you'd like!\pJust use that computer over there.$
data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_AskToSeeMon: If you have that POKéMON, may I\nsee it, please?$
data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_ExcitedToSee: You will show me? How good of\nyou!$
data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_YouDontHaveIt: You don't have it?\nThat's too bad…$
data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_ShownPokemon: Ah, so that is {STR_VAR_1}?\pIsn't it cute! That's so kind\nof you.$
data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_Appreciation: Thanks!\pThis is a token of my\nappreciation.$
data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_ShownAll:
Thanks for showing me so many
cute POKéMON.\pI really enjoyed myself. I'm
glad I've lived such a long life.\pFeel free to use the TELEPORTER
whenever you like.$
data/maps/Route25_BillsHouse_hns/scripts.Route25_BillsHouse_Text_WrongPokemon: Hm?\pThat's not the POKéMON that I\nwas told about.$

data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_Misty: MISTY: I love the sunset here!\nIt gives me the courage to go on,\lyou know?\pRight!\pIf you're ready for a real splash,\nmeet me at the FIGHTING DOJO!$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_Eusine1:
EUSINE: Puff, puff...
I am... no match for you.\p...As I predicted.
..........................\l... Go ahead.\pSince I met you in the BURNED TOWER
at ECRUTEAK CITY, I've sort of\lknown that SUICUNE would choose\lyou.$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_Eusine2: Take a look at it!\pSUICUNE is waiting for you!\nIt has been waiting for a battle\lwith a worthy trainer to whom it\lcan entrust itself.$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_Eusine3:
{PLAYER}...
You two are truly amazing...\pI have never seen a battle this
intense!\lI have no regrets...\pFarewell, SUICUNE!
Farewell... {PLAYER}!$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_MistyDate:
MISTY: Aww! Why did you have to
show up and bug us now?\pDo you know what they call
people like you?\pPests! You heard me right,
pest!\p…\p…Oh? Those BADGES you have…
Are they JOHTO GYM BADGES?\pIf you have eight, you must be
good.\pOK, then. Come to CERULEAN GYM.\pI'll be happy to take you on.\pI'm MISTY, the GYM LEADER in
CERULEAN.$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_SchoolboyDudleySeen: Beat the six of us trainers to\nwin a fabulous prize!\pThink you've got what it takes?$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_SchoolboyDudleyAfter: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_LassEllenAfter: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_SchoolboyJoeAfter: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_LassLauraAfter: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_CamperLloydAfter: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_LassShannonSeen: I'm the last in line, but I tell\nyou, I'm tough!$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_LassShannonAfter: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_SupernerdPatSeen: Mufufufu…\pI have nothing to do with the\nsix-pack trainers.\pI waited here to beat you when\nyou were tired out by all the\lbattles.$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_CooltrainerKevinNugget: You took on one more battle than\nyou expected, but you won\lanyway.\pAs promised, you win a prize.$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_CooltrainerKevinSeen: But after seeing how you battle,\nI want to see how I'll fare.\pHow about it? Let me take you\non.$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_CooltrainerKevinBeaten: I've never had a battle this\ngood!$
data/maps/Route25_hns/scripts.inc.Route25_Text_CooltrainerKevinAfter: That was a great battle!\pYou and your POKéMON are truly\noutstanding!$

data/maps/Route26_House1_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_HealHouseRest: Your POKéMON look a little tired.\pYou should rest them a while.$
data/maps/Route26_House1_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_HealHouseKeepAtIt: There!\pYour POKéMON are looking good!\pKeep at it!$

data/maps/Route26_House2_hns/scripts.inc.DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse_Text_Pokedex2:
To my brothers and sisters:\pWe take pride in serving POKéMON
trainers.\pWhen trainers talk to you, give
them something useful.\pLove,
MONICA\pKeep reading?$

data/maps/Route26_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_CooltrainermJakeSeen: I'm making my final preparations\nfor the POKéMON LEAGUE.$
data/maps/Route26_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_CooltrainermJakeAfter: It's going to be tough to win at\nthe LEAGUE.\pI need to do some more training.\pI hear that the LEAGUE's ELITE\nFOUR are tougher than GYM LEADERS.$
data/maps/Route26_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_CooltrainermGavenSeen: By experiencing tough battles, you\ngain power.$
data/maps/Route26_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_CooltrainermGavenAfter: To get to POKéMON LEAGUE, you have\nto get through VICTORY ROAD.\pBut VICTORY ROAD is tough.\pPractically nobody goes there!$
data/maps/Route26_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_GavenRegister: To get to POKéMON LEAGUE, you have\nto get through VICTORY ROAD.\pBut VICTORY ROAD is tough.\pPractically nobody goes there!$
data/maps/Route26_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_GavenRematchIntro: By experiencing tough battles, you\ngain power.$
data/maps/Route26_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_GavenPostRematch: To get to POKéMON LEAGUE, you have\nto get through VICTORY ROAD.\pBut VICTORY ROAD is tough.\pPractically nobody goes there!$
data/maps/Route26_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_CooltrainerfJoyceSeen: Since you've come this far,\nyou must be good.\pI'm going to give this battle\neverything I've got!$
data/maps/Route26_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_CooltrainerfJoyceAfter: I've defeated eight GYM LEADERS,\nso I was feeling confident.\pI'll have to try harder next time.$
data/maps/Route26_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_CooltrainerfBethSeen: I lost to a trainer named {RIVAL}.\pHe was really strong, but…\pIt was as if he absolutely had to\nwin at any cost.\pI felt sorry for his POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route26_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_BethRematchIntro: I lost to a trainer named {RIVAL}.\pBut I won't lose to you!$
data/maps/Route26_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_PsychicRichardSeen: Wow, look at all those BADGES!\nI'm impressed.\pBut you're not satisfied by just\ncollecting them, right?$
data/maps/Route26_hns/scripts.inc.Route26_Text_PsychicRichardAfter: People and POKéMON grow from their\nexperiences.\pDon't get lazy and complacent.$

data/maps/Route27_House_hns/scripts.inc.SandstormHouse_Text_Woman1: Where are you off to with\nPOKéMON?\pPOKéMON LEAGUE?\pAre your POKéMON loyal enough for\nyou to win?\pLet me see…$
data/maps/Route27_House_hns/scripts.inc.SandstormHouse_Text_LoyalMon: Ah! Your POKéMON trusts you very\nmuch.\pIt's nice to see a good trainer.\pHere. A gift for your journey.$
data/maps/Route27_House_hns/scripts.inc.SandstormHouse_Text_TM37Description: TM37 happens to be SANDSTORM.\pIt's a move that inflicts damage\non both battlers.\pIt's for advanced trainers only.\pUse it if you dare. Good luck!$
data/maps/Route27_House_hns/scripts.inc.SandstormHouse_Text_DisloyalMon: If it doesn't come to trust you\nsome more, it could be tough going.\pTrust is the tie that binds POKéMON\nand trainers.$

data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_FisherMessage: Do you know what you just did?\pYou've taken your first step into\nKANTO.\pCheck your POKéGEAR MAP and see.$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_CooltrainermBlakeSeen: You look pretty strong.\nLet me battle you!$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_CooltrainermBlakeAfter: If you prevail on this harsh trek,\nthe truth will be revealed!\pHeh, sorry, I just wanted to say\nsomething cool.$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_CooltrainermBrianAfter: A good trainer can recognize other\ngood trainers.$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_CooltrainerfReenaSeen: You shouldn't underestimate the\nwild POKéMON in these parts.$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_CooltrainerfReenaAfter: You're just a kid, but you're not\nto be underestimated either.$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_ReenaRegister: You're just a kid, but you're not\nto be underestimated either.$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_ReenaRematchIntro: You shouldn't underestimate the\nwild POKéMON in these parts.$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_ReenaPostRematch: You're just a kid, but you're not\nto be underestimated either.$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_CooltrainerfMeganSeen: It's rare to see anyone come here.\pAre you training on your own?$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_CooltrainerfMeganAfter:
I'm checking out pre- and post-
evolution POKéMON.\pEvolution really does make
POKéMON stronger.\pBut evolved forms also learn
moves later on.$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_PsychicGilbertSeen: Don't say a thing!\pLet me guess what you're thinking.\pMmmmmmm…\pI got it! You're on the POKéMON\nLEAGUE challenge!$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_PsychicGilbertAfter: With your skills, you'll do well at\nthe LEAGUE.\pThat's what my premonition says.$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_BirdKeeperJoseAfter: BIRD KEEPERS like me mimic bird\nwhistles to command POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_JoseRegister: BIRD KEEPERS like me mimic bird\nwhistles to command POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_JosePostRematch: BIRD KEEPERS like me mimic bird\nwhistles to command POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_JoseHasItem: Hey! I found something\nshiny while bird-watching!\pHere, you can have it!$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_JoseGaveItem: I find all sorts of things\nout here on ROUTE 27.\pI'll let you know if I find\nanything else!$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_JoseNoRoom: Hmm, your BAG is full.\pCome back when you have room.$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.TohjoFalls_Text_Sign: TOHJO FALLS\pTHE LINK BETWEEN KANTO AND JOHTO$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_FisherScottSeen: I'm feeling great today!\pI feel like I could boot even the\nLEAGUE CHAMP!$
data/maps/Route27_hns/scripts.inc.Route27_Text_FisherScottAfter: Just like in fishing, it's all over\nin POKéMON if you give up.$

data/maps/Route28_House_hns/scripts.inc.Route28House_Text_Celebrity1: Oh, dear. You've found me.\pPlease don't tell anyone about me.\pI'll give you this for keeping my\nsecret. Please?$
data/maps/Route28_House_hns/scripts.inc.Route28House_Text_Celebrity2: It's tough being a top celebrity.\pEverywhere I go, people chase me.\pI just want to be left alone…$

data/maps/Route28_hns/scripts.inc.Route28_Text_Scientist: Hiya, Boss.\pYes, I've found several artifacts,\nbut no sign of the AZURE FLUTE.\pIt may be inside the MOUNTAIN, but\nthe wild POKéMON here are strong,\land my team needs some rest...\p..................\pYou're breaking up...\lBoss....?\pI'm going to the POKéMON CENTER.\pI'll call back if I find the FLUTE.$

data/maps/Route29_hns/scripts.inc.Route29_Text_PressAorB: Press A or B to stop viewing.$
data/maps/Route29_hns/scripts.inc.Route29_Text_OldMan1: POKéMON hide in the grass.\nWho knows when they'll pop out…$
data/maps/Route29_hns/scripts.inc.Route29_Text_OldMan2: I've seen you a couple times.\nHow many POKéMON have you caught?\pWould you like me to tell you\nhow to catch POKéMON?$
data/maps/Route29_hns/scripts.inc.Route29_Text_OldManExplanation:
If you weaken them first,
POKéMON are easier to catch.\pThen, throw a ball at them from
your bag! Any ball will do.\pIf you want to learn more,
go to the ACADEMY in VIOLET CITY!\pThe students there know a lot
about POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route29_hns/scripts.inc.Route29_Text_OldManDeclined:
Oh. Fine, then.\pCheck every route to find
different types of POKéMON.\pYour POKéDEX shows where you can
find them too!\pIf you want to learn more,
go to the ACADEMY in VIOLET CITY!\pThe students know a lot about
POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route29_hns/scripts.inc.Route29_Text_Youngster: Yo. How are your POKéMON?\pIf they're weak and not ready\nfor battle, keep out of the grass.$
data/maps/Route29_hns/scripts.inc.Route29_Text_Lass: See those ledges?\nIt's scary to jump off them.\pBut you can go to NEW BARK\nwithout walking through the grass.$
data/maps/Route29_hns/scripts.inc.Route29_Text_Girl: I wanted to take a break,\nso I saved to record my progress.$
data/maps/Route29_hns/scripts.inc.Route29_Text_Boy_WaitingForDay: I'm waiting for POKéMON that\nappear only later in the day.$
data/maps/Route29_hns/scripts.inc.Route29_Text_Boy_WaitingForNight: I'm waiting for POKéMON that\nappear only at night.$
data/maps/Route29_hns/scripts.inc.Route29_Text_MeetTuscany: TUSCANY: I do believe that this\nis the first time we've met?\pI'm TUSCANY of the WEEKDAY FAMILY.\pIf you can guess my favorite day,\nI'll give you a reward.$
data/maps/Route29_hns/scripts.inc.Route29_Text_TuscanyGivesGift: Yes! By way of introduction,\nplease accept this gift, a SILK\lSCARF.$
data/maps/Route29_hns/scripts.inc.Route29_Text_TuscanyGaveGift: TUSCANY: Wouldn't you agree\nthat it is most adorable?\pIt strengthens NORMAL-type\nmoves.\pI am certain it will be of use.$
data/maps/Route29_hns/scripts.inc.Route29_Text_TuscanyTuesday: TUSCANY: Have you met MONICA,\nmy older sister?\pOr my younger brother, WESLEY?\pI am the third of seven\nchildren.$

data/maps/Route2_House_hns/scripts.inc.Route2_House_Text_Fisher: Hi! Wow, I'm glad to see you.\pYou're the first visitor I've had in a\nlong time.\pI'm super-happy! Let me give you a\nlittle present.$
data/maps/Route2_House_hns/scripts.inc.Route2_House_Text_Fisher_GotNugget: That's a NUGGET.\pI can't give you any nuggets of\nwisdom, so that'll have to do!$

data/maps/Route2_hns/scripts.inc.Route2_Text_RobRematchIntro: I've caught even more bugs!\nCheck them out!$
data/maps/Route2_hns/scripts.inc.Route2_Text_RobPostRematch: I caught every bug in VIRIDIAN.\nIs there a better FOREST somewhere?$
data/maps/Route2_hns/scripts.inc.Route2_Text_BugCatcherRob_Seen: My bug POKéMON are tough. Prepare to\nlose!$
data/maps/Route2_hns/scripts.inc.Route2_Text_BugCatcherRob_AfterBattle: I'm going to look for stronger bug\nPOKéMON.$
data/maps/Route2_hns/scripts.inc.Route2_Text_BugCatcherEd_Seen: If you walk in tall grass wearing\nshorts, do you get nicks and cuts?$
data/maps/Route2_hns/scripts.inc.Route2_Text_BugCatcherEd_AfterBattle: They'll really sting when you take a\nbath.$
data/maps/Route2_hns/scripts.inc.Route2_Text_BugCatcherDoug_Seen: Why don't girls like bug POKéMON?$
data/maps/Route2_hns/scripts.inc.Route2_Text_BugCatcherDoug_AfterBattle: Bug POKéMON squish like plush toys\nwhen you squeeze their bellies.\pI love how they feel!$

data/maps/Route30_House_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_BerryHouse_Text_MonEatBerries:
When you follow that path up north,
you will see MR. POKéMON’s house.\pBut before you go, allow me to
tell you about BERRIES!\pPOKéMON get healthier by eating
BERRIES.\pThey can even eat BERRIES
they're holding in battle.\pBERRIES can also be turned into
BALLS by KURT in AZALEA TOWN.\pHere. I'll share one with you!$
data/maps/Route30_House_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_BerryHouse_Text_CheckTrees: Check trees for BERRIES.\nThey grow back after a few hours.$

data/maps/Route30_MrPokemonsHouse_hns/sc.MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro1: Hello, hello! You must be\n{PLAYER}.\pPROF.ELM said that you would\nvisit.$
data/maps/Route30_MrPokemonsHouse_hns/sc.MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro2: This is what I want PROF.ELM\nto examine.$
data/maps/Route30_MrPokemonsHouse_hns/sc.MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro3:
I know a couple who run a
POKéMON DAY-CARE service.\pThey gave me that EGG.\pI was intrigued, so I sent
mail to PROF.ELM.\pFor POKéMON evolution,
PROF.ELM is the authority.$
data/maps/Route30_MrPokemonsHouse_hns/sc.MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro5: If my assumption is correct,\nPROF.ELM will know it.$
data/maps/Route30_MrPokemonsHouse_hns/sc.MrPokemonHouse_Text_Heal: You are returning to PROF.ELM?\pHere. Your POKéMON should have\nsome rest.$
data/maps/Route30_MrPokemonsHouse_hns/sc.MrPokemonHouse_Text_AlwaysNewDiscoveries: Life is delightful!\nAlways, new discoveries to be made.$
data/maps/Route30_MrPokemonsHouse_hns/sc.MrPokemonHouse_Text_OakIntro:
OAK: Aha! So you're {PLAYER}!\pI'm OAK! A POKéMON researcher.\pI was just visiting my old friend
MR. POKéMON.\pI heard you were running an errand
for PROF.ELM, so I waited here.\pOh! What's this? A rare POKéMON!\pLet's see…
Hm, I see!\pI understand why PROF.ELM gave
you a POKéMON for this errand.\pTo researchers like PROF.ELM and
I, POKéMON are our friends.\pHe saw that you would treat your
POKéMON with love and care.\p…Ah!\pYou seem to be dependable. How
would you like to help me out?\pSee? This is the latest version of
the POKéDEX.\pIt automatically records data on
POKéMON you've seen or caught.\pIt's a hi-tech encyclopedia!\pIt shows their habitats, how
they evolve, and their moves.$
data/maps/Route30_MrPokemonsHouse_hns/sc.MrPokemonHouse_Text_OakParting: Go meet many kinds of POKéMON and\ncomplete that POKéDEX!\pBut I've stayed too long.\pI have to get to GOLDENROD\nfor my usual radio show.\p{PLAYER}, I'm counting on you!$
data/maps/Route30_MrPokemonsHouse_hns/sc.MrPokemonHouse_Text_GimmeTheScale:
Hm? That SCALE! What's that?
A red GYARADOS?\pThat's rare! I, I want it…\p{PLAYER}, would you care to
trade it?\pI can offer this EXP.SHARE
that I got from PROF.OAK.$
data/maps/Route30_MrPokemonsHouse_hns/sc.MrPokemonHouse_Text_Disappointed: That's disappointing.\nThat happens to be very rare.$
data/maps/Route30_MrPokemonsHouse_hns/sc.MrPokemonHouse_Text_ExpShare: I also have a special item\nfor you.$
data/maps/Route30_MrPokemonsHouse_hns/sc.MrPokemonHouse_Text_ForeignMagazines: It's packed with foreign\nmagazines.\pCan't even read their titles…$
data/maps/Route30_MrPokemonsHouse_hns/sc.MrPokemonHouse_Text_BrokenComputer: It's a big computer.\nHmm. It's broken.$
data/maps/Route30_MrPokemonsHouse_hns/sc.MrPokemonHouse_Text_StrangeCoins: A whole pile of strange coins!\pMaybe they're from another\ncountry…$

data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_ThisIsABigBattle: What? This is a big battle!\nLeave me alone!$
data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_YoungsterJoey1Seen: I just lost, so I'm trying to\nfind more POKéMON.\pWait! You look weak! Come on,\nlet's battle!$
data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_YoungsterJoey1After: Do I have to have more POKéMON\nin order to battle better?\pNo! I'm sticking with this one\nno matter what!$
data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_YoungsterMikeySeen: You're a POKéMON trainer,\nright?\pThen you have to battle!$
data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_YoungsterMikeyAfter: Becoming a good trainer is\nreally tough.\pI'm going to battle other\npeople to get better.$
data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_BugCatcherDonSeen: Instead of a bug POKéMON,\nI found a trainer!$
data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_BugCatcherDonAfter: I ran out of POKé BALLS while\nI was catching POKéMON.\pI should've bought some more…$
data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_YoungsterDirectionsToMrPoke: MR. POKéMON's house?\nIt's a bit farther ahead.$
data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_CooltrainerF: I'm not a trainer.\pBut if you look one in the\neyes, prepare to battle.$
data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_TrainerTips: TRAINER TIPS\pNo stealing other people's\nPOKéMON!\pPOKé BALLS are to be thrown\nonly at wild POKéMON!$
data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_JoeyRegister: You're pretty good!\pMy RATTATA's raring to go,\njust like always.\pIt's the only one I have.\nI'm going to become a great\lTRAINER with it!\pLet's battle again sometime!$
data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_JoeyRematchIntro: I promised things would be\ndifferent! Let's battle!$
data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_JoeyPostRematch: I'm checking out my\nRATTATA's moves and devising\lsome strategies.\pWhen I come up with a good\none, let's battle!$
data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_YoungsterJoeyGiveHPUp:
I lost again…
Gee, you're tough!\pOh yeah, I almost forgot that
I had to give you this.\pUse it to get even tougher,
OK?\pI'm going to get tougher too.$
data/maps/Route30_hns/scripts.inc.Route30_Text_Elm_Disaster: PROF.ELM: H-hello? {PLAYER}? It's\na disaster!\pUh, um, it's just terrible!\pWhat should I do? It…\nOh, no…\pPlease get back here now!$

data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_CooltrainerM: DARK CAVE…\pIf POKéMON could light it up,\nI'd explore it.$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_BugCatcherWade1_Seen: I caught a bunch of POKéMON.\nLet me battle with you!$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_BugCatcherWade1_After: You can catch POKéMON even if\nyou have six with you.\pIf you catch one, it'll go to\nyour BOX automatically.$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_SleepyMan: … Hnuurg… Huh?\pI walked too far today looking\nfor POKéMON.\pMy feet hurt and I'm sleepy…\pIf I were a wild POKéMON, I'd\nbe easy to catch…\p…Zzzz…$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_SleepyManGotMail: …Zzzz… Huh?\pWhat's that? You have MAIL\nfor me?$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_HandOverMailMon: {PLAYER} handed over the\nPOKéMON holding the MAIL.$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_ReadingMail:
Let's see…\pThanks for bringing this to
me.\pMy friend's a good guy, and
you're swell too!\pI'd like to do something good
in return too!\pI know! I want you to have
this!$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_DescribeRest: ...Zzz...\p...Umm... Rest!\pThe phrase 'recover fast' became\nshortened to 'Rest,' you see?\pThis is a move to sleep and recover\nsome HP.$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_MissingMail: Why is this POKéMON so special?\pIt doesn't have any MAIL.$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_CantTakeLastMon: If I take that POKéMON from\nyou,\pwhat are you going to use in\nbattle?$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_Youngster:
I found a good POKéMON in DARK
CAVE.\pI'm going to raise it to take
on FALKNER.\pHe's the leader of VIOLET
CITY's GYM.$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_WadeRegister:
You're awesome! I like you!\pI look for POKéMON here every
day.\pWhen I'm in the grass, I find
all kinds of BERRIES.\pIf you'd like, I'll share
some.$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_WadeRematchIntro: I was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_WadePostRematch: You'll hear from me as soon\nas I find anything that you\lmight like.$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_WadeHasItem: Hey! I've been looking for\nyou!\pI found something while I\nwas in the grass.\pHere, you can have it!$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_WadeGaveItem: I'll let you know if I find\nanything else!$
data/maps/Route31_hns/scripts.inc.Route31_Text_WadeNoRoom: Hmm, looks like your BAG\nis full.\pCome back when you have\nroom!$

data/maps/Route32_PokemonCenter_hns/scri.Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruQuest: This is a great fishing spot.\pYou saw people fishing?\nHow about you?\pWould you like one of my RODS?$
data/maps/Route32_PokemonCenter_hns/scri.Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruYes: Heh, that's good to hear.\pNow you're an angler too!$
data/maps/Route32_PokemonCenter_hns/scri.Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruGiveR: Fishing is great!\pIf there's water, be it the sea or\na stream, try out your ROD.$
data/maps/Route32_PokemonCenter_hns/scri.Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruAfter: Yo, kid. How are they biting?$
data/maps/Route32_PokemonCenter_hns/scri.Route32_Pokecenter_Text_CooltrainerF: What should I make my POKéMON hold?\pMaybe an item that increases\nATTACK power…$

data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_AideIsWaiting: {PLAYER}, right?\nSome guy wearing glasses\pwas looking for you.\pSee for yourself. He's waiting for\nyou at the POKéMON CENTER.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_SproutTower: Have you gone to SPROUT TOWER?\nIf you ever visit VIOLET CITY,\pthey'll expect you to train there.\nThat's basic for trainers.\pGo to SPROUT TOWER!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_VioletGym: Have you gone to the POKéMON GYM?\nYou can test your POKéMON and\pyourself there.\nIt's a rite of passage for all\ptrainers!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_HaveThisSeed:
You have some good POKéMON there.
It must be from the training you\pgave them around VIOLET CITY.
The training at the GYM must have\pbeen especially helpful. As a
souvenir of VIOLET CITY, take this.\pIt increases the power of GRASS-
type moves.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_Experiences: Your experiences in VIOLET CITY\nshould be useful for your journey.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_SlowpokeTailOffer: How would you like to have this\ntasty, nutritious SLOWPOKETAIL?\pFor you right now, just\n¥1,000,000!\pYou'll want this!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_ThoughtKidsLoaded: Tch! I thought kids\nthese days were loaded…$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_RefusedSlowpokeTail: You don't want it?\nThen scram. Shoo!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_FisherJustin_Seen: Whoa!\pYou made me lose that fish!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_FisherJustin_After: Calm, collected… The essence of\nfishing and POKéMON is the same.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_FisherRalph1_Seen: I'm really good at both\nfishing and POKéMON.\pI'm not about to lose to any kid!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_FisherRalph1_After: Fishing is a lifelong\npassion.\pPOKéMON are lifelong friends!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_RalphRegister: Fishing is a lifelong\npassion.\pPOKéMON are lifelong friends!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_RalphRematchIntro: I'm really good at both\nfishing and POKéMON.\pI'm not about to lose to any kid!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_RalphPostRematch: Fishing is a lifelong\npassion.\pPOKéMON are lifelong friends!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_FisherHenry_After: Freshly caught POKéMON are\nno match for properly raised ones.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_YoungsterAlbert_Seen: I haven't seen you around before.\nSo you think you are pretty tough?$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_YoungsterAlbert_After: I'm going to try to be the\nbest with my favorites.\pI'm not using the same tough\nPOKéMON as everyone else.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_YoungsterGordon_Seen: I found some good POKéMON\nin the grass!\pI think they'll do it for me!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_YoungsterGordon_Beaten: Darn. I thought I could win.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_YoungsterGordon_After: The grass is full of\nclingy things.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_CamperRoland_After: If you don't want to battle,\njust avoid eye contact.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_PicnickerLiz1_Seen: Uh-huh. Yeah, and you know…\pPardon? Battle? I'm on the phone.\nOh, all right. But make it fast.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_PicnickerLiz1_Beaten: Oh! I've got to relieve\nmy anger!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_PicnickerLiz1_After: I was having a nice chat too.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_LizRegister: I was having a nice chat too.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_LizRematchIntro: Uh-huh. Yeah, and you know…\pPardon? Battle? I'm on the phone.\nOh, all right. But make it fast.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_LizRematchDefeat: Oh! I've got to relieve\nmy anger!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_LizPostRematch: I was having a nice chat too.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_BirdKeeperPeter_Seen: That BADGE! It's from VIOLET CITY!\nYou beat FALKNER?$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_BirdKeeperPeter_Beaten: I know what my weaknesses are.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_BirdKeeperPeter_After: I should train again at the\nGYM in VIOLET CITY.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_RoarIntro: WROOOOAR! PEOPLE RUN WHEN I\nROAR! BUT YOU CAME LOOKING!\pTHAT PLEASES ME! NOW TAKE THIS!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_RoarOutro: WROOOOAR! IT'S ROAR!\pEVEN POKéMON RUN FROM A GOOD\nROAR!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_MeetFrieda: FRIEDA: Yahoo!\pI'm FRIEDA of the WEEKDAY FAMILY!\nNice to meet you!\pIf you can guess my favorite day,\nI'll give you a reward.$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_FriedaGivesGift: Here's a POISON BARB for you!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_FriedaGaveGift: FRIEDA: Give it to a POKéMON\nthat has POISON-type moves.\pOh!\pIt's wicked!\pYou'll be shocked how good it\nmakes poison moves!$
data/maps/Route32_hns/scripts.inc.Route32_Text_FriedaFriday: FRIEDA: Hiya! What day do\nyou like?\pI love Friday. No doubt about\nit!\pDon't you think it's great too?$

data/maps/Route33_hns/scripts.inc.Route33_Text_HikerAnthony2Seen: I came through the tunnel,\nbut I still have plenty\lof energy left.$
data/maps/Route33_hns/scripts.inc.Route33_Text_HikerAnthony2Beaten: Whoa! You've got more zip\nthan me!$
data/maps/Route33_hns/scripts.inc.Route33_Text_HikerAnthony2After: We HIKERS are at our best\nin the mountains.$
data/maps/Route33_hns/scripts.inc.Route33_Text_AnthonyRegister: We HIKERS are at our best\nin the mountains.$
data/maps/Route33_hns/scripts.inc.Route33_Text_AnthonyRematchIntro: I came through the tunnel,\nbut I still have plenty\lof energy left.$
data/maps/Route33_hns/scripts.inc.Route33_Text_AnthonyRematchDefeat: Whoa! You've got more zip\nthan me!$
data/maps/Route33_hns/scripts.inc.Route33_Text_AnthonyPostRematch: We HIKERS are at our best\nin the mountains.$
data/maps/Route33_hns/scripts.inc.Route33_Text_HikerAnthonyDunsparce: Hey, did you get a DUNSPARCE?\pI caught one too.\pTake a look at it in the light.\nIt's got a funny face!$
data/maps/Route33_hns/scripts.inc.Route33_Text_Lass: Pant, pant…\pThat cave was bigger than\nI'd expected.\pI got too tired exploring\nfor MARILL, so I came outside.$

data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_Bookshelf1: A BABY POKéMON encyclopedia!\pVOLUME 1: ALL ABOUT ABILITIES$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_Bookshelf2: A BABY POKéMON encyclopedia!\pVOLUME 2: TYPICAL TYPES$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_Bookshelf3: A BABY POKéMON encyclopedia!\pVOLUME 3: BABIES' CRIES$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_Bookshelf4: A BABY POKéMON encyclopedia!\pVOLUME 4: ADORABLE ACTIONS$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_ClerkBefore: I'm the DAY-CARE couple's son.\pAn ODD EGG was found with a TRAINER's\nPOKéMON, but they didn't want it...\pI'd offer it to you...\nBut how can I know you'll take good\lcare of it?$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_ClerkNoRoom: It looks like you can't carry another\nPOKéMON anyway.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_ClerkQuestion: Answer this question for me.\nHow do you feel about this ODD EGG?$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_Rejection: Hmm, I think this EGG isn't for you.\pIt would be irresponsible of me to\ngive out a precious EGG like this\lto someone who isn't as well-read\lon the subject of baby POKéMON!$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_TakeCare: I knew you were the right trainer\nfor the job. Take good care of it!$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_ClerkAfter: We see a lot of those eggs around\nhere.\pSomething was different about that\none, though.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_ClosedForChallenge: Sorry, we can't look after your\nPOKéMON during a party limit\lchallenge!$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_Text_SeeWifeIfYoudLikeMeToRaiseM: I'm the DAY-CARE MAN.\pI help take care of the precious\nPOKéMON of TRAINERS.\pIf you'd like me to raise your POKéMON,\nhave a word with my wife.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_Text_DoYouWantEgg: Ah, it's you!\pWe were raising your POKéMON,\nand my goodness, were we surprised!\pYour POKéMON had an EGG!\pWe don't know how it got there,\nbut your POKéMON had it.\pYou do want it, yes?$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_Text_YourMonIsDoingFine: Ah, it's you! Good to see you.\nYour {STR_VAR_1}'s doing fine.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForIt: You have no room for it…\nCome back when you've made room.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_Text_ReceivedEgg: {PLAYER} received the EGG from\nthe DAY-CARE MAN.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_Text_FriendlyWithOtherTrainersMo: By the way, about your {STR_VAR_1},\nit seemed to be friendly with\l{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}.\pI may even have seen it receiving\na piece of MAIL.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_Text_SeeWifeIfYouWantToPickUpMon: If you want to pick up your POKéMON,\nhave a word with my wife.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_Text_YourMonsAreDoingFine: Ah, it's you! Your {STR_VAR_1} and\n{STR_VAR_2} are doing fine.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_Text_IWillKeepDoYouWantIt: I really will keep it.\nYou do want this, yes?$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_WouldYouLikeUsToRai: I'm the DAY-CARE LADY.\pWe can raise POKéMON for you.\pWould you like us to raise one?$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_WhichMonShouldWeRai: Which POKéMON should we raise for\nyou?$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_WellRaiseYourMon: Fine, we'll raise your {STR_VAR_1}\nfor a while.\pCome back for it later.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_WeCanRaiseOneMore: We can raise two of your POKéMON.\nWould you like us to raise one more?$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_HusbandWasLookingFo: My husband was looking for you.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_TakeOtherOneBackToo: Will you take back the other one,\ntoo?$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_GoodToSeeYou: Ah, it's you! Good to see you.\nYour POKéMON can only be doing good!$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_YourTeamIsFull: Your POKéMON team is full.\nMake room, then come see me.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_TakeBackWhichMon: Which POKéMON will you take back?$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_ItWillCostX: If you want your {STR_VAR_1} back,\nit will cost ¥{STR_VAR_2}.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_YouHaveJustOneMon: Oh? But you have just one\nPOKéMON.\pCome back another time.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_TakeYourMonBack: Will you take your POKéMON back?$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_WhatWillYouBattleWi: If you leave me that POKéMON,\nwhat will you battle with?\pCome back another time.$
data/maps/Route34_DayCare_hns/scripts.in.Route34_DayCare_Text_YoullBeLeftWithJust:
Huh?
Now, now.\pIf you leave that POKéMON with
me, you'll be left with just one.\pYou will be better off if you catch
some more, I dare say.$

data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_YoungsterSamuel_After: I'm going to train even harder.\pAfter all, I'm trying to become\na GYM LEADER.$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_YoungsterIan_Seen: I'm the best in my class at\nPOKéMON.$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_YoungsterIan_After: I'm trying hard so I can be the\nstar in my class.$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_CamperTodd_Seen: I'm confident in my ability to\nraise POKéMON.\pWant to see?$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_CamperTodd_Beaten: Did I screw up my training?$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_CamperTodd_After: Maybe I should take one to DAY-CARE,\nor maybe use some items…$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_ToddRegister: Maybe I should take one to DAY-CARE,\nor maybe use some items…$

data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_ToddRematchDefeat: Did I screw up my training?$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_ToddPostRematch: Maybe I should take one to DAY-CARE,\nor maybe use some items…$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_GinaRegister: You're too strong to be a\npractice partner.$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_PicnickerGina_Seen: Are you a TRAINER?\pLet's have a practice battle.$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_PicnickerGina_Beaten: Oh, no! I just can't win…$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_PicnickerGina_After: You're too strong to be a\npractice partner.$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_OfficerKeith_Seen: Who goes there?\nWhat are you up to?$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_OfficerKeith_After: Yep, nothing wrong today.\pBe good and stay out of trouble.$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_PokefanBrandon_Seen: I just got my POKéMON back from\nDAY-CARE.\pLet's see how much stronger it got!$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_PokefanBrandon_Beaten: Why does it end this way?$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_PokefanBrandon_After: My POKéMON came back with new moves.\pThat confounded me to no end!$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_Sign_Route34: ROUTE 34\nGOLDENROD CITY - AZALEA TOWN\pILEX FOREST SOMEWHERE BETWEEN$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_TrainerTips: TRAINER TIPS\pBERRY trees grow new BERRIES\nseveral times a day.\pNote which trees bear which\nBERRIES.$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_CooltrainerIrene_After1: IRENE: My sister KATE will get you\nfor this!$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_CooltrainerIrene_After2: IRENE: Isn't this beach great?\pIt's our secret little getaway!$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_CooltrainerJenn_Seen: JENN: What the...?\nWhat are you doing?$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_CooltrainerJenn_Beaten: JENN: So sorry, IRENE! Dear Sis!$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_CooltrainerJenn_After1: JENN: Don't get cocky! My sister\nKATE is tough!$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_CooltrainerKate_Seen: KATE: I must pay you back for\ntaking care of my sisters!$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_CooltrainerKate_Beaten: KATE: No! I can't believe I lost.$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_CooltrainerKate_GiveSoftSan: KATE: You are so strong.\nWe lost with no excuses...\pHere, take this!$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_CooltrainerKate_After: KATE: I'm sorry we jumped you.\pWe never expected anyone to find\nus here. You sure startled us.$
data/maps/Route34_hns/scripts.inc.Route34_Text_Sign_DayCare: DAY-CARE\pLET US RAISE YOUR POKéMON FOR YOU!$

data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_CamperIvanSeen: I've been getting POKéMON data off\nmy radio. I think I'm good.$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_CamperIvanAfter: Music on the radio changes the\nmoods of wild POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_CamperElliotSeen: I'm gonna show my girlfriend I'm\nhot stuff!$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_CamperElliotBeaten: I wish you would have lost for me…$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_CamperElliotAfter: I was humiliated in front of my\ngirlfriend…$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_PicnickerBrookeSeen: My boyfriend's weak, so I can't rely\non him.$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_PicnickerBrookeAfter: I can count on my POKéMON more than\nmy boyfriend.$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_PicnickerKimSeen: Are you going to the GYM? Me too!$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_PicnickerKimAfter: The GYM BADGES are pretty. I collect\nthem.$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_BirdKeeperBryanSeen: What kinds of BALLS do you use?$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_BirdKeeperBryanAfter: Some POKéMON flee right away.\pTry catching them with KURT's\nFAST BALL.\pWhenever I find a ASPEAR BERRY, I\ntake it to KURT.\pHe turns it into a custom BALL.$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_JugglerIrwinAfter: I was going to dazzle you with my\nprize POKéMON.\pBut your prowess electrified me!$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_BugCatcherArnieSeen: I'll go anywhere if bug POKéMON\nappear there.$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_BugCatcherArnieBeaten: Huh? I shouldn't have lost that…$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_BugCatcherArnieAfter: My VENONAT won me the Bug-Catching\nContest at the NATIONAL PARK.$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_IrwinRegister: I was going to dazzle you with my\nprize POKéMON.\pBut your prowess electrified me!$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_ArnieRegister: My VENONAT won me the Bug-Catching\nContest at the NATIONAL PARK.$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_ArnieRematchIntro: I'll go anywhere if bug POKéMON\nappear there.$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_ArnieRematchDefeat: Huh? I shouldn't have lost that…$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_ArniePostRematch: My VENONAT won me the Bug-Catching\nContest at the NATIONAL PARK.$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_BugCatcherArnieYanma: Wow… Look at all those YANMA!\pI'm so blown away, I can't move.$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_FirebreatherWaltBeaten: Ow! I scorched the tip of my nose!$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_FirebreatherWaltAfter: The POKéMON March on the radio\nlures wild POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_OfficerDirkAfter: You know, night time is fun in its\nown ways.\pBut don't overdo it, OK?$
data/maps/Route35_hns/scripts.inc.Route35_Text_OfficerDirkTough: Your POKéMON look pretty tough.\pYou could go anywhere safely.$

data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_SudowoodoAttacked: The weird tree doesn't like the\nSQUIRTBOTTLE!\pThe weird tree attacked!$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_RockSmashGuy1: Wa-hey!\pI was going to snap that tree\nwith my straight-arm punch.\pBut I couldn't! I'm a failure!$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_RockSmashGuy2: Did you clear that wretched tree?\pI'm impressed!\nI want you to have this.$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_RockSmashGuy3: That happens to be ROCK SMASH.\pYou can shatter rocks with just a\nsingle well-aimed smack.\pIf any rocks are in your way,\njust smash 'em up!$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_OddTree: A weird tree is blocking the way.$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_Lass1: Be careful at night on this route!\pI saw a POKéMON that looked like\nGROWLITHE, but it had a scary aura\lto it.$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_Lass2_ClearedSudowoodo: That odd tree disappeared without\na trace.\pOh! That tree was really a\nPOKéMON?$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_PsychicMarkSeen: I'm going to read your thoughts!$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_PsychicMarkAfter: I'd be strong if only I could tell\nwhat my opponent was thinking.$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_SchoolboyAlan1Seen: Thanks to my studies, I'm ready\nfor any POKéMON!$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_SchoolboyAlanAfter: Darn. I study five hours a day too.\pThere's more to learning than just\nreading books.$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_MeetArthur: ARTHUR: Who are you?\nI'm ARTHUR of the WEEKDAY FAMILY.\pIf you can guess my favorite day,\nI'll give you a reward.$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_ArthurGaveGift: ARTHUR: A POKéMON that uses ROCK-\ntype moves should hold on to that.\pIt pumps up ROCK-type attacks.$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_ArthurThursday: ARTHUR: I'm ARTHUR of Thursday.\nI'm the fifth son out of seven.$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_Tips1: TRAINER TIPS\nPOKéMON stats vary--even within\lthe same species.\pTheir stats may be similar at first.\pHowever, differences will become\npronounced as the POKéMON grow.$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_Tips2:
TRAINER TIPS
Use DIG to return to the entrance of
any place.\pIt is convenient for exploring
caves and other landmarks.$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_AlanRegister: Darn. I study five hours a day too.\pThere's more to learning than just\nreading books.$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_AlanRematchIntro: Thanks to my studies, I'm ready\nfor any POKéMON!$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_AlanPostRematch: Darn. I study five hours a day too.\pThere's more to learning than just\nreading books.$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_AlanHasItem: Hey! I found something\nwhile studying!\pHere, you can have it!$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_AlanGaveItem: I'll let you know if I find\nanything else!$
data/maps/Route36_hns/scripts.inc.Route36_Text_AlanNoRoom: Hmm, your BAG is full.\pCome back when you have room.$

data/maps/Route37_hns/scripts.inc.Route37_Text_TwinsAnnAndAnne1_Seen: ANN: ANNE and I are in this\ntogether!$
data/maps/Route37_hns/scripts.inc.Route37_Text_TwinsAnnAndAnne1_Beaten: ANN & ANNE: Nnn… A little too\nstrong.$
data/maps/Route37_hns/scripts.inc.Route37_Text_TwinsAnnAndAnne1_After: ANN: I can tell what my sister and\nmy POKéMON are thinking.$
data/maps/Route37_hns/scripts.inc.Route37_Text_TwinsAnnAndAnne2_Seen: ANNE: ANN and I are in this\ntogether!$
data/maps/Route37_hns/scripts.inc.Route37_Text_TwinsAnnAndAnne2_Beaten: ANN & ANNE: Nnn… A little too\nstrong.$
data/maps/Route37_hns/scripts.inc.Route37_Text_TwinsAnnAndAnne2_After: ANNE: We share the same feelings as\nour POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route37_hns/scripts.inc.Route37_Text_PsychicGreg_Seen: POKéMON can't do a thing if they are\nasleep.\pI'll show you how scary that is!$
data/maps/Route37_hns/scripts.inc.Route37_Text_PsychicGreg_After: Putting POKéMON to sleep or paralyz-\ning them are good battle techniques.$
data/maps/Route37_hns/scripts.inc.Route37_Text_Sunny_Meet: SUNNY: Hi!\pI'm SUNNY of the WEEKDAY family!\pIf you can guess my favorite day,\nI'll give you a reward.$
data/maps/Route37_hns/scripts.inc.Route37_Text_Sunny_GiveGift1: I was told to give you this if I saw\nyou!$
data/maps/Route37_hns/scripts.inc.Route37_Text_Sunny_GiveGift2: I was told to give you this if I saw\nyou!$
data/maps/Route37_hns/scripts.inc.Route37_Text_Sunny_GaveGift: SUNNY: That thing…\pUm…\p… What was it now…\p…\pOh! I remember now!\pA POKéMON that knows electric\nmoves should hold it.\pMy sis MONICA said it powers up\nelectric moves!$
data/maps/Route37_hns/scripts.inc.Route37_Text_Sunny_Sunday: SUNNY: My sisters and brothers are\nMONICA, TUSCANY, WESLEY, ARTHUR,\lFRIEDA and SANTOS.\pThey're all older than me!$
data/maps/Route37_hns/scripts.inc.Route37_Text_Sunny_NotSunday: SUNNY: Isn't today Sunday?\nUm… I forgot!$

data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_BirdKeeperTobySeen: Fly high into the sky,\nmy beloved bird POKéMON!$
data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_BirdKeeperTobyBeaten: I feel like just flying\naway now.$
data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_BirdKeeperTobyAfter: I plan to train in CIANWOOD CITY\nto teach my POKéMON how to FLY.$
data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_SchoolboyChad1Seen: Let me try something\nI learned today.$
data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_SchoolboyChadAfter: I have to take so many\ntests, I don't have much\ltime for POKéMON.\pSo when I do get to play,\nI really concentrate.$

data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_ChadPostRematch: I have to take so many\ntests, I don't have much\ltime for POKéMON.\pSo when I do get to play,\nI really concentrate.$
data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_LassDana1Seen: You seem to be good at\nPOKéMON.\pIf you are, how about\ngiving me some advice?$
data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_LassDana1Beaten: I see. So you can battle\nthat way.$
data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_LassDanaAfter: I know something good!\pMOOMOO FARM's milk is\nfamous for its flavor.$
data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_BeautyValerieSeen: Hi! Aren't you a cute\ntrainer!\pMay I see your POKéMON?$
data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_BeautyValerieBeaten: I'm glad I got to see\nyour POKéMON!$
data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_BeautyValerieAfter: When I see POKéMON, it\nseems to soothe my nerves.$
data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_SailorHarrySeen: I've been overseas, so I\nknow about all sorts of\lPOKéMON!$
data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_SailorHarryAfter: All kinds of people around\nthe world live happily with\lPOKéMON.$
data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_BeautyOliviaSeen: Don't you think my POKéMON\nand I are beautiful?$
data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_BeautyOliviaAfter: MOOMOO MILK is good for\nbeauty and health,\pbut inconveniently, they\nonly sell one bottle at a time.$

TRAINER TIPS\pIf a POKéMON is trying to
evolve, you can stop it.\pPress the B Button during
evolution to cancel it.\pThat startles the POKéMON
and stops its evolution.$

data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_DanaRegister: I know something good!\pMOOMOO FARM's milk is\nfamous for its flavor.$

data/maps/Route38_hns/scripts.inc.Route38_Text_DanaGaveItem: I'll let you know if I find\nanything else!$

data/maps/Route39_Barn_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_BarnTwinMoomooIsSick: MOOMOO is sick…\pShe needs lots of ORAN BERRIES.$
data/maps/Route39_Barn_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_BarnCryIsWeak: Its cry is weak…\nGive an ORAN BERRY to MILTANK?$
data/maps/Route39_Barn_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_BarnRefusedBerry: {PLAYER} wouldn't give an\nORAN BERRY.\pMILTANK looks sad.$

data/maps/Route39_FarmHouse_hns/scripts..Route39_Text_FarmerMSickCow: My MILTANK ain't givin' me\nmilk no more.\pThis here FARM's got famous milk.\pMost everyone wants a drink.\pIt'll give me lots o' milk if'n\nI feed it lots o' BERRIES,\lI reckon.$
data/maps/Route39_FarmHouse_hns/scripts..Route39_Text_FarmerMBuyMilk: How'd you like my MOOMOO MILK?\pIt's my pride and joy, there.\pGive it to POKéMON to restore HP!\pI'll give it to ya fer just\n¥500.$
data/maps/Route39_FarmHouse_hns/scripts..Route39_Text_FarmerMNoSale: You don't want it?\nCome again, hear?$
data/maps/Route39_FarmHouse_hns/scripts..Route39_Text_FarmerMMilking: I best go do my milkin'.$
data/maps/Route39_FarmHouse_hns/scripts..Route39_Text_FarmerFInTrouble: Our milk even goes out to\nKANTO.\pSo if our own MILTANK won't\ngive us any milk, we're in trouble.$
data/maps/Route39_FarmHouse_hns/scripts..Route39_Text_FarmerFHealedMiltank: You fixed our MILTANK, hon.\nNow it gives MOOMOO MILK again.\pHere's somethin' fer your trouble.$
data/maps/Route39_FarmHouse_hns/scripts..Route39_Text_FarmerFSnatchSpeech:
That there's SNATCH.\pIt's a tricky move that lets
a POKéMON steal a foe's move\lright before it's used.\pIf more than one POKéMON use
SNATCH, only the slowest one\lwill end up stealing the move.\pUse it smart, hon. Timing is
everything.$

data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_ChooseLegend: BAOBA: GOOD HEAVENS! Did that\nshadow belong to a POKéMON?\pDid you get a good look at it?\nI can't tell what color it was...$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_BaobaIntro:
How strange...\p...Ohh!
What you are holding is...\lwhat they call... a POKéDEX!\pHaven't seen one of those in ages.\pMy name is BAOBA!
I used to run a SAFARI ZONE in\lFUCHSIA CITY, but it was becoming\lout of date with new entertainment\loptions coming out.\pI decided to go overseas to learn
the newest technology and open a\lstate-of-the-art SAFARI ZONE\lin CIANWOOD.\pIt may be more than a coincidence
that we are chatting.\pWhy don't we register each other's
numbers in the POKéGEAR?\pI can give you a call once the
SAFARI ZONE is open before I call\lanyone else!$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_WillCall: BAOBA: I'll let you know\non the POKéGEAR soon!$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_Woman: That shadow... Maybe it was a giant\nPIDGEY?$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_SailorEugeneSeen: I just got back to OLIVINE.\pSo how about a POKéMON battle?$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_SailorEugeneAfter: My POKéMON were caught and\nraised overseas.\pThey're my companions on\nthose long voyages.$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_PokefanMDerekSeen: This is a good time to brag\nabout my PIKACHU!$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_PokefanMDerekBeaten: I had no time to show off\nPIKACHU…$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_PokefanMDerekAfter: I'm not listening to your\nbragging!\pWe POKé FANS have a policy\nof not listening to bragging!$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_PokefanFRuthSeen: Such darling POKéMON.\pLet's show our POKéMON\ntogether at the same time.$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_PokefanFRuthAfter: Do you know about baby\nPOKéMON?\pI bet they're just adorable!$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_PsychicNormanSeen: Let me see what your\nPOKéMON are capable of.$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_PsychicNormanAfter: You know how POKéMON have\ndifferent abilities?\pPeople are like that too.\nEveryone has different\lpotential.$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_PokefanFJaimeSeen: You came at just the right\ntime.\pLet's battle.$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_PokefanFJaimeAfter:
I met UMBREON at night right
here on ROUTE 39.\pI'm not sure why, but it
seems to like it when I\ltrain here.\pIt seems to become friendlier
by training here than\lanywhere else.$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_MoomooFarmSign: MOOMOO FARM\pEnjoy Our Fresh and Tasty Milk$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_TrainerTips:
TRAINER TIPS\pUse HEADBUTT on trees to shake
POKéMON out.\pDifferent kinds of POKéMON
drop out of trees.\pUse HEADBUTT on any tree
you see!$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_DerekRegister: I'm not listening to your\nbragging!\pWe POKé FANS have a policy\nof not listening to bragging!$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_DerekHasItem: Hey! I was showing off my\nPIKACHU and found something.\pHere, you can have it!$
data/maps/Route39_hns/scripts.inc.Route39_Text_DerekNoRoom: Hmm, your BAG is full.\pCome back when you have room.$

data/maps/Route3_hns/scripts.inc.Route3_Text_FirebreatherOtis_Seen: Ah! The weather's as fine as ever.$
data/maps/Route3_hns/scripts.inc.Route3_Text_FirebreatherOtis_Beaten: It's sunny, but I'm all wet…$
data/maps/Route3_hns/scripts.inc.Route3_Text_FirebreatherOtis_AfterBattle: When it rains, it's hard to get\nignition…$
data/maps/Route3_hns/scripts.inc.Route3_Text_YoungsterWarren_Seen: Hmmm… I don't know what to do…$
data/maps/Route3_hns/scripts.inc.Route3_Text_YoungsterWarren_AfterBattle: You looked strong.\pI was afraid to take you on…$
data/maps/Route3_hns/scripts.inc.Route3_Text_YoungsterJimmy_Seen: I can run like the wind!$
data/maps/Route3_hns/scripts.inc.Route3_Text_YoungsterJimmy_AfterBattle: I wear shorts the whole year round.\pThat's my fashion policy.$
data/maps/Route3_hns/scripts.inc.Route3_Text_FirebreatherBurt_Seen: Step right up and take a look!$
data/maps/Route3_hns/scripts.inc.Route3_Text_FirebreatherBurt_AfterBattle: The greatest fire-breather in KANTO,\nthat's me.\pBut not the best trainer…$
data/maps/Route3_hns/scripts.inc.Route3_Text_MtMoonSquareSign: MT.MOON SQUARE\pJust go up the stairs.$

data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_SwimmermSimonSeen: You have to warm up before\ngoing into the water.\pThat's basic.$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_SwimmermSimonAfter: CIANWOOD CITY is a good\ndistance away from here.$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_SwimmermRandallSeen: Hey, you're young and fit!\pDon't ride your POKéMON!\nSwim!$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_SwimmermRandallAfter: Swimming exercises your\nentire body. It's healthy.$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_SwimmerfElaineSeen: Are you going to CIANWOOD?\pHow about a quick battle\nfirst?$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_SwimmerfElaineAfter: I'd say I'm a better swimmer\nthan you. Yeah!$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_SwimmerfPaulaSeen: No inner tube for me.\pI'm hanging on to a sea\nPOKéMON!$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_SwimmerfPaulaAfter: While I float like this,\nthe waves carry me along.$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_Lass1: Although you can't see it from here,\nCIANWOOD is across the sea.$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_Lass2: I came to OLIVINE by ship to see\nthe sights and soak up the\latmosphere.\pBeing a port, it feels so\ndifferent from a big city.$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_StandingYoungster:
Have you gone to the TRAINER
HILL?\pI think a lot of tough trainers
