have gathered there already.\pBut since you have so many BADGES
you shouldn't do badly at all.$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_Monica: MONICA: Glad to meet you.\nI'm MONICA of the WEEKDAY FAMILY.\pI bet you can't guess my favorite\nday of the week!$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_MonicaGivesGift: That's right!\pAs a token of our friendship,\nI have a gift for you!$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_MonicaGaveGift: MONICA: It's an item that raises\nthe power of FLYING-type moves.\pYou should equip a bird\nPOKéMON with that item.$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_MonicaMonday: MONICA: My brothers and\nsisters are all over the place.\pSee if you could find\nthem all!$
data/maps/Route40_hns/scripts.inc.Route40_Text_MonicaNotMonday: MONICA: I don't think today\nis Monday. How sad…$

data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmermCharlieSeen: The water's warm here.\nI'm loose and limber.\pSure, I'll take you on!$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmermCharlieAfter: Isn't it relaxing just floating\nlike this?$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmermGeorgeSeen: I'm a bit tired.\nIf I win, lend me your POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmermGeorgeAfter: It's so far to CIANWOOD.\pBut it's no easy return trip\nto OLIVINE either.\pWhat should I do?$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmermBerkeSeen: See those islands that are\nblocked by whirlpools?\pThere just has to be a secret!$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmermBerkeAfter: It was a dark and stormy night…\pI saw this giant POKéMON flying\nfrom the islands.\pIt was scattering feathers\nfrom its silver wings.$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmermKirkSeen: The waves are wild here.\pThey tire you out while\nyou swim.$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmermKirkAfter: The currents keep me from\nreaching that island.$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmermMathewSeen: Are you seeking the secrets\nof WHIRL ISLANDS?$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmermMathewAfter: A secret about WHIRL ISLANDS…\pIt's pitch-black inside!$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmerfKayleeSeen: I'm on my way to WHIRL ISLANDS.\pI'm going exploring with friends.$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmerfKayleeBeaten: Is that how you do it?$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmerfKayleeAfter: There's supposed to be a big\nPOKéMON deep beneath WHIRL ISLANDS.\pI wonder what it could be?$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmerfSusieSeen: You look so elegant,\nriding your POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmerfSusieAfter: Wasn't there a hit song about\na boy riding a LAPRAS?$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmerfDeniseSeen: The weather is so beautiful,\nI'm in a daze!$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmerfDeniseAfter: A sunburn is the worst for skin.\pBut I don't use a sunblock.\pI won't pollute the water.$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmerfKaraSeen: If you need to rest,\njust tread water.\pYou'll get your wind back,\nso you can keep on going strong.$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmerfKaraBeaten: Oh! You have more energy than I do.$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmerfKaraAfter: I heard roars from deep inside\nthe ISLANDS.$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmerfWendySeen: At night, STARYU gather near\nthe water's surface.$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_SwimmerfWendyAfter: The clusters of STARYU light up\nat the same time.\pIt's so beautiful, it's scary.$
data/maps/Route41_hns/scripts.inc.Route41_Text_TentacruelHeal: The TENTACRUEL used RECOVER!\nIt is fully healed!$

data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_EusineAdmireSuicune: EUSINE: SUICUNE...\nHow brave it is!\pHow refreshing it is!\nHow beautiful it is!\pAnd how quickly it moves!$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_EusineJealous:
{PLAYER}!\pYou seem to be around where
SUICUNE would appear.\pWell, that's OK.\lMy desire to search for
SUICUNE is far beyond yours...\pMy grandpa was... quite into
myths.\pI've heard so many stories
about SUICUNE from him.$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_EusineWontGiveUp: SUICUNE...\nI won't stop following you\luntil I've found out what\lyou're after...\pYou hear me!$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_FisherTullySeen: Let me demonstrate the power\nof the POKéMON I caught!$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_FisherTullyBeaten: What? That's not right.\nI can't believe this!$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_FisherTullyAfter: I want to become the trainer\nCHAMP using the POKéMON I\lcaught myself.\pThat's the best part of fishing!$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_HikerBenjaminSeen: Ah, it's good to be outside!\nI feel so free!$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_HikerBenjaminAfter: Losing feels insignificant\nif you look up at the big sky!$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_PokemaniacShaneSeen: HEY!\pThis is my secret place!\nGet lost, you outsider!$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_PokemaniacShaneBeaten: I should have used my\nMOON STONE…$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_PokemaniacShaneAfter: You're working on a POKéDEX?\pWow, you must know some\npretty rare POKéMON!\pMay I please see it?\nPlease?$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_TullyRegister: I want to become the trainer\nCHAMP using the POKéMON I\lcaught myself.\pThat's the best part of fishing!$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_TullyRematchIntro: Let me demonstrate the power\nof the POKéMON I caught!$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_TullyRematchDefeat: What? That's not right.\nI can't believe this!$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_TullyPostRematch: I want to become the trainer\nCHAMP using the POKéMON I\lcaught myself.\pThat's the best part of fishing!$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_TullyHasItem: Hey! I found something\nwhile I was fishing!\pHere, you can have it!$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_TullyGaveItem: I'll let you know if I\nreel in anything else!$
data/maps/Route42_hns/scripts.inc.Route42_Text_TullyNoRoom: Hmm, your BAG is full.\pCome back when you have room.$

data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_PokemaniacBenSeen: I love POKéMON!\pThat's why I started--and why I'll\nkeep on collecting POKéMON!$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_PokemaniacBenBeaten: How could you do this to me?$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_PokemaniacBenAfter: What else do I like besides\nPOKéMON?\pMARY on the radio. I bet she's\ncute!$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_PokemaniacBrentSeen: Hey! Do you have any rare\nPOKéMON?$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_PokemaniacBrentAfter: I'd be happy just to own a single\nrare POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_BrentRegister: I'd be happy just to own a single\nrare POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_BrentRematchIntro: Hey! Do you have any rare\nPOKéMON?$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_BrentPostRematch: I'd be happy just to own a single\nrare POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_PokemaniacRonSeen: Would you get this?\pSome {RIVAL} guy made fun of my\nPOKéMON!\pDarn it! My POKéMON's great!$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_PokemaniacRonBeaten: My NIDOKING did pretty right on!$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_PokemaniacRonAfter: It's okay for people to like\ndifferent types of POKéMON.\pPOKéMON isn't just about having the\nmost powerful one.$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_FisherMarvinSeen: I'm in a slump.\pMaybe it's the gear I'm using.\pLet's battle for a change of pace!$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_FisherMarvinBeaten: I lost, but I feel better anyway.$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_FisherMarvinAfter: KURT's LURE BALL is the best for\ncatching hooked POKéMON.\pIt's much more effective than a\nULTRA BALL.$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_CamperSpencerSeen: I can do so much with my\nPOKéMON--it's super-fun!$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_CamperSpencerAfter: What is going on at LAKE OF RAGE?\pWe were planning to camp there.$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_PicnickerTiffanySeen: Are you going to LAKE OF RAGE too?\pLet's play for a little while!$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_PicnickerTiffanyWantsPicnic: I'm having a picnic with POKéMON.\pWon't you join us?$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_TiffanyRegister: I'm having a picnic with POKéMON.\pWon't you join us?$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_TiffanyRematchIntro: Are you going to LAKE OF RAGE too?\pLet's play for a little while!$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_Text_TiffanyPostRematch: I'm having a picnic with POKéMON.\pWon't you join us?$
data/maps/Route43_hns/scripts.inc.Route43_TrainerTips:
TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON have pros and cons
depending on their types.\pIf their types differ, a higher-
level POKéMON may lose in battle.\pLearn which types are strong and
weak against your POKéMON's type.$

data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_FisherWilton1Seen: Aack!\pYou made me lose a POLIWAG!\nWhat are you going to do about it?$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_FisherWiltonHugePoliwag: That POLIWAG that got away…\nit was huge.\pI swear it must've been\n16 feet long!$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_WiltonRegister: That POLIWAG that got away…\nit was huge.\pI swear it must've been\n16 feet long!$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_WiltonRematchIntro: Aack!\pYou made me lose a POLIWAG!\nWhat are you going to do about it?$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_WiltonPostRematch: That POLIWAG that got away…\nit was huge.\pI swear it must've been\n16 feet long!$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_WiltonHasItem: Hey! I reeled in something\nother than a POKéMON!\pHere, you can have it!$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_WiltonGaveItem: I'll let you know if I\nfish up anything else!$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_WiltonNoRoom: Hmm, your BAG is full.\pCome back when you have room.$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_FisherEdgarSeen: I fish until I can't anymore.\pI also battle until I drop.\pThat's my relationship with my\nPOKéMON.$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_FisherEdgarAfter: That's 100 wins to 101 losses.\pI won't battle again for a while.$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_BirdKeeperVance1Seen: Do you know about the legendary\nbird POKéMON?$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_BirdKeeperVanceBirds: ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS and MOLTRES are\nthe three legendary bird POKéMON.\pI heard there are other legendary\nbirds, though.$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_VanceRegister: ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS and MOLTRES are\nthe three legendary bird POKéMON.\pI heard there are other legendary\nbirds, though.$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_VanceRematchIntro: Do you know about the legendary\nbird POKéMON?$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_VancePostRematch: ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS and MOLTRES are\nthe three legendary bird POKéMON.\pI heard there are other legendary\nbirds, though.$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_PsychicPhilAfter: It's important to have conviction\non your side.$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_PokemaniacZachSeen: I'll do anything to get my hands\non rare POKéMON!$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_PokemaniacZachAfter: If a POKéMON has different colors\nfrom usual, it's more valuable.\pWhat? You mean that's not true?$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_CooltrainermAllenSeen: I can tell you're a good trainer\nby looking at you.\pI'm good at POKéMON, and I can\nsee that you are too.$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_CooltrainermAllenBeaten: Tch! It's a total loss on my part.$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_CooltrainermAllenAfter: Wow. You have a lot of BADGES.\pNo wonder you're so tough.\pI wonder if ECRUTEAK GYM's MORTY\nis still in training?\pHe really hammered me.$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_CooltrainerfCybilSeen: You look strong.\pGood trainers seek tough\nopponents instinctively.$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_CooltrainerfCybilBeaten: Nope! This won't do at all.$
data/maps/Route44_hns/scripts.inc.Route44_Text_CooltrainerfCybilAfter: We all get better by experiencing\nmany battles.\pI battled a lot to become what I\nam today--an elite.$

data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_HikerErikSeen: Be prepared for anything!\pLet me see if your POKéMON have\nbeen raised properly!$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_HikerErikAfter: I'll head back to BLACKTHORN's\nICE PATH and train some more.$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_HikerMichaelSeen: Yo! You're spunky! But you know\nwhat?\pWhen it comes to sheer\nspunkiness, I'm the man!$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_HikerMichaelAfter: Boy, do I love HP UP! Mmmm, yum!\pI keep drinking my POKéMON's!\pI can't help it!$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_HikerParryAfter: I'm not much good at thinking,\nsee?\pSo, I just plow ahead with power!$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_ParryRegister: I'm not much good at thinking,\nsee?\pSo, I just plow ahead with power!$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_ParryPostRematch: I'm not much good at thinking,\nsee?\pSo, I just plow ahead with power!$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_HikerTimothySeen: Why do I climb mountains?\pBecause they're there.\pWhy do I train POKéMON?\pBecause they're there!$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_HikerTimothyAfter: The best thing to ever happen to\nme was discovering POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_HikerParryGivesIron: I just can't find a way to win!\pKeep it up!\pOh, and take this -- it's the\ngift you couldn't take when we\nlast met.$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiSeen: I was training here alone.\pBehold the fruits of my labor!$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiAfter: This calls for extreme measures.\pI must take to the hills and train\nin solitude.$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_KenjiRegister: This calls for extreme measures.\pI must take to the hills and train\nin solitude.$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_KenjiRematchIntro: I was training here alone.\pBehold the fruits of my labor!$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_KenjiPostRematch: This calls for extreme measures.\pI must take to the hills and train\nin solitude.$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_KenjiHasItem: Hey! I'm taking a break from\ntraining.\pI found something good while I\nwas out. Here, take it!$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_KenjiGaveItem: Use it well!\pI need to get back to my\ntraining. Oooooaaarrrgh!$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_KenjiNoRoom: Hmm, your BAG is full.\pCome back when you have room.$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiMorning: I'm going to train a bit more\nbefore I break for lunch.$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiNight: We had plenty of rest at lunch, so\pnow we're all ready to go again!\pWe're going to train again!$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_CooltrainermRyanSeen: What are your thoughts on\nraising POKéMON?$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_CooltrainermRyanAfter: I see you're raising your POKéMON\nwith care.\pThe bond you build will save you\nin tough situations.$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_CooltrainerfKellySeen: What is your battle strategy?\pIt is foolish to use strong moves\nindiscriminately.$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_CooltrainerfKellyAfter: I'm not in favor of overly\npowerful moves.\pI want to win, but I also don't\nwant to harm POKéMON.$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_CamperQuentinBeaten: I was tough at the TRAINER HILL…$
data/maps/Route45_hns/scripts.inc.Route45_Text_CamperQuentinAfter: Have you been to the TRAINER HILL?\pI never, ever lose there, but…$

data/maps/Route46_hns/scripts.inc.Route46_Text_HikerBaileySeen: Awright! I'll show you the\npower of mountain POKéMON!$
data/maps/Route46_hns/scripts.inc.Route46_Text_HikerBaileyAfterBattle: It's over. I don't mind.\nWe HIKERS are like that.$
data/maps/Route46_hns/scripts.inc.Route46_Text_CamperTedSeen: I'm raising POKéMON too!\pWill you battle with me?$
data/maps/Route46_hns/scripts.inc.Route46_Text_CamperTedAfterBattle: I did my best but came up\nshort.\pNo excuses--I admit I lost.$
data/maps/Route46_hns/scripts.inc.Route46_Text_PicnickerErinSeen: I raise POKéMON too!\pWill you battle with me?$
data/maps/Route46_hns/scripts.inc.Route46_Text_PicnickerErinAfterBattle: I've been to many GYMS, but the\nGYM in GOLDENROD is my favorite.\pIt's filled with pretty flowers!$
data/maps/Route46_hns/scripts.inc.Route46_Text_ErinRegister: I've been to many GYMS, but the\nGYM in GOLDENROD is my favorite.\pIt's filled with pretty flowers!$
data/maps/Route46_hns/scripts.inc.Route46_Text_ErinRematchIntro: I raise POKéMON too!\pWill you battle with me?$
data/maps/Route46_hns/scripts.inc.Route46_Text_ErinPostRematch: I've been to many GYMS, but the\nGYM in GOLDENROD is my favorite.\pIt's filled with pretty flowers!$
data/maps/Route46_hns/scripts.inc.Route46_Text_PicnickerErin2Beaten:
Aww… I keep losing all the time!\pI'll just have to try harder!
Anyway, thanks for battling
me again and again.\pHere's that present from the
other time.$

data/maps/Route47_hns/scripts.inc.Route47_Text_HikerSeen: Longing for others is...\nwhat it is. \pBut battles are battles,\nso let's go!$
data/maps/Route47_hns/scripts.inc.Route47_Text_HikerAfter: After a battle you should always leave\nwith a parting laugh!$
data/maps/Route47_hns/scripts.inc.Route47_Text_CamperSeen: I'm not good with large crowds, so\nI'm camping out here with my\lPOKéMON!$
data/maps/Route47_hns/scripts.inc.Route47_Text_CamperBeaten: I should be headed deeper into the\nmountain I guess...$
data/maps/Route47_hns/scripts.inc.Route47_Text_Couple1Seen: THOM: One plus one is two. But the\ntwo of us together is much\lstronger!\pKAE: The two of us aren't just some\nboring pair!$
data/maps/Route47_hns/scripts.inc.Route47_Text_Couple1Beaten: THOM: That wasn't what I expected.\lKAE: You're unusual too!$
data/maps/Route47_hns/scripts.inc.Route47_Text_Couple1After1: THOM: It seems your power is\nimpossible to predict!$
data/maps/Route47_hns/scripts.inc.Route47_Text_Couple1After2: KAE: I figured you were an ordinary\nlone trainer. Boy was I wrong!$
data/maps/Route47_hns/scripts.inc.Route47_Text_Couple2Seen: DUFF: Watching over my girlfriend\nmakes my heart soar!\pEDA: My heart's feelings for my\nboyfriend are as wide and deep\lthe ocean!$
data/maps/Route47_hns/scripts.inc.Route47_Text_Couple2Beaten: DUFF: I was no match for you...\lEDA: You are really something...$
data/maps/Route47_hns/scripts.inc.Route47_Text_Couple2After1: DUFF: Thank you for the awe-\ninspiring battle! Bye!$
data/maps/Route47_hns/scripts.inc.Route47_Text_Couple2After2: EDA: You should really find a\nwonderful partner, too!$
data/maps/Route47_hns/scripts.inc.EmbeddedTower_Text_OldManIntro:
Well, hello!\pIt's said that past this hole used to
be a huge tower reaching far into\lthe sky.\pThey say that it was a rather strange
tower with half of it embedded\lin the cliff.\pIt was not just a tall tower reaching
up to the sky, but also reaching deep\ldown underground!\pIt is rumored that it even reached
the bottom of the ocean!\pIn short, the ruins used to connect
the sky, the land, and the sea to\leach other...\pMost of the tower is now crumbled,
and the only things that remain are\lthe entrance and its interior, where\lyou'll see strange patterns.$

data/maps/Route49_hns/scripts.inc.Route49_Text_SkylarDefeat: OKAY, you can have the PLATE.$
data/maps/Route49_hns/scripts.inc.Route49_Text_SkylarAfter: As cool as that PLATE is,\nyou earned it fair and square.\pI'll just buy something at the gift\nshop instead.$
data/maps/Route49_hns/scripts.inc.Route49_Text_SkylarBeforeBattle: What?\pYou want the PLATE?\nIt's an artifact imbued with an\lancient power with a connection\lto the legendary POKéMON?!\pWell now I'm definitely keeping it.\pFine.\pYou'll just have to battle me for it.$
data/maps/Route49_hns/scripts.inc.Route49_Text_SkylarBefore: When I was hitting the slopes, my\nskis snagged on something.\pIt was this strange SKY-blue PLATE.\pI think I'll hold onto it as a\nsouvenir!$
data/maps/Route49_hns/scripts.inc.Route49_Text_SkierM: Hey, watch out for my board!\pWhat? You want to battle?\nNo way, these slopes are too wicked!$
data/maps/Route49_hns/scripts.inc.Route49_Text_KimonoGirl: You....\pYou must be {PLAYER}, correct?\nI've heard all about you and\lyour deeds from my cousins\lin ECRUTEAK CITY.\pMy sisters wish to meet with you.\lIf you find the time, please\nseek us out in the town up ahead.$

data/maps/Route4_hns/scripts.inc.Route4_Text_BirdKeeperHank_Seen: I'm raising my POKéMON. Want to battle\nwith me?$
data/maps/Route4_hns/scripts.inc.Route4_Text_BirdKeeperHank_AfterBattle: If you have a specific POKéMON that you\nwant to raise, put it out first, then\lswitch it right away.\pThat's how to do it.$
data/maps/Route4_hns/scripts.inc.Route4_Text_PicnickerHope_Seen: I have a feeling that I can win.\pLet's see if I'm right!$
data/maps/Route4_hns/scripts.inc.Route4_Text_PicnickerHope_AfterBattle: I heard CLEFAIRY appear at MT.MOON.\pBut where could they be?$
data/maps/Route4_hns/scripts.inc.Route4_Text_MtMoonSquareSign: MT.MOON NEW ENTRANCE\nDUE TO CAVE-IN\pWATCH YOUR STEP$

data/maps/Route50_hns/scripts.inc.Route50_Text_BlackBelt1: The body must be hardened\nand the mind strengthened\lin the harshest of conditions!$
data/maps/Route50_hns/scripts.inc.Route50_Text_BlackBelt2: Phew!\pI'm not as hardcore as he is.\pThere's really not much else\nto do here but train.$
data/maps/Route50_hns/scripts.inc.Route50_Text_WesselBefore:
Incredible, A VOLTORB!\pBut it appears to be made
of... Wood?\pMy hypothesis that this route
would contain many STEEL TYPE\lPOKéMON is disproven yet again.\pBut why else would I have found
this STEEL PLATE here?\pI must collect more data!$
data/maps/Route50_hns/scripts.inc.Route50_Text_WesselBeforeBattle: You want this PLATE?\nBut I haven't analyzed it yet!\pFine, we will battle for it.$
data/maps/Route50_hns/scripts.inc.Route50_Text_WesselAfter: Take the PLATE. I don't want to\ntalk about it.$
data/maps/Route50_hns/scripts.inc.Route50_Text_FinleyBefore:
How are the villagers treating
you?\pThey can be very unwelcoming to
strangers.\pBut meeting new people is one
of life's greatest joys.\pOne day, I hope to meet CHAMPION
LANCE.\pHe is a legendary dragon tamer,
much like myself.\lWho am I?\pWell, I am FINLEY, keeper of the
DRACO PLATE.$
data/maps/Route50_hns/scripts.inc.Route50_Text_FinleyBeforeBattle: I know the KIMONO's have sent you\nto collect these PLATES.\pThey say you are worthy...\nBut can you conquer my dragons?$
data/maps/Route50_hns/scripts.inc.Route50_Text_FinleyAfter: Perhaps you are even strong enough\nto beat LANCE...$

data/maps/Route5_House_hns/scripts.inc.Route5_House_Text_Granny1: Eeyaaaah!\pI sense a sinister shadow\nhovering over you.\lTake this to ward it off!$
data/maps/Route5_House_hns/scripts.inc.Route5_House_Text_Granny2: You were in mortal danger, but\nyou're protected now.$
data/maps/Route5_House_hns/scripts.inc.Route5_House_Text_Woman: My grandma is into warding off what\nshe believes to be evil spirits.\pI'm sorry that she startled you.$

data/maps/Route6_hns/scripts.inc.Route6_Text_PokefanM: The road is closed until the\nproblem at the POWER PLANT is\lsolved.$
data/maps/Route6_hns/scripts.inc.PokefanM_Text_RexSeen: My STANTLER is the cutest in the\nworld.$
data/maps/Route6_hns/scripts.inc.PokefanM_Text_RexAfter: Look how adorable my STANTLER\nacts!\pIsn't it cute enough to make\nyour heart melt?$
data/maps/Route6_hns/scripts.inc.PokefanM_Text_AllanSeen: My GRANBULL is the cutest in the\nworld.$
data/maps/Route6_hns/scripts.inc.PokefanM_Text_AllanAfter: Look how adorable my GRANBULL\nacts!\pIsn't it cute enough to make\nyour heart melt?$

data/maps/Route7_hns/scripts.inc.Route7_Text_UndergroundPathSign: What's this flyer?\p… Uncouth trainers have been\nholding battles in the\lUNDERGROUND PATH.\pBecause of rising complaints by\nlocal residents, the UNDERGROUND\lPATH has been sealed indefinitely.\pCELADON POLICE$

data/maps/Route8_hns/scripts.inc.Route8_Text_BikerDwayneSeen: We're the KANTO POKéMON FEDERATION\ntrainer group.\pWe'll drive you under our wheels!$
data/maps/Route8_hns/scripts.inc.Route8_Text_BikerDwayneAfter: The KANTO POKéMON FEDERATION will\nnever fall!$
data/maps/Route8_hns/scripts.inc.Route8_Text_BikerHarrisSeen: The cops shut down our\nUNDERGROUND PATH!\pThat really fries me!$
data/maps/Route8_hns/scripts.inc.Route8_Text_BikerHarrisAfter: Wiped out by some punk from\nJOHTO…$
data/maps/Route8_hns/scripts.inc.Route8_Text_BikerZekeSeen: We're the KANTO POKéMON FEDERA-\nTION!\nRight on!$
data/maps/Route8_hns/scripts.inc.Route8_Text_BikerZekeAfter: We'll try not to disturb anyone\nfrom now on…$
data/maps/Route8_hns/scripts.inc.Route8_Text_SupernerdSamSeen: How does the MAGNET TRAIN work?$
data/maps/Route8_hns/scripts.inc.Route8_Text_SupernerdSamBeaten: I just want to see the MAGNET\nTRAIN…$
data/maps/Route8_hns/scripts.inc.Route8_Text_SupernerdSamAfter: The power of magnets is awesome!$
data/maps/Route8_hns/scripts.inc.Route8_Text_SupernerdTomSeen: Hm… You've got many GYM BADGES.$
data/maps/Route8_hns/scripts.inc.Route8_Text_SupernerdTomBeaten: Just as I thought… You're tough!$
data/maps/Route8_hns/scripts.inc.Route8_Text_SupernerdTomAfter: GYM BADGES give you advantages in\nbattles.$
data/maps/Route8_hns/scripts.inc.Route8_Text_UndergroundPathSign: The flyer's torn.\pIt's impossible to read…$

data/maps/Route9_PokemonCenter_hns/scrip.Route9_PokemonCenter_Text_Engineer1: Sometimes us engineers come here\nfor our break. Or just to get away\lfrom our MANAGER.\pThat guy is crazy.$
data/maps/Route9_PokemonCenter_hns/scrip.Route9_PokemonCenter_Text_Engineer2: The POWER PLANT is very remote, so\nI travel far for work.$

data/maps/Route9_hns/scripts.inc.Route9_Text_CamperDeanSeen: I came to explore ROCK TUNNEL.$
data/maps/Route9_hns/scripts.inc.Route9_Text_CamperDeanAfter: My POKéMON were hurt before even\nentering ROCK TUNNEL.\pI'd better take them to a POKéMON\nCENTER right away.$
data/maps/Route9_hns/scripts.inc.Route9_Text_PicnickerHeidiSeen: Have you ever been to a picnic?\pThey're so much fun!$
data/maps/Route9_hns/scripts.inc.Route9_Text_PicnickerHeidiAfter: We bake lots of goodies and share\nthem all around.\pThey're delicious!$
data/maps/Route9_hns/scripts.inc.Route9_Text_CamperSidAfter: Sorry. You weren't littering. It\nwas my mistake.$
data/maps/Route9_hns/scripts.inc.Route9_Text_PicnickerEdnaAfter: Conserving energy is important,\nbut the environment is even more\lvital.$
data/maps/Route9_hns/scripts.inc.Route9_Text_HikerTimSeen: She'll be coming 'round MT.SILVER\nwhen she comes…\pMT.SILVER is in JOHTO, right?$
data/maps/Route9_hns/scripts.inc.Route9_Text_HikerSidneySeen: I'll tell you a secret.\pBut first, we battle!$
data/maps/Route9_hns/scripts.inc.Route9_Text_HikerSidneyAfter: The POWER PLANT is across a small\nriver.$

data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_B1F_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_B1F_Text_Presence: There is a strange presence here.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_B1F_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_B1F_Text_Hiker: This is a big room, but there's\nnothing here.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_B1F_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_B1F_Text_Teacher: This place has a mystical\nquality to it.\pIt feels sort of ethereal\neven.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_B1F_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_B1F_Text_Gramps: Ancient buildings are often\ntombs of kings.\pLike the pyramids, for\ninstance.$

data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_Scientist1: The RUINS are about 1500 years old.\pBut it's not known why they were\nbuilt--or by whom.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_Scientist2: There are odd patterns drawn on\non the walls of the RUINS.\pThey must be the keys for\nunraveling the RUINS' mystery.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_Fossils: Fossils found within the RUINS.\nMaybe there are more somewhere...$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DeviceForTalkingToP: We're developing a device for talking\nwith POKéMON.\pBut we haven't had much success…$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DevelopingNewBalls: I'm developing new kinds of\nPOKé BALLS…\pBut I haven't made much headway…$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBal:
We finally made new kinds of
POKé BALLS!\pThe REPEAT BALL makes it easier to
catch POKéMON you've caught before.\pThe TIMER BALL gets better at catching
POKéMON the longer a battle runs.\pBoth are proudly developed by
the DEVON CORPORATION.\pPlease give them a try!$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_IMadePokenav: I made the POKéNAV!\pAs an engineer, I feel blessed to have\nmade something so great!$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_WowThatsAPokenav:
Oh, wow!
That's a POKéNAV!\pIt came about as a result of our
PRESIDENT's desire to learn about\lthe feelings of POKéMON.\pWould you like me to describe its
features in detail?\pNo, no. I think you'll find out just by
trying the POKéNAV out.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DeviceToVisualizePo: I'm trying to develop a device that\nvisually reproduces the dreams of\lPOKéMON…\pBut it's not going well.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DevelopDeviceToResu: I've been trying to develop a device\nthat resurrects POKéMON from fossils…\pAnd, it's working!$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_WantToBringFossilBa:
Wait! That thing you have there…
Is that a POKéMON fossil?\pWould you like to bring that POKéMON
back to life?\pI can with my newly developed
FOSSIL REGENERATOR.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_OhIsThatSo: Oh, is that so?\pMy technological expertise\nis outstanding, I tell you.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_OhIsThatSo2: Oh, you don't have this fossil.\nCome back if you manage to find it.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne:
Oh, now that's a surprise!
You have more than one fossil?\pUnfortunately, my machine can only
regenerate one POKéMON at a time.\pWhich fossil would you like to
regenerate?$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_HandedFossilToResea: Excellent!\nLet's do this right away.\p{PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to\nthe RUINS RESEARCHER.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_FossilRegeneratorTa:
The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made,
is incredible.\pBut it has one drawback--it takes
a long time to work.\pSo, uh… How about you go for a stroll
and look around for a while?$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_FossilizedMonBrough: Thanks for waiting!\pYour fossilized POKéMON has been\nbrought back to life!\pThe fossil was an ancient POKéMON.\n{STR_VAR_2}, it was!$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_TooManyPokemon: Uh-oh, you've got too many POKéMON.\nYou have no room for this one.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFe: I'm trying to develop a new feature\nfor the POKéNAV…\pBut it's not going well.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Lab_hns/scripts.in.RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext:
Well, now what shall I work on
developing next?\pOur company allows us to make our
inspirations into reality.\pOne couldn't ask for a better
environment as an engineer.$

data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Outside_hns/script.RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Scientist:
Hm? That's a POKéDEX, isn't it?
May I see it?\pThere are so many kinds of
POKéMON.\pHm? What's this?\pWhat is this POKéMON?\pIt looks like the strange
writing on the walls of the\pRUINS.\pIf those drawings are really
POKéMON, there should be many
more.\pI know! Let me upgrade your
POKéDEX. Follow me.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Outside_hns/script.RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_SuperNerdStan_S: What do you want? I'm studying--\ndon't disturb me!$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Outside_hns/script.RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_SuperNerdStan_B: Sorry…\nI'm frustrated by our lack of\preal understanding…$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Outside_hns/script.RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_SuperNerdStan_A: The RUINS are from about 1500\nyears ago.\pNobody knows who built them.\pIt's also not known if the POKéMON\nstatues have any meaning.\pIt's all one big mystery…$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Outside_hns/script.RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_PsychicNathan_S: Hmmm… This is a strange place.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Outside_hns/script.RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_ResearchSign: RUINS OF ALPH RESEARCH CENTER\pTHE AUTHORITY ON THE\nRUINS OF ALPH$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Outside_hns/script.RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Fisher1: While exploring the RUINS, we\nsuddenly noticed an odd presence.\pWe all got scared and ran away.\nYou should be careful too.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Outside_hns/script.RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Fisher2: The RUINS hide a huge secret!\p…I think…$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Outside_hns/script.RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Youngster1: There are many kinds of UNOWN, so\nwe use them for our secret codes.$
data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_Outside_hns/script.RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Youngster2: A… H… E… A… D… Hmm…\pWhat?\pI'm decoding this message!$

data/maps/RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardCha.RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text: The chamber reacts!\nThe way is open.$
Some kind of ancient sensor.\nWhat is it looking for?$

Welcome to this chamber.\pThere are sliding panels that depict
a POKéMON drawn by the ancients.\pSlide the panels around to form
the picture.\pTo the left is a description of
the POKéMON.\pScientists in the lab are examin-
-ing some newly found patterns.$
A hole just opened up in the floor!\nI'd better tell the others.$
Now a hole in the wall too?!\nThis is getting spooky.$
A POKéMON that hid on the sea floor.\nEyes on its back scanned the area.$
It's a replica of an ancient\nPOKéMON.$
This flying POKéMON attacked its\nprey with saw-like fangs.$
This POKéMON drifted in the sea\nby twisting its ten tentacles.$
A POKéMON that flew gracefully on\nrainbow-colored wings.$

data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_WeShortenItToDevon: The DEVON CORPORATION…\nWe all just shorten it to DEVON.\pThat company makes all sorts of\nconvenient products.$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_SneakyLookingManWentAr: Hm? A sneaky-looking man?\pCome to think of it, yes, a shady-\nlooking guy went around the corner.$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_HaveYouChallengedGym: Have you taken the POKéMON GYM\nchallenge?\pWhen you get that shiny GYM BADGE\nin hand, I guess TRAINERS begin to\lrealize what is required of them.$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_HeyThatsRustborosGymBa: Hey, that's RUSTBORO's GYM BADGE!\pOut of all the POKéMON GYM BADGES,\nRUSTBORO's is the coolest, I'd say.$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_YoureNewAroundHere: Oh? Who might you be?\nYou're a new face around these parts.\pHave you just transferred into the\nPOKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_GymLeaderIsntEasyWithF: I challenged the GYM LEADER, but…\pIt's not going to be easy winning with\nmy FIRE-type POKéMON…\pFIRE-type POKéMON don't match up\nwell against ROCK-type POKéMON…$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyWalksInTheTunn: The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in\na cottage by the sea.\pHe goes for walks in the tunnel every\nso often.$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyLovesPeeko:
The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in
a cottage by the sea.\pHe said he was going shopping in
SLATEPORT for his pet, PEEKO.\pThat old sea dog, he must really love
that PEEKO.$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_WowYouHavePokemon: Wow, you have POKéMON with you, too.\pWhen I get bigger, I'm going to go\nplaces with POKéMON, too.$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_CatchRarePokemonIfIGoT: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL!\pIf I go to this school, will I be able\nto catch rare POKéMON easily?$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_PokemonCanChangeLookFr: If a POKéMON gains experience in\nbattles, it can sometimes change in\lthe way it looks.$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_PokemonChangeShape: A POKéMON changes shape?\nIf one did that, I would be shocked!$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_TradePokemonGrowFast: A POKéMON you get in a trade from\nsomeone grows fast.\pBut if you don't have certain GYM\nBADGES, it may not obey you…$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_HelpMeIWasRobbed:
Oh, it's you!\pYou're that fantastic TRAINER who
helped me in PETALBURG WOODS!\pHelp me! I was robbed by TEAM AQUA!
I have to get the DEVON GOODS back!\pIf I don't…
I'm going to be in serious trouble.$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_ShadyCharacterTookOffT: That shady character, I think he took\noff towards the tunnel over there.$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_YouGotItThankYou:
Oh! How did it go?
The DEVON GOODS?\pYou did!
You got them back!\pYou really are a great TRAINER!\pI know! As my thanks, I'll give you
another GREAT BALL!$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems: You're loaded with items.\nI can't give you this GREAT BALL.$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe: Excuse me, please!\nPlease come with me!$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_MayHiLetsRegister: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou had a MATCH CALL feature put\non your POKéNAV!\pLet's register each other so we can\ncontact one another anytime!\p… … … … … …$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_MayPassedBrineyWantToB:
MAY: Oh, by the way, I passed
MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.\pI guess he's on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.\pHow's your POKéDEX coming along,
{PLAYER}{KUN}? Mine's looking pretty decent!\pSo…
How about a little battle?$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_MayOhHaventRaisedPokem: MAY: Oh, what's the matter?\pHaven't you caught or raised your\nPOKéMON very much?\pThat's not very good for a TRAINER!$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_MayWantToBattle: MAY: So, what do you think?\nHow about a little battle here?$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_MayImNotGoingToLose: MAY: You just became a TRAINER,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_MayMrBrineyHint: MAY: Oh, by the way, MR. BRINEY, who\nI just passed…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, you just moved here so you\nmight not know this, but MR. BRINEY\lwas once a revered seafarer.$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_BrendanHiLetsRegister: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pYou had a MATCH CALL feature put\non your POKéNAV! Cool!\pLet's register each other so we can\nget in touch anytime!\p… … … … … …$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWan:
BRENDAN: By the way, {PLAYER}, I walked
by MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.\pI bet he was on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.\p{PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX?
Have you filled in any pages yet?\pMine rules.\pWant to have a battle to test how
far you've progressed?$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidenceInP: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have\nany confidence in your POKéMON?$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_BrendanWantToBattle: BRENDAN: What's up?\nWant to have a battle with me?$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_BrendanIWontGoEasy: BRENDAN: I know you just became\na TRAINER, but I won't go easy!$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_BrendanMrBrineyHint: BRENDAN: By the way, you know\nMR. BRINEY? The guy I just passed?\pI bet you didn't know this, since you\njust moved here, {PLAYER}, but\lMR. BRINEY was once a great sailor.$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_TunnelNearingCompletio: “Timesaving tunnel nearing\ncompletion!”\p…Is what it says on the sign, but\nthere's also a big “X” splashed\lacross it in red paint…$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpSign: DEVON CORPORATION\p“For all your living needs, we make\nit all.”$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_GymSign: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ROXANNE\p“The ROCK-loving honors student!”$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpBranchOfficeS: DEVON CORP. BRANCH OFFICE\p“Access limited to DEVON employees\nand authorized personnel.”$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_CitySign: RUSTBORO CITY\p“The city probing the integration of\nnature and science.”$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_TrainersSchoolSign: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL\p“We'll teach you anything about\nPOKéMON!”$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_DevelopedNewPokenavFea: I've been developing an added feature\nfor the POKéNAV…\pAnd it turned out great!\p{PLAYER}, may I see that POKéNAV?\nThe one our PRESIDENT gave you?$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_AddedMatchCallPleaseCa:
There you go, {PLAYER}!\pI added a new feature named
MATCH CALL to your POKéNAV.\pUsing the MATCH CALL feature,
you can chat with people who have\lbeen registered in your POKéNAV.\p{PLAYER}, our PRESIDENT STONE should
be registered in your POKéNAV.\pTest it out.
Please give our PRESIDENT a call.$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_IdBetterGetBackToWork: Okay, I'd better get back to work.\nPlease take care, {PLAYER}!$
data/maps/RustboroCity/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Text_YouCanHave2On2Battle:
Did you know this?\pYou can have a 2-on-2 battle even
if you're not with another TRAINER.\pIf you catch the eyes of two TRAINERS
when you have two or more POKéMON,\lthey'll both challenge you.\pDon't you think it'd be cool if you
could beat two TRAINERS by yourself?$

data/maps/RustboroCity_CuttersHouse/scri.RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPut:
That determined expression…
That limber way you move…\lAnd your well-trained POKéMON…\pYou're obviously a skilled TRAINER!\pNo, wait, don't say a word.
I can tell just by looking at you.\pI'm sure that you can put this
HIDDEN MACHINE to good use.\pNo need to be modest or shy.
Go on, take it!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_CuttersHouse/scri.RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_ExplainCu:
That HIDDEN MACHINE, or HM for
short, is CUT.\pAn HM move is one that can be used
by POKéMON outside of battle.\pAny POKéMON that's learned CUT can
chop down thin trees if the TRAINER\lhas earned the STONE BADGE.\pAnd, unlike a TM, an HM can be used
more than once.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_CuttersHouse/scri.RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_DadHelped: When they were expanding the city of\nRUSTBORO, my dad helped out.\pHe made his POKéMON use CUT to clear\nthe land of trees.$

data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_WelcomeTo: Hello and welcome to the DEVON\nCORPORATION.\pWe're proud producers of items and\nmedicine that enhance your life.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_StaffGotR: One of our research staff stupidly\ngot robbed of an important parcel.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ThoseShoe: Hey, those RUNNING SHOES!\nThey're one of our products!\pIt makes me happy when I see someone\nusing something we made.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWas: That stolen parcel…\pWell, sure it's important, but it's not\nanything that anyone can use.\pIn my estimation, that robber must not\nhave been very bright.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_SoundsLik: It sounds like they've recovered\nthe ripped-off DEVON GOODS.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_OnlyAutho: I'm sorry, only authorized people\nare allowed to enter here.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_HowCouldW: It's beyond stupid.\nHow could we get robbed?$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMeta:
Samples of rocks and metal are
displayed in the glass case.\pThere's a panel with some writing
on it…\p“DEVON CORPORATION got its start as
a producer of stones from quarries.\p“The company also produced iron from
filings in the sand.\p“From that humble start as a producer
of raw materials, DEVON developed.\p“DEVON is now a manufacturer of a wide
range of industrial products.”$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDi:
Prototypes and test products fill
the glass display case.\pThere's a panel with a description…\p“In addition to industrial products,
DEVON now markets sundries and\lpharmaceuticals for better lifestyles.\p“Recently, DEVON has begun marketing
tools for POKéMON TRAINERS, including\lPOKé BALLS and POKéNAV systems.”$

data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceFor: We're developing a device for talking\nwith POKéMON.\pBut we haven't had much success…$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_Developin: I'm developing new kinds of\nPOKé BALLS…\pBut I haven't made much headway…$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinally:
We finally made new kinds of
POKé BALLS!\pThe REPEAT BALL makes it easier to
catch POKéMON you've caught before.\pThe TIMER BALL gets better at catching
POKéMON the longer a battle runs.\pBoth are proudly developed by
the DEVON CORPORATION.\pPlease give them a try!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePoke: I made the POKéNAV!\pAs an engineer, I feel blessed to have\nmade something so great!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsA:
Oh, wow!
That's a POKéNAV!\pIt came about as a result of our
PRESIDENT's desire to learn about\lthe feelings of POKéMON.\pWould you like me to describe its
features in detail?\pNo, no. I think you'll find out just by
trying the POKéNAV out.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToV: I'm trying to develop a device that\nvisually reproduces the dreams of\lPOKéMON…\pBut it's not going well.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDe: I've been trying to develop a device\nthat resurrects POKéMON from fossils…\pAnd, it's working!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBri:
Wait! That thing you have there…
Is that a POKéMON fossil?\pWould you like to bring that POKéMON
back to life?\pI can with my newly developed
FOSSIL REGENERATOR.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatS: Oh, is that so?\pDEVON's technological expertise\nis outstanding, I tell you.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossil:
Oh, now that's a surprise!
You have not one, but two, fossils?\pUnfortunately, my machine can only
regenerate one POKéMON at a time.\pWould you like to pick one of your
fossils for regeneration?$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFos: Excellent!\nLet's do this right away.\p{PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to\nthe DEVON RESEARCHER.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilReg:
The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made,
is incredible.\pBut it has one drawback--it takes
a long time to work.\pSo, uh… How about you go for a stroll
and look around for a while?$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_Fossilize: Thanks for waiting!\pYour fossilized POKéMON has been\nbrought back to life!\pThe fossil was an ancient POKéMON.\n{STR_VAR_2}, it was!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TooManyPo: Uh-oh, you've got too many POKéMON.\nYou have no room for this one.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNe: I'm trying to develop a new feature\nfor the POKéNAV…\pBut it's not going well.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWor:
Well, now what shall I work on
developing next?\pOur company allows us to make our
inspirations into reality.\pOne couldn't ask for a better
environment as an engineer.$

data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIH:
I'm MR. STONE, the PRESIDENT of
the DEVON CORPORATION.\pI'd just got word about you!\pYou saved our staff not just once,
but twice!\pI have a favor to ask of an amazing
person like you.\pI understand that you're delivering
a package to SLATEPORT's SHIPYARD.\pWell, on the way, could you stop off in
DEWFORD TOWN?\pI was hoping that you'd deliver a
LETTER to STEVEN in DEWFORD.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWa: MR. STONE: Now, you should know that\nI am a great PRESIDENT.\pSo, I'd never be so cheap as to ask\na favor for nothing in return.\pThat's why I want you to have this!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneEx:
MR. STONE: That device…\pIt's a POKéMON NAVIGATOR, or POKéNAV
for short.\pIt's an indispensable tool for any
TRAINER on an adventure.\pIt has a map of the HOENN region.\pYou can check the locations of
DEWFORD and SLATEPORT easily!\pBy the way, I've heard that sinister
criminals--MAGMA and AQUA, I believe--\lhave been making trouble far and wide.\pI think it would be best if you rested
up before you go on your way.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneGo: MR. STONE: Well, then, {PLAYER}{KUN},\ngo with caution and care!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_CountingO: MR. STONE: I'm counting on you!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouF: MR. STONE: You delivered my LETTER?\nThank you kindly!\pThis is my way of thanking you.\nIt should help you, a TRAINER.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainEx:
MR. STONE: A POKéMON holding that
EXP. SHARE will be given some of the\lEXP Points from battle.\pIt will get EXP Points even if it didn't
actually battle.\pI would say EXP. SHARE is quite useful
for raising weak POKéMON.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamili:
MR. STONE: Since my youth, I've immersed
myself in work.\pConsequently, I'm not familiar with
trends and that sort of thing.\pBut do young people all want to be
TRAINERS in the POKéMON LEAGUE?$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rd:
This is the DEVON CORPORATION's
third floor.\pOur PRESIDENT's OFFICE is on
this floor.\pAnyway, I can't tell you how much I'm
grateful for what you've done.\pUm… By the way, that parcel
you got back for us…\pCould I get you to deliver that to
the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT?\pIt would be awful if those robbers
tried to take it again.\pUh… Hehehe, so, uh, could I count
on you to do that for me?\pOh, that's right.
Could you wait here a second?$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithP: Our PRESIDENT would like to have\na word with you.\pPlease come with me.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_VisitCapt: If you visit the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT,\nyou should go see CAPT. STERN.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RepeatAnd: DEVON's new products, the REPEAT BALL\nand TIMER BALL, have become hugely\lpopular among TRAINERS.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F/scri.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RareRocks: It's a collection of rare rocks and\nstones assembled by the PRESIDENT.$

data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat1_1F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_EveryPokemonH: Every POKéMON has a special ability\nthat it can use.$

data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat1_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ComingUpWithM:
Oh, it's so hard every day…\pWhat's hard?
You need to ask?\pIt's trying to figure out what to
make for meals every day.\pIt really isn't easy coming up with
meals every day.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat1_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKno:
Oh, hello!
Welcome to the PEPPER household.\pI have a question for you.
Have you ever baby-sat?\pYou see, I'm a new father, so raising
a child is all new to me.\pAnd I have a problem. My daughter
WALDA doesn't laugh enough.\pI think she'd laugh for me if I told
her something funny.\pDo you know of a funny word or
phrase you can tell me?$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat1_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_BeenSayingXDo: I've been saying “{STR_VAR_1}”\nto amuse her lately.\pDo you know of a better word or\na phrase that might work?$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat1_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_WonderfulLets: Oh, that's wonderful.\nSo, let's hear it, your suggestion.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat1_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhIsThatRight: Oh, is that right?\pWell, if you come up with a good\nsuggestion, I'm all ears.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat1_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATr: Ah, I see.\nWell, let's give it a try, shall we?$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat1_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhShesLaughin: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pOh, yes! She's laughing!\nOh, I am as delighted as she!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat1_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATr: Ah, I see.\nWell, let's give it a try, shall we?$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat1_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilin: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pHmmm… She's not smiling at all.\nMaybe WALDA is one serious child…$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat1_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThinkOfMyOwnP: Oh, so you don't know any good words.\nI'd better think for myself, then.\pHmm…\nHow about “{STR_VAR_1}”?\lLet's see if that will work.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat1_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilin: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pHmmm… She's not smiling at all.\nMaybe WALDA is one serious child…$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat1_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhYouDontKnow: Oh, so you don't know any good words.\nI guess I'll try to amuse her with\lthe saying I used before.\pAnyways, if you have a good suggestion,\ndon't hesitate in telling me, okay?$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat1_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGi:
Thank you!\pThanks to you, my darling WALDA
laughed for me!\pActually, I may not look all that
special, but I'm one of DEVON\lCORPORATION's top researchers.\pSo, how about I do something in return
for you?\pI know, I'll add some new wallpaper
patterns for the BOXES in the PC\lPOKéMON Storage System.\pIn the wallpaper pattern menu,
select “FRIENDS.”\pThat will give you access to the new
wallpaper patterns.$

data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat2_1F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_DevonWorkersL: DEVON CORPORATION's workers live in\nthis building.$

data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat2_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_DevonWasTinyI: Way back in the old days, DEVON was just\na teeny, tiny company.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat2_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDaddyMadeTh: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.\pMy daddy made this!\nBut I can't use it, so you can have it.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat2_2F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_GoingToWorkAt: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.\pWhen I grow up, I'm going to work for\nDEVON, too.$

data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat2_3F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentColl: DEVON's PRESIDENT likes to collect\nrare stones.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Flat2_3F/scripts..RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentsSon: I think the PRESIDENT's son also\ncollects rare stones.$

data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Yo, how's it going?\pListen, my friend!
Would you like to become the CHAMPION?\pI'm no TRAINER, not me, but I can
sure give you winning advice.\pThat's settled, then! We'll aim for the
POKéMON CHAMPIONSHIP together!\pIt's your job as a TRAINER to collect
GYM BADGES, am I right?\pBut GYM LEADERS aren't pushovers!\pAnd that's where I come in!
I'm here to provide expert advice!\pROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, is a user
of ROCK-type POKéMON.\pThe ROCK type is very durable, but
it can't stand WATER-type and\lGRASS-type moves.\pCome see me afterwards, if you beat
the GYM LEADER.\pWell, go for it!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictor:
Whoa! What a breathtaking victory!
My cheering must've worked!\pGreat!
Check your TRAINER CARD.\pThe STONE BADGE you got should be
properly recorded on it.\pIn other words…\pYou've climbed the first step on
the stairs to the CHAMPIONSHIP!\pThat's got to feel awesome!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshIntro: Don't take us GYM TRAINERS lightly!\nI'll show you why we're better!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshDefeat: You were too good for me…$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshPostBattle: You haven't seen anything of the ROCK\ntype's terrifying power!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyIntro: If you can't beat me, you won't stand\na chance against ROXANNE!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyPostBattle: ROXANNE is stronger than me by\nseveral times.\pYou'd better be on your guard!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcIntro: We might be in the middle of town,\nbut so what?\pMy ROCK POKéMON need room to\nrampage!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcDefeat: Oh, man oh man!\nOur challenger is one feisty customer!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcPostBattle: I have to hand it to our LEADER.\pIt took smarts and sense for her to\npick the ROCK type at her young age.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneIntro:
Hello, I am ROXANNE, the RUSTBORO
POKéMON GYM LEADER.\pI became a GYM LEADER so that I might
apply what I learned at the POKéMON\lTRAINER'S SCHOOL in battle.\pWould you kindly demonstrate how you
battle, and with which POKéMON?$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneDefeat:
So…
I lost…\pIt seems that I still have much more
to learn…\pI understand.\pThe POKéMON LEAGUE's rules state
that TRAINERS are to be given this\lif they defeat a GYM LEADER.\pPlease accept the official POKéMON
LEAGUE STONE BADGE.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_StoneBadgeInfoTake: The STONE BADGE heightens the ATTACK\npower of your POKéMON.\pIt also enables them to use the HM move\nCUT outside of battle.\pPlease take this with you, too.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRockTomb:
That TECHNICAL MACHINE, TM39,
contains ROCK TOMB.\pIt not only inflicts damage by dropping
rocks, it also lowers SPEED.\pIf you use a TM, it instantly teaches
the move to a POKéMON.\pRemember, a TM can be used only once,
so think before you use it.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostBattle: Since you are so strong, you should\nchallenge other GYM LEADERS.\pBy battling many TRAINERS, you should\nlearn many things.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM\pROXANNE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRegisterCal:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pROXANNE: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}?
This is ROXANNE of RUSTBORO CITY.\pI heard from BRAWLY that you're
moving up through the ranks of\lTRAINERS at an incredible clip.\pWell, I'd rather not think that
I can't beat you.\pI promise, I will shape up my GYM
so that you may challenge us again.\pI hope you'll be looking forward to
that occasion as much as me!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredRoxanne: Registered GYM LEADER ROXANNE\nin the POKéNAV.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePreRematch:
ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again.
I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.\pI'm sure we've both experienced many
battles since we last met.\pI would like to see how much better
we've become. Let us battle!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostRematch: ROXANNE: I still have much to learn\nwhen it comes to battling POKéMON.\pThat awareness makes me love battling\nall that much more!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchNeed:
ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again.
I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.\pI'm sure we've both experienced many
battles since we last met.\pI would like to see how much better
we've become…\pOh, no…
You only have one POKéMON with you?\pPlease return with at least one more
POKéMON.$

data/maps/RustboroCity_House1/scripts.in.RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWa:
Huh? My POKéMON is cute?
Sure, I knew that.\pBut if you really want, I'm willing
to trade it to you.\pI'll trade you my {STR_VAR_2} for
a {STR_VAR_1} if you want.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_House1/scripts.in.RustboroCity_House1_Text_PleaseBeGoodToM: Eheheh…\nPlease be good to my POKéMON.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_House1/scripts.in.RustboroCity_House1_Text_DoesntLookLikeM: Huh? That doesn't look anything like\na {STR_VAR_1} to me.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_House1/scripts.in.RustboroCity_House1_Text_YouDontWantToTh: Oh, if you don't want to, that's okay.\nBut my POKéMON is cute, you know…$
data/maps/RustboroCity_House1/scripts.in.RustboroCity_House1_Text_AnyPokemonCanBe: Any POKéMON can be cute if you raise\nit with care and kindness.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_House1/scripts.in.RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlace: In all sorts of places, there are all\nsorts of POKéMON and people.\pI find that fascinating, so I go to all\nsorts of places.$

data/maps/RustboroCity_House2/scripts.in.RustboroCity_House2_Text_TrainerSchoolEx: The TRAINER'S SCHOOL is excellent.\pIf you study there, you could even\nbecome a GYM LEADER.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_House2/scripts.in.RustboroCity_House2_Text_RoxanneKnowsALo: ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, really knows\na lot about POKéMON.\pShe's really strong, too!$

data/maps/RustboroCity_House3/scripts.in.RustboroCity_House3_Text_IGivePerfectlyS: For my own POKéMON, I give them\nperfectly suited nicknames!\pIt's my expression of, uh…\noriginality, yes, that's it!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_House3/scripts.in.RustboroCity_House3_Text_NamingPikachuPe: But giving the name PEKACHU to\na PIKACHU? It seems pointless.\pI suppose it is good to use a name\nthat's easy to understand, but…$

data/maps/RustboroCity_Mart/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCase: I'm buying some PARLYZ HEALS and\nANTIDOTES.\pJust in case I run into SHROOMISH\nin PETALBURG WOODS.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Mart/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPot: My POKéMON evolved.\nIt has a lot of HP now.\pI should buy SUPER POTIONS for it\ninstead of ordinary POTIONS.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_Mart/scripts.inc.RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRope: I'm getting an ESCAPE ROPE just in\ncase I get lost in a cave.\pI just need to use it to get back to\nthe entrance.$

data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F/.RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Pokem: My POKéMON has a NAIVE nature, and my\nfriend's has a JOLLY nature.\pIt's fascinating how POKéMON have\npersonalities!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F/.RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MaleA: Just like people, there are male and\nfemale POKéMON.\pBut no one seems to have any idea how\nthey're different.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F/.RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCut: The man next door gave me an HM!\pI used it to teach my POKéMON how to\nCUT down skinny trees.$

data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Blackboa: The blackboard lists status changes\nthat may affect POKéMON in battle.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ReadWhic: Which topic do you want to read?$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainP:
If a POKéMON is poisoned, it will
steadily lose HP.\pThe effects of poison remain after
a battle.\pA poisoned POKéMON's HP will drop
while it is traveling.\pHeal a poisoning using an ANTIDOTE.$

If a POKéMON becomes paralyzed,
its SPEED drops.\pIt may also not be able to move while
it is in battle.\pParalysis remains after battle.
Cure it using a PARLYZ HEAL.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainS: If a POKéMON falls asleep, it will be\nunable to attack.\pA POKéMON may wake up on its own,\nbut if a battle ends while it is\lsleeping, it will stay asleep.\pWake it up using an AWAKENING.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainB: A burn reduces ATTACK power, and it\nsteadily reduces the victim's HP.\pA burn lingers after battle.\nCure a burn using a BURN HEAL.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainF: If a POKéMON is frozen, it becomes\ncompletely helpless.\pIt will remain frozen after battle.\nThaw it out using an ICE HEAL.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Students: Students who don't study get a little\ntaste of my QUICK CLAW.\pWhether or not you are a good student \nwill be evident from the way you use\lthis item.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainQ:
A POKéMON holding the QUICK CLAW will
occasionally speed up and get to move\lbefore its opponent.\pThere are many other items that are
meant to be held by POKéMON.\pJust those alone will give you many
topics to study!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_TradingR: I'm trading POKéMON with my friend\nright now.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_AlwaysWa: I always wanted a SEEDOT, and\nI'm finally getting one!$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Pokemont: POKéMON can hold items, but they\ndon't know what to do with man-made\litems like POTION and ANTIDOTE.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Confused:
You know how some POKéMON moves can
confuse a POKéMON?\pA confused POKéMON will sometimes
attack itself without meaning to.\pBut once it leaves battle, it will
return to normal.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonH:
A POKéMON holding a BERRY will heal
itself…\pThere are many kinds of items that
POKéMON can hold…\pBoy, it sure is hard taking notes
down…$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Students:
It's this student's notebook…\pPOKéMON are to be caught using
POKé BALLS.\pUp to six POKéMON can accompany
a TRAINER.\pA TRAINER is someone who catches
POKéMON, raises them, and battles\lwith them.\pA TRAINER's mission is to defeat
the strong TRAINERS who await\lchallengers in POKéMON GYMS.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMet:
Hello? Didn't we meet before?
I think back in PETALBURG CITY.\pLet me introduce myself.
My name's SCOTT.\pI've been traveling everywhere in
search of outstanding TRAINERS.\pMore specifically, I'm looking for
POKéMON battle experts.\pSo, what brings you to this SCHOOL?
Are you a TRAINER, too?\pThe first thing you should do is to
have a POKéMON learn the move CUT.\pIf I remember correctly, someone in
this town has CUT.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentT: SCOTT: Hmm…\pThe talent levels of the students here\nare unknown. The potential's there.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottSto:
SCOTT: Oh, what's that?\pIt's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?
That's pretty impressive, I'd say.\pBut, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.\pIt's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.$
data/maps/RustboroCity_PokemonSchool/scr.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMet:
Hello? Didn't we meet before?
I think back in PETALBURG CITY.\pLet me introduce myself.
My name's SCOTT.\pI've been traveling everywhere in
search of outstanding TRAINERS.\pMore specifically, I'm looking for
POKéMON battle experts.\pOh, what's that?
It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?\pThat's pretty impressive, I'd say, for
a starting TRAINER like yourself.\pBut, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.\pIt's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.$

data/maps/RusturfTunnel/scripts.inc.RusturfTunnel_Text_ComeAndGetSome: What, are you coming?\nCome and get some, then!$
data/maps/RusturfTunnel/scripts.inc.RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntIntro:
Grah, keelhaul it all!\pThat hostage POKéMON turned out to
be worthless!\pAnd to think I made a getaway…
In this tunnel to nowhere!\pHey! You!
So you want to battle me?$
data/maps/RusturfTunnel/scripts.inc.RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntDefeat: Urrrggh! My career in crime comes to\na dead end!$
data/maps/RusturfTunnel/scripts.inc.RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntTakePackage:
This is plain not right…\pThe BOSS told me this would be a
slick-and-easy job to pull.\pAll I had to do was steal some package
from DEVON.\pTch!
You want it back that badly, take it!$
data/maps/RusturfTunnel/scripts.inc.RusturfTunnel_Text_PeekoGladToSeeYouSafe: PEEKO!\nAm I glad to see you're safe!$
data/maps/RusturfTunnel/scripts.inc.RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePee:
PEEKO owes her life to you!\pThey call me MR. BRINEY.
And, you are?\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pAh, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I sincerely thank you!\pNow, if there's anything that troubles
you, don't hesitate to tell me!\pYou can usually find me in my cottage
by the sea near PETALBURG WOODS.\pCome, PEEKO, we should make our way
home.\pPEEKO: Pihyoh!$
data/maps/RusturfTunnel/scripts.inc.RusturfTunnel_Text_WhyCantTheyKeepDiggin:
… …\pWhy can't they keep digging?
Is the bedrock too hard?\pMy beloved awaits me in VERDANTURF
TOWN just beyond here…\pIf RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF were
joined by this tunnel, I could visit\lher every day…\pBut this…
What am I to do?$
data/maps/RusturfTunnel/scripts.inc.RusturfTunnel_Text_ToGetToVerdanturf: To get from RUSTBORO to VERDANTURF,\nyou need to go to DEWFORD, then pass\lthrough SLATEPORT and MAUVILLE…$
data/maps/RusturfTunnel/scripts.inc.RusturfTunnel_Text_YouShatteredBoulderTa: Wow! You shattered that boulder\nblocking the way.\pTo show you how much I appreciate it,\nI'd like you to have this HM.$
data/maps/RusturfTunnel/scripts.inc.RusturfTunnel_Text_ExplainStrength: That HM contains STRENGTH.\pIf a muscular POKéMON were to learn\nthat, it would be able to move even\llarge boulders.$
data/maps/RusturfTunnel/scripts.inc.RusturfTunnel_Text_WandaReunion: WANDA!\nNow I can see you anytime!\pWANDA: That's…wonderful.\pPlease, take some rest at my home.$
data/maps/RusturfTunnel/scripts.inc.RusturfTunnel_Text_BoyfriendOnOtherSideO:
On the other side of this rock…
My boyfriend is there.\pHe… He's not just digging the tunnel
to come see me.\pHe works his hands raw and rough
for the benefit of everyone.$
data/maps/RusturfTunnel/scripts.inc.RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeIntro: What do you call a wild man up in the\nmountains? A mountain man, right?\pSo why don't they call a POKéMON in\nthe mountains a mountain POKéMON?$
data/maps/RusturfTunnel/scripts.inc.RusturfTunnel_Text_MikePostBattle: They halted development here to\nprotect POKéMON, right?\lThere's a feel-good story!$

data/maps/SSAqua_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor1_ToVermilion: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA is en route to\nVERMILION CITY.\pWe will make an announcement when\nwe arrive.$
data/maps/SSAqua_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor1_ToOlivine: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA is en route to\nOLIVINE CITY.\pWe will make an announcement when\nwe arrive.$
data/maps/SSAqua_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor2_FirstTime: Here's your cabin.\pIf your POKéMON are hurt, take a\nnap in the bed.\pThat will heal them.$
data/maps/SSAqua_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor3: The passengers are all trainers.\pThey're all itching to battle in\ntheir cabins.$
data/maps/SSAqua_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_1F_Text_Grandpa: Whoa! Excuse me. I was in a hurry!\pMy granddaughter is missing!\pShe's just a wee girl. If you see\nher, please let me know!$
data/maps/SSAqua_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor1_InOlivine: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA has arrived in\nOLIVINE CITY.$
data/maps/SSAqua_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor1_InVermilion: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA has arrived in\nVERMILION CITY.$
data/maps/SSAqua_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_1F_Text_SailorDoorArrived: We have arrived in VERMILION CITY.\nWould you like to disembark?$

data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailor:
Hey, kid. Could I get you to
look for my buddy?\pHe's goofing off somewhere,
that lazy bum!\pI want to go find him, but I'm
on duty right now.$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailorRefu: Oh, gee…\pThe CAPTAIN will be furious…$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailorThan: Thanks, kid! I chewed him out\ngood so he'll quit slacking off!$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailorSawG: A little girl?\pI may have seen her go by here.$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailorDire: The dining room is up ahead.\pThe stairs at the end lead to\nthe CAPTAIN's cabin.$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorJeffSeen: Nothing beats a battle when\nI'm on my break.$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorJeffBeaten: Win or lose, my break's over!$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorJeffAfter: I guess I can't win if I don't\nget serious.$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_PicnickerDebraSeen: I'm so bored. Want to battle?$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_PicnickerDebraAfter: SAFFRON, CELADON… I hear there\nare many big cities in KANTO.$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_JugglerFritzAfter: No more ships for me.\nNext time,\pI'm taking the MAGNET TRAIN.$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorGarrettSeen: This is where we sailors work!$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorGarrettBeaten: I lost on my home field…$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorGarrettAfter: We get different passengers\nfrom VERMILION CITY to\pOLIVINE CITY.$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_FisherJonahSeen: Even though we're out on the\nsea, I can't fish!\pThis is boring! Let's battle!$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_FisherJonahAfter: I plan to fish off\nVERMILION's pier.$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_BlackbeltWaiSeen: I'm building up my legs by\nbracing\pagainst the ship's rocking!$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_BlackbeltWaiAfter: I couldn't find the KARATE KING\nin JOHTO.\pHe's supposed to be training in\na cave somewhere.$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorKennethSeen: I'm a sailor man!\pBut I'm training POKéMON, so I\ncan become the CHAMP!$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorKennethBeaten: My lack of training is obvious…$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorKennethAfter: Eight BADGES! They must prove\nthat you've beaten\pGYM LEADERS.\pNo wonder you're so good!$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_TeacherShirleySeen: Don't lay a finger on my\nstudents!$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_TeacherShirleyAfter: We're on a field trip to the\nRUINS outside VIOLET.$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyNateSeen: Do you know the RUINS OF ALPH?$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyNateAfter: Radios pick up strange signals\ninside the RUINS.$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyRickySeen: There are some odd stone panels\nin the RUINS OF ALPH.$
data/maps/SSAqua_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyRickyAfter: I read that there are four of\nthose stone panels.$

data/maps/SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_hns/script.SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_Text_GranddaughterCa: CAPTAIN, play with me, please?\pI'm bored! I want to play more!$
data/maps/SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_hns/script.SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_Text_GranddaughterHa: Hi! Will you play with me?\p…Oh!\pGrandpa's worried about me?\pI have to go!\pI have to go find Grandpa!$
data/maps/SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_hns/script.SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_Text_CaptainExhausti: Whew! Thanks for coming along.\pKeeping that little girl amused\nwas exhausting.$
data/maps/SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_hns/script.SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_Text_CaptainHowDoYou: How do you like S.S.AQUA's ride?\pShe practically skates across\nthe waves.$

data/maps/SSAqua_PlayersRoom_hns/scripts.SSAquaRooms_Text_TakeRestOnBed_Pokecente: Sorry, you are playing with\nthe POKéCENTER challenge!$
data/maps/SSAqua_PlayersRoom_hns/scripts.SSAquaRooms_Text_TakeRestOnBed: There's a bed…\nLet's take a rest.$

data/maps/SSAqua_RoomNE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_HikerNolandAfterBattl: I wonder if there are any\nmountains worth climbing in KANTO?$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomNE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_PokemaniacEthanSeen: Do you know LILY?\nShe's a hot DJ in KANTO.$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomNE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_PokemaniacEthanAfterB:
LILY's nice, but
MARY's the best!
I want to check
out JOHTO's radio
programs!$

data/maps/SSAqua_RoomNNE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomNNE_Text_CooltrainermSeanSeen: I'm going to KANTO\nto test my skills.$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomNNE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomNNE_Text_CooltrainermSeanAfte: Trainers from JOHTO\ncan battle with KANTO\lGYM LEADERS.$

data/maps/SSAqua_RoomNW_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_SailorStanlySeen: Yeah, I'm a sailor, all right.\pI wasn't goofing off!\pThis cabin was vacant, so I\njust took a quick nap!\pAh, forget it! Let's battle!$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomNW_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_SailorStanlyAfterBatt: Being a sailor, I have to do\nphysical labor. It's exhausting!$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomNW_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_GentlemanEdwardSeen: Oh, no. I've lost something\nthat's very important.$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomNW_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_GentlemanEdwardAfterB: I give up. You don't have to\nlook.\pJust forget about it!$
