data/maps/SSAqua_RoomNW_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_BurglarCoreyAfterBatt: I found a pretty coin here.\pSomeone must have lost it…$

data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_PokefanmColinSeen: Hey, kid! Want to battle\nwith me?$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_PokefanmColinAfter: You're traveling all alone?\nIsn't your mom worried?$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg1Seen: You think I'm a baby?\nThat's not fair!$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg1After: Baby is a rude name to call\nus girls!$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg2Seen: I'm not a baby!\nThat's not nice to say to a lady!$

data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSSE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_CantFindGranddaughte:
Oh, hello…\pI still can't find my
granddaughter.\pIf she's on the ship,
that's OK.\pShe's an energetic child,
so she may be bugging someone\lI'm worried…$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSSE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_EntertainedGranddaug: {PLAYER}, was it?\nI heard you entertained my\lgranddaughter.\pI want to thank you for that.$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSSE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_GrandpaHaveThis: I know! I'd like you\nto have this!$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSSE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_GranddaughterWasPlay: Grandpa, here I am!\nI was playing with\lthe CAPTAIN and this person!$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSSE_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_GranddaughterHadFun: I had lots of fun playing!$

data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSSW_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_FirebreatherLyleSeen: I'm going to KANTO to put\non fire-breathing shows!$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSSW_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_FirebreatherLyleAfte: I guess fire is weak on the sea.\nIt doesn't matter? Really?$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSSW_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_BugCatcherKenSeen: I'm visiting my grandma to\ncatch me some bugs!$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSSW_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_BugCatcherKenAfterBa: You can find lots of POKéMON\nin the trees of JOHTO!$

data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSW_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_BeautyCassieSeen: I'm trying to forget my woes.\nLet's battle!$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSW_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_BeautyCassieAfterBatt: A voyage is best for getting over\na broken heart.\pBut a FAST SHIP trip is too short\nfor grieving.$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSW_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_GuitaristClydeSeen: I'm going to audition my songs\nat GOLDENROD's RADIO STATION.$
data/maps/SSAqua_RoomSW_hns/scripts.inc.SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_GuitaristClydeAfterBa: I was going to make my debut at\nthe BATTLE TOWER…\pI should go back to VERMILION and\nredo my training…$
Speaking of the RADIO STATION,\nwhat's this week's lucky number?$

data/maps/SSTidalCorridor/scripts.inc.SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontier:
SCOTT: Well, hi, hi!
{PLAYER}{KUN}, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pSomething's come up, so I have to
disembark, but am I glad to see you!\pCongratulations, LEAGUE CHAMPION!\pThere's a place I'd like to invite
someone like you.\pIt's the…
BATTLE FRONTIER!\pWhat's the place like?
You'll understand when you see it!\pI've spoken with the ship's CAPTAIN
about this.\pThe next time you take a ferry,
you should be able to sail to\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll be waiting for you
at the BATTLE FRONTIER!$

What are JOHTO's POKéMON CENTERS
like?\p…Oh, I see. So they're not much
different from the ones in KANTO.\pI can go to JOHTO without
worrying, then!$
data/maps/SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_hns/.SaffronCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Fisher: I just happened to come through\nROCK TUNNEL.\pThere was some commotion at the\nPOWER PLANT.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_hns/.SaffronCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Fisher_: There's an odd cave in CERULEAN.\pAs a pro HIKER, I should explore it,\nbut that place scares even me.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_hns/.SaffronCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Youngst: SILPH CO.'s HEAD OFFICE and the\nMAGNET TRAIN STATION--they're the\lplaces to see in SAFFRON.$

data/maps/SaffronCity_SilphCo_hns/script.SaffronCity_SilphCo_Text_Steven1: Hello...\nYou're breaking up...\lI think it depends on my dad.\lI see...\nI'll be on my way. See you soon.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_SilphCo_hns/script.SaffronCity_SilphCo_Text_Steven2:
STEVEN: You are... I remember your
eyes.\pWhen I see a trainer whose eyes
twinkle, I always remember.\pYou have a POKéDEX! So you are
also in search of POKéMON!\lLet me see...\pI think I can help you with that.\pLet's say that you have stones in
front of you. Which color would\l you pick?$
data/maps/SaffronCity_SilphCo_hns/script.SaffronCity_SilphCo_Text_Steven3: You chose correctly! I'll give you\n{STR_VAR_1}!$
data/maps/SaffronCity_SilphCo_hns/script.SaffronCity_SilphCo_Text_Steven4: Take good care of it. Your caring\nfor it will make me very happy.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_SilphCo_hns/script.SilphCo_Text_Receptionist: Welcome. This is SILPH CO.'s HEAD\nOFFICE BUILDING.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_SilphCo_hns/script.SilphCo_Text_Officer: Only employees are permitted to\ngo upstairs.\pBut since you came such a long\nway,\phave this neat little souvenir.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_SilphCo_hns/script.SilphCo_Text_Officer_GotUpGrade: It's SILPH CO.'s latest product.\pIt's not for sale anywhere yet.$

data/maps/SaffronCity_TrainStation_hns/s.SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerTr: The train hasn't come in…\pI know! I'll carry the passengers\non my back!\pThat won't work.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_TrainStation_hns/s.SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerCo: We'll soon depart for GOLDENROD.\pAre you coming aboard?$
data/maps/SaffronCity_TrainStation_hns/s.SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerRi: May I see your rail PASS, please?\pOK. Right this way, please.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_TrainStation_hns/s.SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerNo: Sorry. You don't have a rail PASS.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_TrainStation_hns/s.SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerHo: We hope to see you again!$
data/maps/SaffronCity_TrainStation_hns/s.SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerAr: We have arrived in SAFFRON.\pWe hope to see you again.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_TrainStation_hns/s.SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_Officer_T: I'm sorry, but the MAGNET TRAIN\nisn't operating now.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_TrainStation_hns/s.SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_GymGuide:
The MAGNET TRAIN is a super-modern
rail liner that uses electricity\pand magnets to attain incredible
speed.\pHowever, if there isn't any
electricity…$
data/maps/SaffronCity_TrainStation_hns/s.SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_GymGuide_: Whew…\pHow many times have I gone back\nand forth between KANTO and JOHTO?$
data/maps/SaffronCity_TrainStation_hns/s.SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_Teacher: Before the MAGNET TRAIN STATION\nwas built, there was a house there.\pA little girl named COPYCAT used\nto live there.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_TrainStation_hns/s.SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_Lass: Hi. Do you have a rail PASS?\nI have one.\pAll the people in SAFFRON who ride\nthe MAGNET TRAIN have PASSES.$

Don't be afraid, I'm not a bad
person.\pA place like this...
attracts mean people.\pThey would eventually cause
trouble...\pIt makes me mad just thinking about
it.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_Tunnel_NS_hns/scri.SaffronCity_Tunnel_NS_Text_BaldingManCan: Aha!\nThat's a RAGE CANDYBAR!\pCan I have it?\nPlease!$
data/maps/SaffronCity_Tunnel_NS_hns/scri.SaffronCity_Tunnel_NS_Text_BaldingManGav: {PLAYER} Gave the RageCandyBar to the\nguy at the underground path.\pMunch!\pHow upsetting!\pBut this is so good!\pMunch munch!\pAargh! It makes me mad!\pMunch munch!\pAargh...\p...................Phew!\pI am feeling much better!\nThank you for your candy!\lI want you to have this!$

data/maps/SaffronCity_hns/scripts.inc.SaffronCity_Text_Baoba:
WARDEN BAOBA: {PLAYER}!\pThis is WARDEN BAOBA.\pI'm calling to tell you that the
SAFARI ZONE has expanded again!\pFinally, my SAFARI ZONE has been
fully realized!\pYou remember where it is, right?\pJust west of CIANWOOD CITY!
see you soon!$
data/maps/SaffronCity_hns/scripts.inc.SaffronCity_Text_Lass1: A little girl who is an expert at\nmimicking people lives here.\pShe even mimics the people she's\nconversing with. It's confusing.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_hns/scripts.inc.SaffronCity_Text_Lass1_ReturnedPart: The COPYCAT girl looked unhappy.\pShe said she lost her favorite\nPOKé DOLL--CLEFAIRY.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_hns/scripts.inc.SaffronCity_Text_PokefanM: You came out from JOHTO?\pYou can zip back home if the\nMAGNET TRAIN's running.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_hns/scripts.inc.SaffronCity_Text_PokefanM_ReturnedPart: You came out from JOHTO?\pYou can zip back home by hopping\non the MAGNET TRAIN.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_hns/scripts.inc.SaffronCity_Text_CooltrainerM: I went to the GYM, raring for\nbattles against trainers…\pIt turns out, I stumbled into the\nunused GYM next door.\pBoy, I was pretty embarrassed.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_hns/scripts.inc.SaffronCity_Text_CooltrainerF: This is SILPH CO., famous for\nPOKéMON merchandise.\pIn the past, TEAM ROCKET wanted\nthe company because of that.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_hns/scripts.inc.SaffronCity_Text_Fisher: Chew… Chew…\pI hear there's big trouble brewing\nat the POWER PLANT.\pChew… Chew…$
data/maps/SaffronCity_hns/scripts.inc.SaffronCity_Text_Fisher_ReturnedPart: Chew… Chew…\pI hear there was big trouble at the\nPOWER PLANT.\pChew… Chew… Haaah, I'm full!$
data/maps/SaffronCity_hns/scripts.inc.SaffronCity_Text_Youngster1: Going into an alley for the first\ntime makes me sorta anxious.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_hns/scripts.inc.SaffronCity_Text_Youngster2: There's a place called the CONTEST\nHALL in VIRIDIAN where trainers\lgather from all over the place.$
data/maps/SaffronCity_hns/scripts.inc.SaffronCity_Text_Lass2: Our city was featured on a radio\nprogram.\pIt's nice to hear praise for your\ncity, but it's a bit embarrassing\ltoo.$

data/maps/SaffronCity_hns/scripts.inc.SaffronCity_Text_GymSign: SAFFRON CITY\nPOKéMON GYM\lLEADER: SABRINA\pThe Master of Psychic POKéMON!$

data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Entrance/script.SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNe:
Hey!
I remember your face!\pIf you're here, it must mean that
you're about to mess with us again!\pA punk like you, do you really think
you can take on TEAM AQUA?\pI'd say you're too early by about
a trillion years!\pYou're a perfect fit for the likes of
TEAM MAGMA!\pSpeaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they
were spotted near MOSSDEEP.\pThat bunch of goons, they sure don't
look good near the sea!$

were spotted near MOSSDEEP.\pThat bunch of goons, they sure don't

data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room1/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Intro: We don't need a kid around!\nGo on home already!$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room1/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1PostBatt: I want to get a promotion so I can\nboss around the GRUNTS…$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room1/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Intro: That submarine… It's tiny inside.\nI'm sore all over!$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room1/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2PostBatt: That submarine we jacked, man,\nit's brutal as a ride.\lIt's way too tight in there!$

data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room3/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro:
Ahahahaha!\pHow did you manage to get here without
a submarine?\lWhat an impressive child!\pBut… It won't do to have you
meddling about here.\pAnd, I do want payback for what
happened at the WEATHER INSTITUTE…\pI'm going to give you a little taste
of pain! Resign yourself to it!$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room3/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBatt:
Ahahahaha!
You're so darn strong.\pIt's terribly disappointing that you're
not a TEAM AQUA member.\pYou could have enjoyed the fabulous
world our BOSS has promised as\lone of us…$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room3/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro:
For our dream to become real, we need
the power of POKéMON.\pBut meddlers like you use the power of
POKéMON to mess with us even at\la place like this!\pLife just doesn't work the way we
need it to!$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room3/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBatt:
You know, we don't dare question
the motives of our leader.\pBut here you are, just some punk,
going up against our BOSS.\pMaybe…
You must be something…$

data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room4/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Intro: Who are you?\nWhere did you come in from?$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room4/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3PostBatt: I can't find the way out!\pI'm not afraid. Don't get me wrong!$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room4/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Intro: Who are you?\nWhere do you think you're going?$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room4/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4PostBatt: My partner forgot the map in that\nsubmarine!\pHow's that for being useless?$

data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room9/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieSoItWasY: ARCHIE: Fufufu…\nSo it was you, after all.$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room9/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKy: ARCHIE: Behold!\pSee how beautiful it is, the sleeping\nform of the ancient POKéMON KYOGRE!\pI have waited so long for this day to\ncome…$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room9/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustD: ARCHIE: It surprises me, how you've\nmanaged to chase me here.\pBut that's all over now.\pFor the realization of my dream,\nyou must disappear now!$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room9/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDefeat: What?!\nI lost to a mere child like you?!$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room9/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThis: ARCHIE: Fufufu…\pI commend you. I must recognize that\nyou are truly gifted.\pBut!\nI have this in my possession!\pWith this RED ORB, I can make KYOGRE…$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room9/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_RedOrbShinesBy: The RED ORB suddenly began shining\nby itself!$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room9/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDid: ARCHIE: What?!\pI didn't do anything.\nWhy did the RED ORB…\pWhere did KYOGRE go?$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room9/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieAMessage: ARCHIE: Hm? It's a message from our\nmembers outside…$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room9/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRain:
ARCHIE: Yes, what is it?\pHm…
It's raining heavily?\pGood… That should have happened.
That is why we awakened KYOGRE,\lto realize TEAM AQUA's vision of\lexpanding the sea.\pWhat?!\pIt's raining far harder than we
envisioned? You're in danger?\pThat can't be…
That's just not possible…\pHold your position and monitor
the situation!$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room9/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKy: ARCHIE: There's something wrong…\pThe RED ORB is supposed to awaken\nand control KYOGRE…\pBut… Why?\nWhy did KYOGRE disappear?\pWhy?!$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room9/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveY:
MAXIE: What have you wrought?\pARCHIE… You've finally awoken KYOGRE,
haven't you?\pWhat will happen to the world if this
downpour continues for all eternity?\pThe world's landmass will drown in
the deepening sea…$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room9/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetA:
ARCHIE: W-what?!
Don't get all high and mighty with me!\pWasn't it you, TEAM MAGMA, that
infuriated GROUDON?\pSo long as I have this RED ORB,
I should be able to control KYOGRE…\pI should be able to control it…$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room9/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHav: MAXIE: We don't have the time to\nargue about it here!\pGet outside and see for yourself!\pSee if what you've wrought is the\nworld that we desired!$
data/maps/SeafloorCavern_Room9/scripts.i.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieComeOnPla: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, come on, you have\nto get out of here, too!$

data/maps/SeafoamIslands_Gym_hns/scripts.SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_GymStatue: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$
data/maps/SeafoamIslands_Gym_hns/scripts.SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerW: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$
data/maps/SeafoamIslands_Gym_hns/scripts.SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_Blaine_ExplainTM:
This TM contains
the awesome OVERHEAT!\pThe overwhelming heat scorches your
opponents, but then drops your power.\pI hope your next opponent has an
extra BURN HEAL! Waaah!$
data/maps/SeafoamIslands_Gym_hns/scripts.SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineIntro:
BLAINE: Waaah!\pMy GYM in CINNABAR burned down.\pMy fire-breathing POKéMON and I are
homeless because of the volcano.\pWaaah!\pBut I'm back in business as a GYM
LEADER here in this cave.\pIf you can beat me, I'll give you
a BADGE.\pHa! You'd better have BURN HEAL!$
data/maps/SeafoamIslands_Gym_hns/scripts.SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineWinLoss: BLAINE: Awesome. I've burned out…\pYou've earned VOLCANOBADGE!$
data/maps/SeafoamIslands_Gym_hns/scripts.SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineAfterBattl: BLAINE: I did lose this time, but\nI'm going to win the next time.\pWhen I rebuild my CINNABAR GYM,\nwe'll have to have a rematch.$
data/maps/SeafoamIslands_Gym_hns/scripts.SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineFightDone: BLAINE: My fire POKéMON will be\neven stronger.\pJust you watch!$
data/maps/SeafoamIslands_Gym_hns/scripts.SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineRematch: BLAINE: Whoa!\pI see you've become the KANTO\nCHAMPION!\pThat's blazing!\pYour skills are top-notch.\pI'm always up for a battle.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
data/maps/SeafoamIslands_Gym_hns/scripts.SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineRematchDef: BLAINE: Your skills are truly fiery!\pYou've burned right through my\ndefenses.$
data/maps/SeafoamIslands_Gym_hns/scripts.SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_GymGuideWin: Yo!\p… Huh? It's over already?\pSorry, sorry!\pCINNABAR GYM was gone, so I didn't\nknow where to find you.\pBut, hey, you're plenty strong even\nwithout my advice. I knew you'd win!$
data/maps/SeafoamIslands_Gym_hns/scripts.SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_GymGuideWin2: A POKéMON GYM can be anywhere as\nlong as the GYM LEADER is there.\pThere's no need for a building.$

data/maps/ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom/scr.ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_CanOverc: The penetrating cold around these\nparts is an impediment to training.\pBut with focus, one can overcome!\pWith this FOCUS BAND, buckle down and\nwithstand the cold!$

data/maps/SinjohRuins_ArceusRoom_hns/scr.SinjohRuins_ArceusRoom_Text_CryArceus2: ARCEUS: Dodogyuuun!\pThe ARCEUS is weakened...\nCan be caught?$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_ArceusRoom_hns/scr.SinjohRuins_ArceusRoom_Text_StevenCongra:
STEVEN: You did it, {PLAYER}!\pThat battle was breathtaking.\pSeeing your power made me realize.\pThe KIMONO GIRLS didn't send you
to help our research.\pI think they sent you because
you were the only one worthy of\ltaming the legendary POKéMON.\pThey didn't trust my team and I
to handle it.\pAnd after what I've just seen...\pI think they were right.\pI've brought a lot of unwanted
attention to this town.\pI think I'll spend some time
with the locals.\pAfter all of this, you and your
POKéMON deserve some rest.\pI'll be at the village if you need me.\pFufufu, what could you need from me?$

data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutscene: STEVEN: {PLAYER}!\pI'd recognize those eyes anywhere.\pWhat brings you this far north?\p.............\pI see, the KIMONO GIRLS of NEW SINJOH\nhave sent you to aid our\linvestigation.\pIn that case, allow me to bring you\nup to speed.$

STEVEN: When I first heard about
these ruins, I had to come see\lthem for myself.\pI assembled a team from DEVON CORP.
and we set off on a research\lexpedition.\pWho knows what we'll find buried
here.\pWe've learned quite a lot
already.$

LINGUIST: While the full translation
of the glyphs found around the ruins\lstill eludes me, I've been able\lto make out some aspects.\pThere are 17 peculiar PLATES.\pThey have some significance
to the ruins, but we've only\lfound 1 so far.\pThe rest are said to be guarded
by POKéMON and trainers of\lawesome power.$

STEVEN: That's the story, {PLAYER}.\pThe NOBLE POKéMON that guard the
remaining PLATES are too strong\lfor my team, I'm afraid.\pAnd I need to stay here to oversee
the research.\pBut I think you could do it.
Will you help us?$
Excellent.\pThe glyphs say the PLATES are\nheld by NOBLE POKéMON and\lstrong trainers across SINJOH.\pI'll call your POKéGEAR if we\nlearn anything new.\pThank you, {PLAYER}.$
Are you sure?\pWho knows what we'll find buried\nhere.\pWon't you reconsider?$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_FinalPlateScene1: STEVEN: {PLAYER}!\pI think I know what's going to\nhappen we bring together all 17 of\lthe PLATES.\pI feel...\l.....................$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_FinalPlateScene2: STEVEN: I need to see this for\nmyself!\pOutside, {PLAYER}!$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenFindPlates: STEVEN: Ah, {PLAYER}.\p{STR_VAR_1} PLATES so far.\nNot bad at all.\pI have to admit, I'm curious\nwhat will happen once they're\lall gathered.\pWell, let's see what you find.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenFindPlates3: STEVEN: Ah, {PLAYER}.\p{STR_VAR_1} PLATES so far.\nNot bad at all.\pHave you investigated that\nchamber yet?\lIt's all quite mysterious.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenFindPlates9:
STEVEN: Ah, {PLAYER}.\p{STR_VAR_1} PLATES so far.
Making great progress.\pThe chambers that have opened
up bear a striking similarity\lto a series of chambers\lin the HOENN region.\pEach of those was also home to a
legendary POKéMON.\pBut in HOENN, only 3 were ever
discovered.\pAnd here, there are at least 6.\pWho knows what we'll find next.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenAfterAll:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}!\pThis expedition has been the
experience of a lifetime.\pEver since I heard about these ruins,
I had this feeling.\pI thought we would discover something
amazing.\pAnd my predictions usually come true.\pThank you for all your help,
Champion.\pWhere will you go from here?\pI hope we can meet again somewhere.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Geologist: Ground-penetrating radar shows\n6 subterranean chambers in this\lvalley.\p5 of them appear to be closer\nto the surface level, with 1\lburied even deeper.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_GeologistDuring: All this time I've directed my\nequipment downward to image\lthe underground.\pWhen clearly I should've pointed\nit up!$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_GeologistAfter: Those PLATES were related to the\nmost powerful POKéMON??\pI wish I had more time to study them.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Linguist: Ugh....\nThere's so many glyphs to\ltranslate..\pWe don't have anything like this\nin the HOENN region.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_LinguistDuring:
Imagine my surprise as I
translated the glyph!\pI triple and quadruple checked
it before telling STEVEN!\pI mean, really, the God of
POKéMON?\pIt's incredible.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_LinguistAfter: This expedition has been a\njoy, {PLAYER}.\pThanks for taking care of all\nthe field-work.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Archaeologist:
The existence of a civilization
in this area changes our whole\lunderstanding of history.\pMany of the artifacts we've found
are over a thousand years old.\pThe carbon dating lines up with
artifacts found in the SINNOH region.\pAlthough, that flute you found...
It seems far older.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_ArchaeologistDuring: Those plates...\nThe connection to the SINNOH\lregion...\lThat flute....\lIt's all starting to make sense.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_ArchaeologistAfter: The historical value of what\nyou've helped us unearth here\lcannot be overstated, \l{PLAYER}.\pTruly, thank you.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_GrowlitheBall: This appears to be Growlithe's ball..\nBetter leave it alone.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Biologist:
Look at this wonderful specimen!\pThis species of GROWLITHE is unlike
those found anywhere else in the\lworld.\pDNA analysis reveals that it shares
a common ancestor with GROWLITHE\lfound in other regions.\pYet, its temperament and typing
differ significantly.\pDescriptions of GROWLITHE found in
ancient SINNOH records seem to match.\pPerhaps this species once occupied
a much larger territory, stretching\lnorth through ancient SINNOH.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_BiologistDuring: If the creature at the top of\nthose stairs really is the God\lof all POKéMON, does that mean\lit is the first common ancestor?$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_BiologistAfter: I've been able to gather so much\ndata on regional forms and\ldivergent evolution from this\lexpedition. Thank you,\l{PLAYER}.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Hiker:
For ten years, I've hiked these
wilds.\pNo, make that twenty years.\pUntil one day I found those big
stone pillars and that ominous\ltemple.\pThat's the SINJOH RUINS.
Or so I've heard.\pI didn't know about the town then.\pAll I did was tell a few of my
pals. But word travels fast.\pI never thought it would bring
so much attention to the area.\pMakes me feel kinda funny.
Y'know?$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_HikerDuringAfter:
Don't tell anyone, {PLAYER},
But I saw that temple on\lthe mountaintop when I first\ldiscovered this place.\pI kept it to myself.\pI've blabbed enough about
these ruins.\pIt seems like everything worked
out, at least.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note1:
Research Log 1: May 3, 1975\pWe've arrived at the location
of the ruins.\pThe harsh cold of Mt.Silver
can be felt from all the way\ldown here...\pSoon the main excavation team
will make it through the mountain..\lI cannot wait to see what waits for us\lunderneath our feet!$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note2:
Research Log 2:  May 10, 1975\pA week of digging has yielded
no result whatsoever.\pThe ice here is impossibly thick,
and the rock just breaks our\lequipment entirely.\pNot even MACHAMP was able to
make a dent.\pWhat is this place?\pWe must find out.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note3:
Research Log 3:  May 14, 1975\pYou don't get ahead in life by
standing by and doing nothing.\pI'm just a worker.\pBut I had an idea of how we could
break through the ice.\pOr rather, melt through it.\pWe need FIRE-TYPE POKéMON and
lots of them.\pBut how will we get them here
all the way from SINNOH?$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note4:
Research Log 4:  May 21, 1975\pWe've been busy.\pMy idea worked to get us through
the ice. Only we didn't get the\lFIRE-TYPEs from back home.\pThe boss insisted we get them locally.\pWe found a hot spring by a nearby
village....\pAnd we took what we needed...\pI'm not proud of it. But sacrifices
are sometimes required for progress.\pSo, the ice is gone.\pThere are 6 chambers, and a sealed
temple in the center.\pThe architecture of the main 
structure indicates it may be of the\lthe ancient Celestica peoples...\pOur ancestors. Before they moved north.\pThe boss wants that temple open as
soon as possible...$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note5:
Research Log 5:  June 2, 1975\pWe managed to get it open...\pI thought I'd be overjoyed...\pBut we lost good men in the blast
of energy that sprung from the\ltemple.\pNot to mention the POKéMON that
helped us get it open.\lGod rest their souls...\p........................\pRegardless.\pThe temple is open, but we are
only left with more questions.\pThere is no legendary POKéMON
inside. No treasure.\pOur supplies are starting to run
out and we have nothing to show\lfor our efforts...$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note6: Research Log 6:  June 10, 1975\pThe expedition is done.\nThe rest of the men are packing up.\pBut I can't.\pI can't abandon this mission.\nNot after what we've lost.\pI'm going to stay behind.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note7:
Research Log 7:  September 10, 1975\pIt's been months since we got
here. Since I got here.\pThe rest of the men are gone.\pNow it's just me and the
POKéMON we captured to help us\lwith the work.\pI've been training them to get
stronger.\pMy TYPHLOSION, most of all.\pWe must find out what's beneath
the temple.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note8:
Research Log 8:  September 15, 1975\pFailure.\p......................\pMy POKéMON....\pTogether, all 6 of my POKéMON
were able to smash through
A false wall in the temple.\pBut it was waiting for us...\pSomething like a giant titan...\pThe energy it released was just
like what happened before.\pThey were all destroyed...\pAnd worst of all, that beast
sealed the wall back up.\pI can't go home.
They won't recognize me anymore...\pThis place has changed me...\pI'm going to talk with the
villagers.\pThey don't know what I've done.\pSince the other men are long
gone, they'll think I'm just a\llost hiker.\pThere is no place left for me
but here.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_DisplayCase_Text: It's a display case neatly\npacked and lined with samples\land artifacts!$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Artifact_Text: It's an artifact found from\ninside the ruins!$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_PlayFlute: The AZURE FLUTE is reacting.\nPlay the flute?$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall3Plates:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pWe felt a tremor at the ruins
just now.\pEveryone's fine, don't worry.\pIt's quite intriguing, one of the
subterranean chambers beneath the\lruins has sprung open.\pThe markings inside remind
me of something from HOENN.\pYou should come take a look
when you can.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall6Plates:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pHow's the search going?\pWe had another tremor here.
A second chamber opened up\lthis time.\pI've asked our geologist to keep
his instruments ready in case it\lhappens again.\pThe deeper we dig... The more
questions we find.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall9Plates:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pAnother tremor here at the ruins.\pThe data paints an intriguing
picture.\pIt wasn't an earthquake at all.\pSome kind of energy built up
underground and cracked the\lrock open from the inside.\pWhat could cause that...
I honestly don't know.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall12Plates:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pAnother tremor. Another chamber
opening up.\pWe still can't figure out the
pattern behind the timing.\pSay, {PLAYER}... you're not
doing something to cause all\lthis, are you?\pNo, that can't be right.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall15Plates: STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pDid you just find another PLATE?\p.................\pOf course.\pThe legendary POKéMON lying\nin these ruins... they're responding\lto you, aren't they?\pAs if they want to be found.\pMy predictions usually come true.\nI should have known better than\lto doubt you.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_House1_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall16Plates: STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pWe're very close now. I can feel it.\p..................\pYou should come see this for\nyourself.$

data/maps/SinjohRuins_Temple_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Temple_Text_Mon: Some kind of ancient sensor.\nWhat is it looking for?$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_Temple_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Temple_Text_ScannerAlreadyDo: This sensor has already been activated.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_Temple_hns/scripts.SinjohRuins_Temple_Text_Responds: The temple responds to your actions.$

data/maps/SinjohRuins_hns/scripts.inc.SinjohRuins_Text_StevenGotoStairs1: STEVEN: This could only mean one thing.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_hns/scripts.inc.SinjohRuins_Text_StevenGotoStairs2:
{PLAYER}. We were able to decipher
the rest of the glyphs...\pIf the translation is right, 
the POKéMON at the top of that\lstaircase is the most powerful\lbeing in the universe.\pAnd it is my duty as former
CHAMPION of the HOENN LEAGUE\lto make sure you are strong\lenough to face it.\pMeet me at that landing
when you are ready.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_hns/scripts.inc.SinjohRuins_Text_HealParty: STEVEN: Let me heal your POKéMON\nbefore you go.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_hns/scripts.inc.SinjohRuins_Text_StevenAfterPlate: STEVEN: Good luck, {PLAYER}\pGo on, I'm right behind you.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_hns/scripts.inc.SinjohRuins_Text_StevenAfterBattle: STEVEN: To think, another trainer \nwould defeat me like this.\pIncredible.\pTake this, it's the final plate.$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_hns/scripts.inc.SinjohRuins_Text_StevenReadytoBattle: STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pEver since I first saw the\ndetermination in your eyes,\lI felt it would lead to this.\pI will test the bond between you\nand your POKéMON.\pAre you ready?$
data/maps/SinjohRuins_hns/scripts.inc.SinjohRuins_Text_ChallengeSteven: Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you're going to mount\na serious challenge, expect the worst!$

data/maps/SkyPillar_Outside/scripts.inc.SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPi: WALLACE: Oh, my, I'm terribly sorry!\pIn my haste, I didn't notice that\nI'd left you behind!\pI've opened the locked door of\nthe SKY PILLAR.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, let's be on our way!$
data/maps/SkyPillar_Outside/scripts.inc.SkyPillar_Outside_Text_EarthquakeNotMome: WALLACE: It's an earthquake!\pThere's not a moment to waste!\nWe've got to hurry!$
data/maps/SkyPillar_Outside/scripts.inc.SkyPillar_Outside_Text_SituationGettingW: WALLACE: Hmm…\nThe situation is getting worse…$
data/maps/SkyPillar_Outside/scripts.inc.SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSoo:
WALLACE: This isn't good…\pThe weather distortion is spreading
even here…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pRAYQUAZA should be farther up
from here.\pI'm worried about SOOTOPOLIS.
I've got to go back.\pEverything is in your hands now.
Don't fail us!$

data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_EnergyGuruSellWhatYou: I'm the ENERGY GURU! I'll go for it and\nsell you what you need!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_PleaseGiveItThisEffor: Went for it stupendously!\pAs its reward, please give it this\nEFFORT RIBBON.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_GoForItLittleHarder: You have to go for it a little harder.\pIf you do, I'll give your POKéMON\nsomething nice.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_EffortRibbonLooksGood: Oh! Your {STR_VAR_1}, that EFFORT\nRIBBON looks good on it!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_WonderIfLighthouseSta: The light of the lighthouse reaches\ndozens of miles away.\pI wonder if it doesn't startle POKéMON\nin the sea.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_SeaweedFullOfLife: Ooh, look at this!\pThe seaweed you can get around these\nparts is fresh and full of life.\pWhy, it looks like it can even rear up\nand attack!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_HowTownIsBornAndGrows: Where the water is clean, the fruits\nof bountiful harvest gather.\pAnd where people gather, a market\nsoon starts.\pThat is how a town is born and grows.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_SlateportWonderfulPla: Shopping where you can breathe the\nscent of the ocean…\pSLATEPORT is such a wonderful place!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_BuyBricksSoDecorWontG: If you put DOLLS or CUSHIONS on\nthe floor, they'll get dirty.\pI'm going to buy some BRICKS so my\nDOLLS and CUSHIONS won't get dirty\lwhen I leave them out.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_GoingToCompeteInBattl: Wroooar! I'm going to compete in\nthe BATTLE TENT, too!\pBut before that, I need to catch\nsome POKéMON!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_BushedHikingFromMauvi: Whew… I'm just bushed…\pI hiked over from MAUVILLE CITY.\nBut, boy, this city's huge.\pIf I'd known this, I would've ridden\nmy BIKE here.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_EveryoneCallsHimCaptS: STERN, the fellow who built the\nMUSEUM, also happens to be the leader\lof an undersea exploration team.\pSo, everyone calls him CAPT. STERN.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_WhatsLongLineOverTher: What is that over there?\nThat long line…$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_VisitedMuseumOften: When I was a child, I visited\nthe MUSEUM often.\pI used to dream about the mysteries of\nthe sea after seeing the exhibits.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_QuitPushing: Hey, there! Quit pushing!\nThis is the line, can't you see?$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_AquaHasPolicy: TEAM AQUA has a policy of\nassembling and dispersing at\lthe operation site.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_BossIsBrilliant: Our BOSS is brilliant.\pWhat would he want to do with\na MUSEUM now?$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_WhatsNewSchemeIWonder: What's the new scheme, I wonder?\pOur BOSS is scary when he's mad, so\nI'd better not screw things up…$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_ShouldTakeItAll: If there's something we need in\nthe MUSEUM, we should take it all!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_RemindsMeOfLongLineFo: A long line, huh?\pIt reminds me of the times I lined up to\nbuy smash-hit games…$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_WhyAreWeLiningUp: Why are we even lining up and paying?\nWe should just march in!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_IllReadSignForYou: You want to read this sign?\nI'll read it for you!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_SaysSomethingLikeSeaI: Let's see…\pUm… I think it says something like\n“the life in the sea is endless.”\pYup, I'm pretty sure that's what\nit says.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_ShouldveBroughtMyGame: Grumble…\pI should've brought my Game Boy\nAdvance so I wouldn't get bored in line…\pGrumble…$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_HotSpringsAfterOperat: When this operation's over, I'll take\nyou to a hot spring spa!\pThat's what our leader said.\nI can't wait!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_SeaIsSoWet: The sea is just so vast…\pCould the sea have been made by\nthe tears shed by POKéMON?$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_SinkOldBoats: Do you know what they do with old\nships that become too creaky to sail?\pThey sink them in the sea so they\nbecome habitats for POKéMON.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_BuyTooMuch: Whenever I visit here, I get carried\naway and buy too much.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_GetNameRaterToHelpYou: If you want to change your POKéMON's\nnickname, you'll have to get the NAME\lRATER to help you.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_CantChangeTradeMonNam: Any POKéMON you get in a trade,\nyou can't change its nickname.\pThe original TRAINER's love for that\nPOKéMON is in the nickname.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentBuiltRecent:
Recently, a BATTLE TENT was built
in SLATEPORT.\pGYMS are fun, but the BATTLE TENT's
awesome in its own way.\pYou should go find tough POKéMON
for the BATTLE TENT!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_CaptSternBeingIntervi: I was hoping that it was a famous star\nso I could get an autograph.\pBut who's that being interviewed?\nIsn't that CAPT. STERN?$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_InterviewerSoCool: That lady interviewer is so cool\nand pretty.\pWhen I grow up, I'm going to be\nan international journalist!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_SternSaysDiscoveredSo: CAPT. STERN says they discovered\nsomething at the bottom of the sea.\pI wonder what it is?\nWhat could it be?$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_CaptainComeBackWithBi: What's going on here?\pDid the good CAPTAIN come back with\na big fish from the ocean floor?$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_AmIOnTV: Hey! Are you watching?\nAm I on TV?$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_CaptainsACelebrity: A TV interview! Here!\nThe CAPTAIN's a celebrity!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_BigSmileForCamera: TY: Okay, CAPT. STERN, a big smile\nfor the camera!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_MostInvaluableExperie: GABBY: I see, I see. You've had a most\ninvaluable experience…$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_SternMoveAheadWithExp: CAPT. STERN: Yes, indeed. We intend to\nmove ahead with our exploration.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_GabbyWonderfulThanksF: GABBY: That's wonderful, CAPT. STERN!\nThank you for taking the time from\lyour busy schedule to talk to us.\pWe hope we can interview you again\nwith news of more discoveries!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_SternWhewFirstIntervi: CAPT. STERN: Whew…\pThat was my first time to be filmed for\nTV. That was nerve-wracking.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_OhPlayerWeMadeDiscove:
Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You're looking great!\pWe made a huge discovery on our last
seafloor exploration.\pWe found an underwater cavern on
ROUTE 128.\pWe think it's the habitat of a POKéMON
that's said to have been long extinct.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_AquaWillAssumeControl:
Fufufu…
CAPT. STERN, I presume.\pWe of TEAM AQUA will assume
control of your submarine!\pYour objections are meaningless!
We expect your total cooperation!\pFufufu…
Just watch and learn what TEAM\lAQUA has planned!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_SternWhatWasAllThat: CAPT. STERN: What was that all about?\pIt sounded like someone using\na megaphone…\pWhere did it come from?$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_FromHarborTryingToTak: It's from the HARBOR!\pThe submarine!\nThey're trying to take it!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentSign: BATTLE TENT SLATEPORT SITE\n“Find it! The ultimate POKéMON!”$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardWantedS: STERN'S SHIPYARD\p“Wanted: A sailor capable of sailing\nin all currents.”$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardNearsCo: STERN'S SHIPYARD\p“The ferry S.S. TIDAL nears\ncompletion for serving the ports of\lSLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.”$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardFerryCo: STERN'S SHIPYARD\p“Boarding of the SLATEPORT-LILYCOVE\nferry S.S. TIDAL is handled at the\lHARBOR.”$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign: POKéMON FAN CLUB\n“Calling all fans of POKéMON!”$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_CitySign: SLATEPORT CITY\p“The port where people and POKéMON\ncross paths.”$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_MarketSign: SLATEPORT MARKET\n“Unique items found nowhere else!”$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_HarborFerryUnderConst: SLATEPORT HARBOR\p“The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under\nconstruction in the SHIPYARD.\p“Service is scheduled to begin\nshortly.”$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_HarborSign: SLATEPORT HARBOR\p“Enjoy a delightful cruise on\nthe ferry S.S. TIDAL.”$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries:
If a wild POKéMON gets hurt, it heals
itself by chewing on BERRIES.\pDid you know that?\pSomebody saw that and got the idea
of making medicine from BERRIES.\pDid you know that?\pTo turn BERRIES into medicine,
they must be crushed into powder.\pDid you know that?\pYou seem to have an interest
in BERRIES!\pI've got something good for someone
like you.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerryPowder:
I recently had machines installed at
POKéMON CENTERS for crushing BERRIES.\pThe BERRY CRUSH machines are at
the DIRECT CORNER upstairs.\pDid you know?\pCould you make BERRY POWDER for
me using those machines?\pI can make you all sorts of medicine
if you bring me lots of BERRY POWDER.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_BroughtMeSomeBerryPow: Have you brought me some\nBERRY POWDER?$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeWhatWithIt: What would you like to exchange\nit with?$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeBerryPowderFo: Okay, you want to exchange your\nBERRY POWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_DontHaveEnoughBerryPo: Oh, dear. You don't have enough\nBERRY POWDER.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_FineBerryPowderTradeS: This is fine BERRY POWDER.\nIt will make excellent medicine.\pWould you like to trade more of your\nBERRY POWDER for something else?$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_WhenYouGetMoreBringIt: Okay! When you get some more\nBERRY POWDER, bring it to me, please!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_ComeBackToTradeBerryP: Come back if you'd like to trade your\nBERRY POWDER for some medicine.\pI'm always running a bazaar here.\pDid you know?$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_YouDroveTeamAquaAway:
SCOTT: Huh?
I'm sure I met you somewhere before.\pHave I introduced myself to you?
If not, my name's SCOTT.\pI just saw TEAM AQUA run away from
here like they were stung.\pLet me guess--you drove them away?$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_MaybeThisTrainer: SCOTT: Hmm…\nMaybe, just maybe, this TRAINER…$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_LetsRegisterEachOther: SCOTT: All right! I think you're going\nto become a good friend.\pSo, let's register each other in our\nPOKéNAVS.\p… … … … … …$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_RegisteredScott: Registered this SCOTT person\nin the POKéNAV.$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_KeepEyeOnTrainersBeSe: SCOTT: What I'd like to do is tag along\nwith you, but I do want to keep an eye\lon the talents of other people, too.\pSo, I'll be off to roam other towns\na bit more.\pBe seeing you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$
data/maps/SlateportCity/scripts.inc.SlateportCity_Text_TakingBattleTentChall:
SCOTT: Oh, hey!
If it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, let me guess--you're going
to take the BATTLE TENT challenge?\pYeah! That's a good idea!
That's a really great idea!\pAfter all, a tough TRAINER is
the perfect fit for the BATTLE TENT!\pGive it your best effort!$

data/maps/SlateportCity_BattleTentCorrid.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceFor:
Want a tasty little bit of advice
for CONTESTS?\pUsing a certain move after another
certain kind of move sometimes gets\lyou extra attention.\pIf you know what you're doing,

data/maps/SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Ocea:
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 1
Why is seawater blue?\p“Light is composed of many colors.\p“When light passes through water,
most kinds of light lose color.\p“However, blue light retains its
color, making the sea appear blue.”$

“OCEANIC MINIFACT 2
Why is the sea salty?\p“Seawater contains dissolved salt in
the form of sodium and chlorine ions.\p“These ions leech out of rocks
and are carried out to sea by rain.\p“The concentration of dissolved salt
makes the sea salty.”$

“OCEANIC MINIFACT 3
Which is bigger? The sea or land?\p“The sea covers about 70% of
the planet, and the rest is land.\p“The sea is therefore more than twice
the size of land.”$
data/maps/SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Foss:
It's a fossil with wavy ridges on it.\p“Soil on the ocean floor gets scoured
by the tide.\p“The flowing seawater marks the soil
with small ridges and valleys.\p“If this soil becomes fossilized, it is
called a ripple mark.”$
data/maps/SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Dept: A strange machine is rotating under\na glass dome.\pMaybe it's for measuring the depth\nof something…$

Yes? If you're looking for STERN,
that would be me.\pAh! Those must be the parts I ordered
from MR. STONE of DEVON.\pThank you! That's great!
We can prepare for our expedition now.$
data/maps/SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Well: Hehehe, hold it!\nWe'll take those parts!$

data/maps/SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Boss: Oh, man, what a disaster…\nThe BOSS is going to be furious…$
data/maps/SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_LetM: Humph, sniveling wimp!\nLet me take care of this!$
data/maps/SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Medd: Now what? If we don't get the parts,\nwe're in for it!\pArrgh, I didn't count on being meddled\nwith by some meddling kid!$
data/maps/SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Came: I came to see what was taking so\nlong to snatch some parts, and you\lsimps are held up by a mere child?$
data/maps/SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Arch:
We are TEAM AQUA,
and we love the sea!\pAnd I am TEAM AQUA's leader,
ARCHIE!\pWhat makes you interfere with us?\p…No! You can't be!
You're not one of TEAM MAGMA?\pWait, that can't be right.
You're not dressed for the part.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pPOKéMON, people… All life depends on
the sea.\pSo, TEAM AQUA is dedicated to
the expansion of the sea.\pDon't you agree? What we are doing
is a magnificent undertaking.\pAh, fine…
You're still too young to understand\lour noble objective.\pBut, I warn you, don't even consider
interfering with our plans again.\pThe consequences will cost you
dearly!\pAnd don't you forget it!$
data/maps/SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Ster:

Thank you for saving us!\pOh, yes, I almost forgot that you
even brought the parts from DEVON!$

CAPT. STERN: Whoops!

to go!\pFeel free to wander around and check
