data/maps/SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSTi: “THE FERRY S.S. TIDAL\p“A scale replica of the ship under\nconstruction at STERN'S SHIPYARD.”$
data/maps/SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Subm: “SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1\p“A replica of the high-performance\nocean floor exploration submarine.”$
data/maps/SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Sumb: “SUBMERSIBLE POD\p“A replica of a compact, unmanned\npod for seafloor exploration.”$
data/maps/SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSAn: “S.S. ANNE\p“A replica of the luxury liner that\ncircles the globe.”$

data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F.SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Rais:
Want a tip for battling?\pI'd say it's raising different kinds
of POKéMON in a balanced manner.\pIt's no good to make just one
POKéMON strong.\pIf it has a type disadvantage,
it might not stand a chance.$
data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F.SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trad: I trade POKéMON with my friends.\pIf a traded POKéMON is holding an\nitem, it makes me twice as happy!$

data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub/s.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetCh:
Er-hem! I am the CHAIRMAN of the
POKéMON FAN CLUB!\pBeing the CHAIRMAN, I am naturally
the most important!\pNo one can best me when it comes
to raising POKéMON. No one!\pWell, let me tell you about
POKéMON CONTESTS.\pThey're events where one can show off
POKéMON for the world to see!\pHowever, they're held in far-off towns,
so I cannot participate often enough.\pThat is why we gather here to show
off our POKéMON, and have others\lshow us theirs.$
data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub/s.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_LikeTo: The POKéMON of a TRAINER who has\nentered a POKéMON CONTEST…\lThat, I would like to see.$
data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub/s.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowM:
Er-hem! I see you've participated in
a POKéMON CONTEST!\pPlease! Allow me to examine how you
have raised your POKéMON.\pIt delights me no end to see POKéMON
raised by other TRAINERS.\pThe happy expressions of POKéMON
raised with proper care…\pThe kindly eyes of the TRAINER that
nurtured and raised the POKéMON…\pThe very thought fills my heart to
overwhelming with joy.\pOh! I do beg your pardon!
Forgive me for prattling on so!\pPlease! Allow me to examine how much
your POKéMON has grown!$
data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub/s.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HowIsY: How is your POKéMON growing?\nAllow me to examine it.$
data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub/s.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_GiveMo:
Hmmm… It's not bad, but it's not
good, either…\pYou, the TRAINER, must put more
effort into raising this POKéMON!\pFor instance, may I suggest that
you give it more ポロックS?$
data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub/s.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NoSpac: Oh, my…\pYour POKéMON is growing quite well,\nso you deserve a reward.\pUnfortunately, you have no space for\nthis in your BAG.$
data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub/s.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonMos: Your {STR_VAR_1}, it is growing in\na most impressive manner!\lIt is one fine specimen!\pBut! If you were to give it this,\nit would grow even better! Indeed!$
data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub/s.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Explai: Let a POKéMON hold that RED SCARF.\pEveryone will recognize the coolness\nof that POKéMON!$
Let a POKéMON hold that BLUE SCARF.\pIts beauty will be accentuated much\nmore than now!$
Let a POKéMON hold that PINK SCARF.\pIt will draw out the cuteness of\nthe POKéMON some more!$
Let a POKéMON hold that GREEN SCARF.\pThat will enhance the\nsmartness of POKéMON!$
Let a POKéMON hold that YELLOW SCARF.\pIt will bolster your POKéMON's\ntoughness so much more!$
data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub/s.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Nothin: I'm sorry, but I've nothing else to\ngive you! None at all!\pAfter all, you're blessed with the gift\nof raising POKéMON without resorting\lto any items!$
data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub/s.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ShowMe:
I love seeing POKéMON that love
their TRAINERS.\pPOKéMON are very sensitive to
the feelings of their TRAINERS.\pIf you treat your POKéMON with love
and care, they'll love you back.\pWhen your POKéMON grow to love you,
please come show me.$
data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub/s.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Pokemo: Your POKéMON really adores you.\pFor you, a most compassionate\nTRAINER, a gift from the FAN CLUB!$
data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub/s.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_TreatP: POKéMON are very sensitive to\nthe feelings of their TRAINERS.\pIf you treat your POKéMON with love\nand care, they'll love you back.$
data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub/s.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Pokemo:
If you keep letting a POKéMON faint
in battle, it'll come to resent it.\pSoon, it will become less trusting
of the TRAINER.\pIn other words, it certainly won't
like you very much.$
data/maps/SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub/s.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonEnj: Do POKéMON enjoy having items used\non them?\pMine acted really happy when I gave\nit some PROTEIN.$

data/maps/SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Can:
Umm… If this goes here, and that
goes over there…\pThen where does this thing go?
And what about that doohickey?\pAaargh! I can't make heads or tails
of this!$
data/maps/SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Mee:
Hm?
Hi, I'm DOCK.\pCAPT. STERN commissioned me to
design a ferry.\pOh! That there…
Are they DEVON GOODS?\pBut, hmm…
This won't do…\pCAPT. STERN went off somewhere.
He said he had some work to do.\pCould I get you to go find CAPT.
STERN and deliver that to him?$
data/maps/SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Cou: DOCK: Where could CAPT. STERN have\ngone off to?\pCould you go find CAPT. STERN and\ndeliver that parcel to him?$
DOCK: Shipbuilding is an art.\pA lot of things can't be figured out\njust by calculating.\pI really could use advice from a veteran\nwho knows the seas…$
data/maps/SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Bri: DOCK: Hi! MR. BRINEY's joined us to\nlend us his help.\pThanks to the veteran sailor, the\nferry is steadily coming together.$
data/maps/SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Fer:
DOCK: The ferry is finally ready!\pThe new S.S. TIDAL is truly a marvel
of technology!\pBut, I get the feeling that we can
make something even better.\pYou know, there's never an end to
technology's march.$
data/maps/SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Dec:
MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
It's been too long!\pAye, since I met you, this old sea dog's
been feeling frisky!\pSo I've decided to help DOCK make
a ferry.\pAye, after all, a ferry would be able
to carry a lot of people.\pBut, you know, that DOCK is really
something special.\pWith his knack for technology and
my experience, I'm sure that we can\lbuild one great ship, aye!$
data/maps/SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Sea:
The seasons, the weather, where
the moon sits in the sky…\pThese and other conditions make
the sea change its expression.\pThat's right!
The sea is like a living thing!$
data/maps/SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Get: I get seasick real easily.\nSo I get to help out here instead.$

data/maps/SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_Shi: Designing a large ship is more like\nmaking a big building than putting\ltogether a transportation vehicle.$
data/maps/SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_Flo: Don't you think it's strange that\na ship made of heavy iron floats?\pIt floats because of a principle\ncalled buoyancy.$

data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_KurtIntro:
KURT: Hey there, {PLAYER}!\pThe guard up top took off when
I shouted at him.\pBut then I took a tumble down
the WELL.\pI slammed down hard on my back,
so I can't move.\pRats! If I were fit, my POKéMON
would've punished them…\pAh, it can't be helped.\p{PLAYER}, show them how gutsy
you are in my place!$
data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_KurtAfter: KURT: Way to go, {PLAYER}!\pTEAM ROCKET has taken off.\pMy back's better too.\nLet's get out of here.$
data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM29Seen:
Darn! I was standing guard up
top when some old coot yelled\lat me.\pHe startled me so much that
I fell down here.\pI think I'll vent my anger by
taking it out on you!$
data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM29Beaten: Arrgh! This is NOT my day!$
data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM29After: Sure, we've been hacking the\ntails off SLOWPOKE and selling\lthem.\pEverything we do is for profit.\pThat's right! We're TEAM ROCKET,\nand we'll do anything for money!$
data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_ProtonSeen: What do you want?\pIf you interrupt our work,\ndon't expect any mercy!$
data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_ProtonBeaten: You did OK today,\nbut wait till next time!$
data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_ProtonAfter:
Yeah, TEAM ROCKET was broken up
three years ago.\pThe boss went into hiding.\pBut we continued our activities
underground!\pA small obstacle like you won't be
much of a problem for our mission.\pI advise you to be very afraid of
what is to come!$
data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM2Seen: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!\nQuit taking SLOWPOKETAILS?\pYou're nuts!\nIf we obeyed you, TEAM ROCKET's\lrep would be ruined!$
data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM2After: We need the money,\nbut selling SLOWPOKETAILS?\pIt's tough being a ROCKET GRUNT!$
data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntF1Seen: Stop taking TAILS?\pYeah, just try to defeat all\nof us!$
data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntF1After: SLOWPOKETAILS grow back fast!\pWhat's wrong with selling them?$
data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_SlowpokeWithMail: A SLOWPOKE with its TAIL cut off…\pHuh? It has MAIL.\nRead it?$
data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_SlowpokeMail: {PLAYER} read the MAIL.\pBe good and look after the\nhouse with Grandpa and SLOWPOKE.\pLove, Dad$
data/maps/SlowpokeWell_B1F_hns/scripts.i.SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_TaillessSlowpoke: A SLOWPOKE with its TAIL cut off…$

data/maps/SnowsweptCavern_hns/scripts.in.Snowswept_Text_Machamp_Plate: The MACHAMP seems to be holding\na PLATE in one of its hands.\pBattle it?$

data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_GymSign: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: JUAN\p“The GYM LEADER with the beauty\nof pure water!”$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_CitySign: SOOTOPOLIS CITY\p“The mystical city where history\nslumbers.”$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_PhysicallyFitLivingH: Diving in the sea. Climbing up and\ndown stairs all the time…\pIf you live in this town, you end up\ngetting physically fit.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenly:
These giant POKéMON suddenly appeared
in the middle of the city!\pAnd, I've never seen them before!\pWhy are they smashing into each
other like that?\pWhy can't they be friends, those
POKéMON?$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_WhatIsThatGreenPokem: What? What? What?\nWhat is that green POKéMON?!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_WhereDidLegendariesG: GROUDON and KYOGRE…\nWhere did they go?\pWill they cause droughts or downpours\nsomewhere else?$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_TwoPokemonArentAngry: I just get this sense somehow that\nthe two POKéMON aren't angry.\pI think… They probably can't control\ntheir own power…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_FlyingMonStoppedRamp: That flying POKéMON came down from\nthe sky and stopped the rampaging\lPOKéMON…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_WonderWhatWorldIsLik: I… I've never been out of this city.\pI wonder what the world is like on\nthe other side of this round sky?$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_GoRedAndBlueMon: Go for it, red POKéMON!\nDon't back off, blue POKéMON!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_DoYouKnowMonNames: … … … … … …\pHi, do you know the names of those\nPOKéMON fighting over there?$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_GreenOneSettlesThing: I was wondering which one would win,\nthe red one or the blue one, but, oh no,\lit's the green one that settles things!\pTalk about a huge turn of events!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnE:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by\la colossal battle between POKéMON.\pWell, I'm seeing that happen with
my very own eyes!\pWhoa! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by\la colossal battle between POKéMON.\pWell, I saw that happen with
my very own eyes!\pWhoa! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_BigPokemonFighting: A big POKéMON is fighting with\nanother big POKéMON!\pPlease, someone make them stop!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_PrettyMonCameFromSky: A pretty POKéMON came down from\nthe sky…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisWillBeWrec: Oh, no!\nSOOTOPOLIS CITY will get wrecked!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_NoOrdinaryTourist: Hm!\nYou've come all the way to SOOTOPOLIS?\lYou're no ordinary tourist.\pBut I suppose that doesn't make you\nan extraordinary tourist, either.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_CityRegainedCalm: The city has regained its calm…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLe: Who might you be?\pThis is the CAVE OF ORIGIN.\pThe spirits of POKéMON, becalmed at\nMT. PYRE, are said to be revived here.\pPlease leave.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerT:
A person with a strong will and
superior talent…\pA TRAINER who has knowledge and
experience of many kinds of POKéMON…\pIf such a person were to appear, I was
instructed by WALLACE to lead that\lTRAINER to this CAVE.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_AwakenedPokemonClash: Oh, my…\pThe clash between the two awakened\nPOKéMON was quelled by the awakening\lof a third POKéMON…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginSleepsTo: This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN…\pWith the passing of the crisis,\nthe cave, too, shall sleep…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautif:
SOOTOPOLIS sprang up as a town in
the crater of a volcano.\pIf you look up at the sky, the lip of
the crater is also visible.\lSo, all you see is the sky in a circle.\pBut that's what makes the sky above
SOOTOPOLIS the most beautiful.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_GiganticPokemonFight: When two POKéMON that gigantic\nare fighting that savagely, there's\lnot much that we can do.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_FearedWorstWhenPokem: When that third POKéMON flew down,\nI feared the worst.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_NightSkyFavoriteScen: A circle of a night sky framed by\nthe crater of a volcano…\pAnd in that ring, stars flicker and\nblink as if they were alive…\lIt's my favorite scenery.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild:
The weather was clear this morning,
but…\pAll of a sudden, dark clouds brewed up,
rain started falling in sheets, and\lthere was thunder and lightning, too.\pThe weather just went completely
wild!\pIs all of this because of those
POKéMON?$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_YouBroughtFlyingMon: Oh?\pIt was you who brought that flying\nPOKéMON here?\pWell, aren't you amazing!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop: MAXIE: G… GROUDON…\nPlease! Stop what you're doing!\pI know the extent of your power now!\pIf you keep going, all HOENN, not just\nSOOTOPOLIS, will be utterly ruined!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming:
MAXIE: So the super-ancient POKéMON
weren't only GROUDON and KYOGRE…\pAfter all our fruitless scheming and
frantic efforts, that one POKéMON's\lsimple action puts everything right\lagain as if nothing had happened…\pFu…
Fuhahaha…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_KyogreCalmDown:
ARCHIE: KYOGRE! What's wrong?!
Look over here! It's the RED ORB!\lCalm down! KYOGRE!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pIt's no good!
It's not responding at all!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToP:
ARCHIE: KYOGRE and GROUDON both
flew off to who knows where.\pThe weather in HOENN has returned
to its normal state…\pHaha…
Hahaha…\pMaybe what we were trying to do was
something small, even meaningless,\lto POKéMON…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisCo:
STEVEN: Those POKéMON fighting…
GROUDON… And KYOGRE…\pThe two super-ancient POKéMON
were awakened from a long sleep…\pAnd now they are smashing each other
with their uncontrollable energy…\p…{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pYou being here now I'll take to mean
that you're prepared to become\linvolved in this crisis.\pWell, then, there's someone that
I'd like you to meet.\pCome with me, please.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFear:
STEVEN: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pDoes seeing GROUDON and KYOGRE make
you think POKéMON are to be feared?\pBut that's not true.
POKéMON are really more…\p…Why am I asking you this?
You already know.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWalla: STEVEN: Okay, here we are!\pInside here you'll find someone named\nWALLACE.\pI think you have what's needed to\nhelp him…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_KnowWhatsNeededToHel: STEVEN: I think you have what's\nneeded to help him…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_NeverBeenToSkyPillar: STEVEN: The SKY PILLAR…\pI've never been there.\nI wonder where it could be?$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza: STEVEN: So that's RAYQUAZA…\pIt's incredible how the two rampaging\nPOKéMON would flee from it in fear…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_MaxieArchieLeft: STEVEN: It looks like both MAXIE and\nARCHIE have gone away somewhere.\pPerhaps they've gone to MT. PYRE to\nreturn those ORBS…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPi:
WALLACE: Oh?
{PLAYER}{KUN}?\pHaven't you scaled the SKY PILLAR
yet?\pI'm sure that you can make it to
the top of the SKY PILLAR…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHa: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pThe leaders of TEAM MAGMA and AQUA,\nI don't think they meant harm.\pIt wouldn't hurt to hear what they\nhave to say for themselves.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAccep:
WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
My eyes didn't deceive me.\pThanks to your help, SOOTOPOLIS…
No, all of HOENN was saved.\pOn behalf of the people, I thank you.\pThis is a gift from me.
Please accept it.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoTo:
That HIDDEN MACHINE contains
WATERFALL.\pIf you have the RAIN BADGE, a POKéMON
that has learned that HM move can\lforce its way up waterfalls.\pAnd where does one get the RAIN BADGE?
You know, don't you?\pThat's right! You have to beat
the SOOTOPOLIS GYM LEADER.\pWhen you're all set to go, step through
that door.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity/scripts.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_DazzledByMentor: WALLACE: I'm sure that you will be\ndazzled by my mentor's breathtakingly\lelegant battle style.$

data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_1F/scripts..SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvic:
Yo! How's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pSOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER JUAN is
a master of WATER-type POKéMON.\pAnd, to get to JUAN, an icy floor
will hamper your progress…\pListen, I'm sorry, but that's all the
advice that I have for you.\pThe rest of the way, you have to
go for it yourself!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_1F/scripts..SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostV: Yow! You've beaten even JUAN, who\nwas supposedly the best in all HOENN!\pOkay! Check out your TRAINER CARD.\pIf you've gotten all the BADGES, you're\nset for the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_1F/scripts..SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro:
Let me ask you.
Did you know?\lAh, I should not be so coy.\pIt was I who taught WALLACE everything
there is to know about POKéMON.\pOnce, I had given up my position as
the GYM LEADER.\pIn my place, I had entrusted WALLACE
with the GYM.\pHowever, a compelling reason arose for
me to make a comeback.\pAh, but enough chatter.
Let us begin our match, shall we?\pPlease, you shall bear witness to
our artistry.\pA grand illusion of water sculpted
by POKéMON and myself!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_1F/scripts..SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat:
Ahahaha, excellent!
Very well, you are the winner.\pFrom you, I sense the brilliant shine
of skill that will overcome all.\pHowever, compared with me or even
WALLACE, you are lacking in elegance.\pPerhaps I should make you a loan
of my outfit?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pHahaha, I merely jest!\pRather than my clothes, I shall reward
you with this, the RAIN BADGE!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_1F/scripts..SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBa:
Having the RAIN BADGE shall assure you
the full obedience of all your POKéMON\lto your every command.\pThe RAIN BADGE also allows the use
of the HM move WATERFALL to scale\lwalls of cascading water.\pAnd, so that you never forget the
battle we shared, take this…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_1F/scripts..SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainWaterP: The TECHNICAL MACHINE I handed you\ncontains WATER PULSE.\pIn use, it will occasionally confuse\nthe target with ultrasonic waves.\p… … … … … …$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_1F/scripts..SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredJua: Registered GYM LEADER JUAN\nin the POKéNAV.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_1F/scripts..SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattl:
The TRAINERS who have gathered all
the GYM BADGES of HOENN should make\lway to the ultimate destination.\pThe POKéMON LEAGUE.\pTravel to the easternmost reaches
of HOENN, to the island EVER GRANDE.\pThere, you shall find the POKéMON
LEAGUE.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_1F/scripts..SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GoGetFortreeB: There remains but one BADGE to\nobtain in HOENN.\pIf you wish to challenge the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must obtain the last\lBADGE from the GYM in FORTREE.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_1F/scripts..SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCert: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM\pJUAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_1F/scripts..SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematc:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…\pBut our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!\pWell, my friend, most certainly!\pI shall be delighted to dance with you
as often as you wish!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_1F/scripts..SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchDe: Ahahaha, you are the winner!\nYou have defeated me again!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_1F/scripts..SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRemat:
JUAN: If I told you to become my
apprentice, you will refuse, I am sure.\pI would like to make a gift of my coat
to you.\pBut again, you will refuse.
I imagine that to be so.\pAnd that, my friend, is a certain sign
of nobility!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_1F/scripts..SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNe:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…\pBut our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!\pWell, my friend, most certainly!
I shall be delighted to dance with you…\pAh, no, no, no.
You have with you but one POKéMON.\pI wish that you would return with
two, perhaps more, POKéMON, please.$

data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaIntro: I'll show you the sublime techniques\nI learned from our LEADER JUAN!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaPostBa: Watch what happens if you crack all\nthe floor tiles.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro: You came all the way here, but you won't\nget to see JUAN.\pNot if you lose to me, you won't!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyDefeat: You're strong!\nI was fooled by your cute looks!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyPostBa: You might be good enough to avoid\nbeing wiped out in one hit by JUAN.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro: The sight of JUAN conducting\na battle…\pThe very beauty of it compelled me to\nbecome a TRAINER.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneDefeat: You battled with more beauty than\nI could muster…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBa: The grace you bring to battle is\nfabulous.\pOh… I'm so fortunate to have found\nPOKéMON.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieIntro: I should teach you how harsh battles\ncan be.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBa: I'll tell you something good.\pIf you want to reach JUAN, you\nneed to walk on each floor tile once.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro: The POKéMON GYM of the highest level\nin the HOENN region…\pThat's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetDefea: What a high level you are!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetPostB: Rather than being satisfied by being\nin a strong GYM, I imagine training in\lother places will make you stronger.\lBut above all, it looks more fun.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro: I train my POKéMON together with\nJUAN.\pDon't think I'm a pushover.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaPostBa: I think you have potential.\nWhy don't you stay and train with us?$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro: A graceful glide across the ice while\ncrossing no lines…\pA TRAINER putting on that performance\nwould be elegantly beautiful!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyPostB: This is really obvious, but how strong\nyou are as a TRAINER has nothing to do\lwith how young or old you are.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyIntro: When I'm with my POKéMON, the time\nflies by before you can say, “Oops!”$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyPostB: I wish I could forget about lost causes\nbefore I can manage an “Oops!”$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaIntro: I can battle with really rare POKéMON\nif you'd like.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaDefeat: Oh, there now! Did you have a good look\nat my POKéMON?$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBa: I came to this GYM because JUAN\npraised me for my darling POKéMON.\pOh, if only I'd met JUAN years ago\nwhen I was younger…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaIntro: Giggle…\nYour grim look is so charming.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaDefea: Oh, dear.\nI went much too easy on you.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F/scripts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaPostB: You couldn't lay a finger on JUAN,\nI'm sure. Giggle…$

data/maps/SootopolisCity_House1/scripts..SootopolisCity_House1_Text_DevelopedThis: For thirty years I've remained in\nSOOTOPOLIS honing my skills.\pI developed a shattering TM.\nI bequeath it to you!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_House1/scripts..SootopolisCity_House1_Text_ExplainBrickB: TM31 contains BRICK BREAK! It's a move\nso horrible that I can't describe it.$

data/maps/SootopolisCity_House2/scripts..SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAbo: MT. PYRE…\pAt its peak are two orbs placed side\nby side. Did you know?$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_House2/scripts..SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSid: Yes, two orbs side by side…\pThe sight of them together…\nIt is somehow soothing…$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_House2/scripts..SootopolisCity_House2_Text_OughtToVisitA: Is that so?\nPerhaps you ought to visit and see…$

data/maps/SootopolisCity_House3/scripts..SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFa: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?\pSOOTOPOLIS's JUAN has many fans.\nEven more than his student WALLACE!\pDo you have any?$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_House3/scripts..SootopolisCity_House3_Text_YouMustBePret: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_House3/scripts..SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWo: Oh, dear…\nThat's a little lonesome.\pTry working a little harder to get\na fan following.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_House3/scripts..SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClu: Dedicated fans come over from even\noutside of HOENN.\pIt was really wild when I went to the\nTRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.$

data/maps/SootopolisCity_House4/scripts..SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasu:
Listen up, and I'll tell you something
good.\pThere's supposed to be an ancient
ruin in the sea around here.\pThere could be treasures just waiting
to be discovered down there.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_House4/scripts..SootopolisCity_House4_Text_StrollUnderwa: Ancient treasures…\pIt would be nice if they existed, but\neven if they didn't, it would be so\lbeautiful to take an underwater\lstroll with my POKéMON.$

data/maps/SootopolisCity_House5/scripts..SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtP: There appears to be some connection\nbetween SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE.\pMy friends and I did some research on\nit at the lab where I used to work.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_House5/scripts..SootopolisCity_House5_Text_BrotherUsedTo: My big brother used to study the sea.$

data/maps/SootopolisCity_House6/scripts..SootopolisCity_House6_Text_FirstGuestInW: Hello! You're our first guest in\na good while.\pYou've brightened up my day, so I'll\ngive you a big WAILMER DOLL.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_House6/scripts..SootopolisCity_House6_Text_IllHoldItForY: Oh, you want it, but not right now?\nOkay, then I'll hold it for you.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_House6/scripts..SootopolisCity_House6_Text_DontWantThisD: Are you sure?\nYou don't want this DOLL?$

data/maps/SootopolisCity_House7/scripts..SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CityFromErupt:
An underwater volcano erupted and
forced itself up from the depths.\pIts crater emerged from the sea and
became filled with rainwater.\pThat's how SOOTOPOLIS CITY came into
being.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_House7/scripts..SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CaveMadeToKee: The cave that links SOOTOPOLIS and\nthe outside world…\pIt seems as if the cave was made to\nkeep something from getting out.\pOr am I just imagining things?$

data/maps/SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotH.SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_:
Do you know the POKéMON SEEDOT?
It's hardly ever seen in SOOTOPOLIS.\pAnyway, I love big SEEDOT.
The bigger the better.\pBut my younger brother, he says that
LOTAD is bigger.\pThat's silly.
SEEDOT has to be bigger than that!\pHuh? Do you have a SEEDOT with you?
P-p-please, show me!$

{STR_VAR_2}!
Oh, my gosh, this is a big one!\pIt might even beat the big LOTAD
my younger brother saw!\pThanks for showing me.
This is my thanks!$
{STR_VAR_2}, is it?\pHmm… I've seen a bigger SEEDOT\nthan this one.$
Oh, now this is quite something…\nBut it's not a SEEDOT!$
You don't have a big SEEDOT?\nThat's too bad…\pIf you get a big SEEDOT, please\ncome show me.$
The biggest SEEDOT in history!\n{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3} giant!\pA SEEDOT bigger than a LOTAD\nalways wanted!$

Do you know the POKéMON LOTAD?
It's rarely seen in SOOTOPOLIS.\pI love, I mean love, big LOTAD!\pMy big brother says that SEEDOT is
bigger.\pBut that's wrong! Everyone knows that
LOTAD is a lot bigger.\pHunh? Do you have a LOTAD?
P-p-please show me!$

{STR_VAR_2}!
Wow, that is big!\pIt might be even bigger than the huge
SEEDOT my big brother saw.\pThanks for showing me!
This is my thanks!$
{STR_VAR_2}?\pHmm… I've seen a bigger LOTAD\nthan this one here.$
Well, isn't this something!\nBut it's no LOTAD!$
Don't you have a big LOTAD?\nHow disappointing…\pIf you get a big LOTAD, please\ncome show me!$
The biggest LOTAD in history!\n{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3} colossus!\pA LOTAD bigger than a SEEDOT\nalways wanted!$

data/maps/SootopolisCity_Mart/scripts.in.SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat: PP UP is great!\pIt raises the POWER POINTS, the PP,\nof a POKéMON move.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Mart/scripts.in.SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside: What…\nWhat is happening?\pI really want to know, but it's too\nscary to go outside.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_Mart/scripts.in.SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItem: Do you know FULL RESTORE?\pFull restoration of HP!\nEradication of all status problems!\pIt's truly an item of your dreams!$

data/maps/SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHo.SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Tex: When I was young, I traveled the world\nas a POKéMON TRAINER.\pNow that I've become an old buzzard,\nmy only amusement is watching young\lTRAINERS battle.$
The door appears to be locked.$
A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1}\nis visiting my home.\pWould you like to challenge\n{STR_VAR_1}?$
You won't battle? I'm disappointed\nthat I can't see you battle…$
Oh, good, good!\pBut my house isn't all that sturdy.\pCould I ask you to keep it down to\na 3-on-3 match?$
Before you two battle, you should\nsave your progress.$
I hope to see a good match!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHo.SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_B1F_Te: The match ended up a draw.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHo.SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Tex: So, it became a standoff.\pIt was a brilliant match in which\nneither side conceded a step!$
That was superlative!\pWhy, it was like seeing myself in\nmy youth again!$
Ah, too bad for you!\pBut it was a good match.\nI hope you can win next time.$

data/maps/SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1.SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Wal:
WALLACE is rumored to be the toughest
TRAINER in the whole HOENN region.\pThis town's GYM is led by the TRAINER
who taught WALLACE.\pBut the ELITE FOUR… They're said to be
even stronger than WALLACE's mentor.\pHow strong could they be?$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1.SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Eve: Everyone in town has taken refuge\nand won't come out of their homes.\pEven I would rather not venture\noutside.$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1.SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Alw: Whenever, wherever, and whatever\nhappens, I will always be friends with\lPOKéMON.\pBecause it's fun to be with POKéMON!$
data/maps/SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1.SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Are: Aren't POKéMON our friends?\pWhy are they going wild this way?$

data/maps/SproutTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageChow_Seen: We stand guard in this tower.\pHere, we express our gratitude\nto honor all POKéMON.$
data/maps/SproutTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageChow_AfterBattle: All living beings coexist\nthrough cooperation.\pWe must always be thankful\nfor this.$
data/maps/SproutTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_1F_Sage1: Only if you reach the top will\nyou obtain an HM.$
data/maps/SproutTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_1F_Sage2: SPROUT TOWER was built long ago\nas a place for POKéMON training.$
data/maps/SproutTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_1F_Granny: A BELLSPROUT over 100 feet\ntall…\pPeople say that it became the\ncenter pillar here.$
data/maps/SproutTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_1F_Teacher: See the pillar shaking?\pPeople are training upstairs.$
data/maps/SproutTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_1F_Statue: A POKéMON statue…\pIt looks very distinguished.$

data/maps/SproutTower_2F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageNico_Seen: However hard we battle,\nthe TOWER will stand strong.$
data/maps/SproutTower_2F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageNico_Beaten: I fought hard but I'm too weak.$
data/maps/SproutTower_2F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageNico_AfterBattle: The flexible pillar protects the\nTOWER, even from earthquakes.$
data/maps/SproutTower_2F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageEdmond_AfterBattle: I tried to copy BELLSPROUT's\ngentle movements for battle…\pBut I didn't train well enough.$
data/maps/SproutTower_2F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_2F_Statue: A POKéMON statue…\pIt looks very distinguished.$

data/maps/SproutTower_3F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_ElderLecturesRival:
ELDER: You are indeed skilled
as a trainer.\pAs promised, here is your HM.\pBut let me say this: You should
treat your POKéMON better.\pThe way you battle is far too
harsh.\pPOKéMON are not tools of war…$
data/maps/SproutTower_3F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_RivalOnlyCaresStrong:
…
…Humph!\pHe claims to be the ELDER but
he's weak.\pIt stands to reason.\pI'd never lose to fools who babble
about being nice to POKéMON.\pI only care about strong
POKéMON that can win.\pI really couldn't care less
about weak POKéMON.$
data/maps/SproutTower_3F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageLi_Seen:
So good of you to come here!\pSPROUT TOWER is a place of
training.\pPeople and POKéMON test their
bonds to build a bright future\ltogether.\pI am the final test.\pAllow me to check the ties
between your POKéMON and you!$
data/maps/SproutTower_3F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageLi_TakeFlash: You and your POKéMON should\nhave no problem using this move.\pTake this FLASH HM.$
data/maps/SproutTower_3F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageLi_FlashExplain: FLASH illuminates even the\ndarkest of all places.\pBut to use it out of battle, you\nneed the BADGE from VIOLET's GYM.$
data/maps/SproutTower_3F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageLi_AfterBattle: I hope you learn and grow from\nyour journey.$
data/maps/SproutTower_3F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageJin_Seen: I train to find enlightenment\nin POKéMON!$
data/maps/SproutTower_3F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageJin_AfterBattle: As POKéMON grow stronger,\nso does the trainer.\pNo, wait. As the trainer\ngrows stronger, so do the\lPOKéMON.$
data/maps/SproutTower_3F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageTroy_Seen: Let me see how much you trust\nyour POKéMON.$
data/maps/SproutTower_3F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageTroy_AfterBattle: It is not far to the ELDER.$
data/maps/SproutTower_3F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageNeal_Seen: The ELDER's HM lights even\npitch-black darkness.$
data/maps/SproutTower_3F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageNeal_Beaten: It is my head that is bright!$
data/maps/SproutTower_3F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_SageNeal_AfterBattle: Let there be light on your\njourney.$
data/maps/SproutTower_3F_hns/scripts.inc.SproutTower_Text_3F_Painting: It's a powerful painting of a\nBELLSPROUT.$

data/maps/TinTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.TinTower_1F_Sage1_Text:
According to legend…
When the souls of POKéMON and humans\pcommune, from the heavens descends a
POKéMON of rainbow colors…\pCould it mean the legendary POKéMON
are testing us humans?$
data/maps/TinTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.TinTower_1F_Sage2_Text:
When the BRASS TOWER burned down,
three nameless POKéMON were said\lto have perished. It was tragic.\pHowever…\pA rainbow-colored POKéMON…
In other words…\pHO-OH descended from the sky and
gave new life to the three POKéMON.\pThey are…
SUICUNE, ENTEI and RAIKOU.\pThat is what they say.$
data/maps/TinTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.TinTower_1F_Sage3_Text: The two TOWERS are said to have been\nbuilt to foster friendship and\phope between POKéMON and people.\nThat was 700 years ago, but the ideal\pstill remains important today.$
data/maps/TinTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.TinTower_1F_Sage4_Text1: HO-OH appears to have descended\nupon this, the TIN TOWER!$
data/maps/TinTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.TinTower_1F_Sage4_Text2: The legendary POKéMON are said\nto embody three powers…\pThe lightning that struck the TOWER.\nThe fire that burned the TOWER.\pAnd the rain that put out the fire…$
data/maps/TinTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.TinTower_1F_Sage6_Text2:
Of the legendary POKéMON, SUICUNE
is said to be the closest to HO-OH.\pI hear there may also be a link to
POKéMON known as UNOWN.\pThe POKéMON UNOWN must be sharing a
cooperative bond with SUICUNE.$
data/maps/TinTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.TinTower_1F_EusineHoOh_Text:
I knew it.\pI knew you'd get to see the POKéMON
of rainbow colors, <PLAYER>.\pIt happened just as I envisioned.
My research isn't bad, I might say.\pI'm going to keep studying POKéMON
to become a famous POKéMANIAC!$
data/maps/TinTower_1F_hns/scripts.inc.TinTower_1F_EusineSuicune_Text:
EUSINE: Awesome! Too awesome, even!
I've never seen a battle that great.\pThat was truly inspiring to see.
SUICUNE was tough, but you were even\pmore incredible, <PLAYER>.
I heard SUICUNE's mystic power\psummons a rainbow-colored POKéMON.
Maybe, just maybe, what went on today\pwill cause that POKéMON to appear.
I'm going to study the legends more.\pThanks for showing me that fantastic
battle.\pLater, <PLAYER>!$

data/maps/TinTower_RoofDay_hns/scripts.i.TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kimono_AfterNotCau: You have not only made HO-OH\nappear, but you have also defeated\lit...\pThere is nothing more for us to\nsay. Take care of yourself in your\ljourney...$
data/maps/TinTower_RoofDay_hns/scripts.i.TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kimono_AfterCaught: You have not only made HO-OH\nappear, but you have also caught\lit...\pThere is nothing more for us to\nsay. Take care of yourself in your\ljourney...$
data/maps/TinTower_RoofDay_hns/scripts.i.TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kimono_Opening:
KIMONO GIRL: That's right.
This is where we welcome HO-OH.\pWhen the dance we practiced many
days becomes one with the sound of the\pCLEAR BELL we entrusted to you, then
HO-OH shall come down from the great\larch of the sky once again. $
data/maps/TinTower_RoofDay_hns/scripts.i.TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kimono_Closing1:
That is indeed HO-OH...
The guardian of the sky from\pancient times... \pSo many have tried again and again,
only to fail...\p{PLAYER}, your heart in complete
harmony with the CLEAR BELL has finally\pallowed it to appear...
{PLAYER}, don't you see?\pHO-OH... It must have been waiting for
someone like you all this time.\pWouldn't you agree? $
data/maps/TinTower_RoofDay_hns/scripts.i.TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kimono_After: You have done a great job.\nSay hello to PROF.ELM for us.$

GIOVANNI: ...\pI don't know why you have come
here.\pAnyway, I have to warn you that
this is not a place for kids like\lyou.\pYou have a certain look.
It reminds me of the kid who stood\lin front of me three years ago...\pYou have the same eyes...\p...\pI'm on my way to GOLDENROD CITY
to answer the call and join my team.\lAre you going to get in my way?$

GIOVANNI: How is this possible...?
The past three years have been a\lwaste...?\pHow can a kid like you manage to
destroy my dream once again?\pThe precious dream of TEAM ROCKET
has become little more than an\lillusion...$

data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_HopeYouGiveItY: I hope you give it your best.$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_MovedReception: When the TRAINERS switch places,\nthe movement can be hectic.\pTo avoid the stampede, we moved\nthe reception counter here.\pI'm sorry for the inconvenience.$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainer:
Here at the TRAINER HILL, we conduct
an event called the Time Attack.\pIt is a race that measures how long
you take to reach our owner on\lthe rooftop from this counter.\pThe fastest times are posted on
the Time Board--try competing with\lyour friends.\pIn TRAINER battles along the way,
neither Exp. Points nor money will\lbe awarded.$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_NeedAtLeastTwo: Oh, I'm sorry, but you appear to have\nonly one POKéMON with you.\pYou will need at least two POKéMON\nto enter this event.$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBrav:
Hm! Hm!\pYou finally came!
Yes, you have arrived!\pWait! Don't say it!
I know why you came all the way\lhere by yourself!\pYou wanted to see me, the owner
of the TRAINER HILL, because…\pYou want to form a tag team with me!
Wa-hoo!\p…Uh?
That's not it?\pAnyway, I watched you on your way up.
Marvelous battling! Bravo, indeed!$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Roof_Text_HaveTheMostMarvelo: For a marvelous someone like you,\nI have the most marvelous gift!$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Roof_Text_FullUpBeBackLaterF: Oh, no, full up with things!\nYou'll be back later for this!$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Roof_Text_GotHereMarvelously:
Oh, hold on here! Did you possibly get
here marvelously quickly?\pHow splendid! You needn't have
hurried so to see me!\pThat is so delightful. I'll have the Time
Board at the reception updated!$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouWerentVeryQuick: But, oh…\nYou weren't very quick getting here.$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Roof_Text_ArriveZippierNextT: Perhaps it would please me more if you\narrived zippier next time.\pThen, I should be pleased to form\na tag team with you!\pUntil we meet again, amigo!$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Roof_Text_BuiltTrainerHillTo: I had the TRAINER HILL built for but\none reason and one only!\pTo find the most suitable partner\nwith whom I may form a tag team!$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WhatSortOfTrai: Who knows what sort of TRAINERS\nand POKéMON combos are ahead?\pAll I know is that I'll knock aside\nanyone that stands in my way!$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_CantWaitToTest: I heard tough TRAINERS come to this\nTRAINER HILL from all over.\pI can't wait to test the waters!\pI'll knock aside anyone that stands\nin my way!$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_FriendsTryingT: Do you see the Time Board over there?\pMy friends and I are trying to see who\ncan reach the top in the least time.$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_DoYouKnowWhenT: Do you know when they're opening\nthis place up?\pI'm waiting here to be the first\nchallenger ever!$
data/maps/TrainerHill_Entrance/scripts.i.TrainerHill_Elevator_Text_ReturnToRecept: Would you like to return to\nthe reception counter?$

data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_MtLanikalaSign_Text_0: This mountain is affectionately\nreferred to as MT. LANIKALA by the\llocals, as it is the tallest mountain\lon the ALOLA ISLES.\pThe real name of this mountain has been\nlost to time.$
data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_Phant_outside_Text_0: Hello there, {PLAYER}!\pI'm the developer who built this\nsection of the game!\pI hope you enjoyed this taste of ALOLA.\pI'm working on a full demake of the\nregion called ULTRA ECLIPSE.$
data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_Phant_outside_Text_1: Please come visit me at my house at\nthe top of this isle.\lI'll make it worth your while!$
data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text: I thought I saw something red flying\nthrough the sky.\pCould it have been a POKéMON?$
data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattleYoungster_Text: Hey, I'm going to be the first to climb\nMT. LANIKALA!$
It's not even the real MT. LANIKALA…$
My dad never told me the real name of\nthis mountain.\pWe've always just called it MT. LANIKALA.$
data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_0: You must be tough to handle this\nrough terrain!$
data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_2: ULA'ULA ISLE has the best hiking!\pThe locals refer to this mountain as\nMT. LANIKALA, as it is the tallest on\lthe ALOLA ISLES!$
data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattleCooltrainer_Te: This cave smells terrible!\nLet's battle to get my mind off of it!$
You should plug your nose if you plan\non going in that cave.$
data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_LassNPC_Text_0: The sea by the ISLES is truly\nbreathtaking.\pI could sit here all day and just\nwatch the waves.$
data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_Bench_Heal_Text_0: Would you like to take a rest on this\nbench?$
data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_Text_MoveTutorIntro:
URGH!
AGH!\pYOU!\pDid the others send you here?
Did they tell you that I am the\lmaster of POKéMON moves?\p........................\pI can train your POKéMON in the
ways of the ISLES, but first, a\lsmall fee.\pThe price is 5 HEART SCALES.\pDo you have them?$
data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_Text_MoveTutorPaid: My wife loves these things.\pFrom now on, my services are\ngranted to you.$
data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_Text_MoveTutorNoScales: Five HEART SCALES.\nNot four.\pTry smashing rocks.\nWith your POKéMON, or your fists!$
data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_Text_MoveTutorDone: EXCELLENT!\pYour POKéMON holds the knowledge\nof the ISLES.$
data/maps/UlaulaIsle_hns/scripts.inc.Alola_Ulaula_Text_MoveTutorComeBack: The ISLES aren't going anywhere.\nCome back anytime.$

data/maps/Underwater_SeafloorCavern/scri.Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplor:
“SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1” is painted
on the hull.\pThis is the submarine TEAM AQUA
stole in SLATEPORT!\pTEAM AQUA must have gone
ashore here.$

data/maps/UnionCave_1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_1F_Text_HikerRussellSeen: You're headed to AZALEA, are you?\pLet my POKéMON see if you are good\nenough to battle.$
data/maps/UnionCave_1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_1F_Text_HikerRussellAfter: All right, then! I've decided.\pI'm not leaving until my POKéMON\nget tougher!$
data/maps/UnionCave_1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_1F_Text_PokemaniacLarrySeen: I roam far and wide in search of\nPOKéMON.\pAre you looking for POKéMON too?\pThen you're my collecting rival!$
data/maps/UnionCave_1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_1F_Text_PokemaniacLarryAfter: Sometimes, you can hear POKéMON\nroars from deep inside the cave.$
data/maps/UnionCave_1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_1F_Text_HikerDanielSeen: Whoa! What a surprise!\pI didn't expect to see anyone here!$
data/maps/UnionCave_1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_1F_Text_HikerDanielAfter: I was conned into buying a\nSLOWPOKETAIL.\pI feel sorry for the poor POKéMON.$
data/maps/UnionCave_1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_1F_Text_FirebreatherBillSeen: ZUBAT's SUPERSONIC keeps confusing\nmy POKéMON.\pI'm seriously upset about that!$
data/maps/UnionCave_1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_1F_Text_FirebreatherBillAfter: On weekends, you can hear strange\nroars from deep in the cave.$
data/maps/UnionCave_1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_1F_Text_FirebreatherRaySeen: If it's light, a cave isn't scary.\pIf you're strong, POKéMON aren't\nscary.$
data/maps/UnionCave_1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_1F_Text_FirebreatherRayAfter: It's my POKéMON's fire that lights\nup this cave.$

data/maps/UnionCave_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B1F_Text_HikerPhillipSeen: It's been a while since I last saw\nanother person.\pDon't be shy. Let's battle!$
data/maps/UnionCave_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B1F_Text_HikerPhillipAfter: I've been lost for a long time…\pI don't mind it here, but I am\nsoooo hungry!$
data/maps/UnionCave_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B1F_Text_HikerLeonardSeen: What do you know! A visitor!$
data/maps/UnionCave_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B1F_Text_HikerLeonardAfter: I live down here.\pYou can, too, if you'd like.\pThere's plenty of room, you see.$
data/maps/UnionCave_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B1F_Text_PokemaniacAndrewSeen: Who's there?\pLeave me and my POKéMON alone!$
data/maps/UnionCave_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B1F_Text_PokemaniacAndrewAfter: Just me and my POKéMON. I'm de-\nlirious with joy.$
data/maps/UnionCave_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B1F_Text_PokemaniacCalvinSeen: I came all the way here to conduct\nmy POKéMON research.\pLet me demonstrate my findings in a\nreal battle!$
data/maps/UnionCave_B1F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B1F_Text_PokemaniacCalvinAfter: I should compile and announce my\nstudy findings.\pI might even become famous like\nPROF.ELM.$

data/maps/UnionCave_B2F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainermNickSeen: There are two kinds of people.\pThose who have style, and those\nwho don't.\pWhat kind of person are you?$
data/maps/UnionCave_B2F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainermNickAfter: Your POKéMON style is stunning and\ncolorful, I admit.\pYou'll just keep getting better!$
data/maps/UnionCave_B2F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainerfGwenSeen: I'm in training. Care for a round?$
data/maps/UnionCave_B2F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainerfGwenBeate: Aww, no! You're too good for me.$
data/maps/UnionCave_B2F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainerfGwenAfter: I'm going to train by myself until I\nimprove.$
data/maps/UnionCave_B2F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainerfEmmaSeen: If the POKéMON I liked were there,\nI'd go anywhere.\pThat's what a real trainer does.$
data/maps/UnionCave_B2F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainerfEmmaBeate: I'd rather pet my babies than this!$
data/maps/UnionCave_B2F_hns/scripts.inc.UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainerfEmmaAfter: Just once a week, a POKéMON comes to\nthe water's edge.\pI wanted to see that POKéMON…$

data/maps/VerdanturfTown/scripts.inc.VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel:
My papa told me.\pHe says this tunnel is full of
timid POKéMON.\pThey get all scared of loud noise and
make a big uproar.\pSo they had to stop the big tunnel
project.\pBut there's one man. He's trying to dig
the tunnel by himself!$

data/maps/VerdanturfTown_House/scripts.i.VerdanturfTown_House_Text_TrainersGather: Far away, deep in EVER GRANDE CITY,\nis the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pThe TRAINERS who gather there are\nall frighteningly well skilled.$

data/maps/VerdanturfTown_Mart/scripts.in.VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_XSpecialIsCruci: For any POKéMON match, X SPECIAL\nis crucial.\pIt jacks up the power of some moves\neven though it's only for one battle.$

WALLY: I lost to you, {PLAYER}, but I'm
not feeling down anymore.\pBecause I have a new purpose in life.
Together with my RALTS, I'm going\lto challenge POKéMON GYMS and become\la great TRAINER.\pPlease watch me, {PLAYER}.

WALLY: Please watch me, {PLAYER}.\nI'm going to get stronger than you.\pWhen I do, I'm going to challenge you\nto another battle.$

UNCLE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
WALLY's next door.\pBut, boy, there's something I have to
tell you.\pThis natural environment is doing
wonders for WALLY's health.\pMaybe it's not just the environment.
It could be POKéMON that are giving\lthe boy hope.$

data/maps/VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse/scr.VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyGon: UNCLE: Is that right?\nWALLY's gone away that far all by\lhimself…\pWell, I have to give him credit--he is\nmy little brother's son.$

WANDA: You are?
Oh, right, I get it!\pYou're the {PLAYER} who WALLY was
telling me about.\pI'm WALLY's cousin.
Glad to meet you!\pI think WALLY's become a lot more lively
and healthy since he came here.$
data/maps/VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse/scr.VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DontWorr: WANDA: Don't worry about WALLY.\nHe'll be just fine.\pI know my little cousin, and he has\nPOKéMON with him, too.$
data/maps/VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse/scr.VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_CanSeeGi: Thanks to you, I can see my girlfriend\nevery day.\lHappy? You bet I am!$
data/maps/VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse/scr.VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_Daughter:
My daughter's boyfriend is a very
driven and passionate sort of person.\pHe's been digging a tunnel nonstop
just so he can see my daughter.\pMy daughter's a little concerned,
so she goes out to the tunnel a lot.$
It's amazing. My daughter's boyfriend\nwas digging the tunnel by hand!\pIt's so incredible!$
data/maps/VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse/scr.VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_IfAnythi: If anything were to happen to WALLY,\nI would never be able to look his\lparents in PETALBURG in the eye…$
data/maps/VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse/scr.VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyWas: WALLY was in EVER GRANDE?\pHis parents in PETALBURG would be\nastonished to hear that!$

data/maps/VermilionCity_FanClub_hns/scri.PokemonFanClub_Text_Chairman_Intro:
I'm the CHAIRMAN of the POKéMON
FAN CLUB.\pI've raised over 150 POKéMON.\pI'm very fussy when it comes to
POKéMON.\pDid you visit just to hear about
my POKéMON?$

Good! Then listen up!\pSo… my favorite RAPIDASH…\pIt… cute… lovely… smart…
unbearably…\lplus… amazing… oh… you think\lso?…\lToo much… wild… beautiful…\lkindly…\llove it!\pHug it… when… sleeping… warm
and cuddly…\lOh, and… spectacular…\lravishing… simply divine…\pOops! Look at the time!
I've kept you too long!$
