data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_MachopOwner: My POKéMON is preparing the land\nfor construction.\pBut I have no money to start the\nproject…$
data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_Machop2: A MACHOP is growling while\nstomping the ground flat.$
data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_SuperNerd: There are eight GYMS in KANTO.\pThat big building is VERMILION's\nPOKéMON GYM.$
data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_RadioNearSnorlax: The POKéGEAR was placed near \nthe sleeping SNORLAX…\p…\pSNORLAX woke up!$
data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_BadgeGuy_Trainer: Skilled trainers gather in KANTO.\pGYM LEADERS are especially strong.\pThey won't be easy to defeat.$
data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_BadgeGuy_SomeBadges: You've started to collect KANTO\nGYM BADGES?\pDon't you agree that the trainers\nhere are tough?$
data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_BadgeGuy_MostBadges: I guess you'll be finished with\nyour conquest of KANTO GYMS soon.\pLet me know if you get all eight\nBADGES.$
data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_BadgeGuy_AllBadges: Congratulations!\pYou got all the KANTO GYM BADGES.\pI've got a reward for your efforts.$
data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_BadgeGuy_BattleEdge: Having a variety of POKéMON types\nshould give you an edge in battle.\pI'm sure the KANTO GYM BADGES will\nhelp you.$
data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_Sign: VERMILION CITY\pThe Port of Exquisite Sunsets$
data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_GymSign: VERMILION CITY\nPOKéMON GYM\pLEADER: LT.SURGE\pThe Lightning American$
data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_FanClubSign: POKéMON FAN CLUB\pAll POKéMON Fans Welcome!$
data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_StevenIntro:
Hi!
My name is Steven.\lThe Champion from the HOENN region.\pHave we met...before?\pThat's not possible. 
All the trainers I have battled\lseem to have the same look, anyway.\pEspecially the ones who gave me
tough battles.\pI'm in KANTO for business.
Recently many HOENN POKéMON have\lmigrated to this region.\lThis influx risks disrupting the\lnatural ecosystem here.\pSo with the help of my company,
I'm creating a special habitat\lto attract and contain the most\linvasive species.\pMake sure you keep an eye out
and catch any HOENN POKéMON you see.\pSome trainers have even reported
one that soars through the sky like\la jet... What color was it again?$
data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_StevenOutro: Ah, that's right.\pI must go.\nMay our journeys cross again.$
data/maps/VermilionCity_hns/scripts.inc.VermilionCity_Text_Samson:
Whoah!\pSorry kiddo, I'm in a hurry!\pThe ferry on ROUTE 13 will be
leaving for the ISLES soon, and\lI've got to be on it!\pPhew... Phew...\pI ran all the way here from
MT. MOON.\pSee this tchotchke here?\pI picked up this STRANGE SOUVENIR
at the GIFT SHOP.\pIt's my ticket onto the ISLES.\pWell, see-ya!$

data/maps/VictoryRoadKanto_1F_hns/script.VictoryRoad_Text_RivalBefore:
Hold it.\p…Are you going to take the POKéMON
LEAGUE challenge?\p…Don't make me laugh.\pYou're so much weaker than I am.\pI'm not like I was before.\pI now have the best and strongest
POKéMON with me.\pI'm invincible!\p{PLAYER}!
I challenge you!$
data/maps/VictoryRoadKanto_1F_hns/script.VictoryRoad_Text_RivalDefeat: …I couldn't win…\pI gave it every-thing I had…\pWhat you possess, and what I lack…\pI'm beginning to understand what\nthat dragon master said to me…$
data/maps/VictoryRoadKanto_1F_hns/script.VictoryRoad_Text_RivalAfter:
…I haven't given up on becoming the
greatest trainer…\pI'm going to find out why I can't
win and become stronger…\pWhen I do, I will challenge you.\pAnd I'll beat you down with all my
power.\p…Humph! You keep at it until then.$

data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseA:
WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!\pI bet you're surprised to see me here!\pI made it all the way here, and it's
all thanks to you!\p{PLAYER}, losing to you that time
made me stronger!\pBut I'm not going to lose anymore!\pI'm going to win! For the POKéMON who
gave me courage and strength!\pOkay… Here I come!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyEntranceDefeat: Wow!\n{PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostEntranceBat: WALLY: I couldn't beat you today,\n{PLAYER}, but one of these days, I'll\lcatch up to you!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro: WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!\pI've gotten stronger since that last\ntime! I wanted to show you, {PLAYER}!\pOkay… Here I come!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyDefeat: Wow!\n{PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostBattle: WALLY: I couldn't beat you this time,\ntoo… But one of these days, {PLAYER},\lI'm going to catch up to you…\pAnd challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarIntro: I've made it this far a couple times,\nbut the last stretch is so long…$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarPostBattle: You've made it this far. Keep the\nmomentum going and become the\lCHAMPION! If anyone can, it's you!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertIntro: I didn't come all this way to lose now.\nThat possibility doesn't exist!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertPostBattle: I lost here…\pThat means I lack the qualifications\nto become the CHAMPION…$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeIntro: This seemingly infinite and harsh road\nlives up to its name of VICTORY.$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopePostBattle: You seem to have the potential for\nbecoming the CHAMPION.$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyIntro: What is the VICTORY ROAD?\nI'll tell you if you win!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyPostBattle: Getting through here safely--that's\nthe final test for any TRAINER aiming\lto become the POKéMON CHAMPION.\pThat's why it's called the VICTORY\nROAD.$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnIntro: I have nothing to say to anyone\nthat's come this far. Come on!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnPostBattle: Humph, go right on ahead.\nSee if I care.$

data/maps/VictoryRoad_B1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro: The thought that I'm getting closer to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE…\pI'm getting stage fright…$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelPostBattle: The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant\nagain… What a letdown…$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonIntro: To win your way through the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you need the trust of your\lPOKéMON.$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonDefeat: Your relationship is based on\nsolid trust.$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonPostBattle: By being together all the time, trust\ngrows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleIntro: This isn't the goal. It's only a place\non the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichellePostBattle: You'll do fine, for sure!\nYour POKéMON are all eager to go!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellDefeat: I've never met anyone like you before.$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellPostBattle: Even outside of battle, I sense\nincredible power emanating from you\land your POKéMON.$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleIntro: Okay, no need to get your back up!\nRelax, let's take it easy!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B1F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle: Sure, this is VICTORY ROAD.\pBut it's not all that different from\nthe path you've taken so far.\pTry to enjoy things the rest of\nthe way!$

data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoIntro: I trained together with my whole family,\nevery one of us!\lI'm not losing to anyone!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoDefeat: Better than my family?!\nIs that possible?!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoPostBattle: I was better than everyone in my\nfamily. I've never lost before…\pI've lost my confidence…\nMaybe I'll go home…$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenIntro: I'd heard that there was a tough\nlittle kid around. Do they mean you?$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenPostBattle: The rumors I heard, that tough little\nkid is from PETALBURG CITY.$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineIntro: You must be getting a little tired.$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineDefeat: No signs of tiring at all!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolinePostBattle: VICTORY ROAD and the POKéMON LEAGUE\nare long and grueling challenges.\lBeware of fatigue!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieIntro: You shouldn't get complacent just\nbecause you have a lot of GYM BADGES.\pThere's always going to be someone\nwho's better than you!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JuliePostBattle: Gaze on your collected BADGES and\nremember the TRAINERS you've faced.$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixIntro: I've come this far, but the tension's\ngiving me awful stomach pain…$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixPostBattle: I can't help getting all tense knowing\nthat I'm nearing the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pIt's all I can do to feign calm.$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneIntro: The elite among the elite gather in\nthis cave.\pHow are you finding it?$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneDefeat: Not rattled in the least bit!$
data/maps/VictoryRoad_B2F/scripts.inc.VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DiannePostBattle: You do have guts! I like that!\nKeep it going!$

data/maps/VioletCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.VioletGym_Text_Falkner_Intro:
I'm FALKNER, the VIOLET POKéMON
GYM leader!\pPeople say you can clip
FLYING-type POKéMON's wings\pwith a jolt of electricity…
I won't allow such insults to bird\lPOKéMON!\pI'll show you the real power
of the magnificent bird POKéMON!$
data/maps/VioletCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.VioletGym_Text_Falkner_WinLoss: …Darn! My dad's cherished bird\nPOKéMON…\pAll right. Take this.\pIt's the official POKéMON LEAGUE\nZEPHYRBADGE.$
data/maps/VioletCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.VioletGym_Text_Falkner_BadgeExplain: ZEPHYRBADGE raises the ATTACK\npower of POKéMON.\pIt also enables POKéMON to use\nFLASH, if they can learn it,\lanytime.\pHere--take this too.$
data/maps/VioletCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.VioletGym_Text_Falkner_TMExplain:
By using a TM, a POKéMON will
instantly learn a new move.\pThat TM contains ROOST.\pIt restores HP up to half of your
POKéMON's maximum.\pIn other words, it heals your
POKéMON.$
data/maps/VioletCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.VioletGym_Text_Falkner_AfterFight:
There are POKéMON GYMS in cities
and towns ahead.\pYou should test your skills at
these GYMS.\pI'm going to train harder to
become the greatest bird master!$
data/maps/VioletCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.VioletGym_Text_Falkner_Rematch:
Congratulations on defeating
the ELITE 4!\pI've been training my
FLYING-type POKéMON even harder.\pThink you can take on the power
of the skies again?$
data/maps/VioletCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.VioletGym_Text_Falkner_RematchLoss: Wow… You beat me again.\pI'm going to train harder to\nbecome the greatest bird master!$
data/maps/VioletCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.VioletGym_Text_BirdKeeperRod_Seen: The keyword is guts!\pThose here are training night and\nday to become bird POKéMON masters.\pCome on!$
data/maps/VioletCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.VioletGym_Text_BirdKeeperRod_After: FALKNER's skills are for real!\pDon't get cocky just because\nyou beat me!$
data/maps/VioletCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.VioletGym_Text_BirdKeeperAbe_Seen: Let me see if you are good\nenough to face FALKNER!$
data/maps/VioletCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.VioletGym_Text_BirdKeeperAbe_After: This is pathetic, losing to some\nrookie trainer…$
data/maps/VioletCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.VioletGym_Text_GymGuide_Intro:
Hey! What's up? I'm no trainer,
but I can give some advice!\pBelieve me! If you believe, a
championship dream can come true.\pYou believe? Then listen.\pFALKNER's ace is a bulky owl
that loves to eat BERRIES.\pWhile it's not the strongest,
it can take a lot of hits.\pYou can hurt it with ELECTRIC 
and ROCK-type moves, but watch out\lfor MUD-SLAP!\pIf you want more help, go visit the
POKéMON ACADEMY.\pThe students there really know
their stuff!$
data/maps/VioletCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.VioletGym_Text_GymGuide_Win: Nice battle! Keep it up,\nand you'll be the CHAMP in no\ltime at all!$
data/maps/VioletCity_Gym_hns/scripts.inc.VioletCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified: VIOLET CITY POKéMON GYM\pFALKNER'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

data/maps/VioletCity_House1_hns/scripts..VioletCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWontY: I collect POKéMON!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$
data/maps/VioletCity_House1_hns/scripts..VioletCity_House1_Text_MonYouTakeCare: Yay! I got myself {STR_VAR_1}!\p{STR_VAR_2}, you take care!$
data/maps/VioletCity_House1_hns/scripts..VioletCity_House1_Text_ThisIsntAMon: Uh, no, I don't think so.\nThat isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.$
data/maps/VioletCity_House1_hns/scripts..VioletCity_House1_Text_YouWontTradeMe: You don't want to trade? Aww...$
data/maps/VioletCity_House1_hns/scripts..VioletCity_House1_Text_After: Hi, how's my old ONIX doing?$
data/maps/VioletCity_House1_hns/scripts..VioletCity_House1_Text_PokefanM: A POKéMON you get in a trade\ngrows quickly.\pBut if you don't have the right\nGYM BADGE, they may disobey you.$

data/maps/VioletCity_House2_hns/scripts..VioletCity_NicknameHouse_Text_Teacher: She uses the names of her\nfavorite things to eat.\pFor the nicknames she gives to\nher POKéMON, I mean.$

data/maps/VioletCity_Mart_hns/scripts.in.VioletCity_Mart_Text_Granny:
When you first catch a POKéMON,
it may be weak.\pBut it will eventually grow to
be strong.\pIt's important to treat POKéMON
with love.$
data/maps/VioletCity_Mart_hns/scripts.in.VioletCity_Mart_Text_CooltrainerM: POKéMON can hold items like\nPOTION and ANTIDOTE.\pBut they don't appear to know\nhow to use man-made items.$

data/maps/VioletCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideFavor: {PLAYER}, long time, no see.\pPROF.ELM asked me to find you.\pHe has another favor to ask.\pWould you take the POKéMON EGG?$
data/maps/VioletCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideNoRoo: {PLAYER}, long time, no see.\pPROF.ELM asked me to find you.\pHe has another favor to ask.\pWould you take the POKéMON EGG?\pOh, wait... You need to make room\nin your party first.$
data/maps/VioletCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideGiveE:
We discovered that a POKéMON won't
hatch until it grows in the EGG.\pIt also has to be with other
active POKéMON to hatch.\p{PLAYER}, you're the only person
we can rely on.$
data/maps/VioletCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideGiveI: Oh, and this might help when it hatches.$
data/maps/VioletCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideFullP: Oh, no. You can't carry any more\nPOKéMON with you.\pI'll wait here while you make\nroom for the EGG.$
data/maps/VioletCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideEggTo: Oh, but you can't carry any more\nPOKéMON with you.\pDon't worry--I sent the EGG to\nBILL'S PC for you.$
data/maps/VioletCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_BooksAreGreat: While my POKéMON are recovering\nI love to read a good book.$
data/maps/VioletCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_MobileAdapter: I just battled a friend in\nCIANWOOD over a link.\pIf you connect a MOBILE ADAPTER,\nyou can link with a friend far\laway.$
data/maps/VioletCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_GameboyKid: A guy named BILL made the\nPOKéMON PC storage system.$
data/maps/VioletCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_Gentleman: It was around three years ago.\pTEAM ROCKET was up to no good\nwith POKéMON.\pBut justice prevailed--a young\nkid broke 'em up.$
data/maps/VioletCity_PokemonCenter_hns/s.VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_Youngster: POKéMON are smart. They won't\nobey a trainer they don't respect.\pWithout the right GYM BADGES,\nthey will just do as they please.$

data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Twin:
I'm not a GBA kid, but I love
playing POKéMON games!\pIn the old games, you had to battle
a lot of wild POKéMON to get enough\lEXP.\pBut in newer games, the EXP. SHARE
makes your POKéMON level up too fast.\pIn this game, the EXP. SHARE is
balanced to put your POKéMON at just\lthe right level. Or slightly higher,\ldepending on how many battles you do.\pIf you want a traditional GEN 1-4
experience, turn EXP. SHARE off.\lIf you want a modern experience,\lturn EXP. SHARE ON.\pYou choose how you want to play!$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_EarlIntro: EARL, I am!\pWonderful are POKéMON, yes!\pTeach you I will to be a better\ntrainer!$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Teacher:
Certain POKéMON start off weak and
require much more EXP to become\lstrong than others do.\pFor example, LARVITAR is quite weak
but will eventually become a\lmighty TYRANITAR, at the cost of\lmuch EXP.\pOnly the most dedicated trainers
should attempt to train such a\lPOKéMON.$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_TeachHowTo: Good! Teach you, I will!\pIn battle, POKéMON top on list\njump out first!\pChange order in list, make\nbattle easy, maybe!\pMore from me you want to hear?$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_TeachMore: So, want to know how to raise\nPOKéMON well?$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_TeachRaise:
Fine! Teach you, I will!\pIf POKéMON come out in battle
even briefly, some EXP. Points\pit gets.
At top of list put weak POKéMON\pSwitch in battle quick!
This way, weak POKéMON strong\pbecome!$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_NoMoreToTe: Oh! Smart student you are!\nNothing more do I teach!\pIf you want more, talk to\npupils!$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Youngster1:
POKéMON previously thought to
only evolve through trade can\pevolve through leveling.
MACHOKE and GRAVELER evolve\pat LVL 38, while KADABRA and
HAUNTER evolve at LVL 42.\pSome items, like the METAL
COAT, have also been found to\pevolve certain POKéMON
while holding and leveling up.$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_GameboyKid: Notable POKéMON available in an\narea can be seen in the overworld!\pBut make sure to check routes\nat DAY and NIGHT!$

BERRIES in the JOHTO region are
good for healing and making BALLS.\pBERRIES in KANTO are good for
reducing a POKéMON's stats.\pThe DOJO in KANTO helps POKéMON
perfect individual stats.$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Youngster2: Be aware that your opponents\nnow use teams with better type\lcoverage, so expect a much\lmore challenging journey ahead.$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Blackboard: The blackboard describes\nPOKéMON HM moves.\pHMs, once unlocked, don't need to\nbe taught to be used.$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Notebook: It's this kid's notebook…\pCatch POKéMON using POKé BALLS.\pUp to six can be in your party.\pKeep reading?$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Notebook1: Before throwing a POKé BALL,\nweaken the target first.\pA poisoned or burned POKéMON\nis easier to catch.\pKeep reading?$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Notebook2: Some moves may cause confusion.\pConfusion may make a POKéMON\nattack itself.\pLeaving battle clears up any\nconfusion.\pKeep reading?$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Notebook3:
People who catch and use
POKéMON in battle are POKéMON
trainers.\pThey are expected to visit
POKéMON GYMS and defeat other
trainers.\pThe next page is… Blank!\pBoy: E-he-he…\pI haven't written anymore…$
data/maps/VioletCity_TrainerSchool_hns/s.VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_StickerMac: This super machine prints data\nout as stickers!$

data/maps/VioletCity_hns/scripts.inc.VioletCity_Text_LiquidJustice: Look around!\pIt's easy to see what POKéMON\nyou can catch in an area without\lhaving to run around in tall\lgrass all day!$
data/maps/VioletCity_hns/scripts.inc.VioletCity_Text_EarlAsksIfYouBeatFalkner: Hello!\nYou are trainer?\pBattle GYM LEADER,\nwin you did?$
data/maps/VioletCity_hns/scripts.inc.VioletCity_Text_FollowEarl: Is that so? Then study shall\nyou! Follow me!$
data/maps/VioletCity_hns/scripts.inc.VioletCity_Text_HereTeacherIAm: Here, teacher I am.\nGood it is you study here!$
data/maps/VioletCity_hns/scripts.inc.VioletCity_Text_Lass:
Ghosts are rumored to appear
in SPROUT TOWER.\pThey say that GHOST-type
moves can bypass the defenses\pof tough POKéMON like ONIX
and GEODUDE.$

data/scripts/contest_hall.inc.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainCo:
A POKéMON CONTEST involves four
TRAINERS entering one POKéMON each\lin competitive judging.\pA CONTEST has two stages of judging,
primary and secondary.\pPrimary judging is a popularity poll
involving the audience.\pSecondary judging features appeals
by the POKéMON using their moves.\pPlan appeals carefully to earn the
most attention of the JUDGE and\lexcite the audience.\lDo your best to stand out.\pThe primary and secondary scores are
added at the end.\pThe POKéMON garnering the highest
score is declared the winner.$
There are five kinds of CONTESTS.\pCOOL, BEAUTY, CUTE, SMART, and\nTOUGH are the five categories.\pChoose the CONTEST that is right for\nthe POKéMON you plan to enter.$

There are four ranks of POKéMON
CONTESTS.\pNORMAL, SUPER, HYPER, and MASTER
are the four ranks.\pIn the NORMAL Rank, any POKéMON may
enter.\pAny POKéMON that won a NORMAL Rank
CONTEST may move up to the SUPER Rank\lin the same category.\pIn the same way, a SUPER Rank winner
can move up to the HYPER Rank, and\la HYPER Rank winner can advance to\lthe MASTER Rank in the same category.\pA POKéMON that won in the MASTER Rank
may compete in the MASTER Rank as\loften as its TRAINER wants.$

At least one player has entered using
the 4-player reception counter.\pThere must be four players connected
using a GBA Game Link cable.\pWhen the four players are ready,
select G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE),\lthen register to enter again, please.$
data/scripts/contest_hall.inc.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLi:
This is a CONTEST for two to four
players linked using a Wireless\lAdapter or a GBA Game Link cable.\pParticipants are first asked to choose
the mode they wish to enter.\pThere are two different modes.\pE-MODE (EMERALD MODE) is for
two to four players, each with a\lPOKéMON Emerald Game Pak.\pG-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) is only for
four players, each with a POKéMON\lEmerald, Ruby, or Sapphire Game Pak.\pThe players should discuss which mode
they want, then choose the same mode.\pOnce all the players have chosen
the same CONTEST in the same mode,\lthe entry registration is complete.\pAfter that, a CONTEST will start in
the usual manner.$
data/scripts/contest_hall.inc.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEM:
In E-MODE (EMERALD MODE),
a LINK CONTEST can be held with\ltwo to four players. Each player must\lhave a POKéMON Emerald Game Pak.\pThe players must be linked with each
other using Wireless Adapters or\lGBA Game Link cables.\pIf there are fewer than four players,
TRAINERS in the hall will join to fill\lthe 4-player CONTEST lineup.\pPlease be aware that E-MODE is not
available in POKéMON Ruby or Sapphire.$
data/scripts/contest_hall.inc.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainGM:
G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) is specifically
for four players who are linked using\lGBA Game Link cables.\pEach player must have a POKéMON
Emerald, Ruby, or Sapphire Game Pak.\pThe CONTEST starts after all players
choose G-MODE (POKéMON Emerald) or\lenter through the 4-player reception\lcounter (POKéMON Ruby or Sapphire).$

together four words or phrases.\pHere, I'll show you an example of a
profile using four pieces of text.\pYou can switch those four pieces with
other text pieces any which way you\llike to make your own profile.\pThere are a lot of text pieces that

pieces to display a list of choices.\pThen, pick the choice you want.\pRepeat for the remaining text choices,

You seem to be without a ポロック CASE.\pYour SAFARI Game will be much more
fruitful if you use ポロックS.\pPlease come back with a ポロック CASE.\pYou may obtain a ポロック CASE from
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_South_Text_StillHaveTimeExit: You still have time left. Would you like\nto exit the SAFARI ZONE now?$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_South_Text_EnjoyTheRestOfYour: Please enjoy the rest of your wild\nadventure!$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_South_Text_ExitEarlyThankYouF: Okay.\pI'll take back your remaining SAFARI\nBALLS.\pThank you for playing.\nWe hope to see you again.$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_South_Text_GoodLuck: Good luck!\pIf you need anything, don't hesitate\nto tell me, please!$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_South_Text_Boy: Did you know?\pIf you put a ポロック in that square box,\nPOKéMON gather around.$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_South_Text_Man: I want to keep going deeper, but I\nforgot to bring a BIKE.\pSomething tells me that rare POKéMON\nlive in the outlying areas.$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_Southwest_Text_Woman: Sometimes, when I toss a ポロック at \nPOKéMON, it gets ignored.\pDo POKéMON have likes and dislikes\nabout what they eat?$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_Northwest_Text_Man: Gasp… Gasp…\nI…made it out here…but…\pI'm exhausted… I don't have the\nenergy to catch POKéMON…$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_North_Text_Fisherman: I'm on a mission to find WATER POKéMON\nyou don't see in HOENN.\pDo you have any idea where the lake is?$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_North_Text_Man: I'm going to catch a lot of rare POKéMON\nhere and trade them with my friends!$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_South_Text_Youngster: I put a ポロック on the ポロック FEEDER.\nBut it seems to have disappeared.\pI guess POKéMON must have eaten it\nwithout me noticing.$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Trainer: SAFARI ZONE TRAINER TIP!\pThrow ポロックS at wild POKéMON to make\nthem less likely to flee.$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_Youngster: I don't have any ポロックS, but I caught\na good number of POKéMON.\pYou can improve your chances of making\na catch by getting closer to them\lbefore throwing a SAFARI BALL.$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_PsychicM: If you use ポロックS, wild POKéMON won't\nbe so quick to run away.\pIt's not much use to give ポロックS to\nPOKéMON that don't flee easily.$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_FatMan: If you put a ポロック on the FEEDER,\nPOKéMON are attracted to it.\pI think POKéMON with the same sort of\nnature are drawn by a certain ポロック.$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_South_Text_AreaOffLimits1: This area is still under construction.\nIt's off-limits, sorry!$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_Southeast_Text_ExpansionIsFin: The SAFARI ZONE's expansion project\nis finished now.\pWe hope you will enjoy the new area.$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_South_Text_AreaOffLimits2: This area is still under construction.\nIt's off-limits, sorry!$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_Southeast_Text_LittleGirl: Wow! Whee! I haven't seen any of\nthese POKéMON before!$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_Southeast_Text_FatMan: The POKéMON in this area are all\nnew to me.\pAnd I'm allowed to catch these rare\nPOKéMON! Too cool!$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_Southeast_Text_RichBoy: The POKéMON around here seem to be\nfrom somewhere other than HOENN.$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Boy: I only have a couple SAFARI BALLS left.\pI'm having a hard time trying to\ndecide what I should catch.$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Woman: I heard that you can see PIKACHU here.\nWhere might one be?$
data/scripts/safari_zone.inc.SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Girl: Oh, boo!\nI can't seem to catch anything!\pI'll end up wasting the admission\nprice if I don't catch something!$

data/scripts/secret_base.inc.SecretBase_Text_RegistryInfo:
Once registered, a SECRET BASE will not
disappear unless the other TRAINER\lmoves it to a different location.\pIf a SECRET BASE is deleted from the
registered list, another one may take\lits place.\pUp to ten SECRET BASE locations
may be registered.$
data/scripts/secret_base.inc.SecretBase_Text_BattleTowerShield: A shield of {STR_VAR_2} that marks winning\n{STR_VAR_1} times in a row at the BATTLE TOWER.$
data/scripts/secret_base.inc.SecretBase_Text_ToyTV: A realistic toy TV. It could be easily\nmistaken for the real thing.$
data/scripts/secret_base.inc.SecretBase_Text_SeedotTV: A toy TV shaped like a SEEDOT.\nIt looks ready to roll away on its own…$
data/scripts/secret_base.inc.SecretBase_Text_SkittyTV: A toy TV shaped like a SKITTY.\nIt looks ready to stroll away…$
data/scripts/secret_base.inc.SecretBase_Text_WouldYouLikeToMoveBases: You may only make one SECRET BASE.\pWould you like to move from the SECRET\nBASE near {STR_VAR_1}?$
data/scripts/secret_base.inc.SecretBase_Text_MovingCompletedUseSecret: Moving completed.\pWould you like to use the SECRET POWER?$

data/scripts/secret_power_tm.inc.Route111_Text_MakingRoomUseTMToMakeYourO:
What's that?
What am I doing?\pI'm thinking about making my own room
here using a POKéMON move.\pI know! I'll give you this TM.
Will you use it to make your own room?$
data/scripts/secret_power_tm.inc.Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower:
Find a big tree that looks like it might
drop some vines.\pUse SECRET POWER in front of the tree.
Some vines should get free and drop\ldown, so you can climb the tree.\pYou'll find a lot of space for putting
your favorite things.\pIt'll be your own secret room…
A SECRET BASE!\pYou should make one, too.\pAnother thing, you don't always have
to make your SECRET BASE in a tree.\pTry using SECRET POWER on rock walls
that have small indents in them.\pI'm going to look for other places, too.
Okay, bye!$
data/scripts/secret_power_tm.inc.Route111_Text_DontWantThis: Oh, you don't want this?\nIf you change your mind, tell me, okay?$
data/scripts/secret_power_tm.inc.Route111_Text_DontHaveAnyRoom: Oh, you don't have any room for this.\pI'll hold on to it, so come back for it\nanother time, okay?$

data/scripts/shared_secret_base.inc.SecretBase_Text_SmallIndentInWall: There's a small indent in the wall.$
data/scripts/shared_secret_base.inc.SecretBase_Text_IndentUseSecretPower: There's a small indent in the wall.\pUse the SECRET POWER?$
data/scripts/shared_secret_base.inc.SecretBase_Text_WantToMakeYourSecretBase: Want to make your SECRET BASE here?$

data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeChallenge0: Um, I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nSnivel… This tension is getting to me…$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeChallenge2: I'm the no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice of {STR_VAR_1}!\nAccept my challenge!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeChallenge3: Um… I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice…\nDo you think someone like me can win?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeChallenge4: I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nI'll let you challenge me!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeChallenge5: I'm horribly busy, but I also happen\nto be {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeChallenge6: I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nGlad to meet you!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeChallenge7: I serve as {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nMay I begin?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeChallenge8: Eek! I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nI'll do my best!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeChallenge10: I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s 1,000th apprentice!\nActually, I'm no. {STR_VAR_2}! Here goes!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeChallenge11: Yeah, I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nLet's get rockin' and a-rollin'!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeChallenge12: Yippee-yahoo! I'm what you call\n{STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeChallenge13: Cough! I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nGood to meet you! Cough!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeChallenge14: This is nerve-racking…\nI'm the no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice of {STR_VAR_1}.$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeChallenge15: I am {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice,\nand that's no lie.$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach0:
Are you… {PLAYER}?
Oh! Sniff…sob…\pOh! S-sorry…
I'm so nervous, I can't help crying…\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, and I really look up
to you, {PLAYER}.\pI… I had this dream of one day meeting
you and asking you about POKéMON.\pPlease, please, {PLAYER}!
Please teach me about POKéMON!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching0: Oh… B-but…\nSnivel… Waaaaaaah!\pPlease!\nI'm begging you, please!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode0:
Oh, really? You will?
Awesome! Wicked! Awoooh!\pOh… I'm sorry…
I'm so happy, I'm crying…\pUm… Then please tell me!
It's about the BATTLE TOWER.\pWhich would be better for me: Level 50
or the Open Level?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks0:
{STR_VAR_1}?
Waaaaah!\pOh! I'm so sorry!
You've made me happy by choosing\lthe level for me, and it's made me cry…\pSnivel…
Thank you so much!\lPlease talk with me again!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach1:
Wowee! You're {PLAYER}, aren't you?
You're awesomely strong, aren't you?\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}!
I just became a TRAINER!\pPlease, {PLAYER}!
Can you be my teacher and tell me\llots about being a TRAINER?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching1: Aww, why?\nOh, please? Pretty please?\lPlease be my teacher, please!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode1: Yay! Great!\pThe first thing I wanted to ask you is\nabout the BATTLE TOWER!\pThe Level 50 and Open Level Rooms…\nWhich would be perfect for me?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks1: {STR_VAR_1}, huh? That's true!\nI'll do my best there!\pIf we meet here again, please teach\nme something else, teacher!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach2:
Um… Are you {PLAYER}?
My name is {STR_VAR_1}.\pI want to become a POKéMON TRAINER,
but I don't know what to do…\pSo I thought maybe I could ask you for
advice because you're so famous.\p{PLAYER}, could you give me advice?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching2: Oh, but…\pI sincerely want to become a POKéMON\nTRAINER!\pPlease, can you answer my questions?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode2:
Thank you!
Here's my first question right away!\pThe BATTLE TOWER has two levels,
Level 50 and Open Level, right?\pWhich level do you think is more
suitable for me?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks2: Oh, the {STR_VAR_1} challenge?\nUnderstood!\pIf I have another question, I'll come\nback here for your advice!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach3:
Oh? Huh? You're…
No, that can't be true.\pThere isn't any way that someone
like me could meet {PLAYER}.\p…You really are {PLAYER}?
I can't believe I'm talking to you!\pWhen something this good happens,
only terrible things will happen to me\lnow, I just know it…\p…I'm sorry…
I'm… {STR_VAR_1}…\pThere isn't anything special about
me that I can be proud of…\pI shouldn't even say anything about
myself because you'll forget…\pI had this dream that if I ever met
you, {PLAYER}, that maybe I could ask\lyou for advice as a TRAINER.\pBut I don't think you would agree
to that.\p…Or will you be so kind as to give
me advice?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching3:
I knew it…\pIt had to happen because I'm such
a really boring nobody…\pBut I thought just maybe…
You won't reconsider, will you?\pBut I can't give up just like that.
I'll ask you while I'm still lucky!\pPlease, will you be so kind as to give
me advice?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode3:
Really? I can't believe it!
I can't believe you'll advise me!\lI… I'm so happy…\pWhat I want to ask you is really
trivial, but I can't decide…\pAt the BATTLE TOWER, they let you
choose Level 50 or Open Level.\pWhich course do you think even I may
have a chance at?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks3:
{STR_VAR_1}? Okay!
But do you really think someone like\lme would have a chance?\pI'll do my best, even though I don't
think it will work.\pThank you very much for spending
time with someone like me.$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach4:
Oh! You're {PLAYER}{KUN}, aren't you?\pI've heard that you're tough at
POKéMON!\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}!
I'll be your friend!\pDid you know?\pYou can't win at the BATTLE FRONTIER
if all you know is what they teach at\lthe TRAINER'S SCHOOL.\pI'm willing to listen to your advice.
You'll agree, of course?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching4: Huh? Why are you refusing me?\nIt's me who's asking you!\lYou have to reconsider!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode4:
Okay, so there is this something.
I want you to decide it for me.\pYou know that the BATTLE TOWER has
Level 50 and Open Level Rooms?\pWhich do you think would be good
for me, {PLAYER}{KUN}?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks4:
Okay, {STR_VAR_1} is suitable for me?
Thank you!\pKnowing that you made the decision,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.
Bye!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach5:
Oh, hi, there! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I know you because you're famous!\lCall me {STR_VAR_1}! Glad to meet you!\pI'm a TRIATHLETE, so I keep myself
fit even while I raise POKéMON.\pI'm also involved with other things
like work, napping, ballroom dancing…\pBeing this busy, it's not so easy for
me to become a decent TRAINER.\pSo, I have a proposition!\pThere must be a reason why we met.
So, {PLAYER}{KUN}, how about sharing your\lwisdom with me every so often?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching5: Oh, but, please?\nA guy like me needs someone like\lyou, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHonestly, I need your advice!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode5:
Thank you! That's more like it!
So, let's start with an easy one!\pYou know about the BATTLE TOWER's
two courses, right?\lYou know, Level 50 and Open Level.\pMe being a busy guy, which one should
I gear up for?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks5: {STR_VAR_1}, huh? Okay, gotcha.\nI'll find time somehow and give it a go!\p…Whoops, I'd better go to work!\nThanks! See you around!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach6:
No way! Uh-uh!
Are you maybe the real {PLAYER}?\pA-hah! Awesome! I'm {STR_VAR_1},
so pleased to meet you!\p{PLAYER}, you're very strong,
aren't you?\pEveryone's talking about you!\pOh! I just had this great idea!
I'll get advice off you, {PLAYER}!\lI'm sure it will make me tougher!\pIsn't it a great idea?
Please, I want your advice!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching6: Ahahaha, you can pretend to be mean,\nbut you can't fool me!\lYou really mean okay, don't you?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode6:
Yay! I knew you'd have a big heart,
{PLAYER}!\pWhat should I ask you first?
…Oh, I thought of something!\pDrum roll, please!
The question I have is…\pIf I were to take a BATTLE TOWER
challenge, which way should I go?\pLevel 50 or Open Level?
Which suits me more?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks6:
Oh-oh-oh!
{STR_VAR_1}, you say!\lThank you for a totally cool reply!\pI guess that's about all I wanted
to ask you today.\pLet's meet here again, okay?
Thanks!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach7:
I beg your pardon, but…
Are you {PLAYER}?\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, and I am delighted to
make your acquaintance.\pI have long been an admirer
of yours…\p… … … … … …\pUm… I hope you don't find this
request too much of a burden, but…\pMay I become your apprentice,
{PLAYER}?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching7:
Oh…!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\p…I must have fainted from shock.
I'm sorry, I must have misheard you.\pPlease! Please say that you will
accept me as your apprentice!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7:
Oh… I'm delighted!\pI don't wish to waste your time,
so please advise me on this.\pI plan to take a BATTLE TOWER
challenge soon.\pHowever, there are two levels…\pWhich would be most suitable for me?
Level 50 or Open Level?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks7: {STR_VAR_1} is your choice!\nI see. I will do my best!\pThank you, {PLAYER}.\nI hope I can count on you again.\lPlease take care!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8:
Eek! Eek! {PLAYER}!
You spoke to me!\lI… I'm overjoyed!\pMe! My name is {STR_VAR_1}!
I just became a TRAINER!\pI'm delighted I met you, {PLAYER},
the big name in POKéMON circles!\pOh-oh-oh, I know!
May I ask a huge favor, {PLAYER}?\pPlease take me in as your apprentice!
I want to learn from you!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching8: Waaaah!\n{PLAYER} turned me down…\lIt… It's an invaluable experience!\p{PLAYER}, please! I want to hear\nan affirmative answer this time!\pI beg you for your guidance!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8:
Hieeeeh! {PLAYER} said yes!
{PLAYER} said yes!\pI won't be able to sleep tonight…
Thank you ever so much!\pThen, here's my question!\pAt the BATTLE TOWER, what is right
for me, Level 50 or Open Level?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks8: {STR_VAR_1}! Perfectly understood!\nI understand perfectly!\lI'm deliriously delighted!\pI hope you'll be willing to teach me\nsome more another time.$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9:
Whoa! Could you be…
Might you be… {PLAYER}{KUN}?!\lThat strong and famous TRAINER?\lWell, hello, aren't I just the luckiest!\pHello, the name's {STR_VAR_1}!\pI've been on the lookout for
a POKéMON teacher.\pAnd with impeccably good timing,
along came you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pSo, there you have it, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Let me apprentice under you!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching9: Gwaaaah!\nYou're quite cool and tough…\pDon't be that way, please.\nI'm asking you!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9:
Oh, yeah! That's a solid reply!
Excellent, I might add!\pSo how about a first piece of advice
on the BATTLE TOWER?\pIf I were to go, what would be better?
Level 50 or Open Level?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks9: Uh-huh, {STR_VAR_1} it is!\nOK, A-OK!\lI'll go show my mettle, like, jam!\pAll right, I'll look to you as my mentor!\nAdios!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10:
Oh, hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?
The police were looking for you!\p… … …
Of course I'm lying!\pMe, I'm {STR_VAR_1}. Despite the way
I look, I'm the POKéMON CHAMPION!\l…That's a lie, too!\pThis is no lie, though.
I'm not very good at battling.\pSo, how about you becoming my master
about all things POKéMON?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10:
If you're going to act cold like that,
I'll show you what I'll do!\pWaaah! Waaah! Waaah!
Hiccup!\pHahaha, that was my FAKE TEARS!\pCome on, will you please be
my POKéMON master?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10:
Yippee!
I'll buy you a boat for that!\pOf course I'm lying again!
But… Thank you, master!\pYou know how there's Level 50 and
Open Level at the BATTLE TOWER?\pI'm having trouble deciding which
level I should challenge…\pCan you decide for me, master?$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks10:
Okay, so {STR_VAR_1} is better!
I'll go to the other level, then!\pJust kidding!
I'll obey your teaching, master!\pThanks, master!
I hope you'll keep teaching me!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11:
A-H-O-Y!
And that spells ahoy, and it means hi!\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, the rappin' SAILOR
am I!\pYour turn now, tell me a little about
yourself, give it a try!\pUh-huh, uh-huh!
{PLAYER}{KUN}'s your name,\land POKéMON's your game!\pAnd you're at a delicate age
when all the world's your stage!\pAnyway, I just want to say,
that you're the tenth TRAINER\lI've spoken to today.\pLet's make that a celebration!
Become my mentor for commemoration!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching11: But!\nYou have to work with me!\pDon't be such a tease!\nBecome my mentor, please!$
data/text/apprentice.inc.gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11:
That's it!
{PLAYER}, you've got the spirit!\pSo here's my first question
that begs your suggestion!\pIt's about the BATTLE TOWER,

data/text/battle_tent.inc.SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_Expla: In a Battle Swap event, you may use\nonly three POKéMON.\pWhether you are renting or swapping,\nyour team may not have two or more\lof the same POKéMON.$
You may swap POKéMON only with\nthe TRAINER you have just defeated.\pYou may swap for only those POKéMON\nused by the beaten TRAINER.$
After every battle you win, you may\nswap for one of your defeated\lopponent's POKéMON.\pYou will not be able to swap POKéMON\nwith the third TRAINER in the event.$

There are two key points to be aware
of when swapping POKéMON.\pFirst, when swapping, you can't check
the stats of the POKéMON you are\labout to receive.\pSecond, the POKéMON on your team
are lined up in sequence, depending on\lthe order in which you rented them.\pThis sequence remains unchanged

data/text/battle_tent.inc.VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Expl: Here at the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT,\nPOKéMON are required to think and\lbattle by themselves.\pUnlike in the wild, POKéMON that live\nwith people behave differently\ldepending on their nature.$

Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.\pAnother POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.\pYet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.\pDepending on its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good\lat using.\pIt may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.$

There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.\pThere are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or\lused to heal HP and so on.\pThere are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with\lstat problems including poison and \lparalysis.\pPOKéMON will consider using moves in
these three categories.$

When not under command by its TRAINER,
a POKéMON may be unable to effectively\luse certain moves.\pA POKéMON is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.\pIf a POKéMON only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often\lbe unable to live up to its potential.$
Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may\nstart using moves that don't match its\lnature when it is in trouble.\pIf a POKéMON begins behaving oddly\nin a pinch, watch it carefully.$

data/text/berries.inc.Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis: If you see BERRIES growing in loamy\nsoil, feel free to take them.\pBut make sure you plant a BERRY in the\nsame spot. That's common courtesy.\pHere, I'll share this with you.$
data/text/berries.inc.Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBe:
The way you look, you must be a
TRAINER, no?\pTRAINERS often make POKéMON hold
BERRIES.\pIt's up to you whether to grow BERRIES
or use them.$
data/text/berries.inc.Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeB: I watered the plants every day.\nThey grew lots of flowers.\pAnd they gave me lots of BERRIES, too.\pHere you go!\nYou can have it!$
data/text/berries.inc.Route111_Text_GoingToTryToMakeDifferentC: I'm going to try really hard and make\nBERRIES in different colors.\pI hope you try hard, too!$
data/text/berries.inc.Route111_Text_WhatColorBerriesToLookForT: I wonder what color BERRIES I'll look\nfor today?$
data/text/berries.inc.Route114_Text_LoveUsingBerryCrushShareBe: I love using the BERRY CRUSH machine,\nso I'm collecting BERRIES.\pI'll share one with you, if you'd like.$
data/text/berries.inc.Route114_Text_TryBerryCrushWithFriends: You should try the BERRY CRUSH\nmachine with your friends.$
data/text/berries.inc.Route114_Text_FunToThinkAboutBerries: Which BERRY should be planted?\nShould you use or hoard BERRIES?\pIt's fun to think about.$
data/text/berries.inc.Route120_Text_BerriesExpressionOfLoveIsn: BERRIES grow by soaking up sunlight.\pWe help the BERRIES grow by watering\nthem regularly.\pIt's an expression of love, isn't it?$
data/text/berries.inc.Route120_Text_YesYouUnderstand: Yes, yes.\nYou understand what I mean.\pYou should take this.$
data/text/berries.inc.Route120_Text_MakeYourOwnImpressions: Oh… But it is important to make your\nown impressions, I guess…\pYou can have this.$
data/text/berries.inc.Route120_Text_BerryIsRareRaiseItWithCare: I think that BERRY is rare.\nI hope you raise it with loving care.$
data/text/berries.inc.Route120_Text_IllGetMoreBerriesFromBerry: I'll get more BERRIES from\nthe BERRY MASTER.$
data/text/berries.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou: When it gets right down to it…\pThe same way suits suit me perfectly,\na crisp breeze suits the sea.\pAnd you, a BERRY suits you to a “T”…\pWhy should that be so?$
data/text/berries.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_BecauseYoureTrainer: When it gets right down to it…\pIt's because you're a TRAINER!$
data/text/berries.inc.LilycoveCity_Text_PokeblocksSuitPokemon: When it gets right down to it…\pThe way dignified simplicity suits me,\nポロックS perfectly suit POKéMON.$
data/text/berries.inc.Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDes: You may call me the BERRY MASTER.\pI dream of filling the world with\nbeautiful flowers, so I raise BERRIES\land hand them out to everyone.\pYou're deserving of one!$
data/text/berries.inc.Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_VisitPre: Be sure to visit the PRETTY PETAL\nflower shop near RUSTBORO.\pLet flowers fill the world!$
data/text/berries.inc.Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_DoneForT: I'm done for today.\nCome again another day.\pLet flowers fill the world!$
data/text/berries.inc.Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGo: The way my husband grows BERRIES,\noh, he's the best in the world.\pHe makes me proud, that he does.\pIncidentally, child, have you heard\na good saying lately?$
data/text/berries.inc.Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_Inspirat: Ah! What a remarkable saying!\nInspirational, it is!\pI want you to have this.$
data/text/berries.inc.Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_GoodSayi: Oh! A good saying it is.\nYou're quite remarkable.\pI want you to have this.$
data/text/berries.inc.Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_JoyNever: Our four grandchildren should become\nmore accomplished than my husband.\pJoy never goes out of my life!$
data/text/berries.inc.Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_This: Hello!\pThis is the PRETTY PETAL flower shop.\nSpreading flowers all over the world!$
data/text/berries.inc.Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_Lear: {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about\nBERRIES?$
data/text/berries.inc.Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_Intr: Your name is?\p{PLAYER}{KUN}.\nThat's a nice name.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about\nBERRIES?$
data/text/berries.inc.Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_Berr:
BERRIES grow on trees that thrive
only in soft, loamy soil.\pIf you take some BERRIES, be sure to
plant one in the loamy soil again.\pA planted BERRY will soon sprout,
grow into a plant, flower beautifully,\lthen grow BERRIES again.\pI want to see the whole wide world
filled with beautiful flowers.\lThat's my dream.\pPlease help me, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Plant BERRIES
and bring more flowers into the world.$
data/text/berries.inc.Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_Flow: Flowers bring so much happiness to\npeople, don't they?$
data/text/berries.inc.Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouC: Hello!\pThe more attention you give to flowers,\nthe more beautifully they bloom.\pYou'll like tending flowers. I'm sure\nof it. You can have this.$
data/text/berries.inc.Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_Wail:
While BERRY plants are growing,
water them with the WAILMER PAIL.\pOh, another thing.\pIf you don't pick BERRIES for a while,
they'll drop off onto the ground.\lBut they'll sprout again.\pIsn't that awesome?
It's like they have the will to live.$
data/text/berries.inc.Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ImGr: I'm trying to be like my big sisters.\nI'm growing flowers, too!\pHere you go!\nIt's for you!$
data/text/berries.inc.Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_Mach: You can plant a BERRY and grow it big,\nor you can make a POKéMON hold it.\pBut now they have a machine that mixes\nup different BERRIES and makes candies\lfor POKéMON.\pI want some candy, too.$
data/text/berries.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfT: Hi, what's your name?\p… … …  … … …  … … …\nOkay. That's nice!\pMy name is KIRI.\pMy mommy and daddy named me that so\nI would grow healthy and warmhearted.\lThat's what they wished.\pYou can have one of these.$
data/text/berries.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_GiveYouThisBerryToo: KIRI will give you this BERRY, too!\nI really like it lots!$
data/text/berries.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_WhatKindOfWishInYour: I wonder what kind of wish is included\nin your name.$
data/text/berries.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_LikeSeasonBornIn: Spring, summer, autumn, and winter.\pIf you're born in springtime, do you like\nthe spring, and if you're born in the\lsummer, do you like the summer?$
data/text/berries.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_ThenILoveAutumn: Then KIRI was born in the autumn,\nso I love the autumn!\pWhich season do you like?$
data/text/berries.inc.SootopolisCity_Text_OhDoesntMatter: Oh…\nIt doesn't matter…\pThere's so much that I want to know…$

data/text/birch_speech.inc.gText_Birch_Welcome: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!\pWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\pMy name is BIRCH.\pBut everyone calls me the POKéMON\nPROFESSOR.\p$
data/text/birch_speech.inc.gText_Birch_Pokemon: This is what we call a “POKéMON.”\p\n$
data/text/birch_speech.inc.gText_Birch_MainSpeech:
This world is widely inhabited by
creatures known as POKéMON.\pWe humans live alongside POKéMON,
at times as friendly playmates, and\lat times as cooperative workmates.\pAnd sometimes, we band together
and battle others like us.\pBut despite our closeness, we don't
know everything about POKéMON.\pIn fact, there are many, many
secrets surrounding POKéMON.\pTo unravel POKéMON mysteries,
I've been undertaking research.\lThat's what I do.\p$
data/text/birch_speech.inc.gText_Birch_BoyOrGirl: Are you a boy?\nOr are you a girl?$
data/text/birch_speech.inc.gText_Birch_YourePlayer: Ah, okay!\pYou're {PLAYER}{KUN} who's moving to my\nhometown of LITTLEROOT.\lI get it now!\p$
data/text/birch_speech.inc.gText_Birch_AreYouReady:
All right, are you ready?\pYour very own adventure is about
to unfold.\pTake courage, and leap into the
world of POKéMON where dreams,\ladventure, and friendships await!\pWell, I'll be expecting you later.
Come see me in my POKéMON LAB.\p$

data/text/blend_master.inc.BerryBlender_Text_BlendWithTheBlendMaste: BLEND MASTER: Indeed I am!\nThe BLEND MASTER am I!\pBlend with me, and you shall witness\nthe mastery I bring to blending!$
data/text/blend_master.inc.BerryBlender_Text_SeeMyMasteryInAction: BLEND MASTER: Hmmm! So, you wish to\nsee my mastery in action?$
data/text/blend_master.inc.BerryBlender_Text_TooBusyNowIsee: Hmmm!\pSo, you are too busy now, I see!\pBut fear not!\nI shall be here all day!\lHurry back from your errand!$
data/text/blend_master.inc.BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoBerries: Hmmm!\pYou haven't got a single BERRY!\pI shall be here all day!\nHurry back with some BERRIES!$
data/text/blend_master.inc.BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterKnowHowToMa: Of course!\nOf course!\pIncidentally…\nYou do know how to blend ポロックS\lfrom BERRIES?$
data/text/blend_master.inc.BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerr: Hmmm!\pAh, but it is a simple process!\pWhen the BLENDER's arrow comes to\nyour marker, just press the A Button.\pThat's all you have to do.\pWhen you see how precisely I press\nthe A Button, you will understand.$
data/text/blend_master.inc.BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterLetsBerryBl: Fine!\pLet's get started, then!\pAll together with the BLEND MASTER,\nlet's BERRY BLENDER!$
data/text/blend_master.inc.BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoPokeblock: Hmmm!\pYou don't appear to have gotten\nthe ポロック CASE!\pI shall be here all day!\nObtain the ポロック CASE and hurry back!$
data/text/blend_master.inc.BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterPokeblockCa: Hmmm!\pYour ポロック CASE appears to be full!\pI shall be here all day!\nUse some ポロックS and hurry back!$
data/text/blend_master.inc.BerryBlender_Text_MadeAmazingPokeblocksW: When I blended with the MASTER,\nwe made amazing ポロックS!$
data/text/blend_master.inc.BerryBlender_Text_QualitiesOfBlendMaster:
Eyes that track the arrow with
machinelike intensity…\pA hand that taps the A Button
with clockwork-like precision…\pPossessing these qualities makes
the BLEND MASTER truly great.$
data/text/blend_master.inc.BerryBlender_Text_MasterWorksOnSkillsInM: The BLEND MASTER's supposed to work\non his skills deep in the mountains.\pSometimes, he comes to LILYCOVE\nto blend BERRIES all day long.$

jumps in time.$

data/text/cable_club.inc.CableClub_Text_ExplainBattleModes:
There are three Battle Modes.\pSINGLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.\pDOUBLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with two or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER will send out two
POKéMON in battle at a time.\pMULTI BATTLE is for four TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.$

data/text/cable_club.inc.CableClub_Text_UnionRoomInfo:
The TRAINERS in the UNION ROOM
will be those players around you\lwho have also entered the ROOM.\pYou may do all sorts of things
here, such as exchanging greetings.\pYou may enter two POKéMON up to
Lv. 30 for a one-on-one battle.\pYou may take part in a chat with
two to five people.\pOr, you may register a POKéMON for
trade.\pWould you like to enter the ROOM?$
data/text/cable_club.inc.CableClub_Text_EnjoyUnionRoom: I hope you enjoy your time in\nthe UNION ROOM.$
data/text/cable_club.inc.CableClub_Text_FirstTimeRightThisWay:
Hello!
My name is TEALA.\pThis must be your first time
up here.\pI'll show you how the Wireless
Communication System works.\pFirst, I need to show you this
floor of our POKéMON CENTER.\pRight this way, please.$
data/text/cable_club.inc.CableClub_Text_ExplainWirelessClubFirstT:
On the top floor, there are two
rooms.\pFirst, the room on the left.
It's the UNION ROOM.\pYou may link up with TRAINERS
around you who have also entered\lthe UNION ROOM.\pWith them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.\pSecond, the room on the right is
the DIRECT CORNER.\pYou may trade or battle POKéMON
with your friends in this room.\pIf the Wireless Adapter isn't
connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.\pIf that is the case, you must go
to the DIRECT CORNER.\pI hope you enjoy the Wireless 
Communication System.$
data/text/cable_club.inc.CableClub_Text_AskAboutLinking: Hello, {PLAYER}!\pIt's me, TEALA, the POKéMON\nCENTER 2F attendant.\pIs there something you needed to\nask me about linking?$
data/text/cable_club.inc.CableClub_Text_ExplainWirelessClub:
Let me explain how the POKéMON
WIRELESS CLUB works.\pOn this, the top floor, there are
two rooms.\pFirst, the room on the left.
It's the UNION ROOM.\pYou may link up with TRAINERS
around you who have also entered\lthe UNION ROOM.\pWith them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.\pSecond, the room on the right is
the DIRECT CORNER.\pYou may trade or battle POKéMON
with your friends in this room.\pSometimes, you may not be able to
find your friends in the UNION ROOM\lor the DIRECT CORNER.\pIn that case, please move closer
to your friends.\pIf the Wireless Adapter isn't
connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.\pIf that is the case, you must go
to the DIRECT CORNER.\pI hope you enjoy the Wireless 
Communication System.$

data/text/event_ticket_1.inc.EventTicket_Text_ShowOldSeaMap: The ferry to SLATEPORT is…\pI beg your pardon?\nCan we sail to this place on the map?\pI know someone who will help you better.\nPlease wait.$

data/text/event_ticket_1.inc.EventTicket_Text_ShowEonTicket:
Aye, mate, are you the one who brought
that mighty odd PASS?\pI'll tell you, you're trying to reach a
tiny spit of an island far in the south.\pThere's no telling what we'll encounter
once we reach there, aye.\lThat shivers my timbers!\pAll aboard!$

data/text/event_ticket_1.inc.SouthernIsland_Exterior_Text_Sign: “Those whose memories fade seek to\ncarve them in their hearts…”$

What's up, youngster?\pWhat, it's you who's supposed to have
a tattered old map?\pLet's have a look.
… … … … … …\pBoy, this is quite a ways away.

Is it you who brought that odd
ticket?\pWhere you're trying to go is an island
that's far, far away.\pNo one knows what awaits there…\pThe very thought excites my blood
as a sailing man!\pGet on board, youngster!$

data/text/lottery_corner.inc.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Lot:

get to draw a POKéMON LOTO TICKET.\pIf the LOTO TICKET's number matches
the ID number of any of your POKéMON,\lyou will receive a fabulous gift.\pWould you like to draw a POKéMON
LOTO TICKET?$
