data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Hillary_Battle: Hello, {PLAYER}.\nIt's HILLARY.\pMy POKéMON have graduated\nto the next level!\pCome test us on ROUTE 15!$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Rob_General1: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nROB here!\pVIRIDIAN FOREST is full\nof cool bugs!$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Rob_General2: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pI saw a BUG TYPE GYM\nLEADER in VIRIDIAN FOREST!$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Rob_Battle:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
ROB here!\pMy bug team is stronger
than ever!\pCome to ROUTE 2 for a
rematch!$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Nicole_General1:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
It's NICOLE!\pThe waves are great today!
My POKéMON love swimming\lin the open sea.\p{STR_VAR_3} is getting
so fast!$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Nicole_General2: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pSwimming with POKéMON is\nthe best exercise.$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Nicole_Battle: Hi, {PLAYER}!\nIt's NICOLE!\pMy water POKéMON are\nraring to battle!\pCome to ROUTE 20!$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Billy_General1:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
It's BILLY.\pI've been studying battle
strategies in class.\p{STR_VAR_3} and I have
been practicing them!$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Billy_General2: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pTests are coming up, but\nI'd rather be battling.\pBook smarts aren't\neverything, right?$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Billy_Battle: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nIt's BILLY.\pI learned some new tricks!\nCome to ROUTE 15!$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Kenny_General1: Hey there, {PLAYER}!\nKENNY here.\pWere all mountains really\nshaped by oceans and rivers?$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Kenny_General2: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pIt's KENNY here.\nI visited the PEWTER museum!\pDid you know the entire KANTO\nregion was once under water?$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Kenny_Battle:
Hey there, {PLAYER}!
KENNY here.\pI've trained hard in the
mountains!\pCome to ROUTE 13 for
a battle!$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Joel_General1:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
JOEL here.\pI've been working on
looking cool in battle.\p{STR_VAR_3} has some
flashy new moves!$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Joel_General2: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pJOEL here.\pThere was an accident on\nCYCLING ROAD.\pBeing safe is the coolest thing\nyou can be.$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Joel_Battle: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nJOEL here.\pI look AND fight cool now!\nCome to CYCLING ROAD!$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Charles_General1: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nCHARLES here.\pI was something of a\nheartbreaker in UNOVA.\pNow I'm a highway star!$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Charles_General2: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pCYCLING ROAD at night is\nsomething else.\pThe streetlights and the\nwind… it's freedom!$
data/text/match_call_hns.inc.MatchCall_HNS_Charles_Battle: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nCHARLES here.\pThe highway stars want\nrevenge! Come to\lCYCLING ROAD!$

data/text/mauville_man.inc.GiddyText_ISoWantToGoOnAVacation: I so want to go on a vacation.\nWould you happen to know a nice place?$
data/text/mauville_man.inc.GiddyText_IBoughtCrayonsWith120Colors: I bought crayons with 120 colors!\nDon't you think that's nice?$
data/text/mauville_man.inc.GiddyText_WouldntItBeNiceIfWeCouldFloat: Wouldn't it be nice if we could float\naway on a cloud of bubbles?$
data/text/mauville_man.inc.GiddyText_WhenYouWriteOnASandyBeach: When you write on a sandy beach,\nthey wash away. It makes me sad.$
data/text/mauville_man.inc.GiddyText_WhatsTheBottomOfTheSeaLike: What's the bottom of the sea like?\nJust once I would so love to go!$
data/text/mauville_man.inc.GiddyText_WhenYouSeeTheSettingSunDoesIt: When you see the setting sun, does it\nmake you want to go home?$
data/text/mauville_man.inc.GiddyText_LyingBackInTheGreenGrass: Lying back in the green grass…\nOh, it's so, so nice!$
data/text/mauville_man.inc.GiddyText_SecretBasesAreSoWonderful: SECRET BASES are so wonderful!\nCan't you feel the excitement?$

data/text/move_relearner.inc.MoveRelearner_Text_WouldLearnNewMoves: Hi, I'm the Move Relearner.\nWould you like to learn new moves?$
data/text/move_relearner.inc.MoveRelearner_Text_AnythingElse: Is there anything else I may do for you?$
data/text/move_relearner.inc.MoveRelearner_Text_CantTeachMoveToEgg: Sorry…\nBut an Egg can't learn moves.$
data/text/move_relearner.inc.MoveRelearner_Text_CantTeachMoveToPkmn: Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have any move\nI can teach that Pokémon.$
data/text/move_relearner.inc.MoveRelearner_Text_ThankYouComeAgain: Thank you for using our services.\nPlease come again!$

data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_ThisMoveCanOnlyBeLearnedO: This move can be learned only\nonce. Is that okay?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTeach:
Heh! My POKéMON totally rules!
It's cooler than any POKéMON!\pI was lipping off with a swagger in
my step like that when the CHAIRMAN\lchewed me out.\pThat took the swagger out of my step.\pIf you'd like, I'll teach the move
SWAGGER to a POKéMON of yours.$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerDeclined: What, no? Can't you get into\nthe spirit of things?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerWhichMon: All right, which POKéMON wants to\nlearn how to SWAGGER?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTaught: I'll just praise my POKéMON from now\non without the swagger.$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach:
Did you know that you can go from
here a long way in that direction\lwithout changing direction?\pI might even be able to roll
that way.\pDo you think your POKéMON will
want to roll, too?\pI can teach one the move ROLLOUT
if you'd like.$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_RolloutDeclined: You don't need to be shy about it.\nLet's roll!$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_RolloutWhichMon: Ehehe, sure thing! It'd be great if\nthe POKéMON looked like me.$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTaught: Rolling around in the grass makes me\nhappy. Come on, let's roll!$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTeach:
There's a move that gets stronger
when you keep using it in a row.\pIt's a BUG-type move, and it is
wickedly cool.\pIt's called FURY CUTTER.
Want me to teach it to a POKéMON?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterDeclined: We're not on the same wavelength.$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterWhichMon: Yay!\nShow me which POKéMON I should teach.$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTaught: I get a thrill watching to see if\nthe move keeps hitting in succession!$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_MimicTeach: Ah, young one!\pI am also a young one, but I mimic\nthe styles and speech of the elderly\lfolks of this town.\pWhat do you say, young one?\nWould you agree to it if I were to\loffer to teach the move MIMIC?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_MimicDeclined: Oh, boo! I wanted to teach MIMIC\nto your POKéMON!$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_MimicWhichMon: Fwofwo! And so I shall!\nLet me see the POKéMON\lyou wish me to teach.$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_MimicTaught: MIMIC is a move of great depth.\pCould you execute it to perfection\nas well as me…?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach:
I want all sorts of things!
But I used up my allowance…\pWouldn't it be nice if there were
a spell that made money appear when\lyou waggle a finger?\pIf you want, I can teach your POKéMON
the move METRONOME.\pMoney won't appear, but your POKéMON
will waggle a finger. Yes?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeDeclined: Okay. I'll be here if you change\nyour mind.$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeWhichMon: Okay! I'll teach it!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTaught: When a POKéMON waggles its finger\nlike a METRONOME, all sorts of nice\lthings happen.\pWouldn't it be nice if we could\nuse it, too?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach:
Humph! My wife relies on HIDDEN
POWER to stay awake.\pShe should just take a nap like I do,
and SLEEP TALK.\pI can teach your POKéMON how to
SLEEP TALK instead. Interested?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkDeclined: Oh, fine, fine. You want to stay awake\nwith HIDDEN POWER, too…$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkWhichMon: Ah, an appreciative child!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTaught: I've never once gotten my wife's\ncoin trick right.\pI would be happy if I got it right\neven as I SLEEP TALK…$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach:
When I see the wide world from up
here on the roof…\pI think about how nice it would be
if there were more than just one me\lso I could enjoy all sorts of lives.\pOf course it's not possible.
Giggle…\pI know! Would you be interested in
having a POKéMON learn SUBSTITUTE?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteDeclined: Oh, no?\pA POKéMON can make a copy of\nitself using it, you know.$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteWhichMon: Giggle…\nWhich POKéMON do you want me to\lteach SUBSTITUTE?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTaught: We human beings should enjoy our\nown lives to the utmost!\pI hope you'll get that way, too!$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach:
I can't do this anymore!\pIt's utterly hopeless!\pI'm a FIGHTING-type TRAINER,
so I can't win at the GYM\lno matter how hard I try!\pArgh! Punch! Punch! Punch!
Punch! Punch! Punch!\pWhat, don't look at me that way!
I'm only hitting the ground!\pOr do you want me to teach your
POKéMON DYNAMICPUNCH?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchDeclined: Darn! You're even making fun of me?\nPunch! Punch! Punch!$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchWhichMon: What? You do? You're a good person!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTaught: I want you to win at the CERULEAN GYM\nusing that DYNAMICPUNCH!$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach:
Sigh…\pThe GYM LEADER is really
lovably admirable.\pBut that also means I have many
rivals for his attention.\pHe's got appeal with a DOUBLE-EDGE.
I couldn't even catch his eye.\pPlease, let me teach your POKéMON
the move DOUBLE-EDGE!$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeWhichMon: Okay, which POKéMON should I teach\nDOUBLE-EDGE?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTaught: I won't live for love anymore!\nI'll become tough!$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTeach:
I don't intend to be going nowhere
fast in the sticks like this forever.\pYou watch me, I'll get out to the city
and become a huge hit.\pSeriously, I'm going to cause
a huge EXPLOSION of popularity!\pIf you overheard that, I'll happily
teach EXPLOSION to your POKéMON!$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionDeclined: Gaah! You're turning me down because\nI live in the country?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionWhichMon: Fine! An EXPLOSION it is!\nWhich POKéMON wants to blow up?$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTaught: For a long time, I've taught POKéMON\nhow to use EXPLOSION, but I've yet\lto ignite my own EXPLOSION…\pMaybe it's because deep down,\nI would rather stay here…$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_HeadbuttTeach: What am I doing?\pI'm shaking trees using HEADBUTT.\pDo you think your POKéMON will\nwant to HEADBUTT, too?\pI can teach one the move HEADBUTT\nif you'd like. It's fun!$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_HeadbuttWhichMon: Ehehe, sure thing! It'd be great if\nthe POKéMON looked like me.$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_HeadbuttDeclined: You don't need to be shy about it.\nLet's butt heads!$
data/text/move_tutors.inc.MoveTutor_Text_HeadbuttTaught: Rattle trees with HEADBUTT.\nSometimes, sleeping POKéMON fall out.$

data/text/oak_speech_hns.inc.gText_Oak_Welcome: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!\pWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\pMy name is OAK.\pPeople call me the POKéMON\nPROFESSOR.\p$
data/text/oak_speech_hns.inc.gText_Oak_Pokemon: This is what we call a “POKéMON.”\p\n$
data/text/oak_speech_hns.inc.gText_Oak_MainSpeech:
This world is widely inhabited by
creatures known as POKéMON.\pPeople and POKéMON live together,
by supporting each other.\pSome people play with POKéMON,
some battle with them. \pBut we don't know everything about
POKéMON yet. \pThere are still many mysteries
to solve. That's why I study\lPOKéMON every day.\p$
data/text/oak_speech_hns.inc.gText_Oak_BoyOrGirl: Are you a boy?\nOr are you a girl?$
data/text/oak_speech_hns.inc.gText_Oak_ChallengeSelected: That sounds like the right\nlevel of challenge to me!$
data/text/oak_speech_hns.inc.gText_Oak_YourePlayer: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are you ready?\pYour very own adventure is about\nto unfold.\p$
data/text/oak_speech_hns.inc.gText_Oak_AreYouReady: You'll face fun times and tough\nchallenges.\pA world of dreams and adventures\nwith POKéMON awaits! Let's go!\pI'll be seeing you later!\p$

data/text/obtain_item.inc.gText_NoRoomLeftForAnother: Too bad! There's no room left for\nanother {STR_VAR_2}…$
data/text/obtain_item.inc.gText_PutCoinsAwayInCoinCase: {PLAYER} put the COINS away in\nthe COIN CASE.$
data/text/obtain_item.inc.gText_CoinCaseIsFull: Too bad!\nThe COIN CASE is full…$
data/text/obtain_item.inc.gText_NothingToPutThemIn: Too bad!\nThere's nothing to put them in…$

data/text/pc_transfer.inc.gText_PkmnTransferredSomeonesPC: {STR_VAR_2} was transferred to\nSOMEONE'S PC.\pIt was placed in \nBOX “{STR_VAR_1}.”$
data/text/pc_transfer.inc.gText_PkmnTransferredSomeonesPCBoxFull: BOX “{STR_VAR_3}” on\nSOMEONE'S PC was full.\p{STR_VAR_2} was transferred to\nBOX “{STR_VAR_1}.”$
data/text/pc_transfer.inc.gText_PkmnSentToPCAfterCatch: {STR_VAR_2} was sent to\n{B_PC_CREATOR_NAME} PC.\pIt was placed in \nBOX “{STR_VAR_1}”.$
data/text/pc_transfer.inc.gText_NoMoreRoomForPokemon: There's no more room for POKéMON!\pThe POKéMON BOXES are full and\ncan't accept any more!$
data/text/pc_transfer.inc.gText_NicknameThisPokemon: Do you want to give a nickname to\nthis {STR_VAR_1}?$

data/text/pkmn_center_nurse.inc.gText_WouldYouLikeToRestYourPkmn: Hello, and welcome to\nthe POKéMON CENTER.\pWe restore your tired POKéMON\nto full health.\pWould you like to rest your POKéMON?$
data/text/pkmn_center_nurse.inc.gText_IllTakeYourPkmn: Okay, I'll take your POKéMON\nfor a few seconds.$
data/text/pkmn_center_nurse.inc.gText_RestoredPkmnToFullHealth: Thank you for waiting.\pWe've restored your POKéMON\nto full health.$
data/text/pkmn_center_nurse.inc.gText_WeHopeToSeeYouAgain: We hope to see you again!$
data/text/pkmn_center_nurse.inc.gText_WelcomeCutShort: Hello, and welcome to\nthe POKéMON CENTER.\pWe restore your tired POKéMON\nto full health.\pWould you like to…$
data/text/pkmn_center_nurse.inc.gText_NoticesGoldCard:
Th-that card…
Could it be… The GOLD CARD?!\pOh, the gold color is brilliant!
The four stars seem to sparkle!\pI've seen several TRAINERS with
a SILVER CARD before, but, {PLAYER},\lyou're the first TRAINER I've ever\lseen with a GOLD CARD!\pOkay, {PLAYER}, please allow me
the honor of resting your POKéMON!$
data/text/pkmn_center_nurse.inc.gText_YouWantTheUsual: I'm delighted to see you, {PLAYER}!\nYou want the usual, am I right?$
data/text/pkmn_center_nurse.inc.gText_IllTakeYourPkmn2: Okay, I'll take your POKéMON\nfor a few seconds.$
data/text/pkmn_center_nurse.inc.gText_WeHopeToSeeYouAgain2: We hope to see you again!$

data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_AreYouCurious: PROF. BIRCH: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pAre you curious about how your\nPOKéDEX is coming along?$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_Cancel: Hm? Oh, you haven't caught enough\nPOKéMON to make it worthwhile.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_SoYouveSeenAndCaught: Hmhm…\pSo, you've seen {STR_VAR_1} POKéMON,\nand you've caught {STR_VAR_2} POKéMON…$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan10: Go into grassy areas more and look\nfor POKéMON more carefully.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan20: I guess you're getting the hang\nof it. But, it gets harder from here.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan30: Some POKéMON only appear in\ncertain areas.\lYou must be persistent.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan40: Well, it could use more quantity,\nbut this is looking more like\la POKéDEX now.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan50: This is coming along pretty good.\nKeep up the effort.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan60: Are you using any RODS?\nThere are many POKéMON in the sea.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan70: Instead of just catching POKéMON,\nhow about making them evolve, too?$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan80: This is going to be a fantastic\nPOKéDEX.\lThat's the feeling I'm getting.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan90: You've collected this many…\nYour talent is remarkable!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan100: Have you visited the SAFARI ZONE?\pI hear there are some POKéMON that\ncan only be caught there.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan110: You've finally reached\nthe 100-kind mark.\pThis is an impressive POKéDEX!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan120: There might be POKéMON that can be\nfound using ROCK SMASH.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan130: You should get some more POKéMON\nby trading with others.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan140: I've heard of POKéMON that evolve\nwhen they come to fully love their\lTRAINERS.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan150: I had no idea that there were so\nmany POKéMON species in the HOENN\lregion.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan160: On occasion, some POKéMON appear\nin large numbers like outbreaks.\pDon't miss opportunities like\nthose.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan170: One can get a very good idea about\nthe POKéMON of the HOENN region\lby looking through your POKéDEX.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan180: I would say you already qualify as\na POKéMON PROFESSOR, and a good\lone, too!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan190: With a POKéDEX this complete,\nyou're a real professional at this!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan200: You're very close to completing\nthis POKéDEX.\lI can feel it in my bones!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gBirchDexRatingText_OnANationwideBasis: Hmhm…\nOn a nationwide basis…\pYou've seen {STR_VAR_1} POKéMON,\nand you've caught {STR_VAR_2} POKéMON…$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_HowIsPokedexComingAlo: OAK: Good to see you!\nHow is your POKéDEX coming along?\pHere, let me take a look.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_SeenXOwnedY: The amount of progress you've made\non your POKéDEX is:\p{STR_VAR_1} POKéMON seen and\n{STR_VAR_2} POKéMON owned.\p{FONT_NORMAL}PROF. OAK's rating:$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan10: You still have lots to do.\pGo into every patch of grass you\nsee and look for POKéMON!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan20: It looks as if you're getting on\nthe right track!\pI've given one of my AIDES a FLASH\nHM. Make sure you go get it!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan30: Your POKéDEX could use a bit more\nvolume still!\pTry to catch other species of\nPOKéMON!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan40: Good, it's apparent that you're\ntrying hard!\pI've given one of my AIDES an\nITEMFINDER. Be sure to collect it!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan50: Your POKéDEX is coming along quite\nwell!\pI've given one of my AIDES an\nAMULET COIN. Be sure to get it!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan60: Ah, you've finally topped 50\nspecies!\pI've given one of my AIDES an EXP.\nSHARE. Be sure to go get it!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan70: Hoho! This is turning into quite the\nrespectable POKéDEX!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan80: Very good!\pI think you'll collect even more\nPOKéMON by going fishing!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan90: Wonderful! Let me guess… You\nlike to collect things, don't you?$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan100: I'm impressed!\nIt must have been difficult to do!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan110: You've finally hit 100 species!\nI can't believe how good you are!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan120: You even have the evolved forms\nof POKéMON! Super!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan130: Excellent! Trade with friends to\nget some more!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan140: Outstanding!\nYou've become a real pro at this!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan150: I have nothing left to say!\nYou're the POKéMON PROFESSOR now!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_NationalDexSeenXOwned: And your NATIONAL POKéDEX is:\p{STR_VAR_1} POKéMON seen and\n{STR_VAR_2} POKéMON owned.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LookForwardToFilledNa: I'll be looking forward to seeing\nyou fill the NATIONAL POKéDEX!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_YouveCompletedDex: Finally…\pYou've finally completed the\nPOKéDEX!\pIt's magnificent!\nTruly, this is a fantastic feat!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_ThankYouMadeDreamReal: Thank you, {PLAYER}!\nSincerely, thank you!\lYou've made my dream a reality!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.PokedexRating_Text_LoveSeeingYourPokedex: OAK: Ah, welcome!\pTell me, how is your POKéDEX\ncoming along?\pWahaha!\pActually, I know how it is, but I\nlove seeing it anyway!\pLet's see…$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gElmDexRatingText_GoFindMrPokemon: PROF. ELM: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHave you found MR. POKéMON's\nhome yet? It is on ROUTE 30,\pyou can't miss it!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gElmDexRatingText_Robbery: PROF. ELM: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pGet here quick! Something\nawful has happened!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gElmDexRatingText_AreYouCurious: PROF. ELM: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pAre you curious about how your\nPOKéDEX is coming along?$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gElmDexRatingText_AreYouCuriousNational: PROF. ELM: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pAre you curious about how your\nNational POKéDEX is coming along?$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan10: Look for POKéMON in grassy areas!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan20: Good. I see you understand how to\nuse Poké Balls.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan35: You're getting good at this,\nbut you have a long way to go.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan50: Hmm, you're catching POKéMON at a\ndecent pace!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan65: You're trying--I can see that.\nYour POKéDEX is coming together.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan80: You're training them well. You know\nsome POKéMON don't evolve just by\pbattling with others, right?$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan95: Do you have a Fishing Rod?\nThere are some POKéMON that can\ponly be found by fishing!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan110: Excellent! You seem to be good at\ncollecting things!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan125: Some POKéMON only appear during\ncertain times of the day.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan140: Your POKéDEX is really filling up.\nKeep up the good work!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan155: I'm impressed.\nYou're evolving POKéMON, not just\pcatching them.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan170: If you can learn how to use the\ncustom Poké Balls made by Kurt\peffectively, you'll be able to catch\nPOKéMON better!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan185: When you trade POKéMON, you can\nalso trade information. Your\pfriends can really help you!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan200: Are you trading your POKéMON?\nIt's tough to do this alone!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan215: Wow! You've reached 200!\nYour POKéDEX is looking great!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan230: You've proven yourself capable.\nThere's nothing to worry about.\pKeep catching POKéMON the way\nyou've been doing so far.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan245: Your POKéDEX is well on the way to\nbeing filled up.\pThis POKéDEX can be considered a\njournal of your adventure.$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan260: You've found so many POKéMON!\nYou've really helped my studies!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan275: Magnificent! You have the ability\nto become a great POKéMON\pProfessor someday!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThanMaxDex: Your POKéDEX is amazing!\nYou're ready to turn professional!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gJohtoDexRatingText_Complete:
Wow!
That is a complete Johto POKéDEX!\pThanks to you, {PLAYER}, the Johto
POKéDEX is complete!\pWow...
You've done an incredible job!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan100: The goal may be far away, but don't\ngive up yet! Keep going!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan150: Don't forget, some POKéMON only\nappear at certain times of the day!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan200: If you break rocks, some POKéMON\nthat were hiding there might come\pjumping out!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan250: That's wonderful you've been able\nto gather this many POKéMON!\pThe path ahead is long. Keep up the\ngreat work!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan300: If you Headbutt a tree, sometimes\na POKéMON might fall out!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan350: A lot of POKéMON not found in the\nJohto region like to congregate\pat the Safari Zone$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan400: There are hidden locations all\nover the world containing rare\pand unusual POKéMON, try to find\nthem all!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan435: Wow, you've gotten so far...!\nI'm actually a little surprised!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan465: This is a critical moment!\nYou can't become discouraged!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan475: Just a little more!\nI've got high expectations for you!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gNationalDexRatingText_LessThanMaxDex: I have never before in all my years\nseen such an incredible Trainer!$
data/text/pokedex_rating.inc.gNationalDexRatingText_Complete:
Excellent! That is an amazing
National POKéDEX!\pWow...{PAUSE 10}\pYou've lived up to my
expectations wonderfully!\pNo, you've exceeded them, {PLAYER}.
You've become an amazing Trainer!\pThank you, {PLAYER}!$

data/text/pokemon_news.inc.gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Upcoming:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pSLATEPORT's most popular kind of guy,
the ENERGY GURU, is in the news again!\pHe promises to, “Stupendously go for
it in just this many days: {STR_VAR_1}!”\pWhile he refused to elaborate on what
he will stupendously go for, the\lENERGY GURU advised, “Save up your\lmoney. That'll be good…”\pIt sounds like a trip to SLATEPORT
would be well worth your while that day.\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
data/text/pokemon_news.inc.gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Ongoing:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pThis is the news you've all been
waiting for!\pSLATEPORT'S ENERGY GURU is going
for it stupendously in the MARKET!\pHe promises unbeatable bargain
prices on CALCIUM and PROTEIN!\pA trip to SLATEPORT CITY sounds
worthwhile. Why not visit and shop\lto your heart's content?\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
data/text/pokemon_news.inc.gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Ending:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pThis is the news you've all been

data/text/pokemon_news.inc.gPokeNewsTextBlendMaster_Upcoming:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pWe have big news for everyone
involved in the making of ポロックS.\pThe legendary BLEND MASTER will be
appearing in LILYCOVE CITY with just\la mere {STR_VAR_1}-day wait to go!\pThe BLEND MASTER is said to be
the best in all HOENN when it comes to\lspinning a BERRY BLENDER.\pThose people who want to make great
ポロックS or see the MASTER in action\lare urged to save their BERRIES.\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
data/text/pokemon_news.inc.gPokeNewsTextBlendMaster_Ongoing:

data/text/pokemon_news.inc.gPokeNewsTextBlendMaster_Ending:

It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pIt's incredible!
Too incredible, even!\pThe BERRY BLENDER is spinning at
a dizzying pace!\pThe BLEND MASTER has lived up to
his reputation!\pThe BLEND MASTER will soon be
leaving LILYCOVE.\pIf you haven't seen the MASTER in

data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer0Intro: Have you made a SECRET BASE already?\pI went here, there, everywhere before\nchoosing this place.\pSince you're already here, how would\nyou like to battle?$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer0Defeated: Waaargh! You're too strong!\nAbout me losing… Please keep it secret!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PostBattle: What do you think of my SECRET BASE?\nCome visit me again tomorrow.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PreChampion: Have you made a SECRET BASE already?\pI went here, there, everywhere before\nchoosing this place.\pFeel free to hang out!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Intro: There're a lot of places where\nyou can make a SECRET BASE.\pBut I like this spot best.\nDon't you think it's nice?\pOh, would you like to have a battle?$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Defeated: Hmmm… It's our loss…\nBut don't tell anyone!\lIt's a confidential secret!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PostBattle: If you're in this area again,\nI hope you'll visit me.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PreChampion: There're a lot of places where you can\nmake a SECRET BASE.\pBut I like this spot best.\nDon't you think it's nice?$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Intro:
This is a popular spot.
It's always taken.\pOh! Were you thinking about
taking this spot, too?\pI'll tell you what, you can have this
spot if you can beat me.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer1AcceptBattle: Okay!\nI'm going to defend my SECRET BASE!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer1DeclineBattle: Hunh? Is that right?\nYou're not interested in this spot?$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PostBattle: Okay, when I move one day,\nthis place will be yours!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PreChampion: This is a popular spot.\nIt's always taken.\pI waited a long time for it to open.\nI finally got to use it!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Intro: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.\pI carry out research on battling in\nsecrecy.\pWould you like to see how strong I am?$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer6AcceptBattle: I'm going to go all out!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Defeated: Hmm… I've still got lots to learn.\nI have to study some more.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PostBattle: Thanks for battling with me.\nPlease come back again tomorrow.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PreChampion: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.\pI carry out research on battling in\nsecrecy.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Intro: A big mansion is nice, but I like this\nsort of place more.\pI like it because all kinds of people\ncome visit me.\pSo, how would you like a battle?$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer2DeclineBattle: When you're ready, give me a shout!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Defeated: Aww! Done in!\nBut it's still fun to battle!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PostBattle: Well, anyway, I should go buy some\ndecorations and furniture.\pI want my SECRET BASE to be a place\nother people can enjoy.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PreChampion: A big mansion is nice, but I like this\nsort of place more.\pI like it because all kinds of people\ncome visit me.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Intro:
I simply adore shopping for decorations
and furniture.\pI also love raising POKéMON just
as much.\pIf you would be so kind, will you battle
with my POKéMON?$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PostBattle: That was all in good fun!\nI should go enjoy shopping now.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PreChampion: I simply adore shopping for decorations\nand furniture.\pI also love raising POKéMON just\nas much.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Intro: Some people make their SECRET BASES in\nhard-to-find places.\lDo they want to just lie low?\pBut since you found me, how about we\nhave a battle?$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer3DeclineBattle: Oh… Are you maybe tired from searching\nfor this place?$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PostBattle: Where's your SECRET BASE?\nI should go visit you there.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PreChampion: Some people make their SECRET BASES in\nhard-to-find places.\lDo they want to just lie low?$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Intro: People have told me that you can get\ndecorations in several ways.\pWe should have a race to see who can\nget nicer decorations and furniture!\pIn the meantime, want to battle?$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer8AcceptBattle: This is my SECRET BASE.\nI can't lose!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PostBattle: I won't lose at collecting decorations.\nCome visit again!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PreChampion: People have told me that you can get\ndecorations in several ways.\pWe should have a race to see who can\nget nicer decorations and furniture!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Intro:
I found a spot I liked, and I did it up
with my favorite decorations.\pI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow
stronger with it.\pThat's what I do.
Want to battle with me?$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer4AcceptBattle: Show me what you're made of!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer4DeclineBattle: I guess there are times when you're not\ninto it.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Defeated: I know exactly what you're made of now.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PostBattle: We can both become stronger.\nLet's keep at it!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PreChampion: I found a spot I liked, and I did it up\nwith my favorite decorations.\pI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow\nstronger with it.\pEvery day is a great day.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Intro: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\ldecorations they have, and how they\ldisplay them.\pWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?\pWant to see my taste in battling?$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer9DeclineBattle: I'll be happy to demonstrate my style\nanytime.$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Defeated: You're supremely talented!\nYour power seems to be limitless…$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PostBattle: What did you think of my style?\nI'll keep on polishing it!$
data/text/secret_base_trainers.inc.SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PreChampion: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\ldecorations they have, and how they\ldisplay them.\pWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?$

data/text/shoal_cave.inc.ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_AreYo:
Are you planning on going deep
in there?\pHow about bringing me back some
SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS?\pI can make you something good if
you bring me the ingredients.$
data/text/shoal_cave.inc.ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_Bring: If you bring me four each of the\nSHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS,\lI can make you a SHELL BELL…\pYou can get those ingredients\nevery day.$
data/text/shoal_cave.inc.ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_Would: Oh, hey! SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS!\nAnd enough of them, too!\pWould you like me to make you\na SHELL BELL with them?$
data/text/shoal_cave.inc.ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_MakeS: All righty, then! I'll make you\na SHELL BELL right away.\p… … … … … … … …\n… … … … … … … …\pThere! Done!$
data/text/shoal_cave.inc.ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_Expla:
Have a POKéMON hold on to that.
It'll love it, that's for certain.\pWhy, the SHELL BELL's chime…
It's simply sublime!\pYou can get its ingredients every day,
so I can make you more.$
data/text/shoal_cave.inc.ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_Wante: Oh… Is that so…\nI wanted to make a SHELL BELL…$
data/text/shoal_cave.inc.ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_NoSpa: You don't have space in your BAG\nif I were to make it for you.\pYou should make room and come back\nfor a SHELL BELL.$
data/text/shoal_cave.inc.ShoalCave_Text_WasShoalSaltNowNothing: There was some SHOAL SALT here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.$
data/text/shoal_cave.inc.ShoalCave_Text_WasShoallShellNowNothing: There was a SHOAL SHELL here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.$

data/text/surf.inc.gText_WantToUseSurf: The water is dyed a deep blue…\nWould you like to SURF?$
data/text/surf.inc.Text_CurrentTooFast: The current is much too fast!\nSURF can't be used here…$

data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_CalvinIntro: If you have POKéMON with you, then\nyou're an official POKéMON TRAINER!\lYou can't say no to my challenge!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_CalvinDefeated: Arrgh, I lost…\nI should have trained mine more…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_CalvinPostBattle: Listen, you. If you're strong,\nyou should have told me before!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_CalvinRegister: I've been working hard at this since\nI saw you before.\pI'd like to battle you again, so can\nyou register me in your POKéNAV?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_CalvinRegisterShort: I'd like to battle you again, so can\nyou register me in your POKéNAV?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_CalvinRematchIntro: Ever since I lost to you, I desperately\ntrained my POKéMON.\lYou can't say no to my challenge!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_CalvinRematchDefeated: Arrgh, I lost…\nIs my training method not right?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_CalvinRematchPostBattle: If you're going to get stronger,\nI'll get stronger, too.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_AllenIntro: Did you just become a TRAINER?\nWe're both beginners!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_AllenDefeated: I called you because I thought\nI could beat you…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_AllenPostBattle: I haven't won once yet…\nI wish I would win soon…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_RickIntro: Hahah! Our eyes met!\nI'll take you on with my BUG POKéMON!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_RickPostBattle: If you lock eyes with a TRAINER,\nyou have to challenge! It's a rule!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_TianaIntro: I'm going to keep winning and aim\nto be the best TRAINER.\pHelp me further my career!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_TianaDefeated: I ended up furthering your career…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route102_Text_TianaPostBattle: To keep winning my way up, I see that\nI have to catch more POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_DaisyIntro: Did you feel the tug of our\nsoul-soothing fragrance?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_DaisyDefeated: You weren't led astray by our aroma…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_DaisyPostBattle: Aromatherapy is a form of mental\nhealing that works with fragrances.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_AmyIntro: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\lWe battle together!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_AmyPostBattle: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\lagainst two TRAINERS.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_AmyNotEnoughPokemon: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\lYou can't battle us like that.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_LivIntro: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_LivDefeated: LIV: Oh, we lost, big sister…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_LivPostBattle: LIV: We work perfectly together,\nme and my big sister…\pBut we still lost…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_AmyLivRegister: LIV: Really, we're a lot better…\nIt's true! We'll show you next time!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_LivNotEnoughPokemon: LIV: If you want to battle us,\nyou have to have two POKéMON!\lIt's not fair if you don't!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_AmyRematchIntro: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\lWe battle together!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_AmyRematchDefeated: AMY: Aww, boo!\nWe couldn't win again…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_AmyRematchPostBattle: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\lagainst two TRAINERS.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_AmyRematchNotEnoughPokemon: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\lYou can't battle us like that.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_LivRematchIntro: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_LivRematchDefeated: LIV: Awww, we lost again…\nBig sister…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_LivRematchPostBattle: LIV: We work perfectly together,\nme and my big sister…\pBut why did we lose again?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_LivRematchNotEnoughPokemon: LIV: If you want to battle us, you\nhave to have two POKéMON!\lIt's not fair if you don't!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_AndrewIntro: Gah! My fishing line's all snarled up!\nI'm getting frustrated and mean!\lThat's it! Battle me!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_AndrewDefeated: Gah! Lost it!\nI'm even more annoyed now!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_MiguelIntro: My POKéMON is delightfully adorable!\nDon't be shy--I'll show you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_MiguelPostBattle: My delightful POKéMON looks darling\neven when it's fainted!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_MiguelRegister: I'll get you to come out and look in\non my delightful POKéMON again!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_MiguelRematchIntro: Hi, you! My delightfully adorable\nPOKéMON has become more darling!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_MiguelRematchPostBattle: The more I spend time with it,\nthe more adorable my POKéMON becomes.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_PeteIntro: This sort of distance…\nYou should just swim it!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_PetePostBattle: Oh, I understand where you're coming\nfrom now.\pIf I had a POKéMON that trusty,\nI'd want to SURF on it, too!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_IsabelleIntro: Watch where you're going!\nWe're going to crash!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_IsabellePostBattle: I'm a poor swimmer so I was practicing…\nSorry for almost crashing into you.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_RhettIntro: Whoa!\nHow'd you get into a space this small?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_RhettPostBattle: Do you like cramped quarters\nlike this?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_MarcosIntro: Did my guitar's wailing draw you in?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route103_Text_MarcosPostBattle: I was playing my guitar where few\npeople were around, but a lot of fans\lhave gathered.\pHeh, maybe I should turn pro.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_GinaIntro: GINA: Okay, let's battle with our\nPOKéMON!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_GinaPostBattle: GINA: You are strong!\nWe have to train lots more!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_GinaNotEnoughMons: GINA: Oh? Only one POKéMON?\nThen, we don't battle with you.\pIf there's only one POKéMON, it will\nbe lonesome. That's not nice.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_MiaIntro: MIA: We are twins, so we battle\nPOKéMON together.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_MiaDefeat: MIA: We battled together, but we\nboth lost…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_MiaPostBattle: MIA: We will train our POKéMON more\nand be strong like you.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_MiaNotEnoughMons: MIA: You want to battle with us?\pIt's a big no-no if you don't have two\nPOKéMON with you.\lWe're too strong for you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_IvanIntro: Why keep it a secret?\nI'm the WATER POKéMON expert!\pHuh?\nYou don't know me?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_IvanDefeat: I thought I wasn't too bad, if I may\nsay so, but I guess not… Bleah…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_IvanPostBattle: I got too into fishing.\nI forgot I had to raise my POKéMON…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_BillyIntro: Leaving footprints in the sand is\nso fun!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_BillyDefeat: Waah! I got sand in my runners!\nThey're all gritty!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_BillyPostBattle: I want to leave my footprints in\nthe sand everywhere, but they\ldisappear quickly…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_HaleyIntro: Should I…\nOr shouldn't I?\pOkay, sure, I will battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_HaleyPostBattle: If you're faced with a decision and\nyou let someone else choose for you,\lyou will regret it, however things\lturn out.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_HaleyRegister1: You're strong, but should I register\nyou in my POKéNAV?\lMaybe I shouldn't…\pOkay, sure, I will register you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_HaleyRegister2: You're strong, but should I register\nyou in my POKéNAV?\lMaybe I shouldn't…\pOkay, sure, I will register you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_HaleyPostRematch: I made the decision to battle, so\nI can accept this loss with grace.\pI am still upset about losing!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_WinstonIntro: Oh, sure, I'll accept your challenge.\nI have a lot of money.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_WinstonPostBattle: There are some things money can't buy.\nThat's POKéMON…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_WinstonRegister1: Hm?\nAh, you've obtained a POKéNAV.\pI will gladly register you.\nAfter all, I have plenty of money.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_WinstonRegister2: Hm?\nAh, you've obtained a POKéNAV.\pI will gladly register you.\nAfter all, I have plenty of money.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_WinstonRematchIntro: After I lost to you, I learned a bunch\nof things about POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_WinstonRematchDefeat: I lost again?\nWhy couldn't I win?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_WinstonPostRematch: I'm fabulously wealthy, but I can't\nseem to win at POKéMON…\pIt's so deep, the world of POKéMON…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_CindyIntro: We must have been fated to meet.\nMay I ask you for a battle?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_CindyPostBattle: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_CindyRegister1: Hello, we meet again.\pWe seem to be drawn together. Let's\nregister each other in our POKéNAVS.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_CindyRegister2: We should commemorate how we seem\nto be drawn to each other.\pLet's register each other in our\nPOKéNAVS.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_CindyRematchIntro: Hello, we meet again.\nMay I ask you for a battle?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_CindyRematchDefeat: Oh, my…\nI did the best that I could…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_CindyPostRematch: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_DarianIntro: I fished up a tough-looking POKéMON!\pIt has this magical quality to it!\nIt surely looks tough, yes it does!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route104_Text_DarianPostBattle: Hey, MAGIKARP, you sure don't live up\nto your name, do you?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_FosterIntro: There's supposed to be a mystical\nrock around here.\lDo you know anything about it?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_FosterDefeated: I was thinking too much about that\nrock, while my POKéMON remained weak…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_FosterPostBattle: I can spend hours and hours staring\nat a nice rock without growing bored.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_LuisIntro: Whew! I was worried that a kid was\ndrowning when I saw you.\pYou seem to be okay, so what do you\nsay to a battle?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_LuisPostBattle: If you are drowning, the signal is to\nwave one arm toward the beach.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_DominikIntro: Swimming the deep blue sea…\nIt feels the greatest!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_DominikPostBattle: Why is the sea blue?\pI learned about that at the MUSEUM in\nSLATEPORT, but I forgot.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_BeverlyIntro: My body feels lighter in the water.\nIt's as if I've gotten slimmer!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_PostBattle: Your body weight is reduced to just\none tenth in the water.\pThat would make me…\nWhoops! I'm not telling you my weight!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_ImaniIntro: The blue, blue sky…\nThe vast sea…\lIt's so peaceful…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_ImaniDefeated: I lost while I was lounging!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_ImaniPostBattle: I want to be told I'm relaxing to be\nwith. Giggle.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_AndresIntro: I'm convinced that the sea keeps\nsecrets from us.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_AndresDefeated: Yes…\nI am no good at battling…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_AndresPostBattle: I'm sure there are many secrets to be\ndiscovered in the world's seas.\pI mean to find them all!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_AndresRegister: Huh? I'm so weak, but you're willing\nto register me in your POKéNAV?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_AndresRematchIntro: I've told you that I'm weak…\nAre you sure you want to do this?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_AndresRematchDefeated: Yes…\nI didn't think I could win.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_AndresRematchPostBattle: I may be weak at battling, but my\ndrive to explore can't be bested.\pI will travel the seas all around\nthe world!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_JosueIntro: I'm exhausted from swimming.\nI'm just not used to it.\pI need a battle for a change of pace!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_JosueDefeated: I lost because I battled at sea.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route105_Text_JosuePostBattle: Yeah, for me, the sky is a much better\nmatch than the sea.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route106_Text_ElliotIntro: Which do you prefer, fishing in the\nsea or a stream?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route106_Text_ElliotDefeated: Like in deep-sea fishing, I lost\nspectacularly!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route106_Text_ElliotPostBattle: Fishing is the greatest whether it's\nin the sea or a stream.\lYou agree with me, right?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route106_Text_ElliotRegister: Fishing's great, but so is battling.\nIf you don't mind, can we meet again?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route106_Text_ElliotRematchIntro: I caught a bunch of POKéMON fishing.\nI'll show you an impressive battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route106_Text_ElliotRematchPostBattle: Win or lose, POKéMON are the greatest!\nYou agree with me, right?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route106_Text_NedIntro: What do people do if they need to go\nto a washroom?\pWhat if my ROD hooks a big one while\nI'm in the washroom? I just can't go…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route106_Text_NedDefeated: I lost because I'm trying to not go\nto the washroom…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route106_Text_NedPostBattle: Oh, no! I've got this feeling I'll hook\na big one!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route106_Text_DouglasIntro: Hahahah! I'm a lousy runner, but in\nthe water you can't catch me!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route106_Text_DouglasPostBattle: I wouldn't lose in a swim race…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route106_Text_KylaIntro: The sea is my backyard. I'm not going\nto take it easy because you're a kid!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route106_Text_KylaDefeated: Did you take it easy on me by any\nchance?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route106_Text_KylaPostBattle: Drifting along with the waves…\nI love it! Why don't you give it a try?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_DarrinIntro: Yawn…\pI must have drifted off to sleep while\nI was drifting in the waves.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_DarrinDefeated: Ahaha, I lost…\nI'll take a snooze, I think…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_DarrinPostBattle: Floating and being rocked by\nthe waves--it's like sleeping in\la plush, comfy bed.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_TonyIntro: The sea is like my backyard.\nLet's battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_TonyDefeated: I lost on my home field…\nI'm in shock!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_TonyPostBattle: I swim the seas with a heart full of\ndreams…\pIt's a song!\nAnyways, I'm swimming some more.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_TonyRegister: You've shocked me to the bone!\nWell, so you won't forget me…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_TonyRematchIntro: Swimming in the big, wide sea,\nmy POKéMON has grown stronger!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_TonyRematchDefeated: What a shock!\pMy POKéMON has gotten stronger, but\nI stayed weak as a TRAINER!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_TonyRematchPostBattle: What you learn in battle makes you\na stronger TRAINER.\lThe waves taught me that.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_DeniseIntro: Do you know a little town called\nDEWFORD?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_DenisePostBattle: A weird saying is getting really\ntrendy at DEWFORD HALL.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_BethIntro: Did you want to battle me?\nSure, I'll go with you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_BethDefeated: I wasn't good enough for you.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_BethPostBattle: I think you're going to keep getting\nbetter. I'll go for it, too!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_LisaIntro: LISA: We challenge you as a sister\nand brother!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_LisaDefeated: LISA: Awesome.\nYou're in a different class of tough.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_LisaPostBattle: LISA: Do you have any friends who\nwould go to the beach with you?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_LisaNotEnoughPokemon: LISA: If you want to battle with us,\nbring more POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_RayIntro: RAY: We always battle POKéMON,\nme and my sister.\pI always lose, but we can beat you\n2-on-2!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_RayDefeated: RAY: Wowee, you're at a higher level\nthan us!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_RayPostBattle: RAY: My sister gave me my POKéMON.\nI raised it, and now it's my important\lpartner!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_RayNotEnoughPokemon: RAY: If you want to battle us,\ngo bring some more POKéMON!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_CamronIntro: I'm in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut I'm nowhere near tired!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route107_Text_CamronPostBattle: I still have swimming and running left\nto do after this.\pAm I going to be okay?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_JeromeIntro: My dream is to swim the world's seven\nseas!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_JeromeDefeated: I won't be able to swim the seven seas\nlike this…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_JeromePostBattle: Playing with marine POKéMON is one of\nthe pleasures of swimming!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_MatthewIntro: Ahoy, there! Are you going out to\nthe ABANDONED SHIP, too?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_MatthewPostBattle: Some people even go inside that\nABANDONED SHIP.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_TaraIntro: My liar of a boyfriend told me that\nI look great in a bikini…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_TaraPostBattle: Even if it's a lie, I love being told\nI look great…\lWe girls are so complex…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_MissyIntro: I love the sea!\nI forget all my worries when I swim!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_MissyDefeated: When I lose a battle, I get all\nstressed out!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_MissyPostBattle: Work off your stress by swimming!\nIt's so healthy!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_CoryIntro: I love WATER-type POKéMON.\nI love other POKéMON, too!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_CoryPostBattle: Shouting is good for me!\nIt uplifts me!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_CoryRegister: I love tough TRAINERS, too!\nRegister me in your POKéNAV!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_CoryRematchIntro: Win or lose, I love battling at sea!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_CoryRematchPostBattle: If you're faced with a challenge,\ntry shouting at the sea!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_CarolinaIntro: I take huge pride in my POKéMON.\nWe'll show you one speedy battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route108_Text_CarolinaPostBattle: Since I'm at sea like this, I wouldn't\nmind putting on a pink, frilly swimsuit…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_DavidIntro: Hiyah! Look at my chiseled abs!\nThis is what you call “cut”!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_DavidPostBattle: Hiyah!\pMy sculpted abs have nothing to do\nwith POKéMON battles!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_AliceIntro: Are you properly protected against\nthe sun?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_AlicePostBattle: Cheeks are the most prone to burning!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_HueyIntro: I've laid anchor in ports around\nthe world, but SLATEPORT's the best.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_HueyPostBattle: In the best port was the best\nTRAINER…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_EdmondPostBattle: I'm usually stronger than this!\nI'm just seasick as a dog!\pI'm a SAILOR, but…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_RickyIntro: I'm thirsty… I could go for a SODA POP\nat the SEASHORE HOUSE…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_RickyPostBattle: I'm getting famished… My inner tube\nlooks like a giant doughnut…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_RickyRegister: Will you have another match with me\nwhen I'm not all thirsty?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_RickyRematchIntro: I'm hungry, but I've got enough pep in\nme for a battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_RickyRematchPostBattle: When you eat on a beach, everything\nseems to taste a little better.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_LolaIntro: Doesn't a beach umbrella look like\na giant flower?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_LolaPostBattle: If you look at the beach from the sky,\nit looks like a big flower garden!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_LolaRematchIntro: I'm not losing to you again!\nThat's why I have my inner tube!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_LolaRematchPostBattle: If I have an inner tube, me and my\nPOKéMON's cuteness goes way up!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_AustinaIntro: I can't swim without my inner tube,\nbut I won't lose at POKéMON!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_AustinaDefeated: Did I lose because I have an inner\ntube?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_AustinaPostBattle: My inner tube is a fashion item.\nI can't be seen without it.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_GwenIntro: Hi, big TRAINER.\nWill you battle with me?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_GwenPostBattle: How did you get to be so strong?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_CarterIntro: Wahahah! This dude's going to catch\nhimself a big one!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_CarterPostBattle: This dude thinks you're a big one.\nNo, you're a big-one-to-be!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_PaulIntro: PAUL: Well, this is a mood-breaker.\pI wish you wouldn't disturb our\nprecious time together.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_PaulPostBattle: PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that\nwe're here.\lThis is just our private world of two!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_PaulNotEnoughPokemon: PAUL: We're totally, deeply in love.\nThat's why we make our POKéMON battle\ltogether.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_MelIntro: MEL: We're, like, totally in love.\nOur romance is heating up all of HOENN!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_MelDefeated: MEL: We lost, and it's my fault!\nPAUL will hate me!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_MelPostBattle: MEL: Um, PAUL, are you angry with me?\nPlease don't be angry.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_MelNotEnoughPokemon: MEL: We're, like, deeply and truly in love.\nThat's why we make our POKéMON\lbattle together.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_ChandlerPostBattle: After I showed you my round inner\ntube, too…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_HaileyIntro: I can't swim, so I'm pretending\nto swim.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_HaileyDefeated: I thought so!\nI didn't think we could win.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_HaileyPostBattle: When I learn how to swim, I think\nmy POKéMON will become tougher.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_ElijahIntro: For a guy as macho as me, this kind\nof POKéMON is the perfect match!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_ElijahDefeated: I'm cool even in defeat, hey?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route109_Text_ElijahPostBattle: For a guy as macho as me, a port\nis the perfect setting!\pI guess I'll head for SLATEPORT.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_JacobIntro: Whoa! Watch it!\nI guess you're not used to BIKE racing.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_JacobPostBattle: Flat tires and brake problems can\ncause serious injury!\lInspect your BIKE for problems!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_AnthonyIntro: Yo, you!\nCan you keep up with my speed?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_AnthonyPostBattle: Speed alone won't let me win at POKéMON.\nI need to reconsider this…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_BenjaminIntro: Don't panic if your BIKE's going fast!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_BenjaminPostBattle: There's no need to panic or stress.\nTake it easy. There's plenty of time.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_BenjaminRegister: I'll keep chugging on without stressing.\nGive me a shout if you're up to it.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchIntro: Aren't you going a little too fast?\nTake it easy and let's battle.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchDefeated: I didn't panic, but I still lost…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchPostBattle: There's no need to panic or stress.\nTake it easy. There's plenty of time.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_AbigailIntro: The triathlon is hard in the extreme.\pYou have to complete the three events\nof swimming, cycling, and running.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_AbigailPostBattle: I'm exhausted, so I need a break.\nIt's important to get proper rest.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_AbigailRegister: You know, I like you!\nLet's have a rematch on CYCLING ROAD.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_AbigailRematchIntro: Isn't it neat to hold a battle while\ncycling?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_AbigailRematchDefeated: Wow…\nHow could you be so strong?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_AbigailRematchPostBattle: Were you going after a record?\pI'm sorry if I held you up!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_JasmineIntro: I've been riding without stopping.\nMy thighs are like rocks!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_JasminePostBattle: Oh, you have some GYM BADGES?\nNo wonder you're so strong!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_EdwardIntro: I have foreseen your intentions!\nI cannot possibly lose!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_EdwardDefeated: I failed to prophesize my own demise!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_EdwardPostBattle: I see your future…\pHmm…\nI see a shining light…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_JaclynIntro: Ahahahaha!\nI'll dazzle you with my wonders!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_JaclynPostBattle: You managed to win only because it was\na wonder! Yes, a wonder!\lDon't think you can win all the time!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_EdwinIntro: Could I see your POKéMON?\nJust one look, please?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_EdwinPostBattle: When I see a POKéMON that I don't know,\nmy passion as a collector is ignited!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_EdwinRegister: I like collecting MATCH CALL\nregistrations, too…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_EdwinRematchIntro: Hi, have you caught any new POKéMON?\pCould I see your POKéMON?\nJust one look, please?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_EdwinRematchPostBattle: Oh, I long to make all rare POKéMON\nmine!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_DaleIntro: Hey!\nDon't sneak up behind me like that!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_DalePostBattle: Fishing is all about concentration.\nYou have to focus on the floater.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_IsabelIntro: Ahahaha! I would go anywhere to show\noff my delightful POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_IsabelPostBattle: Rather than battling, perhaps I should\nshow off my POKéMON at the FAN CLUB.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_IsabelRegister: That wasn't close to what I could\ndo to show off my POKéMON.\pI'll have you as my captive audience\nas often as possible!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_IsabelRematchIntro: Ahahahaha! I would be happy to show\noff my POKéMON as often as you like!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_IsabelRematchPostBattle: I don't think that I could ever stop\nfrom showing off my POKéMON.\pBut I like to battle, too!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_TimmyIntro: I found some cool POKéMON in the grass\naround here!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_TimmyDefeated: Being cool isn't enough to win…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_TimmyPostBattle: It's hard to battle with POKéMON you\njust caught.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_AlyssaIntro: I fell off CYCLING ROAD…\pI'll get over my embarrassment by\nbattling with you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_AlyssaPostBattle: Falling… Losing…\nThis is so humiliating for me!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_JosephIntro: Okay! Full-throttle time! If you can't\ngroove, you get left behind!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_JosephDefeated: You got into the groove all right…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_JosephPostBattle: This isn't going to bring me down!\nLosing has made me a better man!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_KalebIntro: When cute POKéMON help each other…\nYou won't see a more adorable sight!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_KalebDefeated: Have you no compassion or pity?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route110_Text_KalebPostBattle: Okay, okay, you've done the best you\ncould, my pretties.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_DrewIntro: Oh, hey! Those GO-GOGGLES suit you.\nBut I think they look better on me.\pLet's decide who they look better on\nwith a battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_DrewDefeat: I couldn't see what was happening at\nmy sides because of the GO-GOGGLES.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_DrewPostBattle: The GO-GOGGLES make it possible to\nget through sandstorms.\lThat makes me happy!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_HeidiIntro: I'm having a picnic in the desert.\pYou can always find a TRAINER,\nso I can enjoy a battle here, too!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_HeidiPostBattle: When you're battling in a sandstorm,\nwatch out for your POKéMON's HP.\pIt can faint if you don't keep\nan eye on it!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BeauIntro: Wearing these GO-GOGGLES makes me\nfeel like a superhero.\lRight now, nobody can beat me!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BeauDefeat: I can't win on spirit alone…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BeauPostBattle: I'm going to be a real hero one day.\nI'm going to work harder to make me\land my POKéMON stronger.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BeckyIntro: I heard there are fossils to be found\nin the desert. Where could they be?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BeckyPostBattle: If they can find fossils in the desert,\nit must have been a sea before.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_DustyIntro: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\lI am to be challenged?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_DustyDefeat: While I have searched for ruins,\nI've not searched for strong POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_DustyPostBattle: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years?\nWhich was it now?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_DustyRegister: I haven't been searching for any\ntough POKéMON.\pBut, for some reason, I sure do like\nPOKéNAVS.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_DustyRematchIntro: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years?\nAnyway, am I to be challenged?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_DustyRematchDefeat: I've found no ruins, nor have I found\nany strong POKéMON…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years
I've searched?\pHmm… It could even be fifty…
How long have I been at this?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_TravisIntro: I'm full of pep!\nAnd my POKéMON is peppy, too!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_TravisPostBattle: When I see a TRAINER with a lot of pep,\nI can't help looking.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_IreneIntro: I don't know where you're going,\nbut would you like to battle?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_IrenePostBattle: I'm thinking that I should go to\nMT. CHIMNEY, but the view around\lhere is very nice, too.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_DaisukeIntro: To train myself, I challenge all\nwhom I meet!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_DaisukePostBattle: All I can do is keep training until\nI can defeat strong TRAINERS such\las yourself.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_WiltonIntro: Show me how much you've toughened\nyour POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_WiltonPostBattle: POKéMON and TRAINERS learn much\nthrough battling.\pWhat's important is to never give up\neven if you lose.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_WiltonRegister: There is much to be learned from\nyour training style.\pI request a rematch if it\nbehooves you.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_WiltonRematchIntro: We're training here to elevate our\ngame to the next level.\lStay and train with us!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_WiltonPostRematch: Since you're that strong, you should\naim for the POKéMON LEAGUE.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BrookeIntro: Oh, your POKéMON look like serious\nactors.\lI have to ask you for an engagement.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BrookeDefeat: They didn't just look strong,\nthey are strong!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BrookePostBattle: I thought I was raising my POKéMON\ndiligently, but, oh no, there is still\lmuch to be done.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BrookeRegister: I wish I could become friends with\nmore strong people like you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BrookeRematchIntro: You can make POKéMON stronger or\nweaker depending on the moves you\lteach them.\pWhat kinds of moves do your POKéMON\nknow?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BrookePostRematch: Maybe I should have stopped my\nPOKéMON from evolving until they\llearned better moves…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_CeliaIntro: I shouldn't have come to a place like\nthis for a picnic!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_CeliaPostBattle: In a sandstorm like this, I can't set\nthe places for a picnic even with my\lGO-GOGGLES on…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BryanIntro: How tough are you?\nWe shall expose that secret!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BryanDefeat: Oh! Your strength!\nIt is shrouded in mystery!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BryanPostBattle: This desert hoards mysteries in\nits shifting sands!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BrandenIntro: I'll give you some of my sandwich\nif you'll lose.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BrandenDefeat: Tch! I thought a sandwich would be\nenough of a bribe…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_TyronIntro: This is my favorite kind of POKéMON!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_TyronDefeat: Wait!\nDid you get a good look at my POKéMON?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_TyronPostBattle: When having a battle, I get a kick out\nof showing off my POKéMON.\pI bet everyone feels that way when\nthey enter a battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_CelinaIntro: Show me how to put a little excitement\ninto my life.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_CelinaDefeat: Oh… My…\nThat was too much excitement.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_CelinaPostBattle: My pulse is still racing.\nYou're one fabulous TRAINER.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_HaydenIntro: When you're as famished as I am,\nthere is no room for pity!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_HaydenPostBattle: My stomach is grumbling!\nMaybe I can grill some BERRIES…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BiancaIntro: Did you come from MAUVILLE?\nThen you should be full of energy!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BiancaDefeat: Ooh lala!\nThat's a lot to take!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route111_Text_BiancaPostBattle: This road here…\nYou have quite a ways to travel.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_BriceIntro: Hahahaha!\nHow about we have a battle?\lYou and me!\lHahahaha!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_BricePostBattle: Hahahahaha! Something flew up my nose!\nHahahaha-hatchoo!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_TrentIntro: My legs are solid from pounding up\nand down the mountains.\pThey're not going to buckle easily,\nfriend!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_TrentPostBattle: Try hiking, and I mean really\npounding, on these mountain trails\lwith a heavy pack weighing dozens of\lpounds.\pThat, my friend, will get your body\ninto serious shape.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_TrentRegister: Ow, my legs have cramped up.\nCan you grab me some bandages from\lmy backpack?\pNo, that's my POKéNAV!\nOh, fine, I'll register you.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_TrentRematchIntro: I've been keeping fit by hiking.\nPower, I have in spades!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_TrentRematchPostBattle: I hear there are some seriously tough\nTRAINERS on top of MT. CHIMNEY.\pI intend to get up there and give them\na challenge!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_LarryIntro: I'm strong.\nI won't cry if I lose.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_LarryPostBattle: I'm not crying because I miss my mommy!\nSnivel…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_CarolIntro: When you're out on a picnic, why,\nyou simply have to sing!\lCome on, sing with me!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_CarolPostBattle: It doesn't matter if you're good or bad\nat singing or POKéMON.\pIf you have the most fun, you win!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_BryantIntro: I caught hot POKéMON in FIERY PATH!\nTake a look!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_BryantDefeat: What a bumpy ride that was!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_BryantPostBattle: I like the way you battle.\nIt has a certain flair to it.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_ShaylaIntro: Oh, aren't you an adorable TRAINER!\nPlease, I need a romantic battle!\lI'm somewhat decent!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_ShaylaDefeat: Oh, how strong you are!\nYou've given me quite a shock!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route112_Text_ShaylaPostBattle: Are you busy right now?\nI was thinking that maybe we can have\la rematch right now…\lBut it's all right if you're busy.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_JaylenIntro: Can you guess why it's so cool\naround here?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_JaylenPostBattle: The volcanic ash blocks the sun,\nso it doesn't get very warm.\pThat's good for me--I can't stand heat!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_DillonIntro: The volcano's eruption is proof that\nthe earth is alive.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_DillonPostBattle: Ouch! Owww! I can't see!\nI got ashes in my eyelashes!\pGet it? Ashes and eyelashes?\pOkay, that was bad, sorry…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_MadelineIntro: I use this parasol to ward off this\nfilthy, yucky volcanic ash from\lmy dear NUMEL.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_MadelinePostBattle: You're very good at this.\nI must say I'm impressed!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_MadelineRegister: Here, slide under my parasol.\nLet me register you in my POKéNAV.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_MadelineRematchIntro: Oh, hello, hasn't it been a while?\nMay I invite you to battle?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_MadelinePostRematch: You've remained very good at this.\nI must say I'm impressed!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_LaoIntro: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!\nI challenge thee!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_LaoPostBattle: I must refine the art of concealment.\nI bid thee farewell.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_LaoRegister: Yiiyaah! Witness the ancient ninja\ntechnique of POKéNAV registration!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_LaoRematchIntro: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!\nI challenge thee!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_LaoPostRematch: My flawless concealment was let down\nby my immature battle skills…\pI bid thee farewell.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_LungIntro: Thanks for finding me!\nBut we still have to battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_LungDefeat: I'll use my ninjutsu on you…\n“VOLCANIC ASH SWIRL CLOAK”!\p…What?\nIt's already over?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_LungPostBattle: You know what's crummy about hiding?\nIt's lonely if no one comes along.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_ToriIntro: TORI: Both of us, we collect ashes.\nWe battle POKéMON, too.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_ToriDefeat: TORI: We lost… It's boring, so I'm going\nto get some more ashes.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_ToriPostBattle: TORI: How much ash do we have?\nEnough for a WHITE FLUTE, I hope.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_ToriNotEnoughMons: TORI: We want to battle 2-on-2.\nIf we didn't, we would lose!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_TiaIntro: TIA: Both of us, we collect ashes.\nWe battle POKéMON, too.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_TiaDefeat: TIA: We couldn't win… It's boring,\nso I'm getting some more ashes.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_TiaPostBattle: TIA: We have a lot of ashes!\nI think enough for a WHITE FLUTE!$
