data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_TiaNotEnoughMons: TIA: We want to battle 2-on-2.\nIf we don't, we won't win!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_CobyIntro: Pfft, with these wings I can\nflick you away!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_CobyPostBattle: I don't know what to say when I get\nbeaten so easily…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_SophieIntro: The warmth here is making me drowsy.\nBattle with me so I can stay awake.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_SophieDefeat: This is a dream.\nI'm sure of it…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_SophiePostBattle: Losing burns me up…\nI'm just going to sleep right here!\lZzz!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_LawrenceIntro: Were you maybe in the middle\nof gathering volcanic ashes?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_LawrencePostBattle: I ought to hide under the ashes, too.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_WyattIntro: Y-you want to battle with me?\nEven though I just caught my POKéMON?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_WyattDefeat: Y-you're all happy to win?\nEven though it's only me?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route113_Text_WyattPostBattle: Oh, so now you want to say a word to\nthe loser?\pAren't you just the coolest?\nHumph!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_LennyIntro: Yodelayhihoo!\p… …\pYou're supposed to shout\n“yodelayhihoo” since it doesn't\lecho here!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_LennyPostBattle: When I was a wee tyke, I believed there\nwas someone copying me and shouting\lback, “Yodelayhihoo.”$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_LucasIntro: If you're not prepared, you shouldn't\nbe up in the mountains!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_LucasPostBattle: In the winter, mountains turn deadly\nwith blizzards and avalanches.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_ShaneIntro: Camping's fun! You can fish, roast\nmarshmallows, and tell spooky stories!\pBut the best of all are the POKéMON\nbattles!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_ShanePostBattle: I think it's great that I can go\ncamping with my POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_NancyIntro: I need to exercise after a meal.\nLet's have a match!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_NancyPostBattle: I just had a tasty meal.\nI'm getting drowsy…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_SteveIntro: Ufufufufufu…\nWant to battle against my POKéMON?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_StevePostBattle: A big body that's all lumpy and hard,\nenormous horns, and vicious fangs…\pUfufufufu…\nI wish I had a POKéMON like that…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_SteveRegister: Don't forget what you've done to me!\nI'll make it so you can't forget!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_SteveRematchDefeat: I feel so lucky getting to see your\nPOKéMON…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_StevePostRematch: Ufufufufufu…\pWhen I see POKéMON battling, I get all\nshivery and shaky…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_BernieIntro: If you're lighting a campfire,\nmake sure you have water handy.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_BerniePostBattle: You really do have to be careful with\nany sort of fire in a forest.\pDon't ever underestimate the power\nof fire.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_BernieRegister: You set my spirit on fire.\nLet's register each other!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_BernieRematchIntro: Have you learned to keep water handy\nfor campfires?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_BernieRematchDefeat: I got hosed down before I could\nflare up, I guess.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_BerniePostRematch: You really do have to be careful with\nany sort of fire in a forest.\pDon't ever underestimate the power\nof fire.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_ClaudeIntro: If we were fishing, you wouldn't stand\na chance against me.\lSo, bring on your POKéMON!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_ClaudeDefeat: If we were fishing, I would've won…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_ClaudePostBattle: I think I'll try my luck at landing\na big one at METEOR FALLS.\pThere has to be something in there.\nI just know it.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_NolanIntro: I like to fish. But I also like to\nbattle!\pIf anyone challenges me, I'm there,\neven if I'm fishing.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_NolanDefeat: I like to battle, but that doesn't\nmean I'm good at it…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_NolanPostBattle: This time I'll do it!\pI always think that, so I can't walk\naway from fishing or POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_TyraIntro: TYRA: Well, sure.\nI'm in the mood for it.\lI'll teach you a little about POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_TyraDefeat: TYRA: What an amazing battle style!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_TyraPostBattle: TYRA: I was teaching my junior IVY\nabout POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons: TYRA: Giggle…\nIf you want to battle with us, just one\lPOKéMON isn't enough!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_IvyIntro: IVY: Who taught you about POKéMON?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_IvyDefeat: IVY: What an amazing battle style!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_IvyPostBattle: IVY: I started training POKéMON\nbecause TYRA, my student mentor,\ltaught me!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_IvyNotEnoughMons: IVY: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nI think it must feel lonesome.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_KaiIntro: I landed a big one!\nA huge one, I tell you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_KaiDefeat: What was that about?\nDid mine lose in size?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_KaiPostBattle: Okay!\nI'll just fish me a bigger one!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_CharlotteIntro: Me!\nI'm not just a pretty face!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_CharlotteDefeat: That wasn't cute in the least!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_CharlottePostBattle: I don't want a POKéMON that's\njust cute.\pI adore cute ones that have a quirk\nor two!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_AngelinaIntro: Have you made your POKéMON evolve\nvery much?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_AngelinaDefeat: Oh, I see.\nThat's good to know.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route114_Text_AngelinaPostBattle: Some POKéMON change so much when\nthey evolve, it's startling!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_TimothyIntro: Hm…\nYou seem rather capable…\lLet me keep you company!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_TimothyPostBattle: There is no such thing as a born genius.\nIt all depends on effort!\lThat is what I believe…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_TimothyRegister: Hmm… A loss this thorough has been\na distant memory.\pIf you would allow it, I wish for\nanother opportunity to do battle.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_TimothyRematchIntro: Hm… As always, your agility speaks\nfor itself.\lCome, keep me company!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_TimothyPostRematch: All it takes is effort!\pI lost because I haven't put in enough\neffort!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_KoichiPostBattle: My MACHOP crew!\pSo long as they seek power, I will\ngrow strong with them!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_NobIntro: My strongest skill is busting bricks\nwith my forehead!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_NobPostBattle: I've been teaching my POKéMON karate.\pIt looks like they'll get a lot better\nthan me. I'm excited about that.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_NobRegister: You impress me! Give me a rematch\nafter I redo my training!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_NobRematchIntro: After you beat me, we trained hard to\nimprove our skills.\lCome on, give us a rematch!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_NobPostRematch: My POKéMON will grow stronger!\nI'll redouble my training!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_CyndyIntro: This beach is my secret training spot!\nDon't come butting in!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_CyndyPostBattle: The sand acts as a cushion to reduce\nimpact and prevent injury.\lThis is the perfect place to train.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_CyndyRegister: Okay, fine, you're free to come here.\nIn return, I'd like to battle you again.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_CyndyRematchIntro: Okay, let's get this battle on!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_CyndyRematchDefeat: I can battle but my POKéMON…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_CyndyPostRematch: Even when I lose, I still get some\nenjoyment out of it.\lIt must be that I love POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_HectorIntro: I have a rare POKéMON!\nWould you like me to show you?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_HectorDefeat: You…\nYou want my POKéMON, don't you?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_HectorPostBattle: I have this rare POKéMON.\nIt's enough to keep me satisfied.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_KyraIntro: I'll battle while I'm running!\nTry to keep up with me!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_KyraPostBattle: I made the mistake of trying to battle\nwhile running!\pI should take a run to calm down…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_JaidenPostBattle: But my POKéMON were ultra,\nweren't they?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_HelenePostBattle: I rarely meet anyone who's better\nthan me…\pI get it now!\nYou're a GYM LEADER, aren't you?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_AlixIntro: Our eyes met!\nThere's no getting away now!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_AlixPostBattle: Oh, well.\nI think I will TELEPORT home.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_MarleneIntro: You've disturbed my meditation…\nYou'll be punished for it.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route115_Text_MarlenePostBattle: I was meditating with my POKéMON.\nBut this place isn't very peaceful…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_ClarkIntro: If the tunnel doesn't go through, then\nI'll just go over the top.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_ClarkPostBattle: It's no big deal if there's no tunnel.\nTo a HIKER, mountains are roads!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JoeyDefeat: Ouch! A scrape!\nI have to put on a bandage!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JoeyPostBattle: Bandages are signs of toughness!\nI've got another one!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JoseIntro: My BUG POKéMON are tough!\nLet's battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JoseDefeat: I lost!\nI thought I had you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JosePostBattle: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.\nSo they get strong quickly, too.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JaniceIntro: Let me teach you how strong my\nadorable POKéMON is!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JanicePostBattle: POKéMON that possess cuteness and\npower, that's ideal, I think.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JerryIntro: We learn all sorts of things at the\nTRAINER'S SCHOOL.\pI want to test things out for real!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JerryDefeat: I slacked off in school…\nThat's why I lost.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JerryPostBattle: I'll have to redo some courses at\nthe TRAINER'S SCHOOL.\lIf I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JerryRegister1: I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL\nthat a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.\pI don't really get what that means,\nso can I just try it?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JerryRegister2: I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL\nthat a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.\pI don't really get what that means,\nso can I just try it?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JerryRematchIntro: I've been studying seriously at the\nTRAINER'S SCHOOL.\lI won't lose like I did last time.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JerryPostRematch: I'll have to redo some courses at\nthe TRAINER'S SCHOOL.\lIf I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_KarenIntro: I study at school, and I study on\nthe way home, too!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_KarenPostBattle: Awww, I'll never become an elegant\nTRAINER like ROXANNE this way!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_KarenRegister1: Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV?\nI have one, too! Please register me!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_KarenRegister2: Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV?\nI have one, too! Please register me!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_KarenRematchIntro: I studied a whole lot since I saw you.\nYou must see my achievements!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_KarenPostRematch: You've beaten ROXANNE?\nI can't beat you, then. Not yet.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_SarahIntro: Just so you know, I've never once been\nbested by anyone at anything.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_SarahDefeat: Oh, my goodness.\nThis is a new experience for me.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_SarahPostBattle: My life of luxury affords me all that\nI could possibly desire.\pHowever, when it comes to POKéMON,\nmy wealth has no meaning.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_DawsonIntro: When you lay your eyes on my POKéMON's\ngorgeous fur, their beauty will render\lyou helpless!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_DawsonDefeat: Oh, baby, say it isn't so!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_DawsonPostBattle: Oh, no, no, no!\nYou've mussed up my POKéMON's fur!\lYou've ruined my hairdo, too!\lI'll have to call my stylist now!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_DevanPostBattle: I should try different POKéMON\ntypes, that's what I ought to do.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JohnsonIntro: It's a dead end up here.\nI'm bored, so can we battle?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JohnsonDefeat: That was fun even though I lost.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route116_Text_JohnsonPostBattle: Want to stay here and keep\nme company?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_IsaacIntro: Listen, could I get you to battle\nthe POKéMON I'm raising?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_IsaacPostBattle: POKéMON isn't all about power.\pPolishing a unique aspect of one's\ncharacter is another way of enjoying\lPOKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_IsaacRegister: I'm going to redouble my training.\nWould you come look in on us?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_IsaacRematchIntro: The POKéMON I've been raising are\nlooking good, just like before.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_IsaacRematchDefeat: You know how to raise them properly.\nYou might have DAY CARE skills…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_IsaacPostRematch: Your POKéMON are growing good!\nYou should enter them in CONTESTS.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_LydiaIntro: Please, allow me to evaluate if you\nhave raised your POKéMON properly.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_LydiaPostBattle: Try raising POKéMON with more\nattention to their character traits.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_LydiaRegister: I'm glad I met a superb TRAINER in you.\nI hope to see you again.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_LydiaRematchIntro: Allow me to reevaluate if you have\nraised your POKéMON properly.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_LydiaPostRematch: POKéMON seem to like different kinds\nof ポロックS, depending on their nature.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_DylanIntro: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but,\nwhatever, let's have a battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_DylanPostBattle: I may have blown it…\pI might have dropped to last during\nthat battle…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_DylanRegister: POKéMON have to be strong, too?\nI'd like you to train me!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_DylanRematchIntro: I'm smack in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut I'm comfortably ahead.\lLet's make this a quick battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_DylanRematchDefeat: I ran out of energy again!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_DylanPostRematch: I was tops in swimming and cycling,\nbut I'm not quite that confident with\lPOKéMON yet.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MariaIntro: I do my triathlon training with POKéMON,\nso I'm pretty confident about my speed.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MariaDefeat: I need to get more practices in,\nI guess.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MariaPostBattle: Training is meaningful only if you\nkeep it up regularly.\pOkay! I'll resume my training!\nTomorrow!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MariaRegister: You appear to be training properly…\nIf you'd like, I'll battle you later!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MariaRematchIntro: Are you keeping up with your training?\nI sure am!\lLet me show you the evidence!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MariaRematchDefeat: I need to get more practices in,\nI guess.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MariaPostRematch: I'll resume training tomorrow.\nLet's battle again sometime!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_DerekIntro: Once a BUG CATCHER!\nAnd now a BUG MANIAC!\pBut my love for POKéMON remains\nunchanged!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_DerekPostBattle: All I did was follow my heart, and now\nthey call me a BUG MANIAC…\pStill, I am an expert on BUG POKéMON,\nso it's only natural that they call me\la BUG MANIAC.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_AnnaIntro: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student\npartner. I have to do good!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_AnnaDefeat: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student\npartner! Let me win!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_AnnaPostBattle: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good\ncombinations.\pI'd say you're second only to us!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_AnnaAndMegRegister: ANNA: We can't take this lying down!\nYou will come back, won't you?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_AnnaNotEnoughMons: ANNA: If you want to battle us,\nbring two POKéMON with you.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MegIntro: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my super\nsenior student partner and beat you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MegDefeat: MEG: Oh, no!\nI'm sorry, ANNA! I let you down…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MegPostBattle: MEG: I dragged ANNA down…\nIf I didn't, she would have won!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MegNotEnoughMons: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nWe can't battle with you, then.\pWe want to have a 2-on-2 battle.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_AnnaRematchIntro: ANNA: I can't keep losing in front of\nmy junior partner, right?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_AnnaRematchDefeat: ANNA: I couldn't get into the groove.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_AnnaPostRematch: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good\ncombinations.\pI'd say you're second only to us!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_AnnaRematchNotEnoughMons: ANNA: If you want to battle us,\nbring two POKéMON with you.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MegRematchIntro: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my\nsenior partner and win this time!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MegPostRematch: MEG: I battled together with my\nsenior partner, but we lost…\pThat's so discouraging…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MegRematchNotEnoughMons: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nWe can't battle with you, then.\pWe want to have a 2-on-2 battle.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MelinaIntro: Isn't it nice? To battle while looking\nat pretty flowers?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_MelinaPostBattle: It feels wonderful to go for a jog\nwhile looking at flowers.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_BrandiIntro: Let me demonstrate the power\nhidden within a PSYCHIC POKéMON!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_BrandiPostBattle: PSYCHIC POKéMON are complex.\nYou should try catching some.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_AishaIntro: Concentrate on getting the win.\nThat's how I battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_AishaDefeat: I don't waste any time being angry\nover a loss--I would rather train.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route117_Text_AishaPostBattle: I think that if you worry about losing,\nyou're more likely to lose.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_RoseIntro: The aroma of flowers has a magical\npower. It cleanses us body and soul.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_RoseDefeat: Oh, dear me.\nI seem to have lost.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_RosePostBattle: Flowers, POKéMON…\nI love whatever smells nice.\pStinky things…\nI'll pass.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_RoseRegister: Sniff… That odor--it's a POKéNAV!\nWe must register each other!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_RoseRematchIntro: Were you drawn here by the sweet\naroma?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_RoseRematchDefeat: The power of aroma…\nIt didn't seem to do much.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_RosePostRematch: If you use a sweet aroma properly,\nPOKéMON will be attracted by it.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_PerryIntro: BIRD POKéMON that FLY elegantly in\nthe sky… They're the best!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_PerryPostBattle: You've got great POKéMON.\nI'll have to train mine better.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_ChesterPostBattle: If they'd get stronger, they'd be able\nto fly more freely…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_BarnyIntro: I'm a FISHERMAN, but also a TRAINER.\nI'm raising the POKéMON I caught.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_BarnyDefeat: I thought I was doing okay in my\ntraining…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_BarnyPostBattle: I couldn't win by training POKéMON\nwhile I fished…\pWas I doing things in half measures?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_WadeIntro: For FISHERMEN, equipment is the key.\pBut for TRAINERS, the key ingredients\nare POKéMON and heart, of course!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_WadePostBattle: Come to think of it, fishing is a battle\nbetween a FISHERMAN and a POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_DaltonIntro: Let my melody rock your soul!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_DaltonPostBattle: An electric guitar doesn't always\nhave to be noisy…\pIt can be strummed to squeeze out\nthis heart-stirring melody…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_DaltonRegister: When I compose better melodies,\nyou have to come listen, okay?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_DaltonRematchIntro: A melody from my POKéMON and me…\nLet us deliver it to your soul.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_DaltonPostRematch: When I play, my emotions should reach\nyou through my electric guitar…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_DeandreDefeat: Come in, POKéMON! Are you okay?\nPOKéMON 1, 2, and 3?!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route118_Text_DeandrePostBattle: Isn't it cool that I have a POKéMON\nbattle team?\pYou can copy me--I don't mind!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_BrentIntro: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!\nWe MIMIC what you do!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_BrentPostBattle: What's so good about mimicry?\pFufufu…\nYou'll never understand…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_DonaldIntro: So, we finally meet!\nMy BUG POKéMON will keep you company!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_DonaldPostBattle: I want to MIMIC you some more.\nCan you hurry up and move?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_TaylorIntro: If you step forward, we step forward.\pIf you turn right, we turn, too…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_TaylorDefeat: But if you win, I lose…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_TaylorPostBattle: I can't MIMIC you winning the match.\nThat's just impossible…\lIt's burning me up…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_DougIntro: Yep, you've finally caught me!\nOr were you trying to avoid me?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_DougDefeat: Whoop, that was a great match!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_DougPostBattle: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!\nI hope you enjoyed our performance.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_GregIntro: You don't know who I am, do you?\pBut, I also don't know you.\nSo, we'll battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_GregPostBattle: Until you go away somewhere, we'll\nkeep on mimicking your every move.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_KentIntro: The MIMIC CIRCLE was formed by people\nwho like to MIMIC.\pA battle starts the instant we meet!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_KentPostBattle: Won't you join our MIMIC CIRCLE?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_JacksonIntro: Who has the knowledge and\nthe technique for survival?\pPOKéMON RANGERS, that's who!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_JacksonPostBattle: To break away from civilization and\nawaken the wild spirit within!\pThat's our vision.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_JacksonRegister: I hope you'll give me a rematch without\nmocking my lack of knowledge.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_JacksonRematchIntro: I'm going to regain my wild spirit by\nbeing together with POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_JacksonPostRematch: Believe in your POKéMON.\nBelieve in yourself.\pThe road will reveal itself to you.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_CatherineIntro: Oh? Look at you.\pFor someone on an adventure,\nyou're traveling awfully light.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_CatherinePostBattle: You're traveling light but you have\neverything you need.\pYou're on top of things mentally and\nphysically, too.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_CatherineRegister: Do you have a POKéNAV?\nIt's a must-have tool for any TRAINER.\pOh, you do have one!\nLet's register each other, then!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_CatherinePostRematch: In the same way that you, as a TRAINER,\nrely on your POKéMON, your POKéMON\lrely on you.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_HughIntro: The vast sky holds untold promise!\pNothing can compare to the sheer\nexhilaration of flight!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_HughPostBattle: My BIRD POKéMON made my dreams of\nflying come true!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_PhilIntro: I'll show you the true potential of me\nand my BIRD POKéMON!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_PhilPostBattle: Ever since I was a little kid, I always\nadmired BIRD POKéMON…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_YasuIntro: To lurk in shadows, and live in\ndarkness… That is my destiny.\pI emerge to challenge you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_YasuPostBattle: Those defeated in battle withdraw\nquietly back into the shadows.\lThat, too, is destiny…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_TakashiIntro: If you're not on your guard,\nyou're in for some pain!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_HideoIntro: To hide a tree, use a forest!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_HideoPostBattle: To hide a tree, use a forest!\nTo hide a POKéMON, use a POKéMON!\pThere is no deep, hidden meaning\nto that.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_ChrisIntro: You spoke to me…\nSo you want to challenge me!\pSure! I'll try out the POKéMON I caught\nwhile SURFING!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_ChrisDefeat: I don't have a clue about what it\ntakes to win.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_ChrisPostBattle: Go for a SURF on my POKéMON…\pThen fish off its back…\pIt's an indescribably luxuriant moment!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_FabianIntro: Hit me with a power chord!\nVictory is mine!\lIt's our time to shine, whoa, yeah!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_FabianDefeat: You showed me who's the boss!\nWe'll have to take the loss, oh, no!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_FabianPostBattle: Hit me with another power chord!\nLeave me alone!\lYour win you have to atone!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_DaytonIntro: Hohoho!\nI like kid TRAINERS!\lLet's have a good one!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_DaytonPostBattle: Hohoho!\nI'll try emulating the pep of kid\lTRAINERS like you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_RachelIntro: Wherever and whenever I may be,\nI always have my parasol in hand.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route119_Text_RachelPostBattle: You're asking if my parasol is heavy?\nYour BAG is filled with more junk than\lI ever carry around.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_ColinIntro: Do you have any moves that can strike\na flying POKéMON?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_ColinPostBattle: The move FLY is convenient,\ndon't you think?\pWhile the POKéMON is flying,\nalmost no moves can strike it.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_RobertIntro: My POKéMON is strong!\nHow about yours?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_RobertPostBattle: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one\nyou can count on.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_RobertRegister: You can be counted on to get better.\nI'd like to register you in my POKéNAV!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_RobertRematchIntro: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one\nyou can count on.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_RobertPostRematch: My POKéMON are growing stronger.\nI have to grow stronger, too.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_LorenzoIntro: I'll check your POKéMON and see if\nthey're fit for the outdoors.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_LorenzoDefeat: With POKéMON that strong, you're in\nno danger of needing rescue!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_LorenzoPostBattle: To travel wherever your heart desires\nwith POKéMON…\lThat's the joy of being a TRAINER.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_JennaIntro: How's your physical fitness?\nIf you're not fit, you could have a\lrough time in critical situations.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_JennaPostBattle: Fitness training is in my routine.\nI always run with my POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_JeffreyPostRematch: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lI'll try harder…\lFor my precious BUG POKéMON…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_JenniferIntro: POKéMON have many special abilities.\nIf you want to become a first-class\lTRAINER, learn about them.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_JenniferPostBattle: The special abilities of POKéMON\nwill make battle styles change.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_ChipIntro: Who might you be?\pAre you perhaps searching for ancient\nruins that are rumored to possibly\lexist according to legend?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_ChipPostBattle: That giant rock… I would like to\nbelieve it may indeed contain ancient\lruins. But I see no entrance.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_ClarissaIntro: Why am I carrying this parasol?\pI'll tell you if you can win against me.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_ClarissaDefeat: A parasol can't ward off POKéMON\nattacks…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_ClarissaPostBattle: I don't think strong sunlight is good\nfor my POKéMON.\lSo I shield them with my parasol.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_AngelicaIntro: Me, POKéMON, and my parasol…\pIf any one of them is missing,\nthe picture of beauty will be ruined.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_AngelicaPostBattle: A parasol wouldn't suit you at all.\pWhy, something like this would only\nget in your way.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_KeigoIntro: I will adopt the movements of POKéMON\nand create new ninja techniques.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_KeigoDefeat: The creation of new ninja techniques\nis but a distant dream…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_KeigoPostBattle: Perhaps I ought to apprentice under\na ninja sensei.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_RileyIntro: We ninja conceal ourselves under our\ncamouflage cloaks.\lI bet you didn't know where I was!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_RileyDefeat: I lost!\nI should camouflage my shame!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_CallieIntro: If you don't pay attention,\nyou could get hurt!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_CallieDefeat: Ouch!\nI was the one to get hurt.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_CalliePostBattle: I wonder… Should I evolve my POKéMON?\nThey're cute the way they are, though.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_LeonelIntro: Your party POKéMON…\nDo you have different types?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_LeonelDefeat: I've seen your policy in action!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route120_Text_LeonelPostBattle: I think it's awesome you're so strong\nbattling with your favorite POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_VanessaIntro: Will you play with my delightfully\npretty POKéMON?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_VanessaPostBattle: I'm going to a CONTEST in LILYCOVE.\pMy POKéMON should have no problem\nsweeping the MASTER CLASS.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_WalterIntro: With my POKéMON, I have traveled\nto the world's four corners.\pYou might say I have some confidence\nin my abilities.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_WalterPostBattle: I would like to circle the globe once\nagain with my POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_WalterRegister: Your POKéMON prowess is remarkable.\nAllow me to register you as a memento.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_WalterRematchIntro: With my POKéMON, I have traveled\nto the world's four corners.\pYou might say I have some confidence\nin my abilities.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_WalterPostRematch: Your POKéMON and you…\pYour prowess together will be\nconsidered strong, even overseas.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_TammyIntro: There are powers beyond our\nunderstanding in the world…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_TammyPostBattle: MT. PYRE…\nThere is a mysterious power\lat work there…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_KateIntro: KATE: Together, we're fearless!\nWe'll demonstrate how tough we are!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_KateDefeat: KATE: I blew it in front of my junior\nstudent partner…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_KatePostBattle: KATE: When someone's relying on me,\nI get this urge to look cool in front\lof them…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_KateNotEnoughMons: KATE: If you've only got one POKéMON,\nwe can't battle with you.\pThat would be bullying.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_JoyIntro: JOY: Together, we're fearless!\nWe'll demonstrate how tough we are!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_JoyPostBattle: JOY: Ehehe, I'll have to train with KATE,\nmy senior student partner, again.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_JoyNotEnoughMons: JOY: You need at least two POKéMON\nif you're going to challenge us!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_JessicaIntro: Stop! Have a good look at my precious\nPOKéMON!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_JessicaDefeat: Oh, how dare you!\nDon't take it so seriously!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_JessicaPostBattle: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at\nthe SAFARI.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_JessicaRegister: I took it easy on you this time!\nIt won't be that way the next time!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_JessicaRematchIntro: My precious POKéMON grew!\nHave a good look!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_JessicaRematchDefeat: Oh, how dare you!\nYou still won't take it easy!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_JessicaPostRematch: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at\nthe SAFARI.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_CristinIntro: I have this routine.\nDefeat five TRAINERS a day.\lGuess what? You're number five!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_CristinPostBattle: I didn't expect to lose this easily…\nI'll win next time!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_CristinRegister: That was total humiliation!\nI won't forget you…\lHand over your POKéNAV!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_CristinRematchIntro: I have this new routine.\nDefeat ten TRAINERS a day.\lGuess what? You're number ten!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_CristinRematchDefeat: Wait! That's nasty!\nI demand a rematch!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_CristinPostRematch: An opponent I just can't beat…\nSnivel…\lI can't believe this is happening…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_CaleIntro: Can't you see that I have all this\nstuff with me?\pDespite that, you still insist that\nwe battle?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_CaleDefeat: Of course I lost!\nI'm holding stuff in both hands!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_CalePostBattle: I bought too much stuff at\nthe LILYCOVE DEPT. STORE.\pIt's up the road from here.\nI wish I had a BAG like yours.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_MylesIntro: There's nothing I love more than\nchecking out other people's POKéMON!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_MylesPostBattle: They're great, your POKéMON!\nHow do you raise them?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_PatIntro: I want everybody to see the POKéMON\nI've raised!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_PatPostBattle: I raise every POKéMON with the same\nlove and care--I don't pick favorites.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_MarcelIntro: My POKéMON have never tasted defeat!\nOn their next win, I'm entering them\lin CONTESTS.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route121_Text_MarcelPostBattle: I may have to train my gang some more\nbefore entering any CONTEST.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_WendyIntro: Want to determine how strong you are?\nI'll be the test!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_WendyPostBattle: To best even me…\nYour strength is marvelous!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_BraxtonIntro: You seem to have a big collection\nof GYM BADGES.\pLet me see if you're actually worthy of\nthose BADGES!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_BraxtonPostBattle: You did your BADGES proud in that\nmatch!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_VioletIntro: They say that good times are filled\nwith good aromas.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_VioletDefeat: Oh…\nI smell the bitter scent of misery…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_VioletPostBattle: The BERRY MASTER's garden is filled\nwith uplifting fragrances.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_CameronIntro: Being a psychic is about willpower.\pI've willed myself not to lose to\nanyone. That makes me strong!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_CameronPostBattle: Being a psychic is about willpower.\nI thought I wouldn't lose to you…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_CameronRegister: I sense it!\nYou and I shall battle again!\lI can't tell if I'll win, though…\pLet's see your POKéNAV.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_CameronRematchIntro: I've convinced myself that I won't\nlose anymore. That makes me strong!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_CameronPostRematch: I should train at MT. PYRE…\nI'll never beat you this way…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_JackiIntro: Don't be too happy if your POKéMON\ndevelop psychic powers.\pYou need to refine those powers to\nmake them really useful.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_JackiPostBattle: We all have psychic powers.\nWe've just forgotten how to use them.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_JackiRegister: I would like to face you again.\nIs that okay with you?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_JackiRematchIntro: Have you awoken the psychic powers\nwithin you?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_JackiPostRematch: Your power with POKéMON…\nThat could be a psychic power, too.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_MiuIntro: MIU: Hello, TRAINER. I hope your\nPOKéMON won't cry when they lose.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_MiuPostBattle: MIU: TRAINER, your POKéMON are\nstrong because you are friends.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_MiuNotEnoughMons: MIU: It's no fun to battle if you\ndon't have two POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_YukiIntro: YUKI: Okay!\nWe're beating the TRAINER's POKéMON!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_YukiPostBattle: YUKI: Why are you so strong?\nWe've never lost before.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_YukiNotEnoughMons: YUKI: It's no fun to battle if you\ndon't have two POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_KindraIntro: MT. PYRE…\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep…\lWill your POKéMON sleep?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_KindraPostBattle: MT. PYRE…\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep…\pIt must overflow with a power that\nsoothes spirits…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_FernandoIntro: I'll turn your lights out while\nI rip through this tune!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_FernandoDefeat: Hey, hold it!\nI was still playing the intro!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_FernandoPostBattle: You're rock steady.\nI'd like to write a tune about you.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_FernandoRegister: The next time, lend your ears to\nthe full tune, will you?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_FernandoRematchIntro: Today's the day I'm going to do it!\nI'll turn out your lights before\lI finish singing my song!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_FernandoRematchDefeat: Hey, hold it!\nI haven't even hit the chorus!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_FernandoPostRematch: I thought you'd be so enthralled\nby my tune, you'd lose.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_DavisIntro: This is my awesome BUG POKéMON!\nMy big brother got it for me.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_DavisPostBattle: Don't tell my brother I lost.\nYou have to keep it a secret!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_JazmynIntro: My confidence will get a boost by\nbeating someone obviously strong!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_JazmynPostBattle: They say that you can't judge a person\nby their appearance.\pBut often, their looks don't lie…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_FrederickIntro: Hello, child!\nCan you spare some time?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_FrederickDefeat: Ah, a mighty capable child!\nLet me contribute to your allowance.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_FrederickPostBattle: Contribute to your allowance?\nWasn't the prize money enough?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_AlbertoIntro: I have to tell you, BIRD POKéMON\nare my obsession!\pBirds are cool!\nThey're the best!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_AlbertoDefeat: Even in defeat, BIRD POKéMON are cool!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_AlbertoPostBattle: I gather BIRD POKéMON feathers that\nscatter during battles.\pI'm going to make a hat with\nBIRD POKéMON feathers.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_EdIntro: When there are no TRAINERS around,\nI let my POKéMON battle each other.\lI watch them.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_EdDefeat: I kind of like your POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_EdPostBattle: Hehe, I'm swiping your battling ideas!\nI think they'll make me better.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_JonasIntro: I lay in ambush, and a TRAINER has\nlanded in my trap!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_JonasDefeat: If you don't lose, how am I supposed\nto have fun playing ninja?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_JonasPostBattle: I'm going to ambush a weaker-looking\nTRAINER next time.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_KayleyIntro: I just bought this parasol.\nMy cuteness should be up by a third!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_KayleyDefeat: You're better than me by about\nfive times!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route123_Text_KayleyPostBattle: Using accessories effectively is\nthe secret behind fashion appeal.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_SpencerIntro: Hey, are you lost at sea?\pIf you can beat my POKéMON,\nI can serve as your pilot.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_SpencerDefeat: I lost my bearings in battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_SpencerPostBattle: Many people lose their bearings at sea.\pIf you're that sort, you should refer\nto the POKéNAV's MAP.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_RolandIntro: Hm! You're riding a POKéMON instead\nof swimming yourself…\pI am envious!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_RolandPostBattle: I'm getting chilled…\nI've been in the water too long…\pI wish I could ride a POKéMON like you…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_JennyIntro: If you just float in the sea like\nthis, POKéMON come around to play.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_JennyPostBattle: While swimming, I noticed that some\nPOKéMON attack, and some just watch.\pI guess POKéMON have personalities\nof their own.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_JennyRegister: It's only on a whim, but maybe I'll get\nyou to register me in your POKéNAV.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_JennyRematchIntro: If you just float in the sea like this,\nTRAINERS challenge you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_JennyPostRematch: This has nothing to do with anything,\nbut maybe I'll visit the TRICK HOUSE.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_GraceIntro: I'm growing bored of swimming…\nHow about a battle?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_GraceDefeat: I had no idea that you were\nthis strong!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_GracePostBattle: All the effort you put in must have\nmade you this strong.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_ChadIntro: Fufufufu… I dive deep underwater\nto go deep under cover.\lPlumbing the depths is where I excel!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_ChadPostBattle: I have it on good authority that\nthere's a DIVE spot around here.\pIt gives me the urge to go deep\nagain…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_LilaIntro: LILA: Sigh…\pHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\pLet's battle so I won't have to dwell\non that!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_LilaDefeat: LILA: ROY! It's your fault we lost!\nYou're in for it later!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_LilaPostBattle: LILA: Sigh…\pIf only it wasn't my little brother\nnext to me, but a nice boyfriend…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_LilaNotEnoughMons: LILA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have two POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_RoyIntro: ROY: My big sister is tough at POKéMON!\pDon't cry when you lose!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_RoyDefeat: ROY: Uh-oh…\nMy big sister will chew me out…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_RoyPostBattle: ROY: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\pThat's why she doesn't have a\nboyfriend.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_LilaRoyRegister: ROY: Will you battle with us again?\nBut take it easy next time, okay?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_RoyNotEnoughMons: ROY: Did you want to battle us?\nBring two POKéMON, then.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_LilaRematchIntro: LILA: Sigh…\pHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\pOh, hi, it's been a while. Let's battle\nso I won't have to dwell on things!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_LilaRematchDefeat: LILA: ROY!\nIt's your fault we lost again!\pWe're having a training session later!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_LilaPostRematch: LILA: Sigh…\pIf I had a nice boyfriend, we'd beat\nanyone with lovely combinations…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_LilaRematchNotEnoughMons: LILA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have two POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_RoyRematchIntro: ROY: If we lose, I'll catch heck.\nI'm going to go totally all out!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_RoyRematchDefeat: ROY: Uh-oh…\nMy big sister will chew me out again.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_RoyPostRematch: ROY: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\pShe's going to make me train really\nhard with POKéMON later…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_RoyRematchNotEnoughMons: ROY: Did you want to battle us?\nBring two POKéMON, then.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_DeclanIntro: Here I am swimming by my lonesome\non this wide, beautiful sea.\pThere's no other word for it.\nThis is pathetic!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_DeclanDefeat: I'm feeling blue.\nBlue as the sky…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_DeclanPostBattle: I should chat up lady SWIMMERS\nand invite them on a long swim.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_IsabellaIntro: I'm not going to lose to some\nsurfer TRAINER.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_IsabellaDefeat: I've only got sweat in my eyes!\nI am not crying!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route124_Text_IsabellaPostBattle: You can find pretty colored shards\nof things around here.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_NolenIntro: I heard you approaching, so I hung\naround for you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_NolenPostBattle: Sound travels faster in water than\nit does through air.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_StanIntro: Hey, there!\nCheck out my sweet POKéMON!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_StanPostBattle: I was blown away by HORSEA's charm,\nso I started swimming, too.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_TanyaIntro: I'm tired of swimming.\nAre you up for a battle with me?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_TanyaPostBattle: Whew…\nWhich way is it to MOSSDEEP CITY?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_SharonIntro: How would you like to take on the\nWATER-type POKéMON I raised?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_SharonPostBattle: Your power… You're the real deal.\nI'm amazed!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_ErnestIntro: Ahoy! I'm a buff, tough SAILOR!\nI've braved the world's seas!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_ErnestPostBattle: The tide ebbs and flows inside the\nSHOAL CAVE.\pBy the way, it's about six hours from\nhigh tide to low tide. Did you know?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_ErnestRegister: Register me in your POKéNAV,\nand I'll tell you something good.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_ErnestRematchIntro: It's high time I get my payback\nfrom you! Come on, we're battling!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_ErnestRematchDefeat: I couldn't win!\nI flat out couldn't win!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_ErnestRematchPostBattle: The SHOAL CAVE…\pThere are places you can and can't\nget to depending on the rise and fall\lof the tide.\pBy the way, it's about six hours from\nhigh tide to low tide. Don't forget!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_KimIntro: KIM: A funny old man lives in the\nSHOAL CAVE. Someone told me.\lAre you going to see him, too?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_KimDefeat: KIM: I thought we would win.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_KimPostBattle: KIM: A funny old man lives in the\nSHOAL CAVE, doesn't he?\pLet's go see him, IRIS!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_KimNotEnoughMons: KIM: No, no, no! You need two POKéMON,\nor it's just no good!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_IrisIntro: IRIS: KIM, can you tell me what we're\nlooking for out here?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_IrisDefeat: IRIS: Oh, we came sort of close.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_IrisPostBattle: IRIS: KIM, are we really going into\nthe SHOAL CAVE?\lWe'll get all wet.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_IrisNotEnoughMons: IRIS: Oh, we could never, ever do\nanything like a 2-on-1 battle.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_PresleyIntro: Why would a BIRDKEEPER like me\ncome out to the sea?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_PresleyDefeat: Okay.\nI'll tell you why I'm here.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_PresleyPostBattle: I put a message in a bottle and put\nit out to sea.\pI'm sure that a girl SWIMMER will\nfind it!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_AuronIntro: Hey! Was it you throwing garbage\ninto the sea?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_AuronDefeat: Oh, you weren't throwing trash into\nthe sea.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route125_Text_AuronPostBattle: I found an unsightly bottle bobbing\nin the waves earlier.\pIt angers me that someone would\npollute the sea!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_BarryIntro: Swimming is a full-body workout!\nYou will get fit!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_BarryPostBattle: Thanks to my daily swimming routine…\nLook! Feast your eyes on this physique!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_DeanIntro: This towering white mountain of rock\nis SOOTOPOLIS CITY.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_DeanPostBattle: I can't find the entrance to\nSOOTOPOLIS. Where could it be?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_NikkiDefeat: My fantasy burst as if it were a bubble!\nBlub, blub, blub…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_NikkiPostBattle: You thrashed me… I want to\ndisappear in a wave of despair…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_BrendaIntro: Hello, kiddo!\nWant a battle with me?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_BrendaPostBattle: I love frolicking with POKéMON in\nthe sea like this!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_PabloIntro: Check out this sculpted body!\nI'm more cut than a BLACK BELT!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_PabloDefeat: Whoops! Too strong!\nNot bad! Not bad at all!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_PabloPostBattle: Losing to you stimulated my senses!\nI'll train myself and POKéMON harder!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_PabloRegister: Yep, you're not bad at all!\nI'd like to get to know you more!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_PabloRematchIntro: Check out this beautiful body!\nI'm more shapely than a SWIMMER!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_PabloRematchDefeat: Whoops! Really too strong!\nNot bad! Not bad at all!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_PabloPostRematch: I'm going to train even harder!\nYou're a great motivator!\lYou have to come back again!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_LeonardoIntro: I couldn't even swim last year,\nbut now I'm a decent SWIMMER.\pI think I'm capable of anything now.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_LeonardoDefeat: Sheesh, getting greedy didn't do\na thing for me.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_LeonardoPostBattle: If you practice at something,\nyou will get better at it.\pYou're young--don't be afraid to\ntry all sorts of things!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_IsobelIntro: If seawater gets up your nose,\ndoesn't it feel terrible?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_IsobelPostBattle: Ooh, I choked on some water!\nIt's bitter! It's salty!!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_SiennaIntro: I'm throwing my whole heart\ninto this!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route126_Text_SiennaPostBattle: I need to cool down now…\nI think I'll go for a dive.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_CamdenIntro: I can see it in your face.\nYou want to challenge me.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_CamdenPostBattle: A well-played match leaves me feeling\nrefreshed and serene.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_DonnyIntro: Do you have a rival whom you just\nhate to lose against?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_DonnyPostBattle: If you have a rival, don't you get the\nfeeling that you have to keep getting\lbetter?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_JonahIntro: Through fishing, I have attained a\nstate of becalmed serenity…\pPlease, allow me to demonstrate…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_JonahDefeat: Though I have lost, my heart remains\ncalm…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_JonahPostBattle: It matters not that I catch nothing.\nThe line remains in the water…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_HenryIntro: Whoops! Don't tell me I snagged\na SURFING POKéMON?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_HenryPostBattle: It'd be a handful if I hooked\nyour tough POKéMON!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_RogerIntro: Well, hey! This is a match between\na POKéMON fan and a fishing buff!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_RogerDefeat: No! My line's all tangled!\nThe party's over!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_RogerPostBattle: My fishing line's doing a dance!\nThe tangle tango! Hahaha, snarl!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_AidanIntro: BIRD POKéMON have excellent vision.\nThey spot prey from great heights.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_AidanPostBattle: There're lots of diving spots in\nthe sea around here.\pYou can spot them easily from the sky\nbecause of their darker color.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_KojiIntro: Run in your bare feet.\nThat will toughen up your soles!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_KojiDefeat: Yowch!\nI got a pebble under a toenail!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_KojiPostBattle: Going barefoot feels great.\nBut your RUNNING SHOES are cool, too.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_KojiRegister: This is what I do to people who beat me!\nI hope we can do this again.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_KojiRematchIntro: I still run in my bare feet daily.\nMy soles are tough!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_KojiPostRematch: Want to go barefoot for a while?\nSo I can try your RUNNING SHOES?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_AthenaIntro: We should have a slow and methodical\nmatch.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_AthenaDefeat: You didn't give me the chance to\ndo any strategizing.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route127_Text_AthenaPostBattle: When I'm surrounded by the blue sea\nand sky, it feels as if time slows down.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_IsaiahIntro: EVER GRANDE CITY is still a long ways\naway…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_IsaiahDefeat: My first victory seems to be far\naway, too…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_IsaiahPostBattle: My whole life has been about losing,\nbut I will never give up!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_IsaiahRegister: I know I'm not good now, but I think\nI can win eventually.\pPlease register me in your POKéNAV.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro: I'm still feeling good. I'll keep on\nswimming to EVER GRANDE CITY.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchDefeat: I've yet to taste my first victory…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_IsaiahPostRematch: I'll eventually reach EVER GRANDE CITY\nwhere I can eventually win…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_KatelynIntro: You have to swim, cycle, and then run\na marathon in a triathlon.\pIt's a grueling race that consists\nof three events.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_KatelynDefeat: A POKéMON battle is grueling, too…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_KatelynPostBattle: I have to ride a BIKE next, but…\nI'm about to throw in the towel…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_KatelynRegister: Well, I may as well make the best\nof this. I'd like a rematch sometime.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_KatelynRematchIntro: A triathlon is long. But I guess the\nroad to become the POKéMON CHAMPION\lis also a long and grueling one.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_KatelynRematchDefeat: A POKéMON battle really is harsh\nand unforgiving…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_KatelynPostRematch: You should give serious thought to\nchallenges on VICTORY ROAD.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_AlexaIntro: We've been working so hard to mount\na POKéMON LEAGUE challenge…\pWe can't afford to lose now!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_AlexaPostBattle: After all I've done to get here,\nI won't give up after one setback.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_RubenIntro: There is no stronger TRAINER than I!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_RubenPostBattle: There probably is no stronger TRAINER\nthan you!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_WayneIntro: I want to visit EVER GRANDE, so I\ncaught myself a POKéMON that knows\lthe move WATERFALL to crest the falls.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_WaynePostBattle: Awww, phooey!\pMy POKéMON knows WATERFALL, but\nI don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_HarrisonIntro: You're looking awfully tough.\nI wonder if I can win?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_HarrisonDefeat: Ouch!\nI guess it was impossible to win.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_HarrisonPostBattle: There are tough TRAINERS galore\naround EVER GRANDE.\pDo you think I may be out\nof my league?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_CarleeIntro: The sunlight seems to be more harsh\nin this area.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_CarleeDefeat: I couldn't see very well because of\nthe sun's glare.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route128_Text_CarleePostBattle: I should go back soon.\nI need to reapply my sunscreen.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route129_Text_ChaseIntro: This is my first triathlon.\nI'm all tense and nervous!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route129_Text_ChasePostBattle: If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to\ngive it my all.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route129_Text_AllisonIntro: I'm in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut, sure, why don't we battle?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route129_Text_AllisonPostBattle: Do you know what's the greatest thing\nabout triathlons?\pTesting the limits of your own\nstrength and endurance against\lMother Nature!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route129_Text_ReedIntro: Say hey, hey!\nLet's get on with it!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route129_Text_ReedPostBattle: There's nothing for a loser.\nTime for me to beat it home.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route129_Text_TishaIntro: What's the hurry?\nLet's take it slow and easy.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route129_Text_TishaDefeat: Oh, my.\nI wanted to relax a little more…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route129_Text_TishaPostBattle: Don't you hate making mistakes when\nyou're in a rush?\pThat's why I try to take things\nslowly.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route129_Text_ClarenceIntro: Surfing isn't as easy as it seems,\nisn't that right?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route129_Text_ClarencePostBattle: You have your sights on the POKéMON\nLEAGUE? Keep at it!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route130_Text_RodneyIntro: What a surprise! I didn't expect to\nsee a TRAINER out in the sea.\pI think we should battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route130_Text_RodneyPostBattle: Your eyes have that look of someone\nwho's experienced harsh challenges\land won. It suits you well!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route130_Text_KatieIntro: In the deep blue sea,\nmy shattered blue heart finds\lcomfort among waves.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route130_Text_KatieDefeat: Like the vast blue sea,\nthe world of POKéMON spans\ldepths beyond belief.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route130_Text_KatiePostBattle: The world's children dream\nof one day becoming\lthe POKéMON CHAMPION.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route130_Text_SantiagoIntro: Floating on the open sea like this…\nIt's peaceful.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route130_Text_SantiagoDefeat: I needed to be a little less peaceful!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route130_Text_SantiagoPostBattle: Swimming and battling like this…\nI'm one happy guy…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_RichardIntro: The sea is teeming with POKéMON.\nIt's not easy swimming, I tell you.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_RichardDefeat: POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are\nseriously tough…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle:
Gasp… Gasp…
I'm wiped out…\pThe going's easy. It's the leaving
that's the hard part.\pWill I have any energy left to make
the return trip?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_HermanIntro: The sea… The sea… The sea…\nThe sea as far as these eyes can see!\lI'm sick and tired of the sea!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_HermanPostBattle: Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.\pI'm a born swimmer!\nThat's what I am.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_SusieIntro: Hi, sweetie, wait!\nWe should battle, you and I!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_SusieDefeat: You're tough in spite of the way\nyou look!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_SusiePostBattle: Did you see a guy over there who whines\nthat he's bored of the sea?\pThat's all talk.\nHe's hopelessly in love with the sea!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_KaraIntro: Why do men love bathing suits so much?\pThey all ogle me!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_KaraPostBattle: Maybe it's not my bathing suit that\nmakes men look. It must be my beauty!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_ReliIntro: RELI: We'll work together as siblings\nto take you on!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_ReliDefeat: RELI: We couldn't win even though we\nworked together…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_ReliPostBattle: RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\ntogether with the sea and POKéMON from\lthe time they are born.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_ReliNotEnoughMons: RELI: You don't have two POKéMON?\nWe can't enjoy a battle, then.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_IanIntro: IAN: I'm doing my best together with\nmy sis!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_IanDefeat: IAN: I did my best with my sis,\nbut we still couldn't win…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_IanPostBattle: IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is\na floating town?\pSo, wherever there is the sea,\nthat's a part of PACIFIDLOG!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_IanNotEnoughMons: IAN: If you have two POKéMON,\nwe'll take you on!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_TaliaIntro: If you can beat me, I'll give you some\ngreat information!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_TaliaPostBattle: There is an odd place nearby.\nThere's a huge tower there.\lWhy don't you go take a look?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_KevinIntro: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\na peaceful bunch.\pThey never get angry.\nThat goes for me, too.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route131_Text_KevinPostBattle: Tch! …Oh, wait.\nI'm not angry. Honestly!\pBut, boy, you're strong!\nHahaha!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_GilbertIntro: I used to catch colds all the time as\na kid, but I became totally fit after\lI started swimming.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_GilbertPostBattle: TRAINERS travel the fields and\nmountains, so they must be fit, too.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_DanaIntro: I try not to swim where the currents\nare too strong.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_DanaPostBattle: If I get swept away, I'll lose all my\nsense of place…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_RonaldIntro: Win or lose, you'll never know until\nyou try!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_RonaldPostBattle: I never battle when I know I'll win.\nI like to battle at the razor's edge of\lvictory and defeat!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_KiyoIntro: I contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day.\nHow could you possibly beat me?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_KiyoPostBattle: Urggh…\nYou're a POKéMON fanatic, aren't you?\pYou must contemplate POKéMON 24 hours\na day, don't you?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_MakaylaIntro: I'm always with my husband,\nbut I can win even without him.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_MakaylaDefeat: Oh, I guess I wasn't good enough.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle: That young man over there looks just\nlike my husband when he was young.\pHe's making me blush!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_JonathanIntro: Someone's been watching me intently.\nWas it you?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_JonathanPostBattle: I can't shake this feeling that\nsomeone's watching me.\pI can't concentrate!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_PaxtonIntro: Now where could my wife have gone?\nI'm always with her.\lI wonder if I can win on my own.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_PaxtonDefeat: Ah, I see that I couldn't manage\nto win on my own after all.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_PaxtonPostBattle: My wife must be looking for me.\nI'd best go find her right away.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_DarcyIntro: I liked training here by myself.\nIt's awful that all these people came!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_DarcyDefeat: Okay! I won't complain about other\npeople being here.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route132_Text_DarcyPostBattle: I suppose I can partner up with that\nold man and challenge that other team.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_FranklinIntro: Did the currents carry you here, too?\nThis must have been fated.\lLet's battle!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_FranklinPostBattle: It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER\nlike you would drift here…\lI must be cursed…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_DebraIntro: I've led a life of woe and misery…\nI've been cast away, and this is where\lI've drifted…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_DebraPostBattle: A life adrift…\nI don't want it anymore!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_LindaPostBattle: A strong child TRAINER…\nThat's so annoying!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_WarrenIntro: I want to win like everyone else, but I\nwon't raise POKéMON like everyone else.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_WarrenDefeat: Darn it!\nMy way is still too slack!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_WarrenPostBattle: It's way more fun to do things the way\nI want than to be like everybody else.\lI mean, that's obvious!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_BeckIntro: I came all the way out here with my\nBIRD POKéMON.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_BeckPostBattle: I'd like to go back to FORTREE,\nbut I've grown to like this place, too.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_MollieIntro: I must have battled thousands\nof times. I've lost count.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_MollieDefeat: I may have lost thousands of times,\nbut a loss still stings.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_MolliePostBattle: Keep at this, youngster. So you can\nbecome like my husband and me.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_ConorIntro: Young people are too happy to go with\nthe flow. They're without direction.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_ConorDefeat: You have a firm sense of purpose.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route133_Text_ConorPostBattle: Don't let others lead you astray.\nDon't lose direction as you grow older.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_JackIntro: Even those POKéMON that can swim are\ncarried along by the rapid currents.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_JackPostBattle: I think POKéMON enjoy the fast-running\ncurrents around these parts.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_LaurelIntro: My LUVDISC are looking for a fun\nmatch. Will you join us?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_LaurelPostBattle: There's a collector who's after\nthe SCALES of LUVDISC.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_AlexIntro: Okeydokey! That's enough rest, gang!\nIt's time for a match!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_AlexPostBattle: My BIRD POKéMON get tired quickly after\na long flight…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_HitoshiIntro: You're a POKéMON TRAINER.\nNo need for words. We battle now.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_HitoshiPostBattle: It was I who challenged you, and yet\nI lost. I am deeply shamed…$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_AaronIntro: The savage tide in this area serves to\nmake us stronger than ever.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_AaronPostBattle: We will return for more training at\nMETEOR FALLS.\pIf you'd like, you should go, too.\nIt will definitely toughen you up!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_KelvinIntro: O-our boat!\nThe tide carried it away!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_KelvinPostBattle: If we can't SURF, how are we supposed\nto get home?\pActually, I know a fainted POKéMON\ncan still SURF, but it feels wrong.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_MarleyIntro: Can your POKéMON dodge our\nlightning-quick attacks?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_MarleyDefeat: I never knew such a technique existed!\nYou've defeated us thoroughly.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_MarleyPostBattle: I haven't lost my passion for speed.\nI will try harder.$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_ReynaIntro: My POKéMON can't be taken down\neasily!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_ReynaPostBattle: Haha!\nYou won, all right!\pI'll work my way back up by taking on\nTRAINERS I happen to meet!$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_HudsonIntro: Listen, have you seen another SAILOR\naround here?$
data/text/trainers.inc.Route134_Text_HudsonPostBattle: Our boat drifted out to sea.\pMy buddy's a timid fellow, so I'm\nworried about him.$
data/text/trainers.inc.VSSeeker_Text_BatteryNotChargedNeedXStep: The battery isn't charged enough.\pNo. of steps required to fully\ncharge the battery: {STR_VAR_1}{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$
data/text/trainers.inc.VSSeeker_Text_NoTrainersWithinRange: There are no Trainers within range\nwho can battle…\pThe VS Seeker was turned off.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$
data/text/trainers.inc.VSSeeker_Text_TrainersNotReady: The other Trainers don't appear\nto be ready for battle.\pLet's wait till later.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$

data/text/trainers_frlg.inc.Route14_Text_CarterRematchIntro: I used TMs to teach good moves\nto my POKéMON.$

data/text/tv.inc.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_Interview:
Oh, hello! You were in a POKéMON
CONTEST, weren't you?\lIt's easy to tell from your POKéMON.\pI'm a reporter. I'm working on a story
on POKéMON CONTESTS.\pIf I may, would you be willing to answer
a few questions?$
data/text/tv.inc.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_DescribeC: Oh, you will?\nThank you.\pBriefly, how would you describe the\nCONTEST you just entered?$
data/text/tv.inc.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhatImage:
Ah, I see.
That's a very edifying comment.\pYou get a good feel for what
the CONTEST was like.\pI've got one last question.\pWhen you hear the word “{STR_VAR_2},”
what image do you get?$
data/text/tv.inc.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ThatsAllF:
I see!\pSo that's how you imagine the concept
of “{STR_VAR_2}” to be.\pThank you!
You've given me some good ideas.\pI think I can write a good story on
POKéMON CONTESTS now.\pMaybe, just maybe, this story will even
make it to television.\lI hope you'll look forward to it!$
data/text/tv.inc.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PleaseDoS: Oh, too bad…\pWell, if you come across a good story,\nplease do share it with me.$
data/text/tv.inc.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LookingFo: I'll be looking forward to your next\nPOKéMON CONTEST.$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVBravoTrainerText00:
Yeah!
It's BRAVO TRAINER time!\pToday, we're going to profile a POKéMON
belonging to {STR_VAR_1}.\pNow, this POKéMON boasts a {STR_VAR_3}
Rank in the {STR_VAR_2} Category.$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVBravoTrainerText01: Introducing {STR_VAR_2} the\n{STR_VAR_1}!\pThe nickname {STR_VAR_2}…\pEven the nickname exudes an air that\nproclaims “{STR_VAR_3}”!$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVBravoTrainerText02: Anyway, when the TRAINER {STR_VAR_1}\nentered the POKéMON in a CONTEST,\lwe managed to get a few impassioned\lquotes about the trusty partner.$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVBravoTrainerText03:
Asked about the CONTEST afterwards,
{STR_VAR_1} happily replied with a huge\lgrin, “{STR_VAR_2}!”\pWell, sure, {STR_VAR_1}'s POKéMON came in
number {STR_VAR_3} in the CONTEST.\pThat line perfectly suits {STR_VAR_1}
right now, I'd say!$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVBravoTrainerText04:
Asked about the CONTEST afterwards,
{STR_VAR_1} replied with a tinge of\lbitterness, “{STR_VAR_2}.”\pWell, sure, {STR_VAR_1}'s POKéMON came in
number {STR_VAR_3} in the CONTEST.\p{STR_VAR_1}'s disappointment comes across
loud and clear, I'd say!$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVBravoTrainerText05:

data/text/tv.inc.gTVSafariFanClubText07: The TRAINER does use ポロックS.\nUsed {STR_VAR_2} that time, I think.\pBut, boy, I wish the TRAINER would\nget a bit better at this.$

data/text/tv.inc.ContestLiveUpdates_Text_TookBreak: Spectator: Even when the {STR_VAR_2}\ntook a break from making appeals,\lI couldn't take my eyes off it.\pI'm captivated by that {STR_VAR_2}.$
data/text/tv.inc.ContestLiveUpdates_Text_GotStartled: Spectator: When the {STR_VAR_2} was\nstartled by another POKéMON's appeal,\lI was close to tears.\p{STR_VAR_2}, you were resilient!\nWay to go!$
data/text/tv.inc.ContestLiveUpdates_Text_MoveWonderful: Spectator: Oh…\nThat {STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}!\l{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}!\l{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}!\lHow could it be so wonderful?$
data/text/tv.inc.ContestLiveUpdates_Text_TalkAboutAnother: MC: Well, there you have it. This place\nis full of the {STR_VAR_1}'s fans!\pI should also mention that another\nPOKéMON, {STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}, \lcaught my eye.\p{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}…$
data/text/tv.inc.ContestLiveUpdates_Text_FailedToAppeal: It failed to make a single appeal during\nsecondary judging out of nervousness.\pNext time, I would like to see this\n{STR_VAR_1} make even one appeal.$
data/text/tv.inc.ContestLiveUpdates_Text_LastInBothRounds: It came dead last in both primary\nand secondary judging.\pI hope that {STR_VAR_1} will retrain this\n{STR_VAR_2} and erase the shame of\lthis undisputed last-place finish.$
data/text/tv.inc.ContestLiveUpdates_Text_NotExcitingEnoug: It failed to take advantage of\nthe audience's excitement and make\lan appropriate appeal.\pWe hope {STR_VAR_1} will learn how to get\na feel for the audience and whip their\lexcitement to a fever pitch next time.$
data/text/tv.inc.ContestLiveUpdates_Text_LostAfterWinning:
While finishing first in the primary
judging, its appeals in the secondary\ljudging failed to click.\pIt suffered a humiliating come-from-
behind loss.\pI'm sure {STR_VAR_1} is studying how to
make more effective appeals now.$
data/text/tv.inc.ContestLiveUpdates_Text_NeverExciting: The audience never got excited by its\nappeals during the secondary judging.\pWe hope it will stop worrying about\nother POKéMON and learn to pitch\lits appeals to the audience more.$
data/text/tv.inc.ContestLiveUpdates_Text_RepeatedAppeals:
It disappointed the JUDGE by
repeating the same appeals.\pIt's an unforgivable error in any
CONTEST, and the POKéMON paid.\p{STR_VAR_1} should feel guilty for
this sorry showing.$
data/text/tv.inc.ContestLiveUpdates_Text_ValiantEffortBut: {STR_VAR_1} turned in a valiant effort,\nbut…\pIt was all for naught, finishing last.\p{STR_VAR_1} should learn from this loss\nand put the knowledge to good use.$
data/text/tv.inc.ContestLiveUpdates_Text_Outro:
I'd like to end this program with our
usual farewell to the winners.\pThis time, it's {STR_VAR_1} and
the {STR_VAR_2}!\pMC: Is everyone ready?
All together now!\pAudience: {STR_VAR_1}! {STR_VAR_2}!
Congratulations!\lYou're the CONTEST winner!$
