data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyPreFirstBattle: GABBY: Oh! We've just spotted a tough-\nlooking TRAINER here of all places!\pOkay, roll camera!\nLet's get this interview.$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyIntro: GABBY: Oh! You're {PLAYER}! Hi!\nDo you remember us from last time?\pCan you show us how much stronger\nyou've become? Okay, cue interview!$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyDefeatFirstTime: GABBY: My eyes didn't lie!\nI did discover an astonishing TRAINER!$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_WhoAreYouInterview:
GABBY: Awesome! Awesome!
Who are you?!\pI knew we were onto something wild
when we spotted you!\pOh, please let me explain. We travel
around everywhere interviewing all\lsorts of TRAINERS.\pSo, would you give us a bit of your time
for an interview?$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_QuoteFromLastInterview: GABBY: “{STR_VAR_1}!”\pRemember? That's the quote you gave\nus as the battle clincher last time.\pI never, ever forget stuff like that!$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_YouStompedUsInterviewAga: The last time we battled, you stomped\nus before we could brace ourselves…\pAnyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_YouThrewABallAtUsIntervi:
The last time we battled, didn't you
throw a POKé BALL at us?\pWe were shocked! So we told everyone,
just everyone, about it!\pAnyway, what do you think?
Do you want to be interviewed again?$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_CleverItemSkillsIntervie: The last time we battled, your item\nskills cleverly did us in.\pAnyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_WeLookedRespectableInter: The last time we battled, we managed\nto look respectable.\pAnyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_InterviewAgain: Anyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_DescribeYourFeelings: You will?\nThank you!\pOkay, I need you to describe your\nfeelings about our battle, but it\lhas to be short and sweet. Go!$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_PerfectWellBeSeeingYou:
GABBY: Mmm, yeah!
That's the perfect clincher!\pI get the feeling that this will make
a great TV show.\pThere's a chance that they'll air this
on TV, so make sure to look for us!\pOkay!
We'll be seeing you!$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_DontGiveUpKeepingEyeOut: GABBY: Oh…\pOkay, but don't give up!\nWe'll be keeping an eye out for you!$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_KeepingAnEyeOutForYou: GABBY: We'll be keeping an eye out\nfor you!$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyNotEnoughMons: GABBY: Is there a strong TRAINER\nanywhere with a lot of POKéMON?$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_GiveUsAnInterviewThisTim:
GABBY: Wow, you are something!\pYou've gotten a lot stronger--a lot--
since we last battled.\pWe were right about you when we
spotted you as a hot TRAINER.\pSo, anyway, what do you think?
Are you willing to give us an interview\lthis time?$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyDefeat: GABBY: That was an intense battle!\nDid you get all that on camera?$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_TyPreFirstBattle: TY: Hey, lookie here! A tough-looking\nTRAINER here, of all places!\lCamera's rolling!$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_TyIntro: TY: Hey, lookie here!\nI remember you!\pI'll get this battle all on this\nhere camera!$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_TyPostBattle: TY: You're a natural!\nGot me some prime footage right here!$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_TyNotEnoughMons: TY: Do you only have the one POKéMON\nand that's it?\pIf you had more POKéMON, it'd make for\nbetter footage, but…$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_TyDefeatFirstTime: TY: Yep, we sure spotted a hot TRAINER.\nThis is a huge scoop for us!$
data/text/tv.inc.GabbyAndTy_Text_TyDefeat: TY: Yep, I got it all.\nThat whole battle's on camera.$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVInSearchOfTrainersText00:
IN SEARCH OF TRAINERS…\pGABBY: Hi! Today I'm visiting an area
near {STR_VAR_1}.\pWe're trying to spot some up-and-
coming new talent in the field.\pToday, we turned our lens on the
TRAINER {PLAYER}.\pThere's something about this TRAINER
that piqued our interest.$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVInSearchOfTrainersText01: We've battled {PLAYER} before, but we\ncan attest that the TRAINER has most\ldefinitely improved from before.\pI knew we were onto someone special\nwhen we spotted this TRAINER!$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVInSearchOfTrainersText02:
The best way to determine how strong
a TRAINER is…\pWell, the fastest way is to battle.
And so we began our investigation!\p… …\pThat's how we ended up in battle
with {PLAYER}.\pIn a dominating performance, we were
flattened, rolled up, and tossed aside!\p{PLAYER} is ruthlessly strong…\pHere's our impressions after having
battled our featured TRAINER.$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVInSearchOfTrainersText03:
The combination of {STR_VAR_1} and
{STR_VAR_3} was divine!\pThe sight of them--{STR_VAR_1} and
{STR_VAR_3}--selflessly supporting\leach other in the thick of battle…\pIt was a marvelous sight to behold!\p{STR_VAR_2} was the move the TRAINER
used last in our battle.\pThe move {STR_VAR_2} is {STR_VAR_1}
and {STR_VAR_3}'s sign of friendship!$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVInSearchOfTrainersText04:
…I lost confidence in myself as
a result of our encounter.\pWe were beaten before we could launch
a single attack.\lOhhh… Snivel…\pIn spite of that, {PLAYER}'s battles
are worth seeing.\pI recommend confident TRAINERS to
challenge {PLAYER}.$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVInSearchOfTrainersText05:
There's only one thing to be said.
Don't you dare throw a POKé BALL during\la TRAINER battle!\p{PLAYER} is certainly strong, but has
no clue about the basic rules.\pTo our TV audience, I have a request.\pIf you see {PLAYER}, please caution
the TRAINER!$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVInSearchOfTrainersText06: {PLAYER} is adept at reading the\nopponent's actions.\pThe timing of item usage was remarkably\neffective!$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVInSearchOfTrainersText07:
Honestly speaking, I thought that
I might even be pretty good.\pWhile we did end up losing, we did have
a hotly contested battle.\pBut if you're struggling against me,
you have a ways to go, {PLAYER}!$
data/text/tv.inc.gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08:
After our battle, we asked {PLAYER} for
a succinct summary.\pThe TRAINER replied, “{STR_VAR_1}.”\p{PLAYER}'s POKéMON {STR_VAR_2} and
{STR_VAR_3}…\lAnd “{STR_VAR_1}”…\pMmm! That's deep! There's deep
significance behind that quote!\pIt's no surprise--a good TRAINER has
good things to say.\pThat's all for today!
See you again on our next broadcast!$
